attribution: "Beef Pasties" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Beef_Pasties, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups (400 g) cubed cooking roast beef, in ¼-inch (65 mm) pieces
½ cup (120 mL) diced cooked onion
Pastry for double crust pie (9-inch or 22 cm)

steps: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C).
Combine beef, potatoes, broth, onion, parsley, thyme, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out ¼ of the pastry into an 8-inch (20 cm) circle.
Mound 1 cup (240 mL) of filling on half of circle.
Moisten edge of pastry with water.
Fold dough over filling. Crimp edges with fork to seal.
Place on ungreased baking sheet.
Repeat with remaining pastry and filling.
Cut slits in top of each completed pastry.
Brush tops with cream.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

name: Beef Stew II
attribution: "Beef Stew II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Beef_Stew_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 500 g (1 lb) beef suitable for soup/stew, cut into cubes and trimmed of fat and gristle
100–125 g (approx. ¼ lb) frozen carrots, sliced
100–125 g (approx. ¼ lb) frozen mushrooms, sliced

steps: Mix the flour, salt, pepper, and garlic powder together in a small bowl.
Heat a large saucepan on the stovetop, then add olive oil and chopped onion.
Dredge the beef cubes in the flour mixture and drop them into the saucepan; reserve the remaining flour mixture. Brown the beef on all sides.
Pour in the broth and add the remaining flour mixture, the potatoes, carrots, mushrooms, tomatoes, marjoram and bay leaf/leaves.
Once it has come to a boil, reduce the heat to the lowest setting, cover, and simmer for an hour or more, until the beef and potatoes are tender.

name: Beef Stir-Fry
attribution: "Beef Stir-Fry" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Beef_Stir-Fry, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 (6–8 oz / 170–225 g) ribeye steak, sliced thinly across the grain on a bias
½ large carrot, peeled and julienned

steps: Lightly oil the bottom of a wok or large skillet and preheat over medium-high heat. Add onion and garlic, and cook, stirring, until the garlic turns golden. Remove from the pan and keep warm.
Sprinkle the beef slices with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Add 4 slices to the hot wok and stir-fry until well browned and no longer pink. Remove and repeat with the remaining beef.
Add chilis, carrots, soy sauce, honey, vinegar, and scallions to the wok. Stir-fry until the vegetables are lightly browned around the edges.
Return the cooked onion, garlic, and beef to the wok. Toss together until heated through.
Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds before serving.

name: Beef Tongue with Chiles, Corn and Tomato (Lengua de Res)
attribution: "Beef Tongue with Chiles, Corn and Tomato (Lengua de Res)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Beef_Tongue_with_Chiles,_Corn_and_Tomato_(Lengua_de_Res), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cans (30 ounces) whole kernel corn, drained

steps: Wash tongue and place in a large pot of water to cover. Simmer until no longer pink (about 50 minutes per pound of tongue). Remove from water and let rest until cool enough to handle. Peel skin from tongue and trim gristle. Cut into ½-inch slices.
Place whole peppers in a skillet over medium-high heat and roast, turning, until all sides are charred. Let cool, rub off skins. Remove stems and seeds.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Sauté chili peppers, onion, and garlic until onion is translucent.
Stir in tongue and continue to cook until tongue is brown, 5 to 10 minutes. Stir in tomatoes and cook until limp, 5 minutes. Pour in corn and heat through, 2 to 5 minutes.
Season with salt, and serve.

name: Beef Yakiniku Pizza
attribution: "Beef Yakiniku Pizza" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Beef_Yakiniku_Pizza, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ red capsicum, cut into 10 pieces
600 g tenderloin beef, cut into 2 x 1 x 1 cm pieces
2 tbsp cornstarch, dissolved with 20 ml water

steps: Combine flours, yeast, sugar, water, and salt to make a dough.
Cover with plastic wrap, and rest the dough 10 minutes until expanded.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan. Add the onion and capsicum, and sauté for 10 seconds.
Add the tenderloin and the water. Add the mirin, soy sauce, and oyster sauce.
Add the dissolved cornflour, salt, and sugar. Stir until well-mixed and slightly thickened.
Separate the solids from the extra sauce. Reserve the sauce to serve with the pizza.
Roll out the pizza dough to a 10 cm diameter. Spread the meat topping on top.
Bake pizza in the oven at 220°C for 20 minutes.
Serve hot with the dipping sauces.

name: Beer Batter
attribution: "Beer Batter" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Beer_Batter, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Stir together dry ingredients.
Stir in beer.
Mix together thoroughly.
Use in preparation of onion blooms.

name: Beer Bread
attribution: "Beer Bread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Beer_Bread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Grease a 9×5×3-inch loaf pan
Mix flour, salt, and baking powder together well.
Combine beer and honey, then add to the dry ingredients. Stir together until well mixed. Add more flour if necessary to make a good consistency.
Spread batter in prepared pan.
Bake 40–45 minutes until browned and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Serve warm.

name: Beer Marinated Shrimp
attribution: "Beer Marinated Shrimp" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Beer_Marinated_Shrimp, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine onion, garlic, shrimp, and beer in a plastic or glass bowl.
Add as much Tabasco as you'd like (start with 1 tbsp) and some salt and pepper to taste.
Cover and marinate overnight.
Remove shrimp from marinade, and discard marinade.
Melt some butter in a pan and sauté shrimp until pink and done. Don't overcook the shrimp or they'll be rubbery. You can also grill the shrimp.

name: Beer-can Chicken
attribution: "Beer-can Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Beer-can_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 recipe spice rub (or use your own recipe)

steps: Poke holes all over chicken to let fat run out during cooking.
Rub chicken thoroughly with spice rub: inside and out, and then under skin as far as you can reach
Set aside chicken.
Remove upper racks from oven.
Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
When oven preheated, take a healthy drink of the beer, leaving about 9–10 ounces.
Crumble bay leaves into beer, in beer can.
Insert beer can firmly into chicken cavity.
Place chicken upright in shallow heatproof pan.
Bake chicken upright for 1–1.5 hours until thickest part is 165°F (73°C).
When removing chicken from oven, keep upright.
Rest chicken upright 15 minutes before removing beer can.

name: Bell Pepper Chili
attribution: "Bell Pepper Chili" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bell_Pepper_Chili, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Put beef in a large pot.
Fry on medium, breaking up the beef, until it turns brown. Drain grease.
Add peppers and onions to the pot.
Fry until the onions are transparent. Drain grease if necessary.
Add crushed tomatoes. Simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
Add kidney beans. Simmer for an additional 10 minutes.
Add chili powder and garlic salt to taste.
Serve over white rice. Optionally, top with shredded cheddar cheese.

name: Bengal Potatoes
attribution: "Bengal Potatoes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bengal_Potatoes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Approximately 2 lb potatoes, unpeeled and cut into chunks
Chile powder (preferably not too hot—e.g. Kashmiri chile )

steps: Put a little ghee into a large heavy-bottomed pan with a good lid over medium heat.
Add panch puran, and let it cook gently until the seeds start to pop.
Add potatoes to pan, stirring so that the seeds coat the potatoes evenly.
Add a little ground turmeric—enough to just color the cut surfaces of all the pieces.
Add a little chile powder to taste. The quantity varies depending on your palate, and the strength of the chile.
Stir well to distribute the spices.
Do one of the following:

*Put on the lid, turn down the heat, and allow the potatoes to cook in their own steam until cooked through. A little extra water can be added if necessary, but as little as possible should be used. The potatoes should not boil.
*Put the spiced potatoes on a tray in a hot oven until cooked through.

name: Betty's Salad
attribution: "Betty's Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Betty's_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1–2 cans water chestnuts, drained and sliced (optional, depending on the recipe you follow)
¼ teaspoon salt, or to taste

steps: Layer the salad ingredients in the order listed.
Mix all the dressing ingredients in blender. Pour over salad.
Store salad in fridge.

name: Beurre Blanc
attribution: "Beurre Blanc" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Beurre_Blanc, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup of good white wine (dry aromatic white, preferably French, such as Pouilly-Fumé)
10–12 Tbsp unsalted butter, very cold and in cubes or lumps

steps: Place the white wine in a non-reactive saucepan with the lemon juice and chopped shallots.

Cook this mixture until reduced to about 2 tablespoons, and don't be shy about letting it boil—it will not adversely affect the sauce. Once reduced, the shallot should still be fairly moist. If you're looking at a dry pan, there's a good chance your sauce won't hold.
Reduce heat to low flame. If you want to increase the holding power of your sauce, add the heavy cream at this juncture, but every authority on traditional French preparation would disapprove.

Begin to add cubes of the cold butter while whisking vigorously. From a technical standpoint, the sauce should stay under 200°F (95°C), so do some of the whisking off the flame. Whisk in 1 or 2 cubes and add more, and continue until you've added all the butter.
Season with salt and white pepper, and serve immediately. The sauce can be held in a vacuum container, such a Thermos, but this is not recommended for long periods of time.

name: Beurre Manié
attribution: "Beurre Manié" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Beurre_Mani%C3%A9, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine the butter and flour in a mixing bowl.
Use your hands or a small utensil such as a fork/spoon to knead the flour into the butter until fully and evenly incorporated.
Use immediately or store as indicated in the notes.

name: Beurre Monté
attribution: "Beurre Monté" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Beurre_Mont%C3%A9, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 8 parts by weight of butter, cold

steps: Bring the water to a low boil in an appropriately sized cooking vessel, such as a saucepan.
Add butter, gradually whisking until smoothly incorporated. Make sure the butter is completely emulsified in before adding the next chunk.
Season to taste as desired.
Keep warm until use. Don't overheat, as this will break the emulsion.

name: Beurre à la Bourguignonne (Garlic Scallion Butter)
attribution: "Beurre à la Bourguignonne (Garlic Scallion Butter)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Beurre_%C3%A0_la_Bourguignonne_(Garlic_Scallion_Butter), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1–3 cloves garlic, mashed or grated with a microplane

steps: Cream the butter until it is very soft.
Beat the shallots, garlic and parsley into the butter.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

name: Bhuna Khichuri (Bengali Rice and Lentils)
attribution: "Bhuna Khichuri (Bengali Rice and Lentils)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bhuna_Khichuri_(Bengali_Rice_and_Lentils), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup white fragrant rice (e.g Basmati rice or short-grained pilau rice)
1 cup green gram or red split lentils
½ cup split dried chickpeas (preferably Bengal variety; optional)
2 whole green chiles, slit in the middle and optionally de-seeded
2 cm piece of ginger, finely chopped
1 medium or 2 small onions, thinly sliced
1 bunch coarsely chopped fresh coriander leaves

steps: Rinse rice, lentils, and chickpeas separately in cold water.
Dry rice in a colander or on a flat surface.
Leave lentils and chickpeas to soak in water for 30 minutes.
Drain lentils and chickpeas, then roast them briefly until they emit an aroma; set aside to cool.
Heat water in a kettle to use later. Keep warm but not boiling.
Semi-crush cardamom, cinnamon, and cloves.

Heat 2 tbsp butter in a heavy-based pan over medium heat. Add bay leaf and semi-crushed spices in; once they start to sputter, add sliced ginger and cumin. Stir for 1–2 minutes until ginger has a nutty aroma.
Add green chili and garden peas, and stir once or twice.
Add rice to the mixture and stir gently for 2–3 minutes, making sure the oil coats it thoroughly.
Add lentils, chickpeas and salt; stir again for 1–2 more minutes

Add hot water to the pan. The level of water should be about 1 inch above the mixture. Lower the heat slightly, cover, and simmer until done. Check regularly to make sure rice does not burn at the bottom. Rice and lentils are done when there is no hard part in rice, it is medium firm, each one is easily separable, but not very soft or sticky. This should take around 10 minutes.
While the rice is simmering, heat the remaining butter in a separate frying pan. Fry the onion on a medium heat until it starts to brown.
When rice mixture is done, top with onion and accompanying oil. Garnish with coriander.
Turn down the heat to the lowest and cover until served which should not take long.

name: Bibimbap
attribution: "Bibimbap" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bibimbap, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 8 oz bean sprouts, with beans attached
¾–1 ½ cup white rice, steamed

steps: Cut the carrots into matchsticks.
Boil matchsticks in a covered pot of salted water for a few minutes. Drain.
Rinse carrots with cold water until cool. Drain again, then put in a bowl.
Add the sesame oil, ground sesame seeds, grated garlic, and salt. Toss together with your fingers.
Put the spinach in a large covered pot with 1 inch of water.
Bring to a boil and cook as usual. Stir occasionally to keep the spinach from sticking to the pot. The spinach is done when it's dark green and reduced to a small fraction of its original volume.
Drain the cooked spinach. Cool by adding cold water to the pot and drain again. Squeeze the spinach in your hands to remove the water.
Slice the cooked spinach into 1-inch pieces.
Put the cooked spinach in a bowl with the sesame oil, ground sesame seeds, and grated garlic. Mix with your fingers.
Blanch the bean sprouts in a pot of salted water until they become clear.
Drain the cooked sprouts, and transfer to a bowl.
Toss with sesame oil, ground sesame seeds, grated garlic, and salt.
Slice the steak thinly, but not paper-thin.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan on high heat. When the oil is hot, but not smoking, add the beef. Stir-fry.
While the beef is cooking, add the sesame oil, ground sesame seeds, and grated garlic. Cook until the meat is well browned.
Add the soy sauce. Continue cooking until the liquid has boiled off.
Place rice in each bowl.

Arrange the prepared namuls, beef soboro, cucumbers, and egg on top of the rice. They should be arranged separately and attractively. The egg sits in the middle. Gochujang, kimchi, and any other root or leafy vegetable is served on the side in small individual bowls for the table to help themselves.
Rub the inside of the dolsots with sesame oil.
Spread the cooked rice evenly over the bottom of the dolsots and part way up the sides. Place the namurus and the beef soboro on top of the rice, each in its own area.

Cover the dolsots and cook over medium-high heat. Watch carefully near the end to avoid burning the rice on the bottom. To test, use a spoon to scrape the rice from the side. Remember that the bottom cooks more than the sides and that the rice keeps cooking after you remove it from the heat. Do not preheat the dolsots.
Add an uncooked egg to the middle of each dolsot.
Serve dolsots on small pieces of wood to keep the heat from damaging the table.

name: Bicol Express
attribution: "Bicol Express" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bicol_Express, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat a frying pan over medium heat, then add the cooking oil.
When the oil is hot, add the onion and garlic. Sauté until fragrant and aromatic.
Add the shrimp paste, siling labuyo and the pork belly. Stir fry the mixture until the pork is browned on all sides.
Add the sugar, pepper, and monosodium glutamate if using.
Stir in the coconut milk, and simmer until the meat is cooked through.

name: Binagoongan (Sautéed Pork with Shrimp Paste)
attribution: "Binagoongan (Sautéed Pork with Shrimp Paste)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Binagoongan_(Saut%C3%A9ed_Pork_with_Shrimp_Paste), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Fry pork pieces in hot oil.
Sauté garlic, onions and tomatoes after pork has browned.
Add shrimp.
Add the rest of the ingredients and let simmer until pork is tender. If desired, let water reduce.
Serve with rice.

name: Bint as-Saḥn (Yemenite Layered Pastry)
attribution: "Bint as-Saḥn (Yemenite Layered Pastry)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bint_as-Sa%E1%B8%A5n_(Yemenite_Layered_Pastry), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup warm margarine (or melted butter)

steps: Combine the yeast and warm water. Stir in the warm milk.
Stir the salt, sugar, vegetable oil, and eggs into the yeast mixture.
Mix the flour and semolina into the above mixture. Knead well to make a dough.
Cover dough and let it sit until dough rises.
Divide the dough into pieces the size of your hand, and transfer to a flour-dusted surface to prevent sticking.
Work each dough ball, stretching and folding the dough over itself multiple times. This stretching and folding process helps produce an airy and light-textured dough.
Let dough balls rest for 10–15 minutes.
Prepare a flat working surface by rubbing it with some margarine. Roll out one piece of dough into a very thin round.
Brush the dough round with margarine, then lightly sprinkle with crushed almonds, pistachios, black cumin, and sesame seeds.

Roll another piece of dough into a thin round. Stack on top of the first round, then brush with margarine and sprinkle with more almonds, pistachios, etc. Repeat this step, stacking the rounds, until all the dough is used up.
Bake the stacked dough in oven. Serve with honey.

name: Biscuit Cake
attribution: "Biscuit Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Biscuit_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pound butter, softened and cut in pieces

steps: Beat together the eggs, butter, and sugar until very creamy.
Combine the flour, nutmeg, and caraway seeds.
Add the dry mixture to the egg mixture, and beat for 1 hour.
Transfer to a pan, and bake for 1 hour. Let cool and unmold.

name: Biscuits and Gravy
attribution: "Biscuits and Gravy" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Biscuits_and_Gravy, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ tbsp (4 mL) ground black pepper

steps: Make 'cut' biscuit dough.
Place the cut biscuits in the oven when you add the bacon grease to the skillet in the gravy procedure below (step 3).
Remove from oven after 10 to 12 minutes; the biscuits should be warm when served with the gravy.
Brown the sausage in a large skillet.
Remove the browned sausage from the skillet and reserve in a bowl, being careful to leave as much of the drippings as possible in the pan.
Add the bacon grease to the skillet, and place the skillet on low to medium-low heat.
Once the bacon grease is up to temperature, mix the flour into the grease.
Add the milk slowly, mixing as you pour.
Bring to a gentle boil, stirring constantly scraping the bottom and edges of the skillet. Stirring keeps the gravy from becoming too lumpy or burnt.
Continue stirring until the gravy has nearly reached the desired consistency, usually about 10 minutes.
Add the browned sausage held in reserve.
Remove from heat and allow to set for 1 minute.
Serve with biscuits.

name: Biscuits II
attribution: "Biscuits II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Biscuits_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup (140 g / 4.9 oz) all-purpose flour, plus extra for dusting

steps: Preheat the oven to 200 C.
Sift flour, salt and baking powder twice in a bowl.
Cut butter in with a knife until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Add milk to the mixture and mix just until you get a soft dough—don't overmix.
Place dough on a floured board. Knead the dough gently until smooth. Roll out to ½ inch (1.3 cm) thick.
Cut out biscuits with a small cutter and place biscuits onto a greased pan.
If you have scraps of dough, knead into a ball, re-roll, and cut out more biscuits.
Bake for 15 minutes until nicely browned. Transfer the biscuits to a wire rack and leave it to cool.

name: Biscuits III
attribution: "Biscuits III" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Biscuits_III, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat the oven to 220 C. Grease a baking pan.
Beat the egg and milk together in a bowl.
Mix the other ingredients into the egg mixture to form a soft dough.
Roll out the dough to 5 mm and cut out into very thin biscuits with a round cookie cutter.
Place the biscuits on the baking pan.
Bake for 6 minutes until golden.
Take the biscuits out of the oven and leave them to cool.

name: Bison Loaf
attribution: "Bison Loaf" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bison_Loaf, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1½ cups soft bread crumbs (from about 2 slices of bread) or ½ cup fine dry bread crumbs

steps: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients together.
Form meat mixture into a loaf or pat into a lightly-oiled loaf pan.
Bake in a 300°F (150°C) oven for 45 minutes until internal temperature reaches 160°F (72°C).

name: Bison Meatballs Baked in Hoisin Sauce (Marvin)
attribution: "Bison Meatballs Baked in Hoisin Sauce (Marvin)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bison_Meatballs_Baked_in_Hoisin_Sauce_(Marvin), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Oil the bottom of a 9x12-inch Pyrex baking dish.
Thinly slice the onion to create long thin slices.
Microwave the onion slices and garlic on high for 5 minutes.
Grind the cumin, coriander, peppercorns, cloves, and salt together using a mortar and pestle.
Roughly mix the softened onions and garlic, bison, rice, spice grind, fish sauce, and basil.
Shape the meat mixture into tapered cylinders (similar to small sweet potatoes) and place into the baking dish. The Marvins should be about 1¼ inch diameter in the middle and 5 inches long.
Coat the Marvins with hoisin sauce.
Bake for 20–25 minutes in the preheated oven.

name: Black Bean Chili
attribution: "Black Bean Chili" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Black_Bean_Chili, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tablespoons (30 mL) corn oil or other vegetable oil
2 tablespoons (30 mL) wine vinegar (red or white)

steps: Place beans in a large pot, add with enough water to cover by 2 inches (2.5 cm), and allow to soak overnight. Drain beans and cover again with fresh water. Bring to boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 2 hours.

Heat the corn oil in a stockpot or other very large pot over medium-high heat. Add the onions and sauté until tender, about 3 minutes. Add garlic, chipotle and ancho chiles, cumin, paprika, oregano, salt, cayenne, and vinegar, and sauté for 5 to 10 minutes.
Add tomatoes, tomato puree, and the water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Add the beans with their juice. Simmer for 1 hour.
Serve with or without sour cream.

name: Black Bean Soup
attribution: "Black Bean Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Black_Bean_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Pick over the beans.
Place in large bean pot and add water to cover by at least 2 inches (~5 cm).
Soak overnight, then change water.
Bring beans to a boil. Reduce heat, then simmer until beans start to soften, around ½ hour.
Add bay leaves, bell peppers, chili powder, cumin, garlic, jalapeños, onions, and red wine vinegar.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer ½ to 1 hour, until beans are soft.
Take out bay leaves.
Stir in cilantro.
Add some sour cream.
Serve.

name: Black Bean Soup and Salsa Verde
attribution: "Black Bean Soup and Salsa Verde" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Black_Bean_Soup_and_Salsa_Verde, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cans (840 g / 31 ounces) black beans, drained
1 cup Mexican salsa verde, or to taste
¼ cup packed cilantro leaves, plus extra sprigs for garnish (optional)

steps: Purée all ingredients in a blender until smooth.
Pour into a large saucepan or Dutch oven, and bring to a simmer.
Simmer, partially covered and stirring frequently, to blend flavors, 5 or 7 minutes.
Serve, garnishing each portion with 1 tablespoon of tortilla chips, 1 tablespoon of sour cream and optional cilantro sprigs.

name: Black Bean Soup with Tomato-Tomatillo Salsa
attribution: "Black Bean Soup with Tomato-Tomatillo Salsa" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Black_Bean_Soup_with_Tomato-Tomatillo_Salsa, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup peeled, seeded, and chopped tomato (fresh or canned)
1 small sprig fresh or dried epazote (optional)
1 tablespoon finely-chopped canned chipotle chile (or ¼ teaspoon cayenne pepper or to taste)
3 medium tomatillos, husks removed and finely diced
1 small red onion, very finely diced
1 serrano or jalapeño chile, very finely diced
¼ cup roughly-chopped fresh cilantro leaves
Crème fraîche or sour cream, for garnish

steps: Pick over the beans to remove any debris. Soak if desired and drain.
In a deep, heavy-based pot, heat oil over medium heat.
Add onions and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add beans, garlic and water.
Bring to a boil, skimming any foam that rises to the surface.
Reduce to a simmer and when the beans are soft, after about 1 hour, add tomato, epazote, chipotle chile, cumin, coriander and salt.
Cook until the beans start to break down and broth begins to thicken.
Taste for seasoning; add salt and pepper if needed.
In a small bowl, combine tomato, tomatillo, onion, jalapeño and cilantro.
Taste for seasoning and add salt as needed.

name: Black Bean Stir-Fry
attribution: "Black Bean Stir-Fry" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Black_Bean_Stir-Fry, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1–2 fresh hot chiles, minced (or ½ teaspoon hot red pepper flakes)
4 scallions, separated: white part minced, green part cut on the diagonal in ½-inch pieces
¼ to ½ cup chicken stock
2 pounds (900 g) shellfish (clams, mussels, crabs, and/or lobster) or 1 pound (450 g) of shrimp, fish, poultry, or pork
1 red bell pepper or ½ red and ½ green peppers, cut in cubes
2–3 cups, thinly sliced vegetables (cabbage, snow peas, and/or carrots

steps: In small bowl, combine garlic, ginger root, chilies, scallion whites, and black beans.
In another small bowl, combine ¼ cup stock, soy sauce, sugar, and sesame oil, and stir until sugar dissolves.
In a third small bowl, dissolve cornstarch in wine or sherry.
Scrub clams, if using, cut shellfish into 1-inch pieces or thinly slice poultry or meat.
Just before serving, heat a wok over high heat.
Swirl in canola oil.
Stir-Fry onion and bell pepper for a minute then add garlic and bean mixture and cook for 15 seconds, or until fragrant but not brown.
Add seafood and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add stock-based sauce and cook for 2 to 5 minutes, or until seafood is cooked; if necessary to prevent mixture from sticking to pan, add remaining stock. (If steaming clams, tightly cover wok.)
Stir cornstarch mixture and add to stir-fry along with scallion greens and sliced vegetables.
Bring sauce to a boil.
Serve immediately along with white rice if desired.

name: Black Forest Cake
attribution: "Black Forest Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Black_Forest_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: a few drops of vanilla essence

steps: Cream the butter and sugar together well.
Melt the chocolate and beat into the creamed mixture, then beat in the eggs.
Sift flour, salt and cinnamon together.
Fold the dry mix lightly into the liquids, then fold in the sour cream and cold coffee.
Pour the mixture into a lined and greased 9-inch round, deep cake tin, and bake for 1 hour and 25 minutes.
Set to cool on a wire rack.
Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl and bind until the mixture stiffens.
Roll the pastry onto a floured board worktable until pastry is about the same size as the base of the cake tin.
Lay out on baking sheet and bake for 20–25 minutes at 350°F, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Whip cream until it holds its shape.
Put some whipped cream into pastry piping bag with a star tip attached, and reserve this for the decoration.
Slice the cake horizontally into 3 equal-sized layers.
Drain the cherries, reserve 8 for decoration and remove the stones from the remainder.
Put pastry on serving plate and spread the pastry with black cherry jam.
Soak the cakes with brandy or cherry juice.
Put one layer of cake on top of coated pastry.
Spread a layer of cream on the cake, and top with half the stoned cherries.
Add the second layer of cake, then another layer of cream and cherries.
Top with the final layer of the cake.
Cover the entire cake with the remaining cream, and press on the grated chocolate.
Decorate the top with piped rosettes of cream and the reserved whole black cherries.

name: Black Forest Torte
attribution: "Black Forest Torte" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Black_Forest_Torte, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 squares (6 ounces / 180 g) semisweet chocolate, chopped
1 can (21 ounces / 600 g) cherry pie filling
2 squares (1 ounce / 30 g) each) semisweet chocolate, chopped

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
In a small bowl, combine wafer crumbs and sugar; stir in butter.
Press onto the bottom and up the sides of a lightly greased 11-inch (30 cm) tart pan with removable bottom.
Place pan on baking sheet.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
Cool on a wire rack.
In a microwave-safe bowl, melt butter and chocolate; stir until smooth.
Cool for 10 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, Beat the eggs, sugar, vanilla, and salt until thickened, about 4 minutes.
Blend in chocolate mixture.
Add the flour and mix well.
Pour into crust; spread evenly.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool completely on a wire rack.
Spread pie filling over the top.
In a small microwave bowl, combine chocolate and cream.
Microwave on high for 20 to 30 seconds or until chocolate is melted; stir until smooth.
Cool for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drizzle over tart.
Chill until set.

name: Black Pepper Syrup
attribution: "Black Pepper Syrup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Black_Pepper_Syrup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup (60 ml) granulated white sugar

steps: Combine pepper, water, sugar and lemon in a saucepan, and heat slowly until the sugar dissolves and the mixture is a light-brown colour.
Remove from heat and let cool for 1 hour.

name: Black-Eyed Peas and Kale
attribution: "Black-Eyed Peas and Kale" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Black-Eyed_Peas_and_Kale, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in the oil over medium heat for several minutes.
Add tomatoes and their juice, peas, cayenne and bay leaf. Simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
Add kale and simmer uncovered until kale is tender but still green (5–10 minutes). Season to taste with salt and freshly-ground black pepper.

name: Black-Peppered Chicken Spaghetti
attribution: "Black-Peppered Chicken Spaghetti" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Black-Peppered_Chicken_Spaghetti, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 chicken fillets, cut into 2 cm pieces

steps: Bring the water to a boil in a pot. Add the spaghetti and 2 tbsp oil. Boil for 10 minutes, then drain the spaghetti, reserving some cooking water.
Boil the chicken in salted water until the color changes. Drain the chicken.
Heat the remaining oil in a non-stick skillet. Add and fry the garlic, capsicum, and onion.
Add the drained chicken, cream, black pepper, salt, and parsley. Stir until well-combined.
Add the spaghetti, and toss together until well-mixed.
Serve hot.

name: Blackberry Mush
attribution: "Blackberry Mush" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Blackberry_Mush, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 80 g (2.8 oz / ⅓ cup) white granulated sugar

steps: Put the fruit in a saucepan.
Add sugar, cornstarch, and water, and mash to a pulp.
Simmer or boil, uncovered, to reduce moisture.
Serve hot over ice cream, or cold as jam.

name: Blue Cheese Dressing
attribution: "Blue Cheese Dressing" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Blue_Cheese_Dressing, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tbsp (30 ml) lemon juice or vinegar (cider or white wine)
4 oz (115 g) any variety of blue cheese

steps: Combine all ingredients except the blue cheese and whisk until smooth and homogeneous.
Dice the blue cheese into approximately ½ inch (1 cm) cubes. Most blue cheese is crumbly, so you'll wind up with a lot of crumbs as well as larger chunks.
Pour the mayonnaise mixture into a serving container and stir in the cubes and crumbs of cheese.

name: Blueberry Cream Pie
attribution: "Blueberry Cream Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Blueberry_Cream_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a mixing bowl, combine sour cream, flour, sugar, vanilla, and egg.
Beat until very smooth.
Fold in blueberries.
Pour filling into pie shell.
Bake for 25 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix flour, butter and pecans, stirring well.
Sprinkle over pie and bake an additional 10 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Cool on wire rack, then chill.

name: Blueberry Muffin
attribution: "Blueberry Muffin" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Blueberry_Muffin, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ⅓ cup (65 g) white granulated sugar
¾ cup (180 ml) blueberries, fresh or frozen

steps: Grease muffin cups or line with paper cups; set aside.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a medium bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Make a well in the center of the mixture and set aside.
In a small bowl, combine beaten egg, milk, and oil. Add this mixture all at once to the flour mixture. Fold in blueberries and stir just until combined. Do not overstir.
Spoon batter into prepared cups, filling each about two-thirds full.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until golden. When a wooden toothpick is inserted near the middle, it should come out clean.
Remove from muffin cups and let cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes.

name: Bobotie
attribution: "Bobotie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bobotie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: Soak the bread in the milk and set aside.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and sauté the onion until soft.
Add the minced meat and cook until browned.
Stir in the curry powder, turmeric, chutney, vinegar, raisins, salt, and pepper.
Squeeze excess milk from the bread and mix the bread into the meat mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a greased baking dish.
Beat the eggs with the milk and pour over the meat.
Place the bay leaves on top.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for about 35–40 minutes, or until the custard is set and lightly browned.
Serve hot with yellow rice, vegetables, or chutney.

name: Boerewors (South African Sausage)
attribution: "Boerewors (South African Sausage)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Boerewors_(South_African_Sausage), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Place seeds into a dry frying pan.
Put the pan over low heat and allow coriander to burn slightly.
Break seeds apart with a fork, or use a coffee/spice grinder to finely grind them.
Cut all meat and spek into cubes.
Mix spek and meat together thoroughly, and then coarsely mince or grind it.
Mix in all dry spices, vinegar, and brandy with a large, two-pronged fork.
Place meat mixture in fridge, and let rest for 2 hours to blend the flavours together.
While the meat is resting, soak the sausage casings in water for the same 2 hours.

Fit casings over sausage maker, and fill with the meat/spice mixture. Be very careful not to over- or understuff the boerewors, as doing so will ruin them. Fill in long continuous lengths; don't make links.
Cook sausages on a barbecue, but do not prick to allow juices to escape as much of the flavour will escape with them. Cook until still pink and juicy inside

name: Boiled Chicken with Broth
attribution: "Boiled Chicken with Broth" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Boiled_Chicken_with_Broth, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut the chicken into quarters, and place in a large pot with the water, rice, and salt.
Bring pot to a slow boil, removing any scum that rises to the surface. Cook until the chicken is thoroughly done.
Remove the chicken and place in a serving dish. Garnish with parsley.
Strain the broth.
Serve the chicken with clarified butter and the hot broth on the side.

name: Boiled Cocoyam
attribution: "Boiled Cocoyam" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Boiled_Cocoyam, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Wash the cocoyam to remove dirt from the surface, and cut into smaller pieces without peeling.
Transfer cocoyam to a pot, and cover with water.
Add a pinch of salt, and simmer for several minutes until tender.
Drain the cocoyam, and remove the peel.
Serve with garden egg stew, egg sauce, or fried pepper.

name: Boiled Cucumber and Grated Coconut (Pachadi)
attribution: "Boiled Cucumber and Grated Coconut (Pachadi)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Boiled_Cucumber_and_Grated_Coconut_(Pachadi), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cucumber (large variety, with dark green and yellow skin)

steps: Skin the cucumber. Cut in half along the length and remove the central core of seeds. Discard the seeds.
Grate the cucumber. Alternatively, cut into very small pieces.
Cook the cucumber in the microwave for about 4–5 min.
Meanwhile, make a fine paste from the grated coconut and the cumin seeds
In a deep pan (kadhai), heat the oil. Add the mustard seeds and red chillies, and let them splutter.
Add the cooked cucumber and the coconut paste and salt to taste. Mix well and let it cook on slow fire. Do not allow it to boil—it just needs to be warmed.
As the mixture starts to boil, take it off the stove. Serve.

name: Boiled Ona (Nigerian Boiled Bitter Yam)
attribution: "Boiled Ona (Nigerian Boiled Bitter Yam)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Boiled_Ona_(Nigerian_Boiled_Bitter_Yam), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut the bitter yam into chunks, and remove the skin.
Rinse the yam chunks, then transfer to a pot and cover with water.
Peel, rinse and add salt to taste.
Add salt to taste, and boil until soft.
Drain the bitter yam, and serve with egg sauce, palm oil or pepper sauce.

name: Boiled Sweet Potato
attribution: "Boiled Sweet Potato" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Boiled_Sweet_Potato, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Sweet potato, unpeeled and cut into chunks

steps: Place the sweet potato chunks in a pot.
Cover the sweet potato with water, and add a pinch of salt.
Bring to a boil, then simmer until the sweet potato is tender.
Drain the sweet potatoes, and peel off the skin.
Serve with the pepper sauce of your choice.

name: Boiled Yellow Split Peas
attribution: "Boiled Yellow Split Peas" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Boiled_Yellow_Split_Peas, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ pound (225 grams / 1¼ cups) dry yellow split peas
⅛ teaspoon baking soda, if needed (see tips)

steps: Pick over beans, then add hot water.
Boil for two minutes.
Set aside for 1 hour.
Drain and rinse.
Simmer until tender.
Pick over beans, then add cold water.
Soak overnight, or 6 hours minimum.
Drain and rinse.
Simmer until tender.

name: Boliche (Cuban Chorizo-Stuffed Roast)
attribution: "Boliche (Cuban Chorizo-Stuffed Roast)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Boliche_(Cuban_Chorizo-Stuffed_Roast), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 tbsp green Spanish olives with pimentos

steps: Cut slits into eye round roast, and stuff with quartered chorizos (follow the grain of meat).
Lightly rub meat with adobo seasoning.
Brown the meat on all sides in a sauté pan to seal in the juices. Remove and place in a large covered roasting pan.
In the same pan as the beef was browned, add saffron, garlic, onions, peppers, bay leaves, oregano, olives, capers, and the Sazon seasoning. Sauté until the onions are translucent in color.
Deglaze with red wine, turn heat down, and simmer about 5 minutes. Add the cilantro and the tomato sauce and stir well.

Pour this mixture over the beef, and roast at 325 °F for 1 ½–2 hours, or until meat is tender. Turn the roast over and baste with the sauce once in a while to assure full flavor penetration and even cooking.
Serve.

name: Bolognese Sauce
attribution: "Bolognese Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bolognese_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1.5 lb (675 g) of lean ground beef, at room temperature
2 large egg whites, at room temperature
1 can (28 oz / 800 g) of stewed San Marzano or Roma (Italian) tomatoes

steps: Put a thick-bottomed pot over a medium-low heat with the oil and garlic.
As the pot warms up, mix the beef and egg whites into a homogeneous paste.
Stir the garlic cloves in the warming oil until the fragrance can be noted.
Add the meat to the pot, stirring to break clusters into fine pieces, and cook until most of the juices have evaporated.
Add the tomato paste and stir before adding the stewed tomatoes.
Cover the pot, leaving a vent, and simmer at a low heat for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.
Turn off the heat and retrieve the garlic cloves, to either discard or mash them before re-adding to the sauce.
Season according to taste, taking in consideration the salt content of the tomato products.
Cover completely and let rest for half an hour, during which time preparation for assembly and plating can be done.

name: Booyah (Chicken Vegetable Stew)
attribution: "Booyah (Chicken Vegetable Stew)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Booyah_(Chicken_Vegetable_Stew), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups tomato sauce (or 1 quart whole tomatoes)

steps: Place chicken in a large pot and cover with water. Simmer until chicken is well done.
Remove chicken from broth and skim off fat.
Add remaining ingredients to broth.
Remove chicken meat from bones and skin. Cut meat into small pieces and add to broth. Add salt and water to taste.
Cover and let simmer for at least 3 hours. It tastes best when cooked all day.

name: Borhani (Spiced Yogurt Drink)
attribution: "Borhani (Spiced Yogurt Drink)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Borhani_(Spiced_Yogurt_Drink), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ tsp fresh green chile peppers

steps: Dry-roast cumin seeds by cooking them over low heat in small pan until you can smell the seasoning, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind to a powder.
Beat yoghurt with water until it becomes smooth. Strain green chili, mint, leaf and coriander pastes with some water blend into the yoghurt. Combine all other ingredients and mix well.
Serve cold.

name: Borscht
attribution: "Borscht" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Borscht, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1½ cups chopped onion (about ⅓ of a large onion)
3–4 cups shredded cabbage (about ⅓ of a large cabbage)
1 cup tomato purée or ¼ to ½ cup tomato paste

steps: Place the potatoes, beets, and water in a medium-sized saucepan. Cover and cook over medium heat until tender (20–30 minutes). While that is cooking, proceed with the recipe.
Melt the butter in a Dutch oven/soup pot. Add the onion and salt. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the onions are translucent (8–10 minutes).
Add the celery, carrots, cabbage, and 2 cups of the water in which the potatoes and beets are cooking. Cover and cook over medium heat until the vegetables are tender (8–10 minutes).

Add the remaining soup ingredients (including the potatoes, beets, and the rest of the water in which they are cooking). Cover and simmer for at least 15 more minutes. Correct the seasonings. If it is too thin, let it simmer uncovered, and maybe add a little more tomato paste.
Serve hot, topped with sour cream or yoghurt and sprinkled with dill. If desired the sour cream or yoghurt can be served with the soup and used as a condiment to taste.

name: Boston Baked Beans
attribution: "Boston Baked Beans" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Boston_Baked_Beans, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 rashers thick cut bacon, sliced (or 5 drops liquid smoke)
4 cups canned kidney beans, rinsed and drained
¼ cup blackstrap molasses, plus more as needed

steps: Cook bacon. Separate the meat from the fat, and chop the bacon.
Place 1 tbsp of the bacon fat into a large stainless steel pan. Add kidney beans and sauté over medium-high heat.
Add rum and tilt to ignite. If you do not have a gas stove, simply light with a fire stick.
Add remaining ingredients and chopped bacon and fold to combine.
Bake in a 325°F oven for 1 ½ hours, adding blackstrap molasses occasionally to prevent drying.

name: Bouballe (Sweetened Matzo Meal Omelette)
attribution: "Bouballe (Sweetened Matzo Meal Omelette)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bouballe_(Sweetened_Matzo_Meal_Omelette), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Whip the egg whites.
Add the yolks, then the matzo meal and cornstarch. Mix everything together.
Cook the mixture like an omelette.
When cooked, sprinkle with sugar and serve.

name: Bouchée à la Reine
attribution: "Bouchée à la Reine" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bouch%C3%A9e_%C3%A0_la_Reine, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 oz small or medium button mushrooms

steps: Place the chicken stock and the bouquet garni in a saucepan. Bring to a boil and allow to infuse 10–11 minutes
Cut the chicken breasts into small dice.
Wash the mushrooms rapidly and cut in halves or quarters depending on the size.
In a sauteuse (or a frying pan), melt the butter on a medium-high heat and add the chopped shallot. Cook for about 1 minute stirring.
Add the flour and cook 1 petite minute, mixing with a whisk or a wooden spoon, without browning.
Add the chicken stock little by little and cook for 2 minutes, stirring.
Add the diced chicken and the mushrooms and cook for 5–6 minutes, stirring from time to time.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (gas mark 6) and bake the vol-au-vent shells for 5–10 minutes or as directed by the manufacturer, without burning them.

In a bowl, mix the cream with the egg yolk. Increase the heat under the sauteuse and add the egg yolk/cream mixture, beating to combine well with the sauce and lower the heat as soon as it reaches a boil. The sauce should be unctuous and should coat a spoon. Do not salt, only pepper.
Remove the vol-au-vents from the oven. Fill rapidly and serve without delay as they cool rapidly.

name: Bouillabaisse
attribution: "Bouillabaisse" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bouillabaisse, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 660 g whole cleaned lotte, or monkfish
1 live octopus (optional), cleaned and cut into pieces
1 kg of potatoes, peeled and cut into large slices
5 ripe tomatoes, peeled, quartered and without seeds

steps: Scale the fish and wash them, if possible, in sea water. Cut them into large slices, leaving the bones.
Warm the olive oil in a large, deep saucepan.
Add the onions, along with 6 cloves of crushed garlic, the octopus pieces and tomatoes. Brown at low heat turning gently for 5 minutes.

Add the fish slices; first the large slices then the smaller ones. Cover with boiling water and add salt, pepper, fennel, the bouquet garni and saffron. Simmer at a low heat, stirring from time to time so the fish doesn't stick to the pan. Correct the seasoning. Remove the bouillabaise from the heat once the oil and water have thoroughly blended with the other ingredients. This should take about twenty minutes.

Prepare the rouille: Use a mortar to crush the garlic cloves into a fine paste after removing the stems. Add the egg yolk and the saffron, then blend in the olive oil little by little to make a mayonnaise, stirring it with the pestle.
Cook the potatoes in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes. Open the sea urchins with a pair of scissors and remove the roe with a small spoon.
Arrange the fish on a platter. Add the sea urchin roe into the broth and stir.
Rub several slices of bread with garlic and spread a tablespoon of rouille on each. Place at least two slices per serving bowl.
Remove the fish and potatoes from the broth and place them on a large serving platter.
Pour the hot broth in each bowl containing a slice of bread smothered in rouille. Then serve the fish and the potatoes on a separate platter.

name: Bourbon Apples
attribution: "Bourbon Apples" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bourbon_Apples, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 Honeycrisp apple, cored, peeled, and sliced into 12ths

steps: Coat apples with butter and lemon.
Combine sugar, allspice, cloves, and cinnamon. Sprinkle over apples and toss to coat.
Preheat a small stainless steel skillet over medium high heat. Add apples and sauté until lightly browned.
Add bourbon to pan and deglaze. Bring to a boil, and cook, stirring occasionally, until apples are fork tender. Serve immediately.

name: Boxty (Irish Potato Cakes)
attribution: "Boxty (Irish Potato Cakes)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Boxty_(Irish_Potato_Cakes), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Take half of the potatoes and wash, peel, chunk, and boil them.
Mash the boiled potatoes with milk and 1 tablespoon butter and set them aside.
Grate the other pound of (raw) potatoes into a strong cloth.
Squeeze cloth to remove all possible liquid from the raw potatoes.
Mix together the grated potatoes, the mashed potatoes, baking soda, buttermilk, flour, and black pepper (to taste).
Stir thoroughly to combine.
Warm nonstick griddle or skillet over medium heat and melt butter.
Pour potato cakes on griddle, ¼ cup at a time.
Fry until edges are soft and cake is bubbling.
Cook on other side.
Serve hot.

name: Braised Collard Greens
attribution: "Braised Collard Greens" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Braised_Collard_Greens, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Place ham hocks, garlic cloves and a healthy pinch of sea salt in the 2 quarts of water, and slowly bring to a boil in a large stew pot until the ham hocks become tender.

Meanwhile, wash the greens thoroughly with cold water to remove dirt, and then wash them once in the vinegar (do not pat dry after vinegar wash). Next, remove the stems and shred the leaves into thin strips.
When the water is boiling, add the greens by the handful and turn the temperature down to medium. Simmer the greens uncovered until they are quite tender and the broth has reduced.
Serve with hot pepper vinegar, Tabasco, or red pepper flakes.

name: Bran Muffins
attribution: "Bran Muffins" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bran_Muffins, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Stir wheat bran and buttermilk together in a mixing bowl.
Cream together egg, brown sugar and margarine in another mixing bowl.
Combine remaining ingredients in a third bowl. Add to batter, and stir just to moisten.
Fill muffin cups ¾ full.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: Brandy Butter
attribution: "Brandy Butter" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Brandy_Butter, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 75 g sieved icing sugar or caster sugar

steps: Cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Gradually beat in the brandy.
Chill before serving.
Serve with Christmas pudding and warm mince pies.

name: Brazilian Black Bean Soup
attribution: "Brazilian Black Bean Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Brazilian_Black_Bean_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tablespoon caribe or another ground hot pepper

steps: Place beans in a large pan and cover with water. Bring to a boil and remove from heat. Cover and let stand for 1 hour. Simmer for 2 hours and drain.

Place beans in a large pan and add 8 cups water, garlic, salt, white onions, cumin, ground chili and lime juice. Tie cloves in cheesecloth for easy removal if desired. Bring to a boil; reduce heat, cover and simmer for 2 hours or until beans are tender and soup is thick.
Mix in green onions and serve with lime wedge.

name: Bread Filled with Potato Curry (Pani Puri)
attribution: "Bread Filled with Potato Curry (Pani Puri)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bread_Filled_with_Potato_Curry_(Pani_Puri), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tablespoon of amchur (dried green mango) powder

steps: Combine amchur, chaat, jeera powder, coriander powder, lemon juice, black salt, red chili powder and water to a fine blend and keep it chilled.
Boil the potatoes and moong separately. Peel the potatoes and roughly mash them.
Make a chutney with tamarind and sugar, and keep it chilled.
Break the puris from the top, put the potatoes, moong, chopped coriander, chutney and chilled water
Garnish with chopped coriander and serve.

name: Bread Pudding
attribution: "Bread Pudding" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bread_Pudding, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 slices of bread, with or without crusts. Slightly stale or new bread is acceptable.
20 cm (8-inch) square baking pan, or large oven-safe bowl

steps: Heat oven to 175°C (350°F).
Rip bread into small pieces. Cutting into cubes is also okay. Place into baking dish. Mix in raisins while filling the dish.
Pour melted butter over the bread.
In a bowl, beat the eggs slightly. Add the sugar, milk, cinnamon, and vanilla. Mix.
Pour mixture over the bread. Press the bread lightly to help it absorb the mixture, if necessary. All the bread should be wet.
Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes.
Remove and let cool.
Serve cold, though warm may also be acceptable. Use a spoon, or cut into squares, to serve.

name: Bread with Tomato Sauce (Pappa al Pomodoro)
attribution: "Bread with Tomato Sauce (Pappa al Pomodoro)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bread_with_Tomato_Sauce_(Pappa_al_Pomodoro), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1–2 garlic cloves, crushed and finely chopped

steps: Dip the bread in water for a short time, so that you can crush it with your hands. It should not be soaked.
Fry the garlic in a large frying pan with oil until it begins to change color.
Add the tomato purée and salt, and cook over medium heat until it comes to a boil.
Add pieces of bread in, none smaller than a walnut, after wringing and continue to mix it with the tomato, until it has become completely red.
At this point the tomato should still have a fresh aroma.
Remove from heat and serve hot in a bowl, seasoned with a drizzle of olive oil, pepper and a basil leaf.

name: Breaded Chicken Livers
attribution: "Breaded Chicken Livers" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Breaded_Chicken_Livers, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Trim the sinews from the livers.
Coat the livers in flour and knock off any excess.
Carefully place the livers in a hot, oiled pan.
Fry for 2–3 minutes on each side, until golden brown on the outside and just pink on the inside.
Serve hot.

name: Breaded Fried Oysters
attribution: "Breaded Fried Oysters" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Breaded_Fried_Oysters, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pint shucked large oysters, cleaned and dried
2 cups fine bread crumbs or cracker crumbs

steps: Take the cleaned oysters, place them on a clean towel, and dry them.
Beat the eggs and cream together, and place in a shallow bowl.
Combine the bread or cracker crumbs with the salt, pepper, and cayenne. Place in a shallow bowl or on a plate.
With a fork, dip each oyster individually in the egg, then in the crumbs. With the back of a spoon, pat the crumbs to adhere them to the oysters.
Heat the oil in a frying pan—the amount of oil will vary with the cooking method used.
Deep fry, pan fry, or sauté the oysters in the pan, but do not crowd them; cook in batches if needed. Fry quickly until light brown on both sides; 1 or 2 minutes a side should be enough.
Serve hot.

name: Breaded Potato Wedges
attribution: "Breaded Potato Wedges" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Breaded_Potato_Wedges, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 pounds Russet potatoes, cut into 10 wedges

steps: Combine eggs with seasoning. Dip potatoes into egg mixture then dredge in cornflakes. Let rest 2–3 minutes.
Heat oil to 350°F. Fry wedges, in batches if needed, 3–4 minutes or until limp. Drain on a cooling rack set above a baking pan.
Heat oil to 375°F. Fry wedges again, until golden brown and crispy. Drain again on same rack. Serve warm.

name: Breakfast Burrito
attribution: "Breakfast Burrito" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Breakfast_Burrito, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 8 eggs either scrambled, sunny-side up, or poached
8 strips of cooked bacon or 1 lb (400 grams) cooked breakfast sausage
Hollandaise sauce, cheese, salt, and pepper to taste

steps: Place one-quarter of the hash browns in a tortilla.
On top of this place 2 strips of bacon or one quarter of the breakfast sausage.
Add two eggs, cheese, salt, and pepper.
Roll up the tortilla to enclose everything. If you used poached or sunny-side up eggs you can squeeze the burritos to pop the egg yolks and then work the yolk around to form a sauce.

name: Breakfast Dürüm
attribution: "Breakfast Dürüm" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Breakfast_D%C3%BCr%C3%BCm, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 large sheet of lavash or yufka flatbread
4 tbsp butter or olive oil, divided
½ cup thinly sliced baby bella or Crimini mushrooms
5 thin slices cooked beef sirloin or flank

steps: Brush the flatbread with the tablespoon of water to keep it soft. Toast the bread using a skillet or in a toaster oven until brown on edges. Set aside.

Combine the grated potato with half the hot water in a bowl. Let sit for 3 minutes, then stir thoroughly and drain the water from the bowl. Repeat this process with the remaining hot water, then drain the potatoes in a colander. Shake gently in a horizontal motion to remove excess starch and water, then set aside to dry.
Sauté the mushrooms in 1 tbsp butter. Add spinach, and cook on medium heat until slightly wilted.

Whisk together the eggs, seasonings and milk, then pour over the spinach and mushrooms. When the eggs are half-set, sprinkle the cheddar on top, then fold the omelet in half and remove from the skillet.

Heat the remaining butter in the skillet. Turn the heat to high, then add the potatoes, onions, and steak, evenly and fully covering the bottom of the skillet. Season to taste, then let them sear to your desired brownness and crunch, taking care to turn them over. Remove from the heat.

Assemble the dürüm by laying the bread sheet flat, with the longer edges to the left and right sides. Spreading the hummus evenly on the half of the bread farthest from you. Pile the potato mixture and the omelet evenly on the nearest half. Pinch and fold the nearest edge over, then roll into a 5-cm (2-inch) thick cylinder and serve.

name: Breakfast Sludge
attribution: "Breakfast Sludge" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Breakfast_Sludge, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 teabag or 1 scoop of chai powder

steps: Put water on to boil.
Break up the granola bar into a mug. You will want to ensure that it is very well ground up. The pieces of the granola bar should be about the size of pieces of oatmeal.
Add the instant coffee, chai, sugar, and hot chocolate powder to the cup.
Add cinnamon to taste.
Pour in enough boiling water to fill the cup.
Stir vigorously until everything is mixed and the mixture has a dark brown appearance.
Add milk to taste.

name: Breakfast Waffles
attribution: "Breakfast Waffles" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Breakfast_Waffles, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix egg yolks and milk.
Add flour, baking powder, sugar, salt and mix well.
Add the oil.
Whip the egg whites until stiff and then fold into the batter.
Preheat a waffle iron.
Ladle a scoop of batter into the waffle iron, and cook until browned and cooked through.
Remove waffle and repeat cooking process with remaining batter.

name: Breakfast Waffles (Gluten-Free)
attribution: "Breakfast Waffles (Gluten-Free)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Breakfast_Waffles_(Gluten-Free), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ lb (225 g) Wheat-Free Baking Mix

steps: Mix egg yolks and milk.
Add the wheat-free baking mix, baking powder, sugar, salt and mix well.
Add the oil.
Beat the egg whites until stiff and then fold into the batter.
Preheat a waffle iron.
Ladle a scoop of batter into the waffle iron, and cook until browned and cooked through.
Remove waffle and repeat cooking process with remaining batter.

name: Brioche Stuffing
attribution: "Brioche Stuffing" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Brioche_Stuffing, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup shelled walnuts, finely chopped
¼ cup dried apples, coarsely chopped
¼ cup unsalted butter, cut into small cubes

steps: Combine all ingredients in a deep roasting pan. Press into a loose, flat layer.
Bake in a 375 °F (190 °C) oven for 25 minutes.
Raise temperature to 425 °F (220 °C), and bake for 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

name: British Christmas Pudding
attribution: "British Christmas Pudding" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:British_Christmas_Pudding, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all dried mixed fruit in a large bowl. Stir well.
Mix in the flour, then the sugar, lemon, orange, breadcrumbs, and nuts.
Whisk eggs in a separate bowl. Mix eggs into the dry ingredients.
Steam the pudding for several hours, remove it, and put it in a cool place.
Serve with butter, cream, custard, or brandy.

name: Broccoli Burgers
attribution: "Broccoli Burgers" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Broccoli_Burgers, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 120 ml (½ cup) seasoned dry bread crumbs

steps: In a bowl, beat eggs.
Stir in broccoli, almonds, onion, breadcrumbs and water.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
On an oiled 30x38 cm (12x15-inch) baking sheet, shape mixture into 4 patties, each 2 cm (¾ inch) thick.
Bake in 190 °C (375 °F) oven, turning halfway through cooking, until each side is golden brown, about 25 minutes total.
Serve on buns with mayonnaise and lettuce.

name: Broccoli Kugel
attribution: "Broccoli Kugel" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Broccoli_Kugel, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Melt margarine and stir in flour.
Add water, chicken soup power, and mayonnaise, and stir until thickened.
Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients.
Pour into 9x13-inch (22x33-cm) pan and bake for approximately 1 hour, until center is firm.

name: Broccoli Salad
attribution: "Broccoli Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Broccoli_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 7–8 slices of crisp fried bacon, crumbled (smoked bacon works well)
1 red or sweet onion, chopped (Vidalia are recommended)
1 cup (80 g / 2.8 oz) raisins, plumped in boiling water
½ cup (110 g / 3.9 oz) granulated sugar (or equivalent artificial sweetener)
½ cup (40 g / 1.4 oz) pecans or sunflower seeds
dash of cider vinegar or lemon juice

steps: Whisk mayonnaise, sugar, and vinegar together.s
Mix remaining ingredients and combine completely in a large bowl.
Cover.
Cool in the refrigerator overnight before serving.

name: Brown Butter Toffee Chocolate Chip Cookies
attribution: "Brown Butter Toffee Chocolate Chip Cookies" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Brown_Butter_Toffee_Chocolate_Chip_Cookies, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¾ stick (90 g / 3 oz) unsalted butter
¾ cup (140 g / 5 oz) lightly packed light brown sugar
1 cup (2 sticks / 250 g / 9 oz) unsalted butter
¾ cup (160 g / 5.5 oz) white granulated sugar
1½ cups (270 g / 9.5 oz) packed light brown sugar
6 oz (170 g) dark chocolate (50–70% cacao), chopped

steps: Line a baking sheet with baking parchment.

Melt the butter, sugar and salt in a saucepan over medium heat. Add water if necessary to keep fat from separating. Continue to cook until the temperature is 150°C (302°F) and when dropped in water it forms brittle threads.
Pour the toffee onto the prepared baking pan. Freeze until ready to use, about 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, line another baking sheet with parchment.
Melt the butter in a saucepan and cook until it turns dark brown. Remove from the heat.
Add an ice cube to the butter and let it melt. Repeat with remaining ice cubes.
Combine the sugars, espresso powder, salt, and baking soda in a large bowl.
Pour the brown butter into the sugar mixture and beat until combined.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Fold in the flour until combined.
Remove the toffee from the freezer and break into chunks. Put into a zippable bag and break into bits using a rolling pin.
Add the toffee and chocolate to the dough and fold in.
Scoop the dough onto the baking sheet and let it chill for 48 hours for flavors to develop.
When ready to bake, preheat the oven to 163°C (325°F). Line 2 baking sheets with baking parchment.
Arrange the cookies on the baking sheets, leaving at least 2 inches (5 cm) of space between each other.
Bake for 18–20 minutes until golden brown.
Take the cookies out of the oven and sprinkle with a little sea salt before leaving them to cool.

name: Brown Rice Casserole
attribution: "Brown Rice Casserole" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Brown_Rice_Casserole, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Combine cheese, mushrooms, peas, and rice in large bowl.
Coat 1½ quart baking pan with cooking spray.
Move mixed ingredients to baking dish.
Cover and bake for 20 to 25 minutes.
Sprinkle almonds on top
Bake 5 minutes more.

name: Brown Rice with Ground Turkey
attribution: "Brown Rice with Ground Turkey" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Brown_Rice_with_Ground_Turkey, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 20 ounces of extra lean ground turkey breast
1 can (12 ounces) diced tomatoes with green chiles
Seasonings to taste (e.g. garlic powder, lemon pepper, allspice, etc.)

steps: Spray skillet with cooking spray, and sprinkle in garlic powder and other seasonings. Add turkey, and crumble it as it cooks. Add tomatoes, and mix with turkey until turkey is cooked.
Add cooking oil to a wok or deep skillet. Add 1 teaspoon allspice and/or other seasonings.
As pan heats slowly add cooked rice (watch for splattering of hot oil). When rice is heated evenly add teriyaki sauce, and mix it evenly.
When ground turkey is done cooking add it to rice in wok, mix it thoroughly, and serve.

name: Brown Rice with Other Starches and Vegetables (Pandora's Feast)
attribution: "Brown Rice with Other Starches and Vegetables (Pandora's Feast)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Brown_Rice_with_Other_Starches_and_Vegetables_(Pandora's_Feast), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup soaked and boiled black, pinto, kidney or other beans
Olive oil, hemp oil, flaxseed oil, or other nutritious oil

steps: Add the brown rice and water to a rice cooker.
Drain, rinse, and add the beans to the rice cooker.
If using, add the garlic to the cooker.
If using, add the sweet potato, squash, beet, or potato.
If using a fuzzy logic (i.e. programmable) cooker, set the cooker to the brown rice setting and turn it on. If using an on/off cooker, simply turn it on.
In about 20–40 minutes, your cooker should finish cooking the rice. When finished, open the lid, add the kale, close the lid, and wait about another minute or two.
Open and serve. Top with oil, yeast, soy sauce and/or sesame seeds, to taste.

name: Brown Sauce (Hartshorne)
attribution: "Brown Sauce (Hartshorne)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Brown_Sauce_(Hartshorne), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix together the sugar, vinegar, olive oil, mustard, salt, and pepper.
Serve or store in a bottle.

name: Brown Sugar Brownies
attribution: "Brown Sugar Brownies" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Brown_Sugar_Brownies, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup (1 stick) butter or margarine, softened

steps: Preheat oven to 325°F.
Grease an 8 x 8 x 2-inch square baking pan.
Cream sugar and butter until fluffy.
Beat in eggs.
Beat in melted chocolate.
Mix in flour, then stir in nuts.
Pour into prepared pan.
Bake about 25 minutes.
Cool in pan, and cut into squares.

name: Brown Sugar Icing
attribution: "Brown Sugar Icing" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Brown_Sugar_Icing, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Boil sugar and cream together until a soft ball forms in cold water.
Cool to 125 F.
Add vanilla and butter; beat until thick enough to spread.

name: Brown Sugar Mulling Spice Mix
attribution: "Brown Sugar Mulling Spice Mix" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Brown_Sugar_Mulling_Spice_Mix, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl.
Stir with wire whisk until well blended.
Store in an airtight container in a cool place.

name: Browned Rice
attribution: "Browned Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Browned_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Sauté onion in margarine over medium heat.
Mix rice and consommé in a baking dish. Pour onion and margarine over rice and consommé and mix.
Bake covered for 30 minutes at 350 °F (180 °C).
Remove from oven, and add ½ can water over rice mixture.
Cover and cook an additional 30 minutes.

name: Bruschetta
attribution: "Bruschetta" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bruschetta, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 loaf of Italian or French bread, sliced ½ inch (1.25 cm) thick on the bias
Toppings of your choice (see examples below)
Chopped tomatoes with arugula or basil
Cooked white beans (topped, if you like, with sautéed kale)
Minced anchovies flavored with wine vinegar and herbs
Thinly-sliced pancetta crisped under the broiler
Pugliese-style chopped mixture of summer vegetables (red onion, cucumber, tomatoes, oregano, flat-leaf parsley, basil, and red pepper flakes)

steps: Toast the bread slices in a toaster oven, under a broiler, or on a grill, until they turn golden.
Immediately rub the bread with the cut side of the garlic. Sprinkle with salt and black pepper, and drizzle generously with extra-virgin olive oil.
Serve warm topped with whatever combinations of seasonal ingredients you choose.

name: Bryndzové Halušky (Slovak Dumplings with Cheese)
attribution: "Bryndzové Halušky (Slovak Dumplings with Cheese)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bryndzov%C3%A9_Halu%C5%A1ky_(Slovak_Dumplings_with_Cheese), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 750 g potatoes, peeled and finely grated
250 g bryndze cheese, cut into very small pieces
100 g bacon (údenej slaniny), cooked and cut into small pieces

steps: Combine the grated potatoes with with the flour and salt to make a dough.
Shape the dough into small cylindrical pieces less than 3 cm in size.
Transfer the dumplings to a pot of boiling salted water. When the dumplings rise to the top of the boiling water, remove one to make sure they are thoroughly cooked.
Remove the dumplings from the pot with a slotted spoon, and transfer to a warmed plate.
Immediately after dumplings are placed on the plate, scatter the cheese over top, and let the cheese melt over the dumplings. Mix if desired.
Sprinkle the crispy bacon bits on top of the cheese.
Serve piping hot.

name: Bubble and Squeak
attribution: "Bubble and Squeak" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Bubble_and_Squeak, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Various cooked vegetables (e.g. potatoes, cabbage, carrots, peas, and/or Brussels sprouts)

steps: Fry the chopped onion in fat or oil.
Chop the vegetables, and add to the pan.
