name: Chipotle BBQ Ribs
attribution: "Chipotle BBQ Ribs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chipotle_BBQ_Ribs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Season ribs with BBQ rub. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Combine BBQ sauce with molasses.
Place hickory chunks into a 325–350°F smoker or in a charcoal grill set for indirect heat at 325–350°F.
Place ribs into smoker or grill and cook for 3–4 hours, brushing with molasses mixture often.
Brush ribs with remaining sauce and place on a medium-high grill and sear until well-browned.
Let sit for 15 minutes; serve.

name: Chipotle BBQ Salmon Burgers
attribution: "Chipotle BBQ Salmon Burgers" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chipotle_BBQ_Salmon_Burgers, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1¼ pounds skinless wild salmon filet, cut into 2-inch cubes
Seafood seasoning, such as Old Bay
4 hamburger buns, split in half and toasted
3 chipotles in adobo sauce, finely minced
3 tbsp unsalted butter, cut into small cubes

steps: Run salmon cubes through a meat grinder on medium setting. Mix with chipotle, sauce, butter, and adobo.
Form into 4 equal patties, about ¾ inch thick. Brush with extra-virgin olive oil and season both sides liberally with seasoning. Set aside.
Preheat grill pan to medium high. Rub with olive oil, then add salmon patties. Grill 5–6 minutes per side for medium rare, or until desired doneness is achieved.
Brush buns with oil. Place a patty on and close. Serve immediately with desired condiments.

name: Chipotle BBQ Sauce
attribution: "Chipotle BBQ Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chipotle_BBQ_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cans chipotle in adobo including all of adobo sauce

steps: Whisk together oil and flour and cook on medium heat, stirring constantly until light blonde color is achieved.
Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil; reduce heat to low and cook 15 minutes.
Cool for 15 minutes and purée in batches until smooth.
Store in nonreactive container for up to 1 week.

name: Chipotle Dip
attribution: "Chipotle Dip" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chipotle_Dip, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Pulse everything except chips in a blender until smooth.
Serve with chips.

name: Chipotle Ketchup
attribution: "Chipotle Ketchup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chipotle_Ketchup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, for ½ hour.
Refrigerate in a non-reactive container for up to 2 months.

name: Chipotle Lime Grilled Chicken
attribution: "Chipotle Lime Grilled Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chipotle_Lime_Grilled_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup freshly squeezed lime juice

steps: Combine all ingredients except for BBQ Rub in a gallon zip-top plastic freezer bag. Add chicken breasts and refrigerate for 45 minutes.
Remove chicken from bag. Season each breast with BBQ Rub.
Place on a preheated charcoal grill and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove and let rest for 5 minutes.
Serve.

name: Chipotle Lime Hot Wings
attribution: "Chipotle Lime Hot Wings" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chipotle_Lime_Hot_Wings, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup Smoky Chipotle Hot Sauce

steps: Heat oil to 350°F. Meanwhile, sprinkle wingettes with kosher salt and black pepper.
Fry wingettes in batches for 12 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack.
Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl large enough to toss wingettes. Add wingettes and toss to coat. Serve.

name: Chipotle Lime Tortilla Chips
attribution: "Chipotle Lime Tortilla Chips" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chipotle_Lime_Tortilla_Chips, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 10 corn tortillas, each cut into 10 wedges

steps: Combine hot sauce, salt, and lime juice in a large dish. Add tortillas and soak for 2 hours.
Remove to a cooling rack and let dry for 2 hours.
Deep fry at 375°F until pieces float and are lightly browned around edges. Drain on a cooling rack set above a baking pan. Serve.

name: Chipped Beef on Toast
attribution: "Chipped Beef on Toast" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chipped_Beef_on_Toast, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Brown the flour in the melted fat.
Dissolve the milk in the beef stock, and then add that to the pot.
Stir this together slowly to prevent lumping, and then add the beef.
Cook for a few minutes, add the parsley and pepper, and serve over toast.

name: Chips Cheese and Gravy
attribution: "Chips Cheese and Gravy" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chips_Cheese_and_Gravy, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C and spread the chips onto an oiled baking tray.
Bake the chips for around 15–20 minutes until they are slightly golden.
After about 5 minutes add grated cheese on top of the chips and continue cooking.
In a small saucepan melt in the butter and flour and mix continuously.
Cook on a low heat and slowly add the beef broth and black pepper. Stir continually.
When the chips are ready, divide between plates and add the gravy as desired.

name: Chipsi mayai
attribution: "Chipsi mayai" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chipsi_mayai, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into fries
2 tbsp vegetable oil (plus extra for frying)

steps: Peel the potatoes and cut them into thin fries.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan or pot.
Fry the potatoes until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fries and drain on paper towels.
In a bowl, beat the eggs until well combined.
Add salt and black pepper.
Stir in the onion, tomato, and chili if using.
Add the fried chips to the beaten eggs and mix gently.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Pour the egg and chips mixture into the pan.
Cook for 3–5 minutes until the bottom is golden brown.
Carefully flip the omelette using a plate or lid.
Cook the other side for another 3–4 minutes.
Remove from the heat when fully cooked.
Garnish with fresh coriander.
Cut into wedges and serve hot.

name: Choco-Crunch Bites
attribution: "Choco-Crunch Bites" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Choco-Crunch_Bites, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup (15 g / 0.5 oz) puffed rice cereal
¾ cup (225 g / 7.9 oz) peanut butter
½ cup (60 g / 2.1 oz) powdered sugar or 1 cup (80 g / 2.8 oz) coconut

steps: Mix all ingredients except the topping together.
Form into 1-inch balls by pressing the mixture firmly together with clean hands.
Gently roll in either the powdered sugar or coconut.
Cover and refrigerate any leftovers.

name: Choco-Nutty Pie
attribution: "Choco-Nutty Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Choco-Nutty_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup butter, melted and cooled

steps: Combine the first four ingredients and mix until well blended.
Stir in chocolate chips, vanilla, and nuts.
Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 350°F for 45–50 minutes.
Let cool before cutting.

name: Chocolate and Nut Covered Strawberries
attribution: "Chocolate and Nut Covered Strawberries" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_and_Nut_Covered_Strawberries, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 ounces semisweet chocolate, melted using a double boiler
Chopped hazelnuts, pecans, walnuts, or almonds (optional)

steps: Combine melted chocolate, syrup, sugar, and salt in a large bowl.
If using cookies or nuts, place them in a pie plate.
Add strawberries to chocolate mixture and toss to coat. If using nuts or cookies, roll strawberries in them.
Insert a toothpick into the side of each fruit and refrigerate until coating sets.
Serve chilled.

name: Chocolate Bananas Foster
attribution: "Chocolate Bananas Foster" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Bananas_Foster, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 slightly unripe bananas, peeled and halved lengthwise
½ cup (60 ml / 2 oz) dark rum
¼ cup (50 g / 1.8 oz) granulated sugar

steps: Combine all ingredients except bananas, powdered sugar, orange, and rum in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Once mixture comes to a boil, add bananas, making sure to keep at least ½ inch (1.3 cm) between them. Cook for 1 minute per side.

Remove bananas from pan and keep warm. Bring mixture again to a strong boil over high heat. Turn off the heat and add rum. If rum has not ignited by itself, do so carefully either with a firestick or a long fireplace match. Wait until flames die out before stirring in zest.
Spoon sauce over bananas and dust with powdered sugar. Serve warm with some ice cream.

name: Chocolate Bourbon Pecan Pie
attribution: "Chocolate Bourbon Pecan Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Bourbon_Pecan_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Pastry dough for 9-inch pie (commercial or your own)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Beat eggs until yellow and creamy, in a large bowl.
Whisk in half-and-half, sugar, and syrup, until smooth.
Stir in bourbon, chocolate chips, and pecans.
Oil a springform pan lightly.
Roll out the pastry dough and press it into a pan, pressing out any air bubbles.
Pour mixture into oiled springform pan.
Put pie on a baking sheet with a raised edge or border.
Bake until only the center is sightly jiggly, about 2 hours.
Do not remove the pie from the mold until absolutely cooled, at least an hour.

name: Chocolate Cake with Coconut Topping (Vegan)
attribution: "Chocolate Cake with Coconut Topping (Vegan)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Cake_with_Coconut_Topping_(Vegan), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Zest of a lemon or grated ginger
2 small apples, cut into small pieces

steps: Beat all wet ingredients together for 10 minutes until creamy, adding the soy milk gradually to the other ingredients.
Combine all dry ingredients, then sift loosely to aerate and remove lumps.
Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Add the wet mixture and the add-ins to the dry mixture. Stir briefly until smooth. Do not over-mix, since this will cause the batter to deflate and become tough.
Spread the batter in a large baking pan lined with baking paper.
Bake for 20 minutes. Turn off the oven, and let the cake continue cooking in the residual heat for 15 minutes. Let cool.
Unmold the cake from the pan, and remove the baking paper.
Melt the chocolate couverture over a double boiler. Spread the melted chocolate on top of the cake, then sprinkle with grated coconut.
Sprinkle the still soft couverture with grated coconut.

name: Chocolate Cheesecake
attribution: "Chocolate Cheesecake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Cheesecake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 packages (24 ounces / 705 g) cream cheese, at room temperature
4 ounces (215 g / 4 squares) semisweet chocolate, melted
6 ounces (150 g / 6 squares) semisweet chocolate, melted

steps: Place rack in center of the oven. Preheat oven to 150 °C (300 °F).
If starting with whole cookies, crackers, or wafers, place them in a sturdy plastic bag a few at a time and crush using a rolling pin, or grind using a food processor.
Mix together chocolate crumbs and melted butter.
Press crumb mixture into bottom and sides of 9-inch springform pan.
In a large bowl, beat together sugar and eggs at medium speed, slowly adding cream cheese, until smooth and fluffy.
Spoon half of cream cheese mixture into crust.
Melt 4 ounces of chocolate using a double boiler or, with care, a microwave. Stir into remaining cream cheese mixture until well blended.
Drizzle chocolate cream cheese mixture over batter in crust. Draw a spoon or other implement through the batter a few times to make swirls. Spread evenly.
Bake cheesecake for 50 minutes. After the first 30 minutes has gone by, place aluminum foil on top to prevent cracking and scorching.
Cool completely.
Cover with plastic wrap, and chill for about 2 hours or up to several days.
Transfer cheesecake to a serving plate.
Uncover cheesecake; carefully remove side of pan.
Melt remaining chocolate.
Mix with sour cream.
Spread over cake, and chill to set.

name: Chocolate Chip Coffee Cake
attribution: "Chocolate Chip Coffee Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Chip_Coffee_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup / 91 g / 28% Semi-sweet chocolate chips
⅓ cup / 66.67 g / 20.51% White granulated sugar

steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Use cooking spray to lightly coat an 8- or 9-inch baking pan.
Combine pancake mix, chocolate chips, and ⅓ cup sugar, then stir until barely mixed.
Add sour cream, vanilla, and water, and mix well.
Spoon mixture into 16 ea. 2-inch dough balls.
Place dough balls 2 or 3 inches apart in pan.
Combine remaining ¼ cup sugar, cinnamon, and nuts, and mix well.
Sprinkle nut mixture over dough balls.
Bake until golden brown, about 24–26 minutes.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies (Gluten-Free)
attribution: "Chocolate Chip Cookies (Gluten-Free)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Chip_Cookies_(Gluten-Free), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup (120 ml) white granulated sugar
1¼ cup (300 ml / 1 cup + 2 tablespoons) sweet rice flour
Chocolate chips (as many as you like)
Stand mixer and bowl (or a hand-held mixer and a medium mixing bowl)
Non-stick silicone baking sheet liner (Silpat, etc.)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Mix the sweet rice flour, xanthan gum, baking powder and baking soda in a large mixing bowl.
In a smaller mixing bowl or stand mixer, cream the butter, sugar, and brown sugar. Add the eggs and vanilla and continue mixing.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix thoroughly with a wooden spoon. Don't worry about over-mixing; since there is no gluten in the flour, there is no danger of overworking it.
Fold in the chocolate chips.
Line cookie sheet with silicone mat and spoon on balls of dough, about 1½ inches (4 cm) in diameter.
Put cookie dough in the fridge for 30–40 minutes or into the freezer for 10–20 minutes.
Bake until golden brown.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies (Vegan)
attribution: "Chocolate Chip Cookies (Vegan)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Chip_Cookies_(Vegan), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups flour (whole wheat pastry flour recommended but all-purpose white also works)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Cream shortening, margarine, and sugar together in a mixer.
Add banana to the sugar and butter mixture.
Mix all the dry ingredients together. Slowly add to the wet mixture.
Add chocolate chips.
Roll small portions of dough into balls and place on a cookie sheet.
Bake for 10–11 minutes, or until slightly browned.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies I
attribution: "Chocolate Chip Cookies I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Chip_Cookies_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 sticks (½ lb / 225 g / 1 cup) butter, softened
¾ cup (180 ml) granulated white sugar
¾ cup (180 ml) packed brown sugar
2 ¼ cups (600 ml / 290 g) all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon dry ground lemon or orange peel (optional)
2 cups (480 ml / 12 oz) semi-sweet chocolate morsels / chips
5 oz (150 g) chopped nuts, such as groundnuts (optional)

steps: Preheat oven to (), or () if you want chewy cookies.
Cream butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar in a large mixer bowl.
Add eggs one at a time, beating until fully incorporated.
Add vanilla extract and beat in.

In a small bowl, sift together the dry ingredients (except chocolate and nuts). Add to the wet mixture in two parts and fold until combined. If you beat this too long, you may get some gluten formation which will change the cookie texture.
Stir in chocolate morsels (chips), and nuts if using.

Drop dough by rounded tablespoons onto ungreased baking sheets. There should be enough fat in the cookie dough to prevent sticking, but using parchment paper or non-stick pans may help if you find this not to be the case.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10–12 minutes or until golden brown (cooking times may vary). Let stand for about 1 minute and remove from hot baking sheet to cool on a wire rack.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies III
attribution: "Chocolate Chip Cookies III" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Chip_Cookies_III, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cream butter and sugar in a bowl until well combined.
Mix in egg and vanilla.
Combine flour, salt, and baking soda. Mix this dry mix into the wet mix.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Scoop cookies onto a parchment-lined baking sheet. Bake at 350°F until golden brown.
Cool slightly, then remove from baking sheet. Cool fully.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies IV
attribution: "Chocolate Chip Cookies IV" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Chip_Cookies_IV, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup (100 g / 3.5 oz) granulated sugar
¾ cup (140 g / 5 oz) light brown sugar, packed
½ cup (1 stick / 125 g / 4.5 oz) unsalted butter, melted
4 oz (115 g) milk or semi-sweet chocolate chunks

steps: Cream the butter, sugars and salt in a mixing bowl until combined.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Sift the flour and baking soda into the mixture and fold in.
Fold in the chocolate.
Cover the dough with clingfilm and chill for at least 2 hours.
Preheat the oven to 180°C (356°F). Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper.
Scoop the dough onto the baking sheets, making sure the cookies are at least 4 inches (10 cm) apart from each other.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the edges are light brown in color.
Take the cookies out of the oven and leave them to cool.

name: Chocolate Chip Peanut Butter Toast
attribution: "Chocolate Chip Peanut Butter Toast" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Chip_Peanut_Butter_Toast, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2–4 tablespoons peanut butter, smooth or crunchy

steps: Toast the bread on both sides in a toaster oven, using the broiler setting.
Smear the peanut butter on the bread.
Sprinkle chocolate chips lightly (or heavily, if you want!) over the peanut butter.
Put the toast back under the broiler for about 20 seconds to melt the chocolate.

name: Chocolate Chip Pumpkin Cookies
attribution: "Chocolate Chip Pumpkin Cookies" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Chip_Pumpkin_Cookies, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup (250 ml / 8.5 fl oz) vegetable oil
2 cups (150 g / 5.3 oz) pecans or almonds, chopped
1 cup (100 g / 3.5 oz) granola, rolled oats or Grape-Nuts

steps: Preheat oven to 375 F.
In a large bowl, combine and wet ingredients.
Sift flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, soda, and cloves together in a separate bowl.
Blend dry into wet ingredients.
Mix in nuts, granola, and chocolate chips.
Drop spoonfuls of dough onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 10–12 minutes, then cool.

name: Chocolate Chip Rolls
attribution: "Chocolate Chip Rolls" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Chip_Rolls, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 ½ cup (360 ml) / 366 g / 75% Milk or soy milk
½ cup (120 ml) / 109 g / 22% Vegetable oil

steps: Preheat oven to 425°F (210°C)
Mix dry ingredients together.
Mix liquid ingredients into dry.
Turn dough out onto floured baking cloth and knead slightly.
Roll dough into log, then cut into 8–12 pieces
Press pieces flat, sprinkle with chocolate chips, and roll up to enclose the chocolate.
Place rolls on greased baking sheet, and bake 13–15 minutes.
Serve fresh.

name: Chocolate Chocolate Chip Muffins
attribution: "Chocolate Chocolate Chip Muffins" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Chocolate_Chip_Muffins, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 ¾ cup (250 g / 8.8 oz) all-purpose flour
¾ cup (175 g / 6.2 oz) granulated sugar
⅓ cup (40 g / 1.4 oz) cocoa, sifted if lumpy
⅓ cup (80 ml / 2.7 fl oz) cooking oil

steps: Combine all-purpose flour, chocolate chips, sugar, cocoa, salt, and baking powder in a mixing bowl. Create a well in the center.
Beat egg in a small bowl. Add milk, cooking oil, and vanilla. Stir and pour into well. Stir until just moistened.
Grease 12 muffin cups with cooking spray. Fill cups ¾ full.
Bake at 400°F (205°C) for 20 minutes until a skewer inserted into the center tests clean.

name: Chocolate Crinkles
attribution: "Chocolate Crinkles" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Crinkles, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 squares (4 oz / 115 g) unsweetened chocolate, melted

steps: Mix oil, chocolate, and granulated sugar.
Blend in one egg at a time until well mixed. Add vanilla.
Stir flour, baking powder, and salt into chocolate mixture.
Chill several hours or overnight.
Heat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Drop teaspoonfuls of dough into confectioners' sugar.
Roll in sugar; shape into balls.
Place about 2 inches (5 cm) apart on greased baking sheet.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes.

name: Chocolate Icing
attribution: "Chocolate Icing" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Icing, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Melt chocolate over hot water.
Add the cream.
Gradually beat in sugar until icing is creamy and thick enough to spread.

name: Chocolate Macaroons (no-bake)
attribution: "Chocolate Macaroons (no-bake)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Macaroons_(no-bake), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup (120 g) margarine or butter

steps: Place the bottom half of a double boiler on the stove to heat.
Place a large metal mixing bowl on top of the boiler. Melt the margarine/butter in this bowl.
Add the white sugar, and whisk until dissolved.
Whisk in the milk.
Whisk in the cocoa, breaking up lumps first.
Remove from heat, take to preparation area.
Using a rubber spatula, thoroughly mix in coconut and oatmeal. There should be no dry sections.
Portion onto pan and let set.

name: Chocolate Milkshake
attribution: "Chocolate Milkshake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Milkshake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Pour all ingredients into the blender and blend until well mixed.
Adjust the consistency as desired with ice cream and chocolate milk.
Stir in crushed Oreo cookies if desired.

name: Chocolate Mousse
attribution: "Chocolate Mousse" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Mousse, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 200 g (8 oz) bittersweet chocolate, chopped (see notes)

steps: Melt the chocolate in a double boiler.
Separate the eggs.
Whip the egg whites and cream separately until very firm. Put both in the refrigerator.

Combine the egg yolks and hot water in a mixing bowl; maximum tap water temperature is enough, approx. 50–60°C (120–140°F). Using a mixer, beat slowly while adding the sugar, then speed up the mixer until the mixture is thick and becomes a light yellow color.

Stir the melted chocolate into the yolk mixture (the chocolate should have cooled enough that it does not hurt if you insert your finger). Mix immediately, otherwise this will cook the egg yolks, and you'll have chocolate scrambled eggs!
With a whisk (from now on do not use the mixer) add the egg whites in three parts to the chocolate mixture, followed by the whipped cream.

The finished mousse should be light brown and very fluffy. While it is still liquid, divide it into individual serving dishes. Allow to chill in the refrigerator for 4–6 hours before serving. The mousse will be quite firm when ready.

name: Chocolate Mousse (Vegan)
attribution: "Chocolate Mousse (Vegan)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Mousse_(Vegan), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Peel the avocados and remove the pit.
Break down the fleshy parts of the avocados using a fork or mixer; depending on the desired texture.
Add the cocoa powder and mix.
Add agave syrup to taste, and mix some more.
Serve.

name: Chocolate Mousse Cake (Vegan)
attribution: "Chocolate Mousse Cake (Vegan)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Mousse_Cake_(Vegan), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1½ cups (200 g / 7.1 oz) unbleached white flour
⅓ cup (40 g / 1.4 oz) unsweetened baking cocoa powder
¼ cup (60 ml / 2 fl oz) vegetable oil
2 tablespoons vinegar (plain red, plain white or rice vinegar)
¼ cup (30 g / 1.1 oz) cocoa powder or carob powder
⅓ cup (75 g / 2.6 oz) packed unrefined sugar

steps: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In bowl combine flour, cocoa, baking soda, salt and sugar.
In another bowl combine water, oil, and the 2 teaspoons of vanilla.
Pour liquid into dry ingredients, then whisk with fork.
Add vinegar and stir. You'll see bubbles when the acidic vinegar reacts with the basic baking soda!
Pour into baking dishes, and bake for 25–30 minutes.
Remove from oven and let cool completely.
Melt the chocolate chips.
Combine the tofu, ½ tablespoon vanilla extract, and melted chocolate chips in a blender. Blend until creamy.
Cut the top of the cake off and set the top aside. Pour the chocolate tofu mousse on the bottom half of the cake. Replace the top half.
Refrigerate until mousse thickens.
In a saucepan combine everything but vanilla extract. Bring to boil, stirring constantly.
Boil 1 minute, stir to cool, then add vanilla extract.
Pour over the top of the chocolate mousse cake.
Garnish with coconut.

name: Chocolate Noodles with Vanilla sauce
attribution: "Chocolate Noodles with Vanilla sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Noodles_with_Vanilla_sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix the flour, cocoa powder, powdered sugar, egg, mascarpone, and salt to create a smooth dough in 5 to 10 minutes.
Cover the dough and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Boil some water in a big pan, then add the butter and crystal sugar.
Roll out the dough on a flour-dusted plate and cut it in thin strips.
Boil the strips for about 4 minutes, then drain. Dry the noodles with paper towels, then keep them warm.
Mix the brown sugar and the egg yolks for the sauce in a cup and put it aside.
Put the milk and cream in a pan with the vanilla pod, stir for a few minutes, then remove the vanilla pod.
Warm the milk and cream and stir gently, then pour the warm mixture onto the egg mix.
Pour the mixture back into the pan and stir it gently until it thickens. Watch out not to boil the mixture!
Place the chocolate noodles on a plate, and pour the vanilla sauce over.

name: Chocolate Orange Hot Cross Bun Trifle
attribution: "Chocolate Orange Hot Cross Bun Trifle" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Orange_Hot_Cross_Bun_Trifle, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 chocolate and salted caramel hot cross buns, 2 split into halves and 4 torn into pieces
1¼ cups (310 ml/10 fl oz) heavy cream
4 large oranges, zested and split into segments

steps: Microwave the marmalade for 30–60 seconds to loosen.
Leave the marmalade to cool until it is just warm to the touch.
Combine the marmalade and custard in a bowl and mix together.
Whip the cream with most of the orange zest in another bowl to soft peaks.
Heat the sugar, cinnamon ,and water in a pan over a low heat for 4–6 minutes, swirling occasionally.
Place the torn buns in a 3 - 4 l trifle dish.
Pour the custard mixture into the trifle dish.
Add a layer of three-quarters of the orange segments and two-thirds of the whipped cream.
Spoon 3 tablespoons of the dessert sauce over the dish.
Top with remaining custard and cream.
Drizzle the remaining sauce over the trifle.
Place the remaining orange segments on top.
Brush the bun tops with the cinnamon glaze and place on top of the trifle.
To serve, sprinkle with the remaining orange zest.

name: Chocolate Orbit Cake
attribution: "Chocolate Orbit Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Orbit_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: almost 2 sticks / 14 Tbsp / 200 g (7 oz) Unsalted butter
1 ⅔ cup / 280 g (10 oz) Chopped semi-sweet or bittersweet chocolate (60% to 70%)
Microwave-safe bowl, or a pan for melting chocolate and butter on the stove top
Whisk (or spoon or fork for stirring)
9-inch round cake pan, at least 1.5 inches (4 cm) deep
An oven-proof pan that is big enough for a 9-inch pan to sit inside (e.g., a larger cake pan, casserole dish, or all-metal skillet)

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F (175°C, gas mark 4—moderate).
Line the bottom of the cake pan with a piece of parchment paper. Optionally, butter the sides of the cake pan.

Melt the butter and chocolate together until smooth and well-combined. The easiest way to do this is in the microwave: Put the chocolate and butter in a microwave-safe bowl or glass measuring pitcher and heat it for 30–60 seconds at a time, stirring each time, until it is nearly all melted. Let it sit for a few minutes so the residual heat will finish melting the chocolate, then give it a final stir.
Put the sugar and eggs in a large mixing bowl. Briefly whisk the sugar and eggs together.

Drizzle the melted chocolate mixture into the sugar–egg mixture, whisking until the batter is smooth in texture and uniform in appearance. The goal of whisking is to combine the ingredients thoroughly, but not to beat air into the cake batter.
Pour the batter into the prepared cake pan, then cover the cake pan with a piece of aluminum foil.

Place the foil-covered pan in a larger, oven-proof pan. Carefully pour very hot water (can be boiling) into the larger pan, so that the foil-covered cake pan is sitting in a hot water bath (called a bain marie in French). The water should be an inch (2.5 cm) deep, or approximately halfway up the side of the foil-covered cake pan. Don't pour the hot water on top of the foil or so high that it might get inside the cake pan.

Carefully put the whole bain-marie assembly in the preheated oven. Bake for about 75–90 minutes, until the cake is set and the surface is nearly dry. To test, remove the cake and its water bath from the oven, and remove the aluminum foil from the top. The surface will be pocked by little craters like an asteroid, which is the source of its name—don't worry, as they'll be covered before serving. The middle of the cake shouldn't jiggle when the cake pan is moved, and when you lightly touch the surface, your finger should come away nearly clean. If it needs just a few more minutes, it's okay to put the cake back in the oven without re-covering it. However, if you think it will need more than about 10 more minutes, re-cover it with the foil and put the whole water bath assembly back in the oven.

When it is done, remove the cake pan from the water bath and remove the foil. Cool the cake in the pan on the counter or a wire cooling rack until it is safe to cover it with plastic wrap and put it in the refrigerator. A large rubber band can help secure the plastic wrap, if needed. Chill the cake in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours (and up to overnight) until firmly set.

To serve, first let the cake warm up to room temperature for about 30 minutes. Slide a dull knife around the edge of the cake pan to loosen the sides. Flip the cake upside down onto a large plate or serving platter. Carefully peel the parchment paper off the cake.

name: Chocolate Pear Bake
attribution: "Chocolate Pear Bake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Pear_Bake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 7 oz (200 g) semisweet chocolate, chopped or in chips
½ cup (120 g) butter or margarine
½ cup (120 g) white granulated sugar

steps: Grease a 9 x 9-inch (22 x 22 cm) baking dish, and preheat the oven to 325°F (170°C).
In a double boiler, melt the chocolate and butter or margarine. When melted, remove from the heat.
Whisk the egg yolks and sugar together until they become thick and pale yellow.
In a separate bowl, whisk the egg whites until firm.
Combine the chocolate and egg yolk mixture, and mix well.
Beginning with about ⅓ the egg whites, gently fold them into the chocolate/egg yolk mixture.
Add the slices of pear, and stir once or twice. Add the entire mixture to the baking dish.
Bake for 35–40 minutes, until the bake is springy yet firm to the touch.
Serve hot with whipped cream.

name: Chocolate Sandesh
attribution: "Chocolate Sandesh" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Sandesh, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine paneer and sugar substitute, and mash together well.
Add cream, cocoa powder, and vanilla essence. Mix well.
Divide into 8 equal parts and shape into balls.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour and serve.

name: Chocolate Sauce
attribution: "Chocolate Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Melt all the ingredients in a saucepan and allow to bubble for a while until the mixture darkens in colour slightly. Be careful not to let the chocolate burn.
Remove from the heat and allow to cool until it thickens.

name: Chocolate Scotcheroos
attribution: "Chocolate Scotcheroos" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Scotcheroos, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 cups / 175 g Puffed rice cereal, such as Kellogg's Rice Krispies
9 x 13 x 2 inch (33 x 23 x 5 cm) baking pan or baking dish
Mixing spoon, such as a wooden spoon
Wax paper, plastic wrap, or baking paper (optional)
Spatula, for spreading the chocolate topping

steps: Spray the baking pan with cooking spray, or butter it lightly. Set aside.

Put the corn syrup and sugar in the saucepan. Cook over medium heat until the sugar is dissolved and the mixture begins to bubble. Do not overcook, or the bars will be hard. If you are using a candy thermometer, aim for 235–240 °F (115 °C), which is the soft ball candy stage. Remove from the heat.
Add the peanut butter, and stir until the color is uniform.
Stir in the cereal. It may be easiest to stir in half the cereal at a time, instead of adding it all at once.

Scrape all of the warm cereal mixture into the baking pan. Gently press it into a flat layer. You can do this with back of the mixing spoon, or you can cover the cereal mixture with a sheet of wax paper and use your hands. Do not crush the cereal, or the bars will be too hard and dense. Set aside.

Place the chocolate and butterscotch chips in the saucepan (it is not necessary to wash it first), and put it back on the stove over medium heat. Stir to melt the chocolate and butterscotch chips together. As soon as the morsels have melted, spread the chocolate mixture over the top of the cereal mixture.
Cool the pan until the topping is firm. If you put it in the refrigerator, this step will take about an hour.
Cut the bars into 36 small pieces, approximately 1.5 x 1.5 inches (4 x 5 cm). Serve at room temperature.

name: Chocolate Sour-Cream Icing
attribution: "Chocolate Sour-Cream Icing" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Sour-Cream_Icing, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Melt the chocolate and butter together in a double boiler.
Remove mixture from the heat, then stir in the sour cream, vanilla extract, and salt.
Slowly beat or stir in the icing sugar until the mixture has the desired consistency. An icing will be thinner and require less icing sugar than a thicker frosting.
Spread mixture on the cake of your choice.

name: Chocolate Spread
attribution: "Chocolate Spread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Spread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 250 g raw tahini or 200 g natural peanut butter

steps: Combine the sugar, cocoa powder, and salt in a saucepan.
Stir in part of the milk, then add the rest.
Heat the mixture on the stove, stirring often until the sugar dissolves into the milk.
Add the chocolate, and mix until dissolved.
Turn off the stove, add the tahini/peanut butter, and mix well.
Cool mixture and store in the fridge.

name: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
attribution: "Chocolate Zucchini Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chocolate_Zucchini_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cream together butter, vegetable oil and sugar.
Add eggs, sour milk, and vanilla. Blend well.
In a separate bowl, sift dry ingredients together.
Blend dry ingredients into the butter mixture.
Add grated zucchini, and mix well.
Spread in a greased floured 9 x 13-inch (23 x 33 cm) pan. Sprinkle walnuts and chocolate chips on top.
Bake in a preheated 325°F (165°C) oven for 45 minutes.

name: Chokladboll (Swedish Chocolate Balls)
attribution: "Chokladboll (Swedish Chocolate Balls)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chokladboll_(Swedish_Chocolate_Balls), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 ¼ cups (500 g / 1.1 lb) quick oats
1 ¼ cups (275 g / 9.7 oz) white granulated sugar
1 Tbsp (15 ml / 14 g / 0.49 oz) vanilla sugar OR 1 tsp (5 ml / 0.17 oz) vanilla extract, added with the coffee
⅔ cup (160 g / 5.6 oz) butter or margarine, softened

steps: Mix oats, sugar, vanilla sugar, and cocoa in a large bowl.
Using your hands or a potato masher, incorporate the butter into the dry ingredients until the dough has an even consistency.
Add the coffee and mix until incorporated.
Fill a small bowl with flaked coconut or pearl sugar.
With your hands, roll the dough into 1-inch (3 cm) diameter balls.
Roll each ball in the coconut or pearl sugar and place on a tray.
Chill chocolate balls for at least one hour before serving.

name: Chola and Roti
attribution: "Chola and Roti" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chola_and_Roti, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Soak the chana dal in water overnight.
Drain the chana dal, and pressure cook them until tender. Drain.
Fry the onions in hot oil until golden brown. Add the tomatoes, and fry until the oil separates out.
Add chiles, ginger, salt, and drained chana dal. Boil for 1–2 minutes.
Stir in pepper and garam masala. Garnish with coriander leaves.
Serve hot with naan or roti.

name: Chorba Frik (Freekeh Soup)
attribution: "Chorba Frik (Freekeh Soup)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chorba_Frik_(Freekeh_Soup), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix all the ingredients together in a pot large enough to contain everything.
Place the pot over low heat. Cook for 90 minutes, stirring often.
Serve with lemon

name: Choripán (Argentine Chorizo Sandwich)
attribution: "Choripán (Argentine Chorizo Sandwich)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chorip%C3%A1n_(Argentine_Chorizo_Sandwich), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Knives for cutting the bread and chorizo

steps: Fire up your grill. Preheat the grates to medium heat (approximately 350 °F / 175 °C).
Grill the chorizo sausages 20 minutes per side.
When the chorizos are nearly done, slice the rolls in half and char it slightly on the grill.
Remove the chorizo sausages from the grill and slice them lengthwise, "butterfly style."
Smear some mayonnaise on the bread halves.
Assemble the sandwiches with 1 sausage per roll. Add tomato slices and lettuce to taste. Dress with chimichurri sauce.

name: Chow Mein
attribution: "Chow Mein" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chow_Mein, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Vegetable oil for frying, as needed
¼ cup water or low-sodium vegetable broth

steps: 1–2 hours before cooking, rinse the mung bean sprouts so that they have time to drain thoroughly.
Cut the seitan into thin strips. Add the marinade ingredients, adding the cornstarch last. Marinate the seitan for 20 to 25 minutes.
The following 3 steps can be completed while the seitan is marinating:

* To prepare the sauce, in a small bowl dissolve the 1 tablespoon cornstarch with the 4 tablespoons water. Whisk the water or vegetable broth with the oyster sauce, soy sauce, salt, pepper and cornstarch and water mixture and set aside.
* Soften the noodles by placing them in boiling salted water. Plunge into cold water to stop the cooking process and drain thoroughly.

* Wash all the vegetables as needed. Cut the celery and the bok choy into ½-inch pieces on the diagonal. If substituting broccoli for bok choy, peel the stalks until no more strings come out, and slice thinly on the diagonal. Wipe the mushrooms clean with a damp cloth and slice. Cut the red bell pepper in half, remove the seeds and cut into chunks. Peel and chop the onion. Dice the green onion.
Heat a wok or frying pan over medium-high to high heat. Add 2 tablespoons oil. When the oil is hot, add the noodles. Fry in batches until golden. Remove the noodles from the pan.

Heat 2 tablespoons oil. Add the onion and the seitan, keeping remaining marinade aside for later use. Let the seitan brown briefly, then stir-fry until the redness is gone and the seitan is nearly cooked through. Remove the cooked seitan and onion from the pan.

Cook the rest of the vegetables separately, except for the green onion, seasoning each with a bit of salt while stir-frying if desired. When cooking the bok choy or broccoli, add ¼ cup of water and cover while cooking. Remove each of the vegetables from the pan when finished stir-frying. Add more oil as needed.

Give the sauce a quick re-stir. Add all the ingredients back into the wok, making a "well" in the middle of the wok for the sauce. Add the sauce and any remaining marinade, stirring quickly to thicken. Mix everything together. Stir in the green onions. Pour the cooked vegetable and sauce mixture on top of the noodles. Garnish the chow mein with the toasted sesame seeds. Serve hot.

name: Christmas Cake
attribution: "Christmas Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Christmas_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 300 g lightly-salted soft margarine (The "Stork" brand is traditional)

steps: Place all the fruit in a large bowl and pour the spirits over the mixture.
Cover the bowl in foil and leave in a cool place.
Mix and stir the fruit every day for at least three days; after a fortnight most of the alcohol will have soaked in and further soaking has no benefit.
Beat together the sugar and margarine with the eggs.
Add the almonds and black treacle, and mix further.
Sieve the flours and the mixed spice into the mixture, beating until a smooth mixture results.
Combine with the pre-prepared fruit (above) and place in a cake tin lined with baking parchment.
Bake at a low temperature (140°C / 275°F / Gas mark 1) for at least 4 hours. It may take up to 5 hours, depending on the oven.
Once a knife comes out clean, remove from the oven and allow to cool fully.
Stored in an airtight box the cake should keep for at least four months.

name: Christmas Cinnamon Cookies
attribution: "Christmas Cinnamon Cookies" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Christmas_Cinnamon_Cookies, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Mix all the ingredients together, in any order, to make a dough.
Cool dough in a refrigerator for 1 hour.
Flatten dough with a rolling pin.
Cut out desired shapes with a cookie cutter.
Bake for 10 minutes. Cool.
The biscuits will be soft when removed from the oven. This is normal as they will harden when they cool down. The cookies will be cooked when they appear brown on the inside and the outside.

name: Christmas Ham
attribution: "Christmas Ham" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Christmas_Ham, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 ea. (7–10 kg) ham, lightly salted and boneless

steps: If ham is frozen, thaw it in its plastic package, for 3 days in the refrigerator for a 7kg ham, 5 days for a 10kg ham.

Before putting the ham in the oven, take it out from the refrigerator and let come closer to room temperature. If you intend to put the ham in the oven in the evening, take it out during the early morning. The ham should be about 10 °C (50 °F) when you put it in the oven.
Use a wet paper towel to clean the ham a bit; then dry it.

Place ham on baking tray in oven, with some water on the tray. Or, if you have a large roasting bag, there is no need for water. Do not use only the oven rack, as nothing will catch all the liquid from the ham if the roasting bag fails, messing up your oven. However, you can put the ham on the rack if you put a baking tray beneath that to catch drips. Aluminum foil can be used on the baking tray to protect it.
Preheat oven to 200 °C (390 °F) and let ham roast in the oven for half an hour. You can skip this if you are not worried about the possible bacteria on the ham.

Turn temperature down, and cook at 100–125 °C (210–260 °F), for about 1 hour/kg (a 7 kg ham will take 7 hours or more) until a meat thermometer in the center of the ham reads 75–80 °C (158–176 °F). Traditional ham is ready at 80 °C but most take the ham out of the oven at 77 °C or so, when the ham has more water left in it and is considered tastier.
After you take the ham out of the oven, wait a little while before removing the thermometer. It is recommended you do not pour the liquid from the bag or baking tray down the drain.

Wait until ham is cool enough to handle, then glaze it all over with mustard and breadcrumbs. First remove the rind from the ham, then cover the ham with mustard, then with breadcrumbs. Bake in a 250 °C (480 °F) oven for 10 minutes.
The ham is ready to eat when it has cooled down a bit. This makes about enough for 3 or 4 people for a week, but if you think you will not eat it all within a week, freeze the rest.

name: Christmas Mince Pies (Meat-Free)
attribution: "Christmas Mince Pies (Meat-Free)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Christmas_Mince_Pies_(Meat-Free), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Shortcrust pastry dough, either homemade or shop bought
Fruit mince, either homemade or shop bought

steps: Roll out the pastry dough if needed, and cut out small rounds of dough.
Line greased tartlet pans with the dough rounds.
Spoon heaped teaspoons of fruit mince into each tartlet shell.
Top the tartlets with slightly smaller circles of dough, preferably cut with a fluted cutter
Bake until golden brown.
If desired, dust pies with a light sprinkling of icing sugar just before serving.

name: Christmas Pudding I
attribution: "Christmas Pudding I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Christmas_Pudding_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 100 g (3.5 oz / ¾ cup) self-rising flour
25 g (0.88 oz / ¼ cup) candied fruit peel
75 g (2.6 oz / ⅓ cup) unsalted butter plus extra for greasing
100 g (3.5 oz / ½ cup) muscovado sugar
40 g (1.4 oz / ½ cup) almonds, chopped roughly
3 tbsp brandy, rum, or sherry and some extra for flaming

steps: In a mixing bowl, combine the raisins, currants, candied peel, and apple with zest and juice from the lemon and orange. Stir well and leave in the bowl for an hour for the flavours to combine.
In another bowl, cream together the butter and sugar using a spoon. When fluffy, slowly add in the eggs.
Sift the flour and spice together in another bowl. Add this bit by bit into the creamed butter and sugar, folding it in with the breadcrumbs and almonds. Then fold in the fruit mixture.
Liberally butter the pudding basin and place a small, round piece of baking paper in the bottom of the basin.

Slowly add the mixture into the basin and level the mixture out. Cut a layer of baking paper and foil for the top, leaving a crease in the middle so the pudding can expand, place it on top of the basin, and secure it with string.
Cook the pudding by either:
* Steaming for 8 hours: put the pudding into a steamer with simmering water. Cover with a lid and top up the water level as needed for 8 hours.

* Boiling for 7 hours: To boil, place a metal jam lid, or any kind of circular, thin metal object, at the bottom of a large pan to be a trivet. Create 2 strips of large string or foil and place them on the trivet so you can easily pick up your pudding once its cooked. Make sure there is enough to hang over the side of your pot, so its easy to get a hold of. Then, slowly place your pudding onto the trivet and pour boiling water in so that it reaches halfway up the side of your pudding bowl. Cover with a lid and let the water simmer for 8 hours until the pudding has reached a dark deep brown, adding more water as needed.

Remove your pudding and leave to cool for 1–2 hours. Once cool, remove the paper and foil and replace it with fresh paper and foil. Store in a cool, dry area. The pudding can be frozen for up to 1 year.
To serve, steam or boil your pudding for two hours to reheat. Once reheated, turn it out onto a serving plate.

To flame, warm a small amount of brandy in a pan, pour it over the hot pudding once at the table and light it with a matchstick or other easily used flame. Place your bowl of brandy butter on the table for people to enjoy with your pudding.

name: Christmas Pudding II
attribution: "Christmas Pudding II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Christmas_Pudding_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ lb (225 g) white granulated sugar (or less)
¾ lb (340 g) shredded suet (can be vegetarian; see note below)
2 oz (55 g) almonds, chopped but not too small

steps: Mix all ingredients together, stirring well to combine.
Divide batter between 2 pudding basins. Cover with cloths or buttered greaseproof paper, tied tightly in place with string.
Steam for 7 hours, then cool and keep until Christmas Day.
To prepare for serving, steam for 2 hours. Times can be reduced by using a pressure cooker.

name: Chuck Wagon Beans
attribution: "Chuck Wagon Beans" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chuck_Wagon_Beans, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ pound bacon, cut into bite-sized pieces

steps: Brown bacon, ground chuck, and onion.
Stir in remaining ingredients in order; mix well in between each addition.
Bake at 350°F for about 40 minutes, or until thickened.

name: Chukauni (Nepalese Potato Salad)
attribution: "Chukauni (Nepalese Potato Salad)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chukauni_(Nepalese_Potato_Salad), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 boiled potatoes, peeled and roughly cubed

steps: Put the boiled potatoes in a bowl.
Add chopped chilies and chilies.
Pour the yoghurt over the potatoes.
Add salt and red chili powder as per your taste.
In a small wok or pan, heat some oil with red chilies and fenugreek seed.
When the seeds turn black, remove the pan from heat.
Add turmeric powder over the oil immediately.
Pour the oil over the potatoes and yoghurt mixture.
Mix the mixture evenly with a ladle or a spoon.

name: Chunky Cran Apple Bran Muffins
attribution: "Chunky Cran Apple Bran Muffins" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chunky_Cran_Apple_Bran_Muffins, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¾ cup (180 g) natural wheat bran
1 ½ cup (360 g) chopped, peeled apples

steps: Combine bran and milk into a mixing bowl. Let rest for 5 minutes.
Combine flour, baking powder, cinnamon, salt, baking soda and nutmeg in another mixing bowl.
Stir brown sugar, cooking oil, and egg into the bran mixture. Stir in dried ingredients, apples and cranberries.
Spoon batter into greased muffin cups.
Fill muffin cups ¾ full. Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15 to 20 minutes, or until tester comes out clean.

name: Chunky Guacamole
attribution: "Chunky Guacamole" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chunky_Guacamole, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Peel and dice avocados.
Sprinkle the avocados with lime juice.
Add salsa fresca, and toss to mix.

name: Chupaqueso
attribution: "Chupaqueso" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chupaqueso, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: About 3 oz (85 g) shredded "shell" cheese (e.g. cheddar)
About 1 oz (28 g) shredded "filler" cheese (e.g. parmesan, Monterey Jack)

steps: In a medium-large non-stick or cast-iron skillet, sprinkle the "shell" cheese evenly. It will melt and bubble, and eventually form a layer of cheese.
Once the underside is orange or brown colored, flip it over.
Sprinkle the filler cheese down the middle, and put whatever toppings you want down the middle.
Fold the shell over, and let it cook long enough to melt the filler cheese if desired.
Serve and eat right away.

name: Churri (Indian Yogurt Herb Sauce)
attribution: "Churri (Indian Yogurt Herb Sauce)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Churri_(Indian_Yogurt_Herb_Sauce), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Add cumin seed to a skillet over medium heat, and toast until fragrant. Don't let burn.
Grind the toasted cumin seeds with a mortar.
Grind the mint, coriander leaves, ginger, and chili peppers into a paste.
Add the yoghurt, buttermilk and salt and make sure everything gets mixed up well.
Add the onion and the ground cumin.

name: Churros I
attribution: "Churros I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Churros_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Sift the flour, baking soda, and salt into a large mixing bowl.
Add the boiling water gradually to the flour, mixing constantly until you get a very thick, smooth paste.
Allow to stand for about an hour.
Heat up a deep frying pan of oil until it shimmers.

Using an icing bag, or a freezer bag with the corner cut out to give a hole about the size of your little finger, squeeze the paste into the pan. Use a pair of scissors to cut the sausage-shaped pieces off after about 10 cm.
Fry the churros until golden brown and crunchy. If the pieces are too thick and are still raw in the middle, cut them in half lengthwise and fry again.
Remove churros from oil, and drain on a rack or paper towels.
Serve dusted liberally with sugar or hot chocolate sauce (or both).

name: Chuu Chee Fish
attribution: "Chuu Chee Fish" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chuu_Chee_Fish, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 650 g whole bream or similar fish
1 metric cup vegetable oil (reserve 1 tablespoon for stir-frying curry paste)
1 teaspoon of kaeng chu chee curry paste
1 tablespoon (warning: perhaps the metric 20 mL one) fish sauce

steps: In a wok or large frypan, over high heat, fry fish using most of the vegetable oil, until golden on one side. It will take about 5 minutes.
Lower heat and, using tongs, gently turn fish over.
Turn up heat again and cook until golden. Using tongs again, lift fish gently onto a serving plate.
In the wok, gently stir-fry the curry-paste and lime leaves in remaining tablespoon of oil.
Add coconut milk and fish sauce. Simmer for about 5 minutes.
Add sugar and simmer for another 5 minutes.
Taste to see if extra coconut milk, fish sauce, or sugar is required.
Pour sauce over fish and garnish with cilantro and chopped chili peppers.

name: Chyapa Shutki Bharta
attribution: "Chyapa Shutki Bharta" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Chyapa_Shutki_Bharta, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6–8 ea. / About 100 grams Chepa shutki (Bengali dried fermented fish)

steps: Clean and wash the fish. If you want, you can remove the scales and extra thorns.
Fry the flat dried fish in a dry pan over low heat until the aroma comes out. Some people fry it with a little oil, but the taste is stronger when fried dry. Remove from the heat, and let cool.
Grind the fish well in a mortar or bowl.
Grind the chiles, garlic, and salt together.
Lightly crush the onion with a fork to release the juice.
Combine all the ingredients together, and serve.

name: Ciabatta
attribution: "Ciabatta" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ciabatta, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Dissolve salt and yeast in lukewarm water
Add sifted wheat flour and olive oil into lukewarm water. Mix.
After thoroughly being mixed and one is left with a dough that is of a uniform texture and consistency, cover and leave to rest in warm place for 45 minutes.

Take out and begin to work the dough once more, stretching it and folding it over itself on all four corners; adding flour to surface to prevent its sticking. Cover and leave it to rest for about 30 minutes, during which time the dough will rise.

Repeat this process, by stretching the dough and folding it over itself on all sides, allowing for air pockets to be formed (which will make the bread airy when it is baked). Cover and allow to rest for 30 minutes.
Repeat the above process once more and leave the dough to settle for 30 minutes while covered.
Take up dough and place on baking sheet, and cut the dough into equal parts to form into smaller, separate loaves (elongated).
Place dough in pre-heated oven and bake at 430 F for 18 minutes.

name: Cincinnati-Style Chili
attribution: "Cincinnati-Style Chili" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cincinnati-Style_Chili, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Crumble the raw ground beef into the cold water.
Add remaining ingredients and spices. Stir well, breaking the meat up before cooking.
Cover and simmer over low heat for two hours, stirring occasionally.
Cool, then refrigerate and remove solidified grease.
Reheat and serve as desired.

name: Cinnamon Bun
attribution: "Cinnamon Bun" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cinnamon_Bun, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tablespoon / 15 g / 12.5% Cream, milk, or water

steps: Combine flour, baking powder and salt.
Cut in the shortening.
Add the milk, stirring with a knife until the dough is soft and slightly sticky.
Knead the dough until it "springs back" when you push your finger into it.
Roll the dough into a 9 x 13-inch (23 x 30 cm) rectangle. Use a 9 x 13-inch (23 x 30 cm) baking pan as a mould for the size.
Brush butter over the dough, leaving about ¼ inch (0.75 cm) around the edges clear.
Combine brown sugar, white sugar, cinnamon and salt. Sprinkle over the buttered dough, leaving about ¼ inch around the edges clear.
Press the sugar mixture down. Roll the dough up lengthwise into a log, as tight as you can.
Trim the edges, then cut into 8 pieces.
Arrange the buns in a small pan, so that all the buns are touching.
Bake at 425°F (210°C) for 15–20 minutes.
Let cool.
Combine icing sugar and liquid. Whisk together to make an icing.
Spread topping on buns after they have cooled.

name: Cinnamon Chicken
attribution: "Cinnamon Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cinnamon_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼–½ peach, chopped finely OR 1–2 tablespoons honey
Enough pasta for 4 servings (cheese tortellini is good)

steps: Heat olive oil in a medium saucepan.
Lightly brown the chicken breasts in the oil—don't cook them through.
Add the onion and fry for a couple of minutes.
Add peach (if you're using peach) and fry for another minute.
Cut the tomatoes in half and add them.
Add everything else and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the lid and let it simmer for about 15 more minutes.
In the meantime, cook the pasta according to the directions on the package.
Remove cinnamon sticks from sauce. Serve over hot pasta with freshly-grated Parmesan and garlic bread.

name: Cinnamon Croutons
attribution: "Cinnamon Croutons" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cinnamon_Croutons, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl, and set aside.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (~180°C).
Heat the walnut oil in a frying pan. Add the bread cubes, then fry them, tossing to coat with oil.
Spread the bread cubes on a baking sheet and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. Bake for 8 minutes or until crispy and dry.
Allow to cool well before handling, as the sugar will make these croûtons easier to brown, and thus hotter to handle initially.

name: Cioppino (Italian Seafood Stew)
attribution: "Cioppino (Italian Seafood Stew)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cioppino_(Italian_Seafood_Stew), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¾ teaspoon dried crushed red pepper flakes, plus more to taste
2 pounds crabs (any type), cut into pieces
1 ½ pounds tilapia (or other white, firm-fleshed fish), cut into 2-inch chunks
2 loaves of San Francisco sourdough bread or any other bread with a chewy crust

steps: Heat the oil in a very large pot over medium heat.
Add the fennel, onion, shallots, and salt and sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add the garlic and red pepper flakes, and sauté for 2 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste.
Add tomatoes with their juices, wine, water, crabs, celery and bay leaf. Cover and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to medium-low. Simmer, covered, for about 30 minutes to allow the flavors to blend.
Add the mussels to the cooking liquid. Cover and cook until the mussels begin to open.This should take about 5 minutes.

Add the scallops and fish. Simmer gently until the fish and scallops are just cooked through and all the mussels are completely open, gently stirring occasionally. This should take about another 10 minutes.
Check the soup for closed mussels and throw them out. Remove the bay leaf.
Season the soup to taste with more salt and red pepper flakes.

name: Citrus Energy Drink
attribution: "Citrus Energy Drink" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Citrus_Energy_Drink, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ ea. lemon, zested in strips and juiced
½ ea. lime, zested in strips and juiced
½ ea. orange, zested in strips and juiced

steps: Combine the citrus zests and sugar, rubbing the sugar into the peels to extract the oils. Let this mixture rest in the fridge for 24 hours to infuse.
Combine the sugar-zest mixture with the citrus juices and caffeine. Stir well to dissolve the sugar and get a syrup.
Strain the syrup—this should yield approximately 5 oz (150 ml) syrup.
To make the finished beverage, mix 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

name: Clams Steamed in Aluminum Foil
attribution: "Clams Steamed in Aluminum Foil" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Clams_Steamed_in_Aluminum_Foil, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C).
Clean clams.
Cut out four 18-inch aluminum foil squares.
Make squares into double foil pockets and put ingredients in them.
Fold edges so there is plenty of space for them to open. The edges themselves should be tightly folded several times to close up.
Bake for 15–25 minutes.
Eat right out of the foil or empty onto plate.

name: Classic Mince Pies
attribution: "Classic Mince Pies" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Classic_Mince_Pies, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine beef, suet, sugar, raisins, apples, wine, and cider until thin enough.
Add mace, nutmeg, and orange zest to taste.
If not sweet enough, add more sugar.
Form pies with the pastry dough and filling.
Bake pies.
Warm the pies before serving.

name: Classic Salad
attribution: "Classic Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Classic_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 medium to large tomato, or 1 cup cherry/grape tomatoes
1 cup cheese- and garlic-flavored croutons, broken into small pieces
1 cup crumbled extra-sharp Cheddar cheese (preferably aged at least 1 year)

steps: Tear the lettuce into small pieces, and place lettuce in a medium-sized bowl.
Slice the tomato into small pieces and let them fall into the bowl. If using cherry or grape tomatoes, sprinkle them over the lettuce.
Sprinkle the crumbled cheese and croutons (and raisins, if desired) over the salad.
Drizzle the salad dressing over the salad.
Enjoy!

name: Classic Vanilla Milkshake
attribution: "Classic Vanilla Milkshake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Classic_Vanilla_Milkshake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Pour the milk, ice cream, and half & half in a blender and partially blend.
Add the sugar and flavoring, and blend until thoroughly mixed.

name: Cochinita Pibil (Mexican Braised Pork)
attribution: "Cochinita Pibil (Mexican Braised Pork)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cochinita_Pibil_(Mexican_Braised_Pork), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Banana leaves and/or heavy-duty aluminium foil
White or Spanish rice, taco shells, or tortillas for serving

steps: Place the annatto, cumin, peppercorns, allspice, and cloves in a spice grinder and process to a fine powder. You can use an electric coffee grinder for the spices, but it will not be suitable for coffee afterwards.
Remove the seeds and veins from the habanero chiles and chop coarsely. If you want a hotter dish, leave some of the veins and seeds in.
Process the orange juice, vinegar, chiles, salt, garlic, and the spice powder in a blender or food processor until liquefied. Add the lemon juice and tequila.
Cut the pork into 2-inch (5 cm) chunks. Leave the fat on the meat, to keep the pork moist while roasting; you can remove it after cooking if you wish.
Place pork in a large, self-sealing plastic bag with the marinade. Seal bag and turn to evenly coat the meat. Refrigerate for 8 to 24 hours, turning occasionally.

Heat oven to 325°F (160°C). Dump the meat and the marinade in a roasting pan lined with banana leaves or foil, making sure to wrap tightly so no steam escapes. If using banana leaves, an outer wrapping with foil will help seal in the steam.
Bake for 4 hours. Open packet carefully; the meat should shred easily with a fork.
Serve over rice, or shred and serve with taco shells or tortillas.

name: Cocoa Mix
attribution: "Cocoa Mix" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cocoa_Mix, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Mix thoroughly.
Store in an airtight container.

name: Cocoa-Coconut Bites
attribution: "Cocoa-Coconut Bites" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cocoa-Coconut_Bites, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup (25 g) unsweetened cocoa powder
⅛ cup + 1 tsp (30 ml + 1 tsp) maple syrup

steps: Melt the coconut oil in a small saucepan over low heat. Once melted, transfer to a bowl and whisk in unsweetened cacao powder, maple syrup, and salt until smooth and lump-free.
Pour the chocolate mix into small chocolate molds. You can also use a regular baking tray.
Place them in the freezer/fridge to harden for a few hours. If using a regular baking tray, cut the chocolate into pieces with a sharp knife.

name: Coconut Barfi
attribution: "Coconut Barfi" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coconut_Barfi, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine sugar and water in a pot, and cook to a 2–3 thread (about 235–255°F) sugar syrup.
Warm the coconut in a heavy saucepan, and pour in the hot syrup. Stir well, and cook until a soft lump forms.
Press and spread the mixture into a ghee-greased pan or mold, and let cool.
Sprinkle with cardamom.
Cut into squares, and store in an airtight container.

name: Coconut Biscuits
attribution: "Coconut Biscuits" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coconut_Biscuits, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat the oven to 150 C.
Whip the egg whites in a mixing bowl until soft peaks form.
Add sugar gradually, whipping until stiff peaks form.
Fold in the coconut until combined.
Form the dough into pyramids. Cover each pyramid with baking parchment and place them on a baking tray.
Bake for 15 minutes until they are colored light brown.
Uncover the biscuits and leave them to cool.

name: Coconut Chutney (North Indian)
attribution: "Coconut Chutney (North Indian)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coconut_Chutney_(North_Indian), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Grind all ingredients well in a blender.
Serve within 2 days.

name: Coconut Cream and Pound Cake with Moscatel (Bienmesabe)
attribution: "Coconut Cream and Pound Cake with Moscatel (Bienmesabe)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coconut_Cream_and_Pound_Cake_with_Moscatel_(Bienmesabe), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup (120 g) of white granulated sugar
3–4 pound cakes (biscochuelo) cut in ½-inch slices

steps: Grate the coconut meat. Separate the flesh from the milk of the coconut.
Combine the coconut flesh with the sugar, reserving the milk. Cook until a thick syrup is made. Remove from heat and to allow to rest.
Beat the yolks with a little bit of the coconut milk, then whisk this into the syrup. Mix well and return to the heat.
Stir constantly until it thickens. The idea is to obtain a rather thick coconut custard.
Remove custard from the heat and let cool.
Soak the cake pieces in wine.
In a glass dish, layer the coconut custard and the cake slices. Continue alternating biscochuelo layers with the coconut custard.
Sprinkle the top generously with cinnamon.

name: Coconut Cream Filled Cake with Meringue (Bienmesabe)
attribution: "Coconut Cream Filled Cake with Meringue (Bienmesabe)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coconut_Cream_Filled_Cake_with_Meringue_(Bienmesabe), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Butter a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
In the bowl of an electric mixer, beat the eggs and sugar until pale and fluffy.
Add the flour, baking powder, and vanilla extract; mix until just combined.
Transfer the batter to the prepared pan. Bake 30–35 minutes at 350°F or until a toothpick inserted in the center tests clean.
Cool cake completely on a wire rack. Meanwhile, make coconut cream filling.
In a large bowl, whisk together sugar, coconut milk, yolks, shredded coconut, and cornstarch.
In a large saucepan, combine milk and remaining 1 cup sugar; heat over medium until sugar dissolves and milk is steaming.
Gradually whisk the hot milk into egg mixture; return the custard mixture to the saucepan.
Cook, stirring, until custard thickens, 3 to 4 minutes.
Pour the custard into a heat-proof bowl. Cover the surface directly with plastic wrap. Set aside to cool completely, about 1 hour (or up to overnight in the refrigerator).
While coconut cream and cake cool, make cake syrup.
Combine water and sugar in a medium saucepan; bring to a boil.
Transfer to a bowl with coconut milk and rum; stir to combine.
Combine sugar and water in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil, stirring to dissolve the sugar, for 4 minutes.
In the bowl of an electric mixer, beat the egg whites and remaining 1 tablespoon sugar.
With the motor running, gradually beat in the syrup mixture in a slow, steady stream.
Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Use a serrated knife to cut cake horizontally into 2 layers.
Brush the bottom layer with syrup and spread with coconut cream.
Add the second cake layer and repeat with syrup and coconut cream.
Spread the meringue over the cake.
Transfer the cake to the oven for 2 to 3 minutes or until the meringue is toasted.

name: Coconut Crusted Baked Cod
attribution: "Coconut Crusted Baked Cod" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coconut_Crusted_Baked_Cod, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: In a bowl, combine coconut milk, soy sauce, sesame oil, pepper flakes, ginger, and pepper.
Marinate cod in this mixture for 15 minutes.
Place fillets on an oiled baking pan.
Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes or until flaky.
Garnish with coconut flakes and fresh mint.

name: Coconut Pudding II
attribution: "Coconut Pudding II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coconut_Pudding_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine eggs, coconut milk, sugar and Jasmine water in a dish. Beat until foamy.
Pour the mixture into a heatproof dish, and place on top of a bamboo steamer basket.
Cover the basket and place above a large wok of boiling water.
Steam the pudding for 30–40 minutes, or until no longer fluid. If the pudding is cooked too fast, it becomes rubbery.
Take the pudding out of the steamer and allow to cool.

name: Coconut Rice (Indian)
attribution: "Coconut Rice (Indian)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coconut_Rice_(Indian), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup fresh/frozen grated coconut or dry coconut flakes
5–7 cups of cooked, cooled white long-grain rice (light and fluffy)

steps: Heat the oil with the mustard seeds in a covered sauté pan.
When the mustard seeds have finished popping, add everything but the rice, and lightly toast in the oil until golden.
Add the seasonings to the cooked rice, mix well, and serve.

name: Coconut Rice (Indonesian)
attribution: "Coconut Rice (Indonesian)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coconut_Rice_(Indonesian), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Rinse and drain the rice.
Put all ingredients in a skillet or saucepan; make sure the rice is submerged in the coconut milk by 2 cm.
Cover the pan and allow to cook over medium-low heat until the liquid is absorbed.
Remove the pandan leaves.
Pour the rest of the coconut milk over the rice.
Allow to rest for 15 minutes at room temperature, then serve.

name: Coconut Rice (Nasi Lemak)
attribution: "Coconut Rice (Nasi Lemak)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coconut_Rice_(Nasi_Lemak), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1–2 pandan leaves tied in a knot (optional)

steps: Rinse the rice and set it aside.
Meanwhile put the coconut milk on the stove, and add the salt.
Add the rice, pandan leaves, and ginger. Let it simmer until the coconut milk evaporates.
Cover it with lid and let it sit for about 15 minutes until it is well cooked.

name: Coconut Rum-Battered Shrimp
attribution: "Coconut Rum-Battered Shrimp" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coconut_Rum-Battered_Shrimp, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
