ingredients.display: 24 large (15/20) shrimp, peeled, deveined, and butterflied
Sweetened shredded coconut, or shredded fresh coconut

steps: Combine rum and seasonings. Pour over shrimp and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, 8 hours for most (the alcohol will cook it after that).
Dredge shrimp in coconut. Let rest at room temperature 2–3 minutes.
Heat oil to 350°F. Fry shrimp 6 at a time 3 minutes.
Drain on a cooling rack above a sheet pan.
Squeeze some lemon juice over and serve warm.

name: Cocoyam Fufu
attribution: "Cocoyam Fufu" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cocoyam_Fufu, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut the cocoyam into medium-sized chunks, and cook in a pot of water until tender. Drain the cocoyam.
Combine the cassava flour with ½ cup water to make a mouldable ball.
Add the cassava mixture to the cooked cocoyam in a mortar. Pound together until smooth.

name: Coddle
attribution: "Coddle" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coddle, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 250 g bacon, chopped into 3 cm pieces

steps: Completely submerge bacon, onions, and sausages in broth, then boil for about 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes, cutting into bite-sized pieces if necessary, then add the rest of the stock.
Return to the boil and simmer for about 1 hour, or until the potatoes have started to disintegrate, thickening the broth.
Add salt and pepper to serve.

name: Coffee Concentrate
attribution: "Coffee Concentrate" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coffee_Concentrate, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pound ground coffee OR coffee and chicory blend

steps: Add coffee grounds to a jar.
Pour mineral water over grounds, stirring only to ensure all coffee is wet.
Let mixture stand for 10–12 hours (best to let it sit over night).
Line sieve with cheesecloth and place over another jar. Pour coffee mixture into sieve, allowing grounds to collect.
Discard coffee grounds and store coffee concentrate in the refrigerator. It will keep for 2–3 weeks.
To prepare coffee from concentrate, use a ratio of concentrate:water of 1:2 or 1:3 depending on taste.

name: Coffee Mousse
attribution: "Coffee Mousse" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coffee_Mousse, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Sprinkle the powdered gelatin over the cream. Let sit for a few minutes to bloom the gelatin.
Combine egg yolk, castor sugar, and milk. Cook on a low flame for about 10 minutes.
Add the cream/gelatin mixture and instant coffee powder. Mix well until thoroughly combined and there are no lumps of gelatin. Cool slightly.
Whip the egg whites in a bowl till they are fluffy. Fold the whipped whites into the egg yolk custard mix.
Transfer mousse mixture to serving dish(es). Refrigerate for an hour.
Combine the heavy cream, vanilla, and sugar. Whip to medium peaks.
Serve the mousse with the whipped cream, and garnish with grated chocolate.

name: Cola BBQ Chicken
attribution: "Cola BBQ Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cola_BBQ_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 each boneless skinless chicken breasts and chicken drumsticks

steps: Season chicken with Rub.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Preheat grill for medium heat.
Place chicken on grill and turn often, basting with sauce every time the chicken is turned until internal temperature reaches 165°F inside the breast and 170°F in the drumstick.
Rest 15 minutes; serve.

name: Cola BBQ Sauce
attribution: "Cola BBQ Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cola_BBQ_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 ½ cans good cola (Pepsi is recommended)

steps: Combine all ingredients and bring to a boil.
Cook over high heat for 10 minutes.
Store refrigerated in a nonreactive container for up to 1 week.

name: Cola de Mono
attribution: "Cola de Mono" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cola_de_Mono, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix the nutmeg, the cloves and the cinnamon in a small pot with the water. Boil the mixture for 10 minutes.
If desired, take remove the spices from the water, although it is better to leave them there.
Transfer the water into a pot with a capacity of 3 liters.
Add the coffee along with some more water and sugar.
As soon as the sugar gets dissolved, add the rest of the milk and the Chilean brandy.
Bottle the Cola de Mono and put it in the refrigerator.

name: Cola I
attribution: "Cola I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cola_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 5 tsp (25 ml) strained fresh lime juice
½ tsp (2.5 ml) finely powdered citric acid

steps: Chop the lemon and orange peels into small pieces.

Combine the peels, lime leaves, caffeine, cinnamon, nutmeg, coriander, and 5 tbsp (75 ml) water in a mortar. Use the pestle to crush and grind everything together, ensuring that everything is well-blended to extract the flavors.
Transfer the ground mixture to a saucepan. Simmer for 10 minutes, then remove from the heat.
Strain the mixture, then combine it with the 1 cup water, lime juice, and citric acid. Set aside.
Transfer the ¼ cup (60 ml) sugar into a heavy saucepan. Carefully melt it over medium heat, making sure the entire mixture heats evenly and doesn't burn. Cook the sugar until caramelized.
Carefully stir the citrus mixture into the caramelized sugar, watching out for splatters, until it is homogenized.
Stir in the 1 cup (240 ml) sugar, and boil until it becomes a viscous and honey-like syrup of approximately 1¼ cup (300 ml) in volume. Remove from the heat and let cool.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

name: Cola II
attribution: "Cola II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cola_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 oz (60 ml) 150+ proof unflavored spirit OR a mixture of 10 tsp (50 ml) water with 2 tsp (10 ml) gum arabic
⅔ cup (160 ml) water, heated to 122°F (50°C)
4 drops tea extract or a mixture of 2 parts water to 1 part matcha

steps: Combine the spirit or gum arabic water and oils together in a small cup, mixing well. Set aside.

Combine the hot water, caffeine, caramel coloring, green tea extract, vanilla extract, lime juice, citric acid, sugar, and ¼ tsp (1.25 ml) of the oil mixture in a heat-safe container. Stir well to dissolve and make a syrup.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

name: Cola III
attribution: "Cola III" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cola_III, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¾ tsp (3.75 ml) 150+ proof unflavored food-grade spirit OR a mixture of ½ tsp (2.5 ml) water with ¼ tsp (1.25 ml) food-grade gum arabic
1 drop petit grain (lemon leaf and twig oil)
¾ tsp (3.75 ml) strained lime juice

steps: Combine the spirits and oils together in a small cup, mixing well. Set aside.
Combine the phosphoric acid, caramel color, lime juice, water, and sugar in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then boil until it becomes a thick syrup.
Remove the syrup from the heat, and stir in the caffeine and oil mixture. Let cool.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

name: Cola IV
attribution: "Cola IV" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cola_IV, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 12 drops tea tree oil (optional, read important warning below)
50 ml 150+ proof unflavored spirit or a mixture of 25 ml water with 25 ml gum arabic

steps: Mix the oils in flavor solution A in a container.
Transfer 1 ml of flavor solution A into another container and dilute it with the spirit or gum arabic water.
Mix flavor solution B in a third container.
Combine ½ teaspoon (2.5 ml) of the finished flavor solution A, all of flavor solution B, the white sugar, and the water to make the syrup.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of syrup with 3 volumes of carbonated water.

name: Cola V
attribution: "Cola V" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cola_V, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ in. wide strip of lemon peel cut around the fruit's circumference
½ in. wide strip of lemon peel cut around the fruit's circumference
½ in. wide strip of orange peel cut around the fruit's circumference

steps: Boil all of the ingredients except for the vanilla extract and bitters in a pot until it becomes sticky.
Strain out the solids.
Add the vanilla extract and bitters.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

name: Colcannon (Scottish)
attribution: "Colcannon (Scottish)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Colcannon_(Scottish), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Equal amounts of cooked potato and cabbage

steps: Melt a piece of butter in a saucepan, allowing approximately 1 ounce per 1 pound vegetables.
Mix all the ingredients together, heat thoroughly, and serve.

name: Cold Potatoes Fried
attribution: "Cold Potatoes Fried" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cold_Potatoes_Fried, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat some drippings in a frying pan.
Add the sliced potatoes, and season with a little salt and pepper.
Cook the potatoes until quite hot.
Serve.

name: Coleslaw I
attribution: "Coleslaw I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coleslaw_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 tablespoons mayonnaise or 2 dL olive oil

steps: If adding cider vinegar, add it to the mayonnaise and mix together well.
Slice or shred the cabbage, as coarsely or finely as desired.
In a large bowl, mix cabbage and onion together with mayonnaise.
Set aside to allow the flavours to merge at least 20 minutes but preferably for a couple of hours.

name: Coleslaw II
attribution: "Coleslaw II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coleslaw_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Toss cabbage with a few big handfuls of kosher salt. Place in a colander in a bowl and let sit at room temperature 2 hours.
Drain cabbage. Rinse with clean water and let them go for a spin in your salad spinner until relatively dry.
Combine vinegar and spices. Microwave on high until mixture comes to a boil.
Fold in mayonnaise and cabbage. Chill until cold.

name: Common Sauce (Hartshorne)
attribution: "Common Sauce (Hartshorne)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Common_Sauce_(Hartshorne), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine veal, ham, onions, parsnips, garlic, and cloves in a large saucepan.
Add broth, wine, and lemon slices.
Simmer over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes, or until reduced.
Sieve the sauce and serve.

name: Confederate Cush
attribution: "Confederate Cush" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Confederate_Cush, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Put bacon into a hot iron skillet, and fry the grease out of it.
Add the beef, then slowly add 4 cups of water. Bring to a boil.
Add cornmeal mush and stir until dry.
Remove skillet from fire, and let cool.
Serve warm, like hash.

name: Cookies and Milk
attribution: "Cookies and Milk" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cookies_and_Milk, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Cookies (preferably chocolate chip, but others can be used)
A glass (diameter must be equal to or larger than that of the cookie)

steps: Drop the cookies into the glass, filling it up to roughly ¾ of the glass. You can fill it more if you desire, but usually about 4–6 cookies is good.
Fill the cookie-filled glass with milk until the milk covers the top cookie.
Wait a couple of minutes for the cookies to absorb the milk and become soft. You can decide how soft you want them
Drink milk and cookies from glass.

name: Coq au Vin I
attribution: "Coq au Vin I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coq_au_Vin_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1.5 kg (about 3.5 lbs) chicken, jointed (or drumsticks, thighs, breasts); get the giblets, and the blood if you can; season beforehand; marrow is important.

steps: Mix flour, salt and pepper. Coat chicken, onion and carrot in flour mixture and set aside.
Sauté mushrooms, set aside.
Brown the chicken pieces a few at a time, set aside.
Brown onions and carrots. Put chicken into large casserole on medium-high heat along with onions, carrots and mushrooms.
Combine wine, garlic, and basil; pour over chicken.
Cover the casserole, cook until chicken is ready (1–1.5 hours), stirring occasionally.

name: Coquitos (Coconut Macaroons)
attribution: "Coquitos (Coconut Macaroons)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coquitos_(Coconut_Macaroons), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat your oven to 180°C.
Mix all ingredients together in a bowl.

If your paste is too thick to pipe with a large piping tip, then add the water, and keep adding one tablespoon of water at a time until you get a consistency you can pipe. If your eggs are extra large, you may not need the extra water.
Pipe dollops on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake in a medium to hot oven for 30 minutes or until done.

name: Coriander Chutney
attribution: "Coriander Chutney" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coriander_Chutney, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tsp cumin seeds or ground cumin (optional)
juice of ½ lemon or lime

steps: Wash the coriander.
Finely chop the onion, chillies, and coriander.
Add the salt, juice, and cumin.
Blend to a fine paste.

name: Corn and Kelp Chowder
attribution: "Corn and Kelp Chowder" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Corn_and_Kelp_Chowder, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 quart corn kernels (removed from the cob)
½ cup dried sea kelp (or laver)
1 green or red bell pepper, chopped

steps: Melt butter in a pan, add the kelp, and sauté until it begins to dissolve in the butter.
Add the remaining ingredients, turn down to low heat, and cover.
Simmer for 30–40 minutes until soft.
Remove cover and cook on low heat until water most of the liquid is evaporated.

name: Corn and Shrimp Chowder
attribution: "Corn and Shrimp Chowder" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Corn_and_Shrimp_Chowder, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup light cream or milk

steps: In a large saucepan, heat olive oil over low heat.
Add onion, carrot and garlic.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is transparent, about 5 minutes.
Add broth and dill seeds.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Add corn to broth and simmer, covered, until the corn is just tender, about 5 minutes.
In a blender or food processor, puree the newly made chowder and pour it back into the saucepan.
Add shelled shrimp, simmer and cook until shrimp are almost done, about 1 minute.
Stir in milk and parsley, salt and pepper.
Bring mixture back to simmer.
Serve immediately.

name: Corn Bread Fish
attribution: "Corn Bread Fish" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Corn_Bread_Fish, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 boneless, skinless fish fillets (about 6 ounces each, 1–1¼ inches at thickest), such as tilapia, catfish or trout (see notes)
1 large corn muffin, or ⅔ cup coarse crumbs

steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F (204°C).
Spray a glass baking dish with cooking-oil spray.
Season each fish piece with salt and pepper, and place in the dish.
Pour the dressing evenly over the fish.
Crumble the corn muffin, and sprinkle the crumbs over the fish.

Place the dish in the preheated oven, and bake until the dressing is bubbling at the edges, the crumbs lightly brown, and the thickest part of the fillets are opaque and flake easily with a fork (about 15 to 20 minutes).
While fish is baking, cut the lemon into 4 parts and set aside.
When the fish is done, remove it from the oven, squeeze the juice from the lemon quarters over the fish, and serve immediately.

name: Corn Chowder I
attribution: "Corn Chowder I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Corn_Chowder_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1½ cups diced, pared potatoes, cut in ½-inch cubes

steps: In a medium saucepan, melt butter; add onion and celery and cook until tender.
Add potatoes, corn, salt, pepper, water, bouillon cubes, and thyme.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, or until potatoes and corn are tender.
Add milk and cream.
Heat through.

name: Corn Dogs
attribution: "Corn Dogs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Corn_Dogs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat deep fat fryer to ().
Combine corn meal, flour, and salt. Add milk, egg, and oil; mix well.
Insert a wooden skewer into one end of each hot dog.
Coat with flour, then coat with corn meal mixture.
Fry a few at a time in deep hot oil until golden brown.

name: Corn Muffins
attribution: "Corn Muffins" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Corn_Muffins, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup plus 1 Tbsp (150 g) bleached all-purpose flour
4 Tbsp plus 4 tsp (66 g) white granulated sugar

steps: Mix the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt together. Whisk together the egg and yogurt, and stir them quickly into the dry goods, leaving some lumps.
Add the melted butter and fold in.
Pour into ramekins or muffin tins.
Bake for 15–18 minutes at 400°F, or until the tops are golden.

name: Corn on the Cob with Husks
attribution: "Corn on the Cob with Husks" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Corn_on_the_Cob_with_Husks, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Corn on the cob, with husks left on

steps: Carefully peel back husk without detaching it and remove silk.
Replace husks and soak ears in cold water for ½ hour.
Place corn on grill or on a rack above an open fire.
Cook for about 15 minutes, turning occasionally to ensure even cooking.
Serve with butter and salt.

name: Corn Soup
attribution: "Corn Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Corn_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine the corn and water in a large pot. Bring to a boil.
Make a roux with the butter and flour.
Add the roux to the soup when the corn is tender.
Boil for an additional 10–15 minutes.
Beat the egg and add it to the soup. Immediately take the soup off the heat.
Add salt and pepper to taste.

name: Cornbread I
attribution: "Cornbread I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cornbread_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup (60 g / 2.1 oz) shortening, melted
¼ cup (55 g / 1.9 oz) white granulated sugar (optional)
½ of a 15 oz can whole corn kernels, drained (optional)

steps: Preheat oven to 425 F. Grease an 8 in baking pan.
Combine cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a large mixing bowl.
Add egg, milk, and shortening.
Beat until fairly smooth (about a minute).
If using corn and/or onion, fold in these ingredients.
Pour the mixture into the baking pan.
Bake for 20–25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. If corn is added to batter, increase time by ~50%
Serve hot!

name: Cornbread II
attribution: "Cornbread II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cornbread_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1¼ cup (310 ml / 10 oz) mixture of milk and orange juice (you can use as much orange juice as you like; ¼–½ cup (60–125 ml / 2–4.2 oz) is ideal)
⅓ cup (75 g / 2.6 oz) white granulated sugar
¼ cup (60 ml / 2 oz) vegetable oil

steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Grease a 20 cm baking pan.
Combine cornmeal and milk/orange juice, and let stand 10 minutes.
Combine dry ingredients.
Add egg and oil to cornmeal mixture, then add dry ingredients. Stir until combined.
Pour the mixture into the baking pan.
Bake for 15–20 minutes.

name: Corned Beef Pie
attribution: "Corned Beef Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Corned_Beef_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F, GM 6).
Sift the flour into a bowl. Rub in the lard and margarine.
Add enough water to bind the mixture into a dough.
Roll out half the dough and use it to line a large flan or quiche dish.
Boil the potatoes. Drain, add the butter, and mash.
Add the chopped onion and corned beef.
Spoon potato mixture into the lined dish.
Roll out the other half of the pastry mixture.
Lay it over the dish sealing at the edges, forming a lid to the pie.
Cut some slits in the top of the lid. Brush with a little milk.
Cook until golden brown (about 35–40 minutes).
Serve with vegetables, gravy, chips, peeled plum tomatoes, waffles, anything you like really.

name: Corny Soufflé
attribution: "Corny Soufflé" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Corny_Souffl%C3%A9, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F.
Put frozen corn, milk, eggs, sugar, and salt into a blender.
Blend on medium until ingredients are mixed thoroughly.
Pour into a medium-sized baking dish coated with cooking spray.
Dot the top with butter pieces.
Bake for 70 minutes.

name: Coronation Chicken
attribution: "Coronation Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Coronation_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 ea. (2.3 kg / 5 lb) chicken, poached (or other cooked chicken)

steps: Skin the chicken if needed, and cut it into small pieces. Traditionally the chicken is cooked whole in advance, but alternatively you can use raw chicken and grill the chicken pieces at this point.
In a small saucepan, warm a small amount of vegetable oil.
Add the onion to the pan and cook gently until soft (about 3 minutes).
Add the curry paste, tomato puree, wine, bay leaf and lemon juice. Simmer uncovered for about 10 minutes until well-reduced. Strain and leave to cool.
Purée the chopped apricots in a blender or processor. Beat the cooled sauce into the mayonnaise with the apricot purée.
Whip the cream to stiff peaks, and fold into the mixture.
Season with salt and pepper, and a little lemon juice if necessary.
Fold in the chicken pieces, garnish with watercress, and serve.

name: Cottage Cheese Eggs
attribution: "Cottage Cheese Eggs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cottage_Cheese_Eggs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 teaspoon Mexican seasoning or chili powder

steps: Preheat a large metal or non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Whisk eggs and cottage cheese together in a small bowl; place in skillet.
Sprinkle Mexican seasoning on eggs (to taste).
As eggs begin to cook, start folding them together, turning as needed, until done cooking.
Serve with or on wheat toast.

name: Cottage Cheese Pancakes
attribution: "Cottage Cheese Pancakes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cottage_Cheese_Pancakes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Place all ingredients in a blender, and blend for 1 minute.
Pour about ¼ cup (60 g) batter for each pancake on a griddle sprayed with cooking spray or lightly coated with vegetable oil.
Let cook until golden on both sides.

name: Crab and Corn Salad
attribution: "Crab and Corn Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Crab_and_Corn_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 16 oz canned whole kernel sweet corn

steps: Chop imitation crab meat and green onions.
Combine the above, corn and mayonnaise in an appropriately-sized bowl.
Mix well.
Add shredded cheese to taste and mix again.

name: Crab Cakes
attribution: "Crab Cakes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Crab_Cakes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 lb (450 g) crabmeat or imitation crabmeat

steps: Combine crabmeat, Italian style breadcrumbs, mayonnaise, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, egg, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl for the cakes.
In a separate bowl, combine remaining ingredients, except the oil, to make the sauce.
Shape crab cake mix into 3-inch (7.5 cm) patties (about 2 per serving) or smaller for appetizer-size.
Add oil to a skillet.
Pan fry the cakes for 3–4 minutes on each side or until golden brown.
Remove from skillet and drain on paper towels.
Serve cakes topped with the sauce.

name: Crab Dip
attribution: "Crab Dip" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Crab_Dip, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Drain, rinse, and pick over crab meat to remove any bits of shell and cartilage.
Combine all ingredients, blending well.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: Crab Fried Rice
attribution: "Crab Fried Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Crab_Fried_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 150 g bean sprouts, soaked in hot water
2 big red chilli, cut into small pieces

steps: Stir fry the crab in the 5 tbsp oil for 1 minute. Remove from the heat, and reserve.
Heat the remaining oil, and use to stir fry the garlic, red onion, scallion, and red chillies for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the fried crab and bean sprouts. Stir until the crab changes color.
Add the rice, fish sauce, salt, and black pepper. Stir until well-mixed.
Serve hot.

name: Crab Meat Ravioli Filling
attribution: "Crab Meat Ravioli Filling" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Crab_Meat_Ravioli_Filling, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 9 oz crab meat, fresh or canned (see notes)
¼ tsp salt (if using fresh crabmeat)

steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in the butter over low heat until soft, about 15 minutes.
Combine crab meat, mustard, cream, egg, lemon juice, parsley, bread crumbs and seasonings in a bowl.
Add the onion and celery and mix until well blended but not homogeneous.
Cover and refrigerate until the pasta dough is ready.

name: Cranberry Orange Squares
attribution: "Cranberry Orange Squares" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cranberry_Orange_Squares, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Lightly oil a a square baking pan, and line it with parchment paper.
In a mixing bowl, combine the rolled oats, flour, sugar, and baking soda using a whisk.
Using your hands, mix the melted butter into the rolled oats mixture, until it forms pea-sized clumps. Do not over mix.
Reserve 1 ½ cups (360 g) of mixture to be used as the topping.
Press remainder of oat mix into the bottom of the pan, making sure it covers the whole bottom.
Mix the orange juice with the cranberry sauce.
Spread evenly over the base.
Sprinkle the reserved oats mixture over the top.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 40 minutes, or until golden brown.
Cool and cut into squares.

name: Crawfish Boil
attribution: "Crawfish Boil" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Crawfish_Boil, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Bring water to a boil in a stockpot or your tallest pot. Stir in seasonings.
Add crawfish, making sure to leave any dead ones behind. Cook for 7 minutes.
Turn off the heat and leave on the burner for 8 minutes. This allows the crawfish to soak in and absorb the flavorful broth without overcooking.
Drain through a colander and serve.

name: Cream Cheese American Buttercream
attribution: "Cream Cheese American Buttercream" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cream_Cheese_American_Buttercream, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup (225 g) block-style cream cheese, cold

steps: Put the cream cheese in a bowl and mix just enough to smooth out lumps. Do not overmix. Set aside.
Cream the butter in another bowl until smooth and creamy.
Beat in powdered sugar in 3–4 batches. It may look crumbly at first, but don't worry—it will come together into a ball, like a dough.
Beat in salt and vanilla.
Add all of cream cheese and mix in until smooth. Do not overmix, as it can make the frosting runny.

name: Cream Cheese-Stuffed Bell Peppers
attribution: "Cream Cheese-Stuffed Bell Peppers" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cream_Cheese-Stuffed_Bell_Peppers, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 bell peppers (assorted colors), stemmed and seeded
2 strips bacon, crisp cooked and crumbled
¼ cup unsalted butter, cut into small cubes

steps: Combine cheese, bacon, butter, salt, pepper, and hot sauce. Place into a piping bag without a tip and pipe into each pepper.
Place on an ungreased half-sheet pan.
Bake in a 375°F oven about 35 minutes, or until browned and bubbly on top.
Serve immediately.

name: Cream of Duck and Mushroom Soup
attribution: "Cream of Duck and Mushroom Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cream_of_Duck_and_Mushroom_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 duck egg yolks (chicken egg yolks will work too)
2 cups (480 ml) milk or half and half
½ cup (120 ml) chopped duck meat

steps: Heat duck stock in a heavy, covered saucepan over medium heat.
Add thyme, chopped duck meat, and mushrooms, and cook until mushrooms are tender.
In a mixing bowl, whisk egg yolks and milk until well-blended, then slowly add to soup.
Stir continually until soup mixture begins to thicken.
Sprinkle in nutmeg and serve.

name: Cream Soda
attribution: "Cream Soda" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cream_Soda, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine the vanilla extract, water, and sugar in a pot.
Boil the mixture until it reduces to about 5 oz (150 ml) syrup.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

name: Cream Wafers
attribution: "Cream Wafers" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cream_Wafers, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ⅓ cup / 75 g Whipping cream (30–40% butterfat)
~1 cup (250 mL) Buttercream icing, such as the Simple Buttercream recipe,
Plastic cling wrap, parchment paper, or wax paper (optional but recommended)
Cookie cutter, round or fluted, about 1½ inches (3–4 cm) in diameter

steps: Cut the butter into smaller pieces.
Put the butter pieces and flour into a mixing bowl, and blend the ingredients together. You can do this by hand or with an electric mixer.
Pour in the the whipping cream, and mix gently until the dough holds together. Do not overmix, or the cookies will be tough.
Turn the dough out onto the counter or a flat board and form into a disk.

* If you cover your work area with plastic cling wrap, you do not need to put any flour on the surface. Cover the top of the dough with another layer of plastic wrap to keep your hands or rolling pin clean. You will also be able to re-roll and use the scrap dough with a lower risk of the second rolling being tough.

* If you are working on a counter or board, sprinkle a large spoonful of flour on the surface before taking the dough out of the mixing bowl, and then another spoonful on top. Use just enough flour to keep the dough from sticking too much.
Roll the dough out until it is ⅛ inch (3–4 mm) thick and almost as big as your baking sheet.
Place the whole sheet of dough on your baking pan, and put it in the freezer for at least 20 minutes until it is completely frozen.
* If you are using plastic cling wrap, leave the dough on the plastic cling wrap.

* If you have too much dough to fit on your baking sheet, divide the dough into parts and repeat the process until all of the dough has been rolled out and placed in the freezer. Sheets of dough can stack on top of each other in the same pan, as long as there is a layer of plastic cling wrap or other barrier between them, to keep the sheets of dough from sticking to each other.
* If you cover the sheets of dough tightly to prevent them from drying out or absorbing other smells and flavors from the freezer, they can stay in the freezer for at least a week.
Put the white sugar in a shallow bowl or on a small plate.
Remove one sheet of dough from the freezer. If you have rolled it on plastic cling wrap, loosen the frozen dough (both sides) from the plastic wrap.
Using the cookie cutter, cut out as many circles of dough as you can. Set aside scrap dough for re-rolling and re-freezing.
Dip both sides of each cookie into the bowl of sugar, and place them on an ungreased, unlined baking sheet.

* If the frozen dough starts melting, then it may become difficult to pick up the cookies without stretching them. If this happens, you can put the sheet of dough back into the freezer for a few minutes so it can firm up again.
* The cookies do not expand much in the oven, so they can be placed fairly close together on the baking sheet, but you don't want to let them touch each other.
Dock each cookie with a fork to make a pattern and to prevent uneven bubbles during the baking process.
Repeat the rolling, freezing, and cutting process for the scrap dough pieces.
Preheat oven to 375 °F (190 °C, gas mark 5—moderately hot).
Bake each sheet for 7–9 minutes, until the top is set and the bottom edges are just turning brown.

* Be careful when moving the tray of cookies, as they slide around very easily. If your baking pan doesn't have a solid rim on all sides, the raw cookies might try to slide off the pan and onto the floor or the bottom of the oven.
With a cookie spatula/lifter, carefully remove the fragile cookies from the pan and place them on a wire cooling rack. Cool completely before trying to move them or frost them.
Put a small spoonful of frosting on the back of one cookie.
Place another cookie on top of the frosting to make a sandwich, and set aside.
Serve cookies at room temperature.

name: Creamed Corn
attribution: "Creamed Corn" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Creamed_Corn, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (15.25 oz / 432 g) whole kernel sweet corn, drained (reserve the liquid)
½ red bell pepper (or other suitable red vegetable), diced
¼ cup (60 ml) cream, half-and-half, or whole milk

steps: Drain the can of corn, reserving the liquid.
Put half of the corn into a bowl and purée it with a wand blender, adding some liquid from the can if necessary to keep it from getting too dry.
Pour puréed corn into a saucepan and add remaining whole corn kernels.
Add the diced bell pepper, butter, and cream, then heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally. You can add more cream or milk if it's not creamy enough.
Salt and pepper to taste.

name: Creamed Spinach
attribution: "Creamed Spinach" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Creamed_Spinach, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 500 g fresh spinach (or whole frozen spinach leaves)
½ dl cream or 1 tbsp butter
400 g of chopped spinach, fresh or frozen

steps: Boil the fresh spinach leaves and the salt in the water for about 5 minutes. If you use frozen spinach, follow the instructions on the box.
Drain away the water, and let the spinach dry for a minute or so.
Put the spinach back into the pan and add the cream. Simmer for a few more minutes.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Boil the fresh spinach leaves as in variation I, or gently thaw the frozen chopped spinach in a little bit of water in a pan.
Mix the flour with the chopped spinach in the pan, and add the milk.
Bring the spinach to the boil, and simmer gently for 3–5 minutes.
Add salt and pepper to taste.

name: Creamy Aioli Salsa
attribution: "Creamy Aioli Salsa" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Creamy_Aioli_Salsa, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 or more jalapeño chiles or serrano chiles, chopped

steps: Squeeze the lime juice into a blender-safe bowl.
Add 2 teaspoons of olive oil and all other ingredients.
Use an immersion blender to blend everything to a purée.
Gradually blend in more olive oil, tasting, until the mixture reaches your desired creaminess.

name: Creamy Cornstarch Scrambled Eggs
attribution: "Creamy Cornstarch Scrambled Eggs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Creamy_Cornstarch_Scrambled_Eggs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: In a cup, whisk together the milk and cornstarch until it is free of lumps.
Add the cornstarch mixture to your eggs, and beat until smooth. Season with salt.
Heat a non-stick skillet over high heat until hot, then add the butter—it should sizzle right away.
Wait until the butter’s melted and bubbly, but before it browns. Add the beaten eggs. Wait without stirring anything, until the edges of the eggs start to bubble up (about 3 seconds).

Remove the skillet from the heat. Start stirring the eggs, making 1 full circle per second, for about 11–12 seconds. The eggs will have absorbed all the butter but remain partially undercooked. Do not wait until they look fully cooked!
Transfer them onto a plate.
Season with black pepper to taste and serve.

name: Creamy Mascarpone Dessert
attribution: "Creamy Mascarpone Dessert" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Creamy_Mascarpone_Dessert, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Crushed vanilla cookies and semi-sweet chocolate curls for topping

steps: Whisk yolks and sugar in a stainless steel bowl until light and creamy.
Place the bowl on top of a pot of 1 inch simmering water to create a double boiler.
Whisk yolks non-stop, until warmed, thickened, and falling off the whisk in ribbons. Set aside until needed.
Fold together egg yolks, mascarpone, cream, and vanilla.

name: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
attribution: "Creamy Mushroom Pasta" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Creamy_Mushroom_Pasta, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 serving uncooked pasta (⅔ cup / 75 g / 2.6 oz) (suggestion: whole wheat linguine)
8 oz (230 g) white button mushroom, stems removed
¼ cup (60 ml / 2 oz) heavy cream
¼ cup (60 ml / 2 oz) low-sodium chicken bone broth
¼ cup (30 g / 1.1 oz) grated parmesan cheese

steps: In a large pot, cook pasta in salted boiling water for 8–9 minutes or according to the package directions until al dente. Drain.
Meanwhile, in a large skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat. Stir in minced garlic and let it cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Place mushrooms in the skillet, cup side up. Cook for 3–5 minutes or until mushrooms start shrinking, moving the mushrooms around with a spatula occasionally.
Add white wine; continue cooking to let the wine and mushroom juice evaporate (about 3 minutes).

Pour heavy cream and chicken bone broth into the skillet, and add a generous pinch of salt. Switch to medium heat and cook until the cooking liquid is slightly thickened, flipping the mushrooms a couple times.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over the mushrooms and gently stir until the cheese is melted. Taste and add more salt if desired.
Toss the cooked pasta into the skillet. Combine well with the mushroom mixture, then transfer to a serving plate.
Sprinkle with freshly ground black pepper and garnish with chopped parsley. Add more grated Parmesan cheese if desired. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Mustard Vinaigrette
attribution: "Creamy Mustard Vinaigrette" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Creamy_Mustard_Vinaigrette, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar or cider vinegar

steps: Mix all ingredients except oil until well blended.
Slowly mix in oil until fully incorporated.
Add salt and pepper to taste.

name: Creamy Tomato and Bean Soup
attribution: "Creamy Tomato and Bean Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Creamy_Tomato_and_Bean_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tbsp olive oil or neutral cooking oil
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) white beans, with liquid
5–10 cloves garlic (according to preference), peeled and cut in half
2 leaves fresh sage, torn in half by hand
2 cans (30 oz / 850 g) crushed or diced tomatoes
10–20 leaves of fresh basil, chiffonaded or torn to strips by hand

steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat for about 30 seconds or until it begins to shimmer.
Add onions to the large pot of oil, and season with salt and pepper. Cook about 2 minutes until softened, stirring occasionally to prevent burning.
Add the beans with their liquid, garlic, oregano, and sage. Simmer for 3–5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, tomato paste, red pepper, and water. Simmer an additional 5–10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat, stir in the cream cheese. and break up any large piece with the stirring utensil.
Let the soup cool for 1–2 minutes, then use either a blender or stick blender to purée the soup.
Return the puréed soup to the stove at the lowest heat setting for an additional 10–15 minutes, stirring often to prevent burning.
Just before serving, stir in fresh basil leaves, reserving a handful to garnish each bowl.

name: Creme Brulee Cheesecake
attribution: "Creme Brulee Cheesecake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Creme_Brulee_Cheesecake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¾ cup (1½ sticks) unsalted butter, melted
6 tablespoon brown sugar, light or dark
6 bricks (3 lb / 1.35 kg) cream cheese, softened

steps: Preheat oven to 325°F (160C).
In a bowl, mix vanilla wafer crumbs, butter and brown sugar until well-blended.
Press the wafer mixture into the bottom and sides of a 10-inch (25 cm) springform pan.
Set aside.
In a large bowl, mix cream cheese, sour cream and 1½ cups sugar on medium speed with electric mixer until smooth.
Add eggs, heavy cream and orange peel. Beat until all the mixture is smooth.
Pour cream cheese mixture into the springform pan.
Place the springform pan into a larger pan.
Add boiling water to the larger pan to come halfway up the sides of the springform pan.
Bake for 50 minutes or until set.
Carefully remove the springform pan from the water and cool at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Refrigerate for 3 hours.
Remove cake from the springform pan.
Sprinkle sugar on top of cheesecake.
Broil under the oven broiler until the sugar melts and browns (be careful not to burn the sugar).

name: Creme de Papaya
attribution: "Creme de Papaya" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Creme_de_Papaya, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Peel papaya and remove seeds. Cube the papaya.
Put papaya pieces in blender with ice cream and blackcurrant liqueur. Blend well until smooth.
Pour into a small bowl and decorate with mint.
Peel papaya and remove seeds. Cube the papaya.
Put papaya pieces in blender with ice cream and blend until creamy consistency.
Pour some blackcurrant liqueur on the bottom of a large dessert glass.
Add the cream mixture. Add a swirl of blackcurrant liqueur on the top.
Cut papaya in half and remove seeds. Scoop papaya from peel with a spoon (this is easier and cleaner than peeling the fruit).
Place approximately equal portions of papaya and vanilla ice cream in a blender. Blend until creamy.
Place the mixture into a serving dish and pour about an ounce of Crème de Cassis on top.

name: Crispy Buffalo Shrimp
attribution: "Crispy Buffalo Shrimp" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Crispy_Buffalo_Shrimp, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 pounds medium shrimp with tails, peeled and deveined
3 cloves garlic, smashed and very finely minced

steps: Combine butter, hot sauce, soy, and garlic. Set aside.
Dip shrimp into lemon juice. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Dredge shrimp into cornmeal. Let rest 2–3 minutes.
Heat oil to 375°F. Fry shrimp in batches until golden brown, about 2 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack.
Toss shrimp in butter mixture. Serve warm with blue cheese dressing, if desired.

name: Crispy Chicken
attribution: "Crispy Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Crispy_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Remove the skin and fat from the chicken thighs with kitchen shears.
Place thighs in a container with Italian dressing. Seal and shake to coat.
If you have the time, allow the chicken to marinate for extra flavor.
While chicken marinates, put bread crumbs in a medium bowl.
Put marinated chicken thighs in the bowl one at a time, and coat them with crumbs, adding extra bread crumbs as needed.
Place breaded chicken on a cookie sheet or other baking pan.
Bake on the oven's center rack at 350°F for 45 to 55 minutes or until bread crumbs are browned.

name: Crispy Gingerbread Cookies
attribution: "Crispy Gingerbread Cookies" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Crispy_Gingerbread_Cookies, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ⅔ cup (~160 g) packed light brown sugar

steps: Pour sugar, molasses, spices, and salt into large saucepan.
Bring to boil and remove from heat.
Add the baking soda and butter and stir until butter melts.
Quickly stir in egg, and then add flour. Mix well.
Chill for several hours until firm enough to roll.
Preheat oven to 325 °F (170 °C).
Roll out until thin on lightly-floured surface.
Cut with cookie cutters and place on cookie sheet sprayed with non-stick cooking spray.
Bake for about 15 minutes at 325 °F (170 °C) and cool on racks.

name: Crock Pot Beef Stew
attribution: "Crock Pot Beef Stew" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Crock_Pot_Beef_Stew, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 pounds (900 g) stew beef, cut into 1-inch (2.5 cm) cubes
1 whole clove or ½ tsp ground cloves

steps: Trim all fat from meat.
Put all ingredients in crockpot; mix thoroughly.
Cover and cook on low 12 hours or on high 5 to 6 hours.
Remove bay leaves before serving.

name: Crock Pot Potato Soup
attribution: "Crock Pot Potato Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Crock_Pot_Potato_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: In a slow cooker, combine potatoes, onions, water, parsley, celery, salt, pepper, chicken broth and butter.
Cook until done -- on low heat, 9 to 11 hours, or on high heat, 3 to 4 hours.
When done, add milk and reheat.
Serve plain or use an immersion blender/put mixture in blender for a smoother soup.
Reheat if necessary.

name: Croque Monsieur
attribution: "Croque Monsieur" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Croque_Monsieur, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 slices of cheese, such as gruyère

steps: Melt the butter in a small saucepan.
Add the flour and stir over a medium heat until blended.
Gradually add the milk, whisking continuously into a smooth sauce.
Simmer gently for 2–3 minutes until the sauce has thickened.
Mix in the mustard, nutmeg, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Preheat a grill to high. Lightly toast the bread on both sides under the grill.
Arrange slices of ham and cheese on each slice of bread, then top with béchamel sauce.
Place back under the grill to brown the béchamel and melt the cheese until golden brown and delicious.
Serve hot.

name: Crotopo Soup
attribution: "Crotopo Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Crotopo_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Pound the veal in a mortar.
Add ham with some fat in it, the egg yolk, salt, pepper, and very little nutmeg, and pound some more.
Pass through a sieve.
Cut the rolls into slices and spread them with the meat mixture.
Place them in the oven and bake until colored.
Cut the rolls in halves or quarters, and place them in a tureen.
Just before serving, pour a very good clear broth over them.

name: Crown Roast of Lamb
attribution: "Crown Roast of Lamb" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Crown_Roast_of_Lamb, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 racks of lamb, trimmed and frenched

steps: Brush both racks of lamb with olive oil. Sprinkle with paprika, garlic powder, and kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper. Rub seasonings into the meat.
Place both racks in a bundt pan and tie the end bones together with butcher's twine.
Place on the middle rack of the oven and roast for 30–35 minutes, until the meat reaches an internal temperature of 145°F for medium rare.
Remove and let rest 10 minutes. Serve.

name: Crunchy Baked Chicken
attribution: "Crunchy Baked Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Crunchy_Baked_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a shallow bowl, melt butter and place chicken breast in bowl to coat.
In another shallow bowl, mix Italian bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese.
Transfer chicken from butter bowl to breadcrumb bowl. Roll chicken in breadcrumb mixture until coated.
Place in greased pan.
Bake for 35–40 minutes.

name: Crushed Tomato Sauce
attribution: "Crushed Tomato Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Crushed_Tomato_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ onion, or an equal amount of shallots
1 can (28 ounces) crushed tomatoes (Cento brand is best)
Several cranks of ground black pepper

steps: Heat olive oil in skillet or pot over medium-high heat. Add garlic, onions, salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning, if desired.
Turn the heat down to low and add tomatoes.
Cook over low heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste a spoonful of the sauce, and season with salt to taste; taste again and salt as needed.
After it is salted to your taste, stir in the basil and remove from the heat.
Serve however you like and enjoy!

name: Crème Anglaise
attribution: "Crème Anglaise" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cr%C3%A8me_Anglaise, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Flavoring (typically a vanilla bean or 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract)

steps: Bring the milk and flavoring to a simmer in a medium saucepan. If using a vanilla bean, cut it lengthwise and add to the milk. After a short time and before the milk simmers, scrape the seeds from the inside of the beans and dispose of the husks.
Meanwhile, whisk the egg yolks and sugar thoroughly. The mixture should be pale yellow.

When the milk simmers, remove from heat and slowly pour about half of it into the egg mixture, mixing continuously. Pour the egg/milk mixture back into the saucepan with the remaining milk, stirring continuously, and return the saucepan to the stove.
Cook for a short time over medium heat, stirring continuously. Be careful to scrape the sides and corners regularly, and do not let the mixture boil.
Test for readiness by dipping a spatula into it and running your finger over the coated spatula. The crème is done when it is thick enough that the trail wiped away by your finger remains.
Remove the saucepan from heat and strain it through a metal strainer into another bowl. Stir it continuously for another two minutes, cooling it.

To complete cooling quickly, place the bowl in a larger bowl of ice and stir the crème until cool. If you have more time, you can place the bowl in the freezer, stirring periodically until it's cool. If you don't use one of these methods, a skin will form on top of the creme.

name: Crème Chantilly
attribution: "Crème Chantilly" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cr%C3%A8me_Chantilly, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1–2 tsp vanilla extract, or cognac, rum, or liqueur

steps: In a chilled 3-quart bowl, whip the cream until it forms soft peaks.
Fold in the powdered sugar and flavouring.
Refrigerate until ready to use.

name: Crème Fraîche Chocolate Sauce
attribution: "Crème Fraîche Chocolate Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cr%C3%A8me_Fra%C3%AEche_Chocolate_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Melt all the ingredients together in a saucepan and allow to bubble for a while until the mixture darkens in colour slightly. Be careful not to let the chocolate burn.
Remove from the heat and allow to cool until it thickens.

name: Crème Saint-Honoré
attribution: "Crème Saint-Honoré" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cr%C3%A8me_Saint-Honor%C3%A9, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 Tbsp superfine sugar OR granulated sugar

steps: Mix any additional flavourings into the crème pâtissière.
Whip the egg whites with the salt until soft peaks form.
Sprinkle the sugar onto the egg whites and continue whipping to stiff peaks.
Stir a quarter of the egg whites into the hot custard.
Fold the rest of the egg whites in and chill before use.

name: Cuban Picadillo
attribution: "Cuban Picadillo" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cuban_Picadillo, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup chopped pimento-stuffed green olives
Salt and fresh ground black pepper to taste

steps: In large skillet, brown beef in 2 tablespoons olive oil over high heat; drain and reserve.
In same skillet, lightly brown onion, pepper, and garlic in remaining oil.
Add tomato sauce, cumin, and oregano; bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mixture has thickened.
Stir in beef, raisins, olives and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Bring back to boil, simmer 10 minutes, and serve over steamed rice with sautéed sliced ripe plantains and black beans.

name: Cucumber and Buttermilk Soup
attribution: "Cucumber and Buttermilk Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cucumber_and_Buttermilk_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Peel cucumbers.
Dice into ¼-inch dice.
Finely chop scallions.
Mix everything together.

name: Cucumber and Radish Salad
attribution: "Cucumber and Radish Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cucumber_and_Radish_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Chop cucumbers and radishes into small cubes (about ¼ inch on the side).
Chop green onions.
Combine all of the above in an appropriately sized bowl.
Add sour cream and mix well.
Add salt to taste and mix again.

name: Cucumber and Tomato Salad
attribution: "Cucumber and Tomato Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cucumber_and_Tomato_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ tsp salt or to taste

steps: Chop cucumbers and tomatoes into small cubes (approx. ¼ inch on the side).
Peel and chop the onion.
Combine all of the above in an appropriately sized bowl.
Add sunflower oil and mix well.
Add salt to taste and mix again.

name: Cucumber Bits in Yogurt
attribution: "Cucumber Bits in Yogurt" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cucumber_Bits_in_Yogurt, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Chop cucumber into small pieces.
Mix yogurt with chopped cucumber.
Add salt to taste.

name: Cucumber Sprout Sandwich
attribution: "Cucumber Sprout Sandwich" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cucumber_Sprout_Sandwich, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Spread 1 tablespoon cream cheese on each slice of bread.
Arrange cucumber slices in a single layer on one slice of bread.
Cover same slice of bread with alfalfa sprouts, sprinkle with oil and vinegar.
Layer same slice of bread with tomato slices, lettuce, and pepperoncini.
Spread mashed avocado on other slice of bread.
Add salt and pepper to taste
Assemble sandwich and serve immediately.

name: Cucumber, Tomato, and Onion Salad
attribution: "Cucumber, Tomato, and Onion Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cucumber,_Tomato,_and_Onion_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 small white onion, diced (perhaps a sliced green onion could be substituted)
1 (or more, if in season) tomato, diced or wedged (optional, adds color)
Additional seasoning as you may desire (e.g. salt)

steps: Peel the cucumbers, either completely or leaving some green, in a pattern you prefer.
Slice cucumbers about ¼ inch (½ cm) thick.
Add vinegar and water, adjusting the proportions to your taste. The end result is that the other ingredients will be floating in clear liquid.
Refrigerate, then serve cool to cold, while the ingredients are still crisp.

name: Cupcakes (Plain)
attribution: "Cupcakes (Plain)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cupcakes_(Plain), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat an oven to .
Place 15 cupcake cases on a baking tray, or in a muffin/cupcake pan if you have one.
Place flour, sugar, margarine and eggs into a mixing bowl. Use a electric mixer to mix the ingredients together for 1 minute.
Use a spoon and knife to evenly dollop the batter into the cases.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until the cakes are golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
When completed remove from oven and leave to cool.
Decorate with icing sugar if desired.

name: Curried Rice
attribution: "Curried Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Curried_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup (125 g/4.4 oz) uncooked brown rice or white rice

steps: Find a large saucepan or frying pan which has a lid, and place over medium heat.
Add butter then chopped onion to pan. Cook the onion for a couple of minutes until it starts to brown slightly.
Add curry powder, and stir for a minute.
Mix in vegetarian bouillon cubes, raisins, rice, and water.
Put on pan lid and simmer until water is absorbed (about 15 minutes).

name: Curry and Honey Chicken
attribution: "Curry and Honey Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Curry_and_Honey_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½–1 cup (120–240 ml) vegetable oil or olive oil
Salt (1 heaping teaspoon per kilogram of chicken works well)
1–3 celery greens (if you add more, they can dominate the mix)

steps: Combine the ingredients for the marinade. Add chicken and marinate for 6–24 hours; longer is better.
Peel almonds by boiling in a small amount of water for 1–2 minutes, cooling, and squeezing the nuts from the skins.
Chop onion/leek finely and fry lightly in a large frying pan with a bit of oil.
Add vegetables, roughly in the order you find logical (i.e., tomatoes don't take long, zucchini can be in the pan from the start of cooking).

Add salt. This will extract water from the vegetables and make them stew faster. You can cover the pan if it goes slowly—this slows the evaporation and allows the vegetables to cook in the water they lose.

Dump the cooked vegetables into a bowl or a small pot to keep them warm, and use the remaining oil to fry the cherry tomatoes, if you have those; once done, keep them separate from the other vegetables.
Fry almonds gently in the pan.

Add chicken meat, and fry on high temperature quickly; when it looks done, cut the largest piece open to see if it is done inside as well. The pieces should be lightly browned. Don't worry, this is the sugar in the honey turning to caramel.
Serve meat and vegetables with rice.

name: Curry Chicken I
attribution: "Curry Chicken I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Curry_Chicken_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tsp olive oil or sunflower oil

steps: Cut the chicken into 5–7 cm pieces and slice them at edges with a knife.
Combine garlic, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp red chili powder, 1 tsp garam masala, red pepper powder, yoghurt, coriander leaves, and ground black pepper in a large bowl.
Add the chicken pieces, and marinate for 8 hours in refrigerator.
In a large pot, fry onion rings, green chilies, and tomato in olive or sunflower oil over low heat until onions are light yellow.
Stir in remaining 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp red chili powder, and ground cashews.
Add chicken pieces, and fry them for about 5 minutes while gently stirring.
Add the marinade and water until all chicken pieces are submerged. Add coconut milk if desired.
Allow the dish to cook over low to medium heat for 30–45 minutes.
Remove from heat and wait for a few minutes until the chicken pieces are tender and have absorbed the sauce.
Serve with rice (Basmati variety works well).

name: Curry Chicken II
attribution: "Curry Chicken II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Curry_Chicken_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tablespoon olive oil or other vegetable oil

steps: In a cooking vessel over medium-high heat, add oil and chopped onion, and sauté until light brown.
Add chicken and salt, and leave for 3–5 minutes, stirring in between.
Add crushed ginger and garlic, and stir for 2 minutes. Stir in masala powder, and cook for 2 minutes.
Add water, and let it boil for 5 minutes.
Reduce heat to low, and let it cook for 15 minutes, or until the liquid has reduced.

name: Curry Fried Rice
attribution: "Curry Fried Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Curry_Fried_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 100 g bean sprouts, soaked in hot water

steps: Heat the oils in a non-stick frying pan. Add the garlic and scallion, and fry until fragrant.
Add sukiyaki beef and chicken. Cook, stirring, for 1 minute until golden brown.
Add bean sprouts, basmati rice, chilli powder and curry powder.
Add soy sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir until well-mixed.

name: Curtido (Spicy Cabbage Slaw)
attribution: "Curtido (Spicy Cabbage Slaw)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Curtido_(Spicy_Cabbage_Slaw), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Cooked green beans, not too soft (optional)
Vinegar or lime juice to taste

steps: Quickly swirl the cabbage in a pot of boiling water, then drain.
Combine all the ingredients in a glass or plastic container, and mix with a wooden spoon (never metal).
Put the container in the refrigerator, and let it rest for a week so that the ingredients pickle.

name: Custard Creams
attribution: "Custard Creams" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Custard_Creams, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 200 g (7.1 oz / 1½ cups) plain flour, plus extra for dusting
80 g (2.8 oz / ⅔ stick) unsalted butter
125 g (4.4 oz / ⅝ cup) superfine sugar
180 g (6.3 oz / ¾ cup) thick custard, such as pastry cream

steps: Combine the flour, bicarbonate of soda, and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter, sugar and vanilla in a mixing bowl until soft and fluffy.
Beat in the egg.
Fold the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients, and bring together until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 2 minutes on a floured surface until smooth.
Shape the dough into a flat disc. Cover with clingfilm and chill for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 190 C.
Line 2 baking trays with parchment paper.
Roll out the dough to 5 mm thick.
Cut out into 24 circles with a cookie cutter.
Transfer the biscuits to the prepared baking trays.
Bake for 10–12 minutes until well-cooked.
Place the biscuits on a wire rack and leave to cool completely.
Spoon 1 tablespoon of custard onto one biscuit. Sandwich it together with another biscuit.
Repeat the biscuit assembly, using remaining biscuits and custard.
Enjoy!

name: Custard Pie
attribution: "Custard Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Custard_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Blend all ingredients for 1 minute in a blender.
Pour into a buttered 9-inch pie plate.
Bake for 30 minutes at 400°F (200°C / Gas Mark 6) or until a knife inserted into the center by 1 inch comes out clean.

name: Cypriot Salad
attribution: "Cypriot Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Cypriot_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 spoon of feta cheese, cut into small pieces

steps: Cut the vegetables into pieces.
Put them in a bowl and decorate them with onions, feta cheese and olives. If you want you can decorate your bowl with every way!
Before serving, add salad and olive oil with lemon and shake.

name: Dabeli (Potato-stuffed Buns with Chutney)
attribution: "Dabeli (Potato-stuffed Buns with Chutney)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Dabeli_(Potato-stuffed_Buns_with_Chutney), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat oil in a pan. Add asafoetida, dabeli masala, potatoes, salt to taste, and a sprinkle of water. Mix it very well so that masala, salt and boiled potato assimilate very well.
Mix in the green chiles if using.

Remove potato mixture from the heat, and taste. If you want to make it more spicy, add some more dabeli masala, and mix again using your hands or a masher. Toss in the roasted peanuts and mix everything well.
Slice pav/bun into halves, and toast them with a little butter on a griddle.
Apply garlic chutney to one half of the bun (inner side) and tamarind-date chutney to the other half.
Place a portion of the potato filling in between between the bun halves.
Top with chopped onion, coriander, and sev.
Press down the bun from both side, and garnish with pomegranate seeds, and roasted peanuts.
Serve immediately, while medium-hot, with a extra dip of chutney on the plate. Fried green chillies, with a sprinkle of salt can be additionally given as an add-on.

name: Dahi Baingana (Fried Eggplant in Yogurt)
attribution: "Dahi Baingana (Fried Eggplant in Yogurt)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Dahi_Baingana_(Fried_Eggplant_in_Yogurt), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut eggplant into thin slices, lengthwise. Deep fry in oil. Keep aside.
Mix dahi with water.
Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a pan. Add panch puran and red chili, then cook until the spices splutter.
Add dahi-water mix, salt to taste, and sugar. Stir properly and make a gravy.
Add fried eggplant to the gravy, and lower the flame.
Heat it for 2–3 minutes, then leave it to cool.
Serve with rice.

name: Daifuku (Sweet Filled Mochi)
attribution: "Daifuku (Sweet Filled Mochi)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Daifuku_(Sweet_Filled_Mochi), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Prepare anko filling as directed. Shape into 12 small, marble-sized balls and set aside.
Prepare a smooth surface, such as a cutting board, by coating with potato starch; be generous, as the dough will be very sticky.

Heat water and sugar together in a microwave until sugar is dissolved. Add rice flour and stir completely. Microwave for 2 minutes, remove and stir. Microwave for 2 more minutes, or until dough begins to expand. Remove from microwave, stir again, and remove the dough to the potato starch-coated surface. The dough, called mochi, will be very hot.
Spread or roll the mochi dough out until thin. Using a knife, cut into 12 even sized pieces.
Coat the palms and fingers of your hands in potato starch. Spread each piece out as thin as possible.
Place an anko ball in the middle of each mochi piece, then wrap the mochi around the ball, forming a bigger ball.
Roll shaped daifuku in potato starch, and set on a plate dusted with potato starch or a piece of wax paper.
Serve warm or cool. Store in an airtight container. Very perishable.

name: Daigakuimo (Japanese Candied Sweet Potato)
attribution: "Daigakuimo (Japanese Candied Sweet Potato)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Daigakuimo_(Japanese_Candied_Sweet_Potato), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut sweet potatoes into bite-sized pieces.
Heat the oil and fry the sweet potatoes at 350°F (175°C) until brown.
Mix water, sugar, and soy sauce in a saucepan. Put the pan on low heat.
When the liquid turns sticky, remove from the heat and add fried sweet potatoes. Quickly mix the potatoes with the sticky sugar.
Sprinkle sesame seeds over the coated sweet potatoes.

name: Dal Makhani (Black Gram with Cream)
attribution: "Dal Makhani (Black Gram with Cream)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Dal_Makhani_(Black_Gram_with_Cream), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup whole dried urad dal (skinless black gram)

steps: Wash and soak black urad dal and red kidney beans overnight in an adequate amount of lukewarm water.
Cook the soaked dal, kidney beans, and chickpeas in 5–6 cups of water with the salt, red chili powder, turmeric, and grated ginger until soft.
Keep the cooked dal aside.

Heat oil or butter in a thick bottomed pan. Add hing, bay leaves, cinnamon stick, cloves, and chopped onions and cook until light golden brown in color. When the onion turns brown, add ginger garlic paste, and sauté.
Add chopped tomatoes. Sauté and add coriander powder. Sauté until tomatoes are well mashed.
Add cooked dal and water as needed.
Mix it well and simmer for 15–20 minutes.
Add fresh cream and clarified butter, and let it simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat. Garnish with coriander leaves before serving.
Serve hot with naan, paratha or rice.

name: Dalgona Coffee
attribution: "Dalgona Coffee" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Dalgona_Coffee, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Ice cubes (optional—you can omit if you're using hot milk if you prefer hot coffee)

steps: Put instant coffee and sugar in a bowl.
Gradually add water while whipping with a hand mixer (highly recommended; if not available, manually whisk the mixture up to 400 times).
Pour milk in a cup, add ice cubes, and add the cream on top.

name: Damper (Australian Campfire Bread)
attribution: "Damper (Australian Campfire Bread)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Damper_(Australian_Campfire_Bread), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: scant ¼ cup water (more and it will be as tough as an old boot)

steps: Add salt to flour.
Add water, then mix and form into a round loaf.
Dig a 1 foot-deep hole near a fire, and fill it with 2 shovels of hot coals and ash.
Add damper mixture to a greased camp oven (traditional cast iron round pot with lid).
Cook in the hole for a maximum of 40 minutes. If undercooked it will be flat and rubbery.
Your first try may be inedible. Keep trying, you'll soon be an expert.

name: Daniel Webster's Chowder
attribution: "Daniel Webster's Chowder" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Daniel_Webster's_Chowder, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 pounds sea bass or cod, cut into slices

steps: Fry the onion with the fatty pork. Transfer to a large pot.
Add all remaining ingredients to pot.
Add enough water to cover everything by 1 inch.
Bring to a boil. Simmer for 1 hour, stirring gently every so often.
Serve.

name: Danish Braised Cabbage (Rødkål)
attribution: "Danish Braised Cabbage (Rødkål)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Danish_Braised_Cabbage_(R%C3%B8dk%C3%A5l), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 5 lbs (about 2.25 kg) red cabbage, finely cut

steps: Brown butter lightly.
Add cabbage and stir well.
Add vinegar, sugar, and salt.
Let simmer for 2–3 hours.

name: Danwake
attribution: "Danwake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Danwake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups wheat flour or guinea corn flour
3 tablespoons vegetable oil or palm oil (for serving)
Shredded cabbage or yaji (Hausa pepper spice; optional)

steps: Dissolve potash in a small bowl with a little water and set aside.
In a large bowl, mix wheat flour (or chosen flour) with baobab leaf flour.
Add the dissolved potash solution gradually into the flour mix.
Slowly add water while stirring until you form a thick, smooth batter.
Bring a large volume of water to a boil in a pot. Using a spoon or hand, scoop small portions of the batter and drop them into the boiling water.
Let the dumplings cook for 10–15 minutes, or until they float and are firm to the touch.
Drain the dumplings and drizzle with vegetable oil.
Garnish with chopped onions and cabbage.

name: Deep Dish Pizza
attribution: "Deep Dish Pizza" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Deep_Dish_Pizza, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tsp active dry yeast (fast-rising yeast is acceptable)
1 or more (170 - 225 g) can(s) of prepared or homemade pizza sauce
¼ cup (20 g) grated Romano cheese (optional)
¼ cup (20 g) grated Parmesan cheese (optional)

steps: In a mixing bowl or dough mixer, mix the yeast and ¾ cup (185 ml) warm water. Let this stand for a few minutes to activate the yeast.

Mix in the 1 cup (140 g) flour, oil, sugar, salt into a smooth batter. Add the remaining flour and water. Mix this until you get a dough with a slightly sticky consistency. Add additional water or flour to adjust the consistency. Knead the dough until it springs slightly when touched.
Let this rise in a warm location in a greased bowl until doubled. Punch down the dough in the bowl.

Transfer dough to a floured flat surface. Roll or shape the dough to the shape of a pizza pan and make an edge up the side of the pan for the crust. Roll the dough thicker for Deep Dish Pizza and thinner for a crisper and more traditional pizza crust.
Preheat the oven to 425 F.

Spread the pizza sauce on the dough, leaving the edge crust uncoated. Add any optional toppings (pepperoni, sausage, green pepper, etc.). Sprinkle the grated mozzarella cheese evenly across the pizza, leaving the edge crust untouched. If desired, sprinkle the grated Parmesan and Romano cheeses evenly over the toppings.

Bake the pizza on a rack of the preheated oven for 25–30 minutes or until the crust and cheese are lightly brown. If the pizza is browning on the outer crust and not in the middle, line the edge with aluminum foil to prevent burning. This rarely happens except on larger diameter pizzas of 40 cm or more.
When removing from the oven, cut into about 8 triangular, pie shaped slices for serving. A pizza cutter with a circular wheel does this nicely.

name: Deep Fried Chickpea Dough Curry Snacks (Pakoda)
attribution: "Deep Fried Chickpea Dough Curry Snacks (Pakoda)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Deep_Fried_Chickpea_Dough_Curry_Snacks_(Pakoda), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup (240 g) besan or gram flour
