attribution: "Garlic Lemon Dressing" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Garlic_Lemon_Dressing, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 strip lemon peel (1 x ½ inch)

steps: Place the garlic and rosemary on a cutting board and lightly crush with the flat side of a heavy knife.
Put the rosemary, garlic and lemon peel in a clean bottle with a tight-fitting cap.
Pour in the oil and lemon juice. Cap the bottle and shake well.
Refrigerate and use within one week.
Shake before serving. Drizzle on steamed vegetables, or seafood, pasta, potato salad, or other salads.

name: Garlic Lemon Marinade
attribution: "Garlic Lemon Marinade" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Garlic_Lemon_Marinade, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Process all ingredients in a blender until smooth.
Keep refrigerated for up to 1 ½ weeks. Shake well before using.

name: Garlic Mayonnaise made with Bread and Fish Stock (Rouille)
attribution: "Garlic Mayonnaise made with Bread and Fish Stock (Rouille)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Garlic_Mayonnaise_made_with_Bread_and_Fish_Stock_(Rouille), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Blend the bread, fish stock, and egg yolk together into a paste.
Crush the garlic and saffron or annatto, and add to the paste.
Gradually add the oil with one hand while vigorously whisking with the other, as when preparing any other mayonnaise.
Add salt and pepper to taste.

name: Garlic Parmesan Pasta
attribution: "Garlic Parmesan Pasta" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Garlic_Parmesan_Pasta, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 220 g (8 oz) fettuccine or angel hair pasta, cooked and drained
360 ml (1 ½ cups) broccoli florets, cooked tender-crisp

steps: Melt the butter in a large skillet. Add the basil, lemon juice, garlic powder and seasoned salt, blending well.
Add the fettuccine, broccoli, and walnuts. Blend well and toss to coat the fettuccine.
After tossing, add fresh grated Parmesan cheese to top off the dish.

name: Garlic Pork Chops with Black Mushrooms
attribution: "Garlic Pork Chops with Black Mushrooms" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Garlic_Pork_Chops_with_Black_Mushrooms, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a small saucepan. Add the dried mushrooms, and simmer over low heat for about 10 minutes.
In a small bowl, stir together the vinegar, soy sauce, honey, and red pepper flakes. Set aside.
Heat the sesame oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the pork chops, and brown for about 2 minutes on each side. Add the garlic and ginger; cook and stir until fragrant.
Stir in the soy sauce mixture, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, and simmer for 5 minutes, uncovered.

Remove the mushrooms from the pan using a slotted spoon, and slice into thin strips. Stir the mushrooms and chicken broth into the pan with the pork chops, and simmer uncovered over low heat until the sauce has reduced by about ⅓, and the pork chops are cooked through.
To serve, place pork chops onto serving plates, and spoon mushroom sauce over them.

name: Garlic Shrimp Scampi Pasta
attribution: "Garlic Shrimp Scampi Pasta" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Garlic_Shrimp_Scampi_Pasta, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup (25 g / 1 oz) chopped parsley

steps: Boil the spaghetti in water until al dente.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a pan over medium heat.
Add the garlic and stir.
Add the shrimp and cook for 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they turn pink-red in color.
Season with salt and pepper, then stir in lemon juice, chili, and parsley.
Drain the pasta in a colander and stir into the pan of shrimp.
Divide the pasta between 4 plates and serve.

name: Garlic, Tomato and Cheddar Sandwich
attribution: "Garlic, Tomato and Cheddar Sandwich" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Garlic,_Tomato_and_Cheddar_Sandwich, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 5 long slices extra mature cheddar cheese

steps: Toast the two slices of brown bread, until one of the two is not soft anymore (the second one can be).
Rub the garlic clove on the hard piece of toasted bread, until only a little piece is left. Chop what's left, and scatter on the bread.
Cut the tomato in two, and crush each side on the same piece of bread. Then spread the juice, cut what's left of the tomato, and put it on the bread.
Add the olive oil, by being careful not to add more oil than there is bread.
Add the salt and pepper. Slice or crush the chili, and scatter on the piece of bread. Add the lemon juice.
Neatly add the slices of cheddar, then close the sandwich with the remaining piece of bread.

name: Garum (Fermented)
attribution: "Garum (Fermented)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Garum_(Fermented), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Salt the fish and fish intestines in a barrel.
Place said barrel in a warm, bright, place, turning regularly for at least 48 hours.
Place a basket, cloth-covered colander, or similar into the barrel, and let the liquids seep up into the container.

name: General Tso's Chicken
attribution: "General Tso's Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:General_Tso's_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 750 g (1.65 lb) raw chicken dark meat, boneless and skinless.
700 ml (3 cups) oil to deep fry, or enough oil to shallow-fry

steps: Cut the chicken into 2 cm (¾ inch) cubes.
Beat the egg, light soy sauce, and seasoning in a bowl.
Add the chicken pieces to the egg mixture, and stir in the cornstarch to thicken the mixture.
Mix the sauce ingredients in another bowl and set aside until needed. Stir out any lumps.
Heat the oil in a wok (if deep frying, aim for 180°C or 350°F).

If deep frying, fry the pieces of battered chicken a few at a time until crispy (around 3 minutes). If shallow-frying, fry until the chicken is cooked and the batter is golden. Remove excess oil from the chicken pieces after frying.
After frying the chicken, empty and wipe clean the wok. Add 2 tbsp oil back to the wok, and return to the heat.
Fry the spring onions and chili peppers together for about 30 seconds.
Add the chicken pieces back to the wok, and stir fry with the vegetables until browned.
Stir sauce and add to wok. After the sauce comes to a boil, cook for about 1 minute or until sauce thickens. The exact time will depend partly on how much cornstarch you added.
Remove from heat and serve immediately.

name: German Potato Salad
attribution: "German Potato Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:German_Potato_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ lb (113 g) uncooked chopped bacon

steps: Peel, thinly slice, and boil the potatoes about 17 minutes or until done but still somewhat firm. Drain, set aside, and allow to cool.
Cook the bacon until crisp. Crumble or chop.
Reserve a small amount of bacon grease and mix with flour, breaking up all clumps of flour. Cook briefly, but try to avoid browning.
Add chopped bacon and remaining ingredients and mix.
Cook for 20 minutes or until smooth at low heat.
Pour sauce over potatoes and stir gently.
Serve warm, room temperature, or cooled.

name: German Style Sweet Mustard (Senf)
attribution: "German Style Sweet Mustard (Senf)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:German_Style_Sweet_Mustard_(Senf), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix sugar, mustard, salt, and pepper together. Mix in water.
Mix in vinegar last, as the mustard will lose some of its flavour if vinegar is introduced too early.
Stir using a wire whisk to prevent lumps.
Add some water if too thick.

name: Germknödel (Plum and Poppy Seed Dumpling)
attribution: "Germknödel (Plum and Poppy Seed Dumpling)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Germkn%C3%B6del_(Plum_and_Poppy_Seed_Dumpling), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 package vanilla sugar or 1 tbsp vanilla extract

steps: Mix the flour, salt, vanilla, eggs, and sugar in a bowl.
In another bowl, mix the lukewarm milk with the yeast, and stir until all of the yeast has dissolved.
Pour the liquid mixture into the flour, and knead everything together with the softened butter. If the dough is too sticky, add more flour.
Cover the dough and leave it to rise for one hour until it has doubled its size.
Divide the dough into 8 pieces. Pat them flat and round on a board until they are about 4 inches in diameter.
Fill each of the pieces of dough with a tablespoon of the plum jam, and carefully form round dumplings. Make sure that the seam is completely closed.
Place the dumplings on a board with a dishtowel covering them, and let them rest for 10 minutes.
Boil salted water in a large pot.
Add the dumplings to the pot. Depending on the size of the pot, only add about 4 at a time so they have space to rise.
Let them simmer for 20 minutes with the lid on. Do not take the lid off, as the dumplings will not rise properly.
When finished, remove the dumplings, and place them in a bowl.
Top the dumplings with poppy seeds and powdered sugar. Pour butter or vanilla sauce over the top.
Serve right away. Enjoy the delicious dumplings!

name: Ghanaian Peanut Soup (Nkatenkwan)
attribution: "Ghanaian Peanut Soup (Nkatenkwan)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ghanaian_Peanut_Soup_(Nkatenkwan), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Start by placing the chicken pieces in a pot. Leave the onions whole, but trim off the top and bottom edges before adding them to the pot.
Add the whole tomatoes to the pot, making sure to remove the tough cores. You can either grate the garlic and ginger or add them whole, as they will be processed later.
Add the bay leaves, kpakpo shito peppers, and chicken stock in the pot. Bring the mixture to a boil and then let it simmer until the chicken becomes tender.

While the soup is simmering, it's time to prepare the peanut sauce. Take another pot and combine the peanut butter with ½ cup water. Mix well to ensure the peanut butter blends smoothly with the water.
Place the peanut sauce over high heat and gradually add the remaining water. Allow it to simmer for about 20 minutes until the peanut oil rises to the surface.

Once the onions and tomatoes have softened, remove them from the broth and transfer them to a blender. For those who prefer a spicier soup, you can add some additional kpakpo shito peppers at this stage. Process the mixture in the blender until smooth, then pour it back into the soup and stir. Let it simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
Gently pour the peanut sauce into the soup and continue simmering for 15 minutes.
Briefly boil the head and tail of the okra before adding them to the soup,
Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning with salt and chili powder according to your preference.
Serve alongside fufu or your preferred accompaniment.

name: Ghavoot (Iranian Nut and Seed Powder)
attribution: "Ghavoot (Iranian Nut and Seed Powder)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ghavoot_(Iranian_Nut_and_Seed_Powder), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Grind and roast each component.
Add an equal weight of sugar; grind everything together.
Serve as powder, or blend it with milk or hot water.

name: Ghee III
attribution: "Ghee III" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ghee_III, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Hardwood of grape vine or hickory wood (optional)
1 Tbsp fenugreek seeds (optional), roasted and powdered

steps: Combine the margarine and butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Melt and bring to a boil.
Strain the mixture using a fine strainer. Mix in the semolina.
If using, place a smoking piece of grapevine wood or hickory wood and in an empty sealed jar. Add the butter, margarine, and fenugreek.

name: Ghevar (Rajasthani Honeycomb Fritter)
attribution: "Ghevar (Rajasthani Honeycomb Fritter)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ghevar_(Rajasthani_Honeycomb_Fritter), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tbsp (10 grams) arrowroot starch or cornstarch
A few drops kewda essence (extract of Pandanus flower)

steps: Combine the sugar and water in a saucepan. Simmer until it reaches a 1-string consistency syrup.
Remove from the heat and keep warm.
Combine the flour, arrowroot, and melted ghee in a bowl.
Very gradually add 1 cup of water in a thin stream, whisking continuously and taking care to see that an emulsion is formed and the water and ghee do not separate.

Add 2 more cups of water again in a thin stream while whisking continuously. At no point should the ghee and water separate. The batter should be of a very thin coating consistency, a little thinner than crêpe batter. More water can be added if required to achieve the required consistency. Keep the batter in a cool place away from the heat.
Add melted ghee to a kadhai or other pot/pan. If desired, place a ghevar mould or other metal ring mould in the pan. The ghee should come up to ¾ of the height of the mould.

Heat the pan over medium heat, and gradually pour a ladleful of the batter directly into the centre of the mould in a very thin stream. The batter should froth and migrate towards the edges of the mold.

When the froth subsides, gradually add another spoonful to the centre in a thin stream. If the batter builds up in the center, use a skewer to push it towards the edges and maintain a hole in the center. Repeat seven times, adding the batter to the centre hole each time.
Increase the heat, and pour a few ladlefuls of hot ghee into the centre to help the ghevar cook.

When the centre is firm and cooked and the whole thing is golden brown, pull the ghevar out gently by inserting a wooden skewer in the centre and pulling it out of the ghee. Let any excess ghee drip off.
Immerse ghevar in sugar syrup, drain quickly, and place on a serving plate.
Repeat the cooking steps, using the remaining batter to make 9 pieces of ghevar.

name: Ghormeh Sabzi (Iranian Herb Stew)
attribution: "Ghormeh Sabzi (Iranian Herb Stew)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ghormeh_Sabzi_(Iranian_Herb_Stew), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 800 g beef or lamb which has some fat (such as the meat for boiled beef)
1 can (about 400 g) fried ghormeh sabzi herbs

steps: Boil the red beans for 1 hour.
Remove unnecessary fat from the meat, and cut the meat into smaller pieces.
Heat a bit of normal olive oil in a big pot with lid. Add the onions, and fry at high temperature for 1–2 minutes.
Stir in the meat, and cook for another 1–2 minutes.
Reduce the heat to the lowest level. The meat will release a significant amount of juice which will contribute to the flavor of the stew.
Stir in the parsley, spinach, coriander leaves, and ghormeh sabzi herbs.
Stir in boiling water (about 0.5 L or until the consistency is right).
Stir in the cooked, drained beans. Simmer for about ½–3 hours over low heat. The longer the better.
Soak the dried limes in hot water for 15 minutes, and puncture each of them with a fork.
Add the dried limes, turmeric, pepper, and salt to the stew. Simmer for another ½–1 hour.
If desired, for the best taste, let the stew cool down and store it in a fridge. The taste is better over the next two days.
Steam the rice.
Grind the saffron and sugar together in a mortar. Add about 1 tablespoon boiling water. Toss some of the cooked rice with the saffron water to color it.
Serve the stew hot in its own bowl. Serve the plain rice in a separate bowl, topped with the saffron rice.

name: Ghraiba bil Loz (Libyan Almond Ghraiba)
attribution: "Ghraiba bil Loz (Libyan Almond Ghraiba)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ghraiba_bil_Loz_(Libyan_Almond_Ghraiba), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Parchment paper or silicone baking mat

steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat.
In a mixing bowl, cream together the softened butter and powdered sugar until light and fluffy.
Add the flour, ground almonds, and vanilla extract to the butter mixture. Mix until well combined and a soft dough forms.
Pinch off small portions of the dough and roll them into balls about the size of a walnut. Place the balls on the prepared baking sheet, leaving some space between them.
Press a whole almond into the center of each cookie ball, gently flattening the cookies slightly.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12–15 minutes, or until the edges of the cookies turn golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes, then transfer them to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Giant Spaghetti-Stuffed Meatball
attribution: "Giant Spaghetti-Stuffed Meatball" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Giant_Spaghetti-Stuffed_Meatball, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 450 g (1 lb) hot Italian sausage meat
⅓ cup (30 g / 1 oz) parsley, chopped
⅓ cup (40 g / 1.5 oz) grated parmesan cheese
½ cup (60 g / 2 oz) grated mozzarella cheese
1 cup (250 g / 9 oz) tomato pasta sauce, heated

steps: Preheat the oven to 190°C (374°F). Line a baking pan with foil.
Boil the spaghetti in water until al dente. Drain the pasta in a colander and set aside.
Combine the meatball ingredients in a bowl until combined.
Line the sides and bottom of a large bowl with clingflim.
Put the sausage mixture into the large bowl and press to cover the sides and bottom of the bowl.
Sprinkle the meatball with cheese and add the spaghetti.
Seal the meatball and roll into a proper ball shape.
Put the meatball on the prepared baking pan. Bake for 40 minutes until well browned.
Pour half of the sauce on a plate.
Take the meatball out of the oven and put it on the plate.
Pour the remaining sauce over the meatball and sprinkle with cheese and garnish with basil leaves.

name: Gin Fried Rice
attribution: "Gin Fried Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Gin_Fried_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 eggs, scrambled, cooked, and roughly chopped
1 tbsp plus ¾ tsp red pepper flakes
A long match or a firestick

steps: Melt butter in a large straight-sided sauté pan.
Add all ingredients except gin to pan. Cook until all ingredients are heated through.
Add gin and carefully ignite off of the heat.
Place pan back on heat and cook until you don't smell alcohol any more.
Serve warm.

name: Ginger Ale
attribution: "Ginger Ale" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ginger_Ale, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup (120 ml) fresh or frozen ginger in ½ in (1.25 cm) dice

steps: Combine the 1 cup (240 mL) water with the ginger in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then remove from the heat and strain the liquid.
Combine the ½ cup (120 ml) water with the sugar in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, and simmer until reduced to about 5 oz (150 ml). Remove from the heat.
Combine the ginger liquid, the syrup, and the lime juice.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of ginger syrup with 1 volume of carbonated water.

name: Ginger Biscuits
attribution: "Ginger Biscuits" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ginger_Biscuits, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat the oven to 160 C. Grease a baking sheet.
Rub the butter and ginger into the flour in a bowl until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Add the eggs and mix to a soft dough, adding a little milk if necessary.
Roll out the dough to 5 mm and cut out biscuits with a plain round cutter.
Place them on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 5 minutes until golden.
Take the biscuits out of the oven and leave them to cool.

name: Ginger Tea
attribution: "Ginger Tea" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ginger_Tea, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut ginger into small pieces, and rinse to remove dirt.
Add water to the sliced ginger and bring to a boil.
Allow to simmer for a few minutes, then strain the drink to remove ginger particles.
Add sweetener to taste, and serve.

name: Ginger-Glazed Grilled Peaches
attribution: "Ginger-Glazed Grilled Peaches" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ginger-Glazed_Grilled_Peaches, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 lb large peaches, peeled and halved
¼ cup crystallized ginger, finely minced

steps: Combine liquid ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat until reduced by half.
Brush peaches with melted butter and place on a medium grill until well marked, brushing with nectar mixture often.
Pour remaining glaze into large bowl and toss with peaches; serve.

name: Gingerbread
attribution: "Gingerbread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Gingerbread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Put the butter, sugar, and syrup in a saucepan. Heat gently until the butter melts.
Place the dry ingredients in a bowl. Pour the melted butter mixture into the bowl, and beat thoroughly.
Warm the milk in a saucepan (so it will dissolve the syrup).
Add the milk to the bowl, and beat thoroughly.
Beat the eggs, and then stir them in to the mixture.
Pour the mixture into an 8-inch (20 cm) greased square cake tin.
Bake at 170°C (325°F) for 1 hour.
Cool in the tin for 15 minutes, then remove.
Leave at least 1 day before cutting into squares. Serve.

name: Gingerbread Pancakes II
attribution: "Gingerbread Pancakes II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Gingerbread_Pancakes_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup brewed coffee, cooled to room temperature

steps: In a mixing bowl, combine pancake mix, coffee, water, molasses, cinnamon, ginger, and nutmeg.
Stir until combined.
The batter will be thin; for thicker pancakes, add more mix, 1 tablespoon at a time.
Coat a nonstick frying pan with cooking spray and place over medium heat. If using an electric skillet, heat to 375°F.
Pour ¼ cup of batter into hot pan; cook 2 minutes or until bubbles appear and edges look dry; flip pancakes and cook 1 or 2 minutes more.
Serve with butter and syrup, if desired.

name: Gingersnaps
attribution: "Gingersnaps" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Gingersnaps, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1½ sticks / ¾ cup / 175 grams (6 oz) Butter

steps: Preheat the oven to 375 °F (190 °C, gas mark 5, moderately hot). Line a baking sheet with parchment baking paper, or lightly grease it.
Cream the butter and the sugar together.
Beat in the egg, then the molasses until fully incorporated.
Combine the cinnamon, ginger, salt, baking soda, and flour to make a dry mix. Stir the dry mix into the batter until it comes together into a dough.

Portion out walnut-sized balls of dough using a medium-size cookie scoop or two teaspoons; alternatively, roll a lump of dough into an inch-thick rope of dough, and then pinch off an appropriate length of the dough. Roll each ball in your hands to make smooth. If the dough is sticky, put it in the refrigerator to chill for an hour (or in the freezer for 15 minutes).
Put some plain white sugar in a small bowl, and roll each dough ball around until it is completely covered in sugar. Place the dough balls on the cookie sheet, spacing them out evenly.

Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. The cookies will be very soft and fragile when they first come out of the oven. Let them rest for a moment, and then use a flat spatula to move them to a wire cooling rack until they have finished cooling.

name: Githeri
attribution: "Githeri" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Githeri, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups dried maize kernels or fresh maize
2 cups dried beans (kidney beans, red beans, or mixed beans)

steps: Wash the maize and beans thoroughly. If using dried maize and beans, soak them overnight in separate bowls of water.
Drain the soaked maize and beans and place them in a large pot.
Add enough water to cover the mixture and boil until both the maize and beans become soft. This may take 1–2 hours depending on the type used.
In another pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until soft and lightly golden.
Stir in the garlic, tomatoes, carrot, and bell pepper. Cook for several minutes until the tomatoes soften.
Add curry powder or turmeric if desired.
Add the cooked maize and beans to the vegetable mixture and stir well.
Season with salt and simmer for 10–15 minutes, adding a little water if necessary.
Serve hot.
cuisine: Traditional Kenyan githeri made with maize and beans

name: Glazed Onion Canapes
attribution: "Glazed Onion Canapes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Glazed_Onion_Canapes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Melt half the butter in a small saucepan.
Turn the burner to medium heat. Add the diced onions to the pan.
Slowly caramelize the onions, adding in the rest of the butter as needed to keep from burning.
Once caramelized, add the brown sugar and the honey. Combine thoroughly until all the onions are glazed.
Place onions attractively onto the crackers, and finish with a small dollop of sour cream.

name: Glazed Sweet Potatoes
attribution: "Glazed Sweet Potatoes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Glazed_Sweet_Potatoes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (40 oz / 1100 g) sweet potatoes, drained

steps: Bring syrup and butter just to boil in large skillet on medium heat. Reduce heat to low, and simmer about 2 minutes.
Add sweet potatoes. Cook on low heat 10 minutes, gently turning sweet potatoes frequently to glaze.
Garnish with pecan halves, if desired.

name: Gluten Veggie Meat
attribution: "Gluten Veggie Meat" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Gluten_Veggie_Meat, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 bag (22 oz/623 g) Vital wheat gluten flour

steps: In a large bowl, combine the gluten flour, garlic powder, parsley flakes, and cup of water.
Knead for about 2 minutes, cover, and set aside for 10 minutes.
Slice gluten into pieces. The smaller the pieces, then firmer the final texture.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add bouillon cubes.
Add sliced pieces of gluten to the seasoned, boiling water.
Reduce heat to subtle simmer. Cover with lid and simmer for 55 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drain substantially larger gluten pieces, and place in another bowl to cool.
In another bowl with a lid, combine all-purpose flour, onion powder, and salt; cover and shake.
In another bowl, pour in soy sauce for dipping.
Dip several pieces of cooled gluten into bowl with soy sauce.
Place gluten pieces in bowl with seasoned flour, cover, and shake.
Fry pieces in frying pan with oil until browned.

name: Goat Cheese Cakes
attribution: "Goat Cheese Cakes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Goat_Cheese_Cakes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 package (5.2 ounces) Boursin brand cheese, room temperature
3 eggs, beaten lightly to make an egg wash

steps: In a mixing bowl, combine goat cheese, Boursin and ricotta cheese. Set aside.
Melt butter in a small saucepan over medium-low heat.
Add the garlic, shallot, chives, thyme, basil and tarragon.
Cook just until soft and fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Fold herbs into cheese mixture.
Cover and refrigerate until mixture is firm, at least 30 minutes.
When cheese mixture is firm, divide it into 8 equal portions and form each portion into a cake about ¾-inch thick.
Dredge each cake in flour, then shake off excess flour.
Dip each cake in egg wash, then into breadcrumbs, covering well on both sides. Set on a wire rack.
Heat oil in a large skillet or sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Gently add cheese cakes and fry until golden on both sides, 1–2 minutes per side.
Drain on a wire rack.

name: Goat Milk Caramel Sauce
attribution: "Goat Milk Caramel Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Goat_Milk_Caramel_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Place the sugar in a heavy-bottomed pot.
Pour the water around the sides of the sugar. The goal is to prevent sugar crystals from sticking to the sides of the pot.
Set the pot over medium heat. Stir gently every so often until the sugar is dissolved. Once the sugar is completely dissolved, do not stir any more.
Bring the sugar syrup to a boil. Cook, brushing the sides of the pot with water if any sugar crystals build up, until the syrup becomes an amber caramel.
Remove the pot from the heat, and gradually stir in the warmed goat milk. The mixture may curdle or separate slightly—this is okay and can be fixed later.
Return the pot to medium heat, and cook until the sauce reaches 230°F (110°C). This evaporates excess water from the goat milk. Be careful not to let the sauce bubble too high.
Remove the pot from the heat, and let cool until it is warm but you can safely touch it.
If the caramel sauce has split or curdled, transfer it to a blender. Blend well until the mixture is smooth.
Season the caramel to taste with salt, then cool completely.

name: Gobi Bhagi (Spiced Cauliflower Stew)
attribution: "Gobi Bhagi (Spiced Cauliflower Stew)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Gobi_Bhagi_(Spiced_Cauliflower_Stew), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Boil the cauliflower in hot water for 5 minutes. Drain and cut into big pieces.
Heat some oil in a pan, and add the onions. Add the tomatoes, and fry until the tomatoes leave the oil.
Add the cauliflower, green chiles, ginger, chili powder, and some water. Pressure cook for 6–7 minutes.
Stir in garam masala, pepper, and salt.
Serve with chappati or naan and pulao.

name: Gochujang (imitation)
attribution: "Gochujang (imitation)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Gochujang_(imitation), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix ingredients together thoroughly.
Refrigerate any leftover portions.

name: Gooey Butter Cake
attribution: "Gooey Butter Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Gooey_Butter_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 box (18.25 oz) of yellow cake mix

steps: Combine the cake mix, one egg, and 4 oz butter to create a stiff dough.
Spray a 9 × 13-inch pan with oil. Spread the dough evenly in the pan and up the sides.
Melt the remaining butter, and mix the remaining ingredients to create the filling, adding the cream cheese and then the confectioner's sugar last. Gently warming the cream cheese aids mixing.
Pour the filling into the crust, and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes. Allow to cool and firm up.

name: Goong Ten (Raw Shrimp Salad)
attribution: "Goong Ten (Raw Shrimp Salad)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Goong_Ten_(Raw_Shrimp_Salad), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Clean freshwater shrimp well.
Put the shrimp in ice water for 5 minutes or until they stop moving. Drain, dry, and set aside.
Make the spicy sauce by combining the fish sauce, sugar, chili, and lime juice together. Test and flavor it as desired. Add more chili for a more spicy taste or add more lime for a more sour taste.
Shake the shrimp with the spicy sauce in a bag to mix it well.
Serve with peppermint leaves and coriander.

name: Grand Union Bacon
attribution: "Grand Union Bacon" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Grand_Union_Bacon, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Very fine cracker crumbs or dust

steps: Beat the egg with the Tabasco sauce.
Dip bacon in the egg mixture, and roll in cracker dust.
Add butter to a frying pan over medium heat. When pan is well heated, add the bacon. Fry until golden brown.
Flip bacon over, cook the other side, and serve on a napkin.

name: Granola
attribution: "Granola" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Granola, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients except the raisins and blueberries.
Spread the mixture on a tray and bake for 1 hour at 250°F, stirring every 10 minutes.
Let cool, then mix in the raisins and blueberries.

name: Grape Lassi
attribution: "Grape Lassi" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Grape_Lassi, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup fresh curd (thick plain Indian yogurt)

steps: Blend black grapes, sugar, curd, milk, and salt in a blender until smooth.
Crush ice-cubes, divide it into 4 portions, and divide between 4 glasses.
Pour the lassi over the ice cubes.
Serve chilled.

name: Grapefruit and Crab Cocktail
attribution: "Grapefruit and Crab Cocktail" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Grapefruit_and_Crab_Cocktail, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut the grapefruits in half. Carefully remove and chop the flesh.
Divide the chopped grapefruit between 4 grapefruit hulls or 4 serving glasses
Toss the asparagus tips with the oil, lemon juice and seasoning. Pile on top of the chopped grapefruit, and top each with a little crab.
To decorate, put 1 teaspoon mayonnaise on each portion, and garnish with parsley.

name: Gravlax
attribution: "Gravlax" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Gravlax, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 800 g (1.75 lb) fresh salmon filet, approximately 2–5 cm (1–2 inches) thick
5 ml (1 tsp) whole or crushed white pepper

steps: Cut the salmon filet into two equally-sized parts (if you are making gravlax for many people it is fine to use two filets instead). Freeze the salmon for at least 4 days at -18°C or colder to kill any parasites.
After deep freezing the salmon remove it from the freezer and let it thaw, preferably overnight in the refrigerator. The salmon does not have to be completely thawed for the next steps.
Combine the salt and sugar. Place the salmon, skin down, on a table. Rub the salt and sugar mix onto the pieces, then apply the juniper berries and pepper. Finally, cover with dill.
Put one salmon piece on top of another, flesh side to flesh side so the skin it outside on both pieces, and place in a plastic bag. Add any leftover ingredients to the bag along with the gin.
Seal the bag and place it in the refrigerator. Let the salmon cure in the mixture, turning the bag over once, preferably twice, a day for 4 days.

After 4 days, the salmon is ready to serve. If you are not going to eat it immediately (it lasts a couple of days) move it to a fresh plastic bag or jar, removing the salty liquid that has formed in the original bag. If you keep it in the original bag the risk is that it may be too salty once you are about to serve it.

Use a sharp knife to slice thin slices from the salmon at an angle. During slicing, also remove any remaining bones. The larger the piece of salmon the larger the angle and the larger surface area for the produced slices. Large slices look better when served.

As a main dish, serve with potato stew, boiled potatoes and gravlax sauce, or in a salad. As an appetizer, serve on crispbread or toast. Potato stew with some additional Dijon mustard is excellent addition to gravlax.

name: Gravy (Vegetarian)
attribution: "Gravy (Vegetarian)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Gravy_(Vegetarian), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tablespoons imitation bacon bits (Bacos are soy based)
Salt or seasoning salt to taste

steps: Heat oil in frying pan over medium heat.
Add flour, stirring constantly, and allow to cook until slightly browned. This creates a roux.
Slowly add milk, whisking continuously to remove any lumps.
Add imitation bacon bits, and continue to cook until gravy thickens.
When thickened, remove from heat and stir in butter. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve over biscuits.

name: Greek Chicken Wrap
attribution: "Greek Chicken Wrap" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Greek_Chicken_Wrap, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup fresh oregano, finely chopped

steps: Combine feta, chicken, yogurt sauce, and oregano. Set aside.
Brush one side of each tortilla with olive oil. Add ¼ of chicken mixture and roll the longer side up.
Repeat until all tortillas have been rolled.
Sprinkle with additional chopped oregano, and serve cold as a snack.

name: Greek Salad
attribution: "Greek Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Greek_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Red or white onions, sliced into half-moons
Green bell peppers, cut into small pieces

steps: Combine tomatoes, cucumbers, onions, peppers, and olives in a deep bowl.
Add enough olive oil, vinegar or lemon juice, and salt to taste. Toss the ingredients for half a minute.
Place a feta cheese slice on top and season with a splash of olive oil.
Top with a sprig of oregano if desired.

name: Greek Yogurt Sauce
attribution: "Greek Yogurt Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Greek_Yogurt_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ ea. small red onion, finely diced
1 ½ tsp fresh rosemary, finely chopped

steps: Pulse all ingredients in a food processor until relatively smooth.
Pour into your dipping bowl, and serve with a Greek-style dish.

name: Green Bean Casserole
attribution: "Green Bean Casserole" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Green_Bean_Casserole, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 ⅔ cups canned French fried onions, divided into 2 equal portions
2 cans (21 ounces) cream of mushroom soup

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Stir together beans, milk, ½ of onions, pepper, soup, and soy sauce in a 3-quart casserole dish.
Bake until hot, about 25 minutes.
Sprinkle top with rest of onions.
Bake another 5 minutes.

name: Green Bean Casserole with Pimento
attribution: "Green Bean Casserole with Pimento" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Green_Bean_Casserole_with_Pimento, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (about 14.5 oz / 410 g) French-style green beans, drained
1 can or jar (about 15 oz / 430 g) small whole onions, drained
1 can (10.75 oz / 305 g) condensed cream of mushroom soup

steps: In a lightly buttered 1½-quart casserole dish, combine green beans, onions, diced pimento, and mushroom soup.
Combine topping ingredients; sprinkle over the top of the casserole.
Bake, uncovered, at 350 F for 25–30 minutes.

name: Green Chicken Curry with Coconut Milk
attribution: "Green Chicken Curry with Coconut Milk" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Green_Chicken_Curry_with_Coconut_Milk, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Grind all the ingredients for the curry paste together with a mortar and pestle.
Fry the curry paste with oil for a couple of minutes in a big pot. Add leeks and bell pepper. Shortly after, add the coconut milk, cover, and let simmer 20–30 minutes.
Meanwhile, crush garlic into a bowl with some soy sauce and mix in the chicken meat cubes. Let marinate.
Fry the marinated meat with oil.
Add the cooked meat to the curry pot, then season with basil, salt, and fish sauce to taste.

name: Green Leaf Juice
attribution: "Green Leaf Juice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Green_Leaf_Juice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 238 g (8 oz / 6 leaves) Swiss chard or collard greens
26 g (1 oz / 1 piece) fresh ginger root

steps: Squeeze the lime juice into the container where the juice extractor dispenses the juice.
Cut the pineapple, removing the outer spiny flesh, the top, the bottom and the pithy core.
Cut the pineapple into long thin strips that can be easily inserted into the juice extractor. Run the pineapple through the juice extractor.
Tear the greens into smaller pieces that can be put into the juice extractor easily. Run the greens through the juice extractor.
Run the cilantro through the juice extractor.
Run the ginger root through the juice extractor.
Stir the juice mixture well, and serve the green juice over ice.

name: Grill Seasoning
attribution: "Grill Seasoning" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Grill_Seasoning, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup dried apples, finely minced in a food processor

steps: Combine all ingredients in an airtight container with a shaker lid.
Use as desired or as directed in a given recipe.

name: Grilled Aubergine
attribution: "Grilled Aubergine" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Grilled_Aubergine, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Wash the aubergine, and cut it into 2.5 cm slices lengthwise.
Brush the cut surfaces with oil.
Grill 7–10 cm from the source of the heat until the aubergine is tender and browned all over (about 5 minutes).
In a small saucepan combine the miso, sugar, and soup stock. Cook, stirring, over low heat until the mixture is smooth and hot. Do not let it boil.
Pour the sauce mixture over the aubergine.
In a small frying pan toast the sesame seeds until they jump, then sprinkle them over the aubergine.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
attribution: "Grilled Cheese Sandwich" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Grilled_Cheese_Sandwich, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1–3 slices of easy-to-melt cheese, such as cheddar, gouda, Limberger, American (or shredded cheese to taste)
Other ingredients as necessary (see variations below)

steps: Heat a skillet, frying pan or griddle over medium heat.
Spread butter on the bread, and place both pieces of bread, butter side down, in the skillet.
When the butter sides of both have browned (check periodically), flip one over and place cheese on top, then place the other slice of bread on top of the cheese (again, butter side down).
Compress the sandwich by pressing on it with a spatula.
Once the bottom side of the sandwich is browned sufficiently, flip the sandwich over. When both sides are browned, take off heat, cut, and serve.
Preheat oven to 150°C (300°F).
Spread butter on both sides of the bread slices.
Sandwich the cheese and fillings between the bread slices, and transfer the sandwiches to a baking sheet.
Bake for 10–15 minutes, flip, and bake another 5–10 minutes or to taste.

name: Grilled Cornish Hens
attribution: "Grilled Cornish Hens" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Grilled_Cornish_Hens, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all seasonings.
Brush hens with bacon fat. Massage seasoning mixture into hens. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Preheat a charcoal grill using a chimney.
Place hens on the grill. Grill them, turning constantly, until internal temperature of both the thigh and breast reach 165°F.
Remove hens from grill and let rest 10 minutes. Serve.

name: Grilled Dog
attribution: "Grilled Dog" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Grilled_Dog, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 small or medium-sized dog, humanely slaughtered, skinned, and cleaned

steps: Cut dog up into about 12–16 large pieces.
In a food processor, blend together all the marinade ingredients.
Combine the dog pieces and marinade in a large container. Let marinate for at least 2 hours in the fridge.
Put dog pieces on a charcoal grill, cover, and let it cook over warm coals. Flip and baste occasionally for about 1 hour or until meat is tender.

name: Grilled Fruit Pouches
attribution: "Grilled Fruit Pouches" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Grilled_Fruit_Pouches, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 peaches, peeled and sliced into eighths
½ cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, divided

steps: In a large bowl, toss together fruit, sugar, salt, lemon, and brandy. Set aside.
In four large sheets of aluminum foil, scatter a foundation of crystallized ginger.
Place the fruit mixture on top of the ginger. Top with 1 tablespoon of the butter. Fold into a pouch.
Place pouches in the hot coal area of a kettle grill. Cook 7 minutes. Serve warm.

name: Grilled Peaches with Vanilla Maple Sauce
attribution: "Grilled Peaches with Vanilla Maple Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Grilled_Peaches_with_Vanilla_Maple_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 ripe yellow peaches, halved and pitted

steps: Combine all ingredients except peaches and sugar. Bring to a boil over high heat in a large saucepan, and simmer until reduced by half.
Dip cut side of peaches into hot mixture. Sprinkle cut side liberally with sugar.
Place peaches cut-side down on a high-heat grill until marked and slightly charred. Serve warm with remaining sauce.

name: Grilled Peanut Butter Sandwiches
attribution: "Grilled Peanut Butter Sandwiches" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Grilled_Peanut_Butter_Sandwiches, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Spread peanut butter between bread slices.
Spread outsides of bread with softened or melted butter or margarine.
Cook in a non-stick skillet on medium heat, turning a few times, until bread is golden brown and peanut butter is melted.
Serve with plenty of milk.

name: Grilled Pork Loin
attribution: "Grilled Pork Loin" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Grilled_Pork_Loin, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine mustard and vinegar, and rub all over pork.
Coat pork evenly with the Barbecue Rub.
Grill on a preheated grill, turning often until internal temperature reaches 145°F (63˚C).
Remove and let rest for 10 minutes. Serve.

name: Grilled Portobello Mushrooms
attribution: "Grilled Portobello Mushrooms" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Grilled_Portobello_Mushrooms, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Remove stems from the mushrooms, then wash and dry them.
Brush with olive oil.
Grill for about 10 minutes, alternating sides, until both sides are grill-marked.

name: Grilled Prime Rib
attribution: "Grilled Prime Rib" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Grilled_Prime_Rib, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Brush roast with olive oil. Season all sides liberally with the prime rib seasoning.
Place roast on a medium grill. Cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 135°F for medium rare, 145°F for medium, and 160°F for well/toast.
Remove and cover with aluminum foil. Let rest 10 minutes before serving.

name: Grilled Ribeye Steak
attribution: "Grilled Ribeye Steak" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Grilled_Ribeye_Steak, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½–1 tsp cayenne pepper (depending on how spicy you like it)
2 bone-in ribeye steaks (sometimes called a rib steak)

steps: Combine all rub ingredients.
Coat steaks with mustard and apply rub to steaks.
Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Heat a grill as high as it will go.
Place steaks on grill and cook 2–3 minutes per side.
Move steaks to medium grill heat. Cook until desired doneness, turning frequently.
Remove and let rest 10 minutes; slice thinly across the grain on a bias and serve.

name: Grilled Summer Fruit
attribution: "Grilled Summer Fruit" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Grilled_Summer_Fruit, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 ripe yellow peaches, halved and pitted
8 wooden toothpicks, soaked in water 30 minutes

steps: Combine all syrup ingredients in a large saucepan, and bring to a boil over high heat until reduced by ⅓. Set aside until cool.
Skewer plums through the side on the toothpicks. Brush cut side of all fruits liberally with syrup, and place syrup-side down on a medium high grill until marked.
Remove from grill, and serve warm with remaining syrup.

name: Grilled Vegetable Sandwich
attribution: "Grilled Vegetable Sandwich" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Grilled_Vegetable_Sandwich, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 slices of bread (preferably organic wholemeal bread)
Sliced vegetables (e.g. mushrooms, courgettes, tomatoes, peppers, etc.)

steps: Place bread slices next to each other on a baking tray.
Arrange the vegetables evenly across both slices.
Drizzle the olive oil over the vegetables, and add liberal sprinklings of oregano.
Broil on medium-high heat for 5–10 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve open-faced, or carefully combine the two parts of the sandwich.

name: Grits with Cheese
attribution: "Grits with Cheese" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Grits_with_Cheese, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Bring the water to a boil in a 1–2 quart saucepan.
Add the grits, stirring constantly.
Reduce heat to low, stirring occasionally until until grits begin to thicken.
Cover and continue to cook on low heat for about 5–6 minutes. Stir occasionally to avoid sticking. If the grits become too thick, stir in a small amount of water.
Adjust the seasoning before serving, adding black pepper to taste.
Serve with a pat of margarine, butter, or grated cheese on top.

name: Groundnut Soup
attribution: "Groundnut Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Groundnut_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups groundnut (peanut) paste (can be made by grinding roasted peanuts or bought from the store)
Leafy vegetables like spinach, ugu (fluted pumpkin leaves), or bitterleaf (optional)

steps: Wash and cut the goat meat, stockfish, and dried fish into bite-sized pieces.
Add the goat meat, stockfish, and dried fish to a pot. Season with a pinch of salt and seasoning cubes. Add enough water to yield enough liquid for the soup base.
Bring the pot to a simmer, and cook until the meats are tender (about 30–45 minutes). Add water as needed to maintain enough liquid for the soup base.
In another pot, heat the palm oil over medium heat. Once hot, add the chopped onions and fry until soft and fragrant.
Add the ground pepper and stir for about 2 minutes.
Gradually add the groundnut paste to the pot, stirring to avoid lumps. Add a little water to thin the paste into a soupy consistency. Stir well.
Pour the cooked meat and stock into the groundnut paste mixture. Stir everything well, adding more water if needed to adjust the soup’s thickness.
Add the ground crayfish, locust beans, and any additional seasoning cubes as desired. Let it simmer on medium heat for 10–15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
If using leafy vegetables, add them in the last few minutes of cooking.
Taste the soup and adjust for salt, seasoning cubes, and pepper. If you want the soup spicier, add more ground pepper.
Once the soup is thick and well-seasoned, it’s ready to be served with your favorite fufu, pounded yam, or rice.

name: Guacamole (Chile- and Herb-Free)
attribution: "Guacamole (Chile- and Herb-Free)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Guacamole_(Chile-_and_Herb-Free), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Gently slice avocado and remove pit.
Add avocado to a bowl and mash until smooth.
Add chopped tomatoes and onion.
Squeeze lime on the mixture.
Add salt and stir.
If desired, eat with chips, bread, or salad.

name: Guacamole I
attribution: "Guacamole I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Guacamole_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 chopped Jalapeño OR 2 tablespoons of crushed red pepper OR 1 tablespoon of cayenne pepper
½ teaspoon of ground black pepper
1 minced jalapeño OR 2 minced serrano chiles OR 2 tablespoon minced of any chile pepper like (adjust for spiciness)

steps: Halve and pit the avocados.
Score the avocado flesh in a criss-cross pattern without cutting through the skin.
Scoop out the flesh of one half with a large spoon and place in mixing bowl.
Add the lime juice and stir to evenly coat the avocados.
Stir in the pico de gallo, garlic, oil, jalapeño, salt, red pepper, and black pepper, mashing and tossing the avocado pieces until thoroughly mixed.
Scoop out the remaining avocado chunks and gently mix and toss in the larger pieces. The guacamole is the right consistency when more large pieces than mashed parts remain.
Garnish with a sprig of cilantro.

name: Guacamole III
attribution: "Guacamole III" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Guacamole_III, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: About ¼ cup cherry, grape, or pear tomatoes halved or quartered, with about ⅛ cup seeded
2 jalapeño peppers, 1 seeded and 1 unseeded, diced finely
Kosher salt and extra virgin olive oil to taste

steps: Halve the avocado. Carefully lodge the base end of a chef's knife in the pit, twisting to remove, and then pinching the pit off of the knife.
Remove flesh with large spoon, being careful to maintain the integrity of the flesh. Dice in large chunks and transfer to mixing bowl. Mash to desired consistency.
Add lime, and stir to combine.
Add remaining ingredients, and stir to combine.

name: Gullisuwa (Nigerian Milk Balls)
attribution: "Gullisuwa (Nigerian Milk Balls)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Gullisuwa_(Nigerian_Milk_Balls), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine powdered milk, sugar, cornstarch, and vanilla powder in a bowl. Mix thoroughly.
Mix in enough water to form a dough.
Grease your hands with vegetable oil, and roll the dough into small balls.
Deep fry the dough in a pan of hot vegetable oil until browned all over.
Use spoon to remove the fritters from the oil and drain in a sieve.
Serve fresh.

name: Gyuveche (Bulgarian Casserole) II
attribution: "Gyuveche (Bulgarian Casserole) II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Gyuveche_(Bulgarian_Casserole)_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Any kind of cooked chicken, pork, or beef (optional)
Any kind of sausage or hot dogs (optional)
Vegetables (optional), such as tomatoes, peppers, small hot pepper, mushrooms, cooked potatoes
Fresh greens (optional), such as parsley, dill, celery leaves

steps: Chop or dice everything you want to put in.
Alternate layers of cheese, meat, and vegetables in a baking dish. Finish with cheese on top.
Bake in the oven at 200 °C (375 °F) for 20 minutes or until the cheese is melted.
Break the egg on top and put back in the oven for another 5–10 minutes depending on how well-done you like your eggs.
Serve with fresh bread or toast. Enjoy!

name: Gözleme (Turkish Flatbread)
attribution: "Gözleme (Turkish Flatbread)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:G%C3%B6zleme_(Turkish_Flatbread), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Sift flour in a large bowl, reserving 1 cup of flour.
Sprinkle with salt and mix. Make a well in the centre.
Combine yeast and sugar in a small bowl. Stir in ¼ cup warm water.
Pour the liquid into the well in the centre of the flour.
Cover yeast with some flour. Let stand for 10 minutes to rise.
Stir in remaining liquid, blending thoroughly. Knead for 5 minutes to form a medium-soft dough.
Cover and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour or until doubled in bulk.
Place dough on lightly floured board. Divide into 10 portions with floured hands.
Shape portions into balls; roll each ball out with rolling pin into a 5 mm thick rectangle. Brush with oil.
Fold opposite edges over, bringing edges together in centre.
Spread filling over half of pastry. Then fold other half over filling, shaping into an oblong.
Seal edges well, pressing slightly.
Heat griddle or a cast iron skillet.
Grease with butter and place gözleme on griddle.
Brown on both sides.
Serve hot with ayran.

name: Habas con Jamon (Broad Beans with Ham)
attribution: "Habas con Jamon (Broad Beans with Ham)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Habas_con_Jamon_(Broad_Beans_with_Ham), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 strips of ham or bacon (or vegetarian bacon)

steps: Fry onions and ham in a pan with a little olive oil.
Add the broad beans and sauté for a few minutes until the beans are soft.
Serve hot.

name: Habet Hlawa (Algerian Anise Beverage)
attribution: "Habet Hlawa (Algerian Anise Beverage)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Habet_Hlawa_(Algerian_Anise_Beverage), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Pour water into a saucepan, add anise seeds, and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Turn off the heat, cover, and leave to infuse for 30 minutes.
Filter out the seeds.
Add the sugar as desired, and bring to boil again over medium heat. Simmer until the syrup drips into a thin stream.
Filter a second time.
Let it cool and bottle. Serve with very cold sparkling or still water according to preference.

name: Habichuela con Dulce (Dominican Sweet Beans)
attribution: "Habichuela con Dulce (Dominican Sweet Beans)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Habichuela_con_Dulce_(Dominican_Sweet_Beans), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Blend cooked beans, including the water they cooked in, into a purée.
Strain beans into a pot in order to get rid of any skins.
Mix in sweetened condensed milk, evaporated milk, vanilla extract, salt, sugar, sweet potatoes, cinnamon sticks, and cloves.
Simmer over low heat until the sweet potatoes are fully cooked. Stir occasionally so that it will not stick on the bottom.
Add raisins and simmer for 10 minutes. You can also add the milk cookies if you want them to become soft.
Remove beans from heat.
If you want, you may remove the cinnamon sticks and cloves.
Serve beans in a bowl, and add milk cookies on top. You may serve warm or chilled.

name: Haggis
attribution: "Haggis" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Haggis, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pound (450 g) beef or lamb heart, cut into 2 inch-wide strips
1 pound (450 g) beef or lamb liver
½ pound (225 g) lamb stew meat, cut in 1-inch cubes
1 ½ cups peeled and finely-chopped yellow onion
2 cups oatmeal, toasted in a 375°F (200°C) oven for 10 minutes
½ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
3 beef CAPS (Talk to a sausage shop about these)

steps: Place the beef heart in a 4-quart (about 3–3.5 litre) covered pot and just cover with cold water. Simmer, covered, for 1 hour and 10 minutes.
Add the beef liver and lamb stew meat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove the contents of the pot and cool. Reserve 1 cup of the liquid. Grind all the meat coarsely.
In a large bowl mix all of the ingredients except for the beef caps, vinegar, and salt for soaking. Mix well and set aside.
Rinse the beef caps in cold water. Turn them inside out and soak them in 2 quarts of cold water with the salt and vinegar for ½ hour. Drain them and rinse very well, inside and out.

Divide the meat mixture into three parts. Fill the beef caps with the meat mixture and tie the ends off with string. Two will have to be tied on just one end, but the third piece will be tied on both ends. Prick the Haggis all over with corn holders or a sharp fork. Place in a steamer and steam for 1 hour and 20 minutes.
Serve the haggis, sliced, with beef or lamb gravy.

name: Hake in Herby Breadcrumbs
attribution: "Hake in Herby Breadcrumbs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hake_in_Herby_Breadcrumbs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup chopped herbs (e.g. parsley, tarragon, etc.)
2 tablespoons avocado oil or olive oil

steps: Preheat the oven to gas mark 4.
Mix together the breadcrumb ingredients in a food processor, adding the oil last. It should be a slightly moist mixture.
Dip each hake fillet in beaten egg, then in the breadcrumb mix. Try to get the fillet evenly coated.
Place each fillet in a gratin dish, drizzling a little oil on top.
Bake in the oven for 20 minutes until the breadcrumbs are browned.
Sprinkle some lemon juice on top.
Serve with a dressed salad.

name: Halibut Cheek Stir-Fry
attribution: "Halibut Cheek Stir-Fry" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Halibut_Cheek_Stir-Fry, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Add oil to wok or frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add halibut cheeks, moving around in oil until they start to brown.
Add carrots and celery, stirring them around in the wok.
Add ginger and garlic, while continuing to stir.
Add soy sauce and fish stock. Stir and bring to simmer.
Garnish with green onions.
Serve and enjoy.

name: Hallaca (Venezuelan Stuffed Corn Dough)
attribution: "Hallaca (Venezuelan Stuffed Corn Dough)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hallaca_(Venezuelan_Stuffed_Corn_Dough), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 leeks, green and white parts cut in 1-inch chunks
1 large bunch of fresh herbs (coriander leaf, thyme, parsley, celery)
1 kg instant polenta meal (coarse corn meal)
500 g cooked and mashed new potatoes
1 jar of mixed pickles in mustard sauce
1 can of mock duck or 1 packet of marinated tofu pieces
1 packet of mi-cuit (half dried) tomatoes or 1 tube of tomato paste

steps: With a damp cloth, wipe the banana leaves.
Heat the banana leaves over a flame (gas cooker, camping fire, etc). The leaves should turn softer and darker, with a distinctive smoky smell.
Cut the hard rim without shredding the leaves. Cut in 30 cm segments along the transversal veins
In a small pan, warm 5 tsp olive oil with the annatto seeds for 20 minutes over very low heat. The oil should turn red. Strain to remove the seeds.
In the meantime, fry the cumin, black pepper, and coriander seeds in 2–3 tsp olive oil in a deep pan.
Add the white onion, 5 cups of boiling water, stock cubes, Marmite, chunked leeks, fresh herbs, three-quarters of the chopped spring onions, and garlic head.
Simmer this broth for 15 minutes.
Put the contents of the pot in a food processor and liquidise it. Strain the mixture very well, keeping the liquid and discarding the solids.
Put the broth in a large bowl, then add the annatto oil along with the liquid from the olive and the caper jars.
Add the polenta meal, 1 cup at a time, stirring very well. The consistency should be that of a smooth dough.
Mix the mashed potatoes with the polenta dough.

Test the consistency of the dough: Wrap 1 tsp dough with a small segment of banana leaf. Wrap it in aluminum foil and boil it in water for 15 minutes. If the cooked dough maintain the shape of the banana leaf "package", the dough is ready. If it crumbles or comes out half dissolved in water, then add more polenta meal. If it comes out rock hard, then add more water to the dough. Adjust the salt content as well.
Rub olive oil on 2 red bell peppers and grill them all over to char the skin.
Remove the skin and seeds and cut in 1 cm-wide strips. Set aside in a small bowl.
Vegetables: Combine the carrot, Brussels sprout, and green beans. Set aside in a small bowl.
Soak the vine fruit in cooking wine or replacement. Set aside in a small bowl.
Soak prunes in cooking wine or replacement. Set aside in a small bowl.
Drain chickpeas and set aside in a small bowl.
Set pickles aside in a small bowl.
Blanch and toast the almonds, and set aside in a small bowl.
Drain and chop the mock duck into 1 cm cubes and set aside in a small bowl.
Put the olives in a small bowl.
Put the capers in a small bowl.
Drain the artichoke hearts, cut in quarters and set aside in a small bowl.
Drain the asparagus and put it on a plate.
Quickly stir-fry the red onion, chopped leek, and the remaining chopped spring onions.
Using a food processor, liquidise the tomatoes, and peppers. Add to the cooking onions and leek, and stir for a minute.
Add soy sauce, chili sauce, and ground cumin to season. Add some cooking wine if you want. Let it simmer for another minute.
Add some flour to thicken. Set the sauce aside in a bowl.
Cut a 35 cm-long piece of aluminum foil and put it over the table. Cover with a banana leaf, with the transversal veins along the horizontal axis.
Rub oil on the surface of the banana leaf. Put a bit more than half a ladle of dough in the centre of the leaf. Spread with a spoon to make a 14 cm-diameter circle.

Put 1 tsp sauce in the middle. Put 1½ tsp shredded vegetables over the sauce. Add 2 olives and 2 capers, one on each corner of the dough. Keep placing the rest of the fillings as in a collage: 1 tsp vine fruit, 1 prune, 2 tsp pickles, 1 tsp chickpeas, 3 cubes of mock duck, 1 asparagus, 2 strips of grilled pepper, and some leaves of parsley.

Wrap the filling with the banana leaf (not against the veins). Fold the foil to seal the ends of the banana leaf packet. Then, fold the foil to wrap the whole packet. Tie it with kitchen string. Repeat for the rest of the dough.
Boil the hallacas in a covered pot of water for 20–30 minutes. You may have to do this in batches unless you have a huge cauldron.
Drain the hallacas and let them cool for 10 hours. Store them in the fridge or freezer if desired.
Reheat the hallacas in boiling water, simmering for 10 minutes before eat them. Enjoy your meal!

name: Halo-Halo (Filipino Layered Dessert)
attribution: "Halo-Halo (Filipino Layered Dessert)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Halo-Halo_(Filipino_Layered_Dessert), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup red mung beans in syrup
⅓ cup nata de coco (coconut gel in syrup)
1 tbsp ube jam (sweet purple yam paste)

steps: Cover the bottoms of two serving bowls or glasses with a layer of shaved ice.
Top the ice with the chickpeas, mung beans, nata de coco, kaong, and ube jam.
Top with ube ice cream and leche flan, then pour the evaporated milk over everything.
Sprinkle with pinipig, if using.

name: Ham and Cheese Crepes
attribution: "Ham and Cheese Crepes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ham_and_Cheese_Crepes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In small bowl, combine cheese, onion, salt, pepper, sour cream, and mustard.
Lay one slice of ham on each crêpe.
Spread about 1 tbsp of the mixture over each ham slice.
Roll up crêpes, and arrange in 13x9-inch baking pan.
Combine melted butter and bread crumbs, and sprinkle over crepes.
Cover pan loosely with foil.
Bake for 15–20 minutes at 350°F.

name: Ham Sauce (Historic)
attribution: "Ham Sauce (Historic)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ham_Sauce_(Historic), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 dessert spoons Musca or sweet port

steps: Cut up ham, and pound it in a mortar.
Add the port or Musca, vinegar, a little dried basil, and a pinch of spice.
Bring mixture to a boil, then pass through a sieve and warm it up in a bain-marie.
Serve with roast meats.

name: Ham Sauce (Modern)
attribution: "Ham Sauce (Modern)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ham_Sauce_(Modern), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3–4 oz ham or prosciutto, cut into strips

steps: Melt butter in small saucepan, and gently sauté the strips of meat.
Stir in tomato purée.
Add stock and simmer for about 5 minutes.
Serve over rice or toss with pasta.

name: Hamburger
attribution: "Hamburger" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hamburger, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Vegetables (lettuce, sprouts, tomato, onion etc; optional)

steps: Shape the ground beef by hand into burger patties. You should get between 4–6 burgers from 500 g (1.1 lb) of beef.

If adding optional ingredients, either season the outside or mix into the beef before forming the patties. Overworking the beef will result in mushy meat that won't stick together, so only mix the minimum necessary and do so by hand.

Pan-fry or grill the patties for about 4–5 minutes on each side for burgers that aren't too thick. Ensure your burgers are fully cooked through before serving. If your burgers are quite thick or if you are unsure, you can cut one open to ensure the insides are browned. If the insides are red, there is a chance that the meat is not fully cooked. Alternately, you can insert a meat thermometer into the center of the burger, if the temperature reads less than 71°C (160°F), your burger is undercooked.
Let the burger rest for several minutes before serving to let the juices cool down and not burst out at first bite.
Serve each burger on a bun, optionally with relish, sliced pickles, ketchup, mayonnaise, mustard, ranch dressing, cheese, lettuce, tomatoes and/or onions.

name: Hamburger Buns
attribution: "Hamburger Buns" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hamburger_Buns, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ stick / 2 tablespoons / 30 g Butter, room temperature
1 packet / 1 scant tablespoon / 7 g Yeast (weight given for active dry yeast)
¾–1 cup (6–8 fl oz) / 170–225 g Warm water (see notes)
Mixing spoon, such as a wooden spoon

Baking sheet, such as a half-sheet pan (or other shallow, oven-proof dishes); a half-sheet (18 x 13 inches / 46 x 33 cm) or two quarter-sheets (13 x 9 inches / 33 x 23 cm) is about the right size for this recipe.

steps: Put all ingredients except the warm water into a mixing bowl. If you are using a stand mixer, fit the dough hook and turn the mixer to its lowest setting to begin stirring the ingredients together. If you are mixing by hand, give it a few strokes with a mixing spoon or spatula. The purpose of this step is to mostly distribute the yeast throughout the flour and other ingredients. Don't bother stirring it more than necessary for this step.

Pour in half to three-quarters of the warm water. Stir this water in thoroughly. If you are using a stand mixer, let it run until the dough comes together. This will probably take several minutes. At first, it may look like it will never come together, and then it will suddenly form into a smooth ball, or even into a wet, slack batter. If you are mixing by hand, you can turn the dough out onto a clean, flat surface (can be oiled or floured, as you prefer) and knead the dough by hand for up to 10 minutes, adding flour or water by the spoonful as you feel the need.

Assess the texture of the dough. If the dough seems sticky (e.g., makes a sticky mess on your fingers) and is too slack to form into a smooth, soft ball, then you need to add more flour. Start with a generous spoonful, and stir again until it is incorporated. Repeat the addition as many times as necessary (it is unlikely that you will need to add more than about ½ cup/60 g of flour). If instead there is dry flour in the bottom, then pour a little bit of the remaining warm water directly on that dry part, and mix again until the dry flour and the water have been thoroughly incorporated. If you overcorrected, then add a spoonful of flour until you get a workable texture.
Unless it's a hot day, turn on the empty, cold oven for one minute. Then turn the oven off. The purpose of this short "preheating" is to make a comfortably warm place for the dough to rise.
Cover the dough to keep the surface from drying out. You can do this by coating the surface of the dough with oil, or by putting a lid or a big plate over the dough.
Put the bowl of dough in the (now slightly warm) oven or another warm place. Double check that the oven has been turned off.
Let the dough rise for about 1 hour, until clearly puffy and almost twice the original volume. If you used cold water, it will take longer.
If you're using parchment paper, place a piece of parchment on your baking sheet. Otherwise, you can lightly grease the pan to keep the buns from sticking.
Sprinkle a big spoonful of flour on your work surface, and spread this out a bit.
Remove the bowl of dough from the oven. Scrape the puffy dough onto your floured work surface.

Roll the dough in the flour to lightly coat all sides with the flour. If needed, put more flour on your work surface to keep it from sticking. Roll the dough into a rough log shape. Use a sharp knife or a bench scraper to cut the dough into about 12 pieces of similar size.

Pick up one piece. Dust the wet edges in the remaining flour on your work surface, so it won't stick to your fingers. Choose one of the smoother sides of that piece to be the "top" of your roll. Grab the edges around your chosen "top" surface, and stretch or pinch them back to the "bottom". This has the effect of stretching the smooth side and hiding any lumpy bits on the bottom. Pinch the lumpy bits together on the bottom. Flatten the bun between your hands, and put it pinched-side-down on your baking sheet.

Repeat this for the other eleven pieces of dough, until all of the pieces are shaped. When you place the rolls on the baking sheet, leave about an inch or two in between them, so they have room to grow in the oven.

Place the baking sheet with the shaped buns back in the barely warm oven. Leave it there for about 45 minutes or an hour to "proof". If your oven has cooled off while you were shaping the buns, you can warm it up again for 30 seconds or so, but be sure to turn it off before you put the pan of raw dough in the oven.
When the buns look nicely puffy, take the baking sheet of raw dough out of the oven.
Preheat the empty oven to 375 °F (190 °C, gas mark 5, moderately hot).
When it is hot, put the proofed buns in the oven and bake for 12–15 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve hot, warm, or at room temperature.

name: Hamburger Deluxe
attribution: "Hamburger Deluxe" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hamburger_Deluxe, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¾ lb (350 g) lean ground beef
1 tablespoon (15 ml) grapeseed oil (or other lightly flavoured oil)
1 tablespoon (15 ml) chipotle BBQ Sauce, or a healthy pinch of chipotle powder
Cheese, smoked cheddar is best, but any cheddar or your favourite cheese will do
1 Vidalia onion, coarsely chopped (Spanish onion will do)
¼ pound (110 g) button mushrooms, sliced thin
Fresh ground black pepper to taste

steps: Sauté onions and mushrooms in butter until lightly brown, then set aside.
Mix all of the hamburger ingredients together until well-mixed, and let rest for 15 minutes.
Heat grill to medium-high.
Divide hamburger mix into 4 equal balls.
Form patties by slapping the burgers back and forth from one palm to the other until they are about an inch thick.
Grill burgers to desired doneness, turning every few minutes and adding cheese after the last flipping of the burgers
Serve on the buns, with the onion/mushroom mixture, a dollop of sour cream, and a thin slice of cream cheese.

name: Hamburger Fried Rice
attribution: "Hamburger Fried Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hamburger_Fried_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 cloves red onion, sliced 0.5 cm thick
