steps: Heat the canola oil in a non-stick frying pan. When the oil is very hot, fry the garlic, red onion, ginger, and red chillies. Stir every 20 seconds until fragrant.
Add the hamburger meat, and cook until the meat browns and is cooked through.
Add the celery and scallion. Add the rice, salt, black pepper, and black soy sauce. Cook until well mixed and heated through.
Serve hot.

name: Hamburger Skillet Dinner
attribution: "Hamburger Skillet Dinner" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hamburger_Skillet_Dinner, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup uncooked pasta, such as macaroni, elbows, or wagon wheels

steps: Boil pasta in 4–6 cups salted, oiled water until al dente. Drain.
While pasta is cooking, sprinkle a 10-inch (25 cm) skillet with garlic salt and minced onion, and brown beef.
Add tomato soup and cook a minute or two.
Stir in drained pasta.

name: Hamburger Stoup
attribution: "Hamburger Stoup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hamburger_Stoup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Fry the onions in a skillet with a dash of oil until the onions are translucent.
Add the ground beef to the onions. Cook, breaking the meat up, until browned.
Combine meat mixture and remaining ingredients in a large stockpot. Add enough water to cover everything by a few inches (usually about 2 cups).
Place pot in a 325°F oven, and bake for 6 hours.
If using pasta, stir in after removing from the oven.

name: Hard Tack
attribution: "Hard Tack" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hard_Tack, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix all the ingredients into a dough and press onto a greased cookie sheet to a thickness of ½ inch.
Bake in a preheated oven at 400°F (205°C) for half an hour. Don't cut now.
Remove from oven, and cut dough into 3-inch squares. Punch four rows of holes, four holes per row into the dough (a fork works nicely).
Flip the crackers and return to the oven for another half hour.

name: Hartshorne Catsup for Sea-stores
attribution: "Hartshorne Catsup for Sea-stores" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hartshorne_Catsup_for_Sea-stores, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 quarts large mushroom flaps, rubbed to pieces

steps: Combine the beer, anchovies, shallots, mace, cloves, peppercorns, ginger, and mushrooms in a pot. Let simmer until reduced by half.
Strain through cloth, and cool.

name: Hartshorne Catsup for Sea-stores II
attribution: "Hartshorne Catsup for Sea-stores II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hartshorne_Catsup_for_Sea-stores_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine anchovies, shallots, horseradish, mace, wine, water, lemon, anchovy liquor, cloves, and peppercorns in a saucepan.
Boil until reduced to 1 quart, then strain and cool.

name: Hartshorne Cream Sauce for a Hare
attribution: "Hartshorne Cream Sauce for a Hare" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hartshorne_Cream_Sauce_for_a_Hare, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Run the cream over the hare or venison just before frothing it, and catch it in a dish
Boil the cream up with the yolks, onion, and a piece of butter rolled in flour and salt.

name: Hartshorne Sweet Sauce
attribution: "Hartshorne Sweet Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hartshorne_Sweet_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.
Simmer for 15 minutes.

name: Hash Browns
attribution: "Hash Browns" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hash_Browns, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Cooking oil (canola is good—see smoke point information)

steps: Grate the raw potatoes with a cheese grater, place them into a bowl and cover completely with water. Let sit for 10 minutes.
Drain the grated potatoes well; if this is not done thoroughly the potatoes will steam instead of fry.
Mix in chopped onions by hand.
Mix the egg OR flour into the hash brown mixture evenly. This will allow the hash browns to stay together when frying.
Place a large frying pan on medium-high heat and add enough oil to provide a thin coating over the entire bottom of the pan.

When the oil has come up to temperature apply a large handful of potatoes to the pan and reshape into a patty that is about ¼–½ inch (6–12 mm) thick. The thinner the patty, the crispier the hash browns will be throughout.
Flip when they are crisp and brown on the cooking side. They should also stick together nicely before they are flipped. This should take about 5–8 minutes.
The hash browns are done when the new side is brown and crispy. This should take another 3–5 minutes.

name: Hashbrown Casserole
attribution: "Hashbrown Casserole" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hashbrown_Casserole, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup melted butter (you can omit this to save calories and reduce the fat content)
1 cup corn flakes cereal tossed with 1 tablespoon melted butter for topping

steps: Combine all ingredients except cornflakes in a large bowl.
Transfer the mixture to an 11x13-inch glass baking dish.
Sprinkle the corn flake mixture on top.
Bake at 350°F for 40 minutes. It's done when it is all bubbly and a little bit browned on top.

name: Hasude (Albanian Cornstarch Pudding)
attribution: "Hasude (Albanian Cornstarch Pudding)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hasude_(Albanian_Cornstarch_Pudding), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Melt butter in pot over medium-high heat. Gradually mix in the cornstarch.
Once all the cornstarch is added, cook until the mass becomes yellow. Sweeten with some sugar.
Separately prepare a syrup using the remaining sugar and water.
After it is done cooking, shape the mass using a spoon or plastic shapes, and pour the syrup on top.

name: Haupia (Hawaiian Coconut Pudding)
attribution: "Haupia (Hawaiian Coconut Pudding)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Haupia_(Hawaiian_Coconut_Pudding), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix coconut milk with sugar and salt over a medium heat.
Slowly add cornstarch and stir until thickened.
Pour into a pan or square form.
Cool for 1 hour or until fully set.
Unmold and cut into squares.

name: Hawthorn Tea
attribution: "Hawthorn Tea" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hawthorn_Tea, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 one small sprig rosemary (just the leaves)
1 one small sprig sage (just the leaves)

steps: Combine the water, tea bag, rosemary, sage, and ginger. Boil briefly, then remove from heat and let steep for 5–10 minutes.
Filter the tea to remove solids, and mix in the sugar and the lemon juice.
Cool and serve.

name: Hazelnut and Black Raspberry Panna Cotta
attribution: "Hazelnut and Black Raspberry Panna Cotta" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hazelnut_and_Black_Raspberry_Panna_Cotta, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat all ingredients in a saucepan over medium-low heat until gelatin is melted.
Pour into ramekins, and chill until set (usually 6 hours, but they are better left overnight).
Serve with fresh berries or a berry sauce.

name: Hazelnut Cream Soda
attribution: "Hazelnut Cream Soda" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hazelnut_Cream_Soda, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Serve cold over ice.

name: Hearty Beef Vegetable Soup
attribution: "Hearty Beef Vegetable Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hearty_Beef_Vegetable_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pound beef round steak, cut into ¾-inch cubes

steps: In a 4-quart saucepan over medium-high heat, brown beef in margarine.
Add onion; cook until tender.
Stir in beef broth, water, celery, and basil; bring to a boil.
Cover; reduce heat and simmer 1 hour.
Add tomatoes, carrots, noodles; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 25 minutes.
Stir in spinach; cook 5 minutes more.

name: Heinz Burger Sauce
attribution: "Heinz Burger Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Heinz_Burger_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Let sit for 30 minutes to allow flavors to blend together.

name: Henry Thiele's Pancake
attribution: "Henry Thiele's Pancake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Henry_Thiele's_Pancake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 500°F.
Combine milk, salt, and sugar. Mix in flour gradually. Mix in eggs.
For each pancake, melt 2 Tbsp butter in a pan. Pour about 1¼ cups batter into melted butter. While batter is frying gather up the batter in some places to make ridges.
When batter is consistency of medium scrambled eggs, put into oven for 5 minutes.
Remove from oven; flip pancake in pan; replace into oven for another 2.5 minutes.
Remove from oven; add generous amount of lemon juice and small amount maple syrup. Roll pancake into a cigar shape. Add lemon juice, maple syrup, and powdered sugar in that order. Eat.

name: Herb Biscuits
attribution: "Herb Biscuits" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Herb_Biscuits, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¾ cup / 90 g / 49% Whole wheat flour
½ cup plus 2 tablespoons / 153 g / 83.33% Skim milk

steps: Preheat oven to 450 °F. Have an ungreased baking sheet ready.
In a large bowl, combine both flours, baking powder, salt, and spices. Mix well.
Add margarine, and mix with a fork or pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add milk. Stir until dry ingredients are moistened.
Place dough on a floured surface and knead a few times just until dough holds together in a ball. Add a small amount of flour if dough is sticky.
Roll dough or press with your hands to ½-inch thickness. Using a 3-inch biscuit cutter or a glass, cut out 8 biscuits. Scraps can be put together and rolled again.
Place biscuits on baking sheet. Bake 10 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Remove to a wire rack. Serve hot.

name: Herb Bubble Bread
attribution: "Herb Bubble Bread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Herb_Bubble_Bread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Measure all ingredients for the dough into the bread pan. Set your bread machine to the dough setting.
Remove dough after it's finished mixing in the bread machine.
In a small bowl, combine the herb mixture in the order listed.
Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Divide the dough into 12–16 equal parts and shape into balls.
Roll each ball into the herb mixture and arrange in greased loaf pan.
Cover with a cloth and let rise in a draft-free place until doubled (about 30 minutes).
Bake for 25–30 minutes or until brown.

name: Herbal Energy Drink
attribution: "Herbal Energy Drink" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Herbal_Energy_Drink, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine the lemon and orange zests with the sugar, rubbing the sugar into the peels to extract the oils. Let this mixture rest in the fridge for 24 hours to infuse.
Bring the water to a boil, then stir in the sugar-zest mixture, lemon juice, licorice root, ginger, and ginseng. Boil until you get a thick syrup.
Strain the syrup and discard the solids. This should yield approximately 5 oz (150 ml) syrup.
Mix the caffeine, B vitamin complex, and taurine into the syrup.
To make the final energy drink, mix 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

name: Herbal Iced Tea
attribution: "Herbal Iced Tea" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Herbal_Iced_Tea, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Sweeten the rosehip tea with the honey and allow to chill.
Add orange juice and orange flower extract.
Divide the lime and lemon between 4 large glasses, and add the tea.
Serve ice-cold.

name: Herbed Corn
attribution: "Herbed Corn" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Herbed_Corn, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 7 ears sweet corn, husks and silks carefully removed

steps: Combine all ingredients except corn in small bowl. Mix well.
Measure about 1 tablespoon of the mixture and spread over each ear of corn.
Wrap each ear of corn in heavy foil.
Grill over medium heat 10–15 minutes, or until tender.

name: Herbed Tomato Soup
attribution: "Herbed Tomato Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Herbed_Tomato_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tablespoon fresh snipped basil (or 1 teaspoon dried)
1 teaspoon fresh snipped thyme (or ¼ teaspoon dried)
4–6 fresh basil leaves (optional), sliced thinly into strips

steps: In a 2-quart saucepan, sauté onion in olive oil until tender but not browned.
Add tomatoes, broth, tomato sauce, basil, thyme and pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in vinegar, if desired, just prior to serving.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with basil strips.

name: Hermits
attribution: "Hermits" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hermits, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ⅔ cup (65 g) seedless raisins (a handful more if you like them)
⅔ cup (120 g) packed dark brown sugar

steps: Preheat oven to 375°F/190°C.
Line a sheet pan with parchment paper.

In a large bowl, stir together flour, raisins, brown sugar, ginger, cinnamon, cloves, baking powder, and salt until well combined; watch the brown sugar to ensure that it doesn't clump—it will want to do so and brown sugar clumps coated in flour look a lot like raisins coated in flour.
Stir in molasses, butter, vanilla, and egg until fully integrated. Shape the dough in two strips (approximately 6 x) separated by at least 1.5 in on the sheet pan.
Bake for 12–15 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the strips comes out dry.

Allow to cool slightly then remove the hermits (on their parchment) to cooling racks to cool completely; be sure the bottoms have cooled (just reach under and feel—if its more than a little warmer than room temperature its not there yet).

Move the hermits (still on their parchment) to a counter for portioning and removal from parchment. Cut hermits into 1.5 in wide strips (a pizza cutter should work well) then carefully scrape them away from the parchment with a good thin spatula.
Enjoy with a glass of milk or a nice cup of tea.

name: Herrencreme (German Custard Dessert)
attribution: "Herrencreme (German Custard Dessert)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Herrencreme_(German_Custard_Dessert), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 packets (88 g) German custard powder (e.g. Dr. Oetker)

steps: Combine milk, sugar, salt, and custard powder in a saucepan. Cook, stirring, over medium heat until it has thickened.
Place a sheet of cling film on the surface of the pudding to prevent a skin from forming, and let cool completely.
Transfer the pudding to a bowl. Stir in rum and chocolate to taste.
Fold in the whipped cream.
Chill in fridge for about 2 hours.
Serve.

name: Herring Soup
attribution: "Herring Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Herring_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Salt, pepper, vinegar, and herbs, to taste

steps: Combine water and barley meal.
Boil it to the consistency of a thick jelly.
Season it with salt, pepper, vinegar, sweet herbs. Add the herring meat.

name: Hickory BBQ Chicken Wings
attribution: "Hickory BBQ Chicken Wings" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hickory_BBQ_Chicken_Wings, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 24 chicken wings, tips removed, cut in half at the joint
2 ½ quarts peanut or canola oil

steps: Combine sauce and liquid smoke. Set aside.
Season chicken evenly with seasoning. Set aside.
Heat oil to 350°F. Add chicken, and working in batches, deep fry for 10–12 minutes or golden brown, crisp, and cooked through to 165°F.
Remove chicken and drain on a cooling rack.
Toss with sauce mixture. Serve warm with blue cheese dressing.

name: Hickory BBQ Rub
attribution: "Hickory BBQ Rub" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hickory_BBQ_Rub, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients in an airtight container with a shaker lid.
Keep in a cool, dark place for up to 2 years.

name: Hickory Maple Glazed Wings
attribution: "Hickory Maple Glazed Wings" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hickory_Maple_Glazed_Wings, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 36 chicken wingettes or 18 whole chicken wings, tips removed and halved
Maple syrup as needed plus 6 tbsp

steps: Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Dip chicken in maple syrup, then dredge in cornmeal.
Heat oil to 350°F, add chicken pieces, and deep fry for 12 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack.
Combine 6 tbsp maple syrup with remaining ingredients. Add wings and toss to coat. Serve.

name: High-Protein Pancakes
attribution: "High-Protein Pancakes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:High-Protein_Pancakes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup (30 g) vanilla-flavored protein powder
½ ea. (50 g) peeled small-to-medium-size ripe banana

steps: Grind the oats for 10–15 seconds in the food processor to make a powder.
Combine the ground oats in a mixing bowl with the protein powder, coconut flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt.
Mash the banana in another mixing bowl, then whisk in the egg and milk until well-combined.
Fold in the dry mixture to form a thick batter.
Heat a thin layer butter or oil in a frying pan over low to medium heat.
Scoop ladlefuls of batter onto the pan, working in batches as needed.
Cook the pancakes for 3–4 minutes until small bubbles appear on top.
Flip the pancakes, then cook for another 1–2 minutes.
Transfer the pancakes to plates, and repeat the cooking process with any remaining batter.
Serve with toppings.

name: Hilbah (Fenugreek Condiment)
attribution: "Hilbah (Fenugreek Condiment)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hilbah_(Fenugreek_Condiment), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 lemon or citric acid to taste
1 tbsp zḥug (hot sauce made from red peppers, garlic, coriander leaves, etc.)

steps: Soak ground fenugreek in the water for 3 hours until expanded.
Beat with a spatula until paste becomes light and frothy. Gradually add more water if necessary.
Mix in coriander leaves and leeks.
Mix in salt, lemon juice, and zḥug.
Mix in grated tomato if using.

name: Hlib Tmer (Algerian Date Milk)
attribution: "Hlib Tmer (Algerian Date Milk)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hlib_Tmer_(Algerian_Date_Milk), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Remove the seeds from the dates and check if there are any worms inside them.
Boil the dates with water and sugar for a few minutes until you feel the dates are well-cooked.
Turn off the heat, blend the date mixture, and strain it as well as possible.
Pour the resulting date syrup into your cup of milk.

name: Hobo Burgers
attribution: "Hobo Burgers" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hobo_Burgers, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix Worcestershire sauce into beef.
Cut four large sheets of heavy duty aluminium foil and place a cabbage leaf onto the shiny side of each one.
Shape beef into 4 patties and place onto cabbage leaves.
Top each portion with onion and potato slices, add a pat of butter, and season with salt and pepper.
Wrap another cabbage leaf around the top of each portion and seal each package.
Place on medium-hot coals for about 20–30 minutes, turning twice (carefully) while cooking.
Discard cabbage leaves if they become charred during cooking.

name: Hogao (Colombian Scallion Tomato Sauce)
attribution: "Hogao (Colombian Scallion Tomato Sauce)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hogao_(Colombian_Scallion_Tomato_Sauce), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat oil in a medium frying pan.
Add scallions, and fry 5 minutes over medium heat.
Add tomato, allspice, bouillon, salt, and pepper. Let cook over low heat for 10 minutes.

name: Holiday Cake (Spiced Fruitcake Loaf)
attribution: "Holiday Cake (Spiced Fruitcake Loaf)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Holiday_Cake_(Spiced_Fruitcake_Loaf), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut dates and cherries into small pieces and soak them in cherry juice overnight.
Preheat oven to 250°F (120˚C).
Cream butter, add half of the sugar. Beat until fluffy.
In another bowl beat egg yolks until thick. Add remaining sugar.
Combine the two mixtures and beat together.
Sift together flour, salt, baking powder, and spices.
Add dry ingredients and milk alternately to wet mixture, beating well after each addition.
Fold in stiffly-beaten egg whites.
Add in fruit and nuts dredged lightly with flour.
Bake in lined loaf pans in slow oven for 3 hours.

name: Holiday Soda
attribution: "Holiday Soda" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Holiday_Soda, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup (120 ml) edible pine needles (preferably Douglas fir)
Peel from 3 clementine oranges (or a similar easy-to-peel variety such as tangerines)

steps: Wash the pine needle branch and clementines.
Remove the pine needles from the branches and peel the clementines.

Mix the pine needles and clementine peels with the sugar in a container, and let this sit in the fridge for 24 hours. The sugar will extract the liquid from the citrus peels and produce a syrupy liquid.
Boil the cinnamon sticks, cloves, and cardamom pods in the water.
Pour the warm water with boiled spices into the container with pine needles and peels.
Mix the ingredients together and strain the mixture.
To make the finished soda, mix 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

name: Holland Tea Cakes
attribution: "Holland Tea Cakes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Holland_Tea_Cakes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Colored sugar or nuts for topping

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Mix the butter and sugar until completely combined. Mix in the egg yolk, then the flour and cinnamon (preferably by hand, though this all can be done in a mixer if you want).
Pour batter into a cookie pan. Use the palm of your hand to spread and smooth it over the whole pan (this is the hardest part).
Brush on leftover egg white. Scatter your desired toppings evenly over the batter.
Bake in preheated oven until cookies are golden brown (about 20 minutes). Remove, and let cool slightly.
Before they get too cool, cut them into small 1-inch (2.5 cm) squares.

name: Holzknechtnocken (Austrian Boiled Dumplings)
attribution: "Holzknechtnocken (Austrian Boiled Dumplings)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Holzknechtnocken_(Austrian_Boiled_Dumplings), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix flour and salt in a large bowl and add water. Knead until you get a dough.
Form dumplings and add them to a pot of boiling water. When dumplings rise to the surface of the water, they are done.
Melt lard in a heavy-bottomed skillet with deep sides. Add dumplings, and fry until they are golden.
Serve with sauerkraut or steamed apples.
Ebenseer Fotoklub. Brauchtum in Ebensee. Ed. Traudl Neubacher. 1987.
http://www.salzkammergut.at/de/5-05-5-33116/detail/salzkammergut.html
http://www.rundschau.co.at/lokales/artikel/2008/01/23/aich-bin-der-holzknechtnocken-sigia (interview with Holzknechtnocken-Sigi)
http://www.hallstatt.net/publisher/articleview/action/view/frmArticleID/220/ (website of the lumberjacks’ museum in Bad Goisern)
http://www.brauchtumsseiten.de/a-z/f/fetzenumzug/home.html (more about ancient customs in Ebensee)
http://www.brauchtumsseiten.de/a-z/g/gloeckerllaufen/home.html (more information on the Glöcklerlauf)

name: Holzknechtnocken with Strawberry Curd au Gratin
attribution: "Holzknechtnocken with Strawberry Curd au Gratin" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Holzknechtnocken_with_Strawberry_Curd_au_Gratin, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups (500 g) strawberries, washed and stemmed
1 cup (250 g) curd cheese (e.g. quark or farmer cheese)

steps: In a large bowl, mix together flour, salt, oil, and hot water. Knead until you get a dough.
Divide dough into 8 pieces. Flatten each piece, and wrap around a single whole strawberry. Pinch shut to form a dumpling.
Boil dumplings for 5–7 minutes in salted water. Coat in melted butter.
Cut remaining strawberries into pieces. Toss with sugar and lemon juice.
Beat together the butter, lemon zest, vanilla sugar, and confectioners’ sugar until creamy. Mix in egg yolks, curd cheese, and crème fraîche.
Whip cream with sugar. Fold the whipped cream into the butter-cheese mixture.
Whip the egg whites to stiff peaks, and fold into the above mixture.
Preheat the oven to 200°C
Arrange some strawberries on oven-safe plates. Top with some of the cheese mixture, then a few dumplings on top and sprinkle with sugar.
Place plates in the oven, and bake until golden.

name: Home Fries
attribution: "Home Fries" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Home_Fries, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 medium potatoes (e.g., russet or Yukon gold), peeled and diced

steps: Boil diced potatoes in salted water for 5 minutes to soften slightly. Drain and let them dry.
Heat oil or butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Add onions (and peppers if using), sauté until translucent.
Add the potatoes in a single layer. Let them brown undisturbed for 5–6 minutes.
Flip and cook the other sides until golden and crispy.
Season with salt, pepper, and paprika. Serve hot.

name: Homemade Applesauce
attribution: "Homemade Applesauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Homemade_Applesauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 pounds (1300 g / about 8 cups) peeled, cored, and chopped apples
½ teaspoon ground cinnamon or apple pie spice

steps: Put chopped apples in a large non-stick saucepan. Stir in water, sugar, sugar substitute, and lemon juice.
Bring mixture to a boil, cover, and reduce heat to medium-low.
Cook until apples are tender (about 10 minutes).
Use a potato masher to break cooked apples up into a nice purée.
Stir in ground cinnamon or apple pie spice.
Serve warm or cold.

name: Homemade Baharat
attribution: "Homemade Baharat" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Homemade_Baharat, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Finely grind all the ingredients using a mill or spice grinder. Mix well.
To intensify the taste, fry the powder in butter before use.

name: Homemade Biscuit Mix
attribution: "Homemade Biscuit Mix" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Homemade_Biscuit_Mix, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Blend together dry ingredients.
Cut in shortening with a pastry blender to make mixture as granular as possible.
Use in recipes like you would use Bisquick©.

name: Homemade Cider Vinegar
attribution: "Homemade Cider Vinegar" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Homemade_Cider_Vinegar, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Two 3-liter (0.8 US gallon) fermenters (can be large bottles or food-grade plastic buckets)
Food-grade siphon hose (from hardware store or homebrew shop)

steps: Wash the apples to remove obvious dirt, and cut out any bruised or bird-struck bits.
Crush the apples, or put them through a juice maker, and collect the juice in one of the fermenters.

Cover the fermenter with a cloth, or plug the opening with cotton wool if narrow, to keep out dust and insects. Don't worry that the fermenter isn't full, as it should be for making hard cider. With vinegar, air space is good, as it brings oxygen to the bacteria.

Set aside somewhere to ferment not too warm or too cool (about 18–22 °C / 64–72 °F). It should start getting bubbly within a couple of days. Note the progress, so that you can tell when fermentation has peaked and is slowing down.

When the fermentation is slowing down and not bubbling so vigorously, siphon into the other fermenter carefully. Try not to get too much of the gunk that has settled to the bottom, or the froth on top—the aim is to get a clear cider without too many floating chunks!

Set the second fermenter aside to ferment for two to three months. After a while, you should see a white film forming on top. Don't despair—this is the vinegar mother, a structure built by the vinegar-making bacteria (acetobacter).
After a couple of months, you can draw off two thirds of the vinegar for use, and top up with fresh, clear cider made in the first fermenter.

name: Homemade Fines Herbes
attribution: "Homemade Fines Herbes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Homemade_Fines_Herbes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients together.
Use as directed in your recipe.

name: Homemade Five-Spice Powder
attribution: "Homemade Five-Spice Powder" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Homemade_Five-Spice_Powder, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Toast the Szechuan peppercorns in a dry frying pan for about 3 minutes.
Grind the peppercorns in a pepper grinder or coffee grinder together with the star anise pods.
Sift the ground spices to remove any larger bits.
Mix together the cloves, cinnamon, and fennel seeds.
Grind the completed mixture until it is a very fine powder.
Use sparingly, as it is extremely pungent.

name: Homemade Garam Masala
attribution: "Homemade Garam Masala" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Homemade_Garam_Masala, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 20 sticks cinnamon, about 2.5 cm in length

steps: Individually toast all the whole spices and herbs in a dry skillet over low heat, shaking, until a shade darker and aromatic. Make sure not to burn.
Remove from the heat, transfer to a cool container, and let cool.
Using a grinder, blender, or mortar, grind/pound all the herbs and spices together to make an even powder.

name: Homemade Ketchup
attribution: "Homemade Ketchup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Homemade_Ketchup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup (120 g) white granulated sugar

steps: Scald tomatoes, and press through a coarse sieve to remove seeds and skins. Let cool.
Measure out 1 gallon (3.8 litres) of tomato pulp, and combine with the remaining ingredients. Let simmer slowly for 3 hours.
Pour hot ketchup into hot sterilized 1-pint jars and seal. Process for 15 minutes in boiling water bath.

name: Hominy Bread
attribution: "Hominy Bread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hominy_Bread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
In a large bowl combine grits, cornmeal, baking powder, salt, butter, and sugar.
In another bowl beat 2 eggs thoroughly, then add milk and mix together completely.
Add egg and milk mixture to dry ingredients.
Grease a large baking dish or 2 loaf pans. Pour mixture into pan(s).
Bake in preheated oven for 35 minutes, until golden brown and a knife inserted in the bread comes out clean.

name: Hominy Grits
attribution: "Hominy Grits" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hominy_Grits, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tablespoon honey, brown sugar, or maple syrup (optional)

steps: Bring water to a rapid boil in a saucepan.
Gradually stir in the hominy grits.
Reduce heat to low.
Stir in the butter.
Cook for 20 minutes, or until the water is absorbed.
If desired, sweeten with honey, brown sugar, maple syrup, or jelly.
Serve while hot.

name: Honey Apple Glazed Pork
attribution: "Honey Apple Glazed Pork" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Honey_Apple_Glazed_Pork, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F (about 165°C).
Mix together pepper, flour, mustard, sage, and salt to get a rub.
Apply rub to pork roast and set aside.
Line a roasting pan with foil and spray with cooking spray.
Place roast in pan and bake for 30 minutes.
Mix together applesauce, cinnamon, honey, and nutmeg as a glaze.
Remove roast from oven and spread with glaze.
Return glazed roast to oven and bake until you get an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C), about 50–60 minutes.

name: Honey BBQ Hot Wings
attribution: "Honey BBQ Hot Wings" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Honey_BBQ_Hot_Wings, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Sprinkle wings with salt and black pepper.
Heat oil to 350°F (175°C).
Deep fry wings in batches for 11–12 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack.
Combine liquid ingredients except for oil.
Bring to a boil over medium high heat until reduced to 10 Tbsp.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes.
Toss wings with sauce; serve warm.

name: Honey Bourbon Marinade
attribution: "Honey Bourbon Marinade" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Honey_Bourbon_Marinade, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a mason jar or a gallon-size zip-top bag.
Refrigerate for up to 2 weeks.

name: Honey Garlic Chicken
attribution: "Honey Garlic Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Honey_Garlic_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Chop chicken into small pieces.
Coat frying pan with a thin layer of olive oil.
Add chicken pieces to frying pan.
Cover the chicken with honey and add garlic.
Cook over medium heat until the mixture thickens and darkens and the chicken is cooked. Don't let it go on too long or the sauce can burn.

name: Honey Lime Chicken Wings
attribution: "Honey Lime Chicken Wings" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Honey_Lime_Chicken_Wings, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Dip chicken in beaten eggs. Season liberally with poultry shake.
Dredge chicken in cornmeal. Let rest 2–3 minutes.
Deep fry in batches at 350°F (175°C) for 11–12 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack.
Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients in a large nonreactive bowl. Add wings and toss to coat. Serve warm.

name: Honey Mug Cake
attribution: "Honey Mug Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Honey_Mug_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine the flour, yeast, and baking powder in a bowl.
Add honey, and mix until incorporated.
Add a small amount of water, and until incorporated.
Add lemon juice and zest, and mix until the batter is smooth.
Pour the batter into a mug, and microwave for 60–90 seconds. To check if it's thoroughly cooked through, stick a toothpick in; if it comes out clean, it is ready.
Serve with any of the optional toppings.

name: Honey Mustard Salad Dressing
attribution: "Honey Mustard Salad Dressing" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Honey_Mustard_Salad_Dressing, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ teaspoon (7.5 ml) freshly-ground black pepper

steps: Combine the mustard, honey, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Gradually whisk the safflower oil into the mixture to form a creamy dressing.

name: Honey Mustard Salmon
attribution: "Honey Mustard Salmon" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Honey_Mustard_Salmon, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F/180°C.
Wash and pat dry the salmon fillet. Remove the pin bones (if there are any), and cut salmon into portions if desired.
Mix honey and mustard, and adjust mixture to taste.
Spread mixture generously over and under the salmon.
Cook in oven on top rack for about 15–18 minutes (depending on how you like your salmon cooked).
Finish under broiler for 2–3 minutes, but remove before glaze starts to char.

name: Honey-Peppered Salmon
attribution: "Honey-Peppered Salmon" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Honey-Peppered_Salmon, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: In a shallow dish, combine oil, honey, mustard, garlic, cayenne, coriander, lemon juice, and salt. Mix well.
Add salmon and let marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350°F (175˚C).
Grease a baking dish.
Remove salmon from marinade and place in the prepared dish.
Bake for 10–12 minutes or until desired "doneness".

name: Hongshao Rou (Red Braised Pork Belly)
attribution: "Hongshao Rou (Red Braised Pork Belly)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hongshao_Rou_(Red_Braised_Pork_Belly), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: In a medium saucepan, over high heat, heat the oil and sugar together until the sugar melts and turns brown.
Add the cubed pork to the sugar and oil and brown all over.
Reduce the heat, add the stock, ginger, star anise, soy sauce, and Shaoxing wine to the pan.
Cover tightly and simmer for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent it burning at the bottom.
Remove the lid and add the spring onions.
Boil the sauce until only a thick, dark gravy is left.
The dish may be served now, but if possible, refrigerate for a day to allow the flavours to develop.
Serve with rice, garnish with sliced spring onion.

name: Hoppin John
attribution: "Hoppin John" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hoppin_John, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 packs long grain rice (3–4 cups cooked)
3 jalapeños, seeded and diced (about ½ cup)

steps: Brown bacon in large Dutch oven, remove, and reserve 2 tablespoons of grease in pan.
Add onion, celery, and bell pepper, and sauté 5 minutes.
Add rice and seasoning packet, water, and black-eyed peas; cover and simmer 25 minutes.
Add bacon and jalapeños, cover and heat 5–10 minutes more.

name: Hopping John with Pinto or Great Northern Beans
attribution: "Hopping John with Pinto or Great Northern Beans" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hopping_John_with_Pinto_or_Great_Northern_Beans, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Wash the beans well and soak overnight in water to cover.
In the morning add 2 cups more water. Simmer until tender.
Fry the salt pork until crisp, remove from the fat, and add to the beans.
Brown the onion in the salt pork fat.
Mix all the ingredients, and add salt and pepper to taste.
Continue cooking for 10 minutes.
And serve at once.

name: Hot and Sour Soup
attribution: "Hot and Sour Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hot_and_Sour_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 cups chicken stock or broth (or 4 cups water and 4 chicken bouillon cubes)
⅓ cup cooked shredded chicken or pork
½ cup canned bamboo shoots, julienned
4 ½ oz block of tofu, cut into ¼-inch dice
3 tablespoons cornstarch and 2 tablespoons cold water

steps: Bring chicken broth to a simmer in a 2-quart saucepan.
Add soy sauce, shredded meat, mushrooms and garlic chili sauce. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add black pepper, white vinegar, bamboo shoots, tofu. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Combine 3 tablespoons of cornstarch with 2 tablespoons of cold water in a cup. Stir until mixture is smooth. Add cornstarch mixture to soup and stir well.
Simmer for 5 minutes until soup is thickened.
Beat egg in a cup until yolk and white are combined. Pour beaten egg slowly, in a fine stream into soup. Stir soup several times, then wait 30 seconds.
Add green onions and sesame oil to soup. Stir well and remove from heat.
Serve hot.

name: Hot and Spicy Dip
attribution: "Hot and Spicy Dip" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hot_and_Spicy_Dip, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 eggs OR 4 soft-boiled egg yolks OR 3 oz egg substitute with lecithin
2 Tbsp sweet pickle relish or chutney

steps: Combine the eggs, lemon juice and salt in a blender. Blend briefly.
While motor is running, add oil in a slow, steady stream until the mixture has emulsified into a mayonnaise.
Transfer to a bowl and add the remaining ingredients.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

name: Hot Chocolate
attribution: "Hot Chocolate" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hot_Chocolate, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup (240 ml / 8.1 oz) milk or water

steps: Heat the milk.
While heating the milk/water put the other ingredients in a mug and mix them very well. It's best if you try to grind it a bit using a spoon.
Fill half the mug with hot milk and stir very well.
Add the remaining milk to the mixture.

name: Hot Chocolate (Orange)
attribution: "Hot Chocolate (Orange)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hot_Chocolate_(Orange), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 oz (110 g) bittersweet chocolate, chopped (can substitute semisweet)

steps: Place the milk and cinnamon in a saucepan, and gently heat to just below a simmer, about 180 F.
Add the chocolate, and stir while allowing to melt. Do not allow to come to a boil.
When the chocolate has melted, strain the chocolate milk into another container, add the extracts, and whisk or blend until frothy.
Transfer to mugs or heatproof glasses and serve.

name: Hot Chocolate with Cayenne
attribution: "Hot Chocolate with Cayenne" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hot_Chocolate_with_Cayenne, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ bar (50 g / 1.8 oz) dark chocolate bar of at least 60% cocoa (but no higher than 80%)

steps: Fill the saucepan with about 2 - 3 in of water, and place it on high heat. Set a heatproof bowl on top of the saucepan to create an improvised double boiler. Then drop bits of the chocolate bar into the bowl. The steam from the water will melt the chocolate.
Stir until it melts completely. Stir in a dash of cayenne pepper until you no longer see any specks of red.
Add a handful of marshmallows and stir until they are completely melted. Add a few more if you'd rather have a sweeter cup.
Once the mixture is smooth, stir in just a bit of milk until the mixture is again smooth. Repeat this process until you have used all the milk. Do this slowly over the course of about 4 minutes.
Turn off the heat and immediately (but carefully) pour into a large mug. Top with marshmallows.

name: Hot Cocoa
attribution: "Hot Cocoa" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hot_Cocoa, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4–5 tablespoons malted chocolate mix or Ovaltine (Ovomaltine), or dry malt extract

steps: Mix the Ovaltine and cocoa powder together.
Pound with a spoon until very fine—this will help reduce stirring time.
Shake the Ovaltine and cocoa powder for 10 seconds.
Pour the mix into the hot water. Stir well.
Top with whipped cream if desired and serve, sprinkled with cinnamon or chocolate powder, if desired.

name: Hot Cross Bun
attribution: "Hot Cross Bun" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hot_Cross_Bun, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat milk and water to lukewarm.
Crumble yeast. Mix with ½ cup (120 ml) flour. Stir in tepid milk/water and mix well.
Cover and set aside in warm place until yeast is active and frothing, about 10–15 minutes.
Mix remaining flour, sugar, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Stir egg and butter into the yeast mix, add the flour mixture and fruit. Mix well.
Put dough onto a floured surface and knead. Return to bowl, and let rise until double in bulk, about 1 hour.
Turn onto a floured surface and knead again.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Divide dough into twelve pieces and shape into buns. Mark a deep cross on the top of each bun.
Arrange on a baking tray, cover with tea towel, and let rise for 30 minutes. Bake in preheated 375°F (190°C) oven for 15 minutes or until golden brown.
Mix together flour, vegetable oil and golden syrup.
Remove buns from tray and glaze.

name: Hot Fudge Sauce
attribution: "Hot Fudge Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hot_Fudge_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 ½ cups (350 g) white granulated sugar

steps: Mix milk, sugar, cocoa and salt in a saucepan and bring to a full rolling boil.
Turn off heat and add butter and vanilla.
Let rest for a couple minutes until butter is melted. Beat with a spoon and serve.

name: Hot Pepper Sauce
attribution: "Hot Pepper Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hot_Pepper_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 Tbsp white malt vinegar (or white wine vinegar)

steps: Blend all ingredients to whatever consistency you desire.
Heat to boiling and simmer for 15–20 minutes.
Spoon the cooked sauce into a preheated preserve jar and seal.
Leave the jar in a cool, dark place for one month (at least) to develop a good flavour.

name: Hot Wing Dip
attribution: "Hot Wing Dip" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hot_Wing_Dip, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 recipe Hot Wings or Buffalo Wings

steps: Combine cheese, cayenne, sour cream, garlic, and salt in a serving bowl.
Serve with celery and hot wings/Buffalo Wings.

name: Hot Wings
attribution: "Hot Wings" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hot_Wings, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 12 whole chicken wings, tip removed and cut in half

steps: To make the sauce, combine melted butter, hot sauce, minced garlic, and soy sauce in a stainless steel bowl.
Preheat oil to 350°F (180°C).
Combine seasoning salt, pepper, and wings. Toss to coat.
Fry wings in batches in oil for 11 minutes. Drain on a rack. Do not use paper towels—they will make the food greasy.
Toss wings with sauce and serve warm.

name: Huancayo Potatoes in Cream Sauce (Papas a la Huancaína)
attribution: "Huancayo Potatoes in Cream Sauce (Papas a la Huancaína)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Huancayo_Potatoes_in_Cream_Sauce_(Papas_a_la_Huanca%C3%ADna), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 10 medium potatoes (new or red a good choice)
1 pound cheese (Romano, Mexican or feta work well)
4 aji amarillo (Peruvian yellow chili peppers), seeded and deveined

steps: Peel and boil potatoes as you normally would. Drain water, and allow them to cool.
In a blender, purée the cheese, peppers, milk, oil, garlic, crackers, mustard, salt and pepper. The sauce should be fairly thick; add more crackers if not, or add milk if too thick
Lay a bed of lettuce in a serving dish and place the potatoes on top. Cover with the sauce. Cut the hard boiled eggs in half and place on top of the potatoes. Add black olives if desired.

name: Huevos Rancheros
attribution: "Huevos Rancheros" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Huevos_Rancheros, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 plum tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped
1 tablespoon cilantro or parsley (optional), finely chopped

steps: To prepare the ranchero sauce, in a skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium-high heat. Add the onion and optional garlic, and sauté until softened but not brown (4–5 minutes).
Add the tomatoes, peppers, chili powder, salt and a few grinds of black pepper and reduce to a simmer. Simmer for about 10 minutes, until the sauce begins to thicken up.
Add the cilantro or parsley, turn off the heat and cover the pan to keep the sauce warm.
In another skillet, lightly fry the tortillas in 1 tablespoon of oil. Remove and drain.
If necessary, add additional oil to the second skillet, and fry the eggs until they are "sunny-side up". Transfer the eggs to the tortillas, and cover with the ranchero sauce.

name: Hummus (Greek)
attribution: "Hummus (Greek)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hummus_(Greek), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 cups raw dried chickpeas (or skip the soaking and cooking steps, and use 7 cups of drained tinned/canned chickpeas)
¾ cup (175 g) tahini (ground sesame seeds)
¾ cup (175 g) freshly squeezed lemon juice
12 cloves of garlic (peeled and roughly chopped)
½ cup extra virgin olive oil

steps: Soak the chickpeas in water overnight, then drain.

Gently simmer the chickpeas with the 9 cups water (generously salted) and the tablespoon of oil until very soft, but still whole (about 3 hours, or 10 minutes + cooling time if using a pressure cooker).
Drain the chickpeas, and reserve a few cups of the cooking liquid (you will need it later).

Rinse the chickpeas with plenty of cold water. While doing so, gently rub them between your hands to release the skins—they should float away with the rinsing water. After several changes of water, and removing a majority of the skins, drain the chickpeas again.
Using a food processor (or other means), mix the lemon juice with the tahini.

Purée (or mash) the chickpeas in batches, using the lemon juice and tahini mixture, the olive oil, and the cooking liquid as required to maintain the desired consistency (add the garlic to the batch with the olive oil, and process until smooth).
In a large bowl, using a spoon, mix the salt and pepper into the other blended ingredients (add additional cooking liquid, if still too thick).

name: Hummus III
attribution: "Hummus III" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hummus_III, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Soak chickpeas overnight.
Drain, rinse, and place chickpeas in saucepan. Just barely cover with water.
Add chopped garlic and salt.
Cook until tender (about 30 minutes) and set aside to cool.
Purée chickpeas in a blender with the oil, lemon juice, and tahini paste until smooth.

name: Hummus with Sprouted Chickpea
attribution: "Hummus with Sprouted Chickpea" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hummus_with_Sprouted_Chickpea, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Soak chickpeas for 12–24 hours then let sprout for 1–2 days. Make sure to rinse three times a day while sprouting.
Combine all ingredients except olive oil, paprika, and fresh parsley in a blender or food processor, and purée until smooth. Refrigerate for best taste.
Sprinkle hummus with olive oil, paprika, and parsley when serving.

name: Hush Puppies
attribution: "Hush Puppies" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hush_Puppies, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Pour oil 3–4 inches (7.5 cm to 10 cm) deep in a pan and preheat to 370°F (~190°C).
In bowl mix cornmeal, flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and cayenne.
Mix in eggs, green onions, milk, and ¼ cup vegetable oil.
Spoon 6–7 tablespoons of the batter into preheated oil.
Fry, stirring constantly for overall browning, until golden brown.
Remove from heat and drain on paper towels.

name: Hutspot (Dutch Mashed Vegetables)
attribution: "Hutspot (Dutch Mashed Vegetables)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hutspot_(Dutch_Mashed_Vegetables), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Add cheese, salt, and pepper to your liking

steps: Cook potatoes in pan of water, adding salt to taste, until done. Drain.
Cook carrots, onions and ham, adding a small amount of salt, until carrots are done. Drain, reserving water from carrot, onion, and ham pot.
Mash all ingredients, adding enough of reserved juices from carrots to reach a mashed potato consistency. Add 2 to 3 chunks of butter while mashing, to taste.

name: Hypotonic Sports Drink
attribution: "Hypotonic Sports Drink" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Hypotonic_Sports_Drink, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Transfer the water to a clean container, such as a measuring jug.
Stir in the salt until fully dissolved, then mix in the cordial. Stir thoroughly until evenly mixed.
Chill the mixture in the fridge until cool.
Pour into a clean sports bottle or thermos flask and sip gradually during exercise.

name: Iced Tea
attribution: "Iced Tea" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Iced_Tea, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 teaspoons citric acid crystals (or malic / tartaric / citric blends)

steps: Fill a drip coffee maker with cold water and place the tea bags in the basket.
Place the stevia, acid, and sugar in the pot, and place the pot in the machine.
Let it run through its cycle, then chill the product. This is a concentrate and will make several litres of iced tea.
Place some ice in a tall glass and fill 80–90% with cold water. Pour in some iced tea nectar. You may reduce the water and add some fruit juice if desired.

name: Idiyappam (South Indian Rice Noodles)
attribution: "Idiyappam (South Indian Rice Noodles)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Idiyappam_(South_Indian_Rice_Noodles), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup raw (i.e. not roasted) rice flour
1 cup water (hot water preferred by some)

steps: Mix rice flour with hot water and salt.
Knead it into a smooth dough.
Press the dough through an idiyappam presser or sieve onto banana leaves on which a little grated coconut has been sprinkled. Alternatively, press it directly onto an idli pan without banana leaves.
Steam for 5–10 minutes. Some people add a little grated coconut on top before steaming.

name: Igbouh Ahi (Nigerian Roasted Bambara Nuts)
attribution: "Igbouh Ahi (Nigerian Roasted Bambara Nuts)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Igbouh_Ahi_(Nigerian_Roasted_Bambara_Nuts), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Rinse bambara nuts and add salt to taste.
Combine blended pepper with bambara nuts.
Roast the peppered bambara nuts until tender.
Serve with plantain or roasted maize.

name: Iguana Pozole
attribution: "Iguana Pozole" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Iguana_Pozole, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Butcher and skin the iguanas. Cut into pieces.
Wash and salt the iguana pieces. Boil in water for 15–20 minutes.
Simmer the corn, garlic, onion, bay leaf, and salt to taste. After 10 minutes, add the meat. Cook for another 15–20 minutes.
Serve with sliced cabbage, sliced onion, cilantro, oregano, and pepper to taste.

name: Indian Beans
attribution: "Indian Beans" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Indian_Beans, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Chop and sauté the onion.
Add the tomatoes.
Add all the spices.
Add the lentils and kidney beans.
Cook everything for 20 minutes over medium heat.

name: Indian Butter Chicken I
attribution: "Indian Butter Chicken I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Indian_Butter_Chicken_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 400–500 g of skinless, boneless chicken thighs or breasts (with the bone, this will probably be 800 g)

steps: Trim and cut the chicken into small cubes. If you prefer chicken on the bone, cut long thin slices laterally into the chicken.

In a big bowl combine the tandoori powder, yogurt, lemon juice, and chicken. Massage this well with your hands so that all the chicken is evenly covered in the Tandoori powder. Cover and put aside for at least ½ an hour.
Heat a large saucepan or frying pan until evenly hot.

In the pan melt 2 tablespoons of butter until it is frothy. Add the onions and the cinnamon to the pan and fry lightly. When the onions are soft and starting to brown, stir in the crushed garlic and ginger. Then add the turmeric, chili, and coriander, and sauté over a medium heat.
Add the chicken and sauté, stirring constantly until the chicken has turned white. This doesn't take long, so make sure you don't overcook the chicken.
Mix in the tomato paste. Add the cream and heat through. After adding the cream and stirring, you may add additional tandoori masala. About 3–5 tablespoons is generally sufficient.
Cover and simmer for just over 10 minutes.

name: Indian Chai
attribution: "Indian Chai" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Indian_Chai, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 teaspoons sugar OR 1 packet artificial sweetener (adjust according to taste)
Dash of chai masala (a little more than a pinch depending on your taste)

steps: Add all the ingredients to the saucepan.
Bring to a boil, and let simmer for no more than a minute, unless you like a stronger tea taste.
Strain the mixture into a cup.

name: Indian Curry Marinade
attribution: "Indian Curry Marinade" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Indian_Curry_Marinade, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Pulse the toasted spices and the bay leaf in a spice grinder until finely ground. Combine remaining ingredients and ground spices.
Keep refrigerated for up to 1 ½ weeks. Shake well before using.

name: Indian Hard Tack (Baati)
attribution: "Indian Hard Tack (Baati)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Indian_Hard_Tack_(Baati), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix the flour and salt.
Put about 1 cup of flour mixture in a small bowl and add a little oil, mixing it in well and breaking up any lumps.

Add water about 1 tablespoon at a time and keep kneading with your hands. You only need 3–4 tablespoons, but you must knead the dough very hard to make it stick together in a ball. The more compact the dough, the better and denser the baati will be.
Let the balls sit for 5 minutes.
Flatten out each ball with first your hands and then a rolling pin until they are smooth discs 4 inches (10 cm) across and ½ inch (1.25 cm) thick.
Cook in a dry metal pan on a low flame. Flip once when the bottom begins to harden, then pinch all over with two fingers so the dough is not too thick and has a bumpy texture on one side.

Check the bottom until it browns in spots, then remove the baati and place it upside-down on a grate or pan with holes in it. This will blacken the top a little, especially on the tops of the pinched bumps.
To serve, drizzle liberally with ghee and accompany with a dhal or vegetable.

name: Indian Ice Cream
attribution: "Indian Ice Cream" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Indian_Ice_Cream, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: optional sweeteners may include fireweed, camas bulb (Camassia quamash) or sweet berries such as salal berries (Gaultheria shallon), or thimbleberries. Nowadays many people sweeten it with sugar.

steps: Crush berries to release the liquid/juice.
Combine juice with an equal part of water.
Add sweetener.
Whip it with a whisk until foamy, similar in texture to whipped cream.

name: Indian Mango, Chilli Powder, and Cumin Condiment (Chhundo)
attribution: "Indian Mango, Chilli Powder, and Cumin Condiment (Chhundo)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Indian_Mango,_Chilli_Powder,_and_Cumin_Condiment_(Chhundo), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Peel and finely grate the mangoes.
Combine the grated mango evenly with the rest of the ingredients.
Spread the mixture in a shallow, wide-mouthed jar and cover with a thin cloth.
Keep the mixture in the sun for 5 days until the syrup attains a single thread consistency, stirring thrice daily.

name: Indian Moong Dal
attribution: "Indian Moong Dal" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Indian_Moong_Dal, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine the dal, green chillies, turmeric powder, and water in a pressure cooker. Cook for 15 minutes, then leave the pressure cooker to release steam on its own.
Open the pressure cooker and mash the cooked dal. Add salt to taste. Add more water if it is too thick and heat over a medium heat.
Heat oil or ghee in a frying pan, then add jeera and curry leaves. After it splutters, pour it over the cooked dal.
Serve hot with rice or rotis.

name: Indian Omelet
attribution: "Indian Omelet" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Indian_Omelet, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Finely-chopped hot green chiles, to taste

steps: In a small bowl, whisk the eggs lightly. Add in all the other ingredients and mix properly.
Set a skillet on stove, and smear its surface with a thin coat of oil.
Pour the contents of the bowl into the skillet.
Lightly brown on one side.
Turn over and lightly brown other side.

name: Indian Potatoes
attribution: "Indian Potatoes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Indian_Potatoes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 small potatoes, peeled and cut in half

steps: Sauté the garlic in olive oil.
Add tomatoes. Cook for 10 minutes, until the oil and tomatoes separate (they will bubble).
Stir in the coconut milk.
Add ½ teaspoon red pepper, and salt to taste. Boil it all together.
Add the potatoes. Cook over low-medium heat until the potatoes are done. They will become fairly soft; check with a fork.

name: Indian Pudding
attribution: "Indian Pudding" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Indian_Pudding, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 egg whites, whipped to stiff peaks

steps: Set aside ½ cup of the milk. Boil the remaining milk.
Add cold water to cornmeal to wet it.
Slowly pour the cornmeal mixture into the boiling milk. Add salt.
Boil for 15 minutes, stirring constantly. If skin forms, remove it. Remove from heat, set aside.
In a small bowl, mix molasses with baking soda, the ½ cup cold milk, and brown sugar.
Add the spices and the beaten egg yolks to this mixture.
Slowly pour the molasses mixture into the cornmeal mixture.
Fold in the whipped egg whites.
Grease or butter a baking dish, add the batter, and bake for 1 hour at 350°F.

name: Indian Rice
attribution: "Indian Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Indian_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat the olive oil in a pot.
Add the cumin, then the raisins and cashews. Sauté for two minutes.
Add the rice, and sauté for another minute.
Add water, and bring everything to a boil.
Lower the heat, cover, and cook for 12 minutes.

name: Injera (Ethiopian Teff Flatbread)
attribution: "Injera (Ethiopian Teff Flatbread)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Injera_(Ethiopian_Teff_Flatbread), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1½ cups warm but not hot water

steps: Mix the flour with the water, and the salt. Add your fermentation starter if using one.
Set aside to ferment overnight, or at least 12 hours. There should be bubbles on the surface from fermenting, before you use it.
Heat a large, flat pan until it is hot enough to make a droplet of water sizzle. Oil it very lightly, just enough to make the pan shine.
Pour or ladle some batter onto the pan, spiralling outwards from the centre. Only a thin layer is required—a little thicker than a crêpe but not by much.

As it cooks, the surface of the injera will become covered in holes or pits. When the entire injera has changed colour and the edges start to lift from the pan, remove it and set aside, then pour the next injera and repeat until finished.

name: Instant Pot Beans
attribution: "Instant Pot Beans" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Instant_Pot_Beans, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Soak the beans in water for 4–12 hours. Drain the water.
Place the soaked beans, water, garlic, onion, and ham pieces in the Instant Pot.
Seal the lid, close the valve, and set the "manual" button to 35 minutes.
Use a natural pressure release or the quick pressure release (see how).
When the valve drops, carefully remove the lid.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve or reuse in other recipes that employs beans.

name: Iresi Eyin (Yoruba Palm Oil Native Rice)
attribution: "Iresi Eyin (Yoruba Palm Oil Native Rice)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Iresi_Eyin_(Yoruba_Palm_Oil_Native_Rice), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Dried catfish, or any other dried fish, soaked in hot salted water until soft, then shredded
Carrots, washed and chopped, to taste
Peas, washed and parboiled if necessary, to taste

steps: Wash the rice and parboil for about 8 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Heat the palm oil in a large, clean pot until the oil changes color.
Add the locust beans, onions, tomato paste, dry pepper, and a little water. Fry until the odour of the sauce changes and becomes more fragrant.
Simmer over medium heat for about 25 minutes until the liquid is absorbed and everything is cooked.

name: Irish Fruit Cake
attribution: "Irish Fruit Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Irish_Fruit_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Sift together flour, salt and baking powder.
Cream together butter and sugar; this may take 5–10 minutes.
Beat in eggs individually, incorporating each fully before adding the next.
Fold in fruits then the dry mixture.
Transfer batter to a greased and parchment-lined 8-inch cake pan.
Bake on the center rack for 75–90 minutes. Check for doneness after 60 minutes.
Let cake cool to room temperature in pan.
Remove to a wire tray, cover with towel, and allow to sit until completely cool.

name: Irish Pastie
attribution: "Irish Pastie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Irish_Pastie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 lb ground pork or beef, cooked and drained
3 medium-sized potatoes, boiled, mashed, and cooled

steps: Combine the cooked meat, breadcrumbs, cooked onion, parsley, salt, pepper, Worcestershire sauce, water, coriander, and mashed potatoes.
Form the mixture into a disc about 3 inches in diameter.
Dip the disc into the batter so it's completely covered.
Deep-fry in 375°F oil, and remove when golden brown.
Serve hot with chips (French fries).

name: Irish Soda Bread
attribution: "Irish Soda Bread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Irish_Soda_Bread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F (160°C).
Grease and flour a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, sugar, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Blend egg and buttermilk together, and add all at once to the flour mixture.
Mix until just moistened. Too much mixing will make it tough.
Stir in butter; pour into prepared pan.
Bake for 65–70 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the bread comes out clean. The loaf should sound hollow if you tap the base.
Cool on a wire rack.
Wrap in tea-towel or foil several hours or overnight for best flavor.

name: Irish Stew
attribution: "Irish Stew" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Irish_Stew, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2½ lb (1.1 kg) deboned mutton, cut in chunks
4 large potatoes, peeled and thickly sliced
3–4 medium carrots, peeled and thickly sliced

steps: Choose a pot with a well-fitting lid and put in the ingredients in layers, starting and finishing with potatoes. Pour in the water and season to taste.
Cover and put on a very low heat for about 2½ hours until the meat is tender and the potatoes have thickened the liquid.

name: Island Ceviche
attribution: "Island Ceviche" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Island_Ceviche, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 ea. (8 ounces) pompano fillet, thinly sliced
1 ea. (7 ounces) mahi-mahi fillet, thinly sliced

steps: Combine juices, salt, and pepper.
Pour into a gallon-size zip-top bag and add fish. Refrigerate overnight.
Serve.

name: Island Salsa Salad
attribution: "Island Salsa Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Island_Salsa_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup minced red onion, scalded (see note)
4 small, ripe avocados, peeled and diced
1–2 small serrano chilis (2½ inches long) or ½ small jalapeño chili, seeded and very finely minced
1½ cups minced fresh pineapple (half a small pineapple)

steps: Combine the avocados, minced chilis, cilantro, cumin, garlic, jicama, lime juice, mango, mint, pineapple, and salt in a medium-sized bowl. Add the onion.
Mix everything together thoroughly but gently.
Chill for about 2 hours, tightly covered.
Serve.

name: Israeli Salad
attribution: "Israeli Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Israeli_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tsp za'atar (can substitute ¼ tsp thyme)

steps: Mix cucumber, tomato, onion, and parsley.
Mix oil, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and za'atar to make dressing.
Pour dressing over vegetables. Correct seasoning to taste.

name: Italian Bread
attribution: "Italian Bread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Italian_Bread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tablespoon / 14 g g / 2.8% White granulated sugar
½ cup / 118 g / n/a Cool water

steps: In a large bowl, sprinkle yeast over warm water and let stand for 5 minutes.
Stir in oil, salt, and sugar.
Add 2½ cups flour and mix to blend.
Using a spoon or heavy duty mixer, beat until elastic (about 5 minutes).
Stir in (you may want to use dough hooks) another cup of flour and the wheat germ to make a stiff dough.

Knead on a board or pastry cloth, floured with some of the last ½ cup flour, until dough is springy and smooth and develops small bubbles just under the surface (about 20–25 minutes—you may want to do this with the dough hooks).
Put in greased bowl, turning to grease top, then cover with a cloth.
Rise until doubled, about an hour, depending on temperature.
Punch down dough, turn out, and divide in half.
Preheat oven to 375°F.
Shape each half of dough into a slender oval loaf about 15 inches long.
Place on greased baking sheet, cover lightly and let rise until nearly doubled, about 30–40 minutes.
Combine cornstarch and cool water. Bring cornstarch mixture to a boil and stir until thick and clear. Brush loaves with mixture.
Slash loaf tops ½ inch with floured sharp knife or razor blade.
Bake until loaves browned and sound hollow when tapped, 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool on wire racks.

name: Italian Crispy Chicken
attribution: "Italian Crispy Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Italian_Crispy_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 ea. (24–32 ounces) boneless skinless chicken breasts
¼ cup garlic-flavored croutons, finely crushed

steps: Combine flour and seasonings in a pie plate. Combine croutons and breadcrumbs in another pie plate, and place the eggs in another pie plate.
Dredge chicken in flour then dip into eggs. Dredge in crouton mixture and let rest 2–3 minutes.
Coat chicken with canola oil and place onto a greased sheet pan. Insert a probe thermometer into one of the pieces.
Bake in a 425°F oven until internal temperature reaches 165°F. Serve warm.

name: Italian Dressing I
attribution: "Italian Dressing I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Italian_Dressing_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tablespoon white Chianti or dry white wine

steps: Combine all ingredients in a jar with tight-fitting top.
Shake well.

name: Italian Dressing II
attribution: "Italian Dressing II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Italian_Dressing_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tbsp plus 1 tsp grated Parmesan cheese
¼ tsp dried whole Italian seasoning

steps: Combine all ingredients except garlic in a jar.
Cover tightly and shake vigorously.
Press a wooden pick through garlic clove; add to dressing mixture.
Cover and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled.
To serve, remove and discard garlic. Cover and shake dressing well.

name: Italian Marinated Chicken
attribution: "Italian Marinated Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Italian_Marinated_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix broth, tomatoes, cheese, Italian seasoning and garlic powder in a shallow non-metallic dish. Reserve half of this mixture.
Add chicken to remaining marinade and turn to coat.
Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Remove chicken from broth mixture. Discard the marinade.
Grill or broil chicken for 15 minutes or until done, turning and brushing often with reserved broth mixture.

name: Italian Meatballs
attribution: "Italian Meatballs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Italian_Meatballs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 500 g (18 oz/1½ lb) minced veal meat
30 g (1 oz/1 Tbsp) grated Parmesan cheese

steps: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Using your hands, squeeze all ingredients.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and drizzle on a little olive oil. Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F) in the meantime.
Use your hands to roll meat into bite sized balls.
Place the meatballs in the skillet and cook uncovered for 3 minutes, then roll them over and cook another 3 minutes.
Transfer the meatballs onto a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 20–25 minutes.

name: Italian Meringue
attribution: "Italian Meringue" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Italian_Meringue, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: In a saucepan, dissolve the sugar in the water and bring to a boil.
Boil the syrup until it reaches 243°F (117°C).
While the syrup is boiling, whip the egg whites to soft peaks.
While beating, gradually pour the syrup into the egg whites in a steady stream.
Continue whipping until the meringue is completely cool and forms firm peaks.
Use as desired.
