Add the onions and garlic, and sauté them for about 2 minutes until the onions are translucent.
Add the thyme, basil and bell pepper. Cook 5 minutes more.
Add the tomatoes and sugar. Bring to a boil and then lower to a light simmer, stirring occasionally for 30 minutes.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve hot by ladling over pasta, seafood or rice.

name: Marinated Cucumbers and Onions
attribution: "Marinated Cucumbers and Onions" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Marinated_Cucumbers_and_Onions, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix vinegar, oil, salt and sugar for the marinade.
Trim the ends from the cucumbers, peel them, and slice them.
Peel the onion and slice it as thinly as possible.
Pour the marinade over the cucumbers and onions and mix well.
Let it sit in a cool place or refrigerator for at least two hours, stirring occasionally.
Serve in a bowl, marinade and all, using salad tongs or a slotted spoon to dish out servings.

name: Marinated Green Olives
attribution: "Marinated Green Olives" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Marinated_Green_Olives, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups (16 oz/450 g) unpitted large green Spanish olives

steps: Lightly crush the olives with a mallet, or make slight slits on each olive with a knife, to ensure that the marinade permeates them.
Place the olives in a sealable glass jar and add the remaining ingredients.
Fill the jar with water and shake well.
Marinate at room temperature for several days to a week.
Serve the olives with toasted almonds and fresh bread.

name: Marinated Mackerel
attribution: "Marinated Mackerel" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Marinated_Mackerel, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Clean and scale fish. Place in a baking dish large enough for the fish and vinegar.
Mix other ingredients, except vinegar, with salt to taste, and pour over fish.
Pour over enough vinegar to cover well.
Place in moderate oven for 40–50 minutes.
Lift fish carefully onto serving dish, and strain liquor over top.
Let cool and serve.

name: Marly Sponge
attribution: "Marly Sponge" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Marly_Sponge, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix the almonds, flour, and the first quantity of sugar with a wire whisk.
Whip the egg whites to soft peaks.
Add the second quantity of sugar, little by little, and beat to firm peaks.
Fold the almond mixture into the egg whites.
Line a sheet pan with parchment paper and draw circles of the required diameter on the paper.
Using a pastry bag, pipe spirals of meringue into the circles.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 12–15 minutes.

name: Marsala Chicken Scallopini
attribution: "Marsala Chicken Scallopini" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Marsala_Chicken_Scallopini, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Put each chicken breast in a plastic bag and flatten with a meat tenderizer.
Coarsely chop the basil, and then throw it in a deep baking pan along with some flour, oregano. Toss the chicken with it.

Melt 2 tsp of butter in a medium frying pan on low-medium heat. When the butter stops bubbling, add the chicken and brown each section for approximately 3 minutes on each side. Once this is done, cover and set aside on a separate plate.
Drain off most of the liquid from the pan, and raise the heat. Pour a dollop of olive oil in, and sear the asparagus quickly. Remove this and set aside.

Keep at high heat, add the marsala and ¼ of the stock. Boil off for a few minutes. Lower the heat, and return the asparagus to the pan. Add the remaining stock and boil off to reduce. Add a tsp of butter, and cover chicken with sauce.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

name: Marzipan Cake
attribution: "Marzipan Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Marzipan_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Melt butter in a small saucepan and let cool slightly.
Beat the eggs in a mixing bowl with a mixer at the highest level until frothy. While stirring, sprinkle in sugar mixed with vanilla sugar, then beat the mixture for 2 minutes.
Combine the flour, baking powder and almonds. Stir in briefly at the lowest setting, then stir in the butter briefly.
Spread the batter in a springform pan.
Bake in the oven for 30 minutes.
Let the cake base cool and cut twice horizontally. Place one of the cake bases on a cake platter.
Stir the jam until smooth and spread on the bottom cake base.
Place the middle cake base on top of the jam, and press gently to secure the layers.
Cut the marzipan into small pieces and place in a mixing bowl. Add the bitter almond flavor, sugar, and water, and stir until smooth with the mixer.
Whip the cream with pectin stiffly according to the package instructions. Mix in the marzipan.
Spread about ¾ of the cream on the middle cake layer, and put the final layer on top.
Spread the cake completely with the remaining cream. Place the cake in the fridge for at least 3 hours.
Place a piece baking paper on a large plate.
Crush the couverture and melt it in a bowl over a water bath. Mix the almonds with the chocolate coating.
Spoon 16 small dollops of the almond-chocolate mixture on the baking paper, and keep in the fridge until the chocolate has set.
Sift powdered sugar and knead into the marzipan. Roll out the marzipan mixture into a round flat disc (Ø=36 cm).
Drape the marzipan over the cake. Press the marzipan onto the edge of the cake. Cut off any excess marzipan.
Prepare cream and transfer to a piping bag. Decorate the cake with cream.
Place almond slivers on top and place the cake in the fridge until ready to serve.

name: Marzipan Muffins
attribution: "Marzipan Muffins" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Marzipan_Muffins, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Finely dice the marzipan or mash it with a fork. Beat it well with butter, milk, and eggs.
Mix the remaining dry ingredients. Add them to the butter and egg mixture, and mix to make a smooth batter. If it is too dry, add a little more milk.
Place muffin tins on a baking sheet. Spread the batter in the tins and bake at 180°C for 20–25 minutes.
If desired, decorate the muffins with chocolate icing and sprinkles.

name: Masala Chai II
attribution: "Masala Chai II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Masala_Chai_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a serving cup. Steep for about 5 minutes.
Stir vigorously to incorporate the cocoa and cinnamon.
Reheat in the microwave if you prefer it very hot.

name: Mascarpone Chocolate Sauce
attribution: "Mascarpone Chocolate Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mascarpone_Chocolate_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Whisk together all ingredients in your serving bowl.
Serve as a dipping sauce with beignets or fruit; or, serve over ice cream.

name: Mashed Pumpkin
attribution: "Mashed Pumpkin" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mashed_Pumpkin, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Clean your pumpkin well, being careful to remove manure, dirt, etc. Chop off the stem.
Bake the cleaned pumpkin in a 375 °F (190 C) oven for about 45 minutes per 250 g. A small pumpkin of less than 500 g works best.
Remove pumpkin and allow to rest for 5–10 minutes.
During this time, take out sea salt, butter, and your pepper mill.
Chop pumpkin in half with cleaver, butcher knife, or kitchen hatchet.
Remove seeds and guts; roast seeds and discard the rest.
Separate the skin from the flesh.
Place hot pumpkin flesh in a food processor, along with salt, pepper, and butter to taste.

name: Matar Paneer
attribution: "Matar Paneer" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Matar_Paneer, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 8 oz (200 g) paneer, cut in 1” cubes
3 green chilies, seeded and finely chopped

steps: Heat some oil in a deep pan.
Add paneer cubes in it. Fry on all the sides over medium-low heat until golden brown.
Remove paneer from the pan, and drain on paper towels.
Remove excess oil from the same pan, and add ginger-garlic paste.
Add chopped onion to it. Cook, stirring, until onion becomes translucent.
Add chopped tomatoes and mix. Cook well over medium heat.
Turn off the heat when tomatoes have left all the water. Let cool.
Transfer mixture to a blender, and add the chiles.
Blend until smooth.
Heat oil in a pan.
Add cumin seeds, and fry until they start to crackle.
Add turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder, and garam masala. Mix well over low heat.
Add the blended purée, and mix well over medium heat.
Season with salt, then mix in the peas.
Add some water, cover, and steam until the peas are fully cooked.
Uncover and add the fried paneer. Mix well, adding more water if required.
Heat a small pan/tadka pan.
Add 1 tsp oil and ½ tsp red chilli powder. Mix well.
Turn off the gas and add to the matar paneer while serving.

name: Matzah Lasagne
attribution: "Matzah Lasagne" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Matzah_Lasagne, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 30–34 ounces marinara sauce or tomato sauce

steps: Grease a baking pan that will fit the matzah sheets.
Spread about ½ cup sauce in the pan to cover the bottom.
Place 1 matzoh sheet on top.
Spread more tomato sauce over the matzah.
Spread a layer of cottage cheese on top of the matzah.
Sprinkle with mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses.
Repeat these layers until all 4 matzah sheets are used.
Spread tomato sauce and sprinkle mozzarella and Parmesan cheese on top.
Add ½ cup water
Cover with foil, and bake at 350°F (175°C) for 35–40 minutes.

name: Mató de Pedralbes (Spanish Maize Custard)
attribution: "Mató de Pedralbes (Spanish Maize Custard)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mat%C3%B3_de_Pedralbes_(Spanish_Maize_Custard), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Stir the maize flour into a glass of the cold milk.
Put the rest of milk in a saucepan, add sugar and yolks, and beat together until blended.
Add cinnamon sticks and heat the mixture. When it begins to boil, add the glass of milk and flour, and mix well. Cook until thickened.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and take out the cinnamon sticks. Pour it into four oval molds and refrigerate until cool.
To serve, unmold the custards and serve with jam or some rosemary honey.

name: Mazagran (Algerian Iced Coffee)
attribution: "Mazagran (Algerian Iced Coffee)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mazagran_(Algerian_Iced_Coffee), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Fill a tall, narrow glass with the ice cubes.
Pour the coffee over the ice.
Add the lemon juice and sugar to taste.
Add the lemon slice or wedge as a final touch if desired.

name: Mazorca Desgranada (Colombian Beef Salad)
attribution: "Mazorca Desgranada (Colombian Beef Salad)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mazorca_Desgranada_(Colombian_Beef_Salad), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ pound (250 g) beef loin steak, cut into thin strips
½ small "Summer Crisp" (Batavian) lettuce, thinly sliced
¼ pound (125 g) shredded costeño or Monterey Jack cheese

steps: Fry beef in a medium skillet. Season with allspice, pepper, salt, and Worcestershire sauce.
Heat corn in warm water, then drain well.
Place lettuce into serving dish.
Place corn over the lettuce.
Add shredded cheese on top of the corn.
Top with beef.
Cover everything with crushed potato chips.
Pour tartar sauce all over the dish, and enjoy.

name: Mbongo Tchobi (Cameroonian Black Stew)
attribution: "Mbongo Tchobi (Cameroonian Black Stew)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mbongo_Tchobi_(Cameroonian_Black_Stew), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Lightly salt the fish fillets, and set aside.
Combine the tomatoes, half the onions, garlic, ginger, leeks, celery, African nutmeg, njangsa, mbongo spice, and ½ cup water. Blend until smooth.
Pour the mixture over the fish, and marinate for 30 minutes.
Heat the oil in a pot. Add the remaining onions and cook until aromatic. Add the fish, marinade, and peppers, then season with salt and stock cubes. Cover and cook for about 15 minutes.
Uncover and check the seasoning. Thin with water if necessary, then cook for another 5 minutes.
Serve with boiled plantains, rice, or yams.

name: Meat and Potatoes in Broth (Niku Jaga)
attribution: "Meat and Potatoes in Broth (Niku Jaga)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Meat_and_Potatoes_in_Broth_(Niku_Jaga), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut potatoes into bite-sized pieces. Set aside to soak in cold water.
Combine mirin, soy sauce, sugar, ginger, and beef in a saucepan. Boil lightly for 2–3 minutes.
Remove beef from pan. Add potatoes, sliced onion, and water. Bring to a boil.
Simmer uncovered until the broth reduces to about ⅓ by volume.
Replace beef in pan, add shirataki noodles, and simmer for roughly 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and serve.

name: Meat and Shrimp Potstickers
attribution: "Meat and Shrimp Potstickers" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Meat_and_Shrimp_Potstickers, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ pound (about 250 g) ground chicken or pork
½ pound ground raw prawn or shrimp
½ cup water chestnuts (fresh if possible) peeled and sliced

steps: Mix together the filling ingredients.
Place a small bowl of water on the work area. If desired, mix in a little cornstarch to make a glue.
Lay out one of the gyoza wrappers in front of you.
Dip your finger in the water and moisten the edges of the wrapper.
Place a heaped teaspoon of filling in the middle of the wrapper.
Fold the gyoza wrapper over the filling and pinch the edges to seal it shut.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large skillet or wok.
When oil is ready, carefully add the dumplings and cook on high heat until golden brown (about 1 minute).
Without turning the dumplings over, add 1 cup of water and cover.
Steam for about 1 minute to cook the raw filling and then turn off the heat (this is to keep the bottom from burning).
Let the dumplings cook for a few more minutes with the heat turned off.
Serve the potstickers with dipping sauce or soy sauce.

name: Meat Masala
attribution: "Meat Masala" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Meat_Masala, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Toast the chillies, coriander, peppercorn, cumin, and mustard in a frying pan.
Grind all ingredients to a powder.
Store in a glass jar with a tight-fitting lid.

name: Meatless Sloppy Joes
attribution: "Meatless Sloppy Joes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Meatless_Sloppy_Joes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup hickory-smoked barbecue sauce, or to your preference

steps: Add olive oil to pan over medium-high heat.
Add onions, bell pepper, and carrots and cook for 3–4 minutes
Add rice, chili beans, and barbecue sauce and cook for approximately 10–15 minutes, stirring frequently to heat thoroughly.
Serve on hamburger buns.

name: Meatloaf I
attribution: "Meatloaf I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Meatloaf_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine the ground beef, eggs, minced garlic, salt, allspice, curry powder, and Worcestershire sauce.
Mix in the chopped onion, celery, and cracker crumbs.
Press the mixture into a standard loaf pan.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for about 10–20 minutes until browned on top.
Tilt the pan, and drain off any accumulated grease. Add the mushroom soup on top.
Bake another 1.5–2 hours until cooked through.

name: Meatloaf II
attribution: "Meatloaf II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Meatloaf_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 8 oz (220 g) package of pre-made stuffing (e.g. Stove Top or Paxo)
Small bowl for mixing egg mixture
Very large bowl for mixing meat mixture

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Beat eggs, water, and approximately soy sauce together in a bowl and set aside.
Get a large bowl and mix the ground beef and stuffing together. Make sure to use your hands and combine the mixture well, as this is the most important step.
Slowly work the egg mixture into the meat and stuffing, once again making sure to combine all ingredients well.
Pick up the big ball of meat and pack in hands until you have formed a loaf. Place in ungreased loaf pan.
Bake, uncovered, on the center rack of the oven for 45–55 minutes until center of meatloaf is browned.
Drain excess grease off side of pan and let stand 5–10 minutes before cutting and serving.

name: Meatloaf III
attribution: "Meatloaf III" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Meatloaf_III, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Pound the Ritz crackers until fine like bread crumbs.
In a separate bowl, add the meat and the other ingredients and mix with your hands until the mixture is smooth.
Grease a glass baking dish with vegetable shortening.
Put the meat mixture in the pan and shape like a football.
Bake in the oven for 1 hour.
Take out the meat loaf and serve warm.

name: Meatloaf IV
attribution: "Meatloaf IV" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Meatloaf_IV, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 slices whole-wheat bread, toasted and cubed

steps: Preheat oven to 325°F.
Combine beaten eggs, milk, mustard, onion, Parmesan cheese, parsley, pepper, and salt, then bread cubes.
Crumble beef into mixture.
Fold meat and sauce mixture together.
Heavily spray a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish or Dutch oven with cooking spray.
Form meat into a loaf shape in pan no more than 3 inches high.
Cover with ketchup, even if it takes more than ½ cup.
Bake 75 minutes or more, if desired.

name: Meatloaf V
attribution: "Meatloaf V" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Meatloaf_V, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (400–425 g/14–15 oz) chickpeas or other beans
400 g (14 oz) mixed ground beef and pork
1 tsp Dijon or other prepared mustard

steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Drain the chickpeas or white beans, reserving the liquid. Mash the peas or beans to a paste.
Combine the mashed peas/beans, the liquid from the can, the meat, milk, salt, pepper, Worcestershire, garlic powder, sage, mustard, and oats in a large bowl and mix thoroughly.
Pour the mixture into an ungreased loaf pan; spread ketchup on top.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 1–1¼ hours. Allow to stand for 15 minutes or so after removing it from the oven before cutting into it.

name: Mediterranean Beef Stew
attribution: "Mediterranean Beef Stew" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mediterranean_Beef_Stew, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 500 g (1.1 lb) of lean beef stewing/braising steak (in steaks, not diced)
600 g (1.3 lb) of green olives, stones removed
1 large clove of garlic, finely chopped

steps: In a large saucepan or casserole dish, gently fry the onion and garlic in plenty of good olive oil for a few minutes, taking care not to brown them.
Season the beef well with salt and black pepper and immediately add to the pan. Fry until evenly sealed and lightly browned.
Add the olives and tomatoes to the pan and simmer gently for two hours with the lid on.
Serve.

name: Mediterranean Green Chicken
attribution: "Mediterranean Green Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mediterranean_Green_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 whole chicken, cut up (or any 8 chicken pieces—any combination of leg, breast, thigh, and wing)

steps: In a blender or food processor, combine parsley, shallots, garlic, olive oil, mustard, Italian herb blend, lemon juice, pepper, and salt. Purée.
Transfer mixture to a gallon zip-lock bag.
Add chicken, making sure it's covered on all sides by the marinade.
Seal bag and refrigerate for an hour.
Preheat oven to 300°F (150C).
Transfer chicken pieces to a rimmed baking sheet.
Bake about 40 minutes, turning pieces after 20 minutes, until juices run clear.

name: Mediterranean Grilled Tuna
attribution: "Mediterranean Grilled Tuna" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mediterranean_Grilled_Tuna, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: At least one hour before serving, prepare a marinade with the oil, vinegar or lime juice, tarragon leaves, salt and pepper in a flat container. Pour over the tuna steaks and turn them to make sure all pieces are well coated. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until it is time to grill.
Spray a clean grill or grilling container with non-stick cooking spray.
Drain and reserve the excess marinade from the tuna. Grill tuna for about 4 minutes on each side or until nicely charred on the outside and still a bit pink in the middle.
Place the steaks on individual serving dishes and pour the marinade on the grilled tuna.
Serve with steamed vegetables, steamed rice, or a spinach salad.

name: Medu Vada (South Indian Savory Lentil Donut)
attribution: "Medu Vada (South Indian Savory Lentil Donut)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Medu_Vada_(South_Indian_Savory_Lentil_Donut), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Wash and soak urad dal for 6 hours. Grind into a fine paste.
Add salt, asafoetida, curry leaves, cumin powder, and crushed peppercorns to the batter and mix well.
Heat oil in a kadai.
Wet your palms and take batter into the palms.
Shape into balls and make a hole with the thumb in the centre like a doughnut.
Deep-fry this in medium-hot oil until golden brown and crisp.
Serve hot with sambhar and coconut chutney.

name: Menemen (Eggs with Onion, Green Pepper, and Tomato)
attribution: "Menemen (Eggs with Onion, Green Pepper, and Tomato)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Menemen_(Eggs_with_Onion,_Green_Pepper,_and_Tomato), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Prepare a concassée of tomatoes by blanching, peeling, seeding and dicing the tomatoes. Alternately, you may simply grind the tomatoes in a food processor or grate them using a box grater.
Dice the onions and peppers in medium dice and sauté in the olive oil until tender.
Add the oregano and paprika, if using.
Add the tomatoes to the peppers and onion and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the parsley and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Beat the eggs and pour over the mixture in the pan. Stir until cooked.
Serve with Turkish bread.

name: Menudo (Mexican Tripe and Hominy Soup)
attribution: "Menudo (Mexican Tripe and Hominy Soup)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Menudo_(Mexican_Tripe_and_Hominy_Soup), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tbsp red pepper flakes (with the seeds)

steps: Wipe the dried Anchos off with a wet paper towel.
If desired, toast dried chilies on each side 15 seconds on a hot griddle (this releases essential oils and enhances the flavor).
Place the dried chilies into the small pot of boiling water and boil for 10 minutes, turning frequently in the boiling water to ensure all sides receive their fair share of punishment.
Remove the chili pot from the stove and drain off the boiling water. Fill with cold water; let it sit a few minutes to cool.
Remove the stems from the chilies, cut chilies longitudinally from stem to tip on one side and open. Flush gently with running cold water to remove the seeds.
Place stemless and seedless reconstituted chilies into a blender and purée.
Remove pure from the blender and place in the refrigerator overnight.
Rinse and drain the white hominy.
Place the patas (feet) and ribs into a pot.
Place the hominy in the pot with the patas (feet).
Put 1 tbsp salt in the pot.
Take 3–4 dried Chilis de Arbol, discard the seeds and stems, and snip the chilis into ringlets and put into the pot.
Cover with water to a height not exceeding 1 cm above the ingredients and bring to a boil.
Cook the posole uncovered until the ribs are finished. Remove from the heat.
Remove the meat from the ribs and dice into small cubes, place back into the pot with the posole, discard the bones.
Place the cooked patas (feet) into the pressure pot you will use to make the menudo.
Place a small pot of water on the stove and set to boil. This will be needed to prepare the chilies.
Cut the fat from off of the tripe. If fat clings to the non-honeycombed side of the tripe, use a stiff brush to remove it.
Cut tripe into small pieces, about ¾–1 inch. Strong scissors work well here!
If the tripe smells overly rank (this is normal), you may want to soak it in clean water for an hour (or possibly boil it in water for five minutes) throwing away the soak (boiling) water.
Place cut tripe into the pressure cooker on top of the patas (feet).
Add the garlic, bay leaves, and Mexican oregano.
Fill pressure cooker with water until about 1 cm. above the height of the stew ingredients.
Cook at pressure 35–40 minutes.
After the stew has cooked in the pressure cooker at full pressure for 35–40 minutes, remove from the heat and let the pot cool off completely until pressure returns to ambient.
Remove the patas from the pot and remove the bones. Put deboned patas into pot with the tripe and discard the bones.
Transfer the stew to a large bowl and add the posole, ensure all savory pieces lie below the waterline, and set in the refrigerator overnight.
In the morning, skim all hardened fat from the surface of the stew which has probably gelatinized overnight.
Reheat a serving portion of the stew in the microwave or on stovetop. When hot, place into a serving bowl.
Add a tablespoon of chili to the stew and blend thoroughly.

The menudo is ready to serve with hot corn tortillas. The spices (oregano and chili flakes) are traditionally combined before serving and placed at the side of the bowl of menudo with a lime wedge for the diner to add just prior to eating. Along with the spices, diced onion or cilantro are also traditionally added to the stew just prior to enjoying.

name: Meringata di Frutta in Coppa (Meringue with Fruit and Cream)
attribution: "Meringata di Frutta in Coppa (Meringue with Fruit and Cream)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Meringata_di_Frutta_in_Coppa_(Meringue_with_Fruit_and_Cream), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Vanilla pastry cream, home-made or store-bought, as needed
Any fruit of choice or a mixture, as needed
Raspberry coulis or other topping of choice

steps: Spoon a few tablespoons of vanilla cream into the bottom of a martini or parfait glass.
Cover the custard with your fruit of choice, leaving enough room for the topping.
Cover the fruit with crème chantilly, and sprinkle crumbled meringue chips on top.
Serve with a sprig of mint or basil and drizzle with raspberry coulis.

name: Meringata with Ginger and Cream
attribution: "Meringata with Ginger and Cream" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Meringata_with_Ginger_and_Cream, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 container store-bought or homemade meringue cookies

steps: Strain the lemon juice and mix with the zest.
Mix the juice and zest with the heavy cream.
Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Fold in the powdered sugar.
Mix the ginger into the cream.
Crumble the meringues and mix into the cream. Do this just before serving.
Serve immediately, otherwise the meringue will dissolve in the cream over time.

name: Meringue Cookies I
attribution: "Meringue Cookies I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Meringue_Cookies_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup (250 ml) superfine sugar, powdered sugar, or granulated sugar (ideally a mixture of 50% superfine and 50% powdered sugar)

steps: Whip whites of eggs until stiff and dry.
Add lemon juice.

Gradually add sugar and continue beating until mixture holds shape and is very shiny. Test to make sure the sugar is wholly solved and no grains remain (this can take longer or shorter depending on the sugar used).
Add vanilla.
Drop meringue by spoonfuls on unglazed paper.
Bake in a slow oven 80–90 minutes, depending on size. Use very low heat, as meringues should dry rather than bake and should be dry and only very slightly colored, when finished.
Let cool before serving.

name: Meringues with Roasted Raspberries and Hazelnut Creme Anglaise
attribution: "Meringues with Roasted Raspberries and Hazelnut Creme Anglaise" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Meringues_with_Roasted_Raspberries_and_Hazelnut_Creme_Anglaise, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup plus 1 tablespoon granulated sugar, divided

steps: Heat the oven to 200°F (90ºC).
In the bowl of a standing mixer or with a hand-held mixer, whip egg whites and cream of tartar on high speed until soft peaks form, about 1 minute.
Reduce mixer speed to low and add 1 cup sugar in a steady stream; continue whipping until stiff and glossy, about 4 minutes.
Whip in cinnamon.
Fill a pastry bag fitted with a medium star tip with the meringue.
Onto a Silpat or oiled piece of parchment paper, pipe the mixture into rounds, starting in the center and moving outward in a spiral to form a 3-inch disk.
Bake for 2 hours, until crisp but not browned.
Cool on the Silpat or parchment, then carefully remove the meringues.
Set aside, uncovered, on a wire rack in a cool, dry place.
Increase oven temperature to 350°F.
Toss raspberries with remaining 1 tablespoon sugar and hazelnut oil.
Mound the berries on a baking sheet lined with Silpat or parchment paper and roast them for about 5 minutes, until glistening and very fragrant, but not mushy.
Remove from the oven.
Pour ⅓ cup of chilled hazelnut creme anglaise into the middle of a soup plate.
Place a cooled meringue in the center, then spoon ¼ of the roasted raspberries on top of each meringue.
Serve immediately.

name: Mesquite Chicken Sandwich
attribution: "Mesquite Chicken Sandwich" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mesquite_Chicken_Sandwich, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup mesquite wood chips, soaked in water 30 minutes
4 ciabatta rolls, split in half and toasted

steps: Preheat grill and toss chips onto coals.
Brush chicken with oil and season liberally with seasoning. Grill, turning often, until internal temperature reaches
Remove to a plate and cover tightly with aluminum foil. Add a slice of cheese to each one and let rest 5 minutes.
Brush both sides with sauce. Place 1 breast inside each bun and serve immediately.

name: Mexican Chocolate Cake with Mocha Buttercream
attribution: "Mexican Chocolate Cake with Mocha Buttercream" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mexican_Chocolate_Cake_with_Mocha_Buttercream, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 teaspoon cinnamon (increase to 2 teaspoons if using the semisweet chocolate)
1 cup plus 2 white granulated tablespoons sugar
Cinnamon, unsweetened cocoa, and confectioner's sugar, optional toppings

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Generously spray a deep 9-inch springform pan with nonstick cooking spray.
Melt the chocolates in a double boiler or in a microwave oven at low power.
Set aside to cool.
Sift together the flour, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon into a medium-size bowl.
Place the butter and sugar in a large mixing bowl and cream at high speed with an electric mixer.
Add the vanilla and the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.
Pour in the cooled chocolate mixture, and beat well until everything is incorporated.
Add ⅓ of the flour mixture, and stir until it is just barely incorporated, then pour in half the milk.
Stir briefly, then repeat with another ⅓ of the flour and the remaining milk.
Add the rest of the flour mixture and stir just enough to blend. Don't over mix, or the cake will toughen.
Spread into the prepared pan and bake for 55 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Cool completely before assembling and frosting.
Cut the cake into 3 equal layers, using a long serrated knife and a gentle sawing motion.
Spread mocha buttercream between the layers, and stack them evenly.
Spread more buttercream on the sides and the top.
Artfully sprinkle the top with extra cinnamon, cocoa, and confectioner's sugar, if desired.

name: Mexican Habanero Hot Sauce
attribution: "Mexican Habanero Hot Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mexican_Habanero_Hot_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a food processor and pulse until smooth.
Refrigerate in a non-reactive container for up to 2 months.

name: Mexican Rice I
attribution: "Mexican Rice I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mexican_Rice_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup chopped tomatoes (if canned, drain them)

steps: Over medium-high heat, fry the dry rice in oil until golden brown, stirring often.
Add onions and green peppers and cook until slightly softened.
Add tomatoes, spices, and water. Cover and cook for 20 minutes on low heat.

name: Mexican Seasoning
attribution: "Mexican Seasoning" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mexican_Seasoning, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 teaspoon or more of the following:

steps: Combine all ingredients.
Store in a cool, dry place.

name: Mexican Tomato Soup
attribution: "Mexican Tomato Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mexican_Tomato_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: About ½ litre tomato sauce, tomato purée, or similar
¼ cup (60 ml) vegetable or olive oil
More vegetables according to your taste

steps: Cut onion fine and fry lightly in a large saucepan with a bit of oil.
Add vegetables, roughly in the order you find logical (ie, tomatoes don't take long, peppers can be there from the start).

Add about ½ teaspoon salt, adjusting to taste. The salt will extract water from the vegetables and make them 'stew' faster. You can cover the pot if it goes slowly—once again, this slows the evaporation and allows the vegetables to cook in the water they lose themselves.
Add tomato sauce and corn.

Add salt and sugar to taste. Be bold; tomato sauce takes a lot of salt and at least a heaping teaspoon of sugar to taste right. If unsure, separate a small amount and try adding more salt—you will see the tastes changes significantly.
Serve with tortilla chips, or toasted bread if not available.

name: Microwave 1-2-3 Cake
attribution: "Microwave 1-2-3 Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Microwave_1-2-3_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Beat the egg until smooth.
Add the honey and milk and mix well.
Add the breadcrumbs and mix until uniform.
Let the mixture sit for a few minutes, to allow the breadcrumbs to absorb the moisture.
Pour the mixture into a small silicone mold (e.g. Dollar store loaf pan).
Microwave on high for 4 minutes or a little after it stops rising.
Allow to cool a little; tip out onto a plate if desired.
Top with more maple syrup or honey, if desired.

name: Microwave Applesauce
attribution: "Microwave Applesauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Microwave_Applesauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup Grade B Amber maple syrup (Grade A Dark Amber would be okay too)

steps: Combine all ingredients in a microwave-safe container.
Cover container, leaving 1 corner open, and microwave on high 7–8 minutes or until apples are easy to mash.
Remove cinnamon stick and discard.
For a chunky sauce, mash the apples with a potato masher. For a slightly smoother sauce, use a hand mixer. For a smooth pureé, use an immersion blender.

name: Microwave Chocolate Cake I
attribution: "Microwave Chocolate Cake I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Microwave_Chocolate_Cake_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 Tbsp vegetable oil (soybean or sunflower oils work best)

steps: Mix the dry ingredients well in a small bowl or large mug.
Add the egg and mix thoroughly.
Pour in the milk and oil and mix well.
Add vanilla essence and chocolate chips (if using), mix again.
Pour into two greased 9-inch round baking pans or keep in large mug.
Microwave on high for 3 minutes or until it stops rising.
Allow to cool a little; tip out onto a plate if desired.

name: Microwave Chocolate Cake II
attribution: "Microwave Chocolate Cake II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Microwave_Chocolate_Cake_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 tbsp (15 ml) chocolate chips, pine nuts, or hazelnuts

steps: Mix all the dry ingredients directly in a microwave-safe mug or bowl.
Add the egg and mix well.
Stir in the milk and oil.
Add the chocolate chips and vanilla. Stir well.
Microwave for 3 minutes at 1000w / 4 minutes at 700w / 3:30 minutes at 750w.
Cool slightly and enjoy.

name: Microwave Chocolate Chip Cookie
attribution: "Microwave Chocolate Chip Cookie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Microwave_Chocolate_Chip_Cookie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened at room temperature
¼ cup (45 g / 1.5 oz) light brown sugar
½ cup (70 g / 2.5 oz) all-purpose flour
½ cup (40 g / 1.5 oz) dark chocolate chips

steps: Line a large microwave-safe plate with parchment.
Beat the butter and sugar in a small bowl until light and fluffy.
Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Sift the flour and salt and fold into the butter mixture. Fold in most of the chocolate chips.
Scoop the dough into center of plate. Decorate with remaining chocolate chips.
Microwave the cookie for 1.5–2 minutes, depending on microwave's power.
Leave the cookie to cool.

name: Microwave Chocolate Pudding
attribution: "Microwave Chocolate Pudding" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Microwave_Chocolate_Pudding, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ⅓ cup (80 g) white granulated sugar or sugar substitute
¼ cup (60 g) unsweetened cocoa powder
2 cups (480 ml) milk or soy milk
1 tsp vanilla extract or imitation vanilla

steps: In a 1-qt microwave-safe bowl, mix the dry ingredients together.
Add the cold milk and mix well with a small wire whisk or an electric mixer until all the cocoa lumps have dissolved.
Microwave in the bowl, on high (100%) power, for 3 minutes. Stir well.
Microwave, again on high power, for an additional 4–6 minutes, stirring after each minute of cooking.
Remove the bowl from the microwave oven and stir in the vanilla.
Pour the result into 4 small custard cups and chill before serving.

name: Microwave Lemon Puddings
attribution: "Microwave Lemon Puddings" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Microwave_Lemon_Puddings, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 tablespoons homemade or purchased lemon curd

steps: Grease 4 ea. 150 ml microwave-safe ramekins.
Mix together the lemon curd and water in a bowl.
Spoon the mixture into the ramekins.
Beat the margarine and sugar together in another bowl.
Beat in the egg and lemon zest.
Fold in the flour, then mix in the lemon juice.
Divide the mixture between ramekins and smooth the tops.
Put the ramekins on a plate and microwave for 4 minutes. Let stand 1 minute.
Dust the puddings with powdered sugar and serve, optionally, with raspberries and crème fraîche.

name: Microwave Oat Porridge
attribution: "Microwave Oat Porridge" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Microwave_Oat_Porridge, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix water, oat flakes, and salt in a bowl.
Boil on high heat for 2–3 minutes.
Stir and serve immediately.

name: Microwave Quesadilla
attribution: "Microwave Quesadilla" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Microwave_Quesadilla, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: About ¼ cup (30 ml) meltable shredded cheese (typically Monterey Jack cheese, but others are okay)
At least one of the following fillings:
Fresh spinach, washed and torn into small pieces
Canned lback beans, rinsed and well drained

steps: Place one tortilla on a microwave-safe plate.
Cover with half the cheese and sprinkle on fillings as desired.
Spread remaining cheese over the toppings, and place second tortilla on top.
Microwave on high power for 30–60 seconds (or until cheese is melted and fillings are warm).
Add desired toppings and enjoy.

name: Microwave Risotto
attribution: "Microwave Risotto" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Microwave_Risotto, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 cups (750 ml/1.6 pints) simmering hot chicken broth
1 dash ground white or black pepper
½ cup (90 g/3.2 oz) minced yellow onion
1 cup (125 g/4.4 oz) uncooked medium grain rice

steps: In a saucepan, bring chicken broth, salt and pepper to a low simmer, and keep warm until needed.
In an oven-proof dish (or 10-inch/25 cm quiche dish), heat oil and butter in microwave for 2 minutes.
Add minced onion to the dish, stir to coat with oil, and cook in microwave for 4 minutes.
Add uncooked rice to the dish, stir to coat with oil, and cook in microwave for another 4 minutes.
Pour simmering chicken broth into the dish and stir well. Microwave 9 minutes.
Stir rice and chicken broth well and microwave another 9 minutes.
If a creamier risotto is desired, add ¼ cup (60 ml) warm water, stir well and microwave for another 2 minutes.

name: Microwaved Artichoke
attribution: "Microwaved Artichoke" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Microwaved_Artichoke, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Dips, such as drawn butter or mayonnaise

steps: Cut off top ⅓ of the artichoke, and all but 1 inch of the stem.
Remove base leaves and cut off the tips of the higher leaves.
Sprinkle artichoke with lemon juice to preserve color.
Place artichoke stem up in a microwave-safe dish tall enough to place lid without touching the artichoke.
Fill dish with 1 inch (3 cm) of water and any of the seasonings.
Cover and microwave on high for 6–8 minutes, and allow to rest for 1–2 minutes. The artichoke is cooked when a paring knife can be inserted into the heart without resistance.
Remove artichoke from the dish and place upside down to drain.
Serve whole, with one or more dips. Diners should remove a leaf, dip the base of the leaf in the dip, and eat the fleshy base of the leaf.
When all the leaves are gone, remove the choke, cut the heart of the artichoke into bite sized pieces, and serve with the dip.

name: Microwaved Basmati Rice
attribution: "Microwaved Basmati Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Microwaved_Basmati_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Add rice and salt to the rice cooker.
Mix in boiling water, then fit the double lids on.
Cook as follows, stirring halfway through:
* 700W for 13 minutes, or
* 750W for 12 minutes, or
* 800W for 11 minutes, or
* 850W for 10 minutes.
Let stand for 5 minutes, then drain in a sieve.
Spread the rice onto an oven paper-lined tray and warming it at a very low setting in a conventional oven. Turn the rice gently from time to time.

name: Middle Eastern Lamb Kabobs
attribution: "Middle Eastern Lamb Kabobs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Middle_Eastern_Lamb_Kabobs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pound (450 g) leg of lamb (shank end), cut into 1½ inch cubes

steps: Combine all ingredients except lamb in a gallon size zip-top bag. Add lamb cubes and toss to coat; refrigerate overnight to marinate.
The next day, drain lamb and discard marinade.
Thread 4 lamb cubes onto one skewer. Repeat until all lamb has been skewered.
Fire up a charcoal grill for 15 minutes. Add lamb and cook 8 minutes per side for medium rare.
Serve warm with couscous.

name: Middle Eastern Meatballs
attribution: "Middle Eastern Meatballs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Middle_Eastern_Meatballs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup packed cilantro, chopped coriander
¼ cup packed flat-leaf parsley, chopped

steps: In a small bowl, whisk together the yogurt, garlic, and mint. Season to taste with salt.
Set the broiler rack 5 inches from the heat.
Preheat the broiler.
In a mixing bowl, combine the meat, rice, onion, cilantro, parsley, cinnamon, cumin, red and black peppers, and ½ teaspoon salt, stirring mixture with a fork until it is well blended
With your hands, form the mixture into 1½-inch meatballs.
As you make them, place the meatballs on a baking sheet that fits under the broiler.
Broil the meatballs until they are well browned on top, 4 to 5 minutes.
Using tongs, turn and cook until the meatballs are browned outside and no longer pink in the center, 3–4 minutes.
Transfer them to a serving plate and serve warm, passing the yogurt sauce in a bowl.

name: Midwestern Chicken Wings
attribution: "Midwestern Chicken Wings" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Midwestern_Chicken_Wings, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 12 ounces apricot preserves (not preserved apricots, not apricot jelly)

steps: Place all ingredients except chicken into a bowl and mix to make a marinade.

Marinate the chicken in the refrigerator with the marinade for at least 3 hours. A plastic bag sealed tight without much air or free space is believed to provide the best marinating. As with many marinating recipes, the longer the better.
Clean and preheat grill to medium heat.
Place wings on grill. Turn 1–4 times over the next 20 minutes.

name: Mild Salty Lassi
attribution: "Mild Salty Lassi" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mild_Salty_Lassi, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ teaspoon mint (finely crumbled, dried; optional)

steps: Dry-roast cumin seeds by cooking them over low heat in a small pan until you can smell the seasoning (about 2–3 minutes). Cool and grind.
In blender, blend cumin seed powder with yoghurt, milk, lemon juice, salt, and ice cubes.
Serve chilled, optionally garnished with crumbled mint and a small pinch of cayenne.

name: Milk Chocolate Pepper Vodka Tart
attribution: "Milk Chocolate Pepper Vodka Tart" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Milk_Chocolate_Pepper_Vodka_Tart, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 roasted red bell peppers, packed in oil
10 ounces milk chocolate, cut into pieces

steps: Place sugar, butter, egg and vanilla in a mixing bowl, and mix at low speed until combined.
Add flour and mix until incorporated; do not over mix.
Set the dough on a floured cookie pan and press flat.
Refrigerate until firm enough to roll out, 45 minutes to an hour.
After making filling, line an 11-inch cake pan with the crust.
Line the bottom of the unbaked tart shell with a single thin layer of red bell peppers that have been wiped free of most of the oil.
Melt chocolate and butter over low heat in a saucepan.
Stir in vanilla.
Take off the heat and add pepper vodka and let cool slightly.
While the chocolate mixture is cooling, whip the sugar and eggs until light and fluffy.
Fold into cooled chocolate mixture.
Sift the flour into this mixture, making sure there are no lumps.
Preheat oven to 350°F.
Pour chocolate mixture on top of red bell pepper layer, leaving ¾ inch at the top of pan.
Bake for about 20 minutes. The center should be soft, similar to a pumpkin pie when it is done.
Let cool before taking it out of the pan.
Refrigerate overnight before cutting.
Whip cream and confectioners' sugar until peaks are thick, then slowly whip in vodka.
When vodka is completely mixed in, add melted white chocolate while whisking.
Refrigerate for 4 hours.
Top each piece with plenty of whipped cream, sprinkle lightly with nutmeg and enjoy.

name: Milk Toast I
attribution: "Milk Toast I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Milk_Toast_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pint (570 ml) milk, part cream if the person is not forbidden that

steps: Heat the milk to the simmering point.
Generously butter the toast slices.
Heat a pretty bowl, deeper than it is wide. Break the hot buttered toast into it, pour the steaming but not boiling milk over it, sprinkle a little salt and pepper on the top, and serve at once.

name: Milk Toast II
attribution: "Milk Toast II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Milk_Toast_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Gradually add cold water to flour to make a smooth, thin paste.
Add paste to milk, stirring constantly until thickened.
Cover, and cook 20 minutes; then, add salt and butter in small pieces.
Dip slices of toast separately in sauce; when soft, remove to serving dish. Pour remaining sauce over all.

name: Mince Pie with Meat I
attribution: "Mince Pie with Meat I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mince_Pie_with_Meat_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 454 g (1 lb) butter, lard, or vegetable shortening, diced
1815 g (4 lb) cored and sliced apples
1 citrus fruit (e.g. orange), zested and juiced

steps: Sear diced beef in a pan until well-coloured (this can be done in batches). Set aside until cool.
Combined all ingredients except dough in a bowl. Mix well (this step can be done in batches).
Use the pastry dough to line 3 deep, greased pie pans (or 5 greased muffin pans, for tartlets) and create pie shells.
Place shells into oven and set to 150 °C (300 °F). Bake until lightly golden. Remove from oven and let rest until cooled.
Fill pie shells with filling mixture until level or slightly mounded above the rim. Trim with excess pastry.
Bake at 150 °C (300 °F) for 45 minutes per tray (or 35 minutes per muffin tray).

name: Minestrone alla Capucina
attribution: "Minestrone alla Capucina" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Minestrone_alla_Capucina, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Pound anchovy.
Fry it in butter with the onion and rice until the rice is golden brown.
Remove the onion and season with salt.
Gradually add some stock, cooking until the dish is of the consistency of rice pudding.

name: Minestrone alla Casalinga
attribution: "Minestrone alla Casalinga" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Minestrone_alla_Casalinga, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Blanch vegetables in boiling salted water, then drain them and fry in butter.
Add plenty of good stock, and put over low heat.
Boil rice in stock until well-done. Add the stock and vegetables.
Season with minestrone seasoning condiment, and serve with grated cheese handed separately.

name: Mini English Muffin Pizzas
attribution: "Mini English Muffin Pizzas" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mini_English_Muffin_Pizzas, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Slice English muffins in half.
Spoon 1 tbsp pizza sauce on each English muffin half and spread evenly.
Place 4 pepperoni slices on each English muffin half.
Cover each mini pizza with ¼ cup mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 10 minutes/
Let cool then eat.

name: Mini Three-Cheese English Muffin Pizzas
attribution: "Mini Three-Cheese English Muffin Pizzas" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mini_Three-Cheese_English_Muffin_Pizzas, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 large English muffins, split and buttered

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Sprinkle buttered muffins with Parmesan cheese.
Toast under broiler until golden brown.
Place 1½ tablespoons of shredded cheddar cheese on each muffin.
Cut frankfurters crosswise in ¼-inch slices; arrange on muffins.
Top each with about 2 tablespoons of pizza sauce, and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of mozzarella cheese.
Bake 12–15 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

name: Mint Tea
attribution: "Mint Tea" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mint_Tea, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Boil the water in a kettle.
Pour the boiling water into the teapot.
Put the mint leaves in the teapot. Let steep for several minutes.
Pour some hot tea in a cup and dilute with additional water. Even if it starts to look transparent, the taste is still there.

name: Mirepoix Sauce
attribution: "Mirepoix Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mirepoix_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: a bunch of herbs (such as parsley, thyme, sage, rosemary)

steps: Combine bacon, ham, carrot, onions, herbs, mushrooms, cloves, and peppercorns in a stew pan.
Add the stock and Chablis.
Boil rapidly for 10 minutes, then simmer until it is reduced to a third of its former volume.
Pass through a sieve and use for masking meat, fowl, fish, etc.

name: Mirliton Casserole
attribution: "Mirliton Casserole" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mirliton_Casserole, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 medium to large green bell pepper, diced
1 lb (500 g) whole shrimp, peeled OR ½ lb (250 g) ground beef (optional)
1 stick (½ cup / 113 g) butter (olive oil may be substituted)

steps: Place mirliton halves seed-side up in a microwave- or oven-safe dish with approximately 1 inch (2.5cm) of water in the dish. Cover with foil (for oven) or plastic wrap (for microwave) and cook in oven (350°F/175°C) or microwave (high at 10 minute intervals) until mirliton are soft enough to stick a fork or knife through easily. Allow mirliton to cool enough to be handled and dice into large pieces.
Sauté onion, celery, and garlic in butter over medium heat, adding garlic to sauté just before onion, celery, and garlic are fully softened.
Add shrimp or beef to pan until beef is lightly browned or until shrimp is just turning pink. Skip this step if you aren't adding meat.
Incorporate mirliton and bay leaf and allow to simmer for 5–10 minutes.
Remove from heat and add salt, pepper, and parsley to taste. Pour mixture into a casserole dish and cover with bread crumbs.
Bake in the oven at 350°F (175°C) until the mirliton is bubbling and the bread crumbs are browned.

name: Miso Soup
attribution: "Miso Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Miso_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cake tofu (optional), cut into ½-inch cubes

steps: Heat oil in a small pot.
Add green onion. Cook for a few minutes while stirring frequently.
Add 2 ½ cups of water. Bring to a boil.
Dissolve miso in remaining ½ cup of water and add to pot.
Lower heat and add mushrooms, seaweed, and tofu, if desired.

name: Miso Soup (Traditional)
attribution: "Miso Soup (Traditional)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Miso_Soup_(Traditional), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 90–94% by volume dashi (consider using instant dashi mix)
6–10% by volume miso (red, white, or a combination)
Finely sliced and deep-fried tofu (agedashi tofu)
Konbu (kelp), perhaps left over from making dashi

steps: Put dashi in a pot.
Add any garnish that needs cooking.
Heat the dashi, letting it simmer to cook any garnish that needs cooking. Do not bring to a rolling boil, as this degrades the flavor.
Add any garnish that does not need cooking, and remove from heat.
Add the miso to the soup. Avoid boiling the miso; some nuances of the flavor will be lost.

name: Miyan Karkashi (Nigerian Sesame Leaf Soup)
attribution: "Miyan Karkashi (Nigerian Sesame Leaf Soup)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Miyan_Karkashi_(Nigerian_Sesame_Leaf_Soup), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup karkashi leaves, either fresh or dried and ground

steps: Grind the karkashi leaves to a paste.
Bring the water to boil in a pot, and stir in the fermented locust beans.
Add the fish and meat, and cook for 5–7 minutes.
Add the karkashi leaf paste along with the potash. Stir, and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the seasoning cube. Continue stirring with a whisk for 3 minutes until the mixture is smooth.
Serve the soup with tuwo masara, tuwo dawa, tuwo alkama, or tuwo shinkafa.

name: Miyan Kubewa (Okra Soup)
attribution: "Miyan Kubewa (Okra Soup)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Miyan_Kubewa_(Okra_Soup), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 500 g beef, goat, or assorted meat (optional: cow tripe, kidney, or liver)
1–2 ea. smoked fish or dried fish (optional)
2 cups fresh chopped or grated okra (or 1½ cups dried okra)
Fresh or dried ground Scotch bonnet chile (to taste)

steps: In a pot, combine your cleaned meat, chopped onions, seasoning cubes, and a pinch of salt. Add a little water and simmer until the meat is cooked through and tender to your taste. This can take a while for tough cuts of meat.
If using smoked or dried fish, add it along with the ground locust beans (dawadawa). Allow it to simmer for 5–10 minutes.
Pour in the palm oil and stir well. Let it cook for a few minutes to combine the flavors.
Stir in the okra. If using dried okra, you may need to add some extra water. Stir continuously to encourage the characteristic "draw" (slippery texture).
Sprinkle in the ground crayfish and pepper. Adjust salt and seasoning to taste.
Allow the soup to simmer for another 5–10 minutes. Avoid overcooking the okra to maintain its texture.

name: Miyan Kuka (Baobab Leaf Soup)
attribution: "Miyan Kuka (Baobab Leaf Soup)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Miyan_Kuka_(Baobab_Leaf_Soup), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Soak the dried fish in cold water. Debone when soft.
Grind the crayfish with dawadawa. Pound the pepper.
Cook the cow ribs with water, stock cube, salt, and onions until the meat is tender. Remove the onions, then the beef, reserving the stock in the pot.
Stir the kuka powder into the reserved stock until smooth, with no lumps.
Stir in pounded pepper, crayfish and dawa dawa mixture, and palm oil.
Add the deboned fish, cover, and cook 5 minutes over medium heat.
Stir in beef, and add salt to taste. Cook for 2 minutes.
Serve with tuwo shinkafa or tuwo masara.

name: Miyan Lalo (Hausa Jute Leaf Soup)
attribution: "Miyan Lalo (Hausa Jute Leaf Soup)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Miyan_Lalo_(Hausa_Jute_Leaf_Soup), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup dried ground chile pepper (adjust to taste)
2 bunches of fresh jute (lalo) leaves, chopped
2 medium pieces of daddawa (fermented locust bean), pounded

steps: In a pot, boil the meat with the stock cube, half of the chopped onion, and just enough water to cover the meat. Cook until the meat is tender.
Add the chopped jute leaves and potash. Cook for 5–10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Blend the remaining onion with the chile pepper and a small amount of water to form a purée. Add this mixture to the pot along with the pounded daddawa.
Stir well and simmer for another 2 minutes, then remove from heat. Serve hot with tuwo (e.g., Tuwon Semo, Tuwon Masara, Tuwon Shinkafa, Semovita or Fufu).

name: Miyan Ridi (Nigerian Sesame Soup)
attribution: "Miyan Ridi (Nigerian Sesame Soup)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Miyan_Ridi_(Nigerian_Sesame_Soup), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 500 g beef, cut into bite-sized pieces
2 cups toasted sesame seeds (ridi), blended into a paste
2 medium-sized dried smoked fish, cleaned and deboned

steps: In a pot, boil the beef with the chopped onion, seasoning cubes, and a little water until the meat is tender.
Blend the toasted sesame seeds into a smooth paste using a blender or grinding stone.
In a separate pot, heat the palm oil over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and blended red bell pepper, then fry for 5–7 minutes until fragrant.
Add the cooked beef and some of the beef stock. Stir in the smoked fish and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the ground sesame seed paste. Stir continuously to avoid lumps, and cook for about 10 minutes. Add water as needed to reach desired consistency.
Add the chopped spinach, stir, and turn off the heat after 1–2 minutes.
Serve hot with tuwo shinkafa, pounded yam, wheat, or other swallow of choice.

name: Miyan Shuwaka (Hausa Bitter Leaf Soup)
attribution: "Miyan Shuwaka (Hausa Bitter Leaf Soup)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Miyan_Shuwaka_(Hausa_Bitter_Leaf_Soup), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 pieces fresh red chile pepper, puréed

steps: If using fresh bitter leaf, wash with salt and squeeze to reduce the bitterness.
Boil the meat in a pot of water for a few minutes until cooked through. Remove the meat and set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium heat, and add the palm oil. Add the onion, pepper, and tomatoes, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Combine the cooked purée, meat, and bitterleaf in a pot. Add enough water to cover everything.
Add the daddawa, stir the soup well, and cook for 3 more minutes over low heat.
Season with salt to taste and serve.
Tuwo shinkafa (rice swallow)
Tuwo masara (maize swallow)
Tuwon dawa (sorghum swallow)
Semovita
Eba
Fufu

name: Miyan Taushe (Hausa Pumpkin Soup)
attribution: "Miyan Taushe (Hausa Pumpkin Soup)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Miyan_Taushe_(Hausa_Pumpkin_Soup), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2–3 tablespoons palm oil or groundnut oil
1 cup chopped spinach, ugu leaf, or yakuwa leaf (optional)
Mixing bowl (optional, for dissolving groundnut paste or soaking dried fish)

steps: Place the meat in a pot. Add chopped onion, seasoning cubes, salt, and enough water to cover everything. Simmer until the meat is cooked through and tender to your taste—this can take a while for tough cuts of meat.
Add pumpkin chunks to the pot. Cook until they become soft (about 10–15 minutes), then gently mash some of the pumpkin to thicken the soup.
Add groundnut paste if using, daddawa, palm oil, chile pepper, and fish. Stir well and simmer for another 10 minutes.
Add your leafy vegetables and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add water if needed to get your desired soup thickness.

name: Mocha Buttercream
attribution: "Mocha Buttercream" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mocha_Buttercream, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3½ cups confectioner's sugar (possibly a little more)
½ cup very strong brewed coffee

steps: Combine butter, confectioner's sugar, cocoa, vanilla, and coffee in a medium-large bowl, mixing slowly until everything is moistened.
Beat at high speed with an electric mixer until uniform and fluffy.
If it seems a little too wet to spread, you can beat in up to ½ cup additional confectioner's sugar.

name: Mocha Delight
attribution: "Mocha Delight" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mocha_Delight, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 bag Dove Rich Dark Chocolate Hearts

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Line bottom of 9-inch springform pan with waxed paper; grease.
Add melted butter to graham cracker crumbs and press into bottom of pan.
Prepare brownie mix according to package instructions; spread over crumbs.
Bake until firm, approximately 35 to 50 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Remove from oven to a wire rack; cool completely and remove from pan.
Whisk egg whites and sugar together in a bowl over simmering water until sugar is dissolved.
Remove from heat; using electric mixer, whip until fluffy and cooled.
Add butter one nugget at a time while continuing to beat.
Dissolve espresso powder in warm water.
Beat espresso into frosting.
Frost top and sides of cake.
Snip small corner of a resealable plastic bag; place whipped cream inside.
Pipe 3 rosettes around outside edges of cake.
Place a chocolate heart atop each rosette.
Place 8 chocolate hearts in a small resealable plastic bag.
Microwave until melted, about 15 seconds.
Cut a corner of the bag; randomly drizzle chocolate on dessert plates.
Place a cake wedge on each plate.

name: Mocha Icing
attribution: "Mocha Icing" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mocha_Icing, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: An hour before baking the cake, take the butter out of the refrigerator to reach room temperature.
Cream the butter.
Add the cocoa and liquids alternately. Then. add the sugar alternately with the liquids.
Stop at spreading consistency even if you have not used all the sugar.
Spread on a hot milk cake or other cake.

name: Mock Hollandaise Sauce II
attribution: "Mock Hollandaise Sauce II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mock_Hollandaise_Sauce_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Melt the butter—it should not get brown, just melted.
Add the cream and the egg yolks.
Add the pepper and the nutmeg.
Heat up with a finger in the sauce and do not stop mixing.
When you cannot bear the heat, remove from the heat and serve.

name: Modeling Chocolate
attribution: "Modeling Chocolate" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Modeling_Chocolate, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Glucose, corn, or golden syrup as indicated by the below table, plus more as needed
2.5:1 / ⅝ cup (180 g) Dark chocolate (50% cocoa solids)
2:1 / ⅔ cup (210 g) Dark chocolate (70%+ cocoa solids)

steps: Melt chocolate in a bowl using a microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring between each interval until fully melting.
Leave to cool slightly to temperature around 35 °C (95 °F).
Combine in syrup, slowly mixing well to thicken the mixture.
Transfer to a cling film, wrap and flatten, and leave to cool completely.
Knead the modeling chocolate until pliable and smooth.

name: Mohingha (Burmese Fish Noodle Soup)
attribution: "Mohingha (Burmese Fish Noodle Soup)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mohingha_(Burmese_Fish_Noodle_Soup), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: In a large bowl, mix sunflower oil, garlic cloves, soup powder, and lemonade for 3 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix boiling water, diced jalapeño peppers, and ketchup for 5 minutes.
Combine both mixtures, and continue mixing for 2 ½ minutes.
Add rice vermicelli to the bowl; cover it and wait for 10 minutes.
Top it with toppings as desired.

name: Moin Moin (Nigerian Bean Pudding)
attribution: "Moin Moin (Nigerian Bean Pudding)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Moin_Moin_(Nigerian_Bean_Pudding), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: About 2 milk tins of black-eyed peas, or other beans
About 2–3 tbsp palm or vegetable oil

steps: Place the beans in a large container. Cover them with water, and soak for about 1 hour.
Blend all the peppers with the onion to make a smooth paste.
Prepare foil or empty cans as molds for cooking.
* If using empty cans, make sure their interior is clean, and lightly greased.
* If using foil:
*#Tear off about 1 foot (30 cm) of the foil.
*#Fold the foil in half.
*#One of the edges is closed and fine. For two of the other edges, roll them a few times over to make sure they will take the weight of the mixture (at least an inch-worth of rolling).
*#When you are done, the foil will look like rectangles with only one edge open.
Rub the beans between your hands to peel the skin off. The skin should float to the top of the container. Keep doing this until you have most of the skin off the beans.
Grind the beans into a smooth, finely-ground, mostly-liquid paste.
Add blended mix of scotch bonnet peppers, bell peppers and onions, a few teaspoons of oil, a little salt, and the optional ingredients as desired.
Transfer the mixture into the intended mould:
* If using cans, simply pour some of the batter into the cans, making sure you leave enough room for the moin moin to expand.
* If using foil, pour some of the batter into the foil, and then close up the last edge of the foil by rolling it securely.

* If using the leaves, wrap the leaves into an open cone. Fold the bottom of the cone to prevent the mix from leaking out. Place some of the mixture to fill half the cone. Roll the top of the cone and fold it. Place the cone in such a way as to keep the folded portion flat against the cooking surface, which should also be lined with the leaves.
Bring water to boil in a large pot. The water should at least cover the bottom of the pot. Less water is needed if you use the leaves. Add the filled moin moin molds.
Leave the moin moin to steam for at least 30 minutes until it solidifies.
Remove them from the cans or the foil before serving.
Serve with rice, meat, custard, pap or other side dishes as desired.
Grind the peeled beans alongside the pepper and onion to give a smooth paste.
Add grounded Maggi, salt, and vegetable oil to the paste, and stir with a wooden spoon to make the ingredients uniform.
Preheat oven to 200°C (390°F).
Rub vegetable oil in the muffin cups and pour the moi moi mixture inside.
Fold aluminum foil to the sides of the up to prevent the moi moi from drying up.
Pour water in an oven tray and place the muffin cups in the tray
Bake for 45 minutes, replenishing the water as necessary to prevent it from drying up.
Leave to cool down and remove from oven when done.

name: Monkey Bread I
attribution: "Monkey Bread I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Monkey_Bread_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 cans of biscuit dough, each biscuit cut into quarters

steps: Combine cinnamon and sugar for rolling.
Roll biscuit sections in sugar mixture, placing in greased bundt pan or high-sided cake pan. Do not pack tightly.
Bring glaze ingredients to a boil, then pour over the dough in the pan.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 40–50 minutes.
Invert onto plate, and serve warm.

name: Monte Cristo Sandwich
attribution: "Monte Cristo Sandwich" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Monte_Cristo_Sandwich, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Butter the first slice of bread and cover with ham and chicken.
Butter the middle slice on both sides, place on meat, and cover with cheese.
Butter the third slice and place, butter down, over cheese.
Trim crusts, then cut sandwich in two and secure with toothpicks
Dip in light egg batter, and fry in butter on all sides until golden brown.
Remove toothpicks and serve with currant jelly, strawberry jam, or cranberry sauce.

name: Monterey Jack Chicken Breasts
attribution: "Monterey Jack Chicken Breasts" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Monterey_Jack_Chicken_Breasts, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup shredded Monterrey Jack cheese

steps: Brush both sides of chicken with olive oil. Sprinkle liberally with salt, freshly ground black pepper, and 1 pinch of cumin.
Place in a large roasting pan and insert a probe thermometer into one of the breasts. Bake in the center of a 400°F oven until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove and sprinkle with cheese. Place back in oven until cheese is melted.
Serve warm.

name: Montreal Russian Borscht
attribution: "Montreal Russian Borscht" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Montreal_Russian_Borscht, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can stewed tomatoes, or an equivalent amount of fresh tomatoes

steps: Fill large stock pot with water. Add can stewed tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar, salt, onion, garlic, and beets, and boil for 20 minutes.
Add carrots, cabbage, and potato.
Return to a boil and cook for 1.5 hours

name: Moqueca de Peixe (Brazilian Seafood Stew)
attribution: "Moqueca de Peixe (Brazilian Seafood Stew)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Moqueca_de_Peixe_(Brazilian_Seafood_Stew), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 kg fresh white fish, cut into two finger-wide strips/slices
2 mid-sized onions, cut into circular slices
2 bell peppers (one red, one green), cut into circular slices
4 ripe tomatoes, optionally skinned then chopped
4 cilantro stems with leaves, finely chopped
12 tablespoons Azeite de dendê (a very tasty, heavy, saffron-colored palm oil, which may not be omitted under any circumstances)

steps: Leave the fish in a marinade made out of lemon juice and fine powdered pepper for at least 1 hour.
Put the fish, onions, bell peppers, garlic, tomatoes and the cilantro in numerous layers into a pot.

Pour the azeite de dendê and the coconut milk over all, and boil everything for 20 minutes. From time to time, ladle/scoop the liquid from the pot's bottom to its top. Be careful, in order to not break the fish!
Season to taste with salt.
Serve with white rice.

name: Morel Mushroom Sauce
attribution: "Morel Mushroom Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Morel_Mushroom_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 cups gray morel mushrooms, cut into slices less than 1 inch long
¼ cup thinly-sliced green onion tops

steps: In a 12-inch non-stick skillet, heat the butter over medium-high heat until foaming.
Add the morels and sauté, stirring occasionally, for 15–20 minutes until slightly crispy.
Add the onion tops, parsley, nutmeg, pepper, and salt and cook for a few minutes
Turn up the heat, add wine, and reduce to almost a glaze
Turn heat to medium and add the cream and mustard. Reduce slightly over slow boil until thickened—about 10–12 minutes.
Serve.

name: Moroccan Salad
attribution: "Moroccan Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Moroccan_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 handful of fresh coriander, finely chopped

steps: Cut the tomatoes, pepper and onion into small dice.
Add the fresh coriander, cumin, salt, pepper, and vinegar.
Put it all into a container, put the lid on tightly, and give it a good shake to combine everything.
Let rest for 30 minutes to allow the flavours to mingle before serving.

name: Moroccan Soup
attribution: "Moroccan Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Moroccan_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 350 g lamb meat or 4 chicken breasts, chopped
400 g diced tomatoes (with garlic if possible)
200 g dried apricots divided into 8 portions

steps: Fry the onion lightly in oil.
Add spices and the rest of the ingredients, and cook until ready. The cooking time depends on the meat used and on whether carrots and sweet potatoes are added.

name: Moussaka (Bulgarian)
