attribution: "Moussaka (Bulgarian)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Moussaka_(Bulgarian), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ kg minced meat (usually pork in Bulgaria, but don't hesitate to experiment!)
1 kg potatoes, peeled and finely chopped

steps: Fry the onion and the minced meat in a little oil until the meat is cooked. The fattier the meat is, the less oil you need.
Combine meat and onions with the potatoes, tomatoes, and parsley. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer to a baking dish. Bake for about 1 hour, or until the potatoes are cooked.
Stir the eggs, the yogurt and the flour together and pour it over the dish. Bake for 10 more minutes.

name: Mozzarella Sticks
attribution: "Mozzarella Sticks" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mozzarella_Sticks, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat deep fryer to 350°F (175°C).
Slice mozzarella into sticks 1–3 cm in diameter.
In a small bowl, whisk egg.
Fill another small bowl with bread crumbs.
Dip 3–4 sticks at a time into the egg.
Shake excess egg off sticks and place them in the bread crumbs.
Shake bowl of bread crumbs, evenly coating all sticks. Add more bread crumbs as needed.
Place coated sticks to the side and repeat for remaining sticks.
After all sticks have been coated, repeat the egg-dip and crumb-coat for each once more.
Place all sticks in fryer basket and submerge in 350°F oil.
Let sit for 30 seconds, gently rocking basket occasionally.

Lift basket and let cool for a few seconds. If cheese is not beginning to ooze out from half the sticks, re-submerge in oil for another 10–15 seconds, gently shaking the basket. Repeat until the cheese is just starting to ooze out.
Dump onto paper towel and pat off excess oil gently.
Serve hot.

name: Mozzarella Tuna Melts
attribution: "Mozzarella Tuna Melts" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mozzarella_Tuna_Melts, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (6 ounces) water-packed tuna, drained and flaked

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In a small bowl, combine tuna, celery, onion and mayonnaise.
Spread on bottom of buns.
Top tuna mixture with a slice of cheese and tomato.
Place on an ungreased baking sheet.
Bake for 12–15 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted.
Top each with a lettuce leaf; replace bun tops.

name: Msemmen
attribution: "Msemmen" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Msemmen, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix the flour, semolina, salt, sugar, and yeast in a bowl.
Gradually add warm water and knead until a smooth dough forms.
Divide the dough into small balls and let rest for 30 minutes.
Flatten each ball into a thin sheet.
Brush with oil and butter, then fold into a square.
Let the folded squares rest for 15 minutes.
Flatten gently and cook on a hot griddle until golden brown on both sides.
Serve warm with honey, jam, tea, or savory accompaniments.

name: Muffuletta Sandwich
attribution: "Muffuletta Sandwich" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Muffuletta_Sandwich, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 muffuletta bread loaf (or other round bread loaf, approximately 10 inches/25 cm in diameter)

steps: Slice bread loaf in half horizontally and spread each cut side with olive spread.
For the authentic Central Grocery muffuletta, layer bottom half of the loaf with salami, ham, Swiss cheese, provolone, mortadella, and a second layer of salami.
Cover with top half of the loaf and press down.
Quarter the muffuletta and serve or wrap the muffuletta tightly in plastic wrap to save for later.

name: Mukimo
attribution: "Mukimo" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mukimo, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups pumpkin leaves, spinach, or kale, chopped

steps: Place the potatoes, maize, and peas in a large pot and cover with water.
Bring to a boil and cook until the potatoes are tender.
Add the chopped vegetables and continue cooking for 5–10 minutes.
Drain excess water if necessary.
Mash all the ingredients together until well combined.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve hot with beef stew, chicken stew, or grilled meat.

name: Mulling Spice with Anise
attribution: "Mulling Spice with Anise" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mulling_Spice_with_Anise, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix ingredients together well.
Store in closed jar.
Mix ¼ cup (150 g) of spice mixture per 16 cups (4 L) of wine, cider, or apple juice.
Simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve hot in mugs with cinnamon stick stirrers or fill a punch bowl and garnish with orange slices.

name: Mung Bean and Brown Rice Curry
attribution: "Mung Bean and Brown Rice Curry" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mung_Bean_and_Brown_Rice_Curry, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan.
Add the mustard seeds.
When they begin to pop, add the turmeric and fold in the rice and beans until coated with oil.
Add the rest of the spices and water.
Simmer for about 45 minutes; most of the water will be absorbed.
Remove from heat and add vegetables.
Make the marinade and pour mix in.

name: Musakhan (Palestinian Spiced Chicken)
attribution: "Musakhan (Palestinian Spiced Chicken)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Musakhan_(Palestinian_Spiced_Chicken), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 10 rolls of either Arabic village bread (markouk, or taboun or tannour) or spring roll pastry

steps: Fry the chicken with the onion.
Add the salt and the peppers before the chicken is done, and add the sumac 5 minutes from the end of cooking.
Fry the raw nuts until they are golden. Add them to the chicken and onions
Roll the mixture in the spring roll pastry, and deep fry them.
Take the spring rolls out of the oil and let them dry on cooking paper.
Serve them hot or cold.

name: Mushroom Bao Buns
attribution: "Mushroom Bao Buns" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mushroom_Bao_Buns, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 25 mm piece fresh ginger, peeled and grated

steps: Combine the flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, and yeast in a bowl.
Add the water and milk. Mix until you get a sticky dough.
Turn the dough out onto a work surface, and knead well for 10 minutes. The dough should no longer be very sticky once you have finished.
Transfer the dough back to a bowl, and cover with plastic wrap or a damp towel. Let rest in a warm place for 1 hour or until doubled in size.
Gently deflate the dough, and transfer it to your work surface.
Roll the dough into an even sausage shape, and cut into 15 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball, then flatten and roll with a rolling pin into an oval. The oval should not be too much longer than it is wide.
Brush the ovals with oil, then fold each in half with the oil on the inside. It should look like a taco shell or a purse. Don't pinch the edges together.
Cover the buns with greased plastic wrap, and let rest for 20 minutes.
Bring a few inches of water to a boil in a steamer. Place the buns in the basket, and steam for 20 minutes.
Remove from the steamer.
Heat a skillet over medium heat, and add 2–3 tablespoons of vegetable oil.
Add the onions to the pan, and stir to coat with the oil.

Cover the pan, and turn the heat down to medium-low. Let the onions cook, stirring occasionally. As they cook, they should wilt and start to soften. Keep stirring every couple minutes to distribute the browning that accumulates at the bottom of the skillet and prevent burning.

Once the onions are a light golden color (it will take a while—be patient), remove the lid and continue cooking until deeply browned to your liking. Note that the more browned they get, the greater the risk of sticking and burning to the pan—pay attention near the end.
Remove the caramelized onions from the heat and set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium heat, then add 15 ml (1 tbsp) vegetable oil.
Add the mushrooms, and fry over medium heat for 3–4 minutes until softened.
Stir in the sesame oil, caramelized onions, ginger, garlic, vinegar, soy sauce, stock, maple syrup, and chile flakes. Cook for another 5–6 minutes until everything is soft and fragrant.
Remove the filling from the heat.

name: Mushroom Barley Bean Soup
attribution: "Mushroom Barley Bean Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mushroom_Barley_Bean_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Vegetable or chicken soup mix or stock

steps: Soak the beans for several hours and set aside.
In a large pot (the same one you'll make the soup in), sauté onion for about 3 minutes.
Add carrots and zucchini; sauté 5 minutes more.
Add mushrooms, and sauté until they release all their liquid.
Add the water, barley, beans, spices, and stock (or soup mix).
Cook for a few hours.

name: Mushroom Caps Stuffed with Bacon and Cheese
attribution: "Mushroom Caps Stuffed with Bacon and Cheese" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mushroom_Caps_Stuffed_with_Bacon_and_Cheese, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup (25 g) diced green onions

steps: Preheat oven to 325°F (about 160–165°C).
Soften cream cheese and put in food processor. Add Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper; pulse until mixed.
Fold in chopped bacon, chopped mushroom stems, diced green onions, and green peppers.
Set stuffing aside.
Mix bread crumbs with just enough butter to hold together.
Stuff mushroom caps with stuffing.
Top with bread crumbs.
Bake for 5 minutes.

name: Mushroom Fried Rice
attribution: "Mushroom Fried Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mushroom_Fried_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ pack shiitake mushrooms, washed and sliced

steps: Heat the oil in a non-stick pan, and fry the garlic and big onion until fragrant.
Add the prawn and minced chicken fillet. Stir fry until the prawn and the chicken change color.
Add the button mushroom, enoki mushroom, and shitake mushroom. Then, add the rice together with oyster sauce, chicken powder, salt, and hoisin sauce.
Serve hot with garnishes.

name: Mushroom Sauce
attribution: "Mushroom Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mushroom_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 225 grams (8 oz) button mushrooms, wiped and sliced
150 millilitres (about ½ cup) dry white wine

steps: Heat the oil and butter in a frying pan and add the onion. Cook the onion until softened, but not coloured.
Add the garlic and the mushrooms to the pan.
Cook for 3–4 minutes until the mushrooms are soft but have not released their juices.
Add the wine and reduce by half.
Stir in the crème fraîche and parsley, and heat through.
Season to taste.

name: Mushroom Soup
attribution: "Mushroom Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mushroom_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 cups button mushrooms, sliced if large

steps: In a large pot over medium heat, melt one stick of the butter.
Add ½ cup of the flour, stirring constantly, to form a roux.
Cook, continuing to stir constantly, until roux takes on a pale blond color, about 5 minutes.
Slowly stir in the beef stock.
Bring to a boil, stirring frequently.
Reduce heat to a simmer.
In a large saucepan over medium-high heat, melt the remaining stick of butter with the olive oil.
Add the portobellos, shiitakes, and button mushrooms and sauté until mushrooms are moist and tender, 5–10 minutes.
Remove pan from heat and dust mushrooms with the remaining ½ cup of flour, tossing gently to incorporate flour.
Combine mushrooms and beef stock in the large pot.
Stir in the sherry.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until flavors are melded and soup thickened slightly, about 10 minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Mushroom Soup (Gabi Supa)
attribution: "Mushroom Soup (Gabi Supa)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mushroom_Soup_(Gabi_Supa), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pound fresh mushrooms, sliced if too big
2 cubes of mushroom base (bouillon) plus 1 cup of noodles OR 1 cube and 1 package of ramen-type mushroom noodle soup
The juice of ½–1 lemon, or to taste

steps: In a pot, fry the flour in the melted butter until slightly golden (about 3 minutes).
Add the water and stir until smooth.
Add the milk, the mushrooms, and the cube(s) of soup base.
Boil for less than 10 minutes or until the mushrooms are cooked but not soft.
Add the noodles and boil until cooked.
Take the pot off the burner, add the lemon juice, the parsley, and more milk if you like the soup to be less thick.
Enjoy!

name: Mushroom Tofu Soup
attribution: "Mushroom Tofu Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mushroom_Tofu_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: In a blender, blend tofu and ¼ cup water for about 2 minutes, or until smooth
Add remaining ¾ cup water and process until blended.
In a large skillet, sauté onion for about 5 minutes.
Add mushrooms and thyme, and sauté 5 minutes more.
Add wine and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add tofu mixture and simmer until mushrooms are wilted.
Stir in soy sauce, and adjust salt to taste.

name: Mushy Peas
attribution: "Mushy Peas" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mushy_Peas, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Place the peas in 2–3 times their volume of water, along with the baking soda, which speeds the soaking process.
Leave to soak overnight.
The next day, drain the peas, and place in a saucepan with enough water to just cover them.
Add the sugar.
Bring to the boil and simmer for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally to help break up the peas.
Add water or reduce to the desired consistency.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

name: Mussels in Onion and Butter Sauce (Moules Mariniere)
attribution: "Mussels in Onion and Butter Sauce (Moules Mariniere)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mussels_in_Onion_and_Butter_Sauce_(Moules_Mariniere), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Sauté the shallots with the garlic clove in ¼ cup butter until golden.
Place wine and bay leaf in a large skillet.
Add the sautéed shallots and mussels, salt, and plenty of pepper.
Agitate pan for 6–8 minutes on moderate-high heat. Allow mussels to cook evenly, removing them from the heat once the shells open.
Discard any mussels that did not open.
Pour mussels into heated bowls.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

name: Mussels with Potatoes
attribution: "Mussels with Potatoes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mussels_with_Potatoes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 450 g (1 lb) mussels, rinsed and scrubbed
225 g (8 oz) potatoes, cooked and diced
175 g (6 oz) carrots, cooked and diced

steps: Place the mussels in a large pot or steamer with about 1–2 inches of boiling liquid (e.g. water, wine, or seasoned broth)
Cover and steam over high heat for approximately 5 minutes or until the shells open
Discard any mussels that do not open.
Remove mussel meal from the shells
Mix together the mussels, potatoes, and carrots and arrange on a suitable serving dish.
Thoroughly blend the oil, vinegar, and seasoning and pour over the salad.
Chill well before serving.

name: Mustard and Curry Leaf Lassi
attribution: "Mustard and Curry Leaf Lassi" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mustard_and_Curry_Leaf_Lassi, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Whip the curd in a bowl until it becomes soft and loosened.
Mix in half as much cold water as curd, along with salt to taste.
Heat a small amount of oil in a pan, and add mustard seeds. When hot, add curry leaves. Heat through for a few more seconds.
Mix the mustard and curry leaf into the curd mixture.
Chill the mixture well, and serve cold.

name: Mustard Dip
attribution: "Mustard Dip" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mustard_Dip, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix all the ingredients together.
Store refrigerated for up to a few days.

name: Mutton Broth
attribution: "Mutton Broth" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mutton_Broth, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 pounds scrag of fresh mutton neck, cut into several pieces
A few turnips, cut into slices

steps: Wash the mutton pieces, then place in a pot.
Cover the mutton with the cold water. Bring to a boil, then skim well.
Add the turnips, parsley, thyme, and a little salt.
Boil gently for 1½ hours. Let cool slightly, and skim the fat from the surface.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove the solids.
Cool thoroughly and as quickly as possible to prevent spoilage.
Store in the fridge or freezer until use.

name: Mutura
attribution: "Mutura" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mutura, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 500 g beef, goat meat, or mixed meat, finely chopped
200 g tripe or organ meat, finely chopped

steps: Thoroughly clean the intestines using water and salt. Rinse several times until clean.
Boil the chopped meat and tripe for several minutes until partly cooked.
Heat a pan and sauté the onions, garlic, ginger, and chilies until fragrant.
Combine the meat mixture with the sautéed ingredients in a bowl.
Add black pepper, coriander leaves, and salt.
Stir in the blood if using.
Carefully stuff the cleaned intestines with the meat mixture, avoiding overfilling.
Tie the ends securely with kitchen twine or thin strips of casing.
Grill the mutura over medium charcoal heat, turning regularly until browned and fully cooked.
Slice into bite-sized pieces and serve hot.

name: Mzembe U Mgban (Roasted African Pear)
attribution: "Mzembe U Mgban (Roasted African Pear)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Mzembe_U_Mgban_(Roasted_African_Pear), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut pear into desired shape and size. Rinse the pieces off.
Season the fruit with pepper, salt, and sugar.
Roast the seasoned fruit, stirring at intervals until tender.

name: Müsli
attribution: "Müsli" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:M%C3%BCsli, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¾ cup (180 g) unsweetened dried coconut
¼ cup (60 g) chopped dried mangoes
⅓ cup (80 g) chopped dried apples
⅓ cup (80 g) chopped dried apricots
¼ cup (60 g) chopped raw cashew nuts

steps: Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl, then transfer to an airtight container to store.
Serve with milk, yogurt, honey or berries. The dried müsli will keep for up to a month in airtight container.

name: Naan
attribution: "Naan" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Naan, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Make the dough by kneading together all the ingredients and sufficient water (this will be approximately ¾ cup but some judgement is required).
Wrap the dough in a damp muslin cloth and leave it to rise for 2–3 hours.
Divide the dough into small balls.
Roll out the balls in oblong or round shapes with a rolling pin or by slapping and stretching with your hands.
Smear the surface with water and bake in a tandoor or preheated oven (as hot as your oven will go).
The naans should puff up a little, and be ready to remove from the oven in 4–5 minutes.
Brush the naan with butter. Serve hot.

name: Nachos
attribution: "Nachos" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nachos, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ⅓ cup chopped canned peeled green chiles (optional)

steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Lay the tortilla chips on a cookie sheet.
Toss together the cheese, chilies, and onion, and sprinkle over the tortilla chips.
Bake for about 2 minutes until the cheese has melted.
Serve hot.

name: Nasi Goreng (Indonesian Fried Rice)
attribution: "Nasi Goreng (Indonesian Fried Rice)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nasi_Goreng_(Indonesian_Fried_Rice), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 100 g chicken fillet, cut into small pieces

steps: Slice shallots and red pepper into thin slices.
Crush garlic, peel of the skin, and mince well.
Slice stinky beans in half, or as desired.
Heat oil in wok, add the chicken or prawn, and stir fry until done.
Add shallot, pepper, garlic and stink beans. Stir until garlic turns golden.
Crack in the eggs, and stir fry until half done.
Add the steamed rice, and stir until all mixed.
Add soy sauces, salt, and ground pepper as desired.
Serve on plates, adding fresh cucumber slices or tomatoes as garnish.

name: Ndole (Cameroonian Bitter Leaf and Peanut Soup)
attribution: "Ndole (Cameroonian Bitter Leaf and Peanut Soup)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ndole_(Cameroonian_Bitter_Leaf_and_Peanut_Soup), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Season the beef in a big pot with salt, maggi, and one-third of the onions, then boil until the meat is soft.
In the meantime, boil the stockfish with salt and water, then add it to the cooked beef. From the meat and stockfish you should get roughly 3 cups. Freeze or reserve the remainder.
In a saucepan, boil the peanuts for around 10 minutes. Let it cool before pulsing or mixing it in a blender. Add to the meat and stockfish mixture.
Grind half the remaining onion and garlic to a paste, then stir into the meat and peanut mixture.
Add the crayfish, then boil it for 10 minutes, stirring often to avoid burning. Season with salt and maggi to taste. Later, you might need to add more.
Add spinach or bitter leaves to the soup. Stir and continue to simmer for few minutes.
Heat the oil in a frying pan while the ndole is simmering. Add the shrimp and stir continuously until they start to turn pink. Add all the remaining onions and stir again for a few more minutes.
Add the shrimp and onion mixture to the soup pot, and stir continuously for about 2 minutes
Serve hot.

name: Neapolitan Anchovy Sauce
attribution: "Neapolitan Anchovy Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Neapolitan_Anchovy_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Wash anchovies in vinegar; bone and pound with fennel and a cinnamon using a mortar and pestle.
Mix in parsley and marjoram, a squeeze of lemon juice, flour, cream, and the bones of the fish for which you will use this sauce.
Pass through a sieve, add garlic, and boil.

name: Nesquik à la Café
attribution: "Nesquik à la Café" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nesquik_%C3%A0_la_Caf%C3%A9, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tbsp Nesquik chocolate-flavored drink powder (or any other brand of milkshake powder or liquid)

steps: Put all ingredients in a glass or cup.
Stir in hot water to achieve desired consistency.

name: Nettle Pesto
attribution: "Nettle Pesto" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nettle_Pesto, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ⅓ cup hazelnuts, walnuts, or pine nuts
Blender, food processor, or mortar and pestle

steps: Dry sauté or roast the nuts until slightly browned.
Wearing thick gloves, submerge nettles in boiling water for 1 minute. Drain and transfer to an ice water bath to stop the cooking process. Drain.
Combine all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth. Alternatively, grind with mortar and pestle for a coarser consistency.

name: Never Fail Pie Crust
attribution: "Never Fail Pie Crust" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Never_Fail_Pie_Crust, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine flour, shortening and salt. Cut in shortening with fork (or pastry blender) until it resembles corn meal.
Combine water and vinegar with beaten egg. Add to flour mixture a little at a time until a soft dough forms.
Divide dough into three discs, and use or freeze individually.
When using, roll out onto a floured surface to desired measurements.

name: New England Clam Chowder
attribution: "New England Clam Chowder" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:New_England_Clam_Chowder, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pound canned clams, minced, or 12 ounces frozen, thawed
1½ quarts skimmed or whole milk , scalded

steps: If using frozen clams, drain and reserve liquid.
Cut hard parts away and keep them separate.
Sauté salt pork in a heavy iron pot until brown and crisp.
Remove pork and sauté hard part of clam and onions in hot fat until onion is light brown.
Stir in flour, then slowly add boiling water, salt, pepper, and diced potato.
Cover and simmer gently 10 minutes or until potato is tender.
Add soft parts of clams and liquid.
Just before serving, stir in scalded milk and butter.
Heat thoroughly, but not to boiling.
Serve piping hot with oyster or soda crackers.

name: New England Potato Salad
attribution: "New England Potato Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:New_England_Potato_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup sweet pickle juice (from jar of pickles)

steps: Cut unpeeled potatoes in half and cook until they are tender when tested with a knife. Do not overcook.
Peel the potatoes by scraping them lightly with a knife and cut them into ½ inch (1.25 cm) cubes.
Place potatoes in a large bowl and let them come to room temperature.
In a small bowl, combine the mayonnaise, pickle juice and sugar and stir until smooth.
Add the mayonnaise mixture, minced onion, parsley, celery seed and chopped eggs to the potatoes.
Add salt and pepper to taste. Stir lightly to combine.
Place in large serving bowl and sprinkle with paprika.
Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: New Mexico Chili Verde
attribution: "New Mexico Chili Verde" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:New_Mexico_Chili_Verde, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 green bell peppers, chopped (not frequently used in New Mexico)

steps: Combine bell peppers, chili peppers, water, tomatoes, bouillon, oregano, cumin, and coriander in a large pot. Cook over medium heat until peppers are tender.

Meanwhile, cook pork and onion in a skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, about ten minutes, or until pork is browned and crumbly. Drain pork and add to chile mixture. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Heat butter in the skillet over medium-low heat. Add flour. Cook, stirring frequently, until flour browns, about 2 minutes.
Add flour mixture to chile. Continue cooking and stirring until thickened to preference.

name: New Mexico Pork Tamales
attribution: "New Mexico Pork Tamales" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:New_Mexico_Pork_Tamales, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (15 oz / 400 g) beanless chili con carne
⅛ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
1 package (8 oz / 230 g) of corn husks (contains about 100 husks)
8 cups warm chicken stock (or 8 cups water plus 8 chicken bullion cubes)

steps: Stir ingredients together and refrigerate until needed.
Soak corn husks in warm water for at least two hours. A dinner plate may be needed to hold corn husks under water.
Mix dry masa flour with paprika, chili powder, garlic powder, cumin and salt. Mix well for even distribution of spices.
Cut shortening into the masa mixture with a pastry cutter. Mix until mixture resembles the texture of tiny peas.
Slowly add chicken broth one cup at a time. Mix well with electric mixer. Mixture should resemble consistency of peanut butter.
Continue mixing with electric mixer to incorporate air into batter. Mixture is ready to use when 1 teaspoon of batter floats on water.
Use one corn husk per tamale. Lay flat on table. The corn husk is roughly rectangle shaped.
Spread ½ cup of masa mixture on entire upward facing corn husk, leaving a 1-inch (2.5 cm) gap along the long edge and narrow end of the corn husk.
Spread 1 tablespoon of meat mixture, in a narrow band in the middle, down the length of the masa spread corn husk.

Roll/fold the husk along the wide edge, touching the edges of the masa together, with the meat mixture ending up in the middle of the masa. The part of the husk with the 1-inch gap with no masa should be rolled around the outside of the husk.
Fold about 1 inch of end of rolled husk, upward along the body of the husk. You should end up with something resembling a cornucopia, with one end folded over and one end open.
Stand all of the rolled tamales on end in a steamer basket with the open end of the tamale facing upward. Cover the basket.
Steam the tamales over boiling water for 2 hours. Keep the tamales above the boiling water, don't allow them to stand in it.
At the end of the cooking period, open one tamale to make sure the masa is cooked and not doughy.
Allow tamales to rest 30 minutes after cooking, before serving. This will help to keep the masa from sticking to the corn husk.

name: New Orleans Style Chicken Wing Dipping Sauce
attribution: "New Orleans Style Chicken Wing Dipping Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:New_Orleans_Style_Chicken_Wing_Dipping_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 jar (12 ounces) of refrigerated chunky blue cheese dressing
⅓ cup scallions, finely chopped (reserve a teaspoon of chopped green tops for garnish)

steps: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving (overnight is preferable).
Garnish with the reserved scallions.

name: New World Affogato
attribution: "New World Affogato" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:New_World_Affogato, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Place the ice cream in a coffee cup.
Boil water in a pan, and then add coffee and sugar to it, and then mix well.
Add brandy to coffee mixture.
Pour coffee mixture over the ice-cream.
Serve immediately, garnished with cinnamon powder.

name: New York Cheesecake
attribution: "New York Cheesecake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:New_York_Cheesecake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 5 ounces Barnham and Bailey animal crackers or sweet digestive biscuits

steps: Butter bottom and sides of 10-inch springform pan.
Crush animal crackers into a fine powder. Mix with 3 tablespoons of sugar.
Add to melted butter and mix with a fork until blended.
Press mixture into the bottom and up about one third of the sides of the pan.
Refrigerate 1 hour.
Have all ingredients at room temperature.
Preheat oven to 475°F.
Mix sugar, flour and cornstarch together.
Using a wooden spoon, beat cream cheese with sugar mix, zest and vanilla until it is smooth. Do not overbeat.
Add the whole eggs and egg yolks, one at a time, beating lightly with wooden spoon after each addition. Do not overbeat as this causes the cheesecake to crack.
Gently stir in cream.
Pour mixture into the pan. Place pan on cookie sheet to avoid leakage.
Bake at 475°F for 15 minutes
Lower heat to 225°F and bake for 1 hour
Raise heat to 250°F and bake for about 15 more minutes

Refrigerate immediately for at least 1 hour, covered with a cloth and cookie sheet (cloth on bottom) until condensation stops forming. Condensation will drip onto the cake if you cover it right away with plastic wrap.

name: New York City–Style Pizza
attribution: "New York City–Style Pizza" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:New_York_City%E2%80%93Style_Pizza, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Sprinkle the yeast over the surface of the warm water in a large bowl. Let stand for 1 minute, then stir to dissolve.
Mix in the flour, salt, and olive oil.
When the dough is too thick to stir, turn out onto a floured surface, and knead for 5 minutes. Knead in a little more flour if the dough is too sticky.
Place into an oiled bowl, cover, and set aside in a warm place to rise until doubled in bulk.

Preheat the oven to 550°F or as hot as your oven will go. Authentic New York pizzerias bake pizzas in ovens from 700–1,000°F. If using a pizza stone, preheat it in the oven as well, setting it on the lowest shelf.
When the dough has risen, flatten it out on a lightly floured surface.
Roll or stretch out into a 12-inch circle, and place on a baking sheet. If you are using a pizza stone, you may place the pizza on a piece of parchment while preheating the stone in the oven.
Spread the tomato sauce evenly over the dough. Sprinkle with oregano, mozzarella cheese, basil, Romano cheese, and red pepper flakes.
Bake for 12–15 minutes in the preheated oven, until the bottom of the crust is browned when you lift up the edge a little, and cheese is melted and bubbly.
Cool for about 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

name: Nibbles
attribution: "Nibbles" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nibbles, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 boxes (16 cups/1 kg/2.2 lb) rice Chex cereal
1 box (8 cups/500 g/1.1 lb) wheat Chex cereal
Heaping ½ cup (150 g) bacon grease

steps: Melt and combine the sauce ingredients.
Combine all dry ingredients except salt in a large canning pot.
Sprinkle a little of the sauce mixture over dry ingredients, and shake well. Repeat until sauce is gone.
Salt the mixture by sprinkling and shaking in the same way.
Bake 1½–2 hours at 200 °F (95 °C) in covered canning pot.
Remove frequently to shake.

name: Nigerian Barbecued Chicken Wings
attribution: "Nigerian Barbecued Chicken Wings" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Barbecued_Chicken_Wings, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine the flour, cornmeal, pepper, salt, sugar, ginger, and paprika in a bowl.
Add the chicken pieces, and rub the mixture into them well so they are completely coated.
Set in the fridge, and allow the chicken to rest for 1 hour.
Arrange the chicken pieces on a baking tray or on a grill. Grill or bake until cooked through (about 45 minutes baking at 375°F).

name: Nigerian Boiled Fish
attribution: "Nigerian Boiled Fish" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Boiled_Fish, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut fresh fish into suitable sized pieces, and wash thoroughly. Remove unwanted substances inside the fish.
Put fish in a pot, cover with water, and add a pinch of salt.
Boil for a few minutes until cooked but tender.

name: Nigerian Cauliflower Fufu
attribution: "Nigerian Cauliflower Fufu" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Cauliflower_Fufu, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut cauliflower into small pieces, and blend with a blender to give a purée.
Strain the cauliflower mixture through a cloth, retaining the solids.
Squeeze the sieve cloth to drain more water until relatively dry and a dough is formed.
Transfer the dough to a saucepan over medium heat, and stir in the psyllium husk.
Stir and mold to form a paste, and shape into portions.

name: Nigerian Coco Pops
attribution: "Nigerian Coco Pops" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Coco_Pops, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Pour water into a bowl.
Stir in the coco pops, then the milk.
Serve warm.

name: Nigerian Cocoyam Chips
attribution: "Nigerian Cocoyam Chips" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Cocoyam_Chips, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Wash cocoyam with water, and peel the tuber. Rinse twice to remove dirt, then thinly slice it to your desired shape.
Put the sliced cocoyam in a pot, then season with salt. Toss well to season all of the cocoyam.
Preheat the frying pan enough vegetable oil for deep frying. Add the cocoyam slices, working in batches if needed, and fry until crisp.
Drain the cocoyam chips of excess oil, and serve.

name: Nigerian Coleslaw
attribution: "Nigerian Coleslaw" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Coleslaw, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Slice cabbage thinly.
Use a grater to shred the carrot into a bowl. If possible, use a grater or mandoline that will make long, thin pieces.
Combine the cabbage and carrots. Add mayonnaise, and toss to combine.
Refrigerate until cold before serving.

name: Nigerian Corned Beef Sauce
attribution: "Nigerian Corned Beef Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Corned_Beef_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a saucepan. Add the onions, tomatoes, peppers, garlic, and ginger. Stir, and fry for about 10 minutes.
Mix in the corned beef, and fry for about 10 minutes.
Add salt and seasoning cube to taste. Stir, then cover and cook for a few minutes.
Adjust seasoning as needed, and serve.

name: Nigerian Custard
attribution: "Nigerian Custard" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Custard, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Place the custard powder in a bowl. Stir in a small amount of cold water until smooth and lump-free.
Gradually stir in boiling water.
Allow the custard to set. If it is too thick or hard, stir in water to your desired consistency.
Stir in milk and sugar.
Serve.

name: Nigerian Dodo (Fried Ripe Plantain)
attribution: "Nigerian Dodo (Fried Ripe Plantain)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Dodo_(Fried_Ripe_Plantain), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup puréed chile pepper mixed with tomatoes

steps: Cut each ripe plantain into 6 small pieces. Toss with salt and chile-tomato purée to taste.
Heat ½ cup of oil in a frying pan. Add the 6 plantain pieces, and deep fry until all sides are golden brown.
Serve with jollof rice or bean porridge.

name: Nigerian Egg Pepper Soup
attribution: "Nigerian Egg Pepper Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Egg_Pepper_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 bell peppers (red, green, or a combination), thinly sliced
1 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (adjust to your preferred spice level)
Fresh cilantro or parsley, for garnish (optional)

steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onions and minced garlic, and sauté until the onions become translucent and slightly golden.
Add the sliced bell peppers and chopped tomatoes to the saucepan. Cook for a few minutes until the vegetables start to soften.
In a separate bowl, crack the eggs and whisk them until well-beaten. Set aside.

Add the chicken or vegetable broth to the saucepan with the vegetables. Stir in the ground cayenne pepper, paprika, cumin, and coriander. Season with salt to taste. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Slowly pour the beaten eggs into the simmering soup, stirring gently with a wooden spoon or spatula in one direction. This will create thin strands of cooked egg throughout the soup.
Continue cooking the soup for about 3–4 minutes, allowing the egg to cook and thicken the soup slightly.
Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning if needed. Add more salt or spices according to your preference.
Once the soup is ready, remove it from the heat.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or parsley if desired.

name: Nigerian Egg Stew
attribution: "Nigerian Egg Stew" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Egg_Stew, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat palm oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Add the chile pepper, chopped onion, crushed Maggi cube, and salt. Stir and cook for 2–3 minutes.
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs. Pour into the pan and stir gently to scramble.
Cook for another 2–3 minutes, or until eggs are fully set but still moist.
Serve with boiled yam, cocoyam, or potatoes.

name: Nigerian Eggplant Fufu
attribution: "Nigerian Eggplant Fufu" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Eggplant_Fufu, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut the eggplant into small pieces and soften in a pot of boiling water. Drain well.
Absorb excess water from the eggplant with paper towels, then blend with the food processor.
Transfer the eggplant purée to a pot, and stir over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Add the psyllium husk, and stir for additional 3 minutes.
Shape into desired portions.

name: Nigerian Fried Cheese Curds (Wara)
attribution: "Nigerian Fried Cheese Curds (Wara)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Fried_Cheese_Curds_(Wara), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Strain the milk into a large pot.
Bring the milk to a boil over medium heat, stirring frequently.
Reduce the heat, and add lime juice. Do not stir. The curds should separate from the whey.
Pack the curds in a colander, and allow excess water to drain out.
Cut curds into desired shapes, and deep fry in hot oil.

name: Nigerian Fried Yam
attribution: "Nigerian Fried Yam" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Fried_Yam, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Yam, peeled and sliced into sticks

steps: Rinse the cut yam and place in a bowl. Season with salt.
Heat oil in a pan or pot. Add the cut yam little by little to avoid overcrowding.
Stir, and cook until the yam is golden. Flip and cook until golden on all sides.
Remove fried yam from pan, and drain away any excess oil.

name: Nigerian Fruit Skewer
attribution: "Nigerian Fruit Skewer" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Fruit_Skewer, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut all the fruit into small chunks.
Thread the fruit chunks onto a skewer.

name: Nigerian Jollof Rice
attribution: "Nigerian Jollof Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Jollof_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Blend together the tomatoes, peppers, and the 2 large onions and set aside.
Boil, then deep-fry the meat. Set aside.
Put a 2-liter pot on the fire and allow any residual water in it to dry. Add the groundnut oil and let it heat up.
Add the diced onion and tomato purée. Stir constantly for 3–5 minutes then add the blended pepper mixture.
Add about 200 ml of the reserved meat stock, stock cubes, bay leaves, curry powder, thyme, cinnamon, ginger, garlic, and crayfish. Stir for about 10 minutes.
Add about 1.2 liters of water and allow to boil.
While waiting for the mixture to boil, wash the rice about 3–4 times or until the water is clear, then drain in a sieve.

When the pot boils, add the rice and season with salt. Use a wooden spatula to mix everything until you are sure that the rice is not just resting on one spot. Depending on the rice, you may need to add a little more water but remember to stir constantly with the wooden spatula in order to minimize the rice sticking to the bottom of the pot.
When you have attained your desired texture for the rice, reduce the heat to allow any residual water to be absorbed.
Serve and garnish with the fried beef/chicken.

name: Nigerian Noodles
attribution: "Nigerian Noodles" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Noodles, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Toast the noodles in a dry pan.
Add some boiling water, along with seasoning and pepper.
Cook, stirring, until the water is fully absorbed and the noodles are tender.
Serve with the optional additions.
Use a timer to avoid overcooking
Don't overcrowd the pot
Bring water to a boil in a pot with a dash of oil.
Add the noodles, and cook until the noodles are tender.
Drain the noodles, and serve with the optional additions.

name: Nigerian Oatmeal
attribution: "Nigerian Oatmeal" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Oatmeal, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Soak the oats in enough milk or water overnight in the fridge.
Bring a pot of water to a boil with a pinch of salt. Stir in the soaked oats and a pinch of sugar.
Cook the oats, stirring, until they have absorbed the liquid and become soft.
Remove from the heat. Serve warm with banana, milk, and/or yogurt.

name: Nigerian Palm Oil Boiled Yam (Ji Mmanu)
attribution: "Nigerian Palm Oil Boiled Yam (Ji Mmanu)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Palm_Oil_Boiled_Yam_(Ji_Mmanu), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Fresh chile pepper, blended to paste

steps: Cook the yam pieces in salted boiling water for a few minutes.
Drain the yam pieces. Toss the yam with palm oil, salt, fresh pepper, and utazi leaves.
Serve.

name: Nigerian Rice and Beans Jollof
attribution: "Nigerian Rice and Beans Jollof" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Rice_and_Beans_Jollof, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or palm oil

steps: Rinse the beans, and boil in water until tender. Drain the cooked beans.
Grind together the chiles, tomatoes, and onions to make a purée.
Heat a thin layer of oil in a pan, and add the purée. Season with stock cube and salt, and simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in the parboiled rice and beans, and cook for 5 minutes.
Serve with beef, chicken, or moin-moin.

name: Nigerian Roasted Plantain
attribution: "Nigerian Roasted Plantain" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Roasted_Plantain, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Place a rack on a baking sheet.
Place the plantains and fish on the rack.
Roast the plantains and fish in the preheated oven until they are cooked through. For an even roast, turn the plantains from time to time.
Heat the pepper stew, and serve it with the plantains and fish.

name: Nigerian Roasted Yam
attribution: "Nigerian Roasted Yam" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Roasted_Yam, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut yam into suitably-sized pieces, then peel them.
Soak the yam in water overnight.
Rinse the yam and roast it, making sure all sides are deeply roasted.
Serve the roasted yam with groundnuts or roasted plantain.

name: Nigerian Tea (Hot Chocolate)
attribution: "Nigerian Tea (Hot Chocolate)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Tea_(Hot_Chocolate), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Pour the evaporated milk into a mug, and stir in the chocolate drink mix.
Stir in hot water.
Serve with bread, Nigerian meat pie, or other Nigerian snacks.

name: Nigerian Tomato Omelette
attribution: "Nigerian Tomato Omelette" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Tomato_Omelette, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat some oil in a pan over high heat. Add the tomatoes, and fry until well-heated.
Beat the eggs, and stir in the cooked tomato. Return the mixture to the pan over medium-low heat, making sure it is evenly spread across the pan. Cook until the egg is sturdy enough to flip.
Flip the omelette to the other side, and cook until the bottom is golden.
Serve hot with bread or jollof rice.

name: Nigerian Yam and Potato Porridge
attribution: "Nigerian Yam and Potato Porridge" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nigerian_Yam_and_Potato_Porridge, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 pieces of ponmo (cow skin), properly cleaned and cut into small pieces
1 medium-sized yam, peeled and sliced into 4 pieces of 10 cm diameter and 2–2.5-inch thickness
5 medium-sized sweet potatoes, peeled and sliced 2–2.5-inch thick

steps: Place the ponmo in a pot with water, 2 seasoning cubes, garlic, and salt to taste. Boil until the ponmo becomes soft, which should take about 10 minutes.
Blend the chile peppers until about 70% smooth.
Heat a dry frying pan over medium heat. Pour 1 cooking spoon of palm oil and ½ spoon of vegetable oil into the pan, and heat them for about 2 minutes.
Add one-third of the finely chopped onions to the pan and fry them, stirring continuously for approximately 2 minutes.
Add the blended peppers, curry powder, ½ teaspoon of salt, and pepper. Let the mixture fry for about 8 minutes.
Add the cooked ponmo to the pan and stir to combine. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for approximately 5 minutes.
Keep warm until time to serve.
In a large pot, combine 1 cup of water and 1 teaspoon of salt. Add the yam, sweet potato, and sliced onions.
Boil the yam and sweet potatoes until they are about 60% softened (approximately halfway done). This process usually takes around 12 minutes. Do not drain.
Blend the ginger-garlic paste, remaining seasoning cubes, and tomato paste together until smooth.
Heat a dry frying pan over medium heat. Add 2 spoons of palm oil and 1½ spoons of vegetable oil to the pan, and heat them for about 2 minutes
Add half the remaining finely chopped onions to the pan and fry them, stirring continuously for approximately 2 minutes.
Add the tomato mixture and salt to taste. Stir continuously until the mixture fries and has lost some liquid.
Stir the fried tomato mixture into the pot with the yam and potatoes. Add the crayfish and remaining chopped onions. Stir well and cover the pot, allowing it to cook for 5 minutes.
Using a wooden stirring rod, stir and mash the yam and potato, leaving some chunks for texture.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for an additional 5 minutes.
Stir the porridge and remove it from the heat, allowing it to steam. Serve the hot porridge on a plate with the peppered ponmo.

name: Nilagang Baka (Boiled Beef and Vegetables in Broth)
attribution: "Nilagang Baka (Boiled Beef and Vegetables in Broth)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nilagang_Baka_(Boiled_Beef_and_Vegetables_in_Broth), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Boil beef, peppercorns, onion, salt, corn, and potato until tender.
Slice onion chives into 3-inch strips. Add to the boiling beef.
Slice saba into half. Add to the boiling beef.
Serve in one large bowl or individual serving bowls.
Serve with rice on the side.

name: Niçoise Salad
attribution: "Niçoise Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ni%C3%A7oise_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 200 g small fresh broad (fava) beans or green beans
12 small fresh artichokes, cut into rounds
12 anchovy fillets, or 300 g tuna steak

steps: Cut the tomatoes in quarters and salt them lightly once. Cut the eggs into quarters or slices. Cut the anchovies into 3–4 chunks (if using tuna, cut into similarly sized pieces). Peel the cucumber and finely slice it. Cut the green peppers into thin rings, and do the same with the onions.
Cut the garlic in two and rub the sides and bottom of a large salad bowl with it. Toss all the ingredients except the tomatoes into the bowl.
Drain the tomatoes, re-salt lightly and add to salad. In a separate bowl, mix 6 spoonfuls of olive oil with the basil, pepper, and salt and pour over salad. Refrigerate before serving.

name: Nkwobi (Nigerian Spicy Cow Foot)
attribution: "Nkwobi (Nigerian Spicy Cow Foot)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nkwobi_(Nigerian_Spicy_Cow_Foot), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut the cow feet into small pieces, and remove all the bigger bones.
Place the cow feet in a pot, along with the salt, seasoning cubes, and chopped onions.
Add just enough water to cover the meat. Simmer until the meat is tender. Add small amounts of water as necessary, but there should be little to no liquid left in the pot once the meat is done.
In a separate pot, boil the ugba separately for just 3 minutes. Drain.
Dissolve the potash in a cup of water, and strain it into a separate pot. Add the palm oil to the potash water, and stir well until thick and yellow.
Add the crayfish, boiled ugba, Cameroon pepper, seasoning cube, and salt to the palm oil mixture. Stir well.
Add your cooked meat, and stir to coat with the palm oil mixture.
Serve in a wooden bowl with toppings of round-cut onions and sliced utazi leaves.

name: Nni Ede (Nigerian Pounded Cocoyam)
attribution: "Nni Ede (Nigerian Pounded Cocoyam)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nni_Ede_(Nigerian_Pounded_Cocoyam), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut the cocoyam into small pieces. Rinse the pieces, and boil them for few minutes. Drain the cocoyam.
Mix water into the cassava flour to make a dough. Shape into balls.
Boil the cassava balls for few minutes, then drain.
Pound together the cassava balls and cocoyam until smooth and lump-free.
Serve with your choice of soup.

name: No-Bake Cheesecake
attribution: "No-Bake Cheesecake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:No-Bake_Cheesecake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 200 g (7 oz) tennis biscuits or digestive biscuits, crushed to fine crumbs
540 g (19 oz) cream cheese, softened to room temperature
750 g (26.4 oz) tinned sweetened condensed milk

steps: Combine melted butter with biscuit crumbs. Press into a pie dish to make a crust.
Beat cream cheese until smooth and fluffy.
Beat lemon juice and condensed milk together.
Mix the condensed milk mixture into beaten cream cheese until thoroughly combined.
Pour filling into the prepared pie dish.
Refrigerate for minimum of 24 hours until set.

name: No-Bake Chocolate Cake
attribution: "No-Bake Chocolate Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:No-Bake_Chocolate_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2½ packs graham crackers, plain digestive biscuits, or whole wheat biscuits; crumbled

steps: Melt the margarine.
Mix the sugar and the egg.
Add the melted butter to the egg/sugar mixture.
Add the cocoa and the vanilla extract.
Add crumbled graham crackers. Mix well until all crackers are covered.
Line a cake pan with aluminum foil and pour in mixture.
Leave in refrigerator for 1 hour (preferably longer).
Unmold and serve.

name: No-Bake Chocolate Chip Cookie Pie
attribution: "No-Bake Chocolate Chip Cookie Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:No-Bake_Chocolate_Chip_Cookie_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 package (15–18 oz/450 g) chocolate chip cookies (recipe uses 26 cookies)
1 ea. (9 oz/270 g) commercial graham cracker pie crust ("extra serving" or "deep dish" size)
1 container (8 oz/240 g) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps: Dip 8 cookies in milk, then place in a single layer in graham cracker crust. Top with one-third of the whipped topping.
Repeat the above step so that you have a total of 3 layers of cookies and whipped topping.
Crumble 2 chocolate chip cookies, and sprinkle over pie.
Cover and chill for 8 hours before serving.

name: No-Bake Chocolate Pie
attribution: "No-Bake Chocolate Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:No-Bake_Chocolate_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2–3 packs of 'marie' biscuits (also known as 'rich tea' biscuits)
Cold brewed black coffee or other taste makers (optional)
Dish or mold with high sides (e.g. springform or pie pan; about 26 cm in diameter)

steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan, then mix in the sugar.
Stir in the cocoa and milk.

Dip biscuits in the coffee, and arrange them in the bottom of the dish to make a single layer. Spread the chocolate mixture on top of the biscuits. Repeat this step until you run out of biscuits and chocolate.
Scatter the sprinkles on top, then chill in the fridge until set.
Slice and serve.

name: No-Bake Matsa Cake
attribution: "No-Bake Matsa Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:No-Bake_Matsa_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 ounces raisins, soaked in 1 tablespoon sweet red wine
½ lb butter, melted and cooled slightly

steps: Combine brown sugar, cocoa, soaked raisins, and melted butter.
Add this mixture to the crumbled matzah and mix well.
Divide the mixture into two 9-inch springform or other cake pans.
Knead the batter to create a flat and smooth surface.
Refrigerate for several hours.

name: Nonpareil Sauce (Hartshorne)
attribution: "Nonpareil Sauce (Hartshorne)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nonpareil_Sauce_(Hartshorne), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 breast of roasted fowl, chopped fine

steps: Combine all the ingredients together.
Boil this mixture until warm and serve.

name: North Carolina-Style BBQ Ribs
attribution: "North Carolina-Style BBQ Ribs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:North_Carolina-Style_BBQ_Ribs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Season ribs with Rib Rub and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Combine remaining ingredients and place in a spray bottle.
Place ribs in a 250°F smoker or a charcoal grill set for indirect heat at 250°F
Cook for 5–6 hours, spraying often with vinegar mixture.
Spray heavily with vinegar mixture and place on a high grill, turning and spraying constantly until well browned.
Remove and let rest 15 minutes; serve.

name: Nshima
attribution: "Nshima" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nshima, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 cups of Mealie Meal/ White Cornmeal

steps: Boil 1 Litre of water in advance, in a Kettle or Sauce pan.
Once the water boils, combine 1 cup of Cornmeal or Meal as we call it, with 1 1/2 cups of cold water in a sauce pan, to make a smooth paste. A flat cooking stick is ideal for this.

Transfer the Cornmeal paste to the stove (set at medium high heat), and then slowly pour about 700ml of boiling water into the saucepan, stirring continuously, making sure the mixture is smooth and well combined.
This should lead to a smooth porridge, almost creamy. Allow this to boil for at least 10 minutes, covered.
Remove the cover after 10 minutes and begin to add the remaining Cornmeal to the porridge, a little at a time, making sure it is well combined, before adding some more.
The porridge should stiffen up quickly with each addition of Cornmeal, and you will need to exert a bit of muscle to mix this well, smoothing out any lumps that form in the process
Remove from the stove after the 10 minutes, and using a smooth serving spoon, scoop out the Nshima, one lump at a time and transfer into your serving dish.

name: Nune Soup
attribution: "Nune Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nune_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Blend pepper the pepper to a paste. Boil it for few minutes.
Add the fish, locust beans, and salt to taste.
Stir and cook for few minutes.
Serve with pounded yam or akpu.

name: Nuremberg Gingerbread
attribution: "Nuremberg Gingerbread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nuremberg_Gingerbread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Bring the honey and sugar to the boil in a saucepan while stirring. Remove from the heat and let cool.
Sift the flour into a bowl.
Stir in the remaining ingredients.
Pour the honey mixture, then the baking powder into the flour. Stir and knead the dough until it cools down.
Roll out the dough.
Cut out the dough, and place on the gingerbread wafers.
Decorate with an almond, and transfer to a baking sheet.
Let cool for about a day
Bake at 180 °C for 15–20 minutes

name: Nut Roll
attribution: "Nut Roll" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nut_Roll, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup / 150 g / n/a Graham cracker crumbs
½ cup / 110 g / n/a White sugar
½ cup / 90 g / n/a Packed brown sugar

steps: Dissolve the yeast in the lukewarm milk. Mix well, and lest rest until foamy.
Stir the sugar, shortening, and salt into the yeast mixture. Let cool slightly, then mix in the eggs.
Place half of the flour in a bowl, and gradually stir in the liquid mixture. Mix well, then knead in the remaining flour. The dough should be smooth and not sticky.
Cover the dough, and let it rise in a warm place for about 2 hours until doubled in volume.
Gently knead the dough to deflate it. Divide it into 6 pieces, and let it stand for 10 minutes.
Combine all of the ingredients for the filling, and set aside until the dough is ready.
Roll each dough piece out, and spread with the nut filling mixture. Roll up the dough to make a spiral.
Place the rolls on a greased and/or parchment-lined baking sheet. Let rise for 1 hour.
Make the egg wash by beating together the eggs with a dash of evaporated milk. Brush the tops of the rolls with the egg wash.
Bake for 35–40 minutes at 350°F (180°C) until golden and cooked through.
Brush the hot rolls with melted butter, and let cool.

name: Nutty Brownie Bars
attribution: "Nutty Brownie Bars" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nutty_Brownie_Bars, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 10 miniature chocolate coconut candy bars, chopped

steps: Prepare brownie mix according to package directions, reducing oil to 3 tablespoons.
Pour into lightly greased 9-by-3-inch pan.
Spread condensed milk over the brownie batter.
Sprinkle with chopped nuts and candy bars.
Bake at 350°F for 35–38 minutes or until done.
Cool completely and cut into bars.

name: Nutty Buddy Chocolate Cookie Bars
attribution: "Nutty Buddy Chocolate Cookie Bars" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Nutty_Buddy_Chocolate_Cookie_Bars, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup pecan pieces or chopped pecans

steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Place butter in microwave-safe dish, cover with a paper towel and microwave on high, for about 45 seconds, or until melted. Remove carefully and stir to melt completely.
Place the graham-cracker crumbs in a metal 13-by-9-inch baking pan.
Pour melted butter over crumbs, and stir and fold until all the crumbs are moistened with the butter. Press crumbs firmly and evenly into the bottom of the pan.
Pour the sweetened condensed milk over the crumb crust. Spread to the edges with the back of a spoon.
Top evenly with chocolate chips, pecans, and almonds. Press down with a fork.
Bake, uncovered, for 25–35 minutes or until bubbling slightly along the edges.
Remove from oven and cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate until firm for 1–2 hours before slicing.
Store at room temperature, covered with foil.

name: Oat Bran Cereal
attribution: "Oat Bran Cereal" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Oat_Bran_Cereal, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Boil water.
Stir in oat bran and salt
Reduce heat and cook for 4–6 minutes

name: Oat Porridge
attribution: "Oat Porridge" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Oat_Porridge, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup (45 g) rolled oats or other grain

steps: Mix oats and water, then bring to the boil, covered with a lid.
Once bubbling, stir and reduce temperature to the lowest possible to maintain simmering. Replace lid and watch carefully to prevent boiling over.
Stir every minute or so. After five minutes, remove lid, stir thoroughly and add milk.
Mix through, and keep stirring until fully mixed.
Serve and add raisins, sugar, brown sugar, maple syrup, a pinch of salt, honey or inverted sugar syrup to taste.

name: Oatmeal Banana Waffle
attribution: "Oatmeal Banana Waffle" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Oatmeal_Banana_Waffle, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Turn waffle iron on high.
Put all ingredients in a blender and blend on high until the contents are smooth. Let the mixture sit for 10–15 minutes.
Spray the waffle iron with non-stick cooking spray.
Pour some of the batter onto the waffle iron. Cook for about 10 minutes. Repeat until you are out of batter.

name: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies I
attribution: "Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Oatmeal_Chocolate_Chip_Cookies_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: In a large bowl beat eggs lightly to break the yolks, then mix in the shortening—you should have a loose mixture.
Mix in the brown sugar, milk, vanilla, and salt.
Mix the flour, baking powder, soda, cinnamon, and oatmeal together in another bowl.
Mix the wet and dry mixes together to get a soft dough.
Stir in chocolate chips and walnuts.
Make balls and place onto a greased or parchment-lined baking sheet. Bake in an oven prheated to 180°C (350°F) for 15–20 minutes.

name: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies III
attribution: "Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies III" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Oatmeal_Chocolate_Chip_Cookies_III, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Cream together butter and sugars.
Add egg and vanilla and mix.
Add salt, baking soda, and flour; mix.
Mix in oatmeal.
Mix in chocolate chips.
Scoop cookies onto a greased or parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake 9–11 minutes at 375°F.

name: Oatmeal Cookies I
attribution: "Oatmeal Cookies I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Oatmeal_Cookies_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Using a mixer, cream together the shortening, brown sugar, white sugar, egg, water and vanilla until light and fluffy (about 10 minutes on high).
In a mixing bowl, mix together the oats, flour, baking soda, and salt.
Add dry ingredients into wet, mix well using mixer.
Stir in raisins if using.
Scoop the portions out—this recipe makes 20 cookies, so make 20 portions.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 8–10 minutes.

name: Oatmeal Cookies II
attribution: "Oatmeal Cookies II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Oatmeal_Cookies_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Put the oil, sugar, water, and vanilla together in a bowl. Mix well.
Add the oats, flour, salt, and baking soda.
Place on a greased baking sheet in lumps about 1 inch across and about 3 inches apart.
Bake at 191 °C (375 °F) for 10–12 minutes, and serve when the cookies have begun to brown.

name: Oatmeal Muffins
attribution: "Oatmeal Muffins" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Oatmeal_Muffins, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Stir rolled oats and buttermilk together in a mixing bowl.
Combine flour, coconut, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in another mixing bowl. Stir together to mix. Make a well in the center.
Add egg and margarine to oat mixture. Mix well.
Pour all at once into flour mixture. Stir just to moisten.
Fill muffin cups ¾ full.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15–20 minutes.

name: Oatmeal Stout Brownies
attribution: "Oatmeal Stout Brownies" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Oatmeal_Stout_Brownies, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 tablespoons unsalted room temperature butter, cut into cubes
1 ½ cup superfine or granulated sugar
1 ¼ cups (10 ounces) oatmeal stout beer (room temperature)
⅓ cup superfine or granulated sugar

steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Line a 9 x 13-inch baking pan with nonstick foil (or grease and flour, or parchment paper…your call).
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, cocoa powder, and salt until evenly combined. Set aside.
Melt butter, bittersweet chocolate, and white chocolate chips in a double-boiler over very low heat, stirring constantly until melted. Remove from heat.
In a large mixing bowl, beat eggs and sugar on high speed until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes. Add melted chocolate mixture, beating until combined.

Beat reserved flour mixture into melted chocolate mixture. Whisk in stout beer. The batter will seem a bit thin. Pour into prepared baking pan. Drop semisweet chocolate chips evenly on top of batter (some will sink in).
Beat cream cheese in medium bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until smooth. Gradually beat in sugar. Beat in vanilla and 1 egg just until blended.
Pour cream cheese mixture over brownie batter in pan; cut through mixture with knife several times for marbled design.
Bake for 25–35 minutes on center rack in the oven, until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out almost clean.
Let brownies cool, uncovered, to room temperature. Dust with confectioners' sugar before serving if desired.

name: Ofe Onugbu (Bitter Leaf Soup)
attribution: "Ofe Onugbu (Bitter Leaf Soup)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ofe_Onugbu_(Bitter_Leaf_Soup), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 300 g assorted meat (beef, tripe, cow skin)
1 tablespoon ogiri or iru (fermented locust beans, optional)
3–5 small cocoyam pieces or 2 tablespoons achi powder (as thickener)
Blender or mortar and pestle (for cocoyam or pepper)

steps: Wash the bitter leaves thoroughly, squeezing and rinsing several times to reduce the bitterness. Set aside.
In a pot, combine the assorted meat, stockfish, dryfish, salt, seasoning cubes, and chopped onions. Cover with water, and simmer until the meat is tender.
Add palm oil and allow it to melt into the meat stock.
If using cocoyam, boil it separately, peel, blend into a paste, and stir into the soup as a thickener. If using achi or ofor powder, stir directly into the pot.
Stir in the ground crayfish, pepper, ogiri, and ground crayfish.
Stir in the washed bitter leaves.Allow to simmer for 5–10 minutes until the soup thickens and the flavors combine.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.

name: Ofe Owerri
attribution: "Ofe Owerri" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ofe_Owerri, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 kg assorted meat (beef, goat, cow tripe, etc.)
500 g dryfish, smoked fish, or stockfish
Fresh bell pepper or chile pepper
1 cup okazi or uziza leaves, thinly sliced

steps: Clean the meats and dryfish, and cut into pieces.
Simmer the meat with seasoning cubes and water in a pot until tender. Add stockfish and dried fish.
Stir in the cocoyam paste to thicken the soup, making sure it's well incorporated.
Stir in the palm oil, crayfish, ogiri, and pepper. Simmer for 5–10 minutes.
Add okazi leaves, and simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in ugu leaves, and simmer for 2–3 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve hot with pounded yam or fufu.

name: Ogolale (Mashed Yam and Plantain)
attribution: "Ogolale (Mashed Yam and Plantain)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ogolale_(Mashed_Yam_and_Plantain), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Boil the yam and plantain in a pot of salted water until cooked through.
Drain the water, and transfer the cooked yam and plantain to a clean container.
Use a spoon or spatula to mash the yam and plantain.
Mix in the palm oil.
Adjust seasoning to taste, and serve.

name: Okpa (Boiled Bambara Bean Pudding)
attribution: "Okpa (Boiled Bambara Bean Pudding)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Okpa_(Boiled_Bambara_Bean_Pudding), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Banana leaves or food- and heat-safe plastic bags
3 cigar cups (450 g / 1 lb) of okpa flour (ground bambara beans)

steps: Thoroughly wash the banana leaves using water and salt.
Sift the okpa flour into a large bowl, and mix in the crushed stock cubes and salt. Add the palm oil, and mix very well with a wooden spoon.

Start adding the lukewarm water to the mixed okpa flour, mixing very well until there are no lumps. After ensuring that there are no lumps, add enough lukewarm water so that the okpa will not be hard as stone when it is done.
Stir in the sliced habanero pepper, and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Scoop some okpa mixture into transparent nylon or banana leaves—avoid adding too much—and tie them closed.
Set some water to boil on the stove in a big pot. Ensure the water is boiling before putting in your okpa.
Boil the okpa for about 1 hour before checking it. The okpa will be solid when fully cooked.
Serve with custard, oatmeal, or pap.

name: Okpo Ogede (Plantain Moi-Moi)
attribution: "Okpo Ogede (Plantain Moi-Moi)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Okpo_Ogede_(Plantain_Moi-Moi), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 teaspoon palm oil or to taste

steps: Blend the plantains, plantain flour, onion, and crayfish together with a little water.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl, then mix in salt and palm oil.
Divide the mixture between molds, such as ramekins or aluminum pouches.
Place the filled molds in a steamer basket over boiling water. Cook until set.
Serve with custard, oatmeal, and/or cooked ground corn (akamu).

name: Okra Plantain Porridge
attribution: "Okra Plantain Porridge" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Okra_Plantain_Porridge, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine the plantain and water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 3–5 minutes.
Add the catfish, stock cube, onions, palm oil, okra, and ugu leaves. Stir until a porridge is formed, then cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Season with the salt and chile-tomato. Serve hot.

name: Omelette of Breadcrumbs
attribution: "Omelette of Breadcrumbs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Omelette_of_Breadcrumbs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Beat the eggs, adding finely chopped garlic and parsley successively.
Add breadcrumbs, making sure the mixture is uniform.
Cook the omelette over low heat with a few drops of cooking oil to prevent sticking.

name: Omo tuo
attribution: "Omo tuo" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Omo_tuo, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: After properly cleaning the rice, add it to a saucepan of water. When the rice is tender, add salt and bring to a boil. Give it a good five to seven minutes.
To make the rice smooth, mash it with a wooden spoon or a small pestle.
Pour cold water into a cup and place it near the pan. Transfer the rice to a serving dish after scooping it with wet hands and rolling it into balls.

name: Omu Tuo (Ghanian Mashed Rice)
attribution: "Omu Tuo (Ghanian Mashed Rice)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Omu_Tuo_(Ghanian_Mashed_Rice), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: If desired, rinse the rice well to eliminate excess starch. This step is optional as the starch contributes to the desired stickiness of the rice.
Combine the rice, butter, and salt in a pot with water. Cook over low heat, allowing the rice to slowly simmer until all the water is absorbed and the rice reaches a soft texture.
