Using a wooden spoon, begin pounding the rice in the pot, alternating from one side to the other. Repeat this process until the rice transforms into a mushy consistency.
Transfer the mashed rice to a moistened bowl and gently swirl it until a bowl shape is formed.
Serve with peanut stew or any other soup of your preference

name: One-Hour Thanksgiving Dinner
attribution: "One-Hour Thanksgiving Dinner" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:One-Hour_Thanksgiving_Dinner, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 ea. 5–6 lb fully pre-cooked smoked turkey breast (see notes)
1–2 package(s) of instant potatoes or stuffing
Nonstick cooking spray or vegetable oil
1 small disposable aluminum turkey pan with built-in rack

steps: Thaw the frozen turkey breast for one day in the refrigerator.
Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Remove turkey from bag and place in aluminum roasting pan. Spray the turkey with cooking spray, or rub the breast with it vegetable oil.
Place turkey breast in the oven on the middle rack, and cook for 15 minutes.
Begin preparing the gravy mix according to package directions.
Place the vegetables on the stove over low heat.
Prepare the instant potatoes or stuffing according to the package directions.
On a small pan lay out your frozen biscuits allowing them to touch one another. At this point the turkey breast should have been cooking for 30 minutes.

Place the frozen biscuits on the lower rack of the oven. The biscuits will cook just fine with the turkey in the oven and will be ready in 25–30 minutes. Check them after 20 minutes to be sure they do not burn.
Finish preparing your instant potatoes or stuffing, instant gravy, and vegetables. Place them in serving dishes if desired.

Place the cranberry sauce in a serving dish. If you are serving pie along with the dinner you will also need to place the pie on a serving dish. If a frozen pie has been purchased, follow the instructions for reheating
After 1 hour of cooking, remove the turkey and check the internal temperature with a thermometer to make sure it has reached 160°F (the minimum temperature necessary to kill any remaining bacteria).
Carve the turkey and serve with all of the prepared side dishes.

name: Onigiri
attribution: "Onigiri" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Onigiri, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 100 ml (½ cup) uncooked Japanese-style short grain rice
Filling of choice, such as any of the following:
Canned tuna, mixed with mayonnaise and seasoned to taste with chopped leeks, soy sauce, or chilies; sour or salty flavours work well.
Katsuobushi, moistened with a small amount of soy sauce

steps: Cook the rice according to package or rice cooker directions. Let cool just enough to handle with your hands.
While the rice is cooking, prepare your fillings.
Fill a bowl with salt water to rinse your fingers and season the onigiri. You can fill and shape the onigiri using two different methods:

* Method 1: Wet your hands in the salt water. Take two large spoonfuls of rice into one hand (carefully; the rice is hot), and gently squeeze and flatten it with the other. Make an indentation in the middle, and put some of the filling into the center. Be a little careful to get the filling only in the center and not all over the ball; that can make the rice less sticky, and stickiness is good. "Fold" the rice over the filling so it becomes covered. Squeeze gently, and mold it into a triangular shape by folding both your hands along the palms while keeping the fingers straight. Squeeze like that, rotating the ball a few times, and you will soon have a very neat triangle—this really is much harder to explain than to do. Once the ball is done, put it down on a clean surface to cool down. Rinse your hands in the salt water and repeat.

* Method 2: Use a bowl and some plastic film. Place about ⅔ of the mixture into the centre of the cling wrap that has been draped into the bowl loosely. Then, add approximately 2 teaspoons of filling (this is working off of about 3–4 portions per cup of rice. Then, place the last ⅓ of the rice to the top. Then, mould the onigiri within the cling wrap. This drastically reduces mess and also is slightly more 'kid friendly'.

Once the balls are reasonably cool, you need to protect them from drying out. The easiest way is to wrap them in cling wrap, or put them into an airtight plastic food container. When it is time to eat, take one rice ball, wrap it in a piece of nori, and eat away. If you don't mind soggy nori, you can wrap the balls in nori beforehand.

name: Onion Chutney
attribution: "Onion Chutney" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Onion_Chutney, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: In a shallow pan, heat the oil. Add the chana dal, and stir until the dal is roasted.
Add the onions, and stir fry them till they become transparent and the edges turn golden brown. Turn off the heat and let them cool for a few minutes.
When cooled, blend together the onion mixture, coconut, chillies, tamarind, and salt until it makes a smooth paste. Add a few teaspoons of water if necessary.

name: Ora Soup II
attribution: "Ora Soup II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ora_Soup_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 bunch ora leaves, torn into small pieces and rinsed

steps: Boil the cocoyams until soft. Peel them, and use a mortar and pestle to pound them to a smooth paste.
Boil the shaki, stockfish, and dryfish in 1 liter of water for about 45 minutes over medium heat.
Add the beef and stock cubes and continue cooking until well done.

name: Orange Brulée
attribution: "Orange Brulée" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Orange_Brul%C3%A9e, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to broil and position rack on the second from top position.
Cut off ends of each orange, then cut off the rind using a paring knife, making certain that no bitter white pith remains.
Cut each orange crosswise into thirds and place in an oven-proof baking dish.
Combine melted butter with brown sugar, then spread over orange rounds.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Place oranges in the oven and broil several minutes until the oranges are hot and begin to form brown spots on the tops.
To serve, arrange oranges in pretty stemmed glassware and drizzle with any cooking juices. Top with a dollop of yogurt and a mint sprig.

name: Orange Chocolate Chip Muffins
attribution: "Orange Chocolate Chip Muffins" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Orange_Chocolate_Chip_Muffins, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 220°C (350°F).
Sift flour into bowl, then rub in butter.
Add sugar, chocolate bits, eggs, milk, orange juice, and orange rind.
Mix well.
Spoon heaped tablespoons of mixture into greased muffin pans.
Bake for 15–20 minutes until cooked through.

name: Orange French Toast
attribution: "Orange French Toast" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Orange_French_Toast, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: In a shallow bowl, combine the eggs, orange juice, half-and-half, sugar, vanilla, and orange peel.
Dip both sides of bread into egg mixture; let soak for 5 minutes.
Place in a greased baking pan.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Uncover, and drizzle with butter.
Bake at 325 °F for 35–40 minutes or until browned.

name: Orange Julius
attribution: "Orange Julius" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Orange_Julius, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (6 ounces/180 ml) of concentrated orange juice
¼ cup (60 g) sugar (or less, to taste)

steps: Place all ingredients in a blender
Blend thoroughly and serve immediately

name: Orange Lemon-Lime Soda Float
attribution: "Orange Lemon-Lime Soda Float" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Orange_Lemon-Lime_Soda_Float, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Place orange juice and ice cream in a blender.
Cover and process until smooth.
Stir in soda.
Pour into glasses.

name: Orange Sherbet Smoothie
attribution: "Orange Sherbet Smoothie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Orange_Sherbet_Smoothie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 large scoop of vanilla ice cream
6 ounces (170 g) Dr. Pepper (or equivalent) soda

steps: Combine all the ingredients in a blender.
Blend until mixture is thin enough to pour out of blender into a glass.
Enjoy with a spoon and/or soda straw.

name: Orange Soda I
attribution: "Orange Soda I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Orange_Soda_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2¼ cups (560 ml / 19 oz) water, warm or room temperature
2¾ cups (650 ml / 625 g / 1.38 lb) white granulated sugar
1 oz (30 ml / 28 g) orange juice concentrate or orange syrup

steps: Combine the water and sugar in a 2-quart or larger saucepan.
Stir over medium heat until the sugar dissolves into a syrup, then remove from the heat.
Stir the orange juice concentrate into the syrup.
Using a funnel, transfer the syrup to an empty bottle and let it cool.
To make the finished syrup, mix one volume of syrup with one volume of carbonated water.

name: Orange Soda II
attribution: "Orange Soda II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Orange_Soda_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Remove the zest from the oranges in strips, leaving behind the bitter white pith.
Combine the sugar and orange zest in a container, and let this sit in the fridge for 24 hours. The sugar will extract the liquid from the citrus peels and produce a syrupy liquid.
Stir the orange juice into the sugar mixture until everything is dissolved. Strain out the solids to yield slightly under ½ cup (120 ml) syrup.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of syrup with 3 volumes of carbonated water.

name: Orange Soda III
attribution: "Orange Soda III" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Orange_Soda_III, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tsp (5 mL) 150+ proof unflavored spirit OR a mixture of ½ tsp (2.5 mL) gum arabic with ½ tsp (2.5 mL) water
½ cup (120 mL) carrot powder OR a mixture of 24 drops of red food coloring and 24 drops of yellow food coloring

steps: Combine the spirit or gum arabic water and oils together in a small cup, mixing well. Set aside.
Transfer this mixture into a larger container.
Put the carrot powder or coloring, citric acid, water, and white sugar into the container. Stir well.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

name: Orange-Glazed Sweet Potatoes
attribution: "Orange-Glazed Sweet Potatoes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Orange-Glazed_Sweet_Potatoes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup firmly packed brown sugar

steps: Slice sweet potatoes about ⅛ inch thick and spread evenly in an 8-inch square baking dish.
Combine orange juice, brown sugar, wheat germ, margarine, orange peel, cinnamon and nutmeg in bowl.
Pour liquid mixture over the sweet potatoes.
Cover dish with foil or lid. Bake for 1 hour at 350°F until potatoes are tender.

name: Oreo Milkshake
attribution: "Oreo Milkshake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Oreo_Milkshake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups (500 ml / 17 oz) vanilla ice cream

steps: Put ice cream in a cup and add a little milk (for thicker) or more milk (for less thick).
Mix with a spoon until smooth. If your cup is not filled to your desire add more ice cream and milk.
Stir in oreos until thoroughly mixed in.
Add anything else to the top such as "magic shell" sauce or whipped cream and sprinkles

name: Oreo Pie
attribution: "Oreo Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Oreo_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ gallon (1.9 litres) ice cream (usually vanilla)
3 crumb crusts (preferably Graham cracker or chocolate)

steps: Begin by softening the ice cream enough to spread.
Mix the softened ice cream with the Cool Whip.
Crumble the Oreos. This can be done by putting the Oreos into a plastic bag and crushing them with a rolling pin.
Mix the Oreos into the ice cream mixture.
Spread the mixture evenly into the 3 pie crusts.
Freeze for at least 2 hours.

name: Original Texas-Style Chili
attribution: "Original Texas-Style Chili" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Original_Texas-Style_Chili, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 chile pods, skinned and blistered, or sun-dried chiles
1 tablespoon Tabasco sauce (optional but frequently included)
2 garlic cloves, chopped (or more, to taste)

steps: Sear beef in a little cooking oil (not lard) until lightly browned.

Add the seared beef, suet, and chile pods to a large iron skillet or pot (at least four quarts), and enough water (the reserved "pepper water" if you prepared the pods yourself) to keep the meat from burning. Bring to a boil, then lower heat, cover, and simmer about 30 minutes.

Take pot off the stove and add spices and garlic. Put back on the stove, bring to a boil again, lower heat, and simmer another hour, keeping the lid on as much as possible. Stir when necessary, but remember that too much stirring will tear the meat. Add a little more water if anything seems seriously in danger of burning (but as little water as possible).
Take pot off the stove and skim off all or most of the grease.

Mix in masa harina, which "tightens" or thickens the chili con carne and adds a subtle tamale-like flavor. Simmer about 30 minutes more, until meat is done. Do a lot of tasting during this time, (1) to adjust the seasoning, and (2) just because a chili cook should do a lot of tasting.

name: Ossobuco Alla Milanese
attribution: "Ossobuco Alla Milanese" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ossobuco_Alla_Milanese, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 slices veal hind shank, about 2.5–4 centimeters (1–1½ inches) thick
3 ribs celery with leaves, chopped fine
240 ml (1 cup) dry white wine or white vermouth

steps: Preheat oven to .
If the butcher has not done so, tie the shanks around the middle with kitchen twine; this will keep them from falling apart during cooking.

Choose a heavy, covered roasting pan or Dutch oven which will just accommodate the veal shanks in one layer. Put the butter, two tablespoons of the oil, the onions, celery and carrots in the pan and sweat over medium heat until the vegetables have wilted—about 8 minutes. Add the garlic and lemon peel and sweat until they're fragrant, about 2 minutes more. Remove from the heat.

Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a skillet until it is near the smoking point. Lightly flour the veal shanks and slip them into the oil. Richly brown the shanks on both of the cut sides, then place them in the roasting pan on top of the vegetables.
Place the wine in the skillet and boil until reduced by one-half, deglazing the bottom of the pan. Pour this over the veal shanks.

Heat the beef broth to a boil in the skillet, whisking in the tomato paste and anchovies. Add this to the veal shanks, along with the herbs, several grindings of pepper, and a large pinch of salt. The liquid should cover three quarters of the shanks. If not, add extra water.

Bring the pot to a simmer, cover, and place in the oven. Cook for approximately 2 hours, turning and basting the shanks every half hour. If you notice that the cooking liquids have nearly evaporated, add hot water, about one half cup at a time. The veal is done when it is fork tender and falling from the bone.

Transfer the shanks to a platter, remove the strings, and cover to keep warm. If the sauce seems watery, as is probable, place the pan on the stove top over high heat and reduce the cooking liquid until the sauce has a thick, creamy consistency. Pour the sauce over the shanks and serve.

name: Osumade Soup
attribution: "Osumade Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Osumade_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 thumb-sized pieces of osumade stick, washed

steps: Soak the osumade stick in a small bowl of water.
Peel the soaked osumade stick. Grind it in a blender or mortar, and then sieve it to extract the infused water. Reserve for later.
Wash the yam, and cut into small pieces.
Place yam pieces in a medium-sized pot. Cover with water, and cook over medium-high heat until tender. Do not salt at this point.
Drain the yam. Use a mortar and pestle to pound the yam until it is well-mashed and stretchy.
Place the meat in a pot. Season with salt, black pepper, and one stock cube. Cook meat over medium-high heat in its own juices
Cover the meat with water, and bring to a simmer.
Add the osumade water, stockfish, ground crayfish, ogili, palm oil, and seasoning cube to the boiling meat. Stir, then cover and cook for 15 minutes. Add additional water as necessary.
Introduce the pounded yam and the dryfish. Cook for about 5 minutes, or until it reaches the desired consistency.
Serve the soup with pounded yam or any other swallow of your choice.

name: Otong Soup
attribution: "Otong Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Otong_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Purée the okra and chile pepper with a blender.
Boil the meat with the blended onion, stock cube, and other spices to taste.
Add the okra purée and a little palm oil. Cook the mixture until it boils.
Stir in the uziza and ugu leaves.
Remove from the heat, and let rest for 2 minutes.
Season with salt to taste, and serve.

name: Ove (Nigerian Yam Moi Moi)
attribution: "Ove (Nigerian Yam Moi Moi)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ove_(Nigerian_Yam_Moi_Moi), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Remove unwanted substances from the fish. Then, rinse and cook for few minutes.
Combine the groundnut oil, onion, pepper paste, and fish to make a sauce.
Stir the sauce into the grated yam along with the salt.
Wrap this mixture up in the leaf, then boil for a few minutes to cook it.

name: Oven Pancakes
attribution: "Oven Pancakes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Oven_Pancakes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 232°C (450°F), and oil an 8-inch oven-safe skillet.
Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and sugar.
Add the milk, oil, and vanilla; stir well.
Stir in the apple cider vinegar, mix well, and pour immediately into the skillet.
Bake at 232°C (450°F) for 18 to 20 minutes, and serve.

name: Oven Pancakes (Vegan)
attribution: "Oven Pancakes (Vegan)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Oven_Pancakes_(Vegan), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 230 C and oil an 8-inch oven-safe skillet.
Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and sugar.
Add the soy milk, vegetable oil, and vanilla; stir well.
Stir in the apple cider vinegar, mix well, and pour immediately into the skillet.
Bake at 230 C for 18 to 20 minutes, and serve.

name: Oven-Roasted Potatoes
attribution: "Oven-Roasted Potatoes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Oven-Roasted_Potatoes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, peel if you like, and cut potatoes into wedges longways.
Toss in large bowl with olive oil.
Sprinkle with thyme.
Place potatoes in baking pan in one layer.
Bake 15 minutes, turn, bake another 15 minutes.

name: Owo Soup
attribution: "Owo Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Owo_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 500 g goat meat, bushmeat, or assorted meat, washed
1 handful dried fish, washed with hot water
½ tsp potash (akaun), ground to a powder

steps: Blend the tomatoes and pepper to a paste.
Combine the meat, onions, seasoning cube, and salt in a pot. Cook for about 3 minutes in its own juices.
Cover meat with water, and simmer until tender.
Add the dried fish, tomato-pepper paste, and ground crayfish to the meat. Add about a cup of water and stir. Let simmer for 10 minutes, stirring to prevent burning.
Dissolve the potash powder in 4 tablespoons of hot water. Strain the mixture carefully, and mix the liquid into the soup.
Turn off the heat, and allow the soup to cool for about 10 minutes.
Return to the heat, and gradually stir in the palm oil.
Remove from the heat, and serve with plantains, yam, or any swallow of choice.

name: Ozark Pudding
attribution: "Ozark Pudding" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ozark_Pudding, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to .
Blend all ingredients together, starting with eggs and ending with nuts.
Grease casserole dish, pour in casserole.
Bake for about 35 minutes.
Top with whipped cream or ice cream.

name: Pabellón Criollo (Venezuelan Rice and Beans with Steak)
attribution: "Pabellón Criollo (Venezuelan Rice and Beans with Steak)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pabell%C3%B3n_Criollo_(Venezuelan_Rice_and_Beans_with_Steak), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 900 g (2 lb) lean steak, (sirloin or rump), about 12 mm (½ inch) thick

steps: Heat the oil in a large saucepan, add the onions and garlic and cook over a medium heat for about 5 minutes until the onions are soft and transparent.
Add the tomatoes, cumin and salt, mix well, reduce the heat to low and cook uncovered, for about 30 minutes, stirring often, until the tomato juices evaporate and the sauce becomes thick.
15 minutes before the end of the cooking time, preheat the grill to hot, place the steak on the grill pan and cook under the grill for 5 minute on each side.
Remove from the grill and cut into pieces about 12mm/ ½-inch long and 6mm/ ¼-inch wide then add the strips of beef to the sauce, mixing well.

name: Pad Thai
attribution: "Pad Thai" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pad_Thai, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3+ tablespoons (50 ml) white vinegar (or rice vinegar)
¼ cup plus 1 tablespoon (75 ml) tamarind juice
¼ cup and 1 tablespoon (75 ml) palm sugar (or granulated sugar)
2 tablespoons (30 ml) dried red chili pepper flakes (or to taste)
½ pound (225 g) of shrimp, tofu, chicken, squid, or beef (or a combination thereof)
Assorted vegetables (e.g., shredded carrots, white onions, red or green peppers)
¾ cup (175 ml) chopped unroasted peanuts

steps: Soak the noodles in warm water for about 20 minutes and strain. Alternatively, pour boiling water over the noodles and let them sit for 7 minutes.)
Mix the fish sauce with the vinegar, sugar and tamarind juice together in a small bowl.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok on high, and brown the chopped garlic and chili peppers for a minute.
Cook the meats/tofu in oil, until they are browned (6–8 minutes).
Add assorted veggies and cook until tender.
Add noodles. Crack the eggs over the noodles, allow them to cook, and then mix them up.
Add the fish sauce mix into the wok, mix it all up and turn the heat down to medium.
Add the chopped green onions and bean sprouts, then stir fry for 2 more minutes.
Serve on a large plate or bowl. Garnish with chopped peanuts and, optionally, chopped cilantro or coriander and a wedge of lime.

name: Pad Thai Sauce
attribution: "Pad Thai Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pad_Thai_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup (60 ml) Thai fish sauce

steps: Mince the garlic. Lightly brown it in a frying pan over high heat with the oil.
Combine the juice, soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar and mix thoroughly
After mixture starts bubbling, add the chili paste and cornstarch. Mix well and cook for another minute or two.

name: Paella de Marisco
attribution: "Paella de Marisco" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Paella_de_Marisco, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 500 g yellow onion, cut into quarters
8 Norway lobsters (or very large crawfish or shrimp if Norway lobsters aren't available)
8–10 strands of saffron (or 1½ teaspoons food coloring; see notes)

steps: Boil the broth ingredients in water, allowing the liquid to reduce until there's 2 liters of broth. Occasionally mash the ingredients against the bottom of the pot with a ladle or potato masher to squeeze out their flavors.
Strain the broth and set aside.
Heat oil in a paellera over a medium flame.
Add mussels and cover with a pot lid. The lid should cover the mussels but not the entire paellera. Cook until they open, then remove and set aside.
Add Norway lobsters and sprinkle them each with a pinch of salt.
Sear the lobsters, then remove.
Add the diced squid and sauté for about 2 minutes.
Add the shrimp and sauté for about 2 minutes.
Add garlic and sauté until golden brown. This should take about a minute.
Add grated tomatoes and sauté for about 4 minutes to make sofrito.
Add rice and braise until completely coated with sofrito.
Add paprika and sauté for about 2 minutes.
Add 2 liters of the seafood broth.
Add saffron (or food coloring). Mix well and simmer for about 3 minutes.
Taste the broth and invite your dinner guests to do so as well. If the broth is bland, add salt a pinch at a time until everyone approves.
Replace the lobsters and mussels, and continue cooking.

Begin tasting the rice after it's been simmering for about 20 minutes and reduce the heat a bit. Make sure the rice doesn't get too soft. Check the rice again every 10 minutes and reduce the heat slightly after each taste. Your goal is to wind up with rice that has a slightly underdone center. The time it takes to reach this point can vary from 30 minutes to an hour depending on your cooking gear.

Your paella is done once the rice is slightly firm to the bite (al dente), the paella is a little moist but not soupy, and there is a bit of toasted rice on the bottom of the paellera. This is considered a delicacy throughout the Spanish-speaking world.
Remove the paellera from the heat and cover it with a white towel (not foil). Allow it to sit for 5 minutes before serving.

name: Paella Roja
attribution: "Paella Roja" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Paella_Roja, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 225 grams (½ pound) of any of the following: frozen seafood mix, fish heads, whole crabs, shrimp heads, smelts
1½–2 red bell peppers, cut into strips
340 grams (12 ounces) boneless chicken breast or tenderloins
450 grams (1 pound) red bell pepper, diced
225 grams (6 ounces) canned beans (e.g. chickpeas, butter beans, great northern beans, lima beans; optional), thoroughly rinsed and strained
1½ tablespoons food coloring for yellow rice (see notes)
340 grams (12 ounces) squid mantles, diced or cut into rings, shrimp
24 live mussels, cleaned with beards removed
Sharp chopping knife for meat and vegetables
Clean, white towel large enough to cover the paellera
Stove or gas burner large enough to accommodate the size of the paellera
Low, forged steel tripod or cinder blocks/bricks to support the paellera over a wood or charcoal fire

steps: Fill a pan with about 1 inch of water. Bring to a slow boil and add the mussels. Cover the pan and wait about 2 minutes.
Remove the open mussels. Continue checking for open mussels about once every minute. Throw out the ones that won’t open but save the water.
Twist off the half shells without meat and discard. Put the half shells with meat in the fridge until you're ready to put them on the paella.
Cut the onion and bell pepper into quarters and place them in a large pot with the rest of the broth ingredients including the water from cooking the mussels.
Boil it down until you've got about ½ gallon of broth. Occasionally press the ingredients against the bottom of the pot with the potato masher to squeeze out their flavors.
Strain the broth and set aside. Discard the boiled seafood and chicken wings. If you don't like the idea of throwing out food then eat it as a snack but don't include it in the paella.
Taste the broth. It should have a strong seafood flavor and moderate chicken flavor.
Cut the red bell pepper into strips.
Pour a pool of oil into the center of the paellera. The pool should be about 2 inches from the edge of the paellera on all sides. Heat over a high flame.
Cook the pepper strips just long enough to scorch them. Remove them and set aside.
Add ½ tablespoon salt to the chicken and sauté until golden brown.
Add the garlic and sauté until it’s brown but be careful not to burn. This step should only take about a minute to 90 seconds.
Add the tomatoes, paprika, onions and diced peppers. Sauté until all the vegetables are tender to make a sofrito.
Add 960 milliliters (4 cups) of broth along with the food coloring and another ½ tablespoon salt. Mix well.
Bring the broth to a rolling boil then lower the heat a bit to allow the broth to simmer for about two minutes.
Taste the broth and invite your dinner guests to do so as well—this is a custom in Spain. The broth should have a very lightly salted flavor.
Add the rice and mix well. Once again, bring the broth to a rolling boil then reduce the heat to create a moderate simmer. Frequently mix the ingredients well to prevent burning.

Begin tasting the rice after it's been simmering for about 20 minutes and reduce the heat a bit. Make sure the rice doesn't get too soft. Check the rice again every 10 minutes and reduce the heat slightly after each taste. Your goal is to wind up with rice that has a slightly underdone center. The time it takes to reach this point can vary from 30 minutes to 1 hour depending on your cooking gear.

Add the seafood (except for the mussels) along with the beans and cover it all with rice. Allow the paella to simmer for 10 more minutes. Don't mix the ingredients during this final phase. Your paella is done once the rice is just slightly firm to the bite (al dente), the paella is a little moist but not soupy, and there is a bit of toasted rice on the bottom of the paellera. The toasted rice is considered a delicacy throughout the Spanish-speaking world.
Remove the paellaera from the heat and cover it with a clean, white towel. Then, allow it to sit for 5 minutes, which will give the rice some time to absorb more water.

Remove the towel, place the mussels around the edge of the paellera with the round edges facing down, and push them down into the rice. If your mussels have become very cold from sitting in the fridge then heat them in a microwave oven for no more than 30 seconds.
Arrange the pepper strips on top of the paella like spokes in a wheel. Your paella is now ready to serve.

name: Paella Valenciana
attribution: "Paella Valenciana" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Paella_Valenciana, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 250 g (10 ounces) chopped green bell peppers (optional)
500 g (17.5 ounces) diced or grated tomatoes
125 g (4.5 ounces) large haricot beans (canned or fresh)
100 g (3.5 ounces) small haricot beans (canned or fresh)
125 g (4.5 ounces) fresh runner beans or green beans
8–10 threads of saffron and/or 1½ teaspoons yellow food coloring (see notes)
400 g (14 ounces) calasparra rice, bomba rice, or pearl rice

steps: Clean the snails, poultry and rabbit thoroughly. Cut the poultry and rabbit into small pieces and salt them generously.
Pour olive oil in a paellera and, when hot, sauté the poultry and rabbit pieces until golden brown.
Add green peppers and sauté for 1 minute. Add the garlic and sauté until brown. Be careful; garlic burns easily.
Once the garlic is brown, add the paprika followed quickly by the tomatoes to prevent the paprika from burning. Sauté until the tomatoes become dark and pulpy and the mixture has reduced a bit.

Add the water and bring it to a rolling boil. Then add the snails, fresh haricot beans (if canned, continue reading to see when to add these), runner beans, and saffron (and/or food coloring). Allow the mixture to boil for 10 minutes over a high flame. Sweep a rosemary branch through the broth for no longer than 30 seconds and then remove it.

After 10 minutes have passed, you should have a flavorful broth. It's customary at this point to allow your dinner guests to taste it. The purpose is to determine if the broth needs more salt. If so, add more salt, a pinch at a time, until everybody is satisfied.

Add the rice and stir it using the rice skimmer. Then, once again with the skimmer, spread the rice over the bottom of the paellera. The coating of rice should be one centimeter thick. Let it cook over a high flame for 10 minutes.

Reduce the heat to medium and let it simmer for 4 minutes. Add the canned haricot beans, reduce the heat again to low, and let it simmer for another 4 minutes. Taste the rice frequently to determine when it's fully cooked. You'll know it's done when it's slightly firm to the bite. Italians use a similar approach when cooking pasta, which they refer to as al dente.

At this point, there should be some toasted rice sticking to the bottom of the pan. This is a delicacy in Valencia called socarrat. If no socarrat has developed, increase the flame to high and listen for the crackling sound of rice toasting at the bottom.

Remove the pan from the heat when the rice is almost dry, and place the unused rosemary branches on top. Cover with a clean, white towel (a white towel prevents dye from leeching onto the paella) and wait 5 minutes before serving to allow the rice to absorb the remaining broth.

name: Pakistani Chai
attribution: "Pakistani Chai" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pakistani_Chai, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 heaping teaspoons of loose chai tea leaves
2 pieces of whole cardamom (optional, but it gives a nice aroma)
1 medium/small saucepan (must at least 5 inches deep)

steps: Bring the water to a simmer in the saucepan over medium-high heat. Tear the cardamom shell (or grind it) and add it to the pan.
Quickly put the milk in the microwave and heat it for 2 minutes, or until very close to boiling over.
When the water nearly reaches a boil, slowly add the loose tea. Don't overwhelm the pan.
Add hot milk to the pan until it reaches a light brown color. It'll get only a shade or two darker when it's done. Raise the heat to the highest setting.
If you think you added too much milk, take a big spoon or spatula and mix it continuously. Remember: This all goes very fast, so be prepared ahead of time with your utensils.
Take the saucepan off the heat when the chai is about to boil over and pour it in the cup through the strainer.
Sweeten with sugar if desired.

name: Paksiw na Bangus (Milkfish Stewed in Vinegar)
attribution: "Paksiw na Bangus (Milkfish Stewed in Vinegar)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Paksiw_na_Bangus_(Milkfish_Stewed_in_Vinegar), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Clean the milkfish by removing the scales, gallbladder, and gills. Do not remove the intestines and liver. Using scissors or a knife, remove the fins and tails. Rinse and cut diagonally into 5 pieces, then pat dry.
Combine the carrots, bitter melon, garlic, and chilies in a heavy pot.
Arrange the sliced milkfish on top of the veggies. Sprinkle with salt and peppercorns.
Pour vinegar and water into the pot, cover, and boil for 5–8 minutes.
Reduce the heat, and simmer gently for another 8–10 minutes.
Remove from heat and serve with garlic or fried rice. Enjoy!

name: Palatschinken (Czech/Austrian Crepes)
attribution: "Palatschinken (Czech/Austrian Crepes)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Palatschinken_(Czech/Austrian_Crepes), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Mineral water (optional, makes the dough more fluffy)
Coated 25–30 cm diameter frying pan that is as flat as possible

steps: Mix the flour with the milk, stirring thoroughly. Mix in the eggs one-by-one, then stir in the salt and rum. If desired, thin the batter with a bit of mineral water.
Heat the pan well. Add a drop of oil and rub it over the pan with a kitchen towel.

Ladle a dipperful of the batter into the pan, tilting the pan so that the batter spreads as evenly as possible over the whole pan. Alternatively, you can accomplish this by using a special wooden tool used to spread crêpes.
Let cook about 45 seconds to 1 minute until the top of the palatschinke is dry.
Flip the pancake over, and allow it to brown for about 30 seconds on the other side. Remove from the pan, and set aside.
Repeat the cooking process until you have used up all the batter.

name: Palm Fruit with Syrup
attribution: "Palm Fruit with Syrup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Palm_Fruit_with_Syrup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Peel the palm fruit, and slice it.
Put the water in a pan, add the white sugar, and let it simmer over medium heat.
Add the palm fruit to the syrup, and heat it again.
Add the pandan leaves to the syrup.
Chill the fruit in syrup. Serve it cold with ice on top.

name: Pan de Jamón
attribution: "Pan de Jamón" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pan_de_Jam%C3%B3n, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 teaspoon (4 g / ½ packet) active dry yeast
¼ lb (220 g) thin-sliced, cured ham

steps: In a large bowl stir 1 teaspoon of the brown sugar into the water and sprinkle the yeast on top. Let sit 5–8 minutes until the yeast is foamy.

While the yeast is proofing, lightly chop the raisins and olives, or give them a few pulses in a food processor. Put in a small bowl and set aside. Make sure the olives are drained of liquid before chopping.
Once the yeast is foamy, add 1 cup of the flour, one egg, and 4 tablespoons of the butter. Mix thoroughly with a fork or with dough hooks.

Add the second cup of flour, the milk, 4 teaspoons of the brown sugar, olive oil, and the salt. Blend thoroughly until it pulls together. Knead by hand or with dough hooks for 5–6 minutes. The dough should be smooth and slightly sticky.
Place the dough in an oiled bowl and lightly cover the top of the dough with spray oil. Put in a warm place to rise, about 90 minutes.
Once the dough is risen, turn out onto a lightly floured surface and roll into a square about 12 inches to a side. Brush with the remaining melted butter.
Place a layer of ham slices, leaving a strip about 1 inch on one side uncovered. This will form the outermost edge of the roll.
Spread the raisin/olive mixture evenly on top of the ham.
Starting on the inner edge, tightly roll up the dough. It should make 3–4 full revolutions.

Wet the uncovered strip of dough and roll the loaf until the edge is directly on the bottom. This allows the dough to stick to itself and form a tight seal. Pinch and twist the ends of the loaf with wet fingers to seal.
Place the loaf on parchment paper on a large baking sheet.
Beat the remaining egg with the remaining 1 teaspoon of brown sugar. Evenly brush the outside of the loaf with the mixture, taking care to wipe away any puddles that form.
Put in a warm place to continue rising for about 40 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Put the loaf in and bake for 30–40 minutes.
Remove and cool on a wire rack.
To serve, cut into slices about the width of your finger.

name: Pan-fried Ravioli
attribution: "Pan-fried Ravioli" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pan-fried_Ravioli, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¾ cup Italian seasoned bread crumbs
½ package (25 ounces) frozen ravioli, thawed

steps: Combine milk and egg in a small bowl.
Place breadcrumbs and salt in a shallow bowl.
Dip ravioli in milk mixture, and coat with breadcrumbs.
In a large saucepan, heat marinara sauce over medium heat until bubbling, about 5–10 minutes. Reduce the heat to simmer.
In a large heavy pan, pour oil to depth of 2 inches. Heat oil over medium heat to 375°F.
Fry ravioli in hot oil, a few at a time, for about 1 minute on each side or until golden.
Drain on paper towels.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and serve immediately with hot marinara sauce.

name: Pan-Fried White Brined Cheese (Saganaki)
attribution: "Pan-Fried White Brined Cheese (Saganaki)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pan-Fried_White_Brined_Cheese_(Saganaki), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 large slice of salty, brined white cheese (e.g. feta, sirene)

steps: Heat a small frying pan over medium-high heat.

While the pan heats, cut the cheese into slices of the desired size and thickness. Thicker slices will take longer to melt through and may result in burning, while thinner ones will have less chance to brown.

Optionally, dredge the slices in flour—this will create a darker and slightly crispier crust, but is an optional step as the cheese will acquire a very slight crust on its own by virtue of the oil and high heat. It will also reduce the spitting somewhat.
Add the oil to the hot pan and swirl it around. When the oil shimmers and seems to become more fluid, it is ready. Add the cheese and step back—it will spit due to the brine-water on the cheese.
Flip the cheese after a minute or two. A slice of ¾ centimeter should get about 1–2 minutes per side.
Serve immediately, with lemon and (optionally) bread.

name: Pan-Seared Pork Chops
attribution: "Pan-Seared Pork Chops" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pan-Seared_Pork_Chops, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Brush pork chops with cider vinegar. Season each pork chop with the chop rub, pressing lightly.
Heat oil in a very large oven-proof cast iron or stainless steel skillet over medium high heat. Add pork chops and sear for 3 minutes per side.
Insert an oven-safe probe thermometer into one pork chop and place pan in a 350°F oven. Bake until internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Remove and let rest for 5 minutes; serve.

name: Pan-Seared Scallops with Cayenne Chocolate Sauce
attribution: "Pan-Seared Scallops with Cayenne Chocolate Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pan-Seared_Scallops_with_Cayenne_Chocolate_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tbsp ground cayenne pepper (adjust to your liking)

steps: Sprinkle scallops with salt and black pepper.
Melt butter in a large stainless steel skillet over medium heat. Place scallops in and cook 30 seconds per side. Remove and put on a platter.
Whisk together chocolate and cayenne pepper. Drizzle on individual plates, place scallops on top, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve.

name: Pancakes (North American)
attribution: "Pancakes (North American)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pancakes_(North_American), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 120 g (½ cup or 4 oz) wheat flour (white, whole grain or 1:1 mix of white and whole grain)
250 ml (1 cup or 8 fl oz) milk (substitute buttermilk or 1:1 mix of milk and buttermilk)

1 tbsp white sugar (optional; this will add a sweetness to your pancakes and is recommended if you are not using any sauces, syrups or ingredient such as bananas or blueberries that will add natural sugars to the mix)

steps: In a large bowl, mix dry ingredients together until well-blended.
Add milk and mix well until smooth.
Separate the egg, placing the whites in a medium bowl and the yolks in the batter. Mix batter well.
Whip whites until stiff and then fold into batter gently (skip this step for heavier pancakes or if 1 cup buttermilk is substituted for milk).
Pour ladles of the mixture into a non-stick pan, one at a time.
Cook until the edges are dry and bubbles appear on surface. Flip, then cook until golden.

name: Pancakes (Vegan)
attribution: "Pancakes (Vegan)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pancakes_(Vegan), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix all dry ingredients: flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
Mix soy milk into the dry ingredients.
Heat a griddle until water sprinkled on it quickly evaporates. Spread a thin film of oil on the griddle.
Pour pancake batter on griddle to form 4- to 5-inch circles. Bubbles should start forming.
When the underside is light brown, flip the pancake.
When the other side is light brown, serve.

name: Pancetta Fusilli with Herb Shallot Cream
attribution: "Pancetta Fusilli with Herb Shallot Cream" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pancetta_Fusilli_with_Herb_Shallot_Cream, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup tightly packed herbs (rosemary, sage, thyme, marjoram, parsley, basil)

steps: Place pancetta in a large sauté pan and cook over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally until crisp (about 15 minutes). Using a slotted spoon remove from pan and drain on paper towels. Set aside. Pour off all but 1 tbsp of the fat.

Add butter to the fat in the pan. Add garlic, shallots and sugar and season lightly with salt and pepper. Reduce heat to lowest setting and cook covered until shallots are soft and transparent about 15 minutes. Remove lid raise heat to medium high and cook stirring constantly until they have a deep golden-brown coating about 10 minutes. Do not allow to burn.

Add the stock and simmer until reduced by one-third, stirring to loosen brown bits from bottom of pan (about 7 minutes). The sauce can be prepared up to this point several hours ahead and kept covered in the refrigerator.

Bring a large pot of water to a boil for the pasta. Reheat the shallot mixture if it was prepared in advance. If using add cream to shallots and simmer for 2 minutes over high heat until sauce thickens slightly. Keep warm. Coarsely chop all but a small handful of herbs.
Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and return to pot. Add chopped herbs to sauce and cook for another minute. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Add pasta to sauce and toss together over low heat for 1 minute. As pasta and sauce heat, sauté remaining herbs in ½ tsp olive oil until crisp for garnish. Stir in pancetta and ½ cup of the grated cheese.
Divide the pasta among 4 bowls. Garnish with sautéed herbs. Serve remaining cheese on the side.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
attribution: "Paneer Butter Masala" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Paneer_Butter_Masala, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Fry paneer in ghee or oil, and set aside in a bowl.
Sauté onion in oil with garlic and ginger paste until golden brown.
Add diced capsicum and tomatoes.
In a separate pan combine ghee, hing, cardamom, turmeric, garam masala, chilli powder, lemon juice, and cumin.
Fry for 2 minutes, then add yoghurt.
Cook on medium heat for five minutes.
Add onions, capsicum, tomatoes, and paneer.
Cook on low heat for 15 minutes occasionally stirring.
Serve with rotis or naan and rice.

name: Panocha (Sprouted Wheat Pudding)
attribution: "Panocha (Sprouted Wheat Pudding)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Panocha_(Sprouted_Wheat_Pudding), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine the flours and salt.
Melt the butter in a medium pot, then stir in the sugar. Let caramelize gently over low heat.
Carefully whisk in the boiling water, then the flour mixture. Make sure to stir until free of lumps.
Cook over low heat for 2–3 hours.

name: Papadam (Black Gram Flatbread)
attribution: "Papadam (Black Gram Flatbread)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Papadam_(Black_Gram_Flatbread), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup water (or more if needed)

steps: Mix together the flour, pepper, cumin, and salt.
Add water and knead the dough until it is smooth. You may have to add some water, depending on the flour.
Split the dough into 10–15 balls.
Roll out one ball at a time to a very thin round layer on a slightly oiled surface.
Dry the papadams in the oven for an hour (at about 100°C or 200°F).
Keep them in an airtight container.
Fry the papadams in oil until they are crispy but not too brown.

name: Papaya Lassi
attribution: "Papaya Lassi" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Papaya_Lassi, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine everything in a blender.
Blend until smooth.

name: Paprika Chicken
attribution: "Paprika Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Paprika_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut the chicken into eight pieces.
Add the oil to a medium sauté pan. Sauté the onions for about 3–4 minutes or until they turn yellow.
Add the chicken, peppercorns, salt, and paprika, and stir it rapidly. It is a lot of paprika, but it is not hot and this is a Paprikash. Add water immediately to cover the meat.

Simmer over low heat. If using, add peppers and carrots after 10 minutes of simmering. Stir occasionally until the chicken is tender. If necessary add more water, but very sparingly. Do not boil the chicken—it should be almost fried in the end. This takes about 45–50 minutes. During the last 15 minutes, stop adding water and wait until the liquid is almost boiled off. Keep about a half finger's width of gravy on the bottom of the pan
Add the sour cream and heavy cream to the gravy and stir. Add fresh chopped parsley on the top.
Serve with dumplings, rice or mashed potatoes and salad.

name: Parmesan Cheese Soufflé
attribution: "Parmesan Cheese Soufflé" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Parmesan_Cheese_Souffl%C3%A9, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175˚C).
Butter a 2-quart (2 liter) soufflé dish.
Add 1 cup cheese, tilting dish to evenly coat the bottom and sides. Shake out any excess. Set dish aside in refrigerator.
Place the sour cream in a large mixing bowl.
Sift the flour into the sour cream, then whisk until well combined.
Add the egg yolks, one at a time, whisking after each addition.
Stir in salt, cayenne, chives, and remaining 2 cups cheese.
In a large clean bowl (copper is ideal), vigorously whip the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold egg whites into the sour cream mixture.
Pour the batter into the prepared soufflé dish and bake until soufflé has risen 2–3 inches above the rim and top is golden brown (1 to 1½ hours).
Serve immediately.

name: Parmesan Encrusted Tilapia
attribution: "Parmesan Encrusted Tilapia" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Parmesan_Encrusted_Tilapia, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup garlic-flavored croûtons, finely crushed

steps: Combine salt, cayenne, pepper, croûtons, and cheese. Set aside.
Coat fish with melted butter. Dredge both sides in cheese mixture. Let rest 2–3 minutes.
Dip fish in olive oil. Place on a shallow roasting pan and bake in a 400°F oven for 11–12 minutes or until fish is opaque and flakes easily when tested with a fork.
Serve warm.

name: Parson's Sauce (Hartshorne)
attribution: "Parson's Sauce (Hartshorne)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Parson's_Sauce_(Hartshorne), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Chop lemon-peel and pickled cucumbers very fine. Mix in all remaining ingredients.
Transfer to a saucepan, and simmer for 10–15 minutes.
Use or serve.

name: Party Mix
attribution: "Party Mix" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Party_Mix, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup (120g) garlic-flavor bite-size bagel chips or regular-size bagel chips, broken into 1-inch pieces

steps: Heat oven to 250°F (120°C).
In an ungreased large roasting pan, melt butter in oven.
Stir in seasonings.
Gradually stir in remaining ingredients until evenly coated.
Bake for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.
Spread on paper towels to cool, about 15 minutes.
Store in airtight container.
In large microwavable bowl, microwave butter uncovered on high about 40 seconds or until melted.
Stir in seasonings.
Gradually stir in remaining ingredients until evenly coated.
Microwave uncovered on high 5–6 minutes, thoroughly stirring every 2 minutes.
Spread on paper towels to cool.
Store in airtight container.

name: Passover Carrot Almond Cake
attribution: "Passover Carrot Almond Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Passover_Carrot_Almond_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 eggs, separated and at room temperature

steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Grease the bottom of an 8-inch springform pan, and lightly dust with almond meal.
Whip egg yolks and brown sugar in a large bowl with an electric mixer until thick and light (about 5 minutes). A slowly-dissolving ribbon should form when the beaters are lifted.
Stir in carrots and vanilla.
Clean and dry the beater. Whip the egg whites with the salt until soft peaks form.
Gradually add the granulated sugar and beat until the egg whites make firm peaks.
Gently fold the whites into the egg yolk mixture.
Combine the almonds, matzo meal, and cinnamon. Fold gently into the egg mixture.
Turn the batter into prepared pan, smoothing the top.
Bake until tester comes out clean (about 1 hour).
Immediately run a knife around the edges, then leave to cool in the pan on a rack.
Remove from the springform pan.

name: Passover Hazelnut Loaf Cake
attribution: "Passover Hazelnut Loaf Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Passover_Hazelnut_Loaf_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 °F (180 °C).
Grind the hazelnuts to in a food processor until fine. You should have about 3½ cups.
Whip sugar and egg yolks until light yellow.
Whip the whites until soft peaks form.
Fold the ground nuts and the egg whites into the egg yolk mixture.
Pour into a shallow wide-brimmed oven-safe dish.
Bake for 30 minutes until the surface is golden brown.

name: Passover Orange Walnut Cake
attribution: "Passover Orange Walnut Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Passover_Orange_Walnut_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Beat eggs and add sugar, mix.
Mix in oil and add matzah meal.
Add walnuts and mix.
Add orange extract generously and mix.
Pour into 9-inch cake pan.
Bake for 30–40 minutes in the preheated oven.

name: Pasta alla Gricia (Pasta with Guanciale)
attribution: "Pasta alla Gricia (Pasta with Guanciale)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pasta_alla_Gricia_(Pasta_with_Guanciale), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat water and salt in a pot until it starts boiling.
Add the pasta, and cook until al dente.
Cook the guanciale in a frying pan until fat melts almost completely.
Add the cooked pasta to the guanciale pan, and fry for 2 minutes.
Add grated pecorino romano and black pepper to the frying pan, and toss to blend the ingredients.

name: Pasta and Bean Soup (Pasta e Fagioli)
attribution: "Pasta and Bean Soup (Pasta e Fagioli)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pasta_and_Bean_Soup_(Pasta_e_Fagioli), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 teaspoon or more crushed or ground hot red pepper
½ pound small diameter macaroni (whole wheat is best)

steps: Put washed beans in salted water (3 parts to 1 part beans).
Soak overnight OR bring to boil, boil 2 minutes and let stand, covered, for 1 hour.
Do not drain beans, but bring to a boil.
Skim off foam and add oil, garlic and bay leaf.
Simmer for about 2 hours, or until tender.
Cook pasta for 6–7 minutes, but don't let it get too soft.
Drain pasta and save some of the water.
Stir pasta and red pepper into beans and simmer until pasta is al dente, adding some of the saved water if necessary.
Garnish with red pepper to taste and parsley.

name: Pasta Marinata
attribution: "Pasta Marinata" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pasta_Marinata, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix the semolina flour, egg yolks, a little salt, and melted butter.
Add the water so as to form a liquid substance.
Whip the egg whites to soft peaks, and fold into the batter.

name: Pasta Romanov
attribution: "Pasta Romanov" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pasta_Romanov, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Pasta (taglietelli, spaghetti, or angel hair preferred)
Mascarpone cheese (or similar mild cheese like ricotta)

steps: Boil a pot of salted water, add the pasta, and cook until al dente. Drain.
Melt the cheese (do not overheat) and stir in a little tomato puree to turn it salmon pink.
Add a slug (a couple tablespoons) of vodka to the melted cheese.
Add caviar to the cheese and toss the drained pasta in it to coat.
Cut lemon into wedges and use as garnish with a teaspoon or two of caviar.
Serve with champagne or crisp white wine.

name: Pasta Salad with Chicken
attribution: "Pasta Salad with Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pasta_Salad_with_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Carrots, peeled and sliced thin or shredded
Canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed
Canned green peas, drained and rinsed
Canned sweet corn, drained and rinsed

steps: Peel the cucumber and cut in half. Scoop out the seeds and discard them. Dice the cucumber.
Combine the cucumber and carrots. Add the drained pasta, kidney beans, peas, corn, baked beans, eggs, and chicken. Toss to mix.
Mix in ranch dressing, mayonnaise, and ketchup to taste.
Allow to chill a few hours before serving.

name: Pasta Soup for Kids
attribution: "Pasta Soup for Kids" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pasta_Soup_for_Kids, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup carrots, in tiny cubes (the size of small peas)
½ cup diced yellow crooked-neck squash
½ cup baby corn, ¼-inch pieces (or ¼ cup frozen corn—see notes)

steps: Bring broth to boil in a medium-sized saucepan.
Add carrots, and lower the heat to a simmer.
Cook for 5 minutes, or until carrots are just tender.
Add zucchini, squash, and corn.
Simmer for 5 minutes, then stir in peas, tofu, and cooked pasta.
Simmer just a couple of minutes longer.
Serve hot (or very warm) in small bowl with small spoons.

name: Pasta with Corn and Tuna
attribution: "Pasta with Corn and Tuna" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pasta_with_Corn_and_Tuna, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 mugfuls of your favourite dried pasta
1 tin of tuna of equal size to the sweet corn

steps: Put the pasta on to boil in copious amounts of water with a little salt and a drop of olive oil added.
In a mixing bowl combine all the rest of the ingredients.
When the pasta is cooked, drain through a colander and add to the bowl.
Stir through, so that everything becomes well coated.
Serve immediately.

name: Pasta with Hot Dogs
attribution: "Pasta with Hot Dogs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pasta_with_Hot_Dogs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Boil and drain the pasta according to directions on package.
Combine pasta, hot dogs, red pepper, and maize corn in a baking dish.
Whisk the eggs and milk together, and season as needed with salt and pepper.
Pour the egg mixture over the dry ingredients, and bake everything together in a 200–225°C oven for 25–35 minutes.

name: Pasta with Red Pepper and Goat Cheese
attribution: "Pasta with Red Pepper and Goat Cheese" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pasta_with_Red_Pepper_and_Goat_Cheese, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 oz (115 g) goat cheese (e.g. bouchon, crottin, or generic chevre)

steps: Skin and finely chop or process the red peppers.
Place chopped peppers in saucepan, and cover with water. Crush and add garlic.
Cover the pot and bring to a simmer. Stir in wine and olive oil.
Add basil, oregano, and Tabasco, stirring occasionally at simmer; allow sauce to begin cooking down.
While you're doing this, start boiling the pasta in salted water. Remember that the sauce just needs to take its sweet time to cook down.
Cut the rind from the goat cheese; you only want the inner part for this.

As soon as the pasta and sauce are ready, toss them and the goat cheese together in your serving dish. You have to do this fast, so the goat cheese will melt through the sauce and over the pasta. Stirring the goat cheese into the sauce could result in burned sauce.

name: Pasta with Sausage
attribution: "Pasta with Sausage" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pasta_with_Sausage, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Bring 2 liters water to a boil, and add salt.
Add the spaghetti to the boiling water, and cook for 3 minutes.
Add sausages to pasta, and boil for 5 minutes.
Drain water.
Add butter to the pasta, then mix in sauce or ketchup.
Serve.

name: Pasta with Vegetables
attribution: "Pasta with Vegetables" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pasta_with_Vegetables, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Bring 2 liters water to a boil with the salt.
Add spaghetti to boiling water. Cook for 4 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes and cucumber to the boiling pasta. Boil for another 5 minutes.
Drain the water, add the butter or oil, and mix in the chopped onion.
Mix in sauce or ketchup, and serve.

name: Pasta, Meat and Cheese Casserole (Mostaccioli)
attribution: "Pasta, Meat and Cheese Casserole (Mostaccioli)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pasta,_Meat_and_Cheese_Casserole_(Mostaccioli), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cook mostaccioli until al dente in boiling salted water. Drain and set aside.
In skillet, combine meat, sausages, onion, green pepper and garlic. Cook while breaking up meat, until browned. Drain off fat.
To the meat, add all remaining ingredients, except egg and cheeses. Bring meat sauce to a boil. Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Combine egg and cheeses. To assemble, stir cooked pasta into meat sauce. Place half in buttered 1-quart baking dish.
Spread cheese mixture evenly over the top. cover with remaining pasta.
Bake, covered, at 350°F for 30–35 minutes or until cooked through.

name: Paste for Tarts
attribution: "Paste for Tarts" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Paste_for_Tarts, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine the sugar and flour.
Make it into a stiff paste with the boiling cream and butter.
Work the dough well, and roll it very thinly.

name: Pasties
attribution: "Pasties" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pasties, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 medium swede (rutabaga, yellow turnip) or similar root vegetable, peeled, cut into chunks, and then thinly sliced
4 large potatoes, prepared same as the swede
4 medium onions, halved and thinly sliced
2 pounds (900 g) beef round (skirt), sliced across the grain into roughly 1x2 cm strips

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F 200°C Gas Mark 6.
Lightly dust the prepared meat in seasoned flour (optional but makes a thicker gravy of the enclosed juices).
Divide the pastry into 4 equal portions. Roll each into circles.
Layer meat and vegetables on one half of each pastry circle to within 1 inch of the edge. Season generously.
Brush milk onto the edge of the pastry circles (optional).
Bring the other half of the dough over the top of the mixture.
Pinch and twist to seal the dough around the edges.
Make a couple of small slashes in the top of the pastry to allow steam to escape.
Brush pasties with the remaining milk (optional).

Use pastry trimmings to make the intended eater's initial(s) on one end of the pasty. This is the Cornish housewife's traditional way of making and identifying individual pasties to suit each family member e.g. less seasoning for young children or more meat for a hard-working son or anaemic daughter. Also, it enabled tin-miners and fishermen to identify their pasties if they had had to put them down somewhere half-eaten to attend to some urgent work.
Place the pasties on a lightly-greased baking tray (or a double thickness of aluminium foil directly onto the oven shelf).
Bake for about 45 minutes on the middle shelf of the preheated oven.
Best taken with a pint of bitter or stout or a large mug of strong tea.

name: Pastries Filled with Jam (Marmeladetascherl)
attribution: "Pastries Filled with Jam (Marmeladetascherl)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pastries_Filled_with_Jam_(Marmeladetascherl), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 package curd cheese (e.g. quark or farmer cheese)

steps: Mix the flour with the baking powder, and rub in the butter. Then, add the curd and the salt, and knead it into dough.
Let the dough rest in the fridge for 1 hour.
Roll the dough to about 2 mm thick, and cut it into 10 cm squares.
Put a blob of jam in the middle of each square, and fold them diagonally. Press the edges to seal the tascherl.
Brush a bit of the egg white onto each tascherl, and place onto a baking sheet.
Preheat the oven to 180°C, put the tascherl into the oven, and bake them for approximately 20 minutes.
Before serving, dust some sugar onto the tascherl to add some extra flavour.

name: Pastry Dough (recipe)
attribution: "Pastry Dough (recipe)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pastry_Dough_(recipe), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1⅛ cups (2 sticks plus 2 tablespoons / 260 g) butter (see notes, below)
1 cup plus 2 tablespoons (220 g) confectioner's sugar

steps: With an electric stand mixer or hand-held mixer, mix flour, butter, and sugar until the mixture has the consistency of small peas.
With the machine on low speed, add eggs and yolk, and mix just until well-incorporated, about 25 seconds.
Wrap dough tightly in plastic wrap and chill for at least 30 minutes before rolling out.

name: Pastry for Cornish Pasties
attribution: "Pastry for Cornish Pasties" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pastry_for_Cornish_Pasties, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ lb (225 g) mixture of lard, butter, and/or suet (equal ratios)

steps: Combine the dry ingredients, then gradually mix in enough water to make a stiff dough.
Roll dough to about a ¼ inch thick.
Cut out rounds with a tea plate—or other round object about 6in across.
Lay rounds on a pastry-board with half the round propped on a rolling-pin. Add the filling, and fold dough over filling.
Dampen the edges with water, and press to seal. Crimp the edges, then make slit in middle of each pasty.
Place on baking sheet, bake in hot oven (450 °F) until golden-brown.

name: Pattaya Fried Rice
attribution: "Pattaya Fried Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pattaya_Fried_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 tbsp olive oil (2 tbsp for frying and 1 tbsp for making an omelette)
2 red chillies, cut in 1 cm dice
2 chicken fillets, cut in 1.5 cm pieces

steps: Heat the oil in a non-stick pan. When the oil is hot, fry the garlic and shallots, stirring until brown and fragrant.
Add the chicken pieces, carrot, green peas, and red chilli. Stir for 2 minutes.
Add the rice, nam pla, tomato sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir until all mixed.
To make the omelette, heat the oil in a separate pan. Beat the eggs, and pour into the pan. Cook until the egg is browned on the bottom.
Flip the egg over to cook on the other side.
Place a ball of the fried rice mixture in the center of the omelette. Fold up the 4 edges of the omelette to enclose the rice. Flip it onto a serving plate.
Serve hot.

name: Pea Soup (Québécois Style)
attribution: "Pea Soup (Québécois Style)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pea_Soup_(Qu%C3%A9b%C3%A9cois_Style), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 ea. (1.5–2 lbs / 700–900 g) raw ham hocks, on the bone
2 cups (400 g) dried yellow split peas, soaked overnight and drained
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
Drizzle of olive or canola oil

steps: Preheat oven to 200 °C (400 °F). Roast ham hocks 30–40 min until browned, turning once partway through.
In a large pot, combine roasted ham hocks, onion, carrot, celery, thyme, bay leaf, peppercorns, and water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to simmer, skimming off any foam that rises to the top.
Simmer 2.5–3 hours until meat is tender and broth is flavorful.
Remove ham hocks and cool slightly. Remove skin, bone, and excess fat from ham; shred meat into bite-sized pieces.
Strain the broth and discard solids. You should have about 8 cups.
Return strained broth to pot, and add soaked split peas, diced onion, carrot, celery, garlic, and thyme leaves.
Bring to gentle simmer and cook 60–75 minutes until peas are very tender.
If using miso, dissolve paste in ½ cup hot broth (do not boil miso directly) and stir into soup.
Add shredded ham and simmer 10–15 minutes.
Add salt and black pepper to taste.
For rustic soup, leave as is. For creamier texture, blend ⅓–½ of the soup with an immersion blender and stir to combine.
Ladle hot soup into bowls. Serve with crusty rye, sourdough, or brown bread and optional drizzle of olive oil, canola oil, or sprinkle of parsley.

name: Peach and Tomato Gazpacho
attribution: "Peach and Tomato Gazpacho" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Peach_and_Tomato_Gazpacho, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups (473 ml / 1 lb / 454 g) pitted peaches
1 Tbsp (15 ml / 8 sprigs) chopped fresh tarragon

steps: Cut the tomato into sections, place ⅔ into the blender, and set the other ⅓ to the side in the small bowl.
Run the blender on high speed to purée the tomatoes.
Cut the pitted peaches into sections, place ½ into the blender, and set the other ½ to the side in the small bowl.
Add the peaches to the tomato purée and blend on high speed to purée the peaches.
Cut the shallot into sections, place into the mixture, and purée.
Chop the fresh tarragon, removing and discarding any large stems, place the leaves into the blender mixture, and purée.
Add olive oil, white wine vinegar, tarragon, salt, and pepper to blender and mix well.
Add crushed ice into the blender and purée for 30 seconds on highest power.
Add contents from small bowl into blender and pulse on lowest setting very briefly (this will provide some texture to gazpacho with small chunks of tomato and peach).
Serve right away as chilled gazpacho soup.

name: Peach Cobbler
attribution: "Peach Cobbler" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Peach_Cobbler, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine flour, butter, and milk. Cut together to make dough and set aside.
Pour peaches in 9x13-inch baking pan. Sprinkle sugar on top.
Roll out crust and place on top of peaches.
Bake at 350 °F or until top is browned lightly (approximately one hour).

name: Peach Curry Chutney
attribution: "Peach Curry Chutney" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Peach_Curry_Chutney, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ tsp freshly ground black pepper

steps: Blend all ingredients on high speed just until mostly liquid. There should still be chunks.
Bring to a boil over medium high heat until reduced by ⅓.
Serve warm.

name: Peanut Butter and Jelly Sandwich
attribution: "Peanut Butter and Jelly Sandwich" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Peanut_Butter_and_Jelly_Sandwich, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Using a spreading knife, spread an even coat of peanut butter on one side of each slice of bread.
When the bread is evenly covered, spread an even coat of jelly atop the peanut butter.
After applying the jelly, put one of the slices on a plate (jelly side up) and place the other slice on top of the first (jelly side down).

name: Peanut Butter Banana Oatmeal
attribution: "Peanut Butter Banana Oatmeal" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Peanut_Butter_Banana_Oatmeal, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup rolled oats or instant oats
½ tbsp (or more) honey, to taste

steps: Cook the oats in water. If using regular oats this should take around 10 minutes, while instant oats will cook more quickly.
Put the cooked oats in a bowl
Add milk, peanut butter, honey and sliced banana.
Mash until the banana and ingredients are all thoroughly combined.
Top with honey and serve warm.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
attribution: "Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Peanut_Butter_Banana_Smoothie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tbsp honey (or agave nectar to make it vegan)

steps: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until smooth. Serve immediately.

name: Peanut Butter Cookies (Egg-Free)
attribution: "Peanut Butter Cookies (Egg-Free)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Peanut_Butter_Cookies_(Egg-Free), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 ¼ cups (300 ml) whole wheat pastry flour (other flours likely work fine)

steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Cream all ingredients except flour together.
Add flour and mix sparingly—it should be dry enough to form into balls by hand without sticking.
Form into walnut-sized balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Flatten with a fork by pressing the tines of the fork across the cookie. Repeat going in the other direction to make a criss-cross pattern.
Bake for about 8–10 minutes.

name: Peanut Butter Pie
attribution: "Peanut Butter Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Peanut_Butter_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 8 ounces cream cheese, at room temperature
1 cup plus 2 tablespoons smooth peanut butter
1 jar (11.75 ounces) plus 2 tablespoons hot fudge topping

steps: In a medium bowl, stir together cream cheese, peanut butter and sugar.
Carefully stir in 3 cups of the whipped topping.
Spoon into pie shell.
Softly spread mixture to edges of the pie shell.
Put all but 2 tablespoons of hot fudge topping in a microwave-safe container and microwave for 60 seconds.
Spread hot fudge topping over peanut butter mixture in pie shell to cover.
Place in refrigerator for 2 hours.
Spread remaining ~1½ cups whipped topping carefully over top of refrigerated pie.
Knead last 2 ounces of hot fudge topping in plastic bag and cut off a corner and drizzle over top of pie.
Knead last 2 ounces of peanut butter in plastic bag and cut off a corner and drizzle over top in an artful pattern.

name: Peanut Butter Sandwich
attribution: "Peanut Butter Sandwich" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Peanut_Butter_Sandwich, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Toast and butter the bread slices.
Combine the peanut butter, honey, and butter. Spread over one slice of toasted bread.
Spread preserves (jam) over the other slice.
Put both halves of sandwich together.
Cut in half and serve with milk

name: Peanut Chicken Stir-Fry
attribution: "Peanut Chicken Stir-Fry" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Peanut_Chicken_Stir-Fry, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
