steps: Melt butter in wok or skillet.
Stir-fry celery and onions.
Add chicken and mushrooms and stir over lowered heat 5 minutes.
Combine (in separate bowl) cornstarch, soy sauce, and broth; slowly add to hot mixture in wok and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in peanuts.
Serve over hot rice.

name: Peanut Curry Sauce
attribution: "Peanut Curry Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Peanut_Curry_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Chop or grind peanuts into a fine meal.

Heat half the coconut milk in a medium saucepan on high heat, and add red curry paste. Stir until curry paste is dissolved and then continue to heat on high for 10–12 minutes (not stirring) until the oil from the coconut milk has risen to the top.
Decrease heat to medium-high and add ground peanuts. Stir and add the rest of the coconut milk, bring to a full boil then decrease heat, and add the sugar, lemon juice and fish sauce.
Continue to cook (stirring occasionally) for 15–20 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the oil has risen to the surface again.

Take off heat and let set for about ½ hour. Stir to blend in the oil that has risen, the sauce should be not quite as thick as peanut butter. If it seems too thick add about a teaspoon of water or coconut milk.

name: Peanut Sauce (Saus Kacang)
attribution: "Peanut Sauce (Saus Kacang)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Peanut_Sauce_(Saus_Kacang), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix the peanut butter with water, and stir gently until smooth.
Add some sambal oelek, some lemon juice, salt, and soy sauce. Keep stirring, adjusting the ingredients to get the taste right.

name: Pear and Almond Smoothie (Vegan)
attribution: "Pear and Almond Smoothie (Vegan)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pear_and_Almond_Smoothie_(Vegan), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut the pear into chunks, discarding the core. Place the chunks of pear in a blender.
Squeeze the juice of the lemon over the pear.
Add the almond milk. Blend. Serve immediately

name: Pear Chutney
attribution: "Pear Chutney" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pear_Chutney, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Pare, core, and slice pears.
Chop pepper finely.
Mix pears, pepper, raisins, sugar, crystallised ginger, white vinegar, salt, and water in a pot.
Use string to tie spices in a cheesecloth bag and add to pears
Simmer mixture until thick, about 2 hours.
Remove spice bag.
Add liquid pectin and boil for 1 minute.
Pour immediately into hot, sterilised jars, and seal straight away.

name: Pear-Cranberry Crisp
attribution: "Pear-Cranberry Crisp" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pear-Cranberry_Crisp, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 ea. (2½ pounds) firm, ripe pears peeled, cored, and sliced
⅔ cup firmly packed brown sugar
½ cup butter cut into pieces

steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Toss pears, cranberries, sugar, and ¼ teaspoon cinnamon in a 9x9-inch baking dish until blended.
Combine oats, almonds, brown sugar, butter, flour, and remaining ¼ teaspoon cinnamon in large bowl. Blend with fingertips.
Sprinkle crumble over fruit and pat down lightly.
Bake until pears are tender and topping is golden, about 45 minutes.
Serve hot or warm.

name: Peas Supreme
attribution: "Peas Supreme" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Peas_Supreme, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (4 ounces) sliced mushrooms, juice reserved

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Cook peas according to package instructions, then drain.
In a separate pan, melt butter.
Add mushroom juice and flour to melted butter. Stir until thickened.
Add mixture to peas, then add water chestnuts and mushrooms.
Place in medium baking pan coated with cooking spray.
Sprinkle breadcrumbs on top if desired.
Bake for 12–15 minutes, or until heated through.

name: Pecan Pie
attribution: "Pecan Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pecan_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup (50 grams) Crisco vegetable shortening (or lard)
½ cup (115 milliliters) very cold water
1 packed cup (200 grams) dark brown sugar
¾ cup (250 grams) light corn syrup
1 tablespoon (45 milliliters) bourbon whiskey or dark rum

steps: Spread whole pecans onto a baking sheet and roast in a 350°F (175°C) oven for 10 minutes.
Allow the pecans to cool, then chop coarsely.
Dice butter into cubes and place butter and shortening in freezer for 20–30 minutes.
Combine the flour, sugar, and salt in a food processor and pulse several times to mix.
Add the butter and shortening, and pulse 8–12 times until the butter is the size of peas.
Mix the water and vinegar together.
With the processor running, pour the water/vinegar mixture down the feed tube and pulse until the mixture begins to come together into a dough.
Dump the dough out onto a board and press it together, forming the dough into a disk.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for approximately 30 minutes.
Roll out dough on a well-floured board into a circle, rolling from the center out, turning and flouring so the dough does not stick to the board.
Roll the dough onto the rolling pin and transfer to a 9-inch pie dish.
Mold the dough into the pie dish, pushing the dough into the corners.
Dock the bottom of the crust with a fork to help prevent the crust from puffing up when baking.
Place the pie shell in the freezer for 30 minutes.
Line the pie shell with parchment paper and fill with pie weights (or dried beans).
Place the pie dish on a cookie sheet and bake the pie shell for 20 minutes at 375°F (190°C) on the middle oven rack.
Remove pie weights by lifting out the parchment paper. Continue to bake pie shell for another 10 minutes.
In a medium saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter.
Stir in the brown sugar and salt until combined.
Add the corn syrup, and bring the mixture up to a boil, stirring occasionally so the filling does not burn on the bottom of the saucepan.
Continue to stir and allow the mixture to boil for 1 minute, then remove from heat.
Stir in the bourbon, vanilla, and chopped pecans.
Allow the mixture to cool for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Beat the eggs and stir them into the cooled mixture a little at a time.
Reduce oven temperature to 350°F (175°C).
Pour the filling into the hot pie crust.
Place the pie dish still on a cookie sheet back into the oven on the lower 3rd over rack; if you have a pie shield, put it in place to prevent the edges of the crust from getting too brown.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 45 minutes, filling should still be slightly jiggly when removed from oven.
Allow pie to cool on a cooling rack for 2–4 hours. Pie will cool to doneness.
Serve warm with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream.

name: Pecan Sweet Potatoes
attribution: "Pecan Sweet Potatoes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pecan_Sweet_Potatoes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup milk (or ¼ cup skim milk)
¼ cup flour (if using self-rising flour, omit salt and baking powder)

steps: Mix base and topping ingredients in separate bowls.
Pour the sweet potato mixture into a 9x12-inch pan.
Sprinkle on topping, and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

name: Pedernales River Chili
attribution: "Pedernales River Chili" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pedernales_River_Chili, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 teaspoon dried oregano (preferable to fresh oregano, which grows wild in central Texas)
6 teaspoons chili powder (or more, to taste)

steps: Brown meat, onion, and garlic in a large skillet.
Add rest of ingredients and bring to a boil. Lower heat, cover, and simmer for about an hour.
Skim off grease.

name: Penne alla Casa (Penne in Creamy Tomato Sauce)
attribution: "Penne alla Casa (Penne in Creamy Tomato Sauce)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Penne_alla_Casa_(Penne_in_Creamy_Tomato_Sauce), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup grated Pecorino Romano cheese
1 pound penne pasta cooked al dente and drained

steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over high heat.
Add garlic, and sauté until it just begins to brown (be careful not to burn garlic), about 1 minute.
Add cream and sun-dried tomatoes, and bring to a boil.
Add marinara sauce.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens and is reduced by one-fourth.
Season with salt, pepper and granulated garlic.
Fold in spinach and Romano, and heat just until spinach is wilted and cheese melted.
Toss with pasta and serve hot.

name: Penne with Hearty Meat Sauce
attribution: "Penne with Hearty Meat Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Penne_with_Hearty_Meat_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 8 ounces dry penne pasta, cooked according to package directions

steps: Remove casings from sausages.
Cook sausage in large skillet over medium heat until browned and crumbled; drain.
Stir in spaghetti sauce, tomato paste, and water.
Add pasta and stir until well coated.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, simmer over low heat 10 minutes or until heated through.
Sprinkle with cheese.

name: Pennsylvania Pot Pie
attribution: "Pennsylvania Pot Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pennsylvania_Pot_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ⅓ cup plus 1 tbsp cold water

steps: Boil chicken in water until tender.
Meanwhile, prepare noodle dough following the first 5 steps of the Flaky Pie Crust procedure, using the ingredients above. Sugar and butter are replaced with pepper and shortening, respectively.
On a floured board, roll dough about twice as thick as ordinary pie crust (about a 9-inch circle or 8 x 10-inch rectangle).
Cut dough into roughly 2-inch squares.
Remove chicken from broth. Shred chicken, discarding bones and skin.
Stir pot pie squares into boiling broth a few at a time, being careful not to let them stick together. Simmer 6 minutes.
Add chicken and green beans. Simmer for 10–15 minutes.
Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

name: Pepes Ikan (Indonesian Steamed Fish)
attribution: "Pepes Ikan (Indonesian Steamed Fish)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pepes_Ikan_(Indonesian_Steamed_Fish), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Banana leaves or aluminum foil to wrap

steps: Grind together all the ingredients for the spice paste.
Scale and clean the fish. Take out the intestines but not the eggs.
Make three diagonal slashes on each side of the fish for spice paste flavor to immerse.
Marinate the fish with salt and tamarind for 15 minutes then wash the fish with a bowl of water to remove excess salt.
Add cooking oil to the spice-paste, mix.
Coat fish with spice paste.
Put kemangi leaves, salam leaves and sliced lemon grass for the flavor.
Wrap the fish in banana leaves or aluminum foil.
Steam over medium heat for 30 minutes. Use pressure cooker for faster cooking time and better taste.
Let it cool and grill the wrapped fish over charcoal fire.

name: Pepper Crusted Flank Steak
attribution: "Pepper Crusted Flank Steak" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pepper_Crusted_Flank_Steak, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine the peppercorns, salt, cayenne, and paprika. Set aside.
Brush steak with mustard. Apply seasoning mixture and gently massage into meat.
Grill over high heat until marked on both sides. Lower heat to medium and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 140 °F for medium rare.
Remove and let rest, uncovered, for 7 minutes.
Slice as thinly as humanly possible across the grain and serve warm.

name: Pepper Soda
attribution: "Pepper Soda" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pepper_Soda, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 cubes of ginger that are ¼ in (0.67 cm) in width
1 tsp (5 ml) anise seed or 2 star anise pods

steps: Combine the water, prunes, ginger, cherries, zest, mint, anise, allspice, cloves, coriander, vanilla, and sugar in a saucepan.
Boil the mixture until it becomes a thick syrup.
Strain the syrup, discarding the solids, and stir in the caffeine. You should have about 5 oz (150 ml) syrup.
To make the finished soda, mix 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of sparkling water.

name: Pepper Soup
attribution: "Pepper Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pepper_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 kg goat, catfish, chicken, or assorted meats
1 tbsp fresh grated ginger or garlic (optional)
1 cup scent leaves or uziza leaves

steps: Wash and cut the meat into bite-sized pieces.
Rub the meat well with the salt, seasoning cube, and ginger/garlic.
Combine the meat and water in a pot, and simmer until tender.
Stir in the pepper soup spice mix, ground crayfish, and ground pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes to let the flavors blend.
Stir in the scent leaves, and cook for 2–3 minutes.
Taste, adjust seasoning, and serve hot.

name: Pepperoni Pasta Salad
attribution: "Pepperoni Pasta Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pepperoni_Pasta_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 ounces orzo, cooked and well drained

steps: Combine all of the ingredients in a large bowl and toss well to combine.
Serve warm or chill before serving.

name: Percolator Punch
attribution: "Percolator Punch" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Percolator_Punch, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Place the pineapple juice, cranberry juice, water, and salt in the bottom reservoir of the percolator.
Place the brown sugar, cloves, allspice, and cinnamon in the top compartment.
Heat for 10 minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Persian Apple Dessert
attribution: "Persian Apple Dessert" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Persian_Apple_Dessert, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 medium apples, peeled and cut up
1 tablespoon rose or orange flower water

steps: Place half the apples and the remaining ingredients in blender.
Cover and blend until coarsely chopped, 20–30 seconds.
Add remaining apples; blend until coarsely chopped.

name: Peruvian Molded Rice (Arroz Tapado)
attribution: "Peruvian Molded Rice (Arroz Tapado)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Peruvian_Molded_Rice_(Arroz_Tapado), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Sauté the garlic in oil, add a few drops of lemon juice, salt and the water, and bring to a boil.
Add rice and cook until tender. This should take 20–25 minutes.
In another pan, stir in onions and sauté.
Add meat, tomatoes, tomato paste, raisins, olives, egg and parsley.
Take an 8-ounce measuring cup and coat the inside with a little oil. Fill halfway with rice, add some meat filling and add more rice to top of cup. Invert onto a plate and carefully remove cup.
Cut the remaining hard-boiled egg in half and serve the two halves along side the arroz tapado on the same plate.

name: Pesto I
attribution: "Pesto I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pesto_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: About 8 oz (200 g) extra virgin olive oil
⅓ cup freshly grated Pecorino Romano or Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese or a 1:1 mixture.
¼ cup pine nuts or nut of choice (optional)
Freshly ground salt and pepper (to taste)

steps: Preheat the oven to 425 °F (220 °C).
If using, toast the pine nuts in an ovenproof pan for 10–15 minutes, checking every 5 minutes to prevent excessive browning or burning.
In a small frying pan (skillet), heat 2 tbsp of the olive oil on medium heat.
Crush the garlic and sauté in the oil until soft, about 2–3 minutes.

Combine the basil, garlic, cheese, pine nuts and oil in a mortar and pestle until it forms a smooth paste, or use a food processor or blender and chop finely, slowly adding the oil to reach the paste-like consistency.

name: Pezzetti di Cavallo (Italian Horse and Tomato)
attribution: "Pezzetti di Cavallo (Italian Horse and Tomato)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pezzetti_di_Cavallo_(Italian_Horse_and_Tomato), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut the horse meat in cubes, and fry it in a pan with some onion until it turns brown.
Add tomato sauce.
Add carrots, parsley, celery, laurel, and chilli peppers to taste.
Cook on low heat (preferably in a clay pot).
Skim the foam on the top and let simmer for 4 hours.
Serve with home-made bread.

name: Philly Cheesesteak
attribution: "Philly Cheesesteak" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Philly_Cheesesteak, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Drizzle filet with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper. Sear in a cast-iron skillet over medium heat for 6 minutes per side. Remove and let rest 7 minutes before slicing into bite-size pieces. Keep warm.
Toss onion with a little olive oil and sauté in same pan until lightly browned around edges.
To serve, place a big scoop of steak into a hoagie roll. Top with onion and torn cheese. Serve.

name: Phulourie (Split Pea Fritters)
attribution: "Phulourie (Split Pea Fritters)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Phulourie_(Split_Pea_Fritters), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ pt split peas, or 1 lb ground split pea flour

steps: If using whole split peas, soak overnight in lightly salted cold water, lightly salted. Drain and grind finely using a mill or food processor.
Mix all the ingredients, adding enough water to make a dropping consistency.
Drop dollops of batter into hot oil, squishing through thumb and forefinger to make balls about ¾ inch in diameter.
Fry until golden brown, remove from oil, and drain on brown paper or kitchen towel.

name: Picadillo (Beef with Potatoes and Tomatoes)
attribution: "Picadillo (Beef with Potatoes and Tomatoes)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Picadillo_(Beef_with_Potatoes_and_Tomatoes), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 large green bell pepper, stemmed, seeded, and chopped
14.5 oz canned diced tomatoes in juice
Black pepper, cumin, oregano and garlic powder to taste (about 2-2½ tablespoons total)

steps: In a large, heavy pan, heat oil over medium-high heat. Dump onions, garlic, bell pepper and seasonings into heated oil.
When the bell pepper starts to discolor, add the ground beef, stirring to break up large pieces. Brown evenly, cooking for about 7 minutes.
As meat is browning, add potato, beef broth and diced tomatoes.
Simmer until picadillo thickens, stirring occasionally.
Serve hot with Spanish (Mexican) rice and tortilla.

name: Picante Peach Cobbler
attribution: "Picante Peach Cobbler" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Picante_Peach_Cobbler, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (29 ounces) cling peach halves, drained and chopped
½ package (15 ounces) refrigerated pie crust (1 crust)

steps: Mix picante sauce, brown sugar, flour, cinnamon, and salt in 3-quart saucepan.
Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture boils.
Reduce heat to low.
Cook and stir 2 minutes more or until mixture thickens.
Stir in peaches. Remove from heat and let cool.
Pour mixture into 9-inch deep-dish pie plate.
Heat oven to 400°F.
Let pie crust stand at room temperature 15 minutes or until it's easy to handle.
Gently put the pie crust over the sauce mixture. Crimp or roll edges to seal.
Cut slits in crust with knife.
Bake for 40 minutes or until crust is golden brown.
Serve warm.

name: Pickert (German Potato Dumpling)
attribution: "Pickert (German Potato Dumpling)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pickert_(German_Potato_Dumpling), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cube yeast (about 16 g or 0.6 oz dried yeast)

steps: Put the yeast in a very big bowl or pot. Mix in the warm milk and grated potatoes by hand.

Mix in the flour and eggs, then the salt and sugar. Stir until it is a homogeneous dough. It should be neither runny nor solid, but have a consistency like soft cookie dough; add milk or flour to adjust.
Let the dough rest for 30 minutes.
Heat lots of oil in a frying pan over low heat.
Scoop palm-sized amounts of dough into the hot oil, and fry over low heat.
Serve it with liver sausage (Leberwurst), syrup, plum jam or a small chunk of butter.

name: Pickled Oysters
attribution: "Pickled Oysters" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pickled_Oysters, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Drain off the liquor from the oysters, and wash them.
Combine the oysters with the salt and vinegar; simmer them for about 10 minutes, discarding any scum that rises to the surface.
Take out the oysters, leaving the liquid. Place oysters in a jar.
Add the peppercorns, mace, and cloves to the oyster liquid, and boil for 5 minutes.
Skim the liquid, and pour it over the oysters in the jar.

name: Pico de Gallo
attribution: "Pico de Gallo" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pico_de_Gallo, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup chopped white or yellow onion
1 ½ tablespoons stemmed, seeded, and minced jalapeño or other chiles

steps: Wash vegetables and cilantro.
Combine vegetables, mixing well.
Add salt, pepper, chiles, lime juice, and garlic.
Add hot sauce as desired.
Let stand 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.

name: Pigeon Pea and Fenugreek Curry (Methi Tadka Dal)
attribution: "Pigeon Pea and Fenugreek Curry (Methi Tadka Dal)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pigeon_Pea_and_Fenugreek_Curry_(Methi_Tadka_Dal), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 handfuls of methi leaves (only the leaves without the tender stem)
½ small spoon of mustard seeds

steps: Mix all above and put them in an Indian cooker (pressure cooker). Wait until the dal is cooked (4 whistles).
Heat the ghee in a pan, and add the mustard seeds, zheera, garlic, red chillis, and curry leaves. Fry until the garlic is golden.
Add the chopped tomato, salt, chilli powder, and coriander to taste.
Add the cooked dal mixture to the fried mixture, and let it simmer. You can add water if you like it to be more like gravy.
Add two drops of lemon juice for added taste.
Serve with hot rice, and an optional touch of Gongura pickle.

name: Pikelet (Australian Mini Pancakes)
attribution: "Pikelet (Australian Mini Pancakes)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pikelet_(Australian_Mini_Pancakes), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Sift the flours into a large mixing bowl, adding half a teaspoon of the bicarbonate of soda and the salt.
Crumble the yeast into a small bowl and slowly add the water until you have a brown paste.
Pour the liquid yeast into the mixing bowl.
Mix it about a bit until you have a very thick batter. You can use a wooden spoon, but you get much better results if you get stuck in and use your hands.
Cover the bowl with a warm and damp cloth and leave in a warm place for 2 hours.
Return to the now frothy batter (if it is not then you have done something wrong). Dissolve the rest of the bicarbonate of soda in the lukewarm milk and slowly add it to the batter.

Heat a lightly greased griddle or ordinary frying pan until very hot. Now, using one spoonful at a time, cook the mixture for about 2 minutes on each side. The indication to turn should be when the bubbles that will form dry out.

name: Pimento Cheese Spread I
attribution: "Pimento Cheese Spread I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pimento_Cheese_Spread_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼–2 teaspoons finely diced jalapeños, to taste

steps: Mix ingredients thoroughly.
Store in well-sealed container in refrigerator.

name: Pimento Cheese Spread II
attribution: "Pimento Cheese Spread II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pimento_Cheese_Spread_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 jar (7 ounces) roasted red peppers or pimentos
1 pound sharp or extra sharp cheddar cheese, coarsely grated

steps: Drain and chop red peppers (or pimentos).
Toss peppers with grated cheese.
In a separate bowl, whisk lemon juice and mayonnaise together.
Pour liquid mix over cheese mixture and mix until well-blended.
Keep refrigerated.

name: Pineapple Bread
attribution: "Pineapple Bread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pineapple_Bread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup / 115 g Unsalted butter, softened
2 slices, each 2 cm thick / 300 g Fresh pineapple slices

steps: Add the banana to a medium bowl, and mash it with a fork. Cut the pineapple into small pieces and mix them into the banana.
In a separate large bowl, combine all dry ingredients except coconut flakes.
Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Put the butter, eggs, milk and fruits into the second bowl and beat well. As the actual water content of fruits can vary, add an additional tablespoon or two of flour if the mixture appears too wet.
Lightly grease or line an 8x4 in (20x10 cm) loaf pan.
Pour batter into pan.
Sprinkle a thin layer of coconut flakes on top.
Bake on middle shelf of oven for 60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the loaf comes out clean.

name: Pineapple Curry
attribution: "Pineapple Curry" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pineapple_Curry, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 8 oz shrimp, or whatever meat desired

steps: Simmer the coconut milk in a saucepan over medium heat for 5 minutes and add red curry paste.
Put the sliced pineapple in the curry and wait until it is soft.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then add the shrimp.
Flavor the curry by adding the palm sugar, fish sauce, and ripe tamarind. Add more palm sugar for a sweeter curry, add more fish sauce for a salty curry, and add more ripe tamarind for a sour flavor.

name: Pineapple Fried Rice
attribution: "Pineapple Fried Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pineapple_Fried_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 red chilli, cut in 1 cm pieces
2 bok choy, cut in 1 cm pieces

steps: Heat the oil in a non-stick skillet. Add the garlic, red onion, and red chilli. Stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the egg, then the rice, bok choy, and diced pineapple.
Season with pepper and salt, and serve hot.

name: Pineapple Side Dish
attribution: "Pineapple Side Dish" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pineapple_Side_Dish, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ⅔ cup coarsely crushed saltines (14 crackers)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175˚C).
Grease a 1½ quart (1½ liter) baking dish.
Drain the pineapple, reserving ¼ cup juice; set aside.
In a small bowl, combine sugar and flour.
Add the butter and 1 cup cheese; mix well.
Gently stir in pineapple.
Pour into the prepared baking dish.
Sprinkle crushed crackers on top; drizzle with reserved pineapple juice.
Bake, uncovered, for 30–35 minutes or until bubbly around the edges.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining cheese.

name: Pineapple Teriyaki
attribution: "Pineapple Teriyaki" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pineapple_Teriyaki, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups cubed chicken, tofu, or vegetarian "chicken" (usually flavored, pressed gluten)
1–2 bell peppers (whatever color(s) you prefer), diced
¼ cup water or reserved pineapple juice
1–2 cloves garlic (optional), minced, depending upon your teriyaki sauce

steps: Bring the rice, water, and salt to a boil. Cover, turn down the heat, and simmer for 20 minutes. Turn off the heat, fluff with a fork, and let stand for a few minutes.
Heat a deep 12-inch pan or wok over high heat. Add the oil, and let it heat up.
Sauté everything in the oil, adding the ingredients in the following order, so as to cook heavier items longer:
*Chicken
*Onion/garlic
*Bell peppers
*Mushrooms
*Pineapple
*Tofu
Combine the water and cornstarch. Add the teriyaki sauce and the cornstarch mixture to the pan. If using cornstarch, heat to boiling to thicken. Thin with extra water or juice as necessary.
Serve over the cooked rice.

name: Pinza Mostarda Bolognese
attribution: "Pinza Mostarda Bolognese" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pinza_Mostarda_Bolognese, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: from 1 lemon / 1 tsp (5 ml) Lemon zest
3 ea. / 150 g out of shell Eggs (standard)
as needed, perhaps ¼ cup (60 ml) Milk

steps: Stir together the dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl.
Cut the cold butter into smaller pieces.
Put the butter pieces into the bowl with the dry ingredients, and blend the ingredients together. You can do this by hand or with an electric mixer.
Add the eggs, stirring briefly after each one.
Mix gently until dough holds together. Add a splash of milk as needed, until you get a thick dough, similar to what you would expect for scones.
Cover the dough tightly and put it in the refrigerator to rest for about an hour.
Preheat oven to 350 °F (175 °C, gas mark 4—medium).
Turn the dough out onto the counter or a flat board and form into a thick disk.

* If you are working on a counter or board, sprinkle a large spoonful of flour on the surface before taking the dough out of the mixing bowl, and then another spoonful on top. Use just enough flour to keep the dough from sticking too much.

* If you cover your work area with plastic cling wrap, you do not need to put any flour on the surface. Cover the top of the dough with another layer of plastic wrap to keep your hands or rolling pin clean.
Roll the dough out into a rectangle about ½ inch (1.25 cm) thick.
Spread a generous layer of Mostarda Bolognese over the surface, leaving a clear border of 1 inch (2.5 cm) around the edges. This will reduce the risk of the jam leaking during the baking process.
Fold the dough along the longer side, letting the edges overlap (see illustration).
Put parchment paper on a large, ungreased baking sheet. Place the roll on the baking sheet, seam side down. Tuck the ends underneath to seal in the jam.
Brush the top with a little bit of milk, and sprinkle with sugar crystals.
Bake at 350 °F (175°C) for 30–35 minutes, until the roll is golden brown and the internal temperature is at least 190 °F (about 90 °C).

name: Pita
attribution: "Pita" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pita, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 500 ml (2 cups or 17 fl oz) durum wheat flour

steps: Dissolve the yeast in a bowl of warm water. Add salt, oil and flour, mix it, and knead it into a dough.
Let the dough rise to twice its size.
Divide the risen dough into 8 pieces and shape them into balls.
Then roll the balls into flat and round pita breads (to a diameter of 15 cm or 6 inches).
Let the breads rise in a warm place covered with a cloth for about 30 minutes.
Bake at 225°C (435°F) for about 12 minutes.

name: Pizza Hot Dogs
attribution: "Pizza Hot Dogs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pizza_Hot_Dogs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Split hot dogs and hot dog buns lengthwise.
Place buns on a cookie sheet.
Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over buns.
Place split hot dog on each bun.
Spread pizza sauce over the hotdogs, sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, and broil until cheese bubbles and the hot dogs are hot.

name: Pizza Rollups
attribution: "Pizza Rollups" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pizza_Rollups, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Pizza spices as desired (anise, basil, fennel, garlic, oregano, etc.)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Unroll 2 croissant rolls and place together on ungreased cookie sheet, pointing in opposite directions, forming a rectangle by pinching sides together.
Lay 6 slices of pepperoni on top of each dough rectangle.
Lay a slice of provolone cheese on top of pepperoni slices.
Roll each into a tube.
Bake 12–15 minutes.

name: Pizza Sauce From Scratch
attribution: "Pizza Sauce From Scratch" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pizza_Sauce_From_Scratch, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 ounce (170 g) can of tomato paste (with no additives is best)
1–1½ cups (250–375 ml) of water (depending on desired consistency)
About ⅓ cup (80 ml) extra virgin olive oil (more or less depending on taste)
About ½ tablespoon dried oregano (according to preference)
About ½ tablespoon dried basil (according to preference)

steps: Combine tomato paste, water, and oil.
Add garlic, basil, and oregano, mixing thoroughly.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
For best results place in refrigerator overnight or allow the mixture to rest before using.

name: Pizza Vanegas
attribution: "Pizza Vanegas" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pizza_Vanegas, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ can (15 oz) of Hunt's Family Favorites Pizza sauce

steps: Dissolve yeast and sugar in 1 cup warm water.
Combine 3 cups of flour, olive oil, one tsp of salt, and the yeast-water mixture. Knead for 15 minutes, adding more flour until dough is no longer very sticky.
Coat dough with a little oil (about 1 tsp) and place it into a large bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and let rest for 45 minutes until the dough is twice its original size.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to 350°F / 175°C for at least 30 minutes).
Gently deflate dough in order to eliminate air bubbles.
Cut dough into 2 pieces (you can freeze dough to bake later for up to a month).
Roll out dough to form a rounded pizza crust.
Add pizza sauce (½ can per pizza), and sprinkle onion, red pepper, salt, oregano and black pepper.
Bake 10 minutes.
Take out of the oven, add mozzarella cheese, pepperoni, and mushrooms.
Return to the oven and bake until cheese melts.
Cut into eight slices, and enjoy!

name: Pizza-Flavored Omelet
attribution: "Pizza-Flavored Omelet" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pizza-Flavored_Omelet, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Salt, pepper, and other seasonings to taste (see tips below)

steps: Mix spices and tomato sauce and allow to meld flavors while preparing the rest of the recipe.
Beat eggs well.
Heat a small skillet over low heat, sprayed with cooking spray.
Pour beaten eggs into skillet, then cover skillet.
Cook for 3 minutes. Eggs should be almost set.
Carefully flip omelet over. Cook another minute.
Combine mushrooms and peppers and cook 30 seconds in microwave oven.
Spread tomato-spice mix over omelet. Sprinkle cheese over tomato sauce. Top cheese with hot mushrooms and peppers.
Cover skillet. Cook another 2 minutes. Cheese should be melted.

name: Placenta Stew
attribution: "Placenta Stew" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Placenta_Stew, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Roll the placenta in a mix of the flour, salt, paprika, clove, pepper, and 6-8 coriander seeds.
Sauté the placenta in 2 tablespoons oil, then add the vegetables and about 1 litre of water.
Allow to boil, and then let simmer for an hour.

name: Plain Lassi
attribution: "Plain Lassi" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Plain_Lassi, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Whip the curd in a bowl until loosened.
Mix in a quarter as much water as curd.
Sweeten with sugar to taste.
Serve cold.

name: Plain Scones
attribution: "Plain Scones" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Plain_Scones, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 450 g (2 cups / 16 oz / 1 lb) cake flour, plus more as needed
5 tbsp cold butter, cut into pieces
120–180 ml (½–¾ cup / 4–6 fl oz) heavy cream, plus more for brushing

steps: Preheat the oven to 230°C (450°F / Gas Mark 8).
Put the flour, salt, baking powder and 2 tablespoons of the sugar in a food processor and pulse to combine. Add the butter and pulse until the mixture resembles cornmeal.
Add the egg and just enough cream to form a slightly sticky dough. If it’s too sticky, add a little flour, but very little; it should still stick a little to your hands.
Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead once or twice, then press it into a 2 cm (¾ inch) thick circle. Cut out 5 cm (2 inch) rounds with a biscuit cutter or glass.
Put the rounds on an ungreased baking sheet. Gently reshape the leftover dough and cut out more scones.
Brush the top of each scone with a bit of cream and sprinkle with a little of the remaining sugar.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes, or until the scones are a beautiful golden brown. Let them cool and serve immediately.

name: Plank-Grilled Salmon
attribution: "Plank-Grilled Salmon" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Plank-Grilled_Salmon, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Cedar wood planks, soaked in water
Grill or BBQ pit with the charcoal spread somewhat to the back so the fish can be moved for more or less heat

steps: Preheat the grill or charcoal pit.
Combine the Worcestershire sauce, beer, garlic powder, and lemon pepper to make a marinade. Add the salmon, and marinate for 15 minutes.
Remove the salmon from the marinade, and place on the plank skin side down. It should not hang over the edge.

Place the plank over the grill, and cook while watching carefully. A glass of water can be used to partially douse the fire when it gets too hot. As an alternative, a squirt-bottle or mister filled with water can douse any fire that commences on the plank. Individual planks give flexibility in moving to get all done evenly. Don't turn the fish on the plank; just move the plank(s) around, rotate, etc.
Remove the plank to onto a baking pan when the fish is cooked to the desired "doneness", and transfer to plates or a serving platter.

name: Po' Boy
attribution: "Po' Boy" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Po'_Boy, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Thinly sliced meat (ham, turkey, roast beef, etc.), fried seafood (shrimp, oysters, fish, etc.), etc.

steps: Slice the bread along one side so that it folds open like a book.
Open the bread and add the cheese, shredded lettuce, and meat.
Add condiments to your liking.
Close the bread (as you would a book) and mash it down.

name: Poached Salmon with wild Huckleberries
attribution: "Poached Salmon with wild Huckleberries" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Poached_Salmon_with_wild_Huckleberries, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In a baking dish, combine the fish stock and water. Add the salmon, making sure it is covered by liquid. If more liquid is needed, add equal parts water/fish stock until covered.
Add herbs, huckleberries, lemon slices, and peppercorns.
Place the in pan in the preheated oven, and bake for 15–18 minutes until salmon is flaky.
Serve and enjoy.

name: Pohe (Spiced Flattened Rice)
attribution: "Pohe (Spiced Flattened Rice)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pohe_(Spiced_Flattened_Rice), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Moisten the pohe with cold water by putting in a bowl and holding under a slow running tap. Mix by hand, then drain excess water and set aside (take care not to soak too long or the pohe would turn pasty).
Heat the oil in a frying pan until medium hot. Add the mustard seeds and let them crackle for a few seconds
Add the turmeric powder and asafoetida and fry for a few seconds (take care not to burn the turmeric).
Add the green chillies and fry for a few seconds.
Add the chopped onion and lower the heat. Cover and cook for 2 minutes. The onions should turn soft but not brown.
The pohe that was kept aside should have absorbed the excess moisture by now.
Mix the pohe by hand so that the flakes do not stick together and add to the frying pan.
Add salt to taste and stir the contents of the fry pay so that the yellow color of the turmeric is spread evenly through the pohe.
Cover and cook for 5 minutes on low heat. Do not uncover during this time, as the pohe must cook in the steam.
Stir and cook for another 1 minute uncovered.
Serve in a bowl garnished with chopped coriander leaves.

name: Polish Cauliflower with Breadcrumbs
attribution: "Polish Cauliflower with Breadcrumbs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Polish_Cauliflower_with_Breadcrumbs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Boil the cauliflower for about 10 minutes.
Melt some butter in the oven or a microwave.
Mix the butter with the breadcrumbs, and add dill if using.
Drain the cauliflower and add the mixture on top.
Eat!

name: Pollo Del Fungo (Chicken with Mushrooms)
attribution: "Pollo Del Fungo (Chicken with Mushrooms)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pollo_Del_Fungo_(Chicken_with_Mushrooms), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut chicken into sixteen 3x½-inch strips.
Wash and dry mushrooms. Mince the mushrooms until very fine.
Mix flour, ⅔ of the minced mushrooms, salt, black pepper, and a pinch of crumbled rosemary.
Heat a large frying pan with a small amount of oil and a pinch of black pepper.
Roll the chicken strips in the flour mixture and fry.
While the chicken is frying, mix (preferably grind) together the pepper, rosemary, paprika, and salt.
Remove the chicken and set aside.
Deglaze the pan with the wine. Add the spice mix and the remaining mushrooms.
Reduce for a minute or two, then add stock. Reduce to a sauce consistency.
On each plate stack 4 chicken strips and spoon 1–2 tbsp of sauce on top.

name: Polvorones (Spanish Shortbread)
attribution: "Polvorones (Spanish Shortbread)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Polvorones_(Spanish_Shortbread), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C)
Mix the margarine and the sugar in a mixing bowl until it reaches a creamy consistency.
Mix in the vanilla extract, salt, and eggs.
While mixing the ingredients, add the flour and stir until it becomes hard to stir the mix.
Make small balls and place on a flat baking sheet without grease.
Bake for 15–20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden.
Let cool.

name: Popcorn
attribution: "Popcorn" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Popcorn, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tbsp fine salt (non-iodized for those who prefer it)
Finely chopped herbs, such as rosemary and/or thyme (optional)

steps: Heat a large stainless steel bowl (or cast-iron skillet) over medium heat. Once hot, add 1 tsp clarified butter, salt, and popcorn kernels and cover with perforated aluminum foil or spatter screen.
Cook, shaking the pan continuously with tongs, for 45 seconds to 1 minute, or until popping slows to about 3 seconds between pops.
Move popped corn to a large serving bowl, leaving any unpopped kernels behind.
Toss with melted butter, salt, and any optional seasonings. Serve warm.

name: Poppyseed Chicken
attribution: "Poppyseed Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Poppyseed_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 pieces of chicken breast, boiled and diced
2 cups (about 1 sleeve) crushed Ritz crackers (or similar)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mix chicken with mayonnaise and sour cream. Spread this in the bottom of a 9x13 inch casserole dish.
Sprinkle cheese, crackers, then poppy seeds on top.
Evenly pour melted butter on top.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 25 minutes.

name: Pork Aachi
attribution: "Pork Aachi" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pork_Aachi, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ of a medium sized onion, finely sliced

steps: Brown the meat in half the coconut oil. Add half the meat masala powder and fry for a minute.
Add the vinegar and fry for a minute more. Add 1 cup water and cook till the meat is about half done.
Sauté the sliced onions and chopped chillies with the remaining coconut oil in a wok or a suitable vessel over medium heat.
Add the ginger and garlic after about 4 minutes. Keep stir frying for about 3 more minutes.
Mix in the remaining meat masala powder, and cook until the onions are translucent.

Add the beef stock cube and ¼ glass of water, keeping on low heat for around 4 minutes. Keep adding a bit of water as necessary to make sure that the paste mix does not stick to the bottom of the vessel/wok.
Add the half-cooked meat and mix well. Keep on medium heat until the meat is cooked thoroughly.
Add ¼ cup of water and the potato flakes/powder and mixture. You can vary the amount of the water/potato mix to desired thickness of the dish.
Remove from fire and hold for 3–5 minutes before serving.

name: Pork and Lima Skillet
attribution: "Pork and Lima Skillet" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pork_and_Lima_Skillet, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 packages (10 ounces) frozen baby lima beans

steps: Cook lima beans according to package directions, omitting salt in cooking water; drain.
In skillet, brown chops over medium heat. Remove chops from skillet. Pour off all but 1 tablespoon drippings.
Add gravy base to skillet. Blend in flour and basil.
Add ¾ cup water; cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly.
Add limas to skillet, stirring to coat with sauce.
Arrange chops over limas. Cover and cook over low heat about 5 minutes, or until heated through.

name: Pork Braised with Garlic and Onions of Indonesia (Babi Kecap)
attribution: "Pork Braised with Garlic and Onions of Indonesia (Babi Kecap)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pork_Braised_with_Garlic_and_Onions_of_Indonesia_(Babi_Kecap), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut the meat into 1-inch (2.5 cm) cubes.
Add the onions, garlic and ginger to a pan and cook at around 200°C.
Add the pork and mix with the soy sauce and black pepper (and chili pepper if desired).
After about 3–4 minutes, reduce the heat to around 120°C and cook, covered, for one hour.
Serve with nice-tasting rice.

name: Pork Gyoza
attribution: "Pork Gyoza" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pork_Gyoza, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1–2 tbsp each of minced green onion, bell pepper, and/or chili
At least 50 round wonton wrappers or other round dumpling skins (see note below)
Soy sauce and honey (mix to taste)
Soy sauce with some rice wine vinegar

steps: Combine the pork, mustard, soy sauce, and vegetables with clean hands. Knead the pork against the glass bowl to work the proteins for a mushier consistency.
Get out your dumpling skins, and cover them with a damp tea-towel or paper towel to prevent them from drying out.
Place about ½–1 tsp filling in the center of each dumpling wrapper.
Dampen the edge of half the dumpling wrapper. Fold the wrapper in half, enclosing the filling, so the wet and dry edges meet. Crimp the edges to ensure a tight seal.
Either proceed directly to the cooking stage, or freeze the dumplings and store frozen for up to six months.
Heat a heavy frying pan (not non-stick) over medium to medium-high heat.
Brush the pan lightly with vegetable oil. Add 8–10 dumplings, making sure not to crowd the pan.
Let these dumplings cook without touching them for at least 2 minutes. They will sizzle and pop, but do not touch them until they have stuck to the pan (usually about 2 minutes).
When they have browned on the bottom (watch the edges near where the dumpling touches the pan) check for sticking.
When the dumplings have stuck to the pan, pour about ⅓ cup of stock, broth, or water into the pan to a depth of about ⅛–¼ inch. Cover with a tight lid.

Cook until all the liquid has been converted to steam (about 2 minutes). This is one of the more difficult parts of this process. You may have to adjust the amount of liquid used based on the liquid and your pan)
Carefully remove the dumplings from the pan. Serve while hot with dipping sauces.

name: Pork Roast with Cayenne Apple Glaze
attribution: "Pork Roast with Cayenne Apple Glaze" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pork_Roast_with_Cayenne_Apple_Glaze, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine dry powders. Set aside.
Smear mustard as needed on one end of each roast. Attach mustard ends of roasts together.
Spread remaining mustard all over roasts. Apply dry powder mixture.
Bake at 375°F until internal temperature reaches 135°F.
Combine remaining ingredients and brush onto pork.
Bake at 375°F until internal temperature reaches 145°F (yes, it is safe).
Let rest for 10 minutes; serve.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Asparagus and Prosciutto
attribution: "Pork Tenderloin with Asparagus and Prosciutto" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pork_Tenderloin_with_Asparagus_and_Prosciutto, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Trim off any small patches of white connective tissue from the pork, as they will be tough and elastic.
Wash and slice the asparagus into small pieces, using angled cuts for improved presentation.
If you wish, you may set aside a few slices of prosciutto (chopped), as you may want to include it in the sauce.
Preheat the oven to 375°F (200°C).
Place the pork on a clean cutting board. Wrap the tenderloin with the slices of prosciutto, trying to wrap as tightly as possible so it will stay in place.

While you are doing this, also preheat an oven-safe pan to medium heat. Pour a few tablespoons of olive oil into the pan and place the pork inside. Start browning the meat on all sides. Once that is done, place the entire pan into the oven.
While you are doing this, heat up another pan (preferably a saucepan) and pour a few tablespoons of olive oil into it. Once it's heated up, toss the garlic and shallots in and sauté them lightly.
Once the garlic has been sautéed to a very light brown colour, add a small amount of olive oil and the asparagus.
When the asparagus is slightly sautéed, add about half of the cream and about a quarter of the wine.
Fill a medium-sized pot three-quarters full with salted water and set on high heat on a back burner.
Turn the tenderloin over in the pan, ensuring that the prosciutto does not fall off the meat. Sprinkle with a bit of salt and pepper.
Reduce the sauce to about half of the original volume, and pour in the rest of the cream and wine.
Turn the tenderloin over again.
Put the linguine in the boiling water and stir occasionally. You may choose to put the chopped prosciutto in at this point.
Once the sauce has reduced down again, lower the heat and remove the pork from the oven. Place it on a clean cutting board and let it sit for a few minutes.
Strain the linguine and start slicing the tenderloin into small medallions.
Place the desired amount of linguine on each plate, and place a few medallions on top. Spoon sauce over the top.

name: Porridge yam
attribution: "Porridge yam" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Porridge_yam, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Sieve or strainer (if using blended cocoyam)

steps: Peel the yam and cut it into medium-sized cubes.
Wash the yam thoroughly and set aside.
Place the yam in a pot and add enough water to slightly cover it.
Add chopped onions, pepper, and salt.
Bring to a boil and cook until the yam starts to soften.
Stir gently to begin breaking some of the yam pieces.
Add palm oil and allow it to cook further while stirring occasionally.
Add ground crayfish and seasoning cubes.
Continue cooking until the yam becomes soft and thickens into a porridge-like consistency.
Add fish or vegetables if using and mix gently.
Simmer for a few more minutes until well combined.
Serve hot.

name: Portable Eggs Benedict
attribution: "Portable Eggs Benedict" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Portable_Eggs_Benedict, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Boil enough water to fill a deep pan.
Add vinegar to the water.
Crack eggs into the boiling water/vinegar mixture. Leave them alone for 5–7 minutes.
Cut open the top of a pita. Line the inside of the pita with cream cheese and smoked salmon.
Take eggs out of the pan using a slotted spoon and drop them into the pita.
Eat immediately.

name: Portobello Eggs
attribution: "Portobello Eggs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Portobello_Eggs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Wipe mushrooms clean with a damp cloth, then remove stems and discard. Brush the outsides with olive oil.
Beat eggs with salt and pepper.
Set mushrooms on a cookie sheet and fill each with egg.
Top with Parmesan cheese and bake until eggs are fully cooked (about 10 minutes).

name: Portuguese Feijoada
attribution: "Portuguese Feijoada" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Portuguese_Feijoada, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Assorted meat of personal choice (universally it is pork knee, pork sausage, and salted dry beef)

steps: Soak beans for several hours, then put them in a large saucepan.
Add all the meat to pot.
Add bay leaves and chopped parsley.
Fill the pot with water and bring to boil.
Fry onions, tomatoes, carrots, and garlic in oil and margarine.
Once onions are fried, transfer two ladle scoops of bean mixture into skillet, mash with vegetables, then dump all contents of skillet back into pot.
Mix in tomato paste, cover, and let cook for 1 hour. Season with salt, pepper, and paprika to taste.
Cook rice separately and, when finished, add to pot, then serve.

name: Portuguese Sweet Rolls
attribution: "Portuguese Sweet Rolls" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Portuguese_Sweet_Rolls, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup / 45 g Potato flour (see notes)
1 packet / 1 scant tablespoon / 7 g Yeast (weight given for active dry yeast)
¾ stick / 6 tablespoons / 85 g Butter, room temperature
⅛–¼ teaspoon / 1–2 g Lemon oil (see notes)
¼ cup (2 fl oz) / 55 g Warm water (see notes)
Mixing spoon, such as a wooden spoon

Baking sheet, such as a half-sheet pan (or other shallow, oven-proof dishes); a half-sheet (18 x 13 inches / 46 x 33 cm) or two quarter-sheets (13 x 9 inches / 33 x 23 cm) is about the right size for this recipe.

steps: Put flour, salt, sugar, potato flour, yeast, and butter into a mixing bowl. If you are using a stand mixer, fit the dough hook and turn the mixer to its lowest setting to begin stirring the ingredients together. If you are mixing by hand, give it a few strokes with a mixing spoon or spatula. The purpose of this step is to mostly distribute the yeast throughout the flour and other ingredients. Don't bother stirring it more than necessary for this step.
Mix the liquid ingredients together. Pour the liquid ingredients into the flour mixture.

Stir everything thoroughly. If you are using a stand mixer, let it run until the dough comes together. This will probably take several minutes. At first, it may look like it will never come together, and then it will suddenly form into a smooth ball, or even into a wet, slack batter. If you are mixing by hand, you can turn the dough out onto a clean, flat surface (can be oiled or floured, as you prefer) and knead the dough by hand for up to 10 minutes, adding flour or water by the spoonful as you feel the need.

Assess the texture of the dough. If the dough seems sticky (e.g., makes a sticky mess on your fingers) and is too slack to form into a smooth, soft ball, then you need to add more flour. Start with a generous spoonful, and stir again until it is incorporated. Repeat the addition as many times as necessary (it is unlikely that you will need to add more than about ½ cup/60 g of flour). If instead there is dry flour in the bottom, then pour a small spoonful of warm water directly on that dry part, and mix again until the dry flour and the water have been thoroughly incorporated. If you overcorrected, then add a spoonful of flour until you get a workable texture.
Unless it's a hot day, turn on the empty, cold oven for one minute. Then turn the oven off. The purpose of this short "preheating" is to make a comfortably warm place for the dough to rise.
Cover the dough to keep the surface from drying out. You can do this by coating the surface of the dough with oil, or by putting a lid or a big plate over the top of the mixing bowl.
Put the bowl of dough in the (now slightly warm) oven or another warm place. Double check that the oven has been turned off.
Let the dough rise for about 1 hour, until clearly puffy and almost twice the original volume. If you used cold water, it will take longer.
If you're using parchment paper, place a piece of parchment on your baking sheet. Otherwise, you can lightly grease the pan to keep the buns from sticking.
Sprinkle a big spoonful of flour on your work surface, and spread this out a bit.
Remove the bowl of dough from the oven. Scrape the puffy dough onto your floured work surface.

Roll the dough in the flour to lightly coat all sides with the flour. If needed, put more flour on your work surface to keep it from sticking. Roll the dough into a rough log shape. Use a sharp knife or a bench scraper to cut the dough into about 16 pieces of similar size.

Pick up one piece. Dust the wet edges in the remaining flour on your work surface, so it won't stick to your fingers. Choose one of the smoother sides of that piece to be the "top" of your roll. Grab the edges around your chosen "top" surface, and stretch or pinch them back to the "bottom". This has the effect of stretching the smooth side and hiding any lumpy bits on the bottom. Pinch the lumpy bits together on the bottom. Flatten the bun between your hands, and put it pinched-side-down on your baking sheet.

Repeat this for the other 15 pieces of dough, until all of the pieces are shaped. When you place the rolls on the baking sheet, leave about an inch or two in between them, so they have room to grow in the oven.

Place the baking sheet with the shaped buns back in the barely warm oven. Leave it there for about 45 minutes or an hour to proof. If your oven has cooled off while you were shaping the buns, you can warm it up again for 30 seconds or so, but be sure to turn it off before you put the pan of raw dough in the oven.
When the buns look nicely puffy, take the baking sheet of raw dough out of the oven.
Preheat the empty oven to 325 °F (165 °C, gas mark 3, moderately slow/warm).

When it is hot, put the proofed buns in the oven and bake for about 20 minutes. Cover them lightly with a piece of aluminum foil to prevent overbrowning, and then bake another 10 minutes (total of 30 minutes in the oven). If you are using a thermometer to check the internal temperature, aim for 190 °F (88 °C).
Serve hot, warm, or at room temperature with butter and jam. Alternatively, slice them in half and use them for sandwiches.

name: Pot-au-feu (Boiled Meat and Vegetables)
attribution: "Pot-au-feu (Boiled Meat and Vegetables)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pot-au-feu_(Boiled_Meat_and_Vegetables), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 ea. (~600 g) turnips (each is one handful)
½ ea. (~400 g) celery root OR 3–4 celery stalks
A bouquet garni made of thyme, bay leaf, and parsley
Nutmeg (if you plan to serve the broth as the first course, i.e. the traditional way)
1 kg low-cost, tougher beef meat (e.g. beef chuck)

steps: Drive the cloves into the onions, so it will be easier to take them off after cooking.

Peel the onions. Cut them in half and burn the cut surface in a frying pan protected with aluminum foil. The cut surface must become completely black. It will bring a slightly "smoked" taste and the typical golden brown color to the broth.
While burning the onions, peel and cut the turnips, carrots, celery into large pieces.
For the leeks, cut the root, wash well the green part and cut them in 2–3 pieces. Even the green, more fibrous part is used.
For the white cabbage, if you took a quarter of a white cabbage, let it in one piece.

In a pressure cooker, put all the vegetables, ground pepper and the bouquet garni. Try to arrange them so that they take a minimum space. Add enough water to cover the vegetables (warning: a pressure cooker should not be filled more than ⅔ to ¾ of its capacity; check on the user's guide of your pressure cooker). If you cannot cover the vegetables with water, just add as much water as you can.
Add salt and cook the vegetables under pressure for 20 minutes.
Put the pressure cooker under cold water so you can open it, and reserve the vegetables. Throw away the onions and the bouquet garni.
Now you should have a golden brown broth. Taste it and add more salt or pepper if necessary. Note that it does not have its final taste since you have not cooked the meat inside it yet.
Put the meat inside the broth. Cook for 60–75 minutes under pressure.
If you use marrowbones, cook them apart or cook them under pressure for 5 minutes with the meat.
Put the pressure cooker under cold water so you can open it. Take the meat off and put the vegetables back into the broth. Allow the broth to boil to warm them up while you are slicing the meat.

name: Potage Parmentier
attribution: "Potage Parmentier" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potage_Parmentier, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3–4 cups (~1 lb / 450 g) sliced leeks or onions
3–4 cups (700–900 g / 2 lb) floury potatoes (e.g. Idaho, Maris Piper), peeled and thickly sliced
2 tbsp table salt or 1 tbsp sea/rock salt
White pepper, freshly ground, to taste
1–2 cups (up to 450 g / 1 lb) vegetables (optional), thinly sliced
1–2 handfuls flat-leaf parsley or watercress (optional), rough chopped

steps: If using leeks, remove the roots and dark green leaves; wash twice as long as you think necessary to remove the grit.

Place the vegetables, water and salt in a pot and bring to a boil. Lower the heat and gently simmer (partially covered) for 45–50 minutes. The soup is done when you can easily mash the vegetables against the side of the pot.
Puree the soup using a food mill fitted with the fine disc. Optionally, pulse it in a blender just until smooth and pass through a fine sieve.
Chill the soup if it is to be served cold, or gently reheat it to a simmer. Refrigerate any left-overs. It will keep for days if refrigerated in a covered container as soon as it cools.

Add 1½–2 tsp cream (or whole milk) per portion just before serving. You’ll need more cream if you’re serving the soup hot or if it’s a bit watery; the idea is to create a smooth, silky puree, but you don’t want the taste or mouth feel of the cream to predominate. Taste and adjust for salt and pepper.

name: Potato and Cabbage Soup
attribution: "Potato and Cabbage Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_and_Cabbage_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Sauté onion lightly in oil.
Add carrots and celery and continue to sauté.
Add flour and continue to sauté.
Add tomato sauce and a few tablespoons of stock slowly, stirring continuously. Cook over low heat until the sauce is ready.
Boil the remaining stock and add cabbage.
Add vinegar and cook for 15 minutes, then add potatoes and beet roots and cook for another 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot, covered with a tablespoon of cream for each dish.

name: Potato and Cauliflower Curry (Aloo Gobi)
attribution: "Potato and Cauliflower Curry (Aloo Gobi)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_and_Cauliflower_Curry_(Aloo_Gobi), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 800 g (6.5 ea.) medium tomatoes, diced or puréed
4–5 potatoes, peeled and cut into cubes
3–5 tablespoons of ghee or vegetable oil

steps: Heat the ghee/oil in frying pan, wok, or karahi (an Indian utensil specially used for frying purposes)
Add cumin seeds and wait until they turn a light brown color.
Add the spices (except for garam masala) and the tomatoes.
When the mixture turns oily, add the vegetables.
Roast the cauliflower and the potatoes until they turn soft. Stir occasionally.
Add the garam masala, mint, and lemon juice.

name: Potato and Chicken Stew (Ajiaco)
attribution: "Potato and Chicken Stew (Ajiaco)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_and_Chicken_Stew_(Ajiaco), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 ea. (approximately 750 g) whole skin-on bone-in chicken breast
2 scallions (white part and first 2 cm of green)
0.5 kg mashing potatoes, peeled and sliced 2 cm thickness
4 ears of corn, quartered lengthwise and cooked
10 ml whipping cream mixed with 10 ml créme fraíche
2 ripe but firm Hass avocados, peeled, pitted and cut into eight slices right before serving

steps: Combine chicken, broth, onions, scallions, carrots, garlic, bay leaf, thyme, cumin, cilantro and peppercorns in large saucepan and bring to a boil. Skim off froth as it rises. Reduce heat to low and cover when frothing finishes.
Remove and reserve chicken after it is cooked through (about 20 minutes).
Strain broth through sieve and return to pot, boil again over medium heat. Reserve carrots.
Add tomato paste and yellow and purple potatoes. Cover and cook until potatoes are soft (approximately 20 minutes).

While yellow and purple potatoes are cooking, boil sliced mashing potatoes in water and beef bouillon in separate pot. Once boiling, reduce to medium heat until potatoes start to fall apart (approximately 30 minutes).
Drain and reserve a quarter of the slices and mash the rest of the sliced potatoes. Add mashed and sliced potatoes to soup.
Remove bones and skin from chicken and discard. Cut chicken into strips 1 cm wide and 3 cm long.
Add chicken and peas to soup and simmer for 5 minutes. Slice the carrots into .5 cm thick rounds and add back into soup. Salt to taste.
Serve hot with garnishes available.

name: Potato and Garlic Ravioli Filling
attribution: "Potato and Garlic Ravioli Filling" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_and_Garlic_Ravioli_Filling, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 cloves garlic, grated with a micro plane or finely chopped

steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins until tender when pierced with a fork.
Peel them as soon as they are cool enough to handle and mash in a bowl.
Sauté the garlic in the oil for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes and mix well.
Add the chives, lemon juice and seasoning and mix well.
Cover and allow to cool while you prepare the pasta dough.

name: Potato and Leek Soup
attribution: "Potato and Leek Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_and_Leek_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 leek, white and light green parts only, sliced and rinsed well
1.25–1.5 pounds (2 large) russet or Yukon gold potatoes, peeled and diced
A few sprigs each of parsley and thyme (optional), tied together
5 ounces lettuce leaves, washed and coarsely chopped (4 cups)

steps: In a large, heavy soup pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the onion and leeks. Cook, stirring occasionally, for about 5 minutes until soft, .
Add ½ teaspoon salt and the garlic. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute or until the garlic is aromatic.
Add the potatoes, stock, leek green, bay leaf, and parsley/thyme bundle. Bring to a simmer, and season with salt to taste.
Cover and cook for 45 minutes on low heat.
Add the lettuce, and simmer for another 15 minutes. The potatoes should be completely soft and fall apart when you press them.

Blend the soup until smooth with an immersion blender, blender, or food processor fitted with the steel blade (working in stages and covering the blender lid or food processor with a kitchen towel to keep the hot soup from spilling). If you want the soup to have a smoother, silkier texture, strain it through a medium sieve.
Return the soup to the boil, and season with salt and freshly ground pepper to taste.
Serve.

name: Potato and Sausage Casserole (Papa Turmada)
attribution: "Potato and Sausage Casserole (Papa Turmada)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_and_Sausage_Casserole_(Papa_Turmada), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup hogao with 6 sliced fried pork sausages

steps: Boil potatoes until tender (20 minutes).
Cut bread into small squares and wet with milk.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch (about 25 x 32-cm) Pyrex baking dish.
Put a layer of potato, then a layer of hogao and sausage, a layer of sliced egg, a layer of wet bread and a layer of mozzarella cheese. Optionally, add thyme to the hogao.
Repeat with another layer of potato, wet bread, and Parmesan cheese.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°F (175°C), and serve.

name: Potato Balls
attribution: "Potato Balls" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_Balls, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine the mashed potatoes and egg yolk.
Roll the potato mixture into balls.
Dip the balls in the beaten egg, then coat with flour or breadcrumbs.
Fry the balls in the drippings until golden.

name: Potato Casserole (Rakott Krumpli)
attribution: "Potato Casserole (Rakott Krumpli)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_Casserole_(Rakott_Krumpli), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 kolbász (Hungarian sausage) or 1 cup diced ham (optional)
350 grams sour cream around 40% fat (called tejföl or smetana)

steps: Cook the potatoes for about 15–20 minutes.
Peel the potatoes and the eggs.
Slice the potatoes, eggs, and sausage.
Put a little olive oil in a baking dish. Arrange alternating layers of potatoes, eggs, and salt or sausage in the dish.
Drizzle olive oil over the filling, and top with sour cream.
Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for about 35 minutes.

name: Potato Curry (Aloo Masala)
attribution: "Potato Curry (Aloo Masala)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_Curry_(Aloo_Masala), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat oil.
Sautée the mustard seed first, then add chana dhal, curry leaves, onion and chillies.
Fry until the onions begin to change color.
Add potatoes.
Sprinkle the turmeric evenly and stir well to mix all the ingredients
Cover and cook on a medium flame for about 5 minutes, stirring well, until the potatoes become very soft and somewhat mashed.
Season with salt to taste.

name: Potato Gnocchi with Basil and Sun-dried Tomatoes
attribution: "Potato Gnocchi with Basil and Sun-dried Tomatoes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_Gnocchi_with_Basil_and_Sun-dried_Tomatoes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Prepare the gnocchi as per the package instructions, and drain.
Finely dice the sun-dried tomatoes.
Add the sun-dried tomato oil to a pan and heat.
Fry the minced garlic in the oil for 2 minutes.
Add the diced sun-dried tomatoes, gnocchi, and fresh basil, and stir until the basil has wilted.
Add the pine nuts, toss, and serve.

name: Potato Gratin
attribution: "Potato Gratin" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_Gratin, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 5 medium sized waxy potatoes, peeled or unpeeled
4 cloves of garlic, chopped (smoked garlic is good for this dish if you can get it)
½ pint reduced fat crème fraîche, single cream, or a mixture of semi-skimmed milk and crème fraîche
3 oz good quality Gruyère, Challerhocker, or Emmentaler cheese, freshly grated.
Salt (such as sea salt) and pepper
Fried pancetta, bacon cubes, or other cooked pork (optional)

steps: Preheat the oven to
Slice the potatoes very thinly (about ⅛" thick), if possible using a mandoline to achieve evenness, and place them in some fresh water.
Swish around the potatoes in the water to get rid of the starch, because that excess starch can make the dish a little unpleasant.

Pour away the water and place the potatoes on a wooden surface. Then pat dry with a paper towel or kitchen towel, which is important because otherwise the remaining water will mix with the cream, causing curdling problems.
Return the sliced potatoes to a bowl and add the cream and chopped garlic. Add a generous pinch of salt and some pepper.
You can also add a few fresh herbs (thyme is particularly good) but this is up to you.
Peel the zest of the lemon and add it to the mixture.
Mix well, so the cream gives a good coating to all the potatoes.
Pile the potatoes into a buttered, oven-proof dish. The size is if course difficult to gauge but the potatoes should not be layered more than about 4 thick.
Grate a generous amount of cheese, and spread over the mixture.
Pop it all into the oven and leave until the top layer of cheese and potatoes are brown and the cream is bubbling and running down the side of the dish. This will take about 40 minutes.
For a final flourish before serving, grate a goodly amount of fresh nutmeg over the cheese.

name: Potato Kugel
attribution: "Potato Kugel" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_Kugel, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup (120 ml) melted schmaltz or vegetable oil

steps: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Peel potatoes, cut into chunks, and place them in a food processor. Process until smooth. Do the same for the onion.
Mix potato and onion with egg, pepper, sugar, and salt.
Heat oil in a 9x13-inch (23x33 cm) pan until it is quite hot. Add 1–2 tablespoons of the oil to the potato mixture, and mix.
Pour the potato mixture into the pan. Bake uncovered for 1 hour.

name: Potato Meat Loaf
attribution: "Potato Meat Loaf" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_Meat_Loaf, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Place sliced potatoes in baking dish.
Place sliced onion over potatoes in baking dish.
Combine all ingredients except cheddar cheese soup, and mix well.
Press into baking dish, forming an indentation in the middle.
Pour cheddar cheese soup in indentation.
Bake 1 hour at 350°F.
Stand 5 minutes before serving.

name: Potato Omelet
attribution: "Potato Omelet" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_Omelet, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 potato, cut into ¼–½-inch (~1 cm) cubes

steps: In a bowl beat together eggs, sugar, salt and pepper. Mix in milk.
Heat up two frying pans to a medium temperature.
Use butter, margarine, or cooking spray to grease each pan.
Add chopped potatoes to one pan.
Cook potatoes until light brown, then add onions.
Add half of egg mixture to the other pan.
Cook omelet mixture until it starts to set (about 1 minute).
Add onions, potatoes, and cheese on top of partially set omelet.
Fold plain side of omelet over the filling and cook for an additional 30 seconds.

name: Potato Pancakes
attribution: "Potato Pancakes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_Pancakes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tablespoons Matzo meal, corn meal, or flour

steps: Peel and grate potatoes and onion.
