Mix potato and onion with egg, matzo meal, and salt.
Heat oil in a 10-inch pan over medium heat until it is quite hot. Drop 1–2 tablespoons of the potato mixture onto the pan per pancake. Turn once to allow both sides to fry.
Serve with applesauce and/or sour cream as a topping.

name: Potato Pie
attribution: "Potato Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Puff pastry, rolled out ⅛ inch thick

steps: Peel and slice your potatoes very thin.
Layer the potatoes in a pie dish, adding some onion, salt, and pepper between each layer.
Add a dash of water to the potatoes, and scatter the chopped butter over top.
Cover the filling with the rolled-out puff pastry.
Bake at 375°F until golden and cooked through (about 1½ hours).

name: Potato Pudding
attribution: "Potato Pudding" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_Pudding, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¾ cup (6 oz) white granulated sugar
1 tsp brandy, or more to taste

steps: Run the potatoes through a sieve, potato ricer, or mouli-mill.
Gently heat butter and cream together until butter is melted. Mix into potatoes.
Beat eggs lightly, then mix into potatoes. Mix in the sugar, currants, lemon zest, nutmeg, and brandy.
Either transfer to pastry-lined dish and bake in a moderately hot oven until golden-brown OR steam in a mould for about an hour.

name: Potato Samosas (Aloo Pies)
attribution: "Potato Samosas (Aloo Pies)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_Samosas_(Aloo_Pies), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1–1½ tsp ground or whole cumin (jeera), or to taste

steps: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and water. Knead lightly to make a dough.
Set dough aside to relax, covered with a bowl or damp cloth
Boil potatoes in salt water until tender. Peel and mash potatoes well.
If whole cumin is used, heat in a dry skillet for a few minutes to release the flavour.
Season the potatoes with salt, black pepper, hot pepper, and cumin.
Divide the rested dough into 9 balls called loyah. Flatten out loyah into 10 cm (4 inch) circles and fill with potato mixture.
Wet one edge with water, then fold over and seal, enclosing all potato
Deep fry in oil until golden brown.
Drain on brown paper or kitchen towel.

name: Potato Soup
attribution: "Potato Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ tsp ground black pepper to taste

steps: Cook onion in butter until tender.
Bring the diced potatoes, carrots, water and chicken bouillon in another stock pot to a boil. Simmer about 10 minutes or until tender. Add ground black pepper.

Add the flour to the cooked onions to make a paste. Stir in the milk. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until warmed through. Add the potato and carrot mixture. Stir in the parsley and thyme and heat through. Serve hot.

name: Potato Spelt Oat Burger
attribution: "Potato Spelt Oat Burger" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_Spelt_Oat_Burger, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine the mashed potatoes, spelt flour, and oat flakes in about equal amounts (1:1:1).
Mix in soy sauce and water.
Fry the onions and tomatoes in a little oil, and add to the potato mixture.
Mix in salt, pepper, savory, chili powder, and gyro spice to taste.
Form the mixture into patties. Fry lightly in a pan with a thin layer of oil until browned on both sides.

name: Potato Stew
attribution: "Potato Stew" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato_Stew, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 dl milk, preferably with high fat content (about 3%)

steps: Peel and dice the cold, already boiled, potatoes; make the cubes about 1–2 cm across.

Mix the flour with the milk in a saucepan. Be sure to make a smooth mix without lumps; it may help to add just a little bit of milk at the time until a smooth thick substance forms, then add the rest of the milk.
Add the butter, and bring the sauce to a boil.
Add the potatoes and boil gently for 5 minutes.
Add salt, pepper, and dill to taste.
Peel and dice the potatoes; make the cubes about 1 cm across.
Put the diced potatoes in a saucepan, and add milk until it almost covers the potatoes.
Simmer until the potatoes are soft (about 10 minutes) stirring occasionally.
If the stew is too thin, add some roux to the potatoes and boil for a few more minutes.
Add salt, pepper, and dill to taste.

name: Potato-Almond Milk
attribution: "Potato-Almond Milk" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato-Almond_Milk, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Double-layer of cheesecloth or nut-milk bag

steps: Pre-soak your almonds in water for 1 hour and then drain.
Cut potatoes 5 cm chunks. Place the chunks into saucepan with enough water to fully cover them.
Bring the saucepan to a simmer over high heat, and simmer for around 15 minutes until tender.
Drain the potatoes. Transfer to blender with the almonds, vanilla, maple syrup, and salt. Add the water, and blend until smooth on a high speed, adding more water as necessary.
Stretch the cheesecloth over a large bowl, and pour your mixture into it. Use a fork to agitate as needed, and let the milk drain through.
When strained, taste the milk. Adjust by adding more water, vanilla, salt, or maple syrup as needed, depending on your taste.
Chill and serve, shaking the mixture beforehand.

name: Potato-Chickpea Curry
attribution: "Potato-Chickpea Curry" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potato-Chickpea_Curry, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 potatoes, chopped (Yukon gold are good, but use whatever you like)

steps: Chop the onion and mince the garlic. Sauté them in olive oil in a saucepan for approximately 5 minutes.
Add the curry powder and fry for a couple minutes more.
Add the coconut milk and the potatoes. Simmer, covered, for about 20 minutes.
Drain the chickpeas, add them to the pot, and simmer for about 20 minutes more, or until the potatoes are cooked.
Serve with basmati rice or whatever you prefer.

name: Potatoes Anna
attribution: "Potatoes Anna" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potatoes_Anna, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat the oven to 250 °C.
Melt the butter.
Slice the potatoes thinly. Press slices against absorbent paper to dry.
Brush the tin with melted butter. Layer the potato slices into the tin, brushing each layer with butter and ending with butter on the top.
Cover and bake in the oven for 20 minutes. Uncover and cook for a further 30 minutes.

name: Potatoes Colcannon
attribution: "Potatoes Colcannon" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potatoes_Colcannon, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Separately boil the potatoes and greens until tender. Drain both.
Mash the potatoes.
Squeeze as much liquid as possible out of the greens, then finely chop them.
Combine the potatoes, chopped greens, butter, pepper, and salt. Mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a greased mold, then bake in a hot oven for 10 minutes.

name: Potatoes Excaloped
attribution: "Potatoes Excaloped" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potatoes_Excaloped, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, then drain.
Mash the potatoes well.
Grease small pans or ramekins with butter, and divide the mashed potatoes between them. Smooth the tops.
Make a cross in the top of the potatoes, and sprinkle with breadcrumbs.
Use a brush to sprinkle with a few drops of melted butter.
Bake in the oven until browned on top. Carefully remove the potatoes from the molds, and bake to brown the other side.
Serve hot.

name: Potatoes Fried Whole
attribution: "Potatoes Fried Whole" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potatoes_Fried_Whole, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Boil the potatoes until almost done. Drain.
If desired, dip the potatoes in flour, then egg yolks, then breadcrumbs.
Heat the drippings in a pan. Add the potatoes, and fry until brown and crisp, shaking regularly to prevent burning.
Remove from pan, and serve hot.

name: Potatoes with Green Sauce
attribution: "Potatoes with Green Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Potatoes_with_Green_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3–4 cups (200 g / 7 oz per cup) sour cream
1 tbsp sunflower oil (or other oil of neutral taste)
1–1½ empty sour cream cups filled with dill
1–1½ empty sour cream cups filled with other mixed herbs (e.g. chives, parsley, onion leaves, lemon balm, burnet, a small amount of sorrel if available)

steps: Combine sour cream, oil, and lemon juice. Add milk until the mixture takes the consistency of a thick sauce.
Mix herbs well, and mix them into the sauce.
Cut hard-boiled eggs to small pieces and add them to the sauce along with some salt and pepper.
Leave the sauce in the fridge for about 1–1½.
Boil potatoes and serve hot with the cold sauce. More hard-boiled eggs can also be served along with this.

name: Poticza
attribution: "Poticza" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Poticza, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¾ cup (180 ml) / 180 g (6 oz) / 50% Milk
1 packet / 2¼ tsp / 7 g Yeast, dry/instant type
2 loaf pans (8.5 x 4.5 inches / 21.5 x 11.5 cm)

steps: Heat the milk and butter together in a microwave or in a small pan on the stovetop until the butter is melted and the milk is very warm, but not boiling. Set it aside to cool until it is warm but not uncomfortable to the touch.
Combine ¼ cup sugar, 1 tsp salt, 3 cups flour, potato flour (optional), and yeast into a large mixing bowl. Stir the dry ingredients briefly to mix.

Stir in the melted butter, warm milk, vanilla extract, and eggs. Using either the dough hook on an electric mixer, a big spoon, or your hands, mix and knead until the dough is smooth and uniform. This is a "slack" (wet) dough, so it will be quite sticky when you start mixing it. It should come together after a couple of minutes.

Cover the kneaded dough and put it in a warm place to rise for about an hour. Alternatively, the dough can be brought to this point, placed in a bowl and covered with plastic wrap or a tightly fitting lid, and left in the refrigerator overnight.

Stir together the chopped nuts, nut meal, the remaining 1 cup of sugar, the remaining ⅓ cup of flour, pinch of salt, cinnamon, and the remaining 3 eggs. The mixture will be a thick paste. However, if it's too thick, you won't be able to spread it. This is most likely to happen if you use very finely ground nuts or nut flours. In that case, add another egg. The nut filling can be made in advance, covered, and stored in the refrigerator overnight.
Line the loaf pans with parchment baking paper, or grease them with butter.

Put plastic wrap with a little flour on your work surface. It may be necessary to put down two overlapping pieces of plastic to make a surface that is large enough. Alternatively, for a more old-fashioned approach, flour a large, smooth, thin cotton cloth and use that to line your work surface. Because the dough will be cut after being rolled out and topped with the nut filling, a silicone baking sheet is not a good choice for this project; the blade of the sharp knife or cutter will permanently damage the silicone mat.
Roll out the dough into a rectangle that measures 28x14 inches (72x36 cm). It will be quite thin, about ⅛ inch (3 mm) thick, when you're done. Patch any holes and thin spots.

Make sure that the dough is not stuck to your work surface. If it is, loosen it, add a little more flour underneath, and re-check the dimensions with a ruler. If there is loose flour on the top of the dough when you have finished rolling it out, you can use a dry pastry brush to brush it off.
Spread the nut filling evenly over the dough, from edge to edge. Any gap will change the swirled design that is seen when you cut the loaf after baking.

Cover the filling with plastic wrap or parchment paper, and run the rolling pin lightly over it again, without further stretching the dough or increasing the size. This helps flatten any thicker lumps of filling and help any bigger chopped nuts attach more securely to the dough.
Use a pizza cutter, pastry wheel, or sharp knife to cut the dough in half, so that you have two matching squares.

To get the four-swirl design, the dough has to be rolled from two opposite sides towards the middle. Start by folding one edge of the dough—about one inch (2 cm)—on top of the nut filling, and then continue folding or rolling that side towards the middle. Do not stretch the dough or roll it tightly. Traditionally, the log is formed by folding the first edge, lifting the floured cloth underneath it, and then letting the dough roll itself; you are trying to produce the same effect. After you have the first edge partially rolled, switch to the opposite side, and start rolling it towards the first one, so that they meet in the middle with two evenly matched scrolls.

Take one end of the resulting rolled log and fold it to the center of the log. Repeat with the other end. Adjust it, overlapping the ends as necessary, so that the folded log fits inside the loaf pan. Place the folded log in the pan, seam side down.
Repeat the process of rolling and folding with the other square of filling-covered dough.

Place both pans in a warm place to rise for about 90 minutes or more. It should look a little puffy, but it won't double in size. Alternatively, the loaves can be covered tightly with plastic wrap and put in the refrigerator overnight. Bring the cold dough back to room temperature before baking.
Preheat oven to 350 °F (180 °C / gas mark 4 / moderate oven).
Bake both loaves at 350 °F (180 °C) for 30 minutes. Then, cover the tops with a loose "tent" of aluminum foil, to prevent the tops from browning too quickly.
Bake for about another 15 minutes after tenting (a total of 45 minutes). If you have an instant-read thermometer, the internal temperature should be around 195 °F (90 °C).

name: Poutine
attribution: "Poutine" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Poutine, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 L vegetable oil for deep frying
1 can (290 g) of poutine sauce (French: mélange à sauce poutine) or gravy
2 cups fresh cheddar cheese curds or mozzarella
1 deep fat fryer or large stove pot to fry the potatoes
1 saucepan or cup suitable for warming gravy
1 serving dish, with enough depth to act as a basket for the fried potatoes

steps: Slice potatoes into finger-width fries and rinse them well to remove any dirt.
Begin warming gravy, keep the temperature low enough for a slow heating.
Heat oil to 185°C (365°F).
Cook sliced potatoes in the oil for about 5 minutes.
Following a first frying to cook the potatoes, they are often removed and then fried again for about 1 minute to crisp the outside.
Remove the fries from the oil; optionally place them on a paper towel mat to absorb excess oil.
Move the fries to a serving dish and put room-temperature cheese curds over the fries.
Pour the gravy over the top; the dish should be served before the cheese curds start to melt.

name: Prawn Curry
attribution: "Prawn Curry" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Prawn_Curry, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 kg medium-sized prawns (shrimp), cleaned with tails removed
¼ tsp nutmeg and mace powder

steps: Heat a tablespoon of oil in a pan and sauté prawns over medium-high heat for 2 minutes only, just until that their water dries out and they turn pink in color. Don't try to cook prawns for more than that because they will become rubbery and hard to chew.
In a saucepan, heat the remaining oil and fry onions over high heat for 8–10 minutes, stirring constantly until they become light golden in color.

When onions have been fried, add tomato pieces, ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric powder, salt, cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon sticks. Cover the pan and cook them over medium heat until they all mix together and form a curry. It takes at least 10–15 minutes for the curry to be cooked.
When curry becomes red and the onions soften, mix in potato pieces and 1 cup water. Let them cook for 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Uncover the pan and cook over high heat until the oil starts to separate from the gravy. Add the cumin powder, black pepper powder, garam masala, nutmeg, and mace powder.
Add fried prawn pieces and a sprinkle of coriander leaves. Mix them together and then cover the pan. Cook for just a minute over very low heat.
Serve with boiled rice or naan.

name: Prepared White Mustard
attribution: "Prepared White Mustard" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Prepared_White_Mustard, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup natural apple vinegar or wine vinegar
4 tbsp honey, treacle, or date syrup

steps: Toast mustard seeds in a skillet without oil. Let cool.
Pound the seeds with a mortar and pestle.
Crush the boiled yolks, and add to ground mustard seeds.
Crush the garlic and add to the mixture.
Toast the flour in a skillet without oil and add to the mixture.
Mix in vinegar, salt, and honey.

name: Prickly Pear Soda
attribution: "Prickly Pear Soda" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Prickly_Pear_Soda, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Remove the peel from the prickly pears, cut them into small pieces about 0.5 x 0.5 in (1.25 x 1.25 cm), and remove the seeds.
Combine the fruit flesh, water, and agave nectar in a saucepan.
Boil the mixture until it becomes very thick, then strain it to get approximately 5 oz (120 ml) of syrup.
Make the finished soda by combining 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

name: Princess Cake
attribution: "Princess Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Princess_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Cake layers (can be home-made or ready-bought)
A green marzipan layer for the top

steps: For the vanilla cream, combine the cream, yolks, cornstarch, and sugar. Heat over a double boiler to just below cooking point. Whip it for a while as it is bubbling (but not boiling). Let it cool off for some minutes and then mix in the vanilla powder.

Put the vanilla cream between the layers of cake. Frost the top of the cake with the whipped cream, shaping the top to make it thick and domed. If you want to have jam in the cake, replace one of the layers of vanilla cream with jam.
Cover the whole cake with the marzipan like on the picture and dust the top with powdered sugar.
Chill until serving.

name: Proja (Serbian Cornbread)
attribution: "Proja (Serbian Cornbread)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Proja_(Serbian_Cornbread), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix everything together to make a batter.
Bake the batter in a 5 cm deep greased pan until golden.
Serve with kiseli kupus and pavlaka.

name: Pudding with Pistachios and Rose Water (Muhallebi)
attribution: "Pudding with Pistachios and Rose Water (Muhallebi)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pudding_with_Pistachios_and_Rose_Water_(Muhallebi), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½–1 cup white granulated sugar (or to taste)
½ cup rose water or orange flower water (optional)

steps: Mix the milk and sugar in a large saucepan and heating slowly, so as not to burn the milk, bring to a simmer.
Make a slurry by dissolving the rice flour and cornstarch in the water and, stirring constantly, slowly add this mixture to the simmering milk.
Simmer gently for 30–40 minutes, stirring frequently, until the mixture has thickened sufficiently to coat a spoon. Remove from the heat.
Stir in the rose water or orange flower water.
Pour into a 9x13-inch baking pan and refrigerate until chilled and set.
Cut into pieces about 4 inches square.
Place the squares on individual dessert plates and garnish with the chopped pistachios.

name: Pudina Hilsa (Bengali Fish with Mint)
attribution: "Pudina Hilsa (Bengali Fish with Mint)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pudina_Hilsa_(Bengali_Fish_with_Mint), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 kg hilsa fish (kelee shad), cut into 10 pieces

steps: Wash the fish thoroughly in water.
Put the salt, sugar, 25 g of butter and all the other ingredients into a baking dish.
Add the fish pieces and sprinkle the rest of the butter on the top.
Bake at 200°C until the fish turns golden in color or otherwise appears to be done.

name: Pufftaloons
attribution: "Pufftaloons" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pufftaloons, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine flour and baking powder.
Rub in the butter.
Add enough milk to make a soft dough.
Deep fry in hot vegetable oil.
Serve hot with jam or golden syrup.

name: Puliyodarai (South Indian Tamarind Rice)
attribution: "Puliyodarai (South Indian Tamarind Rice)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Puliyodarai_(South_Indian_Tamarind_Rice), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 tbsp gingely (sesame) oil ("Til" oil in Hindi, "Nallennai" in Tamil)
½ tsp asafoetida (heengh in Hindi, perungayum in Tamil)

steps: Dry roast all ingredients in a pan without oil until deep brown.
Grind to a fine powder after the mix cools down.
Heat the oil in a pan.
Add groundnuts and split-peas, and fry until golden brown.
Add mustard seeds, asafoetida and red-chillies (broken into pieces). Wait until the mustard seeds splutter, then remove pan from stove.
Mix rice, salt, turmeric powder and tamarind concentrate. Add a little oil to the raw rice before cooking it. This gives it a better texture.
Add the garnishing powder and curry leaves and mix well.

name: Pulse Chutney
attribution: "Pulse Chutney" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pulse_Chutney, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 ½ inch (3 ½ cm) piece of ginger root

steps: Soak the green mung beans for 3–4 hours. Allow to sprout.
Mince the green chilies, fresh ginger, and salt.
Grind to a paste in a mortar and pestle or food processor.
Season with lemon juice to taste.

name: Pulut Durian (Durian with Sticky Rice)
attribution: "Pulut Durian (Durian with Sticky Rice)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pulut_Durian_(Durian_with_Sticky_Rice), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Steam the glutinous rice with a pinch of salt until it is cooked.
Combine the flesh of durian with coconut milk, sugar, salt and screwpine leaves. Boil them together until the sauce thickens.
Serve it hot with the rice.

name: Pumpkin Bread I
attribution: "Pumpkin Bread I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pumpkin_Bread_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F).
Sift dry ingredients together.
Mix pumpkin, water, oil, and eggs together in another bowl. Pour into dry mixture and mix well.
Pour into 2 greased 9x5x3-inch loaf pans. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle of loaf comes out clean.
Cool before removing from pans.

name: Pumpkin Bread II
attribution: "Pumpkin Bread II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pumpkin_Bread_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tablespoon raw pumpkin seeds, for garnish

steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Butter and lightly flour 2 medium loaf pans (8 ½ by 4 ½ by 2 ½ inches).
Using a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, combine eggs, oil, pumpkin and sugar until smooth.
In a separate bowl, combine the flour, soda, salt, allspice, cinnamon and nutmeg.
With the machine on low speed, add the flour mixture to the pumpkin mixture in ¼-cup increments.
Scrape down the side of the bowl and mix for another 30 seconds or so, until all ingredients are well-combined.
Divide the mixture equally between the 2 loaf pans.
Sprinkle the top of each loaf with 1 tablespoon pumpkin seeds.
Bake 40–45 minutes until a tester inserted into the center of each loaf comes out clean.
Allow loaves to cool in the pans for 5–10 minutes before unmolding, then allow loaves to cool on a wire rack to room temperature before cutting or wrapping.

name: Pumpkin Bread III
attribution: "Pumpkin Bread III" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pumpkin_Bread_III, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Beat sugar and oil using electric hand mixer.
Add eggs and pumpkin and beat lightly.
Add flour, then baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, salt, and nuts if desired. Mix well.
Pour into two baking pans sprayed lightly with cooking spray.
Bake until toothpick comes out clean from the center, about 40–45 minutes.
Cool and serve.

name: Pumpkin Muffins
attribution: "Pumpkin Muffins" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pumpkin_Muffins, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup cooked and mashed pumpkin (canned pumpkin can be used as well)

steps: Sift flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon into a bowl.
Beat egg; mix in milk, pumpkin, and oil.
Make a well in center of flour mixture; pour in pumpkin mixture all at once.
Stir quickly until flour is just moistened.
Fill greased muffin cups ⅔ full.
Bake at 425°F for 25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Run spatula around each muffin to loosen; serve immediately.

name: Pumpkin Pie I
attribution: "Pumpkin Pie I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pumpkin_Pie_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups (450 g) cooked and puréed pumpkin (or plain canned pumpkin)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Blend all ingredients except the pie shell together to make the filling.
Pour the filling into the unbaked pie shell.
Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.
Let cool and serve.

name: Pumpkin Pie II
attribution: "Pumpkin Pie II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pumpkin_Pie_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (12 fl oz / 350 ml) evaporated milk

steps: Preheat oven to 425°F (210°C)
Mix sugar, salt, cinnamon, ginger, and cloves in small bowl. Beat eggs in large bowl; stir in pumpkin and sugar spice mixture. Gradually stir in evaporated milk.
Pour into the unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 425°F (210°C) for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350°F (180°C), and bake for 40–50 minutes or until knife inserted near center come out clean.
Cool on wire rack for 2 hours.
Top with whipped cream before serving.

name: Pumpkin Risotto
attribution: "Pumpkin Risotto" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pumpkin_Risotto, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1½ pounds (650 g) pumpkin or winter squash, whole
1 bunch fresh marjoram, chopped (some reserved for garnish)
2 cloves garlic, peeled and thickly sliced
10 tablespoons unsalted butter at room temperature, divided
1½ cups (360 g) Parmiggiano Reggiano, finely grated, plus extra to sprinkle at the table

steps: Preheat oven to 425°F (210°C).

Remove seeds and fiber from inside the pumpkin and cut into chunks. Place skin side down on a baking pan brushed with a little olive oil. Season with salt and pepper, scatter the marjoram and garlic over the pieces, cover with foil and bake about 45 minutes, or until soft.
Remove from oven and allow to cool. Cut the flesh from skin into small cubes and reserve the baking juices.
Heat the chicken stock and check for seasoning.

Melt 6 tablespoons butter and 2 tablespoons olive oil in a wide, heavy-bottomed sauté pan or pot. Add onion and gently sauté until soft. Add rice and stir until completely covered in oil. Then, add vermouth and stir until it is absorbed by the rice.
Turn heat to medium-high and begin adding stock, ½ cup (120 ml) at a time, and stir until stock is completely absorbed by the rice. Continue this process until all the stock is incorporated.
Stir in remaining butter in small pieces, pumpkin with its juices, and cheese. Serve immediately with a sprinkle of cheese and fresh marjoram to garnish.

name: Pumpkin Roll
attribution: "Pumpkin Roll" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pumpkin_Roll, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup (220 g / 7.8 oz) white granulated sugar
⅔ cup (80 g / 2.8 oz) canned pumpkin
¾ cup (75 g / 2.6 oz) chopped pecans

steps: Preheat oven to 375 F.
Mix sugar, eggs, and canned pumpkin in a large bowl until well blended.
Using a second bowl, mix flour, salt, cinnamon, and baking soda.
Fold dry mixture into larger bowl with pumpkin mixture.
Line rectangular cookie sheet with greased parchment paper or waxed paper. Make sure to extend over the sides of the cookie sheet.
Pour batter evenly onto the lined cookie sheet.
Sprinkle batter with the chopped pecans.
Bake at 375 F for 15 minutes.
Set aside ⅛ cup (15 g / 0.53 oz) of the powdered sugar; it will be used later.
Whip cream cheese, vanilla, butter, and remaining powdered sugar until smooth.
Set aside.
Lay a clean dish towel on a flat kitchen surface.
Evenly sprinkle towel with the powdered sugar that was set aside earlier.
Once the cake has been completely baked and before cooled, flip onto the towel with the powdered sugar.
Loosely roll cake, then cool completely to allow cake to set.
Once cooled, unroll cake.
Spread filling over cake.
Roll cake and filling up in a spiral.
Wrap in foil or plastic wrap and freeze.
Once frozen, remove foil and cut into slices while still frozen.

name: Pumpkin Soufflé Casserole
attribution: "Pumpkin Soufflé Casserole" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pumpkin_Souffl%C3%A9_Casserole, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pinch ground cinnamon, or more to taste

steps: Preheat the oven to 450 °F (230 °C), and grease the baking dish.
Use the electric mixer to beat together sugar, butter, and eggs until smooth and creamy.
Mix in pumpkin purée until well combined.
Add milk, cake flour, and baking powder, and mix until smooth.
Pour mixture into the prepared baking dish, and sprinkle cinnamon over top.
Bake in the heated oven until it is set in the middle, 45 minutes or more.

name: Pumpkin Soup
attribution: "Pumpkin Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pumpkin_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Chickpeas, soaked or canned and drained

steps: Fry onions, carrots, potatoes, and zucchinis in a spoonful of oil.
Add pumpkin and chickpeas.
Cover with hot water and simmer. The soup is ready when the carrots are soft.

name: Pumpkin Soup with Curry
attribution: "Pumpkin Soup with Curry" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pumpkin_Soup_with_Curry, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cans (30 oz) chicken broth (reduced sodium is best)

steps: Sauté onions with olive oil until translucent.
Add pumpkin and broth; mix well.
Add all spices and simmer for at least 15 minutes; remove bay leaf.
Let soup cool to lukewarm temperature and purée in a blender for smooth texture.
Return to saucepan and add milk. Reheat on lower temperature to serve immediately or forgo reheating and store in a suitable airtight container

name: Puttanesca Sauce (Vegan)
attribution: "Puttanesca Sauce (Vegan)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Puttanesca_Sauce_(Vegan), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup chopped pitted Kalamata olives
½ cup chopped pitted salt-cured black olives

steps: Heat oil in a large skillet.
Add garlic and sauté over medium heat until garlic starts to brown lightly.
Add oregano, pepper, olives, capers, and tomatoes. Simmer for about 15 minutes.
Add parsley and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add salt to taste.
Pour over 1 pound (450 g) of cooked pasta, and serve.

name: Quail Egg and Chili Jangjorim
attribution: "Quail Egg and Chili Jangjorim" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Quail_Egg_and_Chili_Jangjorim, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the quail eggs, and boil for about 10 minutes.
Carefully drain the eggs, and cool in cold water.
Peel the cooled eggs.
Combine the water, soy sauce, sugar, wine, garlic, and ginger in a saucepan. Bring to a boil.
Add the eggs to the pot, and simmer until the liquid is reduced by half.
Add the peppers, and cook just for 1–2 minutes.

name: Queen of Puddings
attribution: "Queen of Puddings" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Queen_of_Puddings, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 oz (about 4 cups / 170 g) freshly-grated bread crumbs
4 Tbsp raspberry jam, or jam of choice

steps: Heat the milk, sugar, lemon zest and butter until just below the boil.
Pour onto the bread crumbs and allow the whole to cool slightly, about 10 minutes.
Beat the egg yolks and stir into the bread crumb and milk mixture.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 35 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Spread the top with the warmed jam, being careful not to break the surface of the pudding.
Whip the egg whites with the vanilla sugar and a few drops of lemon juice until the mixture reaches soft peaks.
Spread the meringue over the top of the pudding. Return to the oven and bake for 15 minutes until the meringue has browned.
Serve as is or with crème anglaise.

name: Queen's Sauce (Hartshorne)
attribution: "Queen's Sauce (Hartshorne)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Queen's_Sauce_(Hartshorne), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Place the gravy into a saucepan and simmer, stirring the breadcrumbs into it until thickened.
Add the almonds, egg yolks, fowl breast, and cream. Mix well until combined.
Place onto a simmer and add salt and pepper to serve.

name: Queens Soup
attribution: "Queens Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Queens_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Put the ground rice into a saucepan. Gradually add the milk.
Cook gently for 12 minutes in a bain-marie, stirring the whole time, until very smooth.
Add the butter, and pass through a sieve.
Mix the fowl stock, and serve immediately.

name: Quiche Batter
attribution: "Quiche Batter" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Quiche_Batter, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ tsp fresh ground white pepper
10 gratings of nutmeg, or to taste

steps: Combine the milk and cream in the saucepan over medium heat. Cook until scalded and a skin forms, then remove from the heat and let cool slightly.
Combine the eggs, salt, nutmeg, and pepper in the blender.
With the blender running, drizzle in the milk mixture, and keep blending on high speed for 1 minute.
Use immediately as directed in your quiche recipe, or set aside for later.

name: Quick and Easy Beef Stroganoff
attribution: "Quick and Easy Beef Stroganoff" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Quick_and_Easy_Beef_Stroganoff, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (8 oz / 250 g) cream of mushroom soup
½ can (4 oz / 125 ml) beef broth

steps: Cook egg noodles in a large pot according to directions.

While egg noodles cook, season the beef with salt and pepper and brown the meat in a skillet unless it is already cooked. Low and slow makes a tender product. If meat is already cooked, heat the meat in the microwave or in a skillet.
Drain egg noodles.
Mix cream of mushroom soup, beef broth, and sour cream in the pot used for the egg noodles. Season the sauce with salt and pepper keeping in mind that many of the ingredients contain plenty of salt.
Add noodle mixture with beef and serve.

name: Quick and Easy Queso Dip
attribution: "Quick and Easy Queso Dip" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Quick_and_Easy_Queso_Dip, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 10 oz (280 g) stewed tomatoes with green chiles
0.5 lb (225 g) monterey jack cheese, grated

steps: In small pan, heat undrained tomatoes and onion, cooking until the juice is gone.
While tomatoes are cooking, place Velveeta in microwave-safe bowl and melt in microwave. Add monterrey jack cheese and melt mixture using 50% power.
Add tomato mixture to cheese mixture.

name: Quick Baked Beef-Pasta Dish
attribution: "Quick Baked Beef-Pasta Dish" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Quick_Baked_Beef-Pasta_Dish, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pound pasta, such as rigatoni or penne, cooked al dente
32 ounce jar or can of your favorite spaghetti sauce

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Cook beef and onion in a large skillet until meat is lightly browned. Drain and sprinkle with Italian Seasoning.
In a large bowl, combine meat mixture and spaghetti sauce and mix well. Add cooked pasta and mix well.
Spray large baking dish with cooking spray.
Pat meat-pasta mixture level in baking pan.
Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over top.
Cover with aluminium foil, and bake in oven 20 minutes.
Remove foil, and bake uncovered another 10 minutes.

name: Quick Guacamole I
attribution: "Quick Guacamole I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Quick_Guacamole_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Peel, seed, and mash the avocados.
Add the lime juice.
Stir in salsa to taste.
Serve immediately.

name: Quick Guacamole II
attribution: "Quick Guacamole II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Quick_Guacamole_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Peel the avocado and pit it, then slice the avocado into small chunks, around a centimeter or ½-inch per side.
Add the lime juice, some salt, and a moderate amount of red pepper to the avocado chunks. Stir until blended.

name: Quick Oat Bread
attribution: "Quick Oat Bread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Quick_Oat_Bread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1⅓ cups / 185 g (6½ oz) / 56.92% White whole wheat flour
1 cup / 110 g (4 oz) / 33.85% Quick-cooking (not instant) oats
1 cup minus 2 tbsp / 270 g (9½ oz) / 83.08% Plain low-fat yogurt
¼ cup / 55 g (2 oz) / 16.92% Canola oil
¾ cup / 185 g (6½ oz) / 56.92% Low-fat milk

steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Butter a 9x5-inch loaf pan; set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine white whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt and baking soda; set aside.
In a medium bowl, combine oats, yogurt, egg, oil and honey, then stir in milk until combined.
Pour oat mixture over flour mixture and gently stir until just combined and flour is no longer visible.
Scrape batter into prepared pan and smooth the top.
Bake 40–50 minutes, until a wood pick tests clean.
During the last few minutes of baking, tent with foil to prevent over-browning if needed.
Let bread stand in the pan 15 minutes, then turn out onto a cooling rack to cool.
Serve slightly warm.

name: Quick Sparkling Lemonade
attribution: "Quick Sparkling Lemonade" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Quick_Sparkling_Lemonade, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 7 cups (1.7 liters/1.8 quarts) cold carbonated water
1 package of lemonade-flavored Kool-Aid, or similar powdered drink mix

steps: Pour the carbonated water into a 2-quart pitcher.
Add sugar and Kool-Aid or drink mix. Stir thoroughly.
Serve chilled over ice, if desired.

name: Quick Tomato Noodle Soup
attribution: "Quick Tomato Noodle Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Quick_Tomato_Noodle_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 packages instant ramen or udon noodles with flavoring mix

steps: Bring 1.5 liters of water to a boil.
Add noodles to to boiling water with one of flavoring packets.
Add chopped tomatoes and sausages. Boil for 5 minutes.
Add chopped onion and serve.

name: Quince Pudding
attribution: "Quince Pudding" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Quince_Pudding, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Scald quinces until tender.
Skin them and scrape the pulp into a mixing bowl.
Blend the pulp with sugar until very sweet. Add ginger and cinnamon to taste.
Combine the cream and eggs. Stir this into the quince pulp until thick.
Butter a pudding-pan or other baking dish. Pour in the quince-cream mixture.
Bake until firm but still slightly wobbly in the centre. Remove from oven and leave till set.

name: Quinoa (Cooked)
attribution: "Quinoa (Cooked)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Quinoa_(Cooked), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Place quinoa in a bowl and cover completely with water. Soak for 3–4 hours, then discard the water. Replace with fresh water and soak for another hour or so. Drain again.
Combine the drained quinoa with the 2 cups water and pinch of salt in a pot. Bring to a boil.
Lower the heat, and simmer on the lowest heat setting for 16–18 minutes.
Remove from the heat and let rest for 5 minutes.

name: Quinoa, Shiitake Mushrooms and Adzuki Beans
attribution: "Quinoa, Shiitake Mushrooms and Adzuki Beans" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Quinoa,_Shiitake_Mushrooms_and_Adzuki_Beans, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup shiitake mushrooms, sliced (can substitute slightly crushed oyster mushrooms)

steps: Sauté vegetables until tender.
Add broth, beans and quinoa. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for about 20 minutes, until liquid evaporates.
Add salt and pepper and mix with a fork or wooden spoon.

name: Quorn Pitta
attribution: "Quorn Pitta" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Quorn_Pitta, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ teaspoon dried oregano or several stalks of fresh oregano (or to taste)

steps: Combine the ingredients for the sauce, and make sure it's completely smooth.
Microwave the sauce for 2 minutes. Stir the sauce, make sure its not dried out (add some vinegar if too dry), and microwave for 2 minutes more. The sauce can be then set aside.
Microwave the Quorn for 1–2 minutes. Combine sauce and Quorn, and make sure it's smooth—that the whole should look like a paste rather than meat. Microwave again for 2 minutes.
Prepare the pitta as indicated or use as is. Put the Quorn mixture inside the pitta.
Serve.

name: Racuszki (Polish Pancakes)
attribution: "Racuszki (Polish Pancakes)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Racuszki_(Polish_Pancakes), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 L sour milk or cultured buttermilk

steps: In large bowl, mix the baking soda, salt, and flour together well.
Add sour milk and eggs, and mix until smooth.
Pour small ladlefuls of the mixture into a non-stick pan, one at a time OR dip slices of peeled apples in batter and put them in the pan.
Cook until the edges are dry. Turn; cook until golden.

name: Radish Pie
attribution: "Radish Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Radish_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¾ cup (177 ml) broken walnut pieces
⅓ cup (80 ml) fresh Italian parsley

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Wash the radishes well, remove and discard tops. Put radishes into a small baking dish and drizzle with olive oil. Bake for about an hour. Let them cool and then cut into small cubes.
Use half the butter to grease a pie pan, and then line it with pieces of phyllo dough, covering the pan evenly. Tuck any stray bits under to make a nice edge.
Heat the remaining butter in a large pan and sauté the onion in it for about 5 minutes. Add the wine and diced radishes, then cook for another minute. Remove from heat and pour into the pastry shell.
In a bowl, mix together the eggs and cream, and then pour over the vegetables in the pie crust. Crumble the goat cheese over the cream.
Bake the pie in a preheated oven at aforementioned temperature for 20 minutes.
Add the walnuts and bake for another 15–20 minutes.
Remove the pie from the oven and top it with the chopped parsley.
Let cool completely before serving.

name: Radish Stew
attribution: "Radish Stew" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Radish_Stew, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ pound red radish, cut in 1-inch strips, or about 5–6 slices
3 pounds non-red radish, cut in 1-inch chunks (red, yellow, or variety)

steps: In a large saucepan or Dutch oven, cook the radish until crisp.
Add onions and cook until they soften somewhat, about 4–5 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over the onions, add bay leaves and thyme, and increase the heat to high.
Pour in wine and stir to loosen brown bits from the bottom of the pan. Cook for about 2 minutes, or until wine has evaporated.
Add non-red radishes, broth, and pepper. Cover and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium low and simmer until radishes are tender, about 45–60 minutes.
Sprinkle with paprika, if desired. Taste and adjust seasonings.
Remove bay leaves before serving.

name: Radish Tart
attribution: "Radish Tart" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Radish_Tart, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup (4 oz) shredded Edam, Gouda, or Gruyere cheese, divided (Cheddar is also acceptable)
½–1 small bunch of red radishes

steps: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).

Sift and measure flour into a bowl. Cut in the butter until the particles are coarse. Stir in half of the cheese. Pour in ¼ cup of the cream; toss the mixture with a fork until all parts are moistened.
Turn the dough into a 9-inch round pie pan. With floured fingers, press the mixture into the bottom and sides of the pan, then prick the shell with a floured fork.
Bake the pie shell for 10–12 minutes. The sides will slip down a little during baking. Cool on a wire rack.
Lower the oven temperature to 375°F (190°C).

Sprinkle the remaining cheese evenly over the bottom of the cooled pie shell. Beat together the egg yolks, the ¾ cup cream, and the salt. Pour the egg mixture over the cheese. Place the radish slices evenly over the top of the pie.
Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until set.
Remove the pie from the oven, cut it into wedges, and serve it hot.

name: Ragi Dosa (South Indian Millet and Rice Pancake)
attribution: "Ragi Dosa (South Indian Millet and Rice Pancake)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ragi_Dosa_(South_Indian_Millet_and_Rice_Pancake), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Soak ragi, rice and urad dal separately in water for 5 hours.
Grind the soaked rice with water first and next with urad dal and ragi (both) with water.
Mix up all the ground batter. Leave it for about 10 hours to ferment.
After 10 hours put some salt as per your taste to the batter and water if needed.
Take a cup of batter and spread it onto a hot tava.

name: Rainbow Cake
attribution: "Rainbow Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rainbow_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 675 g (1.49 lb / 5½ sticks) unsalted butter, plus extra for greasing
½ tsp each of red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple food colourings

steps: Preheat the oven to 190 C. Grease and line six 20 cm round cake tins.
Beat the butter, sugar and vanilla in a large mixing bowl, until soft and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs, two at a time.
Combine the flour and baking powder. Fold this dry mixture into the batter.
Divide the mixture into 6 separate bowls.
Add the red food colouring, one drop at a time, to the mixture in one bowl and stir in until the mixture reached the desired colour.
Repeat step 6, using orange, yellow, green, blue and purple food colourings.
Spread the red mixture in one of cake tin. Repeat with other colours.
Bake for 25 minutes, in batches of two cakes, until a skewer inserted comes out clean.
Transfer the cakes to a wire rack and leave to cool. Unmold cakes.
For the icing, beat the butter in a mixing bowl until soft.
Add half of the icing sugar, 1 cup at a time, and beat in.
Beat in the milk and vanilla extract.
Add the rest of icing sugar, 1 cup at a time, and beat in.
Spread one-eighth of the icing onto the purple cake. Top with blue cake layer, and press gently.
Repeat the frosting and cake layering in rainbow order, finishing with the red layer.
Spread the rest of icing all over the cake.
If you like, sprinkle the cake with sprinkles.
Enjoy!

name: Raisin Oatmeal Muffins
attribution: "Raisin Oatmeal Muffins" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Raisin_Oatmeal_Muffins, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup (240 g) rolled oats (traditional slow type)
⅓ cup (80 g) white granulated sugar

steps: Pre-heat an oven to 375°F (190°C).
Butter a muffin pan or cupcake pan.
Place the dry ingredients in one bowl, and the wet ingredients in a different bowl.
Mix the ingredients in each bowl, then combine the mixtures to make a batter.
Spoon batter into the pan.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until brown with crispy edges.
Immediately flip the muffins upside-down using a butter knife. Leave them in the hot pan to prevent condensation from ruining the surface.
Muffins are best served hot!

name: Raita
attribution: "Raita" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Raita, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ⅛ cup grated cucumber (about 1 inch of cucumber)
1–2 tbsp finely chopped or minced onions (optional)

steps: Squeeze the grated cucumber to remove and discard excess liquid.
Stir the cucumber into the yogurt.
Add chopped mint, cilantro, and onion.
Add salt to taste.
Sprinkle a little ground cumin on top.
Sprinkle with chili powder if desired.
Refrigerate and serve cold.

name: Rasmalai (Indian Cheese and Milk Dessert)
attribution: "Rasmalai (Indian Cheese and Milk Dessert)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rasmalai_(Indian_Cheese_and_Milk_Dessert), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Crumble paneer and knead it.
Add the 2 tbsp of maida and knead again with the palm to make a smooth dough.
Divide into sixteen equal portions, roll into balls, and press slightly to flatten them.
Thinly slice almonds and pistachios. Dissolve 2 cups sugar in 2 cups of water, then bring to a boil.
Slowly lower the paneer balls in the boiling syrup and cook on high heat for ten minutes. Sprinkle a little water and ½ tbsp of maida and bring to a boil again. Cook for few minutes.
Meanwhile boil milk in a thick-bottomed pan, lower heat, and continue to boil until it is reduced to a thick consistency (⅓ of its original volume).
Add the rest of the sugar and the cardamom powder, and keep boiling until the sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat, cool, and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Add sliced almonds, pistachios, and orange powder, and mix again.
Squeeze the chenna balls and put them into the chilled sweetened milk. Refrigerate it for another half an hour. Serve chilled.

name: Raspberry Cuts
attribution: "Raspberry Cuts" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Raspberry_Cuts, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 packets (120 g) Dr Oetker Rote Grütze powdered dessert mix (see notes)

steps: Mix the eggs, sugar, oil, sparkling water, flour, baking powder, vanilla sugar and a little lemon juice in a bowl to a smooth dough.
Place baking paper in a small baking sheet (approx. 25 x 40 cm) and spread the dough evenly over it.
Bake the dough in the oven at approx. 175 ° C for approx. 30 minutes until golden yellow and then let it cool well.
Bring the dessert mix to the boil with 0.75 l of water.
Add the frozen raspberries to the red groats, stir well and wait until the raspberries are thawed.
Spread the warm mass evenly on the dough.
Now cool the cake, preferably overnight.
Whip the cream with the cream stiff until stiff, lightly sweeten with vanilla sugar depending on your taste, and then distribute the mixture evenly over the cake.
Put on the butter cookies and lightly dust with powdered sugar.

name: Raspberry Ripple Cake
attribution: "Raspberry Ripple Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Raspberry_Ripple_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1⅜ sticks (175 g / 6.2 oz) unsalted butter, plus extra for greasing
¾ cup (175 g / 6.2 oz) superfine sugar

steps: Preheat the oven to 190 C. Grease and line a 20 cm round cake tin.
Beat the butter, sugar and vanilla in a mixing bowl, until soft and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs, one at a time.
Fold the flour and baking powder into the mixture to make a batter.
Purée the raspberries in a blender.
Spoon the batter into the cake tin.
Pour the raspberry puree over the batter, and swirl the mixture with a skewer to create a rippled effect.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until a skewer inserted comes clean.
Transfer the cake to the wire rack and leave it to cool completely.
Dust the cake with icing sugar.

name: Raspberry Vinegar
attribution: "Raspberry Vinegar" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Raspberry_Vinegar, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mash the berries and add the vinegar and let stand for 4 days.
To each cup of liquid, add 1 cup of sugar.
Bring to a boil and cook for 20 minutes.
Strain and bottle.

name: Ratatouille I
attribution: "Ratatouille I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ratatouille_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 bell pepper (green, red, yellow or a combination)
6 medium tomatoes, ripe (juicy), peeled and seeded
Herbes de Provence to taste or 1 small bunch basil (optional), chiffoned

steps: Put a large casserole on the stove on medium heat.
When the casserole is hot, add enough olive oil to just cover the bottom.
Cut the zucchini and eggplant into ½ inch slices. Then, cut these into rectangles of about 3x1 inches. Add to the casserole.
Sauté the slices until light brown; remove from pan and set aside temporarily.
Chop the onions and garlic. Cut the green pepper into strips or dice, as preferred.
Add some additional oil if needed, and cook the onions and peppers slowly for about 10 minutes until tender but not brown. Stir in the garlic.
Peel and seed the tomatoes. Dice them or cut them into quarters, add to the casserole. Add some salt to bring out their juices. Cover and lower the heat.
Five minutes later, check to see if the tomatoes have made enough juice to almost cover the vegetables—if so, perfect; if not, add water as needed (not too much).
Add salt, pepper and Herbes de Provence to taste. In general, 1 tsp of salt, ½ tsp of pepper, and 1 tbsp of the herbs will suffice.

Add the zucchini and eggplant back and blend gently with the tomato-onion-pepper mixture. Cover the casserole and let simmer on low heat until the vegetables are tender but still intact, 10–20 minutes, or to taste.
Remove the lid, raise the heat a little and cook uncovered for another 15 minutes, basting frequently until the liquids have mostly evaporated, leaving a small amount of juice and olive oil.

name: Ratatouille II
attribution: "Ratatouille II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Ratatouille_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Put a pan on the stove on medium heat.
Gently fry the onion and garlic in a little oil—5 minutes should be enough to start to make them soft.
Add the peppers and courgette and continue to fry gently for a further 4–5 minutes until the ingredients soften.
Add the beans and warm through.
Serve in a bowl on its own or with toast.

name: Rava Dosa (Indian Semolina Pancake)
attribution: "Rava Dosa (Indian Semolina Pancake)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rava_Dosa_(Indian_Semolina_Pancake), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix all the ingredients together to a watery batter.
Heat a griddle or pan, and grease it with oil.
Sprinkle the batter on the pan with your hand .
Cook it on medium temperature for 3–4 minutes, or until it is completely cooked.
Serve it with tomato or peanut chutney.

name: Red and White Onion Tapenade
attribution: "Red and White Onion Tapenade" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Red_and_White_Onion_Tapenade, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ⅓ cup (80 ml) chopped white onions
⅓ cup (80 ml) chopped red onions
2 tbsp (30 ml) capers, rinsed and drained
Toasted baguette or rustic bread slices

steps: In food processor with motor running, drop in garlic and chop. Turn off motor and add olives, onions, capers, lemon peel and thyme. Pulse to chop to coarse consistency.
Add olive oil and pulse to just blend keeping texture in mixture.
Serve with toasted baguette or rustic bread slices.

name: Red Bell Peppers Stuffed with Cheese and Egg (Chushki Byurek)
attribution: "Red Bell Peppers Stuffed with Cheese and Egg (Chushki Byurek)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Red_Bell_Peppers_Stuffed_with_Cheese_and_Egg_(Chushki_Byurek), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Roast, peel, and seed the peppers.
Mix the crumbled cheese with 4 of the eggs. Stuff the peppers with this mixture.
Beat the remaining two eggs.
Roll the stuffed peppers in breadcrumbs and beaten eggs.
Fry the breaded peppers in hot oil.
Serve sprinkled with finely-chopped parsley.

name: Red Chile Sauce
attribution: "Red Chile Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Red_Chile_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 oz (90 g) dried chile peppers, such as New Mexico chile
2 cups (500 ml) hot water (boiled water that has cooled a little)

steps: Wipe chile peppers with a damp cloth to clean. See warning for handling instructions.
Break off stems, and remove seeds.
Soak chili peppers in hot water until softened, about an hour.
Taste the soaking water. If it is bitter, replace it with fresh water.
Purée chili pepper and water mixture in a blender
Heat the oil in a pan, add onion, garlic, and seasonings.
Once the onions are cooked, add the chili purée to the pan. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Return mixture to the blender, and purée. See warning.
Pour sauce through a sieve. Use a spoon to stir and press the mixture against the sieve to extract all the sauce.
Add salt to taste. If the sauce is a little bitter, some sugar can be added to compensate.

name: Red Devils
attribution: "Red Devils" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Red_Devils, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Place bacon in a sheet pan.
Set the broiler to 'low'.
Pre-cook the bacon under the broiler until it is about halfway done.
While bacon cooks, place white bread on a sheet, one slice per diner.
Place a slice of American cheese on each slice of bread.
Place the tomato slices on each sandwich
Sprinkle a small amount of onion onto each sandwich.
Place a strip of half-cooked bacon on each sandwich.
Place the cookie sheet under broiler, set to maximum temperature, and broil for approximately 3–4 minutes. You must check on them often to prevent burning.
Remove once the bread is toasted, the cheese is golden at the edges, and the bacon is fully cooked.

name: Red Lentil Soup
attribution: "Red Lentil Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Red_Lentil_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Pick over the lentils to remove any debris if needed. Rinse well.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Once oil is hot, add the onion and carrots. Sauté for a few minutes, until the vegetables have started to soften, then add the garlic.
Add the lentils, bay leaf, and water to the pot. Simmer over low-medium heat for 20–30 minutes until lentils are softened.
Serve hot.

name: Rendang (Indonesian Beef and Coconut Stew)
attribution: "Rendang (Indonesian Beef and Coconut Stew)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rendang_(Indonesian_Beef_and_Coconut_Stew), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tbsp ground fresh red chile pepper
1 kg beef, cut into big cubes to make 20 pieces
2 L ready-to-use coconut milk or coconut milk from 1 big fresh coconut

steps: Using a food processor, grind together all the ingredients for the spice paste.
Marinate meat with the spice paste for at least 1 hour.
Heat the coconut milk over low heat until some oil rises to the surface (at least 20 minutes). Stir the coconut milk while it is cooking.
Transfer the meat and spice paste mixture to a large wok or pot. Cover with 300 ml of the hot coconut milk.
Stirring occasionally, cook over medium-low heat until half of the coconut milk has evaporated.
Add another 100 ml hot coconut milk, and stir until almost all of the coconut milk has evaporated.
Keep on adding coconut milk, 100 ml at a time, and cooking until the previous addition has evaporated.
Cook until the meat is tender (at least 1½ hours) and almost all the liquid from the coconut milk has reduced to a spicy sauce.

name: Reuben Sandwich
attribution: "Reuben Sandwich" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Reuben_Sandwich, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ lb (225 g) sliced corned beef (or try using pastrami)
2 slices rye bread (or use sourdough bread in case of rye allergy)

steps: Combine the sauerkraut, onion, and parsley.
Spread the dressing on two slices bread.
Pile layers of corned beef, cheese, and sauerkraut mixture on one slice.
Add second slice of bread.
Butter the outside of the bread.
Grill until lightly browned, roughly 5–10 minutes.

name: Rhubarb and Custard Bread Pudding
attribution: "Rhubarb and Custard Bread Pudding" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rhubarb_and_Custard_Bread_Pudding, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup (125 ml/4.2 fl oz) water
⅔ cup (150 g/5.3 oz) superfine sugar, plus 1 tablespoon
400 g rhubarb, trimmed and chopped into 3 - 4 cm pieces
⅓ cup plus 1 tablespoon (100 ml) heavy cream, plus extra to serve (optional)
10 slices thick-sliced white sandwich bread, crusts removed and cut into triangles

steps: Preheat the oven to 160 C.
Heat the water and ¼ cup (60 g) of sugar in a large frying pan over medium heat until the syrup bubbles.
Add the rhubarb and simmer for 3 minutes, turning occasionally.
Remove the heat and set aside to soak.
Heat the milk, cream and vanilla in a saucepan over a low heat until small bubbles appear.
Meanwhile, combine the remaining sugar, custard powder, and eggs in a heatproof bowl.
Gradually pour the hot milk into the egg mixture, whisking as you go to temper it.
Grease a 30 by, deep baking pan. Butter the bread slices.
Lay the bread slices in the baking pan, overlapping them slightly. Distribute the rhubarb on top, reserving the rhubarb syrup.
Pour in the custard to cover the bread slices. Soak for 20 minutes.
Bake for 30 minutes until the bread puffs up.
Scatter over 1 tablespoon sugar.
Increase temperature to 180 C and bake for 5 more minutes until golden.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve optionally with rhubarb syrup and cream.

name: Rhubarb Cake
attribution: "Rhubarb Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rhubarb_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup sour milk or cultured buttermilk

steps: Cream the brown sugar and butter until fluffy. Beat in the egg and salt.
Stir in the milk, baking soda, vanilla, and flour. Once blended, add the rhubarb and stir until mixed in.
Pour batter into greased 9x13-inch pan. Combine the ¼ cup sugar and cinnamon, then sprinkle on top of the batter.
Bake at 375°F for 30–35 minutes.

name: Rhubarb Crumble I
attribution: "Rhubarb Crumble I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rhubarb_Crumble_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 400 g (1 ¾ cup or 14 oz) rhubarb, cut into pieces roughly 1.5 cm long (no need to be consistent)
75 g (2 ½ oz) butter or margarine, cut in pieces
50 g (1 ¾ oz) white granulated sugar

steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan).
Rinse and drain the rhubarb pieces, and place them in a deep ovenproof dish. Add the light brown sugar and mix briefly.
Put the flours in a mixing bowl. Add the butter. With your fingers (not the palms of your hands), rub the butter into the flour until it resembles breadcrumbs.
Sprinkle the sugar and cinnamon over this mixture, and mix them in briefly.
Sprinkle the crumble mixture over the fruit, making a complete layer. Do not press the topping down—you want it light and crumbly.
Put the dish in the oven (no lid) for 35–45 minutes until crisp and a bit brown.
Serve with custard.

name: Rhubarb Crumble II
attribution: "Rhubarb Crumble II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rhubarb_Crumble_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix brown sugar, oats, flour, butter, and cinnamon until crumbly.
Press half the mixture into a 9 inch square pan.
Cover crumb mixture with diced rhubarb.
Mix white sugar, cornstarch, and water. Cook until clear and thick, stirring constantly. Add vanilla and stir.
Pour over rhubarb. Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture over the top.
Bake for 1 hour at 180°C.

name: Rhubarb Fool
attribution: "Rhubarb Fool" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rhubarb_Fool, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Milk, or a mixture of milk and cream, for serving

steps: Rinse the rhubarb and cut it into smaller pieces, about 1–3 cm in length. If the rhubarb is coarse or of low quality, it may be necessary to peel it first.
Bring the water and sugar to a boil. Add the rhubarb and boil until soft, about 3–5 minutes. Meanwhile, mix the starch with a bit of water until it dissolves.
When the rhubarb is soft, whisk or stir vigorously to make sure all the rhubarb pieces break up into strings. There should be no whole pieces left—if necessary boil some more.
Remove the rhubarb from the heat. Add the dissolved starch to the rhubarb while stirring. Keep stirring and bring the rhubarb to a boil once again.
Pour the rhubarb fool into serving bowls and sprinkle some sugar on top to prevent a skin from forming. Leave to cool off and then refrigerate.
Serve at room temperature or chilled, with milk.

name: Rhubarb Juice
attribution: "Rhubarb Juice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rhubarb_Juice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine the rhubarb and water in a non-aluminum pot. Cook until mushy.
Strain the mixture well, reserving only the juice.
Mix in lemon juice.

name: Rhubarb Marmalade
attribution: "Rhubarb Marmalade" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rhubarb_Marmalade, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 pounds rhubarb, cut into small pieces

steps: Combine the lemon juice, orange juice, and rhubarb.
Chop lemon and orange rind along with raisins; add to rhubarb mixture.
Mix all and let stand for 30 minutes.
Add sugar and bring to a boil, then simmer for 1 hour, stirring often.
When the mixture gets thick, pour into glasses or crock.
When cool, seal.

name: Rhubarb Pie
attribution: "Rhubarb Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rhubarb_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 5 cups (40 oz / 2 ½ lb / 1100 g) rhubarb stalks
1 ½ cups (12 oz / 340 g) white granulated sugar
¼ cup (2 oz / 60 g) cornstarch or tapioca pearls

steps: Prepare the flaky pie crust and refrigerate while preparing the filling.
Clean and trim the rhubarb stalks.
Cut the stalks into ½–1 inch (1.25–2.5 cm) sections.
Add sugar, cornstarch or tapioca, and salt.
Stir until rhubarb is evenly coated with dry ingredients.
Follow the instructions in the flaky pie crust recipe.
Place pie on lowest rack in oven. Bake for 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350 °F (175 °C), and continue baking for 40–45 minutes.
Serve warm or cold.

name: Rhubarb Pudding
attribution: "Rhubarb Pudding" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rhubarb_Pudding, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Line a buttered baking dish with slices of plain stale cake or bread.
Combine the rhubarb and 4 tbsp sugar, and add to the dish.
Cover and bake in a moderately slow 325°F (160°C) oven for about 30 minutes.
Make a meringue of the egg whites by whipping until very stiff, gradually beating in the ½ cup sugar.
Remove pudding from oven and cover with the meringue.
Return to a slow oven to brown the meringue.

name: Rice an' Peas
attribution: "Rice an' Peas" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rice_an'_Peas, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup beans (kidney beans, black beans, pinto beans) (also known as "peas"), dried or canned

steps: If using dried beans, cover them in water and soak for at least 8 hours.
Drain and rinse the beans (even canned beans) prior to use.
If using dried red kidney beans, boil briskly for 20 minutes, then drain again.
Add rice, beans, water, and coconut milk to a rice cooker. If using a programmable cooker, set to cook for brown rice. For an on/off cooker, turn it on.
In about 30 minutes your rice cooker will finish cooking the rice. Open, stir, and serve.

name: Rice and Beef Soup
attribution: "Rice and Beef Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rice_and_Beef_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 rice cooker cups (12 fl oz / 1½ cups / 360 mL) long grain rice

steps: Add the rice, water, parsley, chives, rosemary, and pepper to a 10-cup or larger rice cooker.
For a simple rice cooker, turn it on. For a programmable rice cooker, set the rice cooker to the quick cook setting and start.
Cover and allow to come to a simmer.
Add the beef and cinnamon, cover again, and allow to cook for 60 minutes.

name: Rice and Cabbage Minestrone
attribution: "Rice and Cabbage Minestrone" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rice_and_Cabbage_Minestrone, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut off the stalk and all the hard outside leaves of a cabbage, wash it, and cut it up.
Drain cabbage and cook it in good stock.
Add boiled rice, a little chopped ham, and a few spoonfuls of tomato sauce.

name: Rice and Lentils (Mejadra)
attribution: "Rice and Lentils (Mejadra)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rice_and_Lentils_(Mejadra), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup (80 g / 2.8 oz) uncooked rice or bulgur

steps: Fry the lentils in oil for 3–4 minutes, stirring continuously, until the first beans show signs of scorching.
Add salt, baharat, cumin, and ground cardamom to taste.
Add 2 cups water and cover. Bring to a boil, lower to a simmer. Cook for 20 minutes or until all the water is absorbed by the lentils.
Fry the rice in oil for 3–4 minutes, stirring continuously, until the grains change colour.
Add salt, black or white pepper, and ground cardamom.
Add 2 cups water and cover. Bring to a boil, lower to a simmer. After 5 minutes turn the heat off, and leave standing for another 10 minutes.
Cut the onion into thin strips (about 0.5x4 cm / 0.2x1.6 in).
Fry the onion in olive oil until crisp and deeply golden brown (this may take a while but will result in much fuller flavor).
Mix the lentils and rice, and top with the fried onion. Use 2 parts lentils to 1 part rice for a moist consistency.

name: Rice and Turnip Minestrone
attribution: "Rice and Turnip Minestrone" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rice_and_Turnip_Minestrone, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 cups chicken, beef, or vegetable stock, brought to a boil

steps: Arrange the turnip slices on a rack over a cookie sheet. Sprinkle with salt, cover them with a dish, and let them stand for about 2 hours until the water has run out of them.
Put the slices in a frying pan, and fry them slightly in butter until softened.
Add the gravy and tomatoes. Cook for a few minutes, then pour it into the boiling stock.
Boil for 30 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Rice Cooked in Tomato Meat Sauce (Ross il-Forn)
attribution: "Rice Cooked in Tomato Meat Sauce (Ross il-Forn)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rice_Cooked_in_Tomato_Meat_Sauce_(Ross_il-Forn), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 250 g minced beef or a mixture of beef and pork
1 tin of peeled plum tomatoes and their juices
120 g grated parmigiano-reggiano, peppercorn pecorino, or mature cheddar
1 heaped tbsp parmigiano-reggiano, peppercorn pecorino, or mature cheddar, to finish

steps: Heat the oil in a pan. Add the onion, and cook until translucent.
Add the bacon and garlic, and cook for a couple minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, then the minced meat. Cook, breaking up the meat, until the meat is browned all over.
Stir in the tomatoes and juice. Simmer for a while until the tomatoes no longer taste raw or metallic. It should be saucy and not watery in texture.
Let cool.
Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Butter a stoneware, Pyrex, or aluminium dish/pan—rectangular is traditional but not obligatory.
Rinse the greased dish in water and shake out excess.
Whisk 1 egg lightly in a small bowl with a fork.
Place the rice, 500 ml of the tomato meat sauce, and the 120 g grated cheese in the dish along with the beaten egg and the water. Season lightly and mix gently but thoroughly.

Bake for 30 minutes, then remove from the oven and stir. At this point the rice should be nearly cooked, but there should be enough liquid left to complete the cooking. If it seems to have dried out too much, stir in some more water.
Mix the remaining egg with the remaining cheese and distribute over the top.
Return to the oven and bake a further 30–40 minutes or until well-browned and firm on top. The water should have been fully absorbed and the texture should be firm but moist under the topping.

name: Rice Pilaf
attribution: "Rice Pilaf" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Rice_Pilaf, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup uncooked orzo pasta or uncooked vermicelli pasta broken into small pieces

steps: Melt butter or margarine in heavy deep pan or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add vegetables and let them be lightly cooked without coloring; using the vegetables would mean you omit the orzo pasta.
Add orzo pasta (or small broken pieces of vermicelli pasta) and cook, stirring constantly until pasta is golden brown.
Add rice and stir until rice is well coated with butter. Allow rice to simmer in butter for a minute or two.
Add boiling chicken broth and salt.
