To prepare the tamarind pulp, mix the tamarind mass with twice the amount of water, then work with a fork to remove pits; later strain the pulp.
Heat the fat/oil in a pan. Add the mustard seeds, and heat until they pop.
Add fenugreek seeds, cumin seeds, curry leaves, chili peppers, and salt. Fry 1–2 minutes.
Add onions, and fry until glazed.
Add garlic, ginger, eggplant, potato, carrot, and daikon. Stir.
Move ingredients to side. Add chili powder to oil at the bottom of pot, then stir all.
Add sambar masalar, and stir.
Add 2 cups of water, and bring to boil. Reduce heat, and simmer 5–10 minutes.
Add tomato, green beans, and drumsticks, then simmer 5–10 minutes.
Add coriander, dhal (cooked lentils with their liquid), and tamarind. Simmer until vegetables are soft.
Serve hot over steamed rice.

name: San Francisco Sourdough Bread
attribution: "San Francisco Sourdough Bread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:San_Francisco_Sourdough_Bread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ oz (15 g) active dry yeast

steps: Mash the grapes thoroughly and place in a loosely-covered container. Allow to stand at room temperature for 48 hours.
Strain off the fermented juice and discard the pulp.
Add warm water to the juice to make 1 pint (450 ml).
Stir in the flour, and leave at room temperature overnight.
Replenish with 1 pint of warm water and 2 cups of flour daily if the starter is kept at room temperature. If refrigerated, replenish twice a week.
In a glass measuring cup, sprinkle the dry yeast onto the surface of 4 tablespoons of the warm water and allow to stand until it becomes foamy.
In a bowl, combine the rest of the water with the sourdough starter.
Add 1 cup of the flour. Stir until the dough starts to form and then add the yeast mixture. Mix for 5 minutes.
Add the remaining flour and the salt. Knead the dough until it is soft and elastic, 10 minutes or more.
Place the dough in a greased bowl and cover with a damp cloth. Let rise in a warm place (ca. 80°F/27°C to 90°F/32°C) until doubled.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a round loaf. Place the loaf on a greased and cornmeal-dusted sheet pan.
Let the loaf rise in a warm place, covered with a damp cloth, until it has doubled in size.
Brush the loaf with beaten egg white and score the top of the loaf in a criss-cross pattern with a sharp knife.
Bake at 450°F (230°C) with a pan of boiling water under the oven rack for 10 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 375°F (190°C), remove the water and continue baking until the bread is well browned (about 35–45 minutes).
Cool on a rack.

name: San Francisco style Scallop Ceviche
attribution: "San Francisco style Scallop Ceviche" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:San_Francisco_style_Scallop_Ceviche, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup (125 ml) lemon juice (about 3–4 lemons)
4 red bell peppers, roasted, peeled, and seeded
½ teaspoon (2.5 ml) ground cayenne pepper

steps: In a non-reactive bowl, combine the scallops and lemon juice. Add more juice as needed to cover the scallops.
Refrigerate, covered, and stir often for 2 hours, until the scallops become opaque.
Combine the bell peppers, vinegar, oil, cayenne, and salt into a food processor or blender, and purée.
To serve, spoon the sauce onto individual plates, drain the scallops, and place them on the sauce. Garnish with slices of avocado.

name: Sancocho (Dominican Meat and Vegetable Soup)
attribution: "Sancocho (Dominican Meat and Vegetable Soup)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sancocho_(Dominican_Meat_and_Vegetable_Soup), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ bunch curly parsley, large stems removed
¼ bunch cilantro, large stems removed
1 pound (about 500 g) boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-size pieces
1 tablespoon clear oil, such as canola
1 medium sweet potato, peeled and cut into ½-inch chunks
1 medium boiling potato, unpeeled and cut into bite-size chunks
1 green plantain, peeled and sliced into ½-inch thick slices (see notes)
1 jalapeño or habanero chile, seeded and minced

steps: In bowl of a food processor or blender, combine orange juice, lemon juice, parsley, cilantro, oregano, garlic, salt, and pepper, and process until combined.
Pour mixture into a non-reactive bowl, add chicken and stir to combine.
Cover and refrigerate 1–2 hours.

Heat oil in a large soup pot over medium heat. When hot, use a slotted spoon to lift the chicken out of the marinade and place in the pot, reserving marinade. Cook chicken until opaque, stirring occasionally.
Add reserved marinade, vegetable stock and water to the pot, and bring to a boil.
Add onion, sweet potato, potato, plantain, corn, jalapeño, salt and pepper.
Bring back to a boil, reduce to low and cook partially covered for 1–1½ hours.

name: Sandwich Layer-Cake
attribution: "Sandwich Layer-Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sandwich_Layer-Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 kg (~2.25 lbs) shrimp with shells on
Sprigs of dill or slices of lemon or lime for garnish
Chopped dill or parsley for garnish

steps: Boil the eggs until hard, and peel the shrimp.
Set aside some shrimp (about ⅓) for garnishing. Chop the remaining shrimp, which will be used for filling.
Mix 1 dl mayonnaise with 1 dl sour cream in a cup or bowl, place in the refrigerator.
Mix the remaining mayonnaise with the cottage cheese in another bowl together with the chopped shrimp; this is the filling.
Cut the bread lengthwise to make eight 1 cm thick slices. Discard the top and bottom slice.

Place two slices next to each other, preferably on a cutting board. Spread one third of the filling on top of the bread slices. Add two more bread slices on top. Spread half of the remaining filling and repeat for the final layer. The cake should now have four layers of bread with three layers of filling between them.
If necessary even out the edges of the cake with a sharp knife.
Take the mayonnaise/sour cream mix out of the refrigerator and spread it thinly and evenly on the sides of and on top of the cake.
Cover the sides of the cake with chopped parsley or dill. Garnish with shrimp, sliced eggs, and dill sprigs or lemon slices.

name: Sangah (Cameroonian Corn and Cassava Leaf)
attribution: "Sangah (Cameroonian Corn and Cassava Leaf)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sangah_(Cameroonian_Corn_and_Cassava_Leaf), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine the water and palm nut cream in a pot. Boil for a few minutes.
Stir in the pounded cassava leaves. Cover with the lid, and boil for 20 minutes.
Stir in as much corn as desired. Season to taste with homi.
Serve hot.

name: Sarsaparilla Soda
attribution: "Sarsaparilla Soda" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sarsaparilla_Soda, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients except for carbonated water in a pot.
Boil them until it becomes a thick syrup; this recipe yields about 5 oz (120 ml) syrup.
Strain the syrup.
To make the finished soda, mix 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

name: Sauce Mornay
attribution: "Sauce Mornay" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sauce_Mornay, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup finely grated Parmigiano Reggiano
¼ cup finely grated gruyère cheese

steps: Combine both grated cheeses.
In a saucepan, combine the sauce béchamel and the cayenne.
Stirring constantly, heat the sauce until it comes to a simmer.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the grated cheese.
Taste for seasoning and adjust with salt and pepper if necessary.
If not served immediately, you may dot the surface with butter to prevent a skin from forming.

name: Sausage and Egg Breakfast Roll
attribution: "Sausage and Egg Breakfast Roll" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sausage_and_Egg_Breakfast_Roll, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut the sausages into small pieces and fry until done. Drain grease if needed and, if you desire, rinse very lightly, using a colander, then return to the pan.
Add the egg and mix into the sausage pieces until all the liquid is gone. Add salt and pepper for taste.
Thickly spread the cream cheese onto the ciabatta roll, and pile the egg and sausage mix into the roll.
Serve classic sandwich style or keep the halves separate.

name: Sausage and Tortellini Soup
attribution: "Sausage and Tortellini Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sausage_and_Tortellini_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Vegetable spray or 1 teaspoon olive oil
2 cartons (2 quarts / 4 pounds) low-sodium chicken broth
1 package (1¾ pounds) fresh Three Cheese Tortellini (from dairy case)

steps: Coat a large stock pot with vegetable spray or 1 teaspoon olive oil.
Remove sausage from casings and heat over medium heat in stock pot until sausage is crumbled and no longer pink.
When the sausage is completely cooked, add sliced mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are sautéed.
Add the entire bag of baby spinach.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until spinach is lightly sautéed.
Add diced tomatoes and stir thoroughly.
Add chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add tortellini and simmer on low for 10–15 minutes until the pasta is cooked.
Ladle into soup bowls and sprinkle generously with Parmesan cheese.

name: Sausage Sizzle
attribution: "Sausage Sizzle" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sausage_Sizzle, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: About five Australian-style thin sausages ("snags") per person (thick sausages on special occasions)
Loaves of sliced sandwich bread (enough for one slice per sausage)
Sliced onions, with a little oil or butter (optional)

steps: Grill the sausages (eucalyptus wood fire is best) until the skins are partially black.
Grill the sliced onions, if desired.
Wrap each sausage in a slice of bread, running the sausage diagonally along the bread.
Add grilled onions and tomato sauce to taste.

name: Sausage-Egg Breakfast Dish
attribution: "Sausage-Egg Breakfast Dish" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sausage-Egg_Breakfast_Dish, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Brown sausage and sprinkle with pepper.
Drain off excess fat, and let sausage cool.
Beat eggs and add milk.
Fold in cubes of stale bread, cheese, and cooled sausage.
Pour into and 8 by 8-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray.
Refrigerate for at least an hour (or freeze for later).
Preheat oven to 325°F. Bake for 1 hour.
Cool and cut into squares.

name: Sauteed Morels
attribution: "Sauteed Morels" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sauteed_Morels, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Sprinkle mushrooms and onion with salt and black pepper.
Heat oil in large sauté pan over medium high heat.
Add garlic and cook 30–45 seconds. Add remaining ingredients and cook for 7–10 more minutes.
Remove from pan and drizzle with pan juices. Serve.

name: Savoury Rice Cake
attribution: "Savoury Rice Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Savoury_Rice_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1½ cups (360 ml) short grain rice, cooked
½ cup (120 ml) grated parmesan cheese
500 g (1 lb) carrots, cauliflower, and broccoli
1 cup (240 ml) tomato salsa, for serving

steps: In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice, spring onions, eggs and the Parmesan cheese. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Press half the rice mixture into a greased 20 cm spring-form pan. Toss vegetables with one cup of mozzarella cheese, place into pan. Spoon on the remaining rice and press down firmly. Sprinkle evenly with remaining cheese and thyme.
Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 30–35 minutes.
Serve with tomato salsa.

name: Sayur Asem (Indonesian Tamarind Vegetable Soup)
attribution: "Sayur Asem (Indonesian Tamarind Vegetable Soup)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sayur_Asem_(Indonesian_Tamarind_Vegetable_Soup), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 20 g fresh tamarind or asam jawa tamarind paste, or 5 dried bilimbi fruit

steps: Grind together all the ingredients for the spice paste until smooth.
Clean the vegetables, and cut into bite-size pieces.
Bring 1.2 liters of water to a boil in a pot. Stir in the spice paste, tamarind, galangal, and salam leaves.
Gradually add the vegetables, starting with those that require a longer cooking time.
Season with salt and sugar to taste.

name: Scalloped Oysters
attribution: "Scalloped Oysters" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Scalloped_Oysters, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Chop the eggs very fine, and mix with the crumbs. Season with cayenne, salt, and mace.
Cover the bottom of a deep pie dish with the eggs and crumbs.
Use a fork to place a layer of oysters over the egg mixture, along with 2–3 small pieces of butter. Continue until all ingredients are used up, reserving sufficient crumbs for a final layer.
Bake 45 minutes at 375–400°F. Serve hot.

name: Scheiterhaufen (Austrian Bread Pudding)
attribution: "Scheiterhaufen (Austrian Bread Pudding)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Scheiterhaufen_(Austrian_Bread_Pudding), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 tsp (20 ml) rum or a few drops of rum aroma

steps: Wash the apples and peaches, and peel them if desired. Cut them into slices approximately ¼ inch (1 cm) thick.
Cut the bread into slices about the same size as the fruit.
Pour the milk into a bowl and add the eggs. Mix well. Then take the slices of bread and let them soak in the mixture for a few seconds. This will take longer if you use stale rather than fresh bread.
Mix the refined sugar and the cinnamon in a cup or a small bowl.

Grease an ovenproof dish, then layer the slices, bread, and fruit alternately in the dish. Sprinkle a bit of the sugar-cinnamon mixture on top of every layer. For the best result, start and end with a layer of bread. You can decide whether you want an apple and a peach layer or whether you would like to mix the different kinds of fruit.
Scatter a few flakes of butter on top, and put the dish into the oven for 45 minutes at 180°C/350°F.
Enjoy!

name: Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte (Black Forest Cake)
attribution: "Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte (Black Forest Cake)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Schwarzw%C3%A4lder_Kirschtorte_(Black_Forest_Cake), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup / 50 g Butter, cut into pieces
1 can / 24 oz (750 g) Sour cherries, stoned
40 g (2 oz) Shaved chocolate for garnish
1 jar Glacé or maraschino cherries for decoration

steps: Mix the flour, cocoa and baking powder in a bowl. Mix the egg white with the sugar and vanilla sugar, then pour into a well in the middle of the flour.
Mix the liquid into some of the flour until it forms a porridge-like mass
Add the cold butter, and rub into the dough.
Mix in the rest of the flour and knead briefly into a ball.
Rest the dough in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Roll the dough out to fit the base of a 20 cm (8 inch) springform cake pan.
Bake at 160°C (325°F) for 20 minutes.
Mix the flour, cornstarch, baking powder and cocoa powder with a whisk.
Whisk the 4 egg yolks with the warm water until it is foamy, and little by little add ⅔ of the sugar, the vanilla sugar, almond extract, and cinnamon.
Whip the egg whites to stiff peaks, and beat in the rest of the sugar a little at a time.
Fold the beaten egg whites into the egg yolk mixture.
Sprinkle the flour mixture onto the egg mixture and carefully incorporate.
Pour into a 20 cm (8 inch) springform pan lined with parchment paper.
Bake at 160°C (325°F) oven for about 35 minutes until a wooden skewer or toothpick comes out clean when the cake is pierced.
Cool cake in pan for 15 minutes, then turn out onto a cooling rack to cool completely.
Drain the cherries in a sieve. Reserve the juice.
Begin heating ¾ of the juice in a saucepan, and mix the cornstarch with the rest.
When the juice starts to boil, pour a little hot juice onto the cornstarch. Mix well, then stir it back into the saucepan. Cook until the mixture has thickened.
Add the sugar and stir to dissolve. Mix in the cherries in, then remove from the heat and allow to cool.
Add the Kirschwasser.
Sprinkle the gelatin onto the 3 tablespoons of water, and allow to bloom for 10 minutes, stirring from time to time.
Heat the gelatin carefully until melted. Allow to cool to room temperature, but don't let it set.

Whip the cream to soft peaks, and fold in the cool but still liquid gelatin. Whip until stiff, adding vanilla sugar to taste. If you don't have vanilla sugar, use 1 tablespoon of vanilla extract and granulated sugar to taste.
Spread ½ the cherry mixture then ⅓ of the whipped cream mixture onto the shortcrust base.
Cut the cake horizontally into two layers using a length of cotton thread.
Press one cake layer onto the filling.
Spread the rest of the cherry mixture onto the cake, along with half of the remaining whipped cream.
Cover the filling with the last layer of cake, and spread the remaining whipped cream on top.
Strew the top of the torte with shaved chocolate, and decorate with glacé or maraschino cherries.
Refrigerate for 4 hours or longer before serving.

name: Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte (Black Forest Cake) II
attribution: "Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte (Black Forest Cake) II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Schwarzw%C3%A4lder_Kirschtorte_(Black_Forest_Cake)_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 250 g (8 oz) Cherries (fresh or frozen, preferably sour cherries)
8 oz / 250 g Cherries (fresh or frozen, preferably sour/pie cherries)
⅓ cup / 30 g Unsweetened cocoa powder
2 packets (¼ oz each) / 4 teaspoons / 14 g Unflavored gelatin powder
½ cup / 115 g Powdered sugar (icing sugar)
½ cup or more / 60 g or more Chocolate shavings (optional)

steps: Pit the cherries if needed.

Cook everything except the liqueur in a medium-sized saucepan on the stovetop, stirring occasionally to keep it from sticking to the bottom of the pan and to prevent it from boiling over, until the cherries begin softening, about 5 to 10 minutes.
Add the liqueur and cook for another 10 minutes over medium heat. The cherries should be soft enough to eat easily, but not cooked so long that they become mushy or lose their shape.
Set the cherries aside to cool.
Pit the cherries if needed.

Cook the cherries and sugar in a medium-sized saucepan on the stovetop, stirring occasionally, until the cherries begin softening, for about 5 to 10 minutes. Because there is no added liquid, you may want to start cooking at a slightly lower temperature and raise it to medium after the sugar has melted.
Add the liqueur, and cook for another few minutes until the cherries are soft enough. Set them aside to cool.
If you are making the cherries in advance, both kinds can be stored in the refrigerator (in separate containers) at this point for up to several days.

After both kinds of cherries have been cooked, drain both types of cherries thoroughly and separately, saving all the drained syrup. The cherries need to be cooled and drained well enough that they won't dissolve the whipped cream filling when the cake is assembled. You will use some of the syrup to moisten the cake layers.

Line two 9-inch (23 cm) cake pans with parchment. If you don't have parchment paper, spread a very thin layer of butter only on the bottom of the pans. Do not butter the sides of the pans, and do not coat the pans with flour.
Preheat the oven to 350 °F (180 °F or gas mark 4–medium).
Separate the eggs.
Whip the egg whites until stiff and set aside.
Whip the egg yolks and sugar in a large mixing bowl, until very light and fluffy. This will take several minutes with an electric mixer and longer if you are beating them by hand.
Sift the cocoa powder and flour together over the egg yolk mixture. Add the stiffly whipped egg whites on top. Gently fold together all ingredients.
Scrape the batter into the two pans and bake until done, approximately 20–25 minutes. The internal temperature should be around 185–190 °F. Set the cakes aside to cool.

Put the powdered gelatin in a small pan. Add an ounce or so (30 ml) of cool water and let it stand until the gelatin has "bloomed" (absorbed the water and softened). This usually takes at least 5 minutes.
Add the kirschwasser to the softened gelatin. If you do not want to use the kirschwasser, you can substitute an equal volume of syrup from the cherries.
Heat the gelatin mixture over low heat, stirring constantly. Remove from the heat when the gelatin has dissolved—it will look clear.

Set the pan aside to cool down to a warm room temperature. Do not place it in the refrigerator. If you have a cooking thermometer, an ideal temperature might be around 75–80°F (24–26 °C). If the gelatin begins to solidify, gently warm it until it is barely liquid again.
In a large mixing bowl, whip the whipping cream, until it begins thickening but has not reached the point of forming soft peaks.
Stir a large spoonful of the half-whipped whipping cream into the cooled but still liquid gelatin.
Resume whipping the remaining cream, gradually drizzling the gelatin mixture into the bowl while whipping.
Once the gelatin has been incorporated, add the powdered sugar and whip until firm but not grainy.
Collect everything you need:
* Both kinds of cooked cherries, completely cooled and well-drained

* About 2 ounces (60 ml) of cherry syrup from cooking the cherries. Choose your favorite one, or mix them together. You can add an extra ounce (30 ml) of kirschwasser to the syrup if you want. If you want a boozy cake, you can even use kirschwasser instead of the cherry syrups.
* 2 cake layers, completely cooled
* Stabilized whipped cream
* Chocolate shavings or sprinkles (if desired)
* A large platter (big enough to accommodate whipped cream on the side of the cake if desired)
Set aside about a dozen pretty, well-drained cherries for decorating the top layer.
Place the first cake layer on the platter.

Pour some of the reserved cherry syrup over the cake layer. The amount should be in the "pancake topping" range (about 1 oz/30 mL): enough to cover most of the cake, but not enough to make it soggy or to pour off the edges. Use a pastry brush to spread the syrup evenly across the surface. Don't skip this step, or the cake will be much too dry.

Top the bottom layer with a small amount of whipped cream. Place a single layer of cherries on top of that. Top that with just enough whipped cream to completely fill the spaces between the cherries. Note that the cherries act as a structural element since the whipped cream can't support the weight of the top cake layer on its own. If you put too much whipped cream between the layers, it will squish out the sides when the top cake layer is added.
Place the top cake layer on top of the cherries, and repeat the process of covering the cake layer with cherry syrup.

Cover the cake with a generous layer of whipped cream (either on top only or on both the top and sides, as you prefer). The whipped cream can be piped with a pastry bag and tips if desired, or it can be spread on with a spoon or spatula. Arrange the reserved cherries in a decorative pattern on top of the cake.
If desired, shave a block of semi-sweet chocolate to make chocolate curls. Add chocolate shavings to the top or sides of the cake.
Place assembled cake in the refrigerator to rest for 4–12 hours before serving.

name: Scottish Porridge
attribution: "Scottish Porridge" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Scottish_Porridge, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup (80 g) steel-cut oats, also called Irish oats
1 teaspoon lemon juice or apple cider vinegar (for soaking)
1 teaspoon of buckwheat flour (for reducing phytates)

steps: Mix the steel-cut oats with a teaspoon of buckwheat flour in a bowl.
Add warm water to soak the oats and add a splash of lemon juice or apple cider vinegar. Cover and allow to soak overnight or at least 7 to 8 hours.
Place the oats, salt and water into a small pan and gently bring it to a small boil, stirring occasionally until the porridge starts to thicken.

Once the thickening has begun, lower the heat to low to avoid burning the porridge and allow it to simmer for approximately 15 to 20 minutes (or less if the oats are tender and reached your preferred consistency).
Remove from the heat and let it stand for 1 or 2 minutes before serving.
Serve and top with your choice of toppings, such as chia seeds, walnuts, tablespoon of peanut butter, berries, cinnamon, or a dollop of Greek yogurt.

name: Scrambled Eggs with Sausage
attribution: "Scrambled Eggs with Sausage" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Scrambled_Eggs_with_Sausage, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Add the sausages to a hot frying pan. Fry, turning, until sausage is cooked through.
Beat the eggs with the salt.
Transfer egg mixture to pan along with vegetables, if using. Fry for 30–60 seconds.
Serve.

name: Scrambled Eggs with Vegetables
attribution: "Scrambled Eggs with Vegetables" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Scrambled_Eggs_with_Vegetables, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat a frying pan over medium heat, and add oil.
Add tomato and cucumber to the pan. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add salt.
Beat the eggs with the onion and additional salt if desired. Transfer mixture to the pan.
Cook eggs and vegetables, turning every 30 seconds until cooked to taste.
Serve.

name: Scribbled Eggs
attribution: "Scribbled Eggs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Scribbled_Eggs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat a small amount of oil in a skillet over medium heat.
If using tomatoes, add them to the pan. Fry for a minute.
If using scallion, add to tomatoes. Cook for another minute.
Beat the eggs well, and pour into the pan.
Start stirring the eggs—Kenyans call this scribbling. Cook like this until the egg is done.

name: Seafood Bruschetta
attribution: "Seafood Bruschetta" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Seafood_Bruschetta, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 300 g prawn, fried with 1 tbsp vegetable oil
8 crabsticks, cut into 6 parts and fried with 1 tbsp vegetable oil
5 fishballs, cut in circles and fried with 1 tbsp vegetable oil

steps: In a bowl, combine prawn, crabstick, fishball, parsley, sugar, salt and black pepper. Stir with spoon until well-mixed.
Top each slice of baguette with some of the the topping mixture.
Bake the bruschetta at 190°C for 15 minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Seafood Cocktail Sauce
attribution: "Seafood Cocktail Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Seafood_Cocktail_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup Heinz Chili Sauce (optional, and can be substituted with ketchup)

steps: Combine all ingredients except horseradish.
Taste and adjust flavors to your liking. Some recipes call for the addition of celery salt or garlic juice.

Add a tablespoon at a time to get it to the taste you prefer. If your grated horseradish is fresh (a fresh bottle from the store), the recipe amount may be too much for your liking; if it is older, the recipe amount may not be enough.
Refrigerate until cold.
Place cold sauce into serving dish. Serve with seafood.

name: Seafood Fried Rice
attribution: "Seafood Fried Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Seafood_Fried_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat the oil in a non-stick pan. Add the garlic, and fry for 20 seconds until fragrant.
Add the bacon, prawn, fishball, and chicken. Stir-fry until they change color.
Add the rice, then the bean sprouts and spring onion.
Season with salt, pepper, jalapeño, and soy sauce.
Serve with the dressing.

name: Seafood Kebabs with Zhoug Sauce
attribution: "Seafood Kebabs with Zhoug Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Seafood_Kebabs_with_Zhoug_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ kg large prawns/shrimp, peeled and deveined
½ kg fish fillets, cut into 2½ cm (1 in) cubes
½ kg squid, cleaned and cut into 2½ cm (1 in) pieces
5 cloves garlic, peeled and finely chopped
¾ cup (180 ml) extra virgin olive oil
¾ cup (180 ml) dry white wine (for halal replace with white grape juice)
1 cup (240 g) coriander leaves, washed, dried, and chopped
1 cup (240 g) parsley, washed, dried, and chopped
8 jalapeños, seeded and chopped (adjust the quantity according to your heat tolerance)
¼ cup (60 ml) extra virgin olive oil

steps: Combine all the marinade ingredients in a nonreactive (glass or ceramic) mixing bowl. Add the seafood and mix to coat well. Refrigerate overnight.
Dry roast the cumin, caraway and cardamom seeds for 2–3 minutes in a cast iron skillet or wok over low heat. Cool, then add the peppercorns and pound in a mortar and pestle to a fine powder.
In a blender or food processor, blend the coriander, parsley, spices, garlic, chilli peppers and olive oil together with ½ cup water until a thick, smooth paste is formed.

Transfer the paste into a saucepan, heat until it starts bubbling, then reduce the heat and simmer, stirring constantly, until the water is evaporated. Cool, transfer to an airtight container and chill.
Remove the seafood from the marinade and drain in a colander. Save the marinade for basting the kebabs later. Thread the seafood onto skewers or satay sticks.
Char-grill the kebabs over hot coals, basting and turning every few minutes. It should take about 10 minutes to cook.
Serve with the zhoug sauce as a dipping sauce.

name: Seafood Pizza
attribution: "Seafood Pizza" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Seafood_Pizza, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Knead all the dough ingredients together to make a smooth, stretchy dough. Cover with aluminium foil, and rest until 2 hours in fridge.
Prepare the toppings, briefly mix all together, and let rest for 3 minutes.
Combine all the ingredients for the sauce.
Roll out the dough into a circle, and spread the sauce on top. Arrange the toppings over top.
Bake at 200°C for about 30 minutes.

name: Seafood Risotto
attribution: "Seafood Risotto" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Seafood_Risotto, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut the squids into strips or rings.
In a bowl marinade the squids, the prawns, and the scallops with some oil, balsamic vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper. Let it marinate for half hour in the fridge while you are cooking the rice.
Bring the fish stock to simmering point without letting the stock boil. The surface of the stock should just be moving a little.
In a large thick pot heat a thin layer of olive oil. Add the onion and garlic, and sweat very gently as for a soffritto.
Stir in the rice, and cook until it has a transparent look for not more than 2 minutes. Add some salt and pepper and the wine.

As the wine cooks away you will see the remaining liquid getting thicker as it is absorbing the starch from the rice. When it is more or less gone, add some hot stock. Do not add too much stock all at once. The rice should never be submerged in stock. Keep stirring it and keep adding more stock as it cooks away. This should take about 15–20 minutes.
Taste during the cooking to see if the rice is done. The rice should be soft, but have enough bite to it to feel the individual grains of rice.
Five minutes before the end of the cooking time for the risotto, add the marinated squid, the scallops, and the prawns. Add the parsley right before tuning off the heat.
When it's done, stir in the butter in small chunks at the time, tasting to get the amount of butter right. Season with more salt and pepper to taste.
Let it rest for a few minutes, and then serve.

name: Seafood Seasoning
attribution: "Seafood Seasoning" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Seafood_Seasoning, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Pulse everything in a spice grinder until relatively smooth. If your spice grinder doubles as your coffee grinder, make sure you pulse some rice after.
Keep in an airtight container with a shaker lid for up to 1 year.

name: Seasoned Bread and Butter Balls
attribution: "Seasoned Bread and Butter Balls" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Seasoned_Bread_and_Butter_Balls, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Remove crusts from bread, and add other ingredients onto a microwave safe plate.
Make each slice of bread into ball, and lay on same plate.
Microwave plate for 25 seconds, wait 30 seconds, and serve.

name: Seasoned Pepper
attribution: "Seasoned Pepper" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Seasoned_Pepper, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine everything, and put it in your pepper mill.
Use like you would ordinary pepper.

name: Seaweed Salad
attribution: "Seaweed Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Seaweed_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 ounce assorted dried seaweed or wakame
¼ cup minced shallot, scallion or red onion

steps: Rinse the seaweed and soak until it has increased 10 times in size, about 5 minutes. Gently squeeze to remove excess water.
Remove any hard bits of seaweed and chop the rest. Put pieces in a bowl.
Toss with the shallot, soy sauce, vinegar, mirin (or sugar), sesame oil, cayenne, and salt (if necessary). Taste and add seasonings as needed.
Garnish with sesame seeds.

name: Seblak
attribution: "Seblak" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Seblak, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1/4 kg of boiled chicken meat (cut into small pieces)

steps: Prepare all the ingredients.
Blend kencur (aromatic ginger), shallots, and garlic. Add a little salt.
Blend the chili separately.
Heat the oil in a pan.
Sauté the blended kencur, shallots, and garlic until fragrant and cooked.
Add the blended chili, then stir until it smells fragrant.
Next, pour in the water.
Add salt, chicken broth powder, and sugar to taste.
Put in the crackers and boiled chicken pieces, then stir until cooked.
Add the instant noodles, and stir again until everything is well-cooked.
Pour it into a bowl according to your preferred portion.
Seblak is ready to serve.
You can add various toppings to your seblak, such as meatballs, sausages, vegetables, or other seafood ingredients as you like.
You can also make seblak with soup or dry-style. If you want to make seblak with soup, make sure to add enough water so it doesn’t dry out.

name: Seitan Burger
attribution: "Seitan Burger" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Seitan_Burger, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup gluten flour (see seitan for how to gain gluten from wheat flour)

steps: Combine water and soy sauce.
Combine gluten, salt, and spices.
Combine the water and gluten mixtures. Knead until smooth.
If using, knead in chopped onions.
Shape the seitan dough into patties.
Combine all the ingredients for the breading, and use it to coat the patties on all sides.
Fry the patties in an oiled pan. Don't use too much oil but enough to let the breading pick up some oil on both sides.

name: Self-rising Flour
attribution: "Self-rising Flour" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Self-rising_Flour, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix all ingredients to combine.
Store in an air-tight container in a cool, dry environment.

name: Semmelknoedel (Bavarian Bread Dumplings)
attribution: "Semmelknoedel (Bavarian Bread Dumplings)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Semmelknoedel_(Bavarian_Bread_Dumplings), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 10 white bread rolls, cut into small cubes
1 bunch of parsley, washed and chopped

steps: Heat the oil in a skillet. Add the diced onions, and sauté until translucent. Remove from the heat.
Combine the bread cubes and the cooked onions.
Mix the eggs with the milk, and pour it over the bread and the onions. Mix to make a dough.
Mix the parsley and flour into the dough. Season with salt and pepper.
Form balls of the dough about the size of tennis balls.
Boil the knoedel in salted water. After about 2 minutes, turn the temperature down to a lower setting and let them boil for another 10–15 minutes.

name: Semolina Minestrone
attribution: "Semolina Minestrone" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Semolina_Minestrone, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Bring the stock to a boil in a saucepan.
Add semolina very gradually, stirring to keep it from getting lumpy.
Cook until the semolina is soft.
Serve with grated Parmesan.

name: Semolina Pudding
attribution: "Semolina Pudding" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Semolina_Pudding, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 125 g (¼ liter) of soft wheat semolina flour
30 g of butter or 1 tbsp of nutty-tasting cold-pressed cooking oil (hazelnut oil, walnut oil, poppy seed oil, rapeseed oil)
1 egg white, whipped to soft peaks

steps: Bring the milk, salt, lemon zest, and grated cinnamon to a boil in a large saucepan.
Stir in the semolina. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the swollen (this happens very quickly).
Stir in the sugar, vanilla sugar, and butter.
Remove the porridge from the heat.
If desired, stir in whisked egg yolk and/or fold in whipped egg whites.
Serve.

name: Sesame Ginger Marinade
attribution: "Sesame Ginger Marinade" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sesame_Ginger_Marinade, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Give everything a big shake in an 8-ounce mason jar until smooth.
Refrigerate for up to two weeks.

name: Sesame Milk
attribution: "Sesame Milk" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sesame_Milk, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tsp maple syrup or other vegan sweetener

steps: Roughly combine ingredients.
Process with a blender until smooth.
Chill for several hours.
Stir before serving.

name: Sesame Noodle Salad
attribution: "Sesame Noodle Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sesame_Noodle_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup or more finely-chopped fresh cilantro

steps: Cook angel hair pasta according to package instructions, then drain.
Add sesame oil, olive oil, and salt (to taste) to drained pasta
Toss in cilantro, scallions, and carrots.
Chill before serving.

name: Sese Plaintains (Cameroonian Plantain Stew)
attribution: "Sese Plaintains (Cameroonian Plantain Stew)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sese_Plaintains_(Cameroonian_Plantain_Stew), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tablespoons chicken-flavour bouillon cube or powder
1 bunch of fresh kale leaves, chopped

steps: Cut the ends off the plantains. Make a shallow slit through the length of the peel, and remove it.
Slice the plantains into thick rounds.
Boil the meat in a saucepan with salt, cayenne pepper, half the onions, and bouillon cubes until tender.
Add the plantain, crayfish, red oil, and remaining onions. Simmer for about 15–20 minutes.
Stir in the kale, and cook for an additional 8 minutes.
Remove from the heat and serve warm.

name: Sev Puri (Crispy Indian Snack with Potato)
attribution: "Sev Puri (Crispy Indian Snack with Potato)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sev_Puri_(Crispy_Indian_Snack_with_Potato), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ tsp red chile pepper (lal mirchi)

steps: Arrange the puris on a plate, and make a hole in the center of each puri.
Fill with a few chopped boiled potato cubes.
Add about ¼ tsp of tamarind and green chutneys in each. Sprinkle with cumin powder, salt, red chilli powder.
Sprinkle finely chopped onions over top, then generously sprinkle sev all over the puris.
Garnish with finely chopped coriander.
Serve fresh.

name: Seven Minute Icing
attribution: "Seven Minute Icing" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Seven_Minute_Icing, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Put the egg white, sugar, and water in the top of a double boiler.
Place over boiling water and beat with a rotary egg beater seven minutes.
Then add baking powder and flavoring.
Remove from heat and beat until thick.
Spread in swirls over cake.

name: Seviyan Ji Khirni (Sindhi Vermicelli Pudding)
attribution: "Seviyan Ji Khirni (Sindhi Vermicelli Pudding)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Seviyan_Ji_Khirni_(Sindhi_Vermicelli_Pudding), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 tbsp South Asian vermicelli (short, fine wheat noodles)

steps: Heat ghee in a skillet. Add vermicelli, and fry over low heat until golden brown. Remove from the heat.
Bring the milk to a boil. Add vermicelli, cardamom, and saffron. Simmer until the vermicelli are tender and the milk is reduced to a little more than half the original volume.
Mix in the sugar, and boil for 5–7 minutes.
Serve, garnished with almonds.

name: Shahan ful
attribution: "Shahan ful" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Shahan_ful, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups dried fava beans (or canned fava beans)
2 tablespoons olive oil or niter kibbeh
Yogurt or feta cheese for serving (optional)
Bread rolls or flatbread for serving

steps: Wash and soak the dried fava beans overnight.
Drain the beans and place them in a large pot with fresh water.
Simmer over low heat until the beans become soft and tender. Add more water if necessary.
Mash the cooked beans into a coarse paste using a spoon or potato masher.
In another pan, heat the olive oil or niter kibbeh over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until soft.
Stir in the garlic, tomatoes, chilies, cumin, and berbere spice.
Cook for several minutes until fragrant.
Add the mashed beans and stir well.
Season with lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Simmer for a few minutes until thick.
Serve hot with yogurt, feta cheese, or fresh herbs if desired.
cuisine: Shahan ful served with bread, tomatoes, and olive oil

name: Shakshuka II
attribution: "Shakshuka II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Shakshuka_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Cayenne pepper, paprika, and turmeric to taste

steps: Peel and chop the onion. Fry it in the oil until it turns translucent.
Chop the tomatoes and pepper, and add to the onion in the pan.
Add herbs and spices. Cover and let cook until the tomatoes are evenly cooked through (around 25 minutes on low heat).
With a wooden spoon, make two holes in the onion-tomato mix.
Break and pour each egg into its own hole. Cover and let cook until the eggs are firm (around 5 more minutes).
Serve with bread.

name: Shashlik (Russian Skewered Meat)
attribution: "Shashlik (Russian Skewered Meat)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Shashlik_(Russian_Skewered_Meat), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Pieces of onion, red or green bell pepper, bacon, sausage, cucumber, baby mushrooms

steps: Mix the honey, mustard, vodka, salt and pepper in a deep bowl and soak the meat pieces in it. Leave the bowl in the refrigerator for 3 hours.
Arrange the meat pieces on wooden or metal skewers, putting some pieces of bacon, sausage, pepper, onion, mushrooms, cucumber, according to your preference, between the pieces of meat.
Grill the skewers.
Serve with potato and other salads! Enjoy!

name: Sheer Khurma
attribution: "Sheer Khurma" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sheer_Khurma, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 100 g dried dates, soaked overnight, pitted and chopped thin

steps: Heat the ghee in a large pot over a low heat.
Add the cashew nuts to the ghee, and fry until browned.
Turn off the flame and add the raisins. When the raisins swell up, take both them and the cashews out of the ghee with a spoon and set aside.
Switch the low heat back on and heat the ghee. Add the vermicelli and fry, stirring so it turns golden-brown. Watch it carefully so it does not burn.
Pour in the milk and water. Add the cashews and raisins back into the mixture.
Add the sliced dates and almonds. Cook for about 2 minutes, or until the vermicelli starts to get flexible; then add sugar.
Keep on the low flame for another 2 minutes, then add cream and cardamom powder.
Heat just a little longer and mix well.
Serve hot.

name: Shepherd's Pie I
attribution: "Shepherd's Pie I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Shepherd's_Pie_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 lb (450 g) minced or ground lamb or beef
3 lb (1.3 kg) powdery old potatoes, such as King Edwards
2 cups (300 ml) beef stock (alternatively, bouillon cubes can be used, or gravy powder, if the flour is omitted)
1 handful of mixed vegetables such as sweetcorn or carrots (optional)

steps: Heat oil in a pan and brown the mince. Where lean meat is used, there may be no need to use additional oil.
Finely chop the onion and lightly fry in a little butter with a small amount of salt until clear.
Add the onions to the mince, mixed herbs, and some pepper.
Sprinkle the flour over the mixture, stir, and cook for 3–4 minutes (if using gravy powder, omit this step).
Cover with lamb or beef stock (or add water and beef bouillon/gravy powder) and simmer for 30 minutes.
Test the savoury mince for seasoning. If gravy is not used, additional salt may be needed.

Meanwhile: Peel, chop and boil the potatoes for 20 minutes until cooked. Once the meat is cooked, skim off the excess fat, then reduce the savoury mince until the liquid is level with the mince and onions. Drain the potatoes until completely dry. Mash until smooth and free of any lumps. Add butter to the mashed potato, taste and add seasoning as required. Slowly add milk whilst mashing until the mash is soft and creamy (heavy mash will not float properly on top of the mince).
Put mince mixture in a shallow oven-proof dish.
Layer the mash over the meat and brush the tops of the potatoes with melted butter.
If desired, sprinkle the grated cheese on top of the mash.
If cooking without cheese, rough up the surface of the mash by dragging a fork across it, as if ploughing a field.
Bake in a hot oven for about 30–50 minutes until the top is golden brown.
Serve with peas or beans, or other green vegetables.

name: Shepherd's Pie II
attribution: "Shepherd's Pie II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Shepherd's_Pie_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pound (450 g) lean ground hamburger meat
12 oz (341 ml or 1 can) creamed corn
Salt, pepper, and butter to taste
1–2 cups shredded Cheddar or Mexican blend cheese (optional, amount depends on how much cheese you want)

steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C)
In a large skillet, brown the hamburger meat until it is no longer pink
In a medium baking pan, evenly layer the meat on the bottom, then corn. Spread a layer of potatoes.
If using, sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake in the oven for about 30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

name: Shepherd's Pie III
attribution: "Shepherd's Pie III" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Shepherd's_Pie_III, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 5 ml olive oil or other cooking oil

steps: Peel and chop the potatoes. Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes whilst preparing the rest of the meal.
Cut the minced lamb and add the garlic.
Next gently heat some olive oil in a frying pan and add the meat and garlic
Then add the vegetables, ketchup, stock cube (or gravy) and cook on a very low heat for 5 minutes.
Add flour and water and mix well.
Cook the mixture for about 25 minutes and stir every few minutes.
Once the potatoes are ready drain them, add a touch of milk and butter (or margarine) and mash.
Pour the mixture into an oven dish then add the mashed potatoes on top. Cover all of the lamb mixture.
Bake in the oven at 200°C for about 15–20 minutes and take it out when the potatoes are turning golden.

name: Shikanjvi (Punjabi Spiced Lemonade)
attribution: "Shikanjvi (Punjabi Spiced Lemonade)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Shikanjvi_(Punjabi_Spiced_Lemonade), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Pour the water into a glass.
Add the lemon juice, ginger, sugar, salt and pepper, then shake it vigorously.
Serve cold.

name: Shirred Egg
attribution: "Shirred Egg" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Shirred_Egg, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Butter a shirred egg dish (a small casserole or custard dish).
Put the dish on a low heat to melt the butter, or just add 2–3 tsp cream.
Break an egg in the dish over the cream and season with salt and pepper.
Optionally, sprinkle with shredded cheese and/or bread crumbs.
Bake in the oven at 375°F long enough to set the whites of the eggs. Alternatively, cook by placing the dish directly on low heat.
Serve in the same dish.

name: Shitha
attribution: "Shitha" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Shitha, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tablespoons red chile powder (or fresh red chilies, blended)

steps: Heat the oil in a small pan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté until golden.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they soften.
Add chile powder and salt. Stir well.
Simmer for 10–15 minutes until the mixture thickens.
Add lemon juice or vinegar if desired for extra tanginess.
Let it cool before serving.

name: Shopska Salata (Tomato, Cucumber, and Bell Pepper Salad)
attribution: "Shopska Salata (Tomato, Cucumber, and Bell Pepper Salad)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Shopska_Salata_(Tomato,_Cucumber,_and_Bell_Pepper_Salad), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 roasted peppers or fresh green bell peppers
2 spoonfuls chopped red onion or green onion
½ pound (225 g) white cheese (feta; optional)

steps: Cut the tomatoes, cucumbers and peppers in small pieces—cubes if possible.
Mix well with the parsley, onion, salt, and oil.
Serve with white cheese grated on top. Enjoy!

name: Shortbread
attribution: "Shortbread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Shortbread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 380 g (1 ½ cup / 13 ½ oz) all-purpose flour
110 g (½ cup / 4 oz) white granulated sugar
1 table fork (optional, leave out for Iced Shortbread)
1 scone cutter or circular cookie cutter (optional)

steps: Preheat the oven to 140°C (275°F or Gas Mark 1).
Cream the butter with the sugar until light and fluffy.
Sift the flour and salt into the mixture and work into the fat and sugar until completely amalgamated.
Shape the dough into a ball and roll out to about 1.3 cm (½ inch) thick. The dough may need to be chilled for 10–15 minutes for easier handling.
Cut into squares or rectangles and prick the tops with a fork in two parallel lines.
Bake in the oven for 30–40 minutes or until the shortbread is lightly browned.
Leave them on a cooling rack to cool.
Store in a cool place in an airtight container.

name: Shortcrust Pastry
attribution: "Shortcrust Pastry" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Shortcrust_Pastry, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 120 g (1 cup) plain flour, plus extra for dusting

steps: Cream together butter, sugar, and lemon rind in a bowl.
Sift together the plain and potato flours into a mound.
Make a well in the center of the mound and add the creamed mixture.
Knead lightly until the dough is consistent.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and chill for 1 hour before use.

name: Shrimp and Cheese Grits
attribution: "Shrimp and Cheese Grits" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Shrimp_and_Cheese_Grits, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ large sweet onion, cut into thin strips
½ yellow bell pepper, cut into strips
½ red bell pepper, cut into strips
¼–½ teaspoon hot sauce, or to taste (optional)

steps: Fry bacon until crisp, remove and set aside.
Sauté onions, garlic, and peppers in bacon grease, add lime juice and hot sauce and set aside.
Prepare grits per the directions on box. Add cheese and butter when done cooking to allow for them to melt, then set aside.
Stir when done melting.
Sauté the shrimp until they turn pink, about 2–3 minutes.
Place the grits and cheese in large serving container and place the shrimp down the center of the container.

name: Shrimp and Sea Bass Ceviche
attribution: "Shrimp and Sea Bass Ceviche" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Shrimp_and_Sea_Bass_Ceviche, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pound (450 g) shrimp (16/20 per pound), peeled and cleaned
2 pounds (900 g) meaty white fish, such as sea bass, boned and cut into large dice
¼ Habañero or Scotch bonnet pepper, seeded and minced
2 ears of corn, grilled with husk on

steps: Boil salted water. Have ice water ready on the side. Poach shrimp for just 30 seconds in the hot water, then cool in ice water and drain.
Combine shrimp with fish, then toss with onion, ginger, garlic, hot pepper, celery, salt, and black pepper. Allow to cool in the refrigerator at least 30 minutes and up to 2 hours.
Add lemon and lime juices and refrigerate 1 additional hour. Finish with cilantro and corn.
Check seasoning and serve.

name: Shrimp Curry
attribution: "Shrimp Curry" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Shrimp_Curry, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pound peeled, deveined jumbo shrimp, heads removed

steps: Heat oil in a large stainless steel sauté pan over medium high heat. Add shrimp and sauté just until bright pink. Remove and keep warm.
Melt ghee in same pan. Add vegetables and sauté until browned around edges.
Add remaining ingredients and shrimp and toss to coat. Reduce heat to medium low and cook until shrimp are heated through.
Remove and serve.

name: Shrimp Fritters (Accra)
attribution: "Shrimp Fritters (Accra)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Shrimp_Fritters_(Accra), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup (60 ml) green pepper, chopped
1 Scotch bonnet or other hot pepper, minced

steps: Combine green pepper, spring onions, onions, and scotch bonnet in a bowl.
Add remaining ingredients except water, and mix thoroughly.
Stir in enough water to make a soft mixture using a spoon. Beat mixture until is smooth.
Using a pan or deep fryer, drop spoonfuls in to hot oil, and fry until all sides are brown.

name: Shrimp Scampi Angel Hair Pasta with Lemon and Pine Nuts
attribution: "Shrimp Scampi Angel Hair Pasta with Lemon and Pine Nuts" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Shrimp_Scampi_Angel_Hair_Pasta_with_Lemon_and_Pine_Nuts, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 package (12 ounces) shrimp scampi, garlic and butter flavor
½ cup fresh flat-leaf parsley leaves, roughly chopped
Finely grated zest and juice of 1 lemon
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps: Boil large pot of cold water and salt it generously.
Add the pasta and cook, stirring occasionally until al dente, 4–5 minutes.
Drain the pasta reserving about 1 cup of the cooking water.
Prepare the shrimp in a large skillet according to package directions.
Stir the lemon zest and juice into the shrimp.
Add the pasta, reserved pasta water, parsley and pine nuts, and toss in the skillet to coat the pasta evenly.
Divide shrimp and pasta among warm pasta bowls and serve.

name: Silog
attribution: "Silog" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Silog, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 fried chicken egg (sunny side-up or beaten)
Add-ons of your choice, such as:

steps: Place the fried rice and the egg on your plate.
Arrange your desired add-ons around the rice.
Serve with any desired condiments, such as spicy vinegar.

name: Simmering Tofu Stir-fry
attribution: "Simmering Tofu Stir-fry" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Simmering_Tofu_Stir-fry, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Mixture of preferred vegetables (suggested combination: onion, green pepper, tomato)
Preferred seasonings (suggested seasonings: pepper, hot sauce, salt)

steps: Slice tofu into manageable slices (no more than ¼ inch thick).
Slice all vegetables and apple.
Simmer tofu and vegetable in a light mixture of olive oil and soy sauce on medium high heat.
Cook until tofu is golden brown and vegetables have thoroughly soaked up juices.
Serve with a side of rice or couscous and season.

name: Simple Ayurvedic Sprout Salad
attribution: "Simple Ayurvedic Sprout Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Simple_Ayurvedic_Sprout_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup fresh mung bean sprouts (sprout your own and use them when the sprouts are about ½ inch long)
½ cup peeled, deseeded, diced cucumber

steps: Combine the veggies and sprouts in a glass bowl.
Whisk together the salt, pepper, lemon juice, and olive oil in a separate bowl. Add to the salad and toss well to mix.
Garnish with the cilantro and sunflower seeds, and serve at room temperature or cool.

name: Simple Biryani
attribution: "Simple Biryani" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Simple_Biryani, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 300 g basmati rice, soaked in warm water for 30 minutes

steps: Wash the rice with cold water until it runs clear.
Cook the onion, cardamom pods, bay leaves, and cinnamon in the butter for 10 minutes.
Add the chicken, turmeric, and curry paste, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the rice and raisins and then the chicken stock.
Cover the pan tightly and bring to the boil.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for 5 minutes.
Remove from the heat and rest for 10 minutes, allowing the rice to absorb any remaining moisture.
Stir in half the coriander and serve with the rest sprinkled over the top.

name: Simple Buttercream
attribution: "Simple Buttercream" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Simple_Buttercream, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cream together butter and vanilla using a mixer.
Beat in powdered sugar one cup at a time, scraping sides and bottom of bowl regularly. Mixture will be very dry.
When all the sugar is incorporated, add milk and beat until incorporated.

name: Simple Chicken Salad
attribution: "Simple Chicken Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Simple_Chicken_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Toss together all ingredients until well-combined.
Serve cool or at room temperature.

name: Simple Chocolate Cheese Pie
attribution: "Simple Chocolate Cheese Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Simple_Chocolate_Cheese_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup (60 ml) unsweetened cocoa powder

steps: Melt the cream cheese, and cool slightly. Transfer to a mixing bowl.
Mix in the cocoa powder and powdered sugar.
Fold in the whipped topping.
Pour mixture into the into ready-made crust
Cover and place in a refrigerator/freezer. Remove when solid.
Serve.

name: Simple Italian Sausage Spaghetti Dinner
attribution: "Simple Italian Sausage Spaghetti Dinner" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Simple_Italian_Sausage_Spaghetti_Dinner, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ pound mild or hot Italian sausage
½ cups red or dry white wine

steps: Prepare pasta according to package directions.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a 4½-quart saucepan or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Peel and finely chop onion, adding to pan as you chop.
Remove casings from sausage, if necessary, and crumble sausage into the pan. Stir and cook, breaking up the sausage, until the sausage is cooked through and the onion is tender, about 5 minutes.
Add wine to pan and stir to loosen any brown bits on the bottom of the pan.
Add canned tomatoes and their juice, tomato paste, garlic, sugar and Italian seasoning.
Stir to combine, then reduce heat to medium-low.
Stir in Parmesan cheese, and cook until pasta is ready.
Serve the sauce with the cooked pasta.

name: Simple Nachos
attribution: "Simple Nachos" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Simple_Nachos, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pound (450 g) lean ground beef (92% lean or greater)
1 can diced tomatoes with green chiles
2 teaspoons or less taco seasoning mix (mostly cumin)

steps: In a skillet, brown ground beef with Mexican seasoning and Taco Mix.
When beef is browned add the can of diced tomatoes with green chiles, cover and allow to simmer an additional 5 minutes.
Put tortilla chips on a large plate. Place 2 tablespoons of sour cream on plate. Sprinkle beef and diced tomato mixture over top of the chips.
Serve and enjoy.

name: Simple Restaurant Miso Soup
attribution: "Simple Restaurant Miso Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Simple_Restaurant_Miso_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: A few 1 cm cubes of medium-firm tofu
1 tablespoon (about 15 ml) miso paste (either white, red, or a mixture)

steps: Heat the dashi to a light simmer.
While this is heating, lay out your bowl and place the wakame and tofu in the bottom.
When the dashi simmers, take a ladle or so of liquid aside and mix it with the miso paste.
Remove the pot of dashi from the stove and stir in the miso mixture.
Ladle the prepared soup into the bowl and serve.

name: Simple Roasted Oysters
attribution: "Simple Roasted Oysters" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Simple_Roasted_Oysters, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Rinse the oysters in a colander and drain well.
Put the live oysters in the shell in a large sauté pan on medium-high heat and leave them till their shells open a little.
Take them off the heat, open them on a plate, and season with salt and pepper.

name: Simple Spaghetti
attribution: "Simple Spaghetti" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Simple_Spaghetti, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2.5 cups (24 oz) pasta sauce (optional but recommended)

steps: On a stovetop, bring the water to a boil on high heat after adding salt and vegetable oil (see tips below).
Reduce heat to medium and add the pasta.
While the spaghetti is cooking, pour desired amount of sauce into pan and set stove to medium.

Set a timer for 7 minutes. When the timer goes off, fish out a strand of spaghetti and bite into it. What you're going for here is al dente, meaning that the pasta is just soft enough to eat: no longer crunchy in the middle, and not mushy and over-done. A more traditional (but messy) way to see if the spaghetti is done is to throw some strands onto a wall. If they stick to the wall, then the pasta is ready to eat.
When the sauce begins to bubble, reduce the heat to its lowest setting and cover.
Once the pasta is ready, carefully drain it through a colander into a sink.
Serve sauce over pasta in bowls.

name: Simple Tarragon Quiche
attribution: "Simple Tarragon Quiche" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Simple_Tarragon_Quiche, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¾ cup (180 ml) freshly-grated Swiss cheese

steps: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Place the eggs, cream, tarragon, nutmeg, salt, and pepper in a blender; blend as briefly as possible until they form a homogeneous mixture.
In the pie crust, create alternating layers of the shredded cheese and the mixture from the blender until the crust is full.
Bake the quiche for 35–40 minutes; a toothpick or fork inserted into its middle should come out "clean".
Remove the quiche from the oven, and let it cool for at least 20 minutes before serving.

name: Sinasir (Nigerian Rice Pancake)
attribution: "Sinasir (Nigerian Rice Pancake)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sinasir_(Nigerian_Rice_Pancake), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Place the rice in a bowl, and cover it with about 1 inch of water. Soak for several hours.
Blend the soaked and parboiled rice in a blender until you get a smooth batter, adding water as necessary.
Transfer the batter to a bowl, then mix in the yeast and sugar. Cover and let ferment at room temperature for a few hours.
Mix in onion, salt, and baking powder.
Heat a non-stick frying pan, and grease with a thin layer of oil.
Scoop in enough batter to make a thin layer in the pan. Cook until the bottom is browned and the pancake is cooked through.
Remove the pancake, and repeat the greasing and cooking process with the remaining batter.

name: Sindhi Fried Potatoes
attribution: "Sindhi Fried Potatoes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sindhi_Fried_Potatoes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat enough oil in a pot for deep frying.
Add the potatoes and deep fry until golden brown.
Remove potatoes from the oil, and place on paper towels to drain.
Transfer potatoes to a serving plate. Sprinkle with salt, chili powder, coriander, and pepper.
Serve hot.

name: Sindhi Pulao
attribution: "Sindhi Pulao" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sindhi_Pulao, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat some oil in a pot, and add the onions. Fry until dark brown.
Add the chiles, curry leaves, cashews, garam masala, pepper, chili powder, bay leaf, and salt.
Add the rice and enough water to cook the rice. Simmer uncovered until all the water is absorbed.
Serve hot.

name: Sindhi Raitha
attribution: "Sindhi Raitha" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sindhi_Raitha, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients together.
Serve cool.

name: Sindhi Spiced Fish
attribution: "Sindhi Spiced Fish" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sindhi_Spiced_Fish, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Shallow fry the fish on one side, then transfer it to a pan fried-side down.
Combine yogurt, onions, coriander leaves, green chile, coriander powder, cumin powder, salt, and tamarind paste.
Spread the yogurt mixture over the fish. Bake until golden.
Serve with chapatis.

name: Sindhi Spiced Moong Dal
attribution: "Sindhi Spiced Moong Dal" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sindhi_Spiced_Moong_Dal, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Soak the dal in water for 1 hour. Drain.
Combine the dal, chiles, and ginger in a pot. Do not add salt.
Cover the dal with water. Boil in a pressure cooker for at least 3–4 minutes.
Transfer the dal to a bowl. Season with salt, coriander, and pepper.
Sprinkle with chili powder, and drizzle with some oil.

name: Sirene po Shopski (Bulgarian Cheese and Tomatoes)
attribution: "Sirene po Shopski (Bulgarian Cheese and Tomatoes)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sirene_po_Shopski_(Bulgarian_Cheese_and_Tomatoes), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: oregano, parsley or any other dry green spice

steps: Take two small earthware pots with lids ("gyuveche" pots), add a layer of cheese, then a layer of peppers and tomatoes, then more cheese. Season with spices as you layer.
Bake for about 20 minutes or until the cheese is melted.
Break an egg on top of each dish, and cook until the egg is the consistency you like.
Serve with salad and beer. Enjoy!

name: Sirniki (Russian Cheese Fritters)
attribution: "Sirniki (Russian Cheese Fritters)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sirniki_(Russian_Cheese_Fritters), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Sour cream and sugar or jam, confiture.

steps: Mix cottage cheese, eggs, flour, sugar and salt.
Take piece of paste, make round, flat shape and put on warm frying pan with oil or melted butter.
Wait until it becomes gold colour and flip.
When it is brown on both sides you can eat it.

name: Six Layer Casserole
attribution: "Six Layer Casserole" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Six_Layer_Casserole, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 10 oz canned tomato soup (you may also use homemade tomato sauce)

steps: Spread layers of raw vegetables and rice in a 9x9-inch baking dish in the order mentioned above and crumble raw hamburger on the top.
Mix the soup and water and pour over all.
Add salt and pepper on top.
Bake about 1.5–2 hours at 350°F.

name: Sizzling Sisig (Filipino Pork Sauté)
attribution: "Sizzling Sisig (Filipino Pork Sauté)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sizzling_Sisig_(Filipino_Pork_Saut%C3%A9), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ kilo of pig's heart, grilled and minced
½ kilo of pig's lungs, grilled and minced
½ kilo of pig's intestines, grilled and minced
2 tbsp oil from the pork fat
1 cup vinegar (sukang iloko would be good)

steps: Grill pork head to remove hair.
Boil pork head until tender.
Take out all the meat and dice.
In a sauté pan, heat oil and sauté garlic, onion, red pepper, pork meat and liver.
Season with liquid seasoning, black pepper, and brown sugar.
Pour in beef stock and cook until meat is tender and starts to oil again.
Add minced chili pepper last.
Serve on a sizzling plate.

name: Skillet Lasagna
attribution: "Skillet Lasagna" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Skillet_Lasagna, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ⅓ cup (80 ml) Italian salad dressing
10 uncooked lasagne noodles, broken into squares

steps: Boil one clove of garlic in a saucepan of water.
Add noodles and cook until tender.
Meanwhile, brown the ground beef in heavy skillet. Drain grease.
Add pasta sauce, water, dressing, and bell pepper.
Stir until well combined and bell pepper is tender.
Cover and let simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Drain noodles and add to meat. Stir until well combined.
Cover and let stand under low heat for 5 minutes.
Add cheese and stir well, then turn off heat and let cool.

name: Slinger
attribution: "Slinger" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Slinger, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cook the eggs in any manner you wish.
Cook the hamburger patty.
Cook the chili.
Dice the onion.
Place the hashbrowns and patty on a plate then put the eggs upon the patty and top it all with the chili, cheese, and onion

name: Sloppy Joes
attribution: "Sloppy Joes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sloppy_Joes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup chopped green bell pepper (optional)

steps: Brown the ground beef, onions, and peppers in skillet on medium heat.
Drain the liquid from the mixture.
Place the ground beef back on the skillet.
While on medium heat mix in the ketchup, barbecue sauce, garlic powder, and chili powder in any order.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve over sliced, toasted hamburger buns.

name: Slow Cooker Baby Back Ribs
attribution: "Slow Cooker Baby Back Ribs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Slow_Cooker_Baby_Back_Ribs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2½ pounds cut-up baby back pork ribs

steps: Season ribs liberally with rib rub. Refrigerate overnight.
The next day, combine remaining ingredients. Place ribs in the bottom of a slow cooker and pour mixture over.
Cover and cook on low for 8–9 hours, or until ribs are tender. Serve warm.

name: Slow Cooker Soda Bread with Spring Herbs
attribution: "Slow Cooker Soda Bread with Spring Herbs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Slow_Cooker_Soda_Bread_with_Spring_Herbs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup / 20 g / 4% Chives, finely snipped
¼ cup / 20 g / 4% Finely chopped parsley or dill

steps: Line the sides and base of a slow cooker pot with baking parchment.
Combine the flours in a bowl. Rub in the butter until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Stir in the salt, sugar, soda, and herbs.
Make a well in the center of the bowl and add the buttermilk and milk.
Mix to form a soft dough.
Turn the dough onto a floured surface.
Knead briefly, then shape into a round shape to fit the slow cooker pot.
Transfer to the slow cooker pot. Using a sharp, floured knife, score a cross in the top.
Cover the pot with a towel, then cover with the lid.
Cook on high for 2 hours. Check that the bread is soft but set at top and crusty on the bottom and sides. If not, cook for 10 more minutes and check.
Remove the bread from the slow cooker and let it cool for 20 minutes.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Slow-Cooked Chicken in Cream Sauce
attribution: "Slow-Cooked Chicken in Cream Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Slow-Cooked_Chicken_in_Cream_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (10 ounces) condensed cream of chicken soup
1 can (10 ounces) condensed cream of celery soup

steps: Put chicken in crock pot.
Mix together cream of chicken soup and cream of celery soup.
Pour soup mixture over chicken in crock pot.
Cook on high for 4 hours or on low for 8 hours.

name: Smoked Salmon Breakfast Burrito
attribution: "Smoked Salmon Breakfast Burrito" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Smoked_Salmon_Breakfast_Burrito, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup smoked salmon cream cheese spread

steps: In a small bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, lemon juice, and pepper.
In sauté pan over medium heat, add oil to coat the pan, add egg mixture to scramble.
Toast the tortillas in a cast iron skillet over medium heat. Spread cream spread in a circle with 2 inches from the edge of tortilla. Add eggs.
Wrap and enjoy.

name: Smoked Salmon Chowder
attribution: "Smoked Salmon Chowder" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Smoked_Salmon_Chowder, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Place stock pot over medium heat, add oil.
Add carrots, onions, celery, stirring until onions turn clear.
Add tarragon and salmon stock to deglaze bottom of pan.
Stir in smashed potatoes, smoked salmon. Continue to stir and bring to a simmer.
Add milk and pepper.
Serve and enjoy.
