name: Smoked Salmon Dip
attribution: "Smoked Salmon Dip" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Smoked_Salmon_Dip, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: In medium-sized bowl, crumble salmon; add cream cheese, sour cream, lemon juice, and pepper.
Mix until well incorporated or creamy.
Mix in basil and parsley.
Serve and enjoy.

name: Smoked Salmon Ravioli Filling
attribution: "Smoked Salmon Ravioli Filling" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Smoked_Salmon_Ravioli_Filling, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix the salmon, chives, lemon zest and seasonings in a bowl until salmon is well coated.
Mix the ricotta or cottage cheese, egg, and Parmesan cheese.
Add to the salmon and mix until well blended but not homogeneous.
Cover and refrigerate until the dough is ready.

name: Smokehouse Turkey Panini
attribution: "Smokehouse Turkey Panini" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Smokehouse_Turkey_Panini, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Assemble a sandwich with the turkey, bread, bacon, and cheese. Set aside.
Preheat 2-burner grill pan over medium high heat.
Brush both sides of sandwiches with oil then place on grill.
Cook until ingredients are heated through and bread is marked, turning as needed. Serve hot.

name: Smoking Shrimp Creole
attribution: "Smoking Shrimp Creole" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Smoking_Shrimp_Creole, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¾ pound small or medium shrimp, shelled

steps: Heat the oil in a medium skillet over medium-high heat.
Sauté the onion, celery, pepper, and garlic until the onion is translucent, 4–5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, bay leaves, paprika, and chipotle chili.
Simmer the sauce, uncovered, until it is thick, 15–20 minutes, stirring it 2–3 times.
Add the shrimp and cook, uncovered, until they are pink and firm, 5–7 minutes, depending on their size.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

name: Smoky Chipotle Glazed Hot Wings
attribution: "Smoky Chipotle Glazed Hot Wings" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Smoky_Chipotle_Glazed_Hot_Wings, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat oil to 350°F. Fry wings in batches for 12 minutes each batch. Drain on a rack.
Combine remaining ingredients, add wings, and toss to coat. Serve.

name: Smoky Tuna Melts
attribution: "Smoky Tuna Melts" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Smoky_Tuna_Melts, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 container (4.5 oz) hickory smoke-flavored albacore tuna

steps: Combine tuna, melted butter, and lemon juice.
Spread some of the tuna mixture on each slice of bread. Top with cheese.
Broil until the cheese is melted.

name: Snails with Garlic Butter (Escargots à la Bourguignonne)
attribution: "Snails with Garlic Butter (Escargots à la Bourguignonne)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Snails_with_Garlic_Butter_(Escargots_%C3%A0_la_Bourguignonne), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 24 snail shells, with snail serving dishes, and snail tongs OR 4 glazed indented earthenware snail serving dishes OR 24 small mushroom caps, trimmed and de-gilled

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Drain and rinse the snails.
Combine the butter with the shallots, garlic, parsley, salt, and pepper, and blend well.
Sauté the mushroom caps, if using, in a small amount of garlic butter until cooked but still firm. Remove from the heat.

If using snail shells, place a snail in each shell and fill the rest of the space with garlic butter. If using a snail dish without the shells, place a snail in each indentation and fill the rest of the space with garlic butter. If using mushroom caps, place 2–3 snails in each cap and top with a generous amount of garlic butter.
Heat the snails in the oven for 5–7 minutes, and serve with copious quantities of French bread for soaking up the garlic butter.

name: Snappy Ginger Muffins
attribution: "Snappy Ginger Muffins" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Snappy_Ginger_Muffins, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In a mixing bowl, beat the oil and the sugars.
Beat in molasses and egg.
Combine the flour, baking soda, cinnamon, ginger, and salt.
Stir into molasses alternating with water.
Fill greased or paper-lined muffin cups ⅔ full.
Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until a wooden toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 10 minutes before turning out to a wire rack.

name: Snezhanka (Bulgarian Cucumber and Yogurt Salad)
attribution: "Snezhanka (Bulgarian Cucumber and Yogurt Salad)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Snezhanka_(Bulgarian_Cucumber_and_Yogurt_Salad), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 liter of plain yogurt (two regular containers in Bulgaria)
½ kg pickles or cucumbers or mixed
1 tsp seasoned salt (like "Vegeta") or salt (use no salt if you are using salty pickles)

steps: Strain the yogurt, and cut the pickles/cucumbers into tiny cubes.
Mix all the ingredients except for the walnuts.
Sprinkle the walnuts on top of the salad. Enjoy!

name: Snickerdoodles (Boston Globe)
attribution: "Snickerdoodles (Boston Globe)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Snickerdoodles_(Boston_Globe), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cream the butter and sugar together.
Beat in the eggs.
Combine the flour, cream of tartar, and baking soda.
Alternately mix the flour and milk into the batter to make a dough.
Drop dough on a greased or lined baking sheet in spoonfuls.
Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.
Bake in a quick oven.

name: Snickerdoodles (Idaho Daily Statesman)
attribution: "Snickerdoodles (Idaho Daily Statesman)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Snickerdoodles_(Idaho_Daily_Statesman), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Stir together sugar and butter until creamy.
Add eggs.
Dissolve baking soda in milk, then add.
Add flour, cream of tartar and salt.
Beat the batter thoroughly.
Pour in shallow pans.
Dust the top of the cake with cinnamon and sugar.
Bake for 15 minutes.
Cool, then cut in squares.

name: Snickerdoodles I
attribution: "Snickerdoodles I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Snickerdoodles_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 344 g (2 ¾ cups or 24 oz) all-purpose flour
300 g (1 ½ cups or 12 oz) white sugar
205 g (1 cup or 8 oz) soft shortening

steps: Preheat oven to 205°C (400°F or Gas Mark 6).
Combine the flour, salt, baking soda, and cream of tartar.
Cream together the sugar and shortening. Beat in the eggs.
Mix the flour mixture into the batter to make a dough.
Shape dough into little balls, then transfer to a greased or parchment-lined lined baking sheet.
Bake for 10 minutes or until crisp and light brown.
Sprinkle generously with cinnamon while hot.

name: Snickerdoodles II
attribution: "Snickerdoodles II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Snickerdoodles_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 344 g (2 ¾ cups or 24 oz) all-purpose flour
200 g (1 cups or 6 oz) white sugar
100 g (½ cup or 4 oz) soft shortening

steps: Preheat oven to 205°C (400°F or Gas Mark 6).
Mix flour, salt, baking soda, cream of tartar, sugar, shortening, and butter.
Roll into 1 tbsp balls.
Mix sugar and cinnamon.
Roll balls in sugar-cinnamon mixture.
Bake for 10 minutes or until crisp and light brown.
Sprinkle generously with cinnamon while hot.

name: Snickerdoodles III
attribution: "Snickerdoodles III" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Snickerdoodles_III, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 227 g (2 cups or 16 oz) butter, softened (not melted)
220 ml (1 cup or 8 fl oz) vinegar
188 g (1 ½ cups or 12 oz) all-purpose flour

steps: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C or Gas Mark 5)
In a medium mixing bowl, beat butter with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds.
Add the 1 cup sugar, baking soda, cream of tartar, and vinegar. Beat until combined, scraping sides of bowl occasionally.
Beat in egg and vanilla until combined.
Beat in as much of the flour as you can with the mixer. Stir in any remaining flour.
Cover and chill dough for 1–2 hours or until easy to handle.
Combine the 2 tbsp sugar and the cinnamon in a small bowl.
Shape dough into 1-inch (2.5 cm) balls. Roll balls in cinnamon-sugar to coat. Place balls 2 inches (5 cm) apart on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 10–11 minutes or until edges are golden. Transfer to a wire rack and let cool.

name: Snickerdoodles IV
attribution: "Snickerdoodles IV" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Snickerdoodles_IV, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 344 g (2 ¾ cups or 24 oz) all-purpose flour
300 g (1½ cups or 9 oz) superfine sugar

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix flour, salt, baking soda, cream of tartar. Set aside.
Beat butter, shortening and sugar.
Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Gradually add dry ingredients, mixing fully.
Roll into 1 tbsp balls.
Mix sugar and cinnamon.
Roll balls in sugar-cinnamon mixture.
Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Bake for 10 minutes or until crisp and light brown.
Let cool completely before eating.
Snickerdoodles (Boston Globe)
Snickerdoodles (Idaho Daily Statesman)
Snickerdoodles (Alternate 1)
Snickerdoodles (Alternate 2)
Snickerdoodles (Alternate 3)

name: Socca (Italian Chickpea Flatbread)
attribution: "Socca (Italian Chickpea Flatbread)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Socca_(Italian_Chickpea_Flatbread), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Black pepper to taste; 2–3 decent grinds of a grinder should do

Something to cook the socca on; traditionally, a 50cm (20 inch) copper plaque is used as it spreads the heat evenly to all parts of the socca, but a good cast iron pan will suffice if preheated in the oven first.

steps: Heat oven as high as it can go—around 300°C / 570°F is traditional, but do whatever your oven can manage that gets close to this. If using a cast-iron pan, get it into the oven at the start so that it is hot when the batter goes into it.
Whisk all the ingredients together well, ensuring there are no lumps. This should make a very thin, easy-to-pour batter.

Once the oven is up to temperature, pour some of the batter into the hot pan or onto the plaque, and put into the oven for 8–9 minutes at 300°C / 570°F, or 13–15 minutes at 250°C / 480°F. With a 50 cm plaque or pan, cook half the batter at a time—the batter should cover the plaque or pan very thinly.
Remove from the oven and cut into triangular wedges. Serve hot.
Repeat for the rest of the batter.

name: Sockerdricka (Swedish Ginger Drink)
attribution: "Sockerdricka (Swedish Ginger Drink)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sockerdricka_(Swedish_Ginger_Drink), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Boil the sugar, water, lemon and crushed ginger for 15 minutes.
Strain the mixture and let it cool.
Mix in the yeast and let the mixture ferment for 2 days.
Put the drink in bottles, and add a raisin to each bottle.
Cork the bottles, and let rest for 5 days. After 5 days the sockerdricka is ready for drinking.

name: Soda Bread
attribution: "Soda Bread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Soda_Bread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Grease and flour an 8-inch (20 cm) round baking tin.
Sift the white flour into a large mixing bowl.
Add the other dry ingredients and mix thoroughly.

Make a well in the centre of the bowl, pour in some of the buttermilk and, with a wooden spoon, gradually mix the flour into the buttermilk. Alternatively, make a volcano shape on a marble slab with the dry ingredients, add the buttermilk, and mix with a knife.

Add more buttermilk and mix in more flour. Continue until the flour is completely absorbed into the mix. The mix should not be over-saturated, but have a slightly stretchy look. Handle it as little as possible. You can also ball it up into one or two balls, place them on a flat baking tray, and cut a cross in the top.
Turn the mix into the baking tin and place in a medium hot oven (180°C or 350°F) for 35–45 minutes, or until golden brown.
Leave to cool on a wire tray.

name: Soda from Extract
attribution: "Soda from Extract" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Soda_from_Extract, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Boil the soda extract, water, and sugar together to make a syrup of about 10 oz (300 ml).
Mix the syrup with the carbonated water to make the finished soda.

name: Soft Boiled Meringues
attribution: "Soft Boiled Meringues" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Soft_Boiled_Meringues, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Whip all the meringue ingredients together to soft peaks.
Boil the water with the milk, then reduce to a simmer.
Drop spoonfuls of the meringue mixture into the simmering liquid. Simmer for about 4 minutes then scoop out and dry on kitchen paper rolls.
Serve with toppings.

name: Soft Spice Cookie
attribution: "Soft Spice Cookie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Soft_Spice_Cookie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: In a large bowl, beat eggs lightly to break the yolks as one would for scrambled eggs, then mix in the shortening. If using butter, soften it slightly beforehand by heating it a little. The shortening/egg mixture should be loose.
Mix in the sugar, then add the salt to the liquid mixture.
Mix in vanilla extract, lemon extract, coffee, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cocoa powder.

Add the baking powder, then slowly add the flour as needed to reach a proper doughy state (in essence, able to be shaped without sticking to one's hands too much). You may not need all of the flour, or you may even need a little more based on your eggs and how closely you measured.
Make balls and place onto a greased or parchment-lined pan.
Top each cookie with a generous amount of cinnamon-sugar.
Bake in a 175°C (350°F) over for between 15-20 minutes.

name: Soft Sugar Cookies
attribution: "Soft Sugar Cookies" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Soft_Sugar_Cookies, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: In a large bowl, beat eggs lightly to break the yolks as one would for scrambled eggs, then mix in the shortening. If using butter, soften it slightly beforehand by heating it a little. The shortening/egg mixture should be loose.
Mix in the sugar, then add the salt to the liquid mixture.

Add the baking powder, then slowly add the flour as needed to reach a proper doughy state (in essence, able to be shaped without sticking to one's hands too much). You may not need all of the flour, or you may even need a little more based on your eggs and how closely you measured.
Make balls and place onto a greased or parchment-lined pan then into an oven heated to 175°C (350°F), and let bake for between 15–20 minutes.

name: Sopaipillas (Latin American Fried Dough)
attribution: "Sopaipillas (Latin American Fried Dough)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sopaipillas_(Latin_American_Fried_Dough), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine ingredients and knead into a round ball.
Cover with a towel and let set for 10–20 minutes.
Break dough into 2–3 inch balls. Roll out each ball so that it is 8–12 inches in diameter. Cut into quarters.
Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown. Turn once.
Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with mixture of sugar and cinnamon.
Serve warm plain or drizzled with honey or strawberry syrup.

name: Soppa ta' l-Armla (Maltese Widow's Soup)
attribution: "Soppa ta' l-Armla (Maltese Widow's Soup)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Soppa_ta'_l-Armla_(Maltese_Widow's_Soup), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Fry the onions in a pan with a small amount of oil until translucent.
Combine the cooked onions, potatoes, courgettes, tomatoes, cauliflower, and peas in a pot.
Season with salt and pepper, and bring to a boil. Simmer until the vegetables are cooked.
In the last few minutes of cooking, add the eggs, ricotta, and cheeselets.

name: Soto Ayam (Indonesian Chicken Noodle Soup)
attribution: "Soto Ayam (Indonesian Chicken Noodle Soup)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Soto_Ayam_(Indonesian_Chicken_Noodle_Soup), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 whole chicken with bones or 1 kg chicken parts with bones
4 potatoes, steamed, peeled, deep fried until golden brown
25 g sohun vermicelli, soaked in hot water for 10 minutes

steps: Grind the ingredients for the spice paste together in a food processor. Stir fry the spice paste over slow fire until fragrant. Remove from the heat.

Make soup by cooking the whole chicken with spice paste, galangal, lime leaves, lemon grass, and bay leaves in a pot for at least 30 minutes until the meat is tender. Use a pressure cooker for faster cooking time and better broth. For a traditional method, bring soup to boil, cover, and turn off heat, then let steep for 30–40 minutes—this makes the meat more tender.
Add a little bit of salt or pepper to taste.
Leave the chicken in a pot until the soup is cool.
Remove the meat from the bones, and slice the meat into tiny bit size using fork and knife, then set aside.
Put back the bones into the soup, add sliced green onion, and bring the soup to the boil right before serving.

name: Soup alla Canavese
attribution: "Soup alla Canavese" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Soup_alla_Canavese, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Blanch the cauliflower, then break into small bunches.
Melt the butter in a pot, then add the chopped onion, carrot, celery, and bacon. Fry until softened.
Add white stock and boil for a few minutes. Strain the stock to remove the solids.
Mix the tomato purée into the stock, then bring to a boil.
Mix in the cauliflower, sage, and parsley. Bring to a boil.
Mix in grated parmesan and pepper.
Serve with additional grated parmesan.

name: Soup with Supplì
attribution: "Soup with Supplì" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Soup_with_Suppl%C3%AC, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Shape the leftover risotto into little balls the size of nuts.
Dip the balls into beaten egg, then roll them in bread crumbs.
Fry the breaded risotto balls in butter, then drain them from the grease.
Serve the risotto balls in hot broth.

name: Sour Cream Chili Sauce
attribution: "Sour Cream Chili Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sour_Cream_Chili_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Stir all ingredients together well.
Put 1 small cup into center of each Onion Bloom for dipping.

name: Sour Cream Dip
attribution: "Sour Cream Dip" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sour_Cream_Dip, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tbsp chopped fresh dill, or 1 tbsp dried and crumbled dill

steps: Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, dill, onion, chives, and parsley.
Season to taste with salt and pepper, then chill.

name: Sour Mix (Vegan)
attribution: "Sour Mix (Vegan)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sour_Mix_(Vegan), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients together.
Store in the fridge until use.

name: Sour Mix (With Egg)
attribution: "Sour Mix (With Egg)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sour_Mix_(With_Egg), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups lemon juice, preferably freshly squeezed

steps: Whisk egg white in a medium-sized bowl until frothy.
Stir in the sugar and water or simple syrup.
Add the lemon juice, and stir all ingredients well.
Store the mix refrigerated, and use within 3 days of making it.

name: South Indian Millet Swallow (Mudde)
attribution: "South Indian Millet Swallow (Mudde)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:South_Indian_Millet_Swallow_(Mudde), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Boil the water in a pot, add a little of the flour to make a paste, then add the rest of the flour.
Stir once with the handle of a wooden spoon and leave it in the pot.
Keep on low heat for about 10 minutes until it smells cooked.

Stir until the mixture turns dark reddish-brown. Once it begins to leave the sides of the pot, remove the pot from the fire and stir vigorously for 5–10 minutes—it's hard work, but the longer you keep at it, the lighter it will be.
Pull the mixture out and form into balls of about fist size.

name: South Texan Pinto Beans
attribution: "South Texan Pinto Beans" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:South_Texan_Pinto_Beans, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 ½ tbsp paprika OR ½ tsp each of paprika and pepper
1 ½ tbsp granulated or brown sugar
1 tbsp salt OR 2 tsp salt and a ham hock
1 ½ tbsp dehydrated onion OR ½ small onion, finely diced

steps: Wash beans carefully and soak overnight in 8 cups of water.
Drain and refill with 5 cups of water.
Add all the other ingredients.
Bring to a boil and simmer at least an hour, or until tender.
Remove bay leaves.
Do not drain prior to serving, as the liquid is an important aspect of the dish. It can be served using slotted spoon, to allow draining, or with a ladle into small side-dish bowls.

name: Southern Clam Chowder
attribution: "Southern Clam Chowder" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Southern_Clam_Chowder, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Remove black parts from clams, saving the liquor.
Cut pork into small pieces and fry until crisp and golden brown, then remove small pieces of pork from the fat. Discard fat.
Add potatoes and onion, with just enough hot water to be seen through the potatoes.
Cook over low heat-just simmer-until done.
When potatoes are done, add clams and pork and cook for 2 minutes after coming to a boil. Longer cooking will make the clams tough.
Remove chowder from heat and let stand for few minutes, then add hot milk, the clam liquor and seasoning to taste. If seasonings are added before hot milk, the chowder may curdle.
Serve hot. May add butter to each bowl for extra taste.

name: Southern Style Greens
attribution: "Southern Style Greens" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Southern_Style_Greens, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 pounds assorted dark leafy greens, such as mustard, collard, and rainbow chard
8 rashers bacon, cut into about ½-inch pieces

steps: Cook bacon to slightly less than done in a large stainless steel pot. Drain.
If desired, pour 1 tbsp bacon fat back into pot. Add greens, and sauté over medium-high heat for 7 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients and lower heat to medium low. Cook for 45 minutes. Defat if needed.
Serve warm, with a vinegar-based, clear hot sauce to accompany.

name: Southwest Pasta
attribution: "Southwest Pasta" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Southwest_Pasta, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (15 oz) sweet corn kernels, drained
1 can (14.5 oz) peeled and diced tomatoes with juice
¼ cup sliced black olives, drained

steps: In a large pot bring 1 quart of lightly-salted water to a boil.
Add pasta and cook for 8–10 minutes until pasta is al dente; drain water.
While pasta is cooking, heat olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Cook onions and bell pepper in oil until lightly browned, about 10 minutes.
Stir in corn, beans, tomatoes, salsa, olives, taco seasoning, salt and pepper. Cook until thoroughly heated, about 5 minutes.
Toss heated vegetables into pasta, mix well and serve.
Serve warm or cold.

name: Southwestern Black Beans and Rice
attribution: "Southwestern Black Beans and Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Southwestern_Black_Beans_and_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 10 ounce can tomatoes and green chiles

steps: In medium saucepan, combine beans, tomatoes and green chiles mix, and cumin.
Heat through.
Serve over hot rice.

name: Southwestern Dip
attribution: "Southwestern Dip" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Southwestern_Dip, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 chipotle chiles in adobo, finely minced

steps: In your dipping bowl, whisk together all ingredients.
Serve with tortilla chips or other snacks.

name: Southwestern Scramble
attribution: "Southwestern Scramble" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Southwestern_Scramble, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Butter, margarine, or cooking spray, for frying pan
1 medium green chile pepper, such as jalapeño, seeded and chopped
1 green bell pepper, seeded and sliced
Serve with hot sauce, such as Tabasco sauce

steps: Crack the eggs into a large mixing bowl, add the milk, and beat until well combined.
Place a large frying pan over medium heat, add the butter, margarine, or cooking spray, and allow to melt. Add the onions, chili, and bell pepper, and sauté for 2–4 minutes.
Add the eggs to the pan, and allow to cook for 30 seconds to 1 minute, until they just begin to set.
Turn the heat up to high, and begin scrambling the eggs by scraping the bottom of the pan with a spatula and folding the cooked egg into the egg mixture.
When the eggs are still moist, but mostly cooked, remove from the fire and plate.
Serve while still hot.

name: Soy Sauce Chicken
attribution: "Soy Sauce Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Soy_Sauce_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Fry the chicken parts in a pan with green onions and oil until the outside of the chicken parts are brown.
Add soy sauce, cooking wine, chopped ginger, and sugar. Add enough water to cover the chicken.
Simmer, uncovered, over low heat until most of the liquid has evaporated.

name: Soy-Lentil-Vegetable Stew
attribution: "Soy-Lentil-Vegetable Stew" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Soy-Lentil-Vegetable_Stew, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat a pot large enough to safely contain all the ingredients over medium heat.
Add the oil, then the onion and garlic. Cook, stirring, for a couple minutes until translucent.
Stir in the soy chunks, lentils, broccoli, and peanuts.
Season to taste with pepper, turmeric, chile flakes, caraway, and ginger—you can be generous. Mix well.
Add enough boiling water to cover all the ingredients—it should be about ½ liter.
Simmer the mixture until the lentils are soft (usually 5–8 minutes).
Serve.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
attribution: "Spaghetti Aglio e Olio" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spaghetti_Aglio_e_Olio, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Boil spaghetti in sufficiently salted water until al dente.
Peel cloves of garlic and crush them gently with the heel of hand.
Heat 2–3 mm olive oil in a pan. Add garlic, and cook until it takes on a golden color. Take care not to let the garlic get too dark, as it will become bitter.
Remove garlic from the oil.
Drain the finished spaghetti and add to the pan with olive oil.
Spice with pepper, mix everything, and serve with parsley.

name: Spaghetti alla Carbonara
attribution: "Spaghetti alla Carbonara" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spaghetti_alla_Carbonara, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 178 ml (¾ cup) grated Pecorino Romano cheese

steps: Dice the guanciale or pancetta into 2.5 cm (1-inch) pieces.
Bring a big pot of water to a boil and add salt to taste when it begins to simmer.
Cook the spaghetti until it is al dente and drain it, reserving 1 cup of water.

While spaghetti is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over a medium-high heat. When the oil is hot, add the pancetta and cook for about 10 minutes over a low flame until the pancetta has rendered most of its fat but is still chewy and barely browned.
In a bowl, slowly whisk about ½ cup of the pasta water into the egg yolks. Add the grated cheese and mix thoroughly with a fork.
Strain the spaghetti and transfer it immediately to the skillet with the pancetta. Toss it and turn off the heat.
Add the egg and cheese mixture to the pasta while stirring in the remaining pasta water to help thin the sauce and create an emulsion.
Add the pepper and toss all the ingredients to coat the pasta.

name: Spaghetti alla Puttanesca
attribution: "Spaghetti alla Puttanesca" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spaghetti_alla_Puttanesca, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 115 grams (4 ounces) unsalted anchovy fillets, crushed into a paste (omit anchovies for Neapolitan version)
200 grams (7 ounces) black olives, pitted and chopped
2 tablespoons salted capers, washed well and coarsely chopped
900 grams (roughly 2 pounds) plum tomatoes, peeled and puréed

steps: Put the olive oil, garlic, and anchovy paste in a skillet over medium heat.
Before the garlic browns, add the olives, capers, tomato sauce, and chile peppers.
Add 2–3 pinches of salt, mixing over high heat. Then lower the heat and allow to simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in salted water (at least 4 quarts of water per pound of spaghetti being cooked). Strain it when it's al dente.
Place pasta in a large serving bowl, and coat it with sauce. Then, sprinkle it with chopped parsley.
Mix and serve hot.

name: Spaghetti and Meatballs
attribution: "Spaghetti and Meatballs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spaghetti_and_Meatballs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup (240 ml) grated Parmesan cheese or Romano cheese
¾ cup (180 ml) fresh parsley, minced
½ tsp crushed red pepper flakes
10 leaves fresh basil, torn or thinly sliced

steps: Fill your largest pot with 1½ gallons of water along with 3 tablespoons of salt. Place it over high heat on the stove.

Combine ground meat, bread crumbs, grated cheese, minced parsley and lightly beaten eggs (add eggs one at a time while stirring ingredients together). Sprinkle with minced garlic, 2 tablespoons of olive oil and seasonings. Then mix well until everything is combined.

Form meat mixture into meatballs, using an ice cream scoop or your hands, pressing lightly, just enough so that meat holds together, but not so much that the meat is very compressed or the meatballs will be tough and dry.

In a heavy skillet, heat olive oil over medium low heat. Add whole garlic cloves. Turn the garlic cloves to color them on all sides, then when lightly browned, press them into the oil; as they brown, remove them.

As soon as the oil is hot, add the meatballs to the skillet, leaving about 1½ inches between them so that they can be easily turned. Turn them often using a spatula or large spoon so that they don't stick. Make sure there is enough oil in the pan (about ½ inch). You don't need extra virgin olive oil for this—any good quality Italian olive oil will do.
When the meatballs are browned well on all sides, remove from the pan and drain on paper towels. Then add the next batch to the pan and continue until all are cooked.
Add the pasta to the water now boiling in your pot and cook until al dente. This should take about 12 minutes.

Add pepper flakes, garlic and finely chopped onion in the same oil you used to cook the meatballs. Sauté 5–7 minutes, until onion bits are soft. Add beef stock, crushed tomatoes, and herbs. Bring to a simmer and cook for about 10 minutes.
Toss hot, drained pasta with a few ladles of the sauce. Turn meatballs in remaining sauce.
Place pasta on dinner plates. Top with meatballs, sauce and extra grated cheese.

name: Spaghetti Bake
attribution: "Spaghetti Bake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spaghetti_Bake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pound (450 g) ground turkey or beef
1 box (16 oz . 500 g) of spaghetti noodles

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Sauté ground meat with onion. When cooked through, mix in spaghetti sauce and seasoning.
Combine cream cheese, cottage cheese, and sour cream; mix well.
Cook spaghetti noodles according to package directions.
Spray 3-quart baking dish with cooking spray.
Layer half the spaghetti noodles on the bottom of the dish.
Spoon cheese mixture on top of noodles.
Layer remaining noodles on top of cheese mixture.
Spread meat mixture on top of second noodle layer.
Mix bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese and sprinkle on top.
Bake 30 minutes until bubbly and heated through.

name: Spaghetti Pie
attribution: "Spaghetti Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spaghetti_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tablespoons butter, plus extra for greasing
1 cup (125 g / 4.5 oz) grated parmesan cheese
1½ cups (180 g / 6.5 oz) grated mozzarella cheese

steps: Preheat the oven to 175°C (347°F). Grease a ovenproof dish.
Break the spaghetti into 5 cm (2-inch) pieces.
Boil the spaghetti in water until al dente.
Drain the pasta in a colander and put in a bowl.
Add 1 egg, half of the breadcrumbs, and the parmesan cheese to the pasta, and mix until combined.
Pour the pasta mixture into the dish and sprinkle with remaining breadcrumbs.
Bake for 20 minutes until the top is lightly browned.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the beef and cook, breaking up into pieces, for 7 minutes until browned.
Remove the fat from the pan.
Add the tomatoes and tomato paste to the beef mixture and stir in.
Add the basil and let it simmer over a low heat while you make the topping.
Beat together the ricotta, egg and oregano in a bowl until combined.
Take the pasta out of the oven and pour the ricotta mixture onto the pasta.
Pour the bolognese sauce on top and sprinkle with mozzarella cheese.
Bake for 25 minutes until the top is browned.
Slice into 8 pieces and serve.

name: Spaghetti Sauce
attribution: "Spaghetti Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spaghetti_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 29 ounces (922 g) plain canned tomato puree or ground tomatoes
Cooked ground beef or bits of steak (optional, may be added at the table)

steps: For more efficient use of the herbs, you should grind them well with the salt. The salt helps to grind the herbs. If you skip this step, increase the amount of herbs. Also double the herbs if you prefer.
Mix everything in a pot.
Bring to a boil while stirring to prevent the sauce from burning to the bottom of the pan.
Immediately remove from the heat and serve. Hot tomato products lose tomato flavor, so don't delay.

name: Spaghetti with Bolognese Meat Sauce
attribution: "Spaghetti with Bolognese Meat Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spaghetti_with_Bolognese_Meat_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ lb (125 g) ham or bacon, cut into cubes
1 lb (450 g) beef lean or medium ground
¼ cup (50 ml) coarsely chopped celery
¼ cup (50 ml) coarsely chopped carrot
¼ cup (50 ml) coarsely chopped fennel bulb, if available
2 cups (500 ml) beef stock (preferably fresh, but canned beef stock will do)
1 lb (450 g) spaghetti pasta, preferably made from durum wheat
1 cup Parmesan cheese for garnish, preferably freshly grated Reggiano Parmesan

steps: Mix the coarsely chopped onion, carrot, celery and fennel (optional) together and finely chop them (this is called a battuto in Italian, or a finely chopped mixture of vegetables and herbs to flavour a dish).
Cut the ham or bacon into little cubes and sauté in a heavy saucepan.
Add the butter and allow it to melt. Then, add the battuto.
Cook, stirring occasionally until very lightly browned. Add this mixture to a heavy pot.
Heat the olive oil in the skillet the battuto was browned in and when the oil is hot, add the beef and stir to break up lumps, cooking until well browned.
Add to the battuto in the pot.
Add the wine to the skillet the beef was in and stir on high heat, scraping any brown bits stuck to the pan.
Add the tomato paste and stock and stir until well mixed and add this mixture to the pot.
Drain and coarsely chop the plum tomatoes and add them to the pot.
Add the bay leaf and lemon rind. Bring the pot to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer, with bubbles barely breaking the surface.
Simmer, stirring occasionally for an hour (or more), until thick.
Add pepper and salt to taste.
When the sauce is ready, bring a gallon (4 litres) of water to a full boil over high heat in a large pot

Add the pasta, give it a brisk stir to ensure it is all covered by water and not clumped together. Cook for about 10–12 minutes, or until al dente (firm but not hard, there should still be a bit of 'bite' when chewing pasta, rather than soggy and mushy).
Drain the pasta well and serve immediately.
Remove the bay leaf and lemon rind, then spoon the Bolognese sauce over the pasta and have guests garnish with the grated Parmesan cheese.

name: Spaghetti with Clams
attribution: "Spaghetti with Clams" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spaghetti_with_Clams, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 225 g (8 oz) diced plum tomatoes (see notes)
225 g (8 oz) canned, shelled clams, thoroughly rinsed (optional)
Peperoncino or, less commonly, black pepper to taste

steps: Boil the water in a large pot with a tablespoon of salt.
Add the spaghetti once the water starts boiling. Cook until the pasta is al dente. This should take 7–8 minutes.
Pour olive oil into a large, wide pan so that it barely covers the bottom and heat the oil.
Add the garlic, along with the peperoncino, and sauté until golden brown. This should take about a minute. Be careful not to burn the garlic.
Add the live clams and diced tomatoes.
Put the lid on the pan and cook for about eight minutes. Shake the pan every minute or so to help the clams open. Throw out those that don't.
Drain the spaghetti and put it in the pan with the live clams and tomatoes. Reduce the heat to low.
Add the canned clams and clam broth to the pan.
Season with salt (and pepper, if the peperoncino is not used) to taste and toss until the pasta is well coated with tomatoes and oil. Add another tablespoon of olive oil if you like.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve hot.

name: Spaghetti with Clams in White Wine Sauce
attribution: "Spaghetti with Clams in White Wine Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spaghetti_with_Clams_in_White_Wine_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 8 oz clams or carpet clams as they are sometimes known
1 large pinch of red pepper flakes
Zest or the juice of 1 lemon
Spaghetti, enough for the number of people to be served

steps: Put a large saucepan of water on the heat, and bring to a rolling boil. Add the spaghetti, keeping an eye on the cooking time to ensure that the spaghetti does not overcook.
Put the clams into a separate small saucepan with the white wine and poach gently for about 2 minutes. Take off the heat and set aside.
Pour a generous quantity of olive oil into a small frying pan, and heat up.
Add the garlic cloves, chillies, chopped parsley, and the lemon zest.
Heat everything for about 3 minutes.
Now add about ½ of the white wine the clams were cooked in.
Continue to heat for a few minutes on a high heat to induce a slight reduction.
Add the cooked clams to the sauce and turn the heat off completely.
Once the pasta is cooked drain it through a sieve or colander and return to the saucepan.
Add the salted butter to the pasta and mix through thoroughly. This will induce the sauce to thicken a little.
Add the cooked clams to the sauce and the pasta.
Mix up thoroughly ensuring you do not damage the clams.
Serve in a high-sided bowl, ensuring that each guest gets their fair share of clams.

name: Spaghetti with Meat Sauce (Naporitan)
attribution: "Spaghetti with Meat Sauce (Naporitan)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spaghetti_with_Meat_Sauce_(Naporitan), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ lb (110 g) sausage or ham, sliced

steps: Put about 8 cups of water in a large pot, and add 2 tbsp salt. Bring to a boil on high heat and cook spaghetti according to package directions.
Meanwhile, heat vegetable oil in a large skillet and stir-fry onion, bell pepper, and sausage on medium heat until softened. Season with salt and pepper.
Add drained spaghetti in the skillet and stir-fry with other ingredients.
Add ketchup and stir-fry the spaghetti. Mix in butter and stop the heat.

name: Spanakopita
attribution: "Spanakopita" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spanakopita, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 900 g (2 lbs) fresh spinach or 580 g (20 oz) frozen, thawed, and drained spinach
¾ cup small curd cottage cheese
¼ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese

steps: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F).

Wash the spinach, remove large stems, and chop. Place in a steamer over boiling water and steam for 2 minutes, or until wilted and reduced in volume. Drain, pressing out any liquid with the back of a spoon.
Heat the oil in a large skillet. Add onion and cook over medium heat until slightly tender. Add scallions and cook until limp. Remove from heat. Stir in parsley, dill, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Add the cheeses, spinach, and lemon juice to the skillet. Mix. Add eggs and mix again gently.

Brush a 9x12-inch baking dish with some of the butter. Lay a sheet of phyllo dough across the bottom of the dish, covering the entire surface and letting the edges fold upward against the sides. Brush with butter, and place another sheet on top. Continue layering the phyllo (brushing each sheet) until the bottom of the dish is covered with about 8 sheets.
Place half of the spinach filling on top of the phyllo, smoothing out with a rubber spatula until evenly distributed.
Cover the filling with 5–8 phyllo sheets, brushing each layer with butter. Place remaining spinach filling on top and smooth as above.
Cover with 5–8 phyllo sheets, brushing with butter as above. Roll up all overhanging phyllo sheets and crumble any broken sheet bits on top. Drizzle any remaining clarified butter over top.
Place the spanakopita in the oven on a medium rack. Bake for 45 minutes, or until puffed and golden. Let sit for 10 minutes before cutting and serving.

name: Spanish Potato Omelette
attribution: "Spanish Potato Omelette" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spanish_Potato_Omelette, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Peel the potatoes, wash them, and dry them with a cloth. Cut them into 1 cm cubes or 2 mm slices. Wash and dry them again. Add some salt to your taste and mix them.
Heat the oil; when hot, fry the potatoes, but do not let them get brown. Once they're done, drain the oil and store the potatoes.
Dice or slice the onion; fry it until it is translucent.
Beat the 8 eggs in a bowl with a small amount of salt until the mix is homogenous. Then, mix in the potatoes and the onion.
Heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil in an empty pan – you can use the previous pan after removing most of the oil.
Once the pan is hot, add the egg with the onion and the potatoes.

After 7–8 minutes, the bottom part should be done. Put the dish over the pan and carefully turn it around so that the undone part rests on the dish. This is the most difficult step of the recipe. After that, put the pan on the fire again and slowly slide the mix into the pan to cook the other side.
After a couple of additional minutes, it should be done and ready to serve.

name: Spanish Rice
attribution: "Spanish Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spanish_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup fresh cilantro, finely chopped (optional)
½ cup shredded cooked chicken or pork
¼ cup minced chorizo, casing removed

steps: Melt butter in a large pot over medium high heat. Add onion, chiles, garlic, meats, and rice, and cook until chorizo and rice are golden brown.
Add broth and bay leaves. Bring to a boil and cook until liquid has evaporated and rice is tender.
Sprinkle with cilantro before serving, if desired.

name: Sparkling Lemonade with Fresh Herbs
attribution: "Sparkling Lemonade with Fresh Herbs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sparkling_Lemonade_with_Fresh_Herbs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: A few leaves of fresh mint and/or lemon balm (Melissa officinalis)

steps: Juice the lemons, and dissolve the sugar in the juice.
Add carbonated water and the fresh herb leaves.
Serve cold.

name: Spelt Bread
attribution: "Spelt Bread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spelt_Bread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine the flour, salt, sugar and yeast.
To the dry ingredients, add the oil and enough water to make a firm dough.
Knead the dough for about 10 minutes.
Place in a greased 1 kg loaf tin, cover and leave it in a warm place until doubled in size.
Uncover and bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for about 35 minutes. The bread is cooked when it makes a hollow sound when tapped on the bottom.

name: Spelt Burger
attribution: "Spelt Burger" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spelt_Burger, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Grind the spelt coarsely (if you have entire corns).
Soak the spelt with oat flakes in some water, in order to get a viscous substance. The burgers will be more compact if you add more oat flakes.
Cut onions and leek in small pieces.
Fry onions and leek with some oil.
Mix the substance with onions, leek and spices of your choice (cumin is a good choice).
Form flat burgers in a hot, oiled pan.

name: Spelt Yellow Cake
attribution: "Spelt Yellow Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spelt_Yellow_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F).
Cream the butter and sugar together until fluffy.
Beat in the eggs.
Mix in vanilla.
Gradually sift in the dry ingredients, alternating with small additions of the milk.
Transfer to a greased and floured baking pan.
Bake at 175°C (350°F), until a skewer inserted shows no moist crumbs; approximately 30 minutes.

name: Spice Rub
attribution: "Spice Rub" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spice_Rub, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients in an airtight container.
Stored in a cool, dark place this will last for a long time.

name: Spice Rub for Chicken
attribution: "Spice Rub for Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spice_Rub_for_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix together spices in a bowl.
Rub on chicken, inside and outside.
Let stand for a few minutes before cooking per your usual directions.

name: Spice Rubbed Grilled Chicken Breast
attribution: "Spice Rubbed Grilled Chicken Breast" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spice_Rubbed_Grilled_Chicken_Breast, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine paprikas, salt, pepper, rosemary, cayenne, cinnamon, and lemon peel. Set aside.
Rub mustard all over chicken. Apply seasoning mixture, and press lightly to aid adhesion.
Grill on a preheated charcoal grill, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove and let rest for 3 minutes. Serve.

name: Spiced Flour
attribution: "Spiced Flour" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spiced_Flour, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix together ingredients thoroughly.
Use in preparation of Onion Blooms.

name: Spiced Kefir
attribution: "Spiced Kefir" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spiced_Kefir, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients together.
Stir well and serve.

name: Spiced Oysters
attribution: "Spiced Oysters" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spiced_Oysters, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Strain the oyster liquor through a sieve, and put it in a saucepan.
Add the oysters, spices, salt, and cider vinegar.
Place them over a slow fire, and as soon as they boil remove them from the heat.
Pour the oysters into a large bowl, and let cool.
When cooled, cover and store the oysters.

name: Spiced Pumpkin Soup
attribution: "Spiced Pumpkin Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spiced_Pumpkin_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup peeled and cubed sweet potato
2 cans (28 oz) nonfat and low-sodium chicken broth or vegetable stock

steps: Melt butter in a Dutch oven or large saucepan over medium-high heat. Sauté onion for 3–4 minutes. Add flour, curry, cumin, and nutmeg and sauté for 1 minute.

Add sweet potato, salt, chicken broth, and pumpkin, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, partially covered for about 20–25 minutes or until sweet potatoes are cooked through and softened. Remove from heat and let stand for 10 minutes to cool.
Place half of the pumpkin mixture in a blender and process until smooth. Using a strainer, pour soup back into pan. Repeat with rest of soup.
Raise heat to medium then stir in milk and cook for 5 minutes or until soup is heated through.
Remove from heat and add lime juice.

name: Spicy Black Beans
attribution: "Spicy Black Beans" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Black_Beans, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups canned black beans, rinsed and drained

steps: Heat both oils in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add all remaining ingredients and toss; cook just until heated through.
Serve immediately as a side dish, or cool slightly and serve as a salad.

name: Spicy Carrot Aioli
attribution: "Spicy Carrot Aioli" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Carrot_Aioli, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 100–200 ml orange juice (any other citrus works)
French-style or Dijon mustard (i.e. one that does not contain "turmeric" in the list of ingredients; optional)

steps: Cut carrots extremely fine (i.e. 1 mm slivers) so that blender can handle it.
Combine all ingredients. Use a blender to start blending everything together.
Continue blending in additional olive oil until it reaches desired creaminess.
Adjust seasoning to taste.

name: Spicy Cheddar Dip with Olives
attribution: "Spicy Cheddar Dip with Olives" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Cheddar_Dip_with_Olives, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 8 oz (225 g) sharp cheddar cheese, shredded or diced very small
3 oz (80 g ) black olives, sliced into rings
4 oz (110 g) canned diced green chiles
2 green onions, cut into ¼-inch pieces
2 tbsp garlic powder, or to taste
2 tbsp hot sauce, or to taste

steps: Slice pitas as you would a pizza, into triangles. Separate pita triangles into halves, and place on a cookie sheet, inside surface up.
Toast in oven until golden brown, but not dark and bitter. This results in novel chips used to scoop the dip.
Combine the cheese, mayonnaise, chiles, half the olives, garlic powder, and hot sauce.
Microwave on high until the edges liquefy and bubble, then mix until everything is of the same consistency. Repeat this process until the whole bowl is creamy and a rich orange color.

Garnish the dip with the remaining olives, green onions, and tomatoes. Standard garnishing technique calls for arranging the remaining black olives, green onions, and diced tomatoes into a bulls-eye pattern.
Serve the dip with the pita chips.

name: Spicy Chicken Casserole
attribution: "Spicy Chicken Casserole" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Chicken_Casserole, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (10 oz) condensed cream of chicken soup
1 can (10 oz) condensed cream of celery soup

steps: Mix all ingredients except tortillas and cheese.
Layer the tortillas, chicken mixture, and cheese in baking dish. Make two layers, finishing with cheese.
Bake at 375°F for 30–40 minutes.

name: Spicy Chicken Cutlets
attribution: "Spicy Chicken Cutlets" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Chicken_Cutlets, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 200°F.
Season both sides of each chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Place the flour on a plate and dredge the chicken breasts through it, lightly coating both sides.
Set aside.
In a large skillet heat the oil over a medium-high heat.
Add the breasts and cook 3 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Flip and cook another 2–3 minutes, or until cooked through.
Transfer the chicken to an oven-proof plate and place in the oven to keep warm.
Return the empty skillet to the burner.
Increase the heat to high and add the chicken broth and vodka to deglaze the pan.
As the liquid bubbles, scrape the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon
Add half of the lime juice and the jalapeños and cook 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and bring to a simmer.
In a small glass, add the cornstarch to the water, then add to the skillet.
Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened, about 2 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the heat.
Stir in remaining lime juice.
Arrange each chicken breast on a plate and top with pan sauce.
Garnish with cilantro.

name: Spicy Chickpea Soup
attribution: "Spicy Chickpea Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Chickpea_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Purée all ingredients in a blender until smooth.
Heat in a large saucepan or Dutch oven, and bring to a simmer.
Simmer, stirring often, 4–5 minutes, to blend flavors.

name: Spicy Chickpeas
attribution: "Spicy Chickpeas" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Chickpeas, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Strain chickpeas and dry with a towel.
Heat oil in large skillet. Add chickpeas, and sauté until slightly colored, about 6 minutes.
Add Dijon mustard and stir.
Season with pepper and salt to taste.

name: Spicy Corn Bread
attribution: "Spicy Corn Bread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Corn_Bread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tsp–¼ cup chopped jalapeños, to taste
½ of a 15 ounce can whole corn, drained (optional)

steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Grease an 8-inch baking pan.
Combine corn meal, flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a large mixing bowl.
Add egg, sugar, and shortening.
Beat until fairly smooth (about 1 minute).
Bake for 20–25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. If corn is added to batter, increase time by about 50%
Serve hot!

name: Spicy Crab and Arugula Salad
attribution: "Spicy Crab and Arugula Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Crab_and_Arugula_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Purée lemon, oil, cayenne, parsley, and dill in a blender or food processor until smooth.
Add crab and arugula and toss to coat.
Chill, if desired, before serving.

name: Spicy Crab Cakes
attribution: "Spicy Crab Cakes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Crab_Cakes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tbsp chipotle in adobo sauce, puréed

steps: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl.
Combine all ingredients except for oil, panko, and egg. Shape into 4 equal patties.
Dip into egg then dredge in panko. Fry at 375°F just until heated through and golden brown.
Serve with chipotle remoulade sauce.

name: Spicy Feta Burger
attribution: "Spicy Feta Burger" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Feta_Burger, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix spices into beef, using hands, until well-mixed.
Form 8 small balls of meat, then press into very flat pancake shapes.
Top four with about 2 tbsp crumbled feta cheese, then cover with the other four.
Press together firmly to flatten, then crimp edges tightly to make four burgers. Chill.
Cook as regular burgers in a skillet or on the grill. Handle gently to avoid crumbling.
Serve on toasted white or rye bread with spicy mustard.

name: Spicy Fried Rice
attribution: "Spicy Fried Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Fried_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 50 g red chile, cut into 1 cm pieces

steps: Heat the oil in a non-stick pan, and fry the big onion, garlic, red chilli, ginger, and scallion. Stir for about 30 minutes until fragrant.
Add the basmati rice, chilli powder, light soy sauce, fish sauce, chicken powder, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring, until well-mixed and heated through.
Serve hot.

name: Spicy Garlic Oil
attribution: "Spicy Garlic Oil" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Garlic_Oil, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ gallon flavorless high smoke point oil, such as canola, peanut, safflower, grapeseed, or soybean
8 Thai bird chiles, stemmed and halved

steps: Combine all ingredients in a large stockpot.
Heat over low heat for 1 hour.
Strain, cool, and store in the refrigerator until oil smells off, looks smoky, or tastes rancid.

name: Spicy Grilled Duck Breasts
attribution: "Spicy Grilled Duck Breasts" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Grilled_Duck_Breasts, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Brush duck with olive oil. Season liberally with salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes. Set aside.
Heat a grill to medium-high heat. Add duck breasts and cook, covered, 4–5 minutes. Flip and cook 3–4 more minutes for medium rare.
Remove to a plate and let rest 5 minutes.
Serve warm, sliced on the bias.

name: Spicy Miso Udon
attribution: "Spicy Miso Udon" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Miso_Udon, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 oz katsuobushi (the flavor is mild so you can use more)
1 chopped green bell pepper or jalapeno pepper
½ tbsp honey or to taste

steps: Bring the chicken broth to a boil. Add the katsuobushi flakes, remove from heat, and let rest for 1 minute.
Strain out and discard the katsuobushi flakes, and set the broth aside.
Cook the udon noodles in salted water until al dente. Drain them, rinse with cold water, and set aside.
In a medium-sized soup pot, stir fry sucuk, green pepper, and onion in olive oil.
Add cabbage, paprika powder, and red pepper paste. Stir to combine.
Add reserved broth, and bring to a simmer over low to medium heat; do not let this get too hot because the flavor of the katsuobushi is very delicate.
Add bean sprouts. Continue to simmer until vegetables reach desired texture.
Add cooked noodles, miso, honey, and tabasco. Do not let the soup reach a boil, as too much heat will destroy the soup's rich flavor.
Add enoki and sardines, and simmer just enough to warm through.
Crack an egg or two into the broth, and serve when the the yolk is just firm
Garnish with scallions.

name: Spicy Placenta with Rice Noodles
attribution: "Spicy Placenta with Rice Noodles" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Placenta_with_Rice_Noodles, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 250 grams of fresh human placenta, chopped into fine strips

steps: Fry onion in olive oil until it is translucent.
Add chopped garlic.
Toss in placenta, and cook quickly.
Add a dash of fresh rosemary and the cumin.
Add a pinch of salt and ground pepper to taste.
Serve on a bed of rice noodles, garnished with sliced red pepper and shallot.

name: Spicy Plantain Chips
attribution: "Spicy Plantain Chips" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Plantain_Chips, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 quarts peanut or canola oil for deep-frying

steps: Combine plantains, salt, black pepper, the chile, and garlic. Shape into rounds about the size of a thin slice of potato.
Heat oil to 375°F. Add rounds, 6–8 at a time, and fry until golden brown and crispy on the outside.
Drain on a cooling rack set above a sheet pan, and season immediately with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Serve warm or room temperature.

name: Spicy Roast Brisket
attribution: "Spicy Roast Brisket" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Roast_Brisket, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 kg (2 pound) piece of beef brisket
1 cup thinly sliced stalk of celery
2 cups of diced tomatoes, fresh or canned
1 bell pepper, green or red, thinly sliced

steps: Heat oil in large heavy pot, add brisket, and brown on all sides.
Push meat to the side. Add onions and celery, and cook over medium heat until softened.
Add garlic, cumin, peppercorns, mustard, oregano, salt, and stir in.
Add tomatoes, beef stock, vinegar, sugar, and bay leaves. Add the tomato juice if desired.
Add 1 cup of boiling water, cover pot, and cook for 2 hours on low heat.
Inspect regularly to make sure there is enough liquid, adding water if necessary.
30 minutes before serving, add bell and chili peppers.

name: Spicy Tomato Soup
attribution: "Spicy Tomato Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spicy_Tomato_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: In a blender or food processor, working in batches if necessary, puree tomatoes, cream, sugar, pepper, salt, garlic and cayenne.
Transfer soup to a saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until soup thickens, 20–30 minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Spinach and Ricotta Lasagna
attribution: "Spinach and Ricotta Lasagna" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spinach_and_Ricotta_Lasagna, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cans (56 oz) San Marzano or Roma tomatoes

steps: Put a thick-bottomed pot over medium-low heat. Add the oil and garlic, and stir until fragrant and blisters begin to form.
Add the tomatoes, and reduce the heat to low.
Simmer until it has a sauce consistency and has reduced to about ⅔ the original volume (about 1½ hours).
Turn off the heat and remove the garlic cloves to mash them with a fork. Add the garlic purée to the sauce.
Add salt to taste, cover, and let rest 30 minutes.
Pour the ricotta cheese onto a cheesecloth or tea towel in a strainer, and let drain for 30 minutes.
Combine the eggs and ricotta, and beat until creamy with a hand mixer.
Cover and reserve, ensuring it is at room temperature during assembly.
Thaw, drain, and press the liquid out of frozen spinach.
Reserve until ready to assemble.
Cook the pasta according to the manufacturer's directions, drain and place back into the pot with cold water.
Lay the sheets on a clean, wet tea towel and roll the cloth until ready to use.
Ladle sauce at the bottom of a 9x13-inch pan or dish and layer lasagna sheets.
Sparsely deposit spinach onto the noodles and apply cheese mixture with a rubber spatula.
Add more sauce and repeat the previous step until the pan is almost full and covered with a layer of lasagna.
Add sauce and cover with grated mozzarella.
Put the pan onto a tray and bake at 350°F for approximately 30 minutes, or to an internal temperature of 150°F.
Let rest for 15–20 minutes before serving.

name: Spinach and Ricotta Ravioli Filling
attribution: "Spinach and Ricotta Ravioli Filling" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spinach_and_Ricotta_Ravioli_Filling, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 15 oz cooked spinach (fresh, frozen, or canned)
½ tsp grated or minced garlic

steps: Squeeze the spinach to remove excess water. Place in a mixing bowl.
Add the other ingredients and mix well with a fork.

name: Spinach Calzones
attribution: "Spinach Calzones" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spinach_Calzones, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 284 g frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
908 g frozen white bread dough, thawed

steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, mix together the ricotta cheese, eggs, Italian seasoning, mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese and spinach. Set aside.

Divide the bread dough into 8 pieces and roll each piece out to about an 8-inch circle. Spoon about ½ cup of the ricotta filling onto each circle, fold over and seal the edges. Place onto a greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until nicely browned on the tops and bottoms.

name: Spinach Fritters
attribution: "Spinach Fritters" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spinach_Fritters, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 handfuls of spinach and rocket leaves

steps: Combine the yogurt, flour, minced garlic, olive oil, salt and pepper in the mixing bowl.
Chop the spinach and rocket leaves, and add them to the mixing bowl.
Mix in the baking powder.
Preheat a frying pan, and grease with olive oil.
Dollop spoonfuls of batter on the pan to make a few fritters about 3 cm apart from each other.
Cook fritters until the bottoms of the fritters are golden brown. Flip the fritters with a spatula, and cook until the second side is golden brown. Remove from the pan.
Repeat the cooking steps until all the batter is used up.
Enjoy and share with friends and family!

name: Spinach Mushroom Omelet
attribution: "Spinach Mushroom Omelet" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spinach_Mushroom_Omelet, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ⅔ cup baby bella mushrooms, thinly sliced
½ ea. large red onion, diced
½ cup shredded aged cheddar cheese

steps: In a large bowl, whisk the eggs, salt, pepper, nutmeg and milk, until even and glossy.
Heat the skillet over medium heat. Add half the butter, tilting the skillet in a circular motion to coat evenly.
Add paprika, mushrooms, and onions, and sauté until lightly browned.
Add spinach and toss for 30 seconds, or until slightly wilted, but still crunchy. Remove the vegetables from the heat and set aside.
Add the remaining half of the oil or butter to the pan over medium heat, and coat evenly. Lower the heat.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet, swirling the pan to ensure an even, creamy layer of eggs. Heat until the eggs have begun to set, with some fluff on top.
Top the egg layer with the vegetables, distributing the vegetables evenly. Sprinkle the cheese evenly on top.
Gently push the edges of the omelet half a centimeter toward the center of the skillet with two spatulas, making sure not to break it. Turn the heat off.
Use the spatulas to carefully lift/pull half the omelet off the skillet and fold it over the other half. Carefully move the entire omelet onto a plate and serve.

name: Spinach Mushroom Pesto Spaghetti
attribution: "Spinach Mushroom Pesto Spaghetti" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spinach_Mushroom_Pesto_Spaghetti, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup (60 g / 2 oz) grated parmesan cheese, plus extra for sprinkling

steps: Boil the spaghetti in water until al dente.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan over a medium heat.
Cook the spinach for 5 minutes until it is wilted.
Add the mushrooms, salt, and pepper and cook for a further 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the pesto and cheese and cook for 2 minutes.
Drain the pasta in a colander and stir into the sauce.
Divide the pasta between 4 plates and serve.
To serve, sprinkle with some extra cheese.

name: Spinach Pesto Linguine
attribution: "Spinach Pesto Linguine" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spinach_Pesto_Linguine, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 8–12 cloves garlic (depending on your preference/size of meal)
1–2 chicken breasts (can substitute salmon or steak)

steps: Lightly sauté the garlic in a pan—this is not meant to completely cook it, but to take a little of the bite off of it.

Chop the garlic up a bit in a food processor, then add the spinach bit by bit (stems may be left on if you like). When you have completed mixing the garlic and spinach together, add the olive oil and mix. Put into a bowl and set aside.
Strip the snap peas of the stringy bits and the hard ends, and place those aside in a bowl as well.

Start the water on the stove at a medium temperature to prevent the water from boiling, but able to easily obtain a boil at your whim. Start the grill and put the chicken (or other meat) on at a medium temperature. When it has heated up, put a bit of olive oil on each side to prevent sticking. When the meat is about a quarter done, you want to have the water boiling. Put the linguine in, and if you wish, add a bit of olive oil for flavor.
While you are doing this, put the snap peas in a small frying pan with some olive oil at a low-medium temperature to warm them up a bit.

When the pasta and meat are cooked (try and get these finished cooking at the same time), slice the chicken into strips (in the case of the steak/salmon, it may be better to just leave it in fillet/steak form for presentation purposes). Strain the pasta, and put it in a frying pan along with some of the pesto (by portion) to heat the pesto up a bit. Make sure it is not at a high temperature, as that will cause the pasta to crisp up. When you have finished this, put it on a plate and top with feta and olives.
Arrange the snap peas and meat strips on top as well, and there's your dinner!

name: Spinach Pie (Pascualina)
attribution: "Spinach Pie (Pascualina)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spinach_Pie_(Pascualina), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 190°C.
Sauté onions until golden.
Add spinach, cream cheese, nutmeg and salt and pepper to taste. Stir through until all ingredients are mixed together. Put aside to cool slightly.
Line a rectangular tray with puff pastry ensuring the pastry reaches right up to the edge of the tray.
Spread out the filling over the puff pastry, and with a spoon make 6 holes in the filling so you can pour in the whole eggs.
Crack eggs one by one and pour into the holes.
Cover the pie with more pastry sealing the edges.
Brush pastry all over with egg wash and bake in a hot oven for 40 minutes until pastry is golden.
Serve with roasted sweet potato and steamed green beans.

name: Spinach Salad
attribution: "Spinach Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spinach_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup (60 ml) red wine vinegar
1 lb spinach, patted dry of any liquid

steps: Combine all ingredients for the dressing. Mix well.
Combine the spinach, eggs, and sliced onion in a large bowl.
Pour the dressing on top of the salad, mix, and top with vegetarian bacon strips or bacon bits.

name: Spoonbread
attribution: "Spoonbread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spoonbread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup white or yellow corn meal
⅛–1 teaspoon red pepper flakes, to taste
⅓ cup grated cheese, mild or sharp to taste (if used, reduce salt)

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (205°C).
Thickly coat 8 x 8 inch (20 x 20 cm) baking pan with cooking spray.
Beat egg whites until stiff, then set aside.
Heat milk in medium saucepan over medium heat until just barely bubbling at the edges.
Reduce heat and whisk while slowly adding cornmeal.
Whisk constantly over low heat for 5 minutes.
Take off heat and stir in black pepper, red pepper flakes, salt, and scallions.
Stir in egg yolks and cheese.
Fold in whipped egg whites.
Pour into pan.
Bake about 30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean.

name: Spring Onion Spelt Spread
attribution: "Spring Onion Spelt Spread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spring_Onion_Spelt_Spread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 or more whole spring onions, chopped
Rapeseed oil or other vegetable oil

steps: Combine tofu, oat flakes, raw spelt, and some water.
If desired, mix in the lecithin to act as an emulsifier.
Mix in the spring onion and gherkins.
Mix in a spoonful of margarine and/or rapeseed oil.
Add salt and pepper to taste.

name: Spritzgeback (German Spritz Butter Cookies)
attribution: "Spritzgeback (German Spritz Butter Cookies)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Spritzgeback_(German_Spritz_Butter_Cookies), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tsp almond, vanilla, or lemon extract

steps: Beat butter and sugar until light.
Beat in egg, egg yolk and extract.
Sift flour, salt, and baking powder together; gradually add flour mixture to eggs.
Chill dough for ½ hour.
Press ¼ of the dough into a cookie press.
Keep remaining dough chilled.
Shape cookies onto a greased baking sheet.
Bake in oven at for 7–10 minutes or until done.
Cool on wire racks and store in airtight tins.

name: Sriracha Oatmeal and Lentils
attribution: "Sriracha Oatmeal and Lentils" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sriracha_Oatmeal_and_Lentils, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cook the lentils in water until they are very soft.
If there is any remaining water, strain the lentils.
Mash the lentils.
In a saucepan, heat the chicken broth.
Return lentils to the heat and add heated chicken broth and oats.
When oats are cooked, add Sriracha. The amount of Sriracha depends entirely on your preference.
Add around ½ tbsp honey and enough salt to season.

name: Steak and Kidney Pudding
attribution: "Steak and Kidney Pudding" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Steak_and_Kidney_Pudding, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut the steak into about 2.5 cm (1 inch) squares. Cut each kidney into 8 pieces.
Line the basin with crust, leaving a small piece of crust to overlap the edge.

Then cover the bottom with a piece of the steak and a few pieces of kidney; season with salt and pepper, and then add another layer of steak, kidney and seasoning. Proceed in this manner until the basin is full, when pour in sufficient water to come within 5 cm (2 inch) of the top of the basin.
Moisten the edges of the crust, cover the pudding over, press the two crusts together, so that the gravy does not escape, and turn up the overhanging pastry.
