Wring out a cloth in hot water, flour it and tie up the pudding; put it int boiling water and let it boil for at least 4 hours. If the water diminishes, always replenish with hot water from a jug, as the pudding should be kept covered all the time, and not allowed to stop boiling.

When the cloth is removed, cut out a round piece in the top of the crust, to prevent the pudding bursting, and send it to table in the basin, either in an ornamental dish or with a napkin pinned round it. Serve quickly.

name: Steak and Peppers
attribution: "Steak and Peppers" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Steak_and_Peppers, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet. Sear steak strips, bell peppers and onion together with salt and red pepper flakes for a few minutes, then turn heat down and add crushed tomatoes and capers.
Simmer, covered, for 10 minutes or until steak is cooked through and tender.
Chiffonade the basil and add, then simmer for another couple of minutes.

name: Steak and Wine Pie
attribution: "Steak and Wine Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Steak_and_Wine_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 tbsp butter or margarine, cut into small cubes
¼ cup red wine or lemon juice
½ stalk celery, sliced ⅛ inch thick
⅓ whole carrot, sliced ⅛ inch thick, then cut into semicircles
13-cm- or 5-inch-diameter pie plate or ceramic bowl
Spoons, cutlery and spatula, as needed

steps: Combine the flour, salt, and Italian seasoning in a shallow bowl, and mix to distribute well. Mix in the butter until solid, firm dough lumps form. If mixing by hand, pinch and clasp them together until a ball can be formed.
Dust a work surface and the dough ball with a little flour to prevent sticking. Flatten dough with a rolling pin until it forms a thin disk large enough to be draped over the pie plate or bowl.
Freeze the dough for 20 minutes, or for the duration of filling prep and cooking.
Combine the oil, wine, and soy sauce to make a marinade. Submerge the beef in the marinade, and let this marinate in the fridge for 24 hours.
Remove the meat from the marinade, and slice it ¼ inch thick.
Heat the saucepan over high heat, then add the butter and let it melt.
Add the sliced beef to the saucepan. Sauté, stirring, until browned all over.
Add bay leaf, thyme, basil, celery, onion, and carrot. Sauté, stirring occasionally, until onions and celery are soft.
Scrape some of the fond off the pan bottom without taking it out, if possible. Stir in the wine, Worcestershire sauce, and gravy granules for 1 minute
Turn heat to low, stir in ketchup, and cover the pan. Cook until stew volume is reduced by a third to half and liquids are beginning to thicken.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Remove from the heat, and discard the bay leaf.
Pour filling into the pie plate or bowl.
Cover with the pie crust disk and press around edges to seal. The dough falling apart is acceptable as long as it retains an amount of crunch or flakiness.
Bake at 445 °F (230 °C / Gas 8) for 10 to 15 minutes or until top crust turns medium brown. Handle with care.

name: Steak Melts
attribution: "Steak Melts" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Steak_Melts, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 ea. (12–16 ounces) boneless strip steaks, cooked to your liking
4 slices pepper jack or Monterrey Jack cheese

steps: Slice steaks thinly across the grain on the bias. Place ¼ of the strips onto each slice bread.
Place a slice of cheese on top of that, then press 2 slices together and then repeat with the other. Brush the sides facing out with melted butter.
Heat a griddle over high heat. Add sandwiches and cook until golden brown on each side. Serve immediately.

name: Steak Sandwiches
attribution: "Steak Sandwiches" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Steak_Sandwiches, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cooked beef tenderloin steaks, sliced thinly
1 ea. (1 foot-long) French or Italian loaf, split in half

steps: Build a sandwich with all of the ingredients.
Toast in a 200°F oven until cheese is melted and bread is toasted.

name: Steak Tartare
attribution: "Steak Tartare" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Steak_Tartare, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ pound (227 g) of quality tender beef (filet mignon) with all connective tissue removed
1–3 drops hot pepper sauce, as desired

steps: Finely chop the beef, or run it twice through a meat grinder with a ¼ inch (0.64 cm) plate.
Loosely combine the minced beef, egg yolk, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, hot sauce, onions, salt, and pepper.
Spread on the bread slices to make open-faced sandwiches. The steak tartare may also be served on buttered toast.
Serve on chilled plates with a favorite beverage.

name: Steakhouse Marinade
attribution: "Steakhouse Marinade" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Steakhouse_Marinade, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan.
Bring to 190°F for 10 minutes.
Strain, cool and place into a gallon size zip-top bag. Keep refrigerated for up to 1½ weeks.

name: Steamed Artichoke
attribution: "Steamed Artichoke" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Steamed_Artichoke, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut off artichoke stem and head.
Remove base leaves and cut off pointy end of upper leaves.
Rub artichoke in lemon to preserve color.
Add salt (and any seasonings) to 3 inches of water, and bring to a low boil.
Place artichoke top-down in a pot tall enough to place lid without touching the artichoke.
Boil on low 30–45 minutes until the artichoke bottom can be punctured without resistance.
Place artichoke upside down to drain.
Serve whole, with one or more dips. Diners should remove a leaf, dip the base of the leaf in the dip, and eat the fleshy base of the leaf.
When all the leaves are gone, remove the choke, cut the heart of the artichoke into bite sized pieces, and serve with the dip.
Drawn butter
Mayonnaise
Mustard Dip (This dip is, in the opinion of some, more tasty than butter or mayonnaise)

name: Steamed Basmati Rice
attribution: "Steamed Basmati Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Steamed_Basmati_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: If adding saffron, soak it in a tablespoon or two of hot water for 10 minutes, and add the water and strands in with the lemon juice.
Rinse the rice in a sieve for 5–7 minutes under cold running water.
Add the water, rice, butter, and salt to a pot.
Bring to a rapid boil.
Mix in lemon juice and the saffron mixture if using.
Cover the pot tightly, reduce heat to minimum, and simmer for 8½ minutes.
Taste the rice to check its texture. Cook for 1–5 minutes longer depending on how underdone it is.
Fluff with a fork and serve hot with your favorite recipe.

name: Steamed Buns with BBQ Pork
attribution: "Steamed Buns with BBQ Pork" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Steamed_Buns_with_BBQ_Pork, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 8 ounces (225 g) shredded cooked pork or chicken

steps: Place all ingredients in food processor.
Process until ingredients are blended and chopped fine.
Stir yeast and 1 tablespoon of sugar into 1½ cups of warm water (95°F / 35°C.). Let stand for 15 minutes.
Mix yeast water, 2 more tablespoons of sugar, flour, cooking oil, baking powder, and salt in mixing bowl.
Stir until dough forms. Knead dough for 10 minutes.
Allow dough to rise in a warm place for 1½ hours.
Punch dough down and divide into 12 pieces.
Roll each piece of dough into a ball, then flatten with rolling pin into a 6-inch (15 cm) circle.
Place 1 tablespoon of meat filling in center of each flattened piece of dough.
Lift the edges of the flattened dough up around the filling and bring edges together. Pinch edges closed to form filled bun.
Place buns on parchment paper. Allow to rise in a warm place 1 hour, until doubled in size.
Steam buns in a steamer over boiling water for 20 minutes.
Remove from steamer. When cool enough to handle, remove parchment paper from bottom.
Serve warm.

name: Steamed Pork With Mustard Greens
attribution: "Steamed Pork With Mustard Greens" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Steamed_Pork_With_Mustard_Greens, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tsp cornstarch combined with 1 tsp cold water
2 tbsp black bean and garlic sauce

steps: Wash greens and discard tough stems.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add greens, and cook for 2 minutes.
Drain greens and rinse with cold water to stop the cooking. Drain again, then cut greens into long diagonal strips.
In a medium bowl, combine cornstarch and water. Stir in sugar, soy sauce and rice wine. Cut pork into thin slices and add to the mixture. Marinate about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Heat oil in a preheated wok or large heavy skillet over medium heat. Add black bean sauce and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add pork and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add mustard greens and water. Mix well and simmer gently about 4–5 minutes, until pork is cooked through and greens are tender.
Season with pepper and serve.

name: Steamed Rice
attribution: "Steamed Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Steamed_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup (250 ml or 8.5 fl oz) dry rice

steps: Wash the rice if desired.
Place the rice in a deep saucepan with lid. Add salt if using, and stir.
Bring rice to a boil over high heat. Stir.
Reduce heat to low and cover the pot. Cook on low for 12 minutes.
Uncover rice and serve.

name: Steamed Salmon
attribution: "Steamed Salmon" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Steamed_Salmon, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Put your salmon in a pot.
Add the boiling water and sprinkle with salt.
Cover the pot, and steam over low heat until the flesh is just cooked.

name: Stewed Oysters I
attribution: "Stewed Oysters I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Stewed_Oysters_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Salt, black pepper, and nutmeg, to taste

steps: Shuck the oysters, saving any liquid in the oyster.
Put your oysters with all their liquid into a saucepan; add the butter, salt, black pepper, mace, and bay leaves.
Bring to a simmer for 5 minutes. Add the cream and shake all well together while heating through.
Pour onto a plate or platter, grating a little fresh nutmeg on each oyster as it lies in the sauce.

name: Stewed Oysters II
attribution: "Stewed Oysters II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Stewed_Oysters_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Salt, mace, and pepper, to taste

steps: Shuck the oysters and save the liquid in the shell.
Beat the butter smooth with the flour.
Put the oysters in a pan over medium heat. When they become hot, stir in the cream, butter, and flour. Season to taste with salt, mace, and pepper.
Serve as soon as they are taken off the fire.

name: Stewed Vegan Maki
attribution: "Stewed Vegan Maki" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Stewed_Vegan_Maki, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup (60 ml) thinly-julienned daikon radish

steps: In a wok or saucepan, combine vegetables and sake. Bring to a simmer and let cook until most of the sake is gone, stirring often.
Add the water and miso, bring this to a simmer, and let it cook until the vegetables are soft (but not mushy), stirring often.
Remove the vegetables from the pan, and reduce the remaining liquid to a thick sauce consistency.
Pour the sauce over the vegetables and mix thoroughly. Let cool, then mix in vinegar.
Evenly spread rice over nori, dab half the wasabi across each, then place the vegetable mix across this. Roll tightly.

name: Stinging Nettle Pesto
attribution: "Stinging Nettle Pesto" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Stinging_Nettle_Pesto, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ⅓ cup hazelnuts, pine nuts, and/or walnuts
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
Blender, food processor, or mortar and pestle

steps: Dry sauté or roast nuts until slightly browned.
With thick gloves, place nettles in boiling water for 1 minute. Transfer nettles to an ice water bath to stop the cooking process. Drain.
Blend all ingredients until smooth. Alternatively, smash with mortar and pestle for a coarser consistency.

name: Stir Fried Seafood with Noodles
attribution: "Stir Fried Seafood with Noodles" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Stir_Fried_Seafood_with_Noodles, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pack (500 g) Hong Kong-style egg noodles, rehydrated and boiled if needed
100 g cabbage, cut into bite-sized pieces
150 g bean sprouts, rinsed in hot water

steps: Heat the oil in a non-stick pan, add the garlic, and fry for about 10 seconds until golden brown.
Add the fishball and shrimp. Stir fry until the shrimp and fishball just begin to change color.
Add the cabbage and scallion, and stir fry at least until all ingredients are hot.
Add the noodles, and stir fry until all ingredients are hot.

Add the bean sprouts, light soy sauce, salt, sugar and pepper. Mix well and stir fry (perhaps on reduced heat) until all ingredients are hot, taking care to not cook so long as to overly wilt the bean sprouts.
Serve immediately with fried onion.

name: Stir-Fried Shrimp with Broccoli
attribution: "Stir-Fried Shrimp with Broccoli" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Stir-Fried_Shrimp_with_Broccoli, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 300 g broccoli, cut into florets and rinsed

steps: Heat a pan, add the oil and garlic, and fry until golden.
Add the shrimp and broccoli. Season with salt and oyster sauce, and add a little water. Stir together.
Put on a plate and serve.

name: Stoofvlees (Flemish Beef Stew)
attribution: "Stoofvlees (Flemish Beef Stew)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Stoofvlees_(Flemish_Beef_Stew), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 500 g beef suitable for stew (e.g. from the neck)
1 bottle of dark beer (preferably Trappist, but any dark beer will do)
1 bottle of cherry beer (any kind blond beer would also work)

steps: Combine the flour, pepper, and salt.
Dice the meat into 2 cm cubes. Mix the meat with the flour until it's lightly coated.
Sear the meat in a pan with butter (not oil) until brown on all sides—it has to be brown in order to add colour to the sauce. Put aside.
Fry the onion in a pot with butter. When it changes colour, add the meat and pour in the beers.
Add the bay leaves and thyme. Spread the bread with mustard, and place mustard side-down on the meat.
Cover the pot, placing a piece of wet baking paper between the pot and lid (this seals the pot so it doesn't burn; don't forget this!)
Cook over low heat for 2–3 hours, or put it in a 100°C oven for about 4–5 hours.
If desired, mix in a dash of vinegar.
Serve with French fries, lettuce, and tomatoes.

name: Stovetop Barley I
attribution: "Stovetop Barley I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Stovetop_Barley_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tsp neutral cooking oil (optional, to reduce foaming)

steps: If desired, rinse barley under running water until water runs clear.
Combine the barley, water, salt, and oil in a pot.
Bring to a boil, skimming off any foam that forms.
Reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook until all the water is absorbed by the barley.
Remove from heat, and fluff like rice.

name: Stovetop Barley II
attribution: "Stovetop Barley II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Stovetop_Barley_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Neutral cooking oil (optional, to reduce foaming)

steps: If desired, rinse barley under running water until water runs clear.
Place the barley in a pot, and add enough water to cover the barley by several inches. Add salt and oil.
Cover, and bring to a boil, skimming any foam that forms.
Boil until barley grains have swelled to 3 times their original size and are a semiopaque white.
Drain into a colander.

name: Stracciatella I
attribution: "Stracciatella I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Stracciatella_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Red chile flakes, or chile powder (optional)

steps: Put the broth in a large pot, and bring to a boil.
Separately, combine eggs, cheese, and parsley, and beat until the cheese and parsley are moistened.
Once the broth is at a rolling boil, use a whisk to set the fluid whirling.
Slowly add the egg mixture, keeping the broth at a boil so the egg cooks quickly.
Remove from heat, and add pepper.
Serve immediately, or reheat and serve very hot.

name: Strawberry And Banana Smoothie
attribution: "Strawberry And Banana Smoothie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Strawberry_And_Banana_Smoothie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¾ cup (200 ml / 6.8 oz) apple juice
⅝ cup (150 g / 5.3 oz) natural (plain) yogurt
⅔ cup (50 g / 1.8 oz) ice cubes

steps: Cut off the tops of the strawberries.
Peel the bananas.
Blend all the ingredients in a blender until smooth.
Add honey to taste.
Pour the smoothie into 2 glasses.
Enjoy!

name: Strawberry and Yogurt Eton Mess
attribution: "Strawberry and Yogurt Eton Mess" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Strawberry_and_Yogurt_Eton_Mess, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 280 ml (1 ⅕ cup or 9 ½ fl oz) double cream
150 ml (⅗ cup or 5 fl oz) Greek yoghurt
500 g (2 ⅕ cups or 1 lb 2 oz) strawberries

steps: Rinse the strawberries, remove the tops, and cut into halves.
Break the meringues into pieces (not too small) and place into a bowl.
Put the double cream, vanilla essence, and icing sugar into a bowl. Whip until reasonably stiff.
Combine the whipped cream, yoghurt, strawberries, and meringue, being careful not to mash the meringue into pieces that are too small.
Serve in bowls.

name: Strawberry Cream Pie
attribution: "Strawberry Cream Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Strawberry_Cream_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup (60 ml) white granulated sugar
2 pounds (900 g) fresh strawberries, cleaned and sliced

steps: Combine sugar and cream in large mixing bowl, and whip until soft and fluffy.
Spread whipped cream in pie crust.
Spread strawberries over whipped cream.
Cover and chill overnight.

name: Strawberry Dumplings
attribution: "Strawberry Dumplings" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Strawberry_Dumplings, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups (500 g) curd cheese (e.g. quark, pot cheese, or farmer cheese)
12 ripe, medium-sized strawberries, rinsed and trimmed

steps: Melt the butter in a frying pan.
Add the breadcrumbs and the sugar and toast them until they gain a brown colour. Stir well, as the sugar makes the crumbs burn faster.
Put the egg and the curd cheese into a large bowl.
Add a pinch of salt.
Stir until the mixture is smooth; the egg and the cheese should be blended well.
Slowly add the flour, stirring until the dough sticks to one side of the bowl.
Let the dough rest for about 5 minutes. If the dough is too moist, which sometimes happens due to the salt, add some more flour.
Cover your hands with flour, so that the dough won't stick to your fingers when forming the dumplings.
Take a large tablespoon of dough and put it onto your palm.
Add some flour and roll the dough slightly between your hands until you receive a small ball.
Press the ball flat and put a strawberry into the middle. Cover the strawberry with dough, and pinch to seal.
Sprinkle the dumpling and your hands with some more flour. Carefully roll the dumpling until you get a smooth, round ball.
Put the dumplings on a floured plate. Leave enough space between them, as they will otherwise stick to one another.
Fill a large pot with about 3 liters of water and bring it to a boil.
Put the dumplings into the boiling water. Let them boil in the open pot for about 10 minutes. The dumplings are done, when they float as if they "danced".
Take the dumplings out of the boiling water and roll them in the breadcrumbs until they are covered evenly. Since the crumbs are supposed to stick, the dumplings should still be moist on the surface.
Serve the dumplings together with a little of the roasted crumbs, and sprinkle them with icing sugar

name: Strawberry Fromage Frais
attribution: "Strawberry Fromage Frais" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Strawberry_Fromage_Frais, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 dl (600 ml) low-fat/fat free fromage frais
3 saltspoons (¾ tsp) sugar or granulated sugar replacement

steps: Soak gelatin sheets in cold water to hydrate them.
Beat fromage frais and strawberry jam until well-combined.
Whip egg whites with sugar until stiff. Fold into the fromage mixture.
Take the gelatin sheets out of the water, and dissolve them in the boiling water. Stir this carefully into the strawberry mixture.
Transfer mixture to individual cups or a bowl, and chill in the refrigerator for several hours until firm.
Decorate with fresh berries and serve.

name: Strawberry Frozen Yogurt
attribution: "Strawberry Frozen Yogurt" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Strawberry_Frozen_Yogurt, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Wash and dry the strawberries and lemon.
Slice strawberries into small pieces.
Combine strawberries and sugar.
Roll a lemon on a counter while applying pressure with the palm of one hand. Cut lemon in half and squeeze both halves through a strainer into the strawberry mixture.
Remove any remaining seeds from the lemon halves and add them, with the rind, to the strawberry mixture.
Allow strawberry mixture to macerate for 1–2 hours, stirring occasionally until all of the sugar crystals are dissolved.
Discard lemon halves, then orange liqueur to the strawberry mixture.
Use a blender or food processor to reduce the strawberry mixture to a purée, but don't over-blend.
Stir the Greek yogurt into to the strawberry mixture, mixing until well combined.
Refrigerate strawberry yogurt mixture for at 4 four hours.
Pour strawberry yogurt mixture into a prepared ice cream maker, and mix for approximately 20 minutes, or until the frozen yogurt has reached a firm consistency.
Eat immediately, or freeze for later.

name: Strawberry Pie
attribution: "Strawberry Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Strawberry_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Place your strawberries in a saucepan and add water, sugar, and lemon juice. Bring to a boil and stir occasionally until thick and syrupy.
Arrange the pie crust in a pie pan (unless the pie crust comes with a pan). Pour filling into the pie crust.
Bake in the oven at 350°F for 60 minutes or until golden brown. Remove pie, and let it cool.
Serve with whipped cream on top.

name: Strawberry Rhubarb Pie
attribution: "Strawberry Rhubarb Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Strawberry_Rhubarb_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup cornstarch or tapioca pearls

steps: Prepare the flaky pie crust and refrigerate while preparing the filling.
Clean the strawberries and remove the leaves.
Cut the strawberries in halves (or quarters for larger berries).
Clean and trim the rhubarb stalks.
Cut the stalks into ½–1 inch sections.
Add sugar, cornstarch or tapioca, and salt.
Stir until rhubarb is evenly coated with dry ingredients.
Follow the instructions in the flaky pie crust recipe.

name: Strong Candied Sweet Potatoes
attribution: "Strong Candied Sweet Potatoes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Strong_Candied_Sweet_Potatoes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Slice the sweet potatoes and lay in a deep baking pan with the cinnamon stick.
Mix the liquids, zest, cloves, brown sugar and nutmeg together in a pot; bring to a boil and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour liquid mixture over the dish's contents.
Cover with foil and bake at 350°F for 30 minutes or until sweet potatoes appear to be tender and glazed.
Chill for 3 hours, and serve cold.

name: Stroopwafels
attribution: "Stroopwafels" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Stroopwafels, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat a Pizzelle iron.
Dissolve the yeast in the warm water.
Add the butter to the flour, then mix in the sugar, cinnamon, eggs, and yeast mixture.
Mix well and set aside to rise for 30–60 minutes.
Roll dough into 12 small balls, squeeze each ball into the preheated pizzelle iron, and cook for about 30 seconds.
In a saucepan, cook the brown sugar, butter, cinnamon, and dark corn syrup until it reaches the soft ball stage (234–240°F or 112–115°C).
Stir in ground hazelnuts at this point, if using.
Cut each waffle into two thin layers and sandwich them with some filling.
Repeat this process until all the filling and waffles are used.

name: Strudel
attribution: "Strudel" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Strudel, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Peel, core, and cube apples.
Combine apples, cinnamon, and sugar. Mix well.
Generously brush filo pastry sheets with butter.
Spread apple mixture over pastry sheet.
Alternate with two layers of filo pastry for every layer of apple mixture.
Brush with melted butter.
Bake for 30 minutes or until pastry is golden brown.

name: Stuffed Duck Breast with Cabbage and Dumplings
attribution: "Stuffed Duck Breast with Cabbage and Dumplings" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Stuffed_Duck_Breast_with_Cabbage_and_Dumplings, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 ea. (about 2.5 kg) whole fresh duck, at room temperature
4 stale white bread rolls, cut into small cubes

steps: Put the shredded cabbage and the minced onion into a large bowl.
Combine vinegar, salt, and sugar in a separate bowl and pour the mixture over the cabbage.
Cover the salad, and refrigerate it for several hours before serving.
Preheat the oven to 200°C. If not already done, disembowel the duck, remove the clumps of fat from the tail, and rinse the whole bird carefully.
Grease the bird with butter all over, and season it generously inside and out with salt, pepper, and marjoram.
Stuff the duck with the peeled apples and make sure to close it appropriately. This will give a wonderful taste to the finished dish.
Put the duck breast-side up into a roasting pan that is deep enough to hold the rendered fat, and roast it at 200°C for around 15 minutes.

Take out the duck, baste it, turn it breast-side down, and roast for another 15 minutes. Continue to do so every 15 minutes. It takes roughly an hour to roast 1 kg; thus, you may prepare yourself to leave the duck in the oven for about 2½ hours.
About 20 minutes before the end of the roasting process, put some more butter on the duck in order to obtain a crispy skin. The duck is ready to be served when its skin is richly browned and crisp.
Turn off the oven and let the duck rest for another 10 minutes.
Put the bread cubes into a large bowl and pour milk over them; use more or less milk depending on how dry the bread is.
Melt the butter in a pan, and mix it with the eggs and the remaining ingredients in a bowl. Add to the bread mixture.
Use your hands to squeeze the bread mixture through your fingers until it is smooth and sticky. If the dough is too loose, add 1–2 tablespoons of flour to firm it up.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and form small portions of the dough into balls.

Drop the dumplings carefully into the water and let them simmer for about 30 minutes until they are light, firm, and well risen. Remove them with a large spoon. Alternatively, form the dough into a roll, wrap it into a wet dishtowel, and firmly tie up both ends. Then, put it into the pot and let it simmer for about 30 minutes.

name: Stuffed Kabocha Squash
attribution: "Stuffed Kabocha Squash" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Stuffed_Kabocha_Squash, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut off top of kabocha squash and scoop out seeds.
Bake the squash for 45 minutes at 375°F (190°C) or until a sharp knife goes through the flesh easily.
Meanwhile, fry the tempeh, shallots, ginger, and jalapeño. Cook until tempeh is completely brown, and then add soy sauce and rice. Take off heat and mix thoroughly.
Put tempeh mixture into kabocha squash and bake for 30 more minutes.

name: Stuffed Mushrooms with Crabmeat
attribution: "Stuffed Mushrooms with Crabmeat" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Stuffed_Mushrooms_with_Crabmeat, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup (120 ml) sour cream or plain yogurt

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Remove and finely chop mushroom stems.
In a bowl, combine chopped mushroom stems, vegetable soup mix, crabmeat, sour cream, bread crumbs, dill, hot pepper sauce, and pepper. Set aside.
On lightly greased baking sheet, arrange mushroom caps; stuff with crabmeat mixture, then brush with butter.
Bake 15 minutes or until tender.

name: Stuffed Peppers (Vegetarian)
attribution: "Stuffed Peppers (Vegetarian)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Stuffed_Peppers_(Vegetarian), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cook the rice.
Cut onion into small cubes and fry in olive oil until brown.
Add water, tomato juice, parsley, soup cube, cheese, garlic, black olives and rice. Season to taste.
Fill into the peppers. Cook for 30 minutes. Rest as above.

name: Stuffed Portabella Mushrooms
attribution: "Stuffed Portabella Mushrooms" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Stuffed_Portabella_Mushrooms, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 oz mozzarella cheese (fresh or regular), diced or grated
10 Saltine crackers, crushed or ½ cup bread crumbs

steps: Generously sprinkle vinegar over the mushrooms, and top with garlic. Leave for 30 minutes or so.
Combine the egg, cheeses, crackers and seasonings in a bowl. Mix well. Spoon the mixture onto the mushrooms.
Bake at 350°F for 40 minutes.

name: Stuffed Squash
attribution: "Stuffed Squash" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Stuffed_Squash, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1–4 winter squashes, depending on size (red kuri, blue hubbard, acorn, or other round-ish winter squash)

steps: Cut off the top of the squash and dig out the soft insides and seeds. Throw away the insides and seeds.
Coat the squash, inside and out, with a thin layer of olive oil. Salt and pepper the inside.
Place in a 350°F oven and roast until a fork easily pierces the flesh (about 30–45 minutes).
While the squash is roasting, prepare the stuffing (below).
Heat almond oil in a large pot. Add the slivered almonds, some red pepper flakes, and a little salt, and sauté the almonds until lightly browned and fragrant.
Add the onion and continue to sauté until translucent, at which point you should add the garlic and red bell pepper and sauté for 1–2 more minutes.
Mix in the rice pilaf mix, coating the mixture with the almond oil. Stir this around until the rice is hot and lightly toasted (3–5 minutes, or less).
Add 2½ cups water or broth and bring it to an open boil. Cover the pan and turn down the heat to let it simmer until the rice is cooked (about 30–45 minutes).
Salt and pepper to taste.
When the rice is done, pour it into the roasted squash. Grate the cheese on top. Broil a few minutes until the cheese is bubbly and toasty.

name: Stuffing
attribution: "Stuffing" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Stuffing, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 slices of white bread (just slightly stale is best)

steps: Trim crusts off bread and place slices into a large mixing bowl.
Add water and all other ingredients, and with the hands, work the mixture until it is thoroughly combined.

The stuffing may be cooked by packing it into the washed cavity of chicken or turkey, prior to roasting, or by forming the stuffing into patties and placing on a greased tray in an oven (moderate temperature).

name: Succotash
attribution: "Succotash" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Succotash, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 24 ears of corn cut off the cob

steps: If using pork, cover pork with water, and parboil it.
Add beans, then corn, sugar, butter, and pepper to taste. After corn is added, watch carefully to keep from scorching.
Serve.

name: Sugar Pie
attribution: "Sugar Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sugar_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup cornstarch (flour can work if cornstarch is unavailable)
Cinnamon or nutmeg to sprinkle on top of pie (optional)

steps: Preheat oven to about 375°F (190–200°C)
In large saucepan, simmer milk without boiling.
Dissolve sugar, cornstarch and butter into milk. Stir gently and allow to thicken for about 5 minutes.
Pour mixture into pie crust and gently transfer into oven. Bake for about 22 minutes.
Optionally engage broiler for a few minutes to caramelize the top of the pie.

name: Sukuma Wiki (East African Greens)
attribution: "Sukuma Wiki (East African Greens)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sukuma_Wiki_(East_African_Greens), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ teaspoon or more ground cayenne pepper (optional)

steps: Heat oil in a medium-sized pot. Add onions and garlic, and stir fry for about 2–3 minutes. Don't let burn.
Stir in the tomato, coriander, curry powder, and paprika. Cook for about 2 minutes.
Stir in the meat and bouillon powder until well-mixed. Cook for at least 5 minutes.
Add the greens, cayenne, and lemon juice. Cook, stirring, for 5–10 minutes until the greens are done.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

name: Summer Pudding
attribution: "Summer Pudding" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Summer_Pudding, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 loaf of white, pappy sort of bread or brioche, crusts removed and sliced
1 bottle of the best quality blackcurrant cordial you can find, in reserve

steps: Liberally butter the inside a pudding bowl about 5 inches in diameter. The bowl should preferably not be greater in diameter that the size of your pieces of sliced bread. If you are worried about getting the whole thing out of the bowl in one piece, line the bowl first with some cling film. It's a fiddly job, but ensures you get a perfect shape at the end.

Combine the blackcurrants, redcurrants, mint leaves, lime zest, sugar, and about 3 tbsp water. Poach them for about 5 minutes on the lowest possible heat setting of your stove. Add the strawberries and poach for another minute.
Turn the heat off and add the raspberries. Leave to cool.
Using the prepared bowl as a guide, cut a circle out of the white bread the same diameter as the top of the bowl. Do the same with the bottom of the bowl.

Using a sharp knife, slice the bread into squares or oblongs, roughly the same height as the bowl, which will be used to line the inside of the bowl. This does not have to be an exact science. In simple terms what we are trying to do is to line the bowl with the white bread.

Lay the smaller circle of white bread on the bottom of the bowl. Put the oblongs of white bread up the side of the bowl, overlapping slightly, and pour the fruit mixture into the void right up to the top. The bread should become well soaked in the juice from the cooked fruit. Indeed if there is not enough juice to soak the bread so it turns very red, use the cordial as a top-up.
Place the large circle, or disc, of bread on the top and press it down well.
Top with a weight or something that fits into the top of the bowl so it squashes everything down tight, and place it in the fridge for at least 40 minutes.

When you are ready to serve the pudding, carefully using a knife to release the bread mould from the side of the bowl, and invert the whole thing onto a plate. If things become a little fraught and wobbly at this point, don't panic—just sort of whack everything back into shape using a wooden spoon.
Decorate your plate with some more summer fruit, maybe a couple of mint leaves, and an artistic dollop of fresh whipped cream or crème fraîche, then serve with a flourish.

name: Summer Rolls
attribution: "Summer Rolls" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Summer_Rolls, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 50 g cooked pork or chicken meat
4 leaves of leafy lettuce (e.g. romaine/cos, mignonette, etc.)
2 leaves of Chinese cabbage, halved lengthways
Fresh herbs, to taste (e.g. coriander, basil, mint)

steps: Dip a rice wafer into the warm water and remove immediately when it is completely wet—it only needs to be in the water for a few seconds.
Lay the rice wafer on a board or plate.
Arrange a portion of the ingredients near the edge of the rice wafer in a neat pile, with the fingers of cucumber roughly parallel to the edge of the wafer.
Fold the edge of the wafer over the pile of ingredients, and roll it over once.
Fold the sides of the wafer inwards, to close of the ends of the roll you just made.
Roll the wafer up the rest of the way, to enclose the roll completely.
Set aside for 5 minutes to dry a little before eating.
The above process for each summer roll.

name: Sunglow Motel-Cafe Pickle Pie
attribution: "Sunglow Motel-Cafe Pickle Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sunglow_Motel-Cafe_Pickle_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 12 oz sweet pickles, drained and ground

steps: Beat eggs and sugar until lemon-colored and thick; beat in cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon extract, cornstarch, cream and margarine.
Stir ground sweet pickles into mixture.
Pour pickle mixture into unbaked pie shells.
Bake at 350°F for 1–1.25 hours, until a knife inserted in center comes out clean.

name: Sunshine Cake
attribution: "Sunshine Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sunshine_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Whip the yolks with a rotary beater until they are thick and lemon-colored.
Whip the egg whites until they are foamy, add the cream of tartar, and continue whipping until they are dry.
Fold the sugar into the egg whites, then then fold the yolks into this mixture.
Sift the flour several times and add it.
Add the lemon juice and vanilla.
Pour batter into a sponge-cake pan, and bake.

name: Super Foamy Milkshake
attribution: "Super Foamy Milkshake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Super_Foamy_Milkshake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 teaspoon (2 grams) locust bean gum powder

steps: Mix the locust bean gum powder, inulin powder, and sweet whey powder together.
Add the resulting powder to the skimmed milk.
Using an electric mixer, whip for 2 minutes until the product has turned to a fine foam. While whipping, move the whisks up and down so that air gets whipped into the shake.

name: Super Moist Corn Bread
attribution: "Super Moist Corn Bread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Super_Moist_Corn_Bread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup melted butter or olive oil

steps: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). If using a Dutch oven, preheat with 16–18 glowing charcoal briquettes, with 3 times as many on the top as on the bottom.
In a large bowl, mix cornmeal, flour, baking powder, baking soda, and brown sugar, if used.
In another bowl, whisk together the milk, yogurt, egg, and melted butter or olive oil.
Gradually add the dry mixture to the wet mixture and stir until just combined, no longer.
Immediately pour into the greased pan and bake for 15–20 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

name: Supercharger Tea
attribution: "Supercharger Tea" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Supercharger_Tea, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 French press or coffee pot of appropriate size

steps: Place tea bags in French press or coffee pot. Make sure to keep the strings taut to prevent the paper weights from falling in.
Pour the hot water into French press. Place lid on top, with a tight grip on the paper weights.
Let the tea steep for 5 minutes.
If using a French press, slowly push the plunger onto the bags, again with a tight grip on the paper weights.
Take off the lid, scoop the teabags out, and gently squeeze the brew from the bags before disposing of them.
Add sweetener and stir thoroughly.
Let tea cool to room temperature. Serve over ice, or place open pot in freezer for 70 minutes for quicker cooling. Stir in milk or citrus juice before serving.

name: Superkanja (Gambian Okra Stew)
attribution: "Superkanja (Gambian Okra Stew)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Superkanja_(Gambian_Okra_Stew), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 lbs lean beef, cut into chunks
1 lb smoked catfish or any fish of your choice
2 lbs okra, diced into small cubes

steps: Bring a pot of water to a boil and add the meat and fish. Let them boil for 15 minutes, then remove the fish from the pot.
To the pot, add salt, onions, pepper, and diced okra. Mix all the ingredients well.
Cook the mixture over medium heat for 15 minutes, then incorporate the palm oil.
Reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Afterward, return the fish to the pot and continue simmering for 6–10 minutes on low heat.
Serve the superkanja stew with white rice or fufu.

name: Supu Ya Ndizi
attribution: "Supu Ya Ndizi" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Supu_Ya_Ndizi, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 green cooking bananas, peeled and sliced

steps: Peel and slice the green bananas into medium-sized pieces.
If using meat, cook it in a pot with water until tender and reserve the stock.
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until soft and translucent.
Stir in the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook until softened.
Stir in the curry powder.
Add the bananas, carrot, and potato.
Pour in the stock or water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 30–40 minutes, or until the bananas are very soft.
Add the cooked meat or fish if using.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Mash some of the bananas with a spoon to thicken the soup, if desired.
Simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot.

name: Svelekake (Norwegian Yogurt Pancakes)
attribution: "Svelekake (Norwegian Yogurt Pancakes)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Svelekake_(Norwegian_Yogurt_Pancakes), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix all ingredients gently (do not use mixer).
Let batter stand ½ hour.
Fry on hot griddle.
Serve with butter, brunost (brown/goat cheese), or Nugatti Crisp (caramel/hazelnut dessert spread).

name: Swedish Cabbage Soup (Kålsoppa)
attribution: "Swedish Cabbage Soup (Kålsoppa)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Swedish_Cabbage_Soup_(K%C3%A5lsoppa), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Quarter the head of cabbage. Remove the inner stem.
Slice the cabbage across into 3 mm, or thinner, strips.
In a cast-iron pot, melt some butter and add the onions. Cook until softened.
Add the sliced cabbage, and cook until slightly browned.
Add stock, covering the cabbage. Season with salt, white pepper, and 12 whole allspice kernels.
Boil the soup gently for 30–45 minutes.
Serve with hard flatbread, butter, and cheese.

name: Swedish Kringle
attribution: "Swedish Kringle" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Swedish_Kringle, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ teaspoon / 3 g Vanilla extract (or almond extract)
Cake pan or rimmed baking sheet at least 1 inch (2.5 cm) deep – a biscuit tin (7x11 inches, 18 x 28 cm) or a square cake pan (8x8 in, 20x20 cm) is a good size

steps: Mix like a pie crust: Cut the butter into the flour, then stir in the water. It will be somewhat dry and crumbly.
Press the crumbs into the bottom of a biscuit tin or cake pan and set aside. (Do not bake yet.)
Preheat oven to 375 °F (190 °C, gas mark 5, moderate/moderately hot).
Boil the water and butter in a medium-size pan.

Remove from heat. Dump the sugar and flour in all at once, and stir (e.g., with a wooden spoon) to form a uniform paste. The dough will be hot and thick at this stage. Traditionally, choux dough is cooked until it reaches 175 °F (80 °C) at this stage, but it needs to cool to about 145 °F (63 °C) before the next step, or the egg might fry instead of getting stirred in.

Add the almond flavoring and the first egg, beating well with a spoon, until the egg is incorporated into the dough. (Do not use an electric mixer.) Then add the second egg, and beat again until the egg is incorporated. Finally, add the third egg, and beat again. Beating each egg in to the dough may take a minute or two per egg, especially for the last one.
Spread the choux pastry over the unbaked crust with a spatula until fairly smooth.

Bake at 375°F for about 45 minutes, until browned. The goal is at least a deep golden brown, not a pale beige. Don't underbake this, or it will completely collapse as soon as you take it out of the oven.
Cool slowly. The center will sink as it cools.
Beat the powdered sugar, salt, and butter together. Add milk and vanilla, and beat again until smooth.
Spread on the cooled pastry.
Serve within two hours, or refrigerate for up to three days.

name: Swedish Meatballs I
attribution: "Swedish Meatballs I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Swedish_Meatballs_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 200–300 ml (¾–1¼ cups) liquid, such as water, milk or cream
1 small onion, finely chopped or grated

steps: Combine the liquid and bread crumbs in a bowl, and let it sit for 7–8 minutes.
Mix in the ground beef, ground pork, egg, onion, salt, and pepper.
Shape the mixture into round meatballs, approximately 2–3 centimeters (1 inch) in diameter.

Pan fry the meatballs on medium heat in a frying pan with butter for approximately 3–5 minutes. Fry them on all sides until they are brown and not pink in the middle. Shaking the pan occasionally will help the meatballs cook evenly.
Serve them with mashed potatoes with a veal based brown sauce made with cream and lingonberry preserve or cranberry preserve.

name: Sweet and Sour Sauce
attribution: "Sweet and Sour Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sweet_and_Sour_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (20 oz / 567 g) pineapple chunks in unsweetened juice
Cooked meat (suggested: chicken or pork) or fish (optional)

steps: Mix the brown sugar and corn starch in a saucepan.
Add the vinegar, soy sauce, and most of the pineapple juice
Heat to boiling while stirring constantly.
Reduce heat, then add pineapple chunks, cherries, celery, and cooked meat.
Cook until celery begins to soften.
Serve sauce with cooked rice.

name: Sweet and Spicy Shrimp
attribution: "Sweet and Spicy Shrimp" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sweet_and_Spicy_Shrimp, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup frozen orange juice concentrate

steps: Dredge shrimp into flour then dip into cornmeal. Set aside 2–3 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a deep-fryer or a pot to 375°F. Add shrimp and fry until golden brown. Drain on a wire rack.
Meanwhile, heat remaining ingredients in a large saucepan over medium-high heat until boiling. Add shrimp and toss to coat.
Serve immediately.

name: Sweet Carrot Juice
attribution: "Sweet Carrot Juice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sweet_Carrot_Juice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Chop or grate the carrots.
Place carrots and sugar in a blender, and add a small amount of water as needed.
Blend this mixture until well-puréed.
Strain the carrot purée to obtain a pure juice.
Chill and serve.

name: Sweet Charoset
attribution: "Sweet Charoset" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sweet_Charoset, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Juice and zest of ½ lemon
Juice and zest of ½ orange

steps: Mix apples, bananas, lemon juice, lemon zest, orange juice, orange zest, dates, and nuts in a bowl.
Add cinnamon, wine, and matzo meal, and blend thoroughly.
Mix in honey to taste.

name: Sweet Cornbread
attribution: "Sweet Cornbread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sweet_Cornbread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup (160 g / 5.6 oz) maple syrup
½ cup (90 g / 3.2 oz) brown sugar
½ cup (125 g / 4.4 oz) butter, softened

steps: In a large bowl beat eggs lightly to break the yolks as one would for scrambled eggs, then mix in the butter. Soften the butter beforehand if you must by heating it a little.
The butter/egg mixture should be loose. Add the sugar and maple syrup, mix well, then add the salt to the liquid mixture.
Mix the cornmeal and baking powder, then blend them into the liquids.

Slowly add the flour as needed to reach a proper cake batter texture. This should be softer than a cookie dough, able to stick to the mixing spoon and come off in blobs. You may not need all of the flour, or may even need a little more based on your eggs and how closely you measured.
Pour into a greased pan, put into an oven heated to 200°C (400°F), and let bake for between 15–25 minutes.

name: Sweet Elderflower Kefir
attribution: "Sweet Elderflower Kefir" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sweet_Elderflower_Kefir, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Mix well and enjoy.

name: Sweet Italian Sausage Skillet
attribution: "Sweet Italian Sausage Skillet" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sweet_Italian_Sausage_Skillet, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups (480 ml) rotini or other spiral pasta
12 oz (330 g) sweet Italian sausage links
14.5 oz (410 g) cut green Italian beans, drained
2 oz (55 g) shredded provolone or mozzarella

steps: Cook pasta and drain.
Meanwhile, brown sliced sausage in hot oil in large skillet for 5 minutes, then drain away the fat.
Stir in undrained tomatoes, tomato paste, broth, and drained beans. Bring to boil, then reduce heat. Simmer, covered, 10 minutes.
Stir in cooked pasta.
Sprinkle with cheese.

name: Sweet Lassi
attribution: "Sweet Lassi" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sweet_Lassi, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients except ice in blender, and blend until smooth.
Add ice and continue blending until frothy.

name: Sweet Mango Lassi
attribution: "Sweet Mango Lassi" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sweet_Mango_Lassi, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 L (4 cups) mango nectar (strained puréed mango)

steps: Mix sugar with the mango nectar until dissolved.
Gradually add the milk to the yoghurt.
Mix together the mango and yoghurt mixtures.

name: Sweet Maple Barbecue Chicken
attribution: "Sweet Maple Barbecue Chicken" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sweet_Maple_Barbecue_Chicken, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Press rub into chicken. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Preheat grill to medium high.
Add chicken pieces and cook, turning often, 15 minutes.
Brush chicken liberally with 1 cup barbecue sauce and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 165–170°F.
Remove to a platter and cover with aluminum foil and let rest 10 minutes.
Serve warm with remaining ½ cup barbecue sauce.

name: Sweet Mole with Vanilla Bean Ice Cream
attribution: "Sweet Mole with Vanilla Bean Ice Cream" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sweet_Mole_with_Vanilla_Bean_Ice_Cream, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 ounces semi-sweet dark chocolate bar, cut into pieces
2 cups high-quality vanilla bean ice cream

steps: Wash, devein, and remove seeds from chile ancho.
Boil the chile, then blend with the smallest amount of water possible.
Strain off water.
In a saucepan, add pureed chile, piloncillo, clove, cinnamon and chocolate.
Boil for 3 minutes.
Remove clove.
To serve, allow vanilla ice cream to soften slightly in a bowl and stir in mole.

name: Sweet Potato Crisp
attribution: "Sweet Potato Crisp" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sweet_Potato_Crisp, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Blend all the base ingredients together until creamy and smooth.
Mix all the topping ingredients together in a bowl.
Transfer the sweet potato mixture to a large casserole dish.
Sprinkle on topping, and bake at 350°F until top crisps and hardens.

name: Sweet Potatoes Sautéed with Honey
attribution: "Sweet Potatoes Sautéed with Honey" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sweet_Potatoes_Saut%C3%A9ed_with_Honey, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tsp (5 g) flavorless oil (such as canola oil)

steps: Peel the sweet potato, then chop it into 1 cm (0.4 in) cubes. The pieces of sweet potato don't need to be exactly 1 cm on each side, but they should all be around that size to ensure even cooking. Discard the peel.
Heat a large frying pan on a stovetop burner over medium heat.
Mix the honey, salt, and paprika together in a small bowl.
Add the butter and oil to the pan, then wait for the butter to melt fully.
Add the potatoes to the pan and stir until evenly distributed around the pan. There shouldn't be any sweet potato chunks on top of each other.
Pour the honey mixture over the potatoes and stir until it's evenly distributed across all of the potato pieces.

Cook for about 10 minutes, stirring the sweet potatoes every other minute. It's important to stir the potato pieces in order to prevent them from burning on one side, but stirring them too frequently won't allow them to brown sufficiently, which is why it's important to stir once every 2 minutes or so.
Serve topped with extra salt to your liking and enjoy!

name: Sweet Rice Fritters
attribution: "Sweet Rice Fritters" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sweet_Rice_Fritters, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine rice, eggs, and sugar. Form into 3-inch balls. Dredge in flour and set aside 2–3 minutes.
Heat oil to 375°F. Add rice balls and, working in batches, fry until golden brown and heated through.
Drain fritters on a cooling rack set in a sheet pan.
If desired, dust with powdered sugar before serving.

name: Sweet Rice I
attribution: "Sweet Rice I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sweet_Rice_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1½ tins (about 2 ½ cups / 600 g) evaporated milk
2 tins (2 ½ cups / 600 g) sweetened condensed milk

steps: Bring water to a boil. Add rice, and boil until very soft. Most of the water should be absorbed by the rice. Add more water if necessary.
Add evaporated milk, condensed milk, cinnamon sticks, and vanilla essence.
Cook over medium heat, stirring once in a while to prevent sticking, until mixture has thickened and reached a pudding-like consistency.
Remove from heat, and stir in raisins.
Let stand.

name: Sweet Rice II
attribution: "Sweet Rice II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sweet_Rice_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼–½ cup slivered almonds, toasted if desired

steps: Wash rice, and transfer to a pot.
Add enough water to cover rice with water equal to the depth of the rice.
Add salt, saffron, sugar, and raisins.
Cook over high heat until water disappears and steam is rising from holes in the surface of the rice.
Reduce heat to warm. Add almonds.
Cover tightly and let stand for 20 minutes.

name: Sweet Southern Chicken Salad
attribution: "Sweet Southern Chicken Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sweet_Southern_Chicken_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Add the chicken breasts to a small pot. Add enough water to cover.

Slice stalks of celery into large sticks. Add celery, bay leaves, teaspoon salt, and peppercorns to the pot. Bring to a boil. Once boiling, lower temperature and simmer for at least one hour. Chicken should be tender, and should pull apart easily.
Remove chicken from water. You may wish to reserve the water as a base for a stock or a soup.
Slice chicken into small bite-size cubes. Take care not to shred the chicken, because the salad should be chunky.

Put cut chicken into a medium-sized bowl. Add mayonnaise and chutney, one spoonful at a time until salad reaches correct consistency. The salad should be moist and chunky, not wet and mushy. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve by itself in a bowl, or on bread, biscuits, or croissants.

name: Sweetened Mulling Spice Mix
attribution: "Sweetened Mulling Spice Mix" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sweetened_Mulling_Spice_Mix, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients together.
Store in an airtight container.

name: Swiss Pudding
attribution: "Swiss Pudding" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Swiss_Pudding, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Butter a baking dish, and sprinkle with the breadcrumbs.
Combine the apples, a little butter, nutmeg, and sugar in a saucepan. Cook until softened.
Transfer the apples into the prepared dish.
Top apples with another layer of the crumbs, then add pieces of fresh butter on the top.
Bake in a slow oven for about 15 minutes, until it becomes a delicate brown.
Serve hot or cold.

name: Switchel (Ginger Water)
attribution: "Switchel (Ginger Water)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Switchel_(Ginger_Water), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ⅔ cup (about 160 ml) apple cider vinegar

steps: Dissolve sugar/syrup and ground ginger in the water.
Stir in the apple cider vinegar
Chill or serve over ice cubes. Shake well before serving.

name: Sydney Smith's Salad Dressing
attribution: "Sydney Smith's Salad Dressing" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sydney_Smith's_Salad_Dressing, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Pass the potatoes through a sieve or a ricer.
Combine potatoes and remaining ingredients. Mix well.

name: Sylheti Beef Curry
attribution: "Sylheti Beef Curry" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sylheti_Beef_Curry, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ teaspoon chile powder (adjust to taste)

steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat.
Add the cloves, green cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, and bay leaves. Sauté for a minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped onions and sauté until they turn golden brown.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and sauté for another 2 minutes until the raw smell disappears.
Add the beef cubes and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Stir in the cumin powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, and chili powder. Cook for a couple of minutes to toast the spices.
Add the hatxora, chopped tomatoes and green chilies. Cook until the tomatoes are soft and the oil starts to separate from the mixture.
Pour in enough water to cover the beef, season with salt, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and let the curry simmer for about 1.5–2 hours or until the beef is tender and the flavors meld.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with steamed rice or naan.

name: Sylheti Biryani
attribution: "Sylheti Biryani" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sylheti_Biryani, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Your choice of meat (e.g. chicken, lamb, or beef)

steps: Rinse the Basmati rice thoroughly and soak it in water for about 30 minutes. Drain the rice and set it aside.
In a large, heavy-bottomed pan or pot, heat the ghee over medium heat.
Add the whole cumin seeds, ginger-garlic paste, sliced onion, green cardamom, cinnamon pieces, bay leaves, cloves, and black peppercorns. Sauté until the onions turn golden brown and aromatic.
Add your meat to the pan and cook until it's no longer pink.
Add the drained rice to the pan and stir well, ensuring it's coated with the flavorful mixture.
Pour in enough water to cover the rice (typically about 4 cups of water for 2 cups of rice). Season with salt according to your taste.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let it simmer for about 15–20 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the water is absorbed.
While the rice is cooking, make shallow cuts (slits) on the green chilies to release their flavor.
Once the rice is done, remove it from heat and let it sit, covered, for a few more minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the aromatic Sylheti biryani hot, garnished with the slitted green chilies, a dash of Kewra water, and a sprinkle of rose water for a delightful touch.

name: Sylheti Doner Kebab
attribution: "Sylheti Doner Kebab" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sylheti_Doner_Kebab, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 500 g boneless meat (chicken, lamb, or beef), thinly sliced
Sliced vegetables (e.g. lettuce, tomatoes, onions) for serving
Garlic, tomato, and naga sauce (extremely spicy)

steps: In a bowl, combine yogurt, vegetable oil, minced garlic, chopped onion, shatkora, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well to create the marinade.
Add the thinly sliced meat to the marinade, ensuring it's coated thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, allowing the flavours to meld.
Preheat your grill or stovetop grill pan over medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated meat onto skewers, creating kebabs.
Grill the kebabs for about 10–15 minutes, turning occasionally, until the meat is cooked through and has a nicely charred exterior.
While the kebabs are cooking, warm the pita bread or flatbreads on the grill.
Once the kebabs are done, remove them from the skewers.
Serve the kebab by placing slices of grilled meat into warmed pita bread or flatbreads. Add sliced vegetables and drizzle with tahini sauce or yogurt-based sauce.
Roll up the bread to encase the filling, and enjoy your sylheti doner kebab!

name: Sylheti Fried Rice
attribution: "Sylheti Fried Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sylheti_Fried_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups leftover cooked rice (cooked and cooled at least 12 hours in advance)
Fresh cilantro leaves and spearmint for garnish

steps: Heat vegetable oil in a large pan or wok over medium heat.
Add the finely chopped onion and sauté until it turns translucent.
Add the leftover cooked rice to the pan and stir well.
Season with salt according to your taste. Be cautious as the rice might already have some salt from the previous meal.
Cook for a few minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice is heated through and starts to turn slightly crispy.
Once done, remove from heat.
Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves if desired.

name: Sylheti Rice Pudding
attribution: "Sylheti Rice Pudding" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Sylheti_Rice_Pudding, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Wash the rice and soak it in water for 30 minutes. Drain and set aside.
In a large, heavy-bottomed pot, bring the milk (if using) to a boil.
Add the soaked rice and simmer over low heat, stirring constantly, until the rice is cooked and the mixture thickens. This may take about 1 hour.
Add sugar and cardamom powder, and continue to cook for another 10–15 minutes until the sugar is fully dissolved and the pudding thickens further.
Stir in the grated coconut and raisins.
Remove from heat.
Grease a serving dish with ghee and transfer the rice pudding to the dish.
Allow it to cool and set.
Serve chilled and enjoy.

name: Szegedin Goulash
attribution: "Szegedin Goulash" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Szegedin_Goulash, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 600 g pork shoulder, cut into bite-sized cubes

steps: Heat the lard in a pot, then add the pork and sauté it for about 3 minutes. Take out the pork and set it aside on a plate.
Put the finely chopped onions into the casserole and fry until they become golden brown.

Stir in the tomato purée and paprika, and add some water or stock. Then add the meat, bay leaves and garlic; pour in more water or stock and season with salt and pepper. Reduce the heat and cook for about 30 minutes.
Add the sauerkraut, and cook for another 40 minutes.
Add the sour cream, mix it thoroughly with the goulash, and serve it on warm plates.

name: Tabbouleh I
attribution: "Tabbouleh I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tabbouleh_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cover the wheat in boiling water and let stand for 5 minutes; drain.
Stir in lemon juice, oil, salt, and pepper to wheat. Refrigerate while the rest of the vegetables are being chopped.
Core and finely chop the bell peppers.
Remove the larger stems from the parsley and finely chop.
Drop the tomatoes in boiling water for 20 seconds, then run under cold water, and the skins peel off easily.
Quarter the tomatoes and discard seeds. Chop finely.
Mix all vegetables along with olives and nutmeg into the wheat.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours.

name: Tabbouleh II
attribution: "Tabbouleh II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tabbouleh_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 bunch fresh parsley (preferably flat leaf), very finely chopped
½ bunch fresh mint leaves, finely chopped
½ tsp salt, or to taste
½ tsp pepper, or to taste

steps: Place the bulgur in the lemon juice and set aside for 15 minutes.
When the bulgur is soft, mix all the ingredients together, adding the olive oil last.
Toss well, and adjust the lemon juice as desired.

name: Tabbouleh IV
attribution: "Tabbouleh IV" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tabbouleh_IV, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup (240 ml) bulgur wheat (#2, medium grind)
1 cup (240 ml) fresh parsley, finely chopped
½ cup (120 ml) fresh mint, finely chopped (do not use dried mint)
1 large tomato, peeled, seeded, and diced
1 medium onion, grated on the large side of a box grater
scant ½ cup (100 ml) extra virgin olive oil
½ cup (120 ml) fresh lemon juice

steps: Soak bulgur in water for 15 minutes. Drain and squeeze out as much water as possible.
Chop the green onions, the white portion finely, the tops around medium.
Mix the bulgur, tomato, green onions, grated onion, parsley, and mint in a large bowl.
Whisk the olive oil and lemon juice together and pour over the salad. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Refrigerate for an hour or so to allow the flavors to meld.

name: Tabbouleh VI
attribution: "Tabbouleh VI" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tabbouleh_VI, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups (480 ml) fresh parsley, finely chopped
1 large tomato, diced with seeds discarded
⅓ cup (80 ml) extra virgin olive oil
½ cup (120 ml) fresh lemon juice

steps: Boil 2–3 cups of water
Once water comes to a boil, add bulgur wheat and remove from heat. Let cool.
Drain the bulgur wheat, and mix wheat with all other ingredients.
Refrigerate.

name: Taboon Bread
attribution: "Taboon Bread" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Taboon_Bread, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix the dry ingredients together.
Add olive oil, then gradually knead in enough water to make a dough. Knead for 10 minutes.
Divide the dough into balls, and allow them to rest for an hour until risen.
Sprinkle a flat working surface with flour, and roll the dough balls into flat, circular-shaped patties.
Preheat an oven containing a bed of smooth beach stones to 200°C (400°F). Alternatively, you can place the stones on a tray or pan in the oven.
Place the flat dough upon the stones, and bake for about 8 minutes until it produces bubbles.
Serve hot.

name: Taco Casserole
attribution: "Taco Casserole" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Taco_Casserole, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Brown the ground beef in skillet on medium heat.
Drain the ground beef.
Dump the ground beef back in the skillet.
While on medium heat mix in the taco seasoning, the chili powder, the garlic powder, and the tomato sauce.
Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Mix the ground beef mixture, tortilla bits, and the cheese together in a casserole dish.
Bake in oven at 375°F (190°C) for 20 minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Taco Meat
attribution: "Taco Meat" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Taco_Meat, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pound (about 500 g) ground beef or turkey
1 medium onion, finely chopped (or 1 ½ teaspoons onion powder)
1 medium tomato, chopped (or 1 small can of tomato sauce)
1 teaspoon chili powder (or ⅓ teaspoon each oregano, cumin, garlic powder)

steps: Brown beef and onion together. Drain grease.
Add the rest of the ingredients to the browned meat.
Stir well.
Heat this mixture thoroughly.
Add more tomato sauce if the mixture is dry.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes, or less if the mixture begins to dry out.

name: Taco Soup
attribution: "Taco Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Taco_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cans (31 ounces) kidney, black, or pinto beans

steps: Heat a heavy skillet or pot over medium-high heat. Add a few tablespoons of vegetable oil, then the ground meat.
Break the meat up into a few large chunks, but otherwise leave it alone until it has cooked and developed some color.
Continue gradually breaking up the meat, letting it rest and brown undisturbed in between.
Remove the meat from the heat, and let the excess fat drain away.
In stock pot, combine the tomatoes, corn, beans, taco mix, water, and meat.
Bring to a boil, stirring continuously to prevent sticking. Let simmer for 15 minutes.
Ladle into bowls, and enjoy with cheese and chips if desired.

name: Tadka Dhal (Spiced Lentil Curry) I
attribution: "Tadka Dhal (Spiced Lentil Curry) I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tadka_Dhal_(Spiced_Lentil_Curry)_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 ea. (400 g) medium onions, chopped as fine as possible
2 large cloves of garlic, chopped finely or crushed
Ginger (about the same as the garlic in size), finely chopped

steps: Cook the ingredients in the order listed, giving the onions some time before adding everything else.
Put the lid on and cook until the lentils are cooked to your preference.

name: Tadka Dhal (Spiced Lentil Curry) II
attribution: "Tadka Dhal (Spiced Lentil Curry) II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tadka_Dhal_(Spiced_Lentil_Curry)_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 small sliver of ginger, chopped, or ¼ teaspoon ginger paste
¼ teaspoon red chilli (hot pepper) powder

steps: Set the dhal and water in an open pot on moderate heat until quite mushy, adding water if it becomes dry and stirring occasionally. This may take 30 minutes to an hour. A pressure cooker may be used to speed up this part of the process; this should take about 10–12 minutes at 5 psi.
Heat the oil in a pan. Add mustard seed, standing well back (they tend to spatter).
Add cumin seed, fenugreek, curry leaves, green chillies and onions

Wait for the onions to turn translucent. Add garlic and ginger, turn the heat low until the garlic changes to a darker shade. Avoid caramelizing the garlic. Add turmeric, red chilli and asafoetida powder.

Throw in tomatoes, and wait for 2–3 minutes, letting the tomatoes fry in the hot oil. This lets the tomatoes pick up the flavors from the spices and also lets the oil-spice (tadka) mixture cool down, stopping the hot frying process that has chilli powder in it. Pour in the mushy dhal, addding salt to taste.
Simmer until the tomatoes become soft (5–10 minutes), stirring occasionally.
Serve with rice or chapatis.

name: Tagliatelle Bake
attribution: "Tagliatelle Bake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tagliatelle_Bake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C (160°C convection / 350°F / gas mark 4).
Heat 3 tbsp oil in a large pan. Add the onion, carrot and celery. Cook gently until soft but not coloured.
Add the minced beef and cook until browned, breaking up the mince as much as possible.
Add the parsley. Pour in the white wine and cook for 5 minutes to burn off the alcohol.
Season to taste and add the chopped tomatoes. Cook over a low heat for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Bring a large pan of water to the boil and salt it. Add the pasta and cook following pack instructions or until the pasta is firm to the bite (al dente). Drain the pasta.

Grease an oven dish and thinly cover the bottom with some of the tomato sauce. Fill with half the quantity of the pasta, the diced mozzarella, half of the tomato sauce, half of the cream and cover with half of the grated Parmesan cheese.
Fill the oven dish with another layer of tagliatelle, the remaining mozzarella, the tomato sauce, the cream and cover with Parmesan cheese and some freshly grated nutmeg.
Bake in the oven for about 30 minutes or until the top of the dish is golden. Remove from the oven and leave to cool for a few minutes.
Add a few basil leaves and serve.

name: Tahdiq (Crisped Persian Rice)
attribution: "Tahdiq (Crisped Persian Rice)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tahdiq_(Crisped_Persian_Rice), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Peel and slice the raw potatoes into ½ inch thick slices.
