Rinse and drain rice. Bring 4–5 cups of water to a boil in a 3-quart pot, adding salt if desired. Add rice, and continue to boil the water, stirring occasionally, for about 10 minutes. Check to be sure that the rice doesn't cook completely at this point.
When rice is roughly half cooked, drain into a colander.

Pour ¼ cup of cooking oil into the pot and lay the potato slices in the bottom close together in a single layer. Add a small amount of salt (if desired). Layer the half-cooked, drained rice loosely atop the potatoes.
Place pot on stove over medium high heat for 4–5 minutes or until rice begins to steam.
Lower heat and add 5 tbsp water and 2–3 tbsp oil on top of rice. Cover and let simmer for about ½ hour or until cooked and tender. The higher the heat, the crunchier the tahdig.
Scoop out the rice and use a soft spatula to remove tahdig at bottom, or try to make the contents of the pot come out as an entire cake of rice on the serving dish.

name: Tahini Cookies
attribution: "Tahini Cookies" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tahini_Cookies, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease cookie sheets.
In a medium bowl, stir together the tahini, honey, and cinnamon.
Mix in walnuts and oats until well blended.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto the prepared cookie sheets. Cookies should be about 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are slightly brown.
Cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before removing to wire racks to cool completely.

name: Tahini Goddess Dressing
attribution: "Tahini Goddess Dressing" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tahini_Goddess_Dressing, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: In a blender, combine the oil, water, tahini, vinegar, lemon juice, soy sauce, garlic, and xanthan gum. Blend on high for about 2 minutes. You will see a change in the texture of the mixture as the xanthan gum starts to work, producing a very smooth, creamy appearance.
Add the sesame seeds, parsley, and chives. Blend on low, just until mixed.

name: Tahini Yogurt Sauce
attribution: "Tahini Yogurt Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tahini_Yogurt_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 8 oz (220 g) plain yogurt or soy-based substitute

steps: Add lemon juice to bowl or small food processor.
Add remaining ingredients, and process well to combine.

name: Tahu Gejrot
attribution: "Tahu Gejrot" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tahu_Gejrot, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 12 red or green bird's eye chiles
15 pieces of Sumedang tofu or tofu pong

steps: Grind the chiles, garlic, and shallots together, then set aside.
Combine the palm sugar, tamarind, and water in a saucepan. Boil the mixture until all the ingredients dissolve and form a syrup.
Pour the syrup over the ground chile mixture. Mix well until evenly combined.
Cut the tofu diagonally, then press lightly until the center of the tofu is slightly crushed.
Arrange the tofu on a plate, then drizzle with the spicy and sweet sauce.

name: Tajine bil Samak (Libyan Fish Tajine)
attribution: "Tajine bil Samak (Libyan Fish Tajine)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tajine_bil_Samak_(Libyan_Fish_Tajine), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4–6 fish fillets (such as cod, haddock, or tilapia)
½ teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (adjust according to spice preference)
Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish
Tajine or deep, wide skillet with a lid

steps: Heat the olive oil in the tajine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic. Sauté until the onion becomes translucent and fragrant.
Place the fish fillets in the tajine, and cook for a few minutes on each side until lightly browned. Remove the fish fillets from the tajine or skillet and set them aside.
In the same tajine or skillet, add the diced tomatoes and tomato paste. Stir well to combine.
Add the ground cumin, paprika, cayenne pepper, coriander, salt, and pepper. Mix the spices into the tomato mixture. Pour in the water and stir until the sauce is well combined.
Return the fish fillets to the tajine, nestling them into the sauce.
Cover the tajine with a lid and let the fish simmer in the sauce for about 10–15 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Remove the tajine from the heat.
Sprinkle chopped parsley or cilantro on top for garnish.
Serve the hot, accompanied by rice or bread.

name: Tamil Spice Mix (Milagai Podi)
attribution: "Tamil Spice Mix (Milagai Podi)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tamil_Spice_Mix_(Milagai_Podi), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix all ingredients
Let sit 3 minutes.

name: Tandoori Tofu
attribution: "Tandoori Tofu" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tandoori_Tofu, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 120 ml tomato sauce or tomato paste
2 tablespoons olive oil or canola oil
Preferred seasonings (suggested seasonings: turmeric, pepper, hot sauce, salt)

steps: Cut tofu into 2.5 cm (1-inch) cubes.
Spread out the tofu on a cookie sheet and bake for 20–25 minutes at 170 - 190 C. This releases the extra water from the tofu and dries it out to be able to absorb the marinade.
Mix the spices, tomato sauce, yogurt, and oil in a bowl.
Let the tofu marinate well (about 8 hours) in this mixture, preferably in the refrigerator.
After marinating, thread the tofu onto skewers and grill it.

name: Tangerine Jelly
attribution: "Tangerine Jelly" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tangerine_Jelly, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Cut the tangerines into small pieces, leaving the peel, but removing the seeds.
Add the water, and let sit until the next day.
Boil the mixture until the fruit is very soft.
Add the sugar, and leave cooking until the jelly is firm when dripped on a cold plate.

name: Tangy Fried Shrimp
attribution: "Tangy Fried Shrimp" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tangy_Fried_Shrimp, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Dredge shrimp in the flour, then dip in lemon juice, then dredge in flour again. Set aside.
Heat oil to 375°F. Fry shrimp, 6 at a time, for 2 minutes or until deeply browned and cooked through. Drain on a wire rack and repeat with remaining shrimp.
Once all shrimp have been fried, sprinkle with seasonings and serve.

name: Tangy Lemon Mousse
attribution: "Tangy Lemon Mousse" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tangy_Lemon_Mousse, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup pasteurized egg product, or 2 pasteurized egg yolks, beaten
2 cups heavy cream, whipped to soft peaks

steps: Combine all ingredients except for whipped cream.
Gently fold in the whipped cream.
Refrigerate for 20 minutes and serve.

name: Tanzanian Sweet Fried Spaghetti
attribution: "Tanzanian Sweet Fried Spaghetti" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tanzanian_Sweet_Fried_Spaghetti, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat a few tablespoons of oil in a frying pan.
Add the spaghetti and fry it until golden.
Add the water, sugar, cardamom, salt, and raisins.
Cover the pan and cook until the pasta has absorbed the water, stirring occasionally. If necessary, add more water.
Serve hot.

name: Tapai Ketan (Indonesian Fermented Sticky Rice)
attribution: "Tapai Ketan (Indonesian Fermented Sticky Rice)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tapai_Ketan_(Indonesian_Fermented_Sticky_Rice), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: A couple of drops of pandan paste for color (optional)

steps: Rinse the rice and cook it in the water, unsalted. If adding pandan paste, add it now. The absorption method is usually easiest: bring the water to boiling point with the rice in it, then put the lid on the pot and turn the heat down to lowest possible setting and simmer for 15 minutes.
Allow rice to cool down to about 30°C (86°F). To help it cool down faster, sit the pot in a basin of cold water.
Crumble the cake of ragi tapai over the rice and mix in well.

Loosely pack the mixture into a large jar, cover with a cloth, and set aside in a warm place to ferment (about 30–35°C / 86–95°F). The tapai will ferment over the next 2–4days. After about two days, it should start to show a little liquid at the bottom of the jar, and will start producing a distinctive smell of tapai. At this point, the tapai can be considered complete, although it will taste better after a couple of days kept in the refrigerator.

name: Tapenade
attribution: "Tapenade" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tapenade, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Blend the anchovies, capers and olives. For this a blender is better than the traditional mortar and pestle.
Mix in a few tablespoons olive oil until smooth.
Serve on toast as an amuse-bouche, or with boiled eggs, with goat cheese and roasted peppers, or on potato gnocchi.

name: Tarator (Bulgarian Cucumber Soup)
attribution: "Tarator (Bulgarian Cucumber Soup)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tarator_(Bulgarian_Cucumber_Soup), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1–2 cucumbers, diced (diced is far better than grated, although at many restaurants they grate them)
A couple of spoonfuls chopped dill
A couple of spoonfuls chopped walnuts (optional)

steps: Mix all the ingredients, using enough water so the soup is about the consistency of milk
Serve cold in a soup dish, adding a couple ice cubes if it's not cold.

name: Tarbes Salad
attribution: "Tarbes Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tarbes_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 ripe orange, cut into small pieces
Small chunk of hard blue or Roquefort cheese, diced

steps: Cut the onion into half moons and brown it in a bit of olive oil. Make it nice and crispy. Once it's done, put it aside in a bowl and squirt a bit of lemon juice on it.

As the onion is cooking, wash the lettuce thoroughly. Soak it several times. Nothing is worse than gritty lettuce in a salad. Break the lettuce into bite-size pieces and drop them in your spinner under running water. Once it's washed, spin it until it's dry. Wet lettuce will dilute the dressing.
Once the lettuce is dry, put it in a bowl. Add the onions, walnuts, orange and cheese.
To make the dressing, just mix the ingredients in a jar and give them a good shake.
Toss everything together in a big bowl and serve.

name: Tarhana (Turkish Yogurt Soup)
attribution: "Tarhana (Turkish Yogurt Soup)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tarhana_(Turkish_Yogurt_Soup), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Dissolve the sugar in the tepid water and sprinkle the dried yeast on top. Allow to soften 5 minutes or so and stir.
Blanche, peel, and seed the tomatoes. Peel and roughly chop the onions. Remove the stem, seeds and membrane from the green peppers and cut roughly.
In a blender or food processor, purée the tomatoes, onion, green pepper and yogurt in batches.

Combine all the ingredients except the flour and mix well. Gradually add enough flour to make a stiff dough. Knead for 5–10 minutes until smooth and elastic then place in a large non-reactive bowl and cover with waxed paper (don't use plastic wrap). Let stand at room temperature for 10–12 days. Punch down the dough once a day. If the dough becomes watery, knead in some more flour. Let stand until the dough no longer rises and has lost its stretch.

Rub the dough between your hands onto a tray covered with parchment paper so that it forms small pieces. Cover the tray with cheesecloth or other protective mesh and leave to dry in a cool, well ventilated place. As it dries, break the dough into smaller pieces eventually crumbling it as small as you can. When it is completely dry (a week or more) pulverize in a blender, a little at a time. Store in freezer bags or large jars. Store in a cool place or refrigerate. May be kept up to 12 months.

To make tarhana soup, mix 1 cup of the dried dough mix with 3 cups of water or meat stock. Mix with a wooden spoon until softened. Add more water or stock to make a thickish soup with a creamy consistency. Add 2 tablespoons of tomato paste and cook for 15–20 minutes. Pour into bowls and garnish with croûtons, parsley, or paprika-infused butter or olive oil, if desired.
Serve with Turkish bread or a crisp baguette.

name: Taro Fish
attribution: "Taro Fish" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Taro_Fish, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Peel and chop taro into 1-inch chunks. Steam until soft.
Meanwhile soak black beans in a little water.
Mash taro with the vegetable stock powder.
Place 2 sheets of nori on the bench, moistening one to join them together.
Place the mashed taro mixture in the centre of the sheets and roll the nori sheets over the top.
Cut the nori at one end to resemble fish fins.
Slice green pepper, ginger and spring onions into thin strips and stir fry for a few minutes.
Add the Shaoxing wine and black beans.
Make cuts halfway through the taro fish at about 1 inch intervals and pour the sauce over it.
Serve on a platter.

name: Tarta de Santiago
attribution: "Tarta de Santiago" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tarta_de_Santiago, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¾ cup (150 g) white granulated sugar

steps: Add eggs and sugar to a bowl, and whisk rapidly until mixture turns pale.
Whisk in the citrus zests.
Combine the almond meal, cinnamon, and salt in a separate bowl. Transfer to the egg mixture, and use a rubber spatula to gently fold everything together until well combined.
Butter and flour the springform pan, then pour in the batter. Smooth the top if necessary.
Bake in preheated oven at 360ºF (180ºC) for 40 minutes or until golden brown and fully cooked in the center.
Cool completely, and unmold the cake.
Place a Santiago cross cut-out on top of the cake, then dust generous amount of icing sugar all over cake.
Carefully remove the cross cut-out. Slice and serve.

name: Tartar Sauce
attribution: "Tartar Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tartar_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 ounces (55 ml) sweet pickle relish or finely chopped sweet pickles

steps: Place the mayonnaise in mixing bowl, and whip it until smooth.
Mix in the other ingredients

name: Tarte Tatin
attribution: "Tarte Tatin" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tarte_Tatin, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 5 Golden Delicious apples, peeled, cored and quartered

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Place sugar, butter and water in a stovetop/oven-safe tarte dish over medium-high heat. Cook until mixture becomes golden brown and bubbly.
Remove from heat and allow mixture to cool to room temperature in the tarte dish.
When caramel mixture has cooled, arrange the apple quarters on their sides in the mixture.
Roll the pastry dough out to a thickness of about ½ inch and a diameter large enough to cover the tarte dish.
Place dough on top of the tarte, then trim and discard the edges.
Bake tarte for 40 minutes.
Allow to cool in the tarte dish for 15 minutes before inverting onto a serving platter.

name: Tater Tot Casserole
attribution: "Tater Tot Casserole" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tater_Tot_Casserole, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can cream of mushroom soup or cream of chicken soup

steps: Brown hamburger and drain.
Mix in cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup.
Put mixture in casserole dish and cover the top with one layer of tater tots.
Bake at 350 F for 1 hour or until done.

name: Tea Eggs
attribution: "Tea Eggs" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tea_Eggs, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Bring water and spices to a boil.
Add eggs, and boil for 3 minutes.
Remove eggs from the liquid and roll them gently on a hard surface to crack the shell all over.
Return the eggs to the pot of liquid, reduce to a simmer, and simmer for 1 hour.
Reduce to low heat and allow eggs to sit in brine until served.

name: Tekka (Japanese Root Vegetables in Miso)
attribution: "Tekka (Japanese Root Vegetables in Miso)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tekka_(Japanese_Root_Vegetables_in_Miso), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ⅔ cup chopped greater burdock root

steps: Heat a pan and pour in the sesame oil.
Add the greater burdock root, and stir-fry for a few minutes.
Add the carrots and the lotus root and stir-fry for a few minutes.
Add miso and ginger. Turn down the heat and allow to cook over a low heat for 4 hours.
Stir frequently until all water has evaporated and until the mixture appears dry and dark.
Allow to cool and keep in a glass jar.

name: Tempe Mendoan II
attribution: "Tempe Mendoan II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tempe_Mendoan_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 250 g tempeh, sliced into pieces 10×6×1 cm

steps: Combine the rice flour, tapioca starch, coriander, garlic, galangal, and salt.
Add water little by little until it forms a smooth batter.
Add the sliced green onion.
Warm the cooking oil in a frying pan.
Dip the tempeh into the batter.
Insert the tempeh into the hot oil, and fry it until done.
Take it out from the oil and serve it with small chilies.

name: Tempura
attribution: "Tempura" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tempura, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Oil for deep-frying (peanut oil is best)

steps: Heat oil in a deep pan to 340–350°F (~171–176°C).
Beat the egg in a bowl and add ice cold water. Warmer water will produce a sticky batter and more oily tempura.
Add flour and mix lightly. Do not overmix batter—a few lumps actually improve the result, adding crispiness.
Dip meat or vegetables briefly in the batter, and fry until brown.
Remove from the oil and drain.
Serve hot.

name: Tempura Baked Halibut with Cilantro Aioli
attribution: "Tempura Baked Halibut with Cilantro Aioli" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tempura_Baked_Halibut_with_Cilantro_Aioli, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 pound halibut fillet, portioned into 2 ea. 2-inch chunks.

steps: Whisk the egg in a medium bowl. Add very cold ice water.
Add flour. Mix, but not too much.
Spray a baking pan with nonstick canola cooking spray.
Dip the fish in the batter and place in the prepared pan.
Bake the fish in a 350°F oven for 20 minutes or until slightly golden.
In small bowl, whisk in mayonnaise, olive oil, garlic, cilantro, lemon juice and black pepper for aioli.
Serve and enjoy

name: Tequila Lime Hot Wings
attribution: "Tequila Lime Hot Wings" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tequila_Lime_Hot_Wings, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Sprinkle wingettes with salt and black pepper.
Heat oil to 350°F. Fry wings in batches for 12 minutes. Drain on a rack.
Combine remaining ingredients and boil over high heat until reduced by ⅓.
Toss wings with sauce mixture and serve warm.

name: Teriyaki Grilled Salmon Steaks
attribution: "Teriyaki Grilled Salmon Steaks" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Teriyaki_Grilled_Salmon_Steaks, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Season salmon with pepper.
Combine remaining ingredients to make teriyaki marinade.
Place on hot grill, and cook for 3–4 minutes on each side until flaky. Glaze with teriyaki marinade for the last 2 minutes.
Serve and enjoy.

name: Teriyaki Sauce
attribution: "Teriyaki Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Teriyaki_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix everything in a 1-quart pot over low heat until the sugar dissolves.
Use sauce to marinate some raw meat or vegetables overnight in the refrigerator.

name: Teurgoule (Norman Cinnamon Rice Pudding)
attribution: "Teurgoule (Norman Cinnamon Rice Pudding)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Teurgoule_(Norman_Cinnamon_Rice_Pudding), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat your oven to 150°C (thermostat 2).
Mix the sugar, milk, rice, salt, and cinnamon in a terrine bowl.
Put the mix in the oven for 5 hours while making sure no one opens the oven door.
The rice must absorb approximately three-quarters of the milk and must be covered by a brown skin.
Let the pudding cool down and serve at room temperature.

name: Texas Easy Chili
attribution: "Texas Easy Chili" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Texas_Easy_Chili, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 pounds chuck roast or ground beef, cubed or formed into small meatballs

steps: Cut chuck roast into bite-size pieces or form ground beef into small meatballs (1 inch / 25 mm in size).
Fry beef in cooking oil until outside is browned.
Add minced garlic and cook for 2 minutes.
Combine chili powder, flour, oregano and cumin in bowl and mix well. Sprinkle mixture over cooking beef and stir until beef is well coated with spice mixture. Cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato juice and bullion cubes. Stir for about 15 seconds.
Simmer for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat and add salt and black pepper to taste.

name: Thai Green Curry Paste
attribution: "Thai Green Curry Paste" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Thai_Green_Curry_Paste, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Grind the green chilli peppers, garlic, lemongrass, and scallions in a mortar.
Add the remaining ingredients except for the oil, and keep grinding to a fluid paste.
Mix in the oil.
Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 month.

name: Thai Grilled Chicken I
attribution: "Thai Grilled Chicken I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Thai_Grilled_Chicken_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 tsp (5 ml) Thai chile paste (Sriracha recommended)
4 ea. (24 ounces / 680 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts
A flame-resistant towel tied into a roll with twine and soaked in oil

steps: In a blender, purée the chiles, chile paste, sauces, garlic, ginger, and vinegar until smooth. Pour into a gallon-size zip-top bag and add chicken breasts. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Heat a grill to medium heat. Quickly swab the grill with the towel and add chicken breasts. Cook 4–6 minutes per side or until internal temperature reaches 165°F (75 °C).
Remove to a plate and let rest 5 minutes. Serve warm.

name: Thai Grilled Chicken II
attribution: "Thai Grilled Chicken II" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Thai_Grilled_Chicken_II, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 ¼ pounds (4 ea.) boneless chicken breast halves

steps: Prepare grill. Place chicken in shallow dish.
Combine soy sauce, garlic and pepper flakes in measuring cup. Pour over chicken, turning to coat.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Combine honey and lime juice in small bowl until blended. Set aside.
Place chicken on grid over medium coals. Brush with some marinade remaining in dish. Discard remaining marinade.
Cover, and grill for 5 minutes. Brush chicken with half of honey mixture, turn, and brush with remaining mixture.
Grill until chicken is fully cooked.

name: Thai Lemonade
attribution: "Thai Lemonade" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Thai_Lemonade, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cm piece of ginger, peeled and cut into pieces

steps: Bring the water to a boil with the sugar, lemon grass, and ginger. Boil for 20 minutes.
Allow the syrup to cool, then remove lemongrass and ginger.
Pour the syrup in 4 large glasses, and add the carbonated water.
Garnish glasses with lime discs.

name: Thai Peanut Fried Rice
attribution: "Thai Peanut Fried Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Thai_Peanut_Fried_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tsp golden syrup or corn syrup

steps: Whisk sauce ingredients together in small bowl.
In a pan, heat 1 tbsp oil. Fry eggs, then chop them up and remove from the pan.
In the same pan, heat 2 tbsp oil. Fry the frozen edamame beans for 2–3 minutes until cooked.
Add the rice and sauce and toss. Then, add in the shredded carrot, peanuts, and the eggs and fry for 2–3 more minutes.

name: Thai Peanut Fried Rice (Vegan)
attribution: "Thai Peanut Fried Rice (Vegan)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Thai_Peanut_Fried_Rice_(Vegan), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tsp golden syrup or corn syrup
1 tbsp vegan Thai red curry paste (i.e. Thai Taste brand red curry paste)

steps: Whisk sauce ingredients together in small bowl.
In the same pan, heat 2 tbsp oil on medium heat. Fry the frozen edamame beans for 2–3 minutes until cooked.
Add the rice and sauce and toss. Then add in the shredded carrots and peanuts and fry for 2–3 more minutes. Then serve.

name: Thai Red Curry Paste
attribution: "Thai Red Curry Paste" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Thai_Red_Curry_Paste, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tablespoons freshly chopped cilantro, leaves and stems

steps: Grind the red chiles, garlic, lemongrass, and onion in a mortar.
Add the remaining ingredients except for the oil, and keep grinding to make a fluid paste.
Mix in the oil. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 month.

name: Thalassery Biryani
attribution: "Thalassery Biryani" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Thalassery_Biryani, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 750 g (3 cups) khaima or jeerakasala rice
⅔ leaves Malabar leaf (Indian bay leaf)
¼ tsp kaskas (Indian white poppy seeds)
2-inch piece fresh ginger, grated or cut into small pieces
1 kg chicken, cut into slightly bigger pieces than usually used for curry, soaked 20 minutes in water and washed
¾–1 cup (~1 bunch) coriander leaves, chopped
¾–1 cup (~1 bunch) pudina (mint) leaves, chopped

steps: Wash the rice in water, and drain completely.
Heat the ghee and a small amount of dalda in a kadai. Add the drained rice and fry for a few minutes.
Add water to the rice in a ratio of 1¾:1 water to rice.
Add cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, bay leaf, Indian white poppy seeds, star anise, and lemon juice. Reduce to a simmer, cover the pan, and cook until all the water is absorbed.
Heat the coconut oil and a little ghee in a deep kadai. Add chopped onions, cashew nuts, and sultana raisins, then fry until it caramel in colour. Remove from the heat and set aside.
Heat the chopped tomatoes and a little water in a deep kadai (do not add oil) until the tomatoes are softened.
Add crushed ginger, garlic, chopped green chili, and chopped shallot. Stir until the raw smell fades.
Stir in fennel seeds, cumin seeds, turmeric powder, mace, and red chili powder.
Mix in the chicken. Cover and cook, stirring intermittently to prevent sticking, until almost cooked.
Add ¼ of the fried onion mixture, lemon juice, garam masala powder, chopped coriander leaves, and pudina (mint) leaves. Reduce to a simmer.
Add black pepper powder and yogurt, and cook until the chicken and masala mixture blend together.
Combine the rice, remaining onion mixture, artificial color, saffron milk, and rosewater.
Layer the masala and rice in a dish, and cover with the lid, tightly sealing the lid with a maida dough or dishcloth.
Place hot coals or charcoal on the lid while cooking. The flame need to be in a simmer mode in this stage of preparation.
Serve.

name: Thin Fish Fillets
attribution: "Thin Fish Fillets" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Thin_Fish_Fillets, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 ea. (24 ounces) flounder or other flat fish fillets

steps: At least 20 minutes before you plan to cook, preheat broiler.
Lightly oil bottom of a 9x13-inch ovenproof dish.
Arrange fillets in a single layer in the dish.
Pour in vermouth, using only enough to be about ½ inch deep.
Put pan under broiler and broil the fish as close to the heat as possible for about 2 minutes.
Remove and quickly spread softened butter over the fillets.
Return the pan to the broiler and cook for about 5 minutes more, until fish is just cooked through.
Remove fish from the broiler.
Salt and pepper each fillet and serve it with lemon wedges.

name: Thin Waffles
attribution: "Thin Waffles" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Thin_Waffles, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Rectangular waffle-iron for making thin waffles

steps: Crack the eggs into a mixing bowl, and add the sugar.
Gradually stir the flour into the egg mixture. Then, gradually mix in the melted butter.
Heat the waffle iron according to the manufacturer's directions until it is ready.

Ladle a sufficient amount of batter onto the waffle iron—it should just barely cover the surface. Close the iron, and cook until the waffle is medium-brown (about 2 minutes). Remove the cooked waffle from the iron.
Category:Recipes for waffles
Serve waffles on their own, or use to make waffle cake.

name: Thousand Island Dressing
attribution: "Thousand Island Dressing" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Thousand_Island_Dressing, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a blender, and process till smooth. The goal is to have a pink smooth sauce.
Pour the sauce into a bowl and chill covered in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes prior to use.

name: Three Bean Confetti Salad
attribution: "Three Bean Confetti Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Three_Bean_Confetti_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (15 oz) pinto beans, rinsed and drained
1 can (15 oz) red kidney beans, rinsed and drained
1 can (12 oz) black beans, rinsed and drained
1 can (8¾ oz) whole kernel corn, drained
1 can (14½ oz) diced tomatoes with roasted garlic, undrained
½ cup fat-free Italian salad dressing

steps: In a bowl, mix together beans, corn, tomatoes, Italian salad dressing, Italian seasoning and pepper.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.

name: Three Sisters Soup
attribution: "Three Sisters Soup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Three_Sisters_Soup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cups drained canned white or yellow hominy corn (can be substituted with regular corn)
2 cups trimmed and snapped fresh green beans
2 cups peeled and cubed butternut squash
1½ cups white or yellow potatoes, peeled and diced (for a sweeter variation, you can use sweet potatoes)

steps: In a large pot, combine the hominy, green beans, squash, and potatoes.
Add water and chicken bouillon.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer until the vegetables are soft (approximately 10 minutes).
In a separate pan, melt the butter and whisk in the flour. Stir the mixture into the soup.
Increase heat to medium and cook until the soup thickens (approximately 5 minutes).
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve your delicious three sisters soup. Garnish with fresh herbs or Indigenous spices for added flavor.

name: Timatim Fitfit (Ethiopian Tomato Salad)
attribution: "Timatim Fitfit (Ethiopian Tomato Salad)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Timatim_Fitfit_(Ethiopian_Tomato_Salad), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 jalapeño pepper, seeded and finely chopped (optional, for spice)
Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped, for garnish

steps: In a mixing bowl, combine the diced tomatoes, finely chopped onion, and jalapeño pepper (if using).
In a separate small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, honey or sugar (if using), and a pinch of salt until well combined.
Pour the dressing over the tomato mixture in the mixing bowl and toss gently to coat all the ingredients.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt, if needed. You can also add more lemon juice or honey/sugar according to your preference.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate the salad for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
Before serving, garnish with freshly chopped cilantro or parsley.
Serve the salad chilled as a refreshing side dish or accompaniment to Ethiopian main courses.

name: Tiramisu Mousse
attribution: "Tiramisu Mousse" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tiramisu_Mousse, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup whipping cream, whipped to soft peaks

steps: Combine mascarpone cheese, sugar, espresso, and eggs. Set aside.
Gently fold in the whipped cream.
Chill until set. Before serving, dust with cocoa powder.

name: Tiramisù
attribution: "Tiramisù" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tiramis%C3%B9, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 400 g of lady fingers (savoiardi) (or sponge cake)

steps: Make espresso coffee, and let it cool a bit.
Separate the egg yolks and the whites of two eggs in two bowls.
Beat sugar into the egg yolks.
Beat the mascarpone into the sweetened yolks.
Add two more egg whites to the other two and whip until they form stiff peaks.
Gently fold egg whites into mascarpone mixture.
Quickly dip both sides of the ladyfingers in the espresso.
Layer soaked ladyfingers and mascarpone in a large bowl or pan (start with fingers, finish with mascarpone).
Refrigerate for one hour or two.
Sprinkle unsweetened cocoa powder on top just before to serve.

name: Tirana Fërgesë with Peppers
attribution: "Tirana Fërgesë with Peppers" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tirana_F%C3%ABrges%C3%AB_with_Peppers, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ lb green or red bell peppers
½ lb salted cottage cheese or Greek feta cheese

steps: Peel the skin off the tomatoes and peppers. Sauté them with the olive oil in a saucepan for 5–7 minutes. Set them aside to cool for 15 minutes.
Chop the tomatoes and peppers the way you like.
In another saucepan, melt the butter. Add flour, cottage cheese, and black pepper, salt, and chili pepper to taste. Mix all the ingredients together well, then stir into the vegetable mixture.
Bake vegetable mixture in a preheated 350°F (175°C) oven for 15 minutes.
Remove from oven and serve immediately.

name: Tirana Fërgesë with Veal
attribution: "Tirana Fërgesë with Veal" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tirana_F%C3%ABrges%C3%AB_with_Veal, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ pound salted cottage cheese or Greek feta cheese

steps: In a saucepan, preheat the olive oil. Sauté the meat and onion for 15 minutes.
In another saucepan, melt the butter and add flour, cottage cheese, and black pepper, salt and chili pepper to taste.
Mix all the ingredients together (adding the sautéed meat and onions) in the saucepan.
Bake in a preheated 350 °F oven for 15 minutes.
Take out and serve immediately.

name: Tisane ma Louisa (Algerian Lemon Herb Tea)
attribution: "Tisane ma Louisa (Algerian Lemon Herb Tea)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tisane_ma_Louisa_(Algerian_Lemon_Herb_Tea), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat the water in a saucepan and bring it to a boil.
Add the verbena leaves to the boiling water.
Let the verbena leaves steep in water for about 10 minutes.
Stir the leaves in the water (attempt to crush them as small as possible), then strain out the leaves.
Add the lemon juice and sugar.

name: Toad in the Hole
attribution: "Toad in the Hole" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Toad_in_the_Hole, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Bake the sausages with the oil in a roasting pan for 10 minutes. This cooks the sausages and allows the pan to heat up.
Add batter to the hot pan. The oil should sizzle as the cold batter is added to the pan.

Bake in the oven for about 40–45 minutes. The oven door must not be opened while the batter is baking; once the crust has risen and browned, you can open the oven. The outside should be crispy and the inside should be firm.
Remove and serve hot.

name: Toasted Coconut Flakes
attribution: "Toasted Coconut Flakes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Toasted_Coconut_Flakes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Crack open the coconut, and separate out the coconut meat.
Grate the coconut meat into flakes.
Toss the coconut flakes with sugar and a pinch of salt.
Spread the coconut mixture on a baking sheet, and place on the lowest rack of the oven. Bake at 300˚F, stirring every few minutes until golden brown and crisp.
Remove the coconut flakes and cool completely.

name: Tofu and Couscous
attribution: "Tofu and Couscous" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tofu_and_Couscous, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup fresh red bell peppers, diced

steps: Sauté tofu, red peppers, and raisins together until soft.
Bring the water to a boil, stir in the couscous, cover, remove from the heat, and let rest for 5 minutes until the water is absorbed. Fluff the couscous with a fork.
Combine the tofu mixture with couscous and olive oil. Flavor to taste with curry or other mixed spices.

name: Tofu Bacon (Vegan)
attribution: "Tofu Bacon (Vegan)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tofu_Bacon_(Vegan), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Slice the tofu into thin strips like traditional bacon.
Fry strips in a pan on medium heat, turning once, until crispy and golden brown on each side.
Add soy sauce and one to two drops of liquid smoke, and toss with the tofu bacon slices.
Coat with nutritional yeast, and remove from heat.

name: Tofu in Spiced Coconut Sauce
attribution: "Tofu in Spiced Coconut Sauce" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tofu_in_Spiced_Coconut_Sauce, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 extra-firm or firm tofu block, cut into ¾-inch cubes
¼ cup (or more) slivered almonds, lightly toasted
⅛ cup toasted coconut threads or flakes (optional)

steps: Crack open the cardamom pods. Reserve the seeds; discard the shells.
Heat oil to quite hot but not smoking in a pan. Add spices and bay leaf. Cook until seeds crack (1–2 minutes).
Reduce heat to medium. Add onion and garlic, then cook until tender and translucent.
Reserve onion, garlic, spices to a side dish.
Season tofu with salt and pepper. Fry, adding oil if needed. When tofu is heated through, sauté until lightly brown (5–8 minutes).
Add reserved onion/spice mixture.
Add currants and sauté for 3–5 minutes. At this point, the tofu may be cooled and chilled for re-heating the following day.
Add sour cream, yogurt, coconut milk, and butter. Simmer until sauce has cooked down a little.
Add toasted almonds and toasted coconut.
Serve hot with Saffron Sweet Rice.

name: Tofu Scramble I
attribution: "Tofu Scramble I" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tofu_Scramble_I, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Olive or vegetable oil (or veggie butter)
⅓ block soft tofu, drained for 15 minutes
2 dashes ground turmeric or curry powder
1–3 ea. flour tortillas, or vegan bread (optional)

steps: Heat about 1–2 tablespoons (15–30 g) oil in a saucepan. Add onion, garlic, and sun-dried tomato to pan, then cook until soft and golden.
While that is cooking, mash tofu until it gets an even scrambled texture, and add seasonings as specified or to taste. Mix it all in until evenly distributed.
When onion mix is cooked, add tofu and spinach. Heat through until spinach is soft and wilted looking.
Serve with tortillas like a breakfast burrito or in bread like a breakfast sandwich.

name: Tofu Tamale Pie
attribution: "Tofu Tamale Pie" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tofu_Tamale_Pie, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 ounces tofu, washed, drained well, and broken up
2 teaspoons chili powder or to taste

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In non-stick skillet, add onion, celery, green pepper.
Add instant beef bouillon, tomato juice, and cook until vegetables are tender.
Add tofu, carrot, garlic salt, chili powder.
Simmer a few more minutes.
Add corn meal and mix thoroughly.
Pour into a one quart casserole and top with grated cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes or until browned.

name: Tom Kha Kai
attribution: "Tom Kha Kai" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tom_Kha_Kai, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 4 stalks lemongrass, cut into 1-inch (2.5 cm) pieces or split lengthwise
2 x 1-inch (5 x 2.5 cm) cube galangal, sliced thin
3–4 mini Thai bird chilies, finely chopped

steps: Bring stock and coconut milk to a boil.
Add lemongrass, galangal, chilies, sugar, and pepper.
Add onion, tomato, chicken bits, and mushrooms.
Keep at a rolling boil for 4 minutes.
Remove the pot from the heat.
Stir in lime juice and soy sauce.
Garnish with cilantro and chilies.

name: Tom Yum Gai
attribution: "Tom Yum Gai" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tom_Yum_Gai, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 400 grams (about 1 lb) boneless chicken meat, diced
1 fresh lemongrass stem, cut into short lengths
5–6 hot fresh Thai chilies, just broken with pestle

steps: Place the stock in a pot, add the lemongrass and kaffir lime leaves, and bring to boil over medium heat.
Add the chicken meat, mushroom, fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar; cook slowly and uncovered for 10 minutes. Do not stir.
Add the tomatoes and chilies and cook for 5 more minutes. Remove from heat.
Serve with steamed jasmine rice.

name: Tomato and Onion Salad
attribution: "Tomato and Onion Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tomato_and_Onion_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Mix all salad ingredients together.
In a separate bowl, mix dressing ingredients.
Stir dressing into salad.
Serve with flat bread and feta cheese.

name: Tomato Basil Sausage Pasta
attribution: "Tomato Basil Sausage Pasta" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tomato_Basil_Sausage_Pasta, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ cup (50 g / 2 oz) fresh basil leaves, chopped

steps: Boil the spaghetti in water until al dente.
Meanwhile, cook the sausage meat in a pan over a medium heat for 6 minutes until well browned.
Add the onion, salt, and pepper and cook for a further 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the marinara sauce, milk, and basil, and cook for 2 minutes.
Drain the pasta in a colander and stir into the sauce.
Divide the pasta between 4 plates and serve.

name: Tomato Curry
attribution: "Tomato Curry" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tomato_Curry, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Fry apple and onion in the butter until blended.
Mix curry powder in a little milk, and stir in.
Season with salt and pepper.
Fry tomatoes in a separate pan.
Cover them with the curry mixture, and serve within a wall of boiled rice.

name: Tomato Juice
attribution: "Tomato Juice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tomato_Juice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (12 oz / 340 g) unsalted, canned tomato paste

steps: Add tomato paste, water, vinegar, and black pepper to container.
Shake or stir vigorously.
Serve or store several days in a suitable container in refrigerator.

name: Tomato Ketchup
attribution: "Tomato Ketchup" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tomato_Ketchup, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Bring to a boil and cook for 15 minutes.
Keep refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks, or freeze up to 2 months.

name: Tomato Pasta
attribution: "Tomato Pasta" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tomato_Pasta, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil, more if you like it
2 large garlic cloves, crushed and finely chopped, more if you like it
4 large ripe tomatoes, well-chopped, seeds and skin included (remove the seeds and skin if you like, but it isn't mandatory.)
4 tbsp freshly, finely grated Parmesan-style cheese (Parmigiano Reggiano recommended!)

steps: Cook dry pasta in plenty of salted boiling water for 10–12 minutes. Proper cooking time should be indicated on the pasta box itself. If it's not, taste one pasta piece from time to time, and stop the cooking when it's still crispy but not tough (it should be al dente). Prepare the sauce while the pasta is cooking:

Heat the olive oil gently in a large frying pan or wok. When moderately hot add the garlic and gently fry until lightly coloured only. Avoid overcooking. Add the tomatoes and cook for several minutes, stirring and folding the ingredients. If there is a lot of liquid from the tomatoes, turn up the heat a little and reduce it a bit. Stir in the basil and turn the heat down.

By this time the pasta should be cooked. Turn off the heat to the pasta and use a slotted spoon to transfer the pasta to the sauce in the other pan. Don't worry if a little of the cooking water is transferred—this is a good thing as long as you don't swamp the sauce with it (you could also use a colander to drain the pasta).
Season to taste, stir and transfer to a large pasta bowl for serving. Scatter the cheese over the whole dish, reserving some for the table.

name: Tomato Pasta with Bacon, Onions, and Cheese
attribution: "Tomato Pasta with Bacon, Onions, and Cheese" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tomato_Pasta_with_Bacon,_Onions,_and_Cheese, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ teaspoon–1 tablespoon crushed red pepper

steps: Boil spaghetti for 6 minutes or so, just until al dente. Drain when ready.
As the water for the spaghetti is brought to a boil, start heating olive oil in a medium saucepan and sauté the bacon until the fat is just clear.
Add the onion and sauté until soft.
Add crushed red pepper and cook 2–3 minutes more.
Add the tomato sauce and heat through.
Remove from heat, add Parmesan cheese, and serve immediately over spaghetti. You may garnish with additional Parmesan cheese.

name: Tomato Paste and Ham Sandwiches (Pan Tomaca)
attribution: "Tomato Paste and Ham Sandwiches (Pan Tomaca)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tomato_Paste_and_Ham_Sandwiches_(Pan_Tomaca), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Pa de pagès (Catalan bread) or 1 loaf French bread, sliced

steps: Toast the slices of pa de pagès. If desired, rub garlic on each slice of bread.
Cut the tomatoes in half, and rub the tomato flesh over the surface of the bread until most of the pulp is gone.
Sprinkle with olive oil and a bit of salt, then place a slice of cured ham on top.
Either top each slice with a second slice of bread to make a sandwich, or leave as an open-faced slice.
Peel the tomatoes, removing the seeds if desired.
Use an immersion blender to blend the tomatoes, 1 tbsp olive oil, and salt to taste in an appropriate vessel with an immersion blender.
If desired, toast the bread slices very lightly.
Spread the tomato mixture on one slice of bread, drizzle with olive oil, and top with a slice of cured ham. Repeat with remaining bread slices.
Either top each slice with a second slice of bread to make a sandwich, or leave as an open-faced slice.

name: Tomato Sauce Piquante
attribution: "Tomato Sauce Piquante" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tomato_Sauce_Piquante, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 6 tomatoes, cut up and strained of all their liquid

steps: Cut up the ham, onion, carrot, and celery very finely. Fry them in butter together with the bay leaf, thyme, clove and peppercorns.
Over this pour the vinegar, and when the liquid is all absorbed, add the Chablis and stock, then the tomatoes.
Cook this in a covered stew pan and pass it through a sieve, making sure none of the bay leaf or thyme goes through.
Mix this sauce with an equal quantity of Veloute sauce (No. 2) or Espagnole sauce, (No. 1), let it boil and pass through a sieve again.
Add the castor sugar, the lemon juice, and butter.

name: Tomatoes with Cheese Stuffing
attribution: "Tomatoes with Cheese Stuffing" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tomatoes_with_Cheese_Stuffing, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Select medium-sized tomatoes and hollow out the centers, reserving the pulp.
Mix the crumbs, cheese, salt, pepper, butter, and hot water with the pulp from the centers of the tomatoes.
Fill the tomatoes with this stuffing, place in a pan, and bake in a moderate oven until the tomato can be pierced easily with a fork.
Serve hot.

name: Tonkotsu Ramen
attribution: "Tonkotsu Ramen" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tonkotsu_Ramen, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1½ tbsp fresh grated ginger or 2 tsp prepackaged ginger paste
500 grams all-purpose flour or medium-strength flour

steps: Bring a pot of water to a rolling boil. If desired, use a small thumb tack to prick a pin hole in the base of every egg, then add eggs to the pot. The water should cover the eggs.
Wait for the water to come back to a full boil, then cook for 7–9 minutes. 9 minutes will give you a fully hard boiled egg, while 7 minutes makes a jammier egg.
Drain the pot and eggs and plunge the eggs in ice water to stop the cooking. This also makes the shells a bit easier to peel.

In a small pot, sauté pork, garlic, onions, and ginger until slightly browned. Add soy sauce, cooking alcohol, sugar, and water, and simmer for 10 minutes until pork is cooked through and flavors meld. Remove from stove.

Remove pork to eat separately. Pour everything else into a bowl large enough to hold marinade and eggs. Carefully, peel the eggs, and place in marinade. Try to make sure the marinade covers all of the eggs. If not, try transferring the sauce into a large ziplock bag, and place the eggs in the bag and seal.
Place the bag in a bowl, and put everything in the refrigerator overnight or at least for a few hours.
Using a butcher knife, separate off the pork hock bones.
Rinse well in running water to wash off the blood. Boil in large pot for 15 minutes and make sure you barely cover the bones with the water.
Skim off as much scum/foam as much possible as it forms.
Drain in colander and use a brush to remove any bloody meat.
Use a saw and cut halfway down the center of the bones. Then use hammer to break bone.
The bones will be filled with marrow. Simmer for several hours until the marrow dissolves out from the bones.
Scum will form at the start. Carefully skim the scum off. Maintain a low boil over medium heat.
After scum has stopped forming, simmer for 6 hours or more. Add more water if the water level drops.

2 hours after the pork bones have started simmering, the soup should become progressively white and cloudy. If tasted at this stage, the soup will not taste good since it will still have a raw flavor.
After the soup has simmered for 6 hours, the inside of the bones should be empty and the soup should have a rich smell just like a ramen place.

Brown the meat in a pan and then simmer in a pot for 2 hours in a sauce made from the remaining ingredients. Allow to cool in the pot. The char siu should be a nice amber color. Slice with care since it will be very tender and tend to fall apart.
Mix the flour and kansui together, then add the water. It may feel as if the amount of water is insufficient—this is normal.
Mix in bowl until a mealy consistency is achieved. The dough will be very stiff. Use you body weight to form the dough into a ball.
Transfer to kneading surface and knead. Knead vigorously for 10 minutes. It is okay if the dough cracks or does not knead together well.
Form into ball, cover with plastic wrap and allow to rest in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes. Make sure that the dough does not dry out.

After the dough has rested, roll the dough out with a rolling pin to a thickness of 5 mm and then insert into pasta machine. Start out with the highest thickness and then continue on the lower settings until the desired thickness is achieved. If a pasta machine is not used, roll out the dough to the desired thickness with the rolling pin. Take into account that the noodles will expand 1.3 times when boiled.
The dough will not be that sticky, so a small amount of flour or potato (or corn) starch is sufficient for flouring.
A wooden box is best for storing the noodles, but if one is not available, use a metal tray lined with wax paper (to prevent sticking) and store in the refrigerator.

Bring a pot of water to a boil, and add the noodles. Cook the noodles to each person’s preference, then drain. For people who like curly noodles, firmly squeeze the noodles until the desired effect is achieved.
Warm a large soup bowl, and add the drained noodles. Add broth, then top with char siu and marinated egg. Add salt for flavor—use sparingly at first and then add more if desired.

name: Tortilla Canaria
attribution: "Tortilla Canaria" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tortilla_Canaria, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Sauté the onions and the chopped garlic in olive oil with the parsley and tarragon until the garlic is slightly brown.
Add the tomatoes and salt. Sauté until the tomatoes are tender. Remove from heat.
Make two open omelets from the scrambled eggs.
Place the cooked vegetables into the center of each omelette and fold them over.
Serve hot.

name: Tortilla Española de Patatas
attribution: "Tortilla Española de Patatas" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tortilla_Espa%C3%B1ola_de_Patatas, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 onions, peeled, quartered, and sliced into ⅛–¼-inch slices

steps: Cut the potatoes into thin slices and dab them dry with a dish towel. Heat the olive oil in a pan. Add the potatoes and onions; turn down the heat and stir-fry them for approximately 20 minutes.

Crack the eggs into a bowl, add salt and pepper, and whisk them. As soon as the potatoes and the onions are cooked, drain them off, collecting the oil. Then add the whisked eggs to the potato-onion mix.

Clean the pan and heat 2 tablespoons of the collected oil in it. Put in the egg-potato-onion mix, reduce the heat and fry the mass for approximately 4 minutes. Make sure that the egg mass covers the potatoes, and be careful not to burn the tortilla.

As soon as the bottom of the mass has solidified, and the top jiggles but is not runny, cover the pan with a big plate and turn it over. Then carefully slide the nearly finished tortilla back into the pan (upside down) and cook it for about 4 minutes.
Let it rest for 15 minutes, then the dish is ready to serve.

name: Tostón (Fried Plantains)
attribution: "Tostón (Fried Plantains)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tost%C3%B3n_(Fried_Plantains), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat the oil in a deep fat fryer to 180°C / 350°F.
Slice the plantain very thinly, then fry in the hot oil until golden brown.
Remove from the oil, and when cool enough to handle, sprinkle with salt and flatten each slice with a mallet until very thin.
Reheat the oil until very hot, then fry the flattened plantain slices until crisp and golden on both sides. Drain on absorbent paper.

name: Toum (Lebanese Garlic Sauce)
attribution: "Toum (Lebanese Garlic Sauce)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Toum_(Lebanese_Garlic_Sauce), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 10–40 g fresh, peeled garlic (less for a milder thoum, more for a stronger one)

steps: Use a pestle (traditionally wooden) to smash the garlic with salt until very smooth; you can add the salt at the beginning or after the garlic is well smashed.

Gradually mix in the oil—start by adding one drop at a time and stirring the oil into the garlic with the pestle. After you've added about 1 tbsp of oil and it's been well incorporated, you can drizzle the oil in rather than adding it drop by drop. After half of the oil is added, alternate a bit of lemon juice with a bit of oil. Don't stop for long while mixing; it's necessary to keep stirring, stopping only for very brief periods. When finished the toum will have a similar consistency to thick mayonnaise.

name: Traditional Beef Stroganoff
attribution: "Traditional Beef Stroganoff" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Traditional_Beef_Stroganoff, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ teaspoon (2.5 ml) ground black pepper
6 ounces (150 g) sliced canned mushrooms, drained

steps: Remove any fat and gristle from the roast, and cut into strips ½ inch thick by 2 inches long. Season with ½ teaspoon each of salt and pepper.

In a large skillet over medium heat, melt the butter and brown the beef strips quickly, then push the beef strips off to one side. Add the onions and cook slowly for 3 to 5 minutes, then push to the side with the beef strips.
Stir the flour into the juices on the empty side of the pan. Pour in beef broth and bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Lower the heat and stir in mustard.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour or until the meat is tender.
Five minutes before serving, stir in the mushrooms, sour cream, and white wine. Heat briefly then salt and pepper to taste.

name: Traditional Lasagne
attribution: "Traditional Lasagne" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Traditional_Lasagne, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Heat the olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium high heat until shimmering. Add in ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, until all liquid had evaporated and meat begins to sizzle (10–15 minutes).
Stir in wine, scraping the pot to loosen the fond. Simmer until wine has evaporated.
Add the crushed tomatoes, bring to a simmer, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the béchamel sauce.
Preheat the oven to 375°F/190°C.
Mix the basil, oregano, salt, and pepper into the ragu.

Place a thin layer of ragu in the base of the ovenproof dish and cover with a single layer of pasta sheets. Spread a layer of béchamel sauce over the pasta. Repeat this until you run out of meat, making sure that you have enough béchamel sauce left to cover the top layer of pasta.
Sprinkle grated parmesan over the pasta.
Place the dish in the oven on the top shelf and cook for about 45 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned and the sauce is bubbling.
Serve.

name: Traditional Pie Crust
attribution: "Traditional Pie Crust" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Traditional_Pie_Crust, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Combine the flour and salt.
Add the lard, and cut it into the dry mixture.
Gently mix in just enough water to make a stiff dough.
Roll out the dough in a cool place, and use in your recipe.

name: Traditional Pilau Rice
attribution: "Traditional Pilau Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Traditional_Pilau_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 medium onion or ½ large onion, peeled and finely chopped
250 g minced meat (lamb or mutton are most common, but you could use beef or imitation meat).
400 g tinned chickpeas (240 g drained weight)
1 large tomato, diced, or 1 dozen cherry tomatoes, cut into eighths
Oil (use sunflower oil or a similar vegetable oil without a strong taste) or ghee

steps: Wash the rice in several changes of water and leave it to soak while you prepare the other ingredients, changing the water whenever you have a spare moment.

Chop the onion, and heat the oil or ghee in the saucepan. Add the onion to the pan and fry over a very low heat until caramelized, stirring frequently to prevent them burning. The onions must be browned, not translucent, to get the authentic flavour. This will take at least 15 minutes. If you want to save time, you can do as many Pakistani cooks do and use the ready-fried onions that can be bought in large bags in Asian supermarkets (or in small, expensive pots sold as "crispy salad onions" in English supermarkets). If using ready-fried onions, skip this step and add them when you add the water.

While the onions are browning, prepare the other ingredients (not forgetting to stir the onions occasionally). Bash the garlic in a mortar and pestle with some salt, chop the tomatoes and drain the chickpeas.

When the onions look like they are beginning to brown, add the garlic and any powdered or seed spices. Do not add them earlier than this or they will burn in the long time the onions take to caramelize.

When the onions and garlic are both done, add the tomatoes and stir for a minute or so. This will help to deglaze the pan and seems to stop the onions cooking any more. Turn up the heat and add the mince. If using meat mince, cook until completely browned (5–10 minutes). If using quorn mince, you just need to cook for a couple of minutes until heated through.

While the mince is cooking, drain the washed rice in a sieve and put a kettle of water on to boil. When the mince is cooked, add the drained rice to the pan, along with a little extra oil or ghee if necessary. Stir the rice gently until it is coated in the oil, taking care not to break up the grains.
Add 575 ml hot water, along with the drained chickpeas and any larger spices like bay leaves, cardamom pods or cloves. Add the salt and bring to the boil.
Once boiled, put on a tight-fitting lid and turn the heat to very low. Cook for 25 minutes and do not remove the lid.

After 25 minutes, remove the lid, add the peas, cover with a clean teatowel (optional) and replace the lid. Turn off the heat and leave to rest for 5 minutes; the peas will cook in the residual heat and the teatowel will absorb excess moisture/condensation.
Turn out onto a serving platter (separate large lumps by pressing with the back of a spoon) or plate up. Add any garnishes, and serve with yoghurt.

name: Traditional Pound Cake
attribution: "Traditional Pound Cake" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Traditional_Pound_Cake, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ½ pound assorted dried fruit (currants, sultanas, and raisins, with perhaps a lesser quantity of glacé cherries; optional)

steps: Preheat the oven to 175°C (350°F or Gas Mark 4).
Cream the butter and sugar together until fluffy.
Beat in the eggs and add the vanilla extract.
Gradually sift in the dry ingredients.
Transfer to a greased and floured baking pan.
Bake for 35 minutes or until a skewer inserted shows no moist crumbs when removed.

name: Traditional Tuna Casserole
attribution: "Traditional Tuna Casserole" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Traditional_Tuna_Casserole, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup (240 g) uncooked macaroni, or other short pasta
1 can (10.75 ounces / 305 g) cream of mushroom or cheddar cheese soup

steps: Preheat oven to 350–400°F (180–200°C).
Mix all ingredients, except cheese slices, in a large casserole dish.
Bake for 1 hour, stirring 2 or 3 times.
When macaroni is tender, cover top with cheese slices, and return to oven for 5 minutes to melt.
Assemble all ingredients, except sliced cheese, in large skillet with 1–1½ cups (240–360 ml) hot water.
Bring to boil, and simmer 15 minutes, frequently stirring.
Melt cheese on top before serving.

name: Tri-Colored Autumn Rice Balls
attribution: "Tri-Colored Autumn Rice Balls" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tri-Colored_Autumn_Rice_Balls, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: ¼ cup toasted black sesame seeds, lightly crushed
1 cup smooth Japanese bean paste (koshi-an), chilled
½ cup roasted soybean powder (kinako) or toasted ground pecans

steps: Mix sesame seeds and sugar in a small bowl.
Moisten your hands with water and divide warm rice into 12 equal portions.
Shape 4 portions into balls. Moisten a clean dish towel and squeeze it dry.
Place 2½ tablespoons bean paste on towel; pat into a 4-inch circle.
Place 1 rice ball in the centre of the bean paste circle and use towel to mould bean paste around the rice ball.
Repeat this 3 more times, using another ½ cup of bean paste and the other 3 rice balls.
Place these on a nice serving tray. Flatten the remaining eight rice portions.
Form the remaining bean paste into 8 balls (about 2 teaspoons per ball). Place a bean paste ball in the centre of each piece of flattened rice and shape the rice around it.
Mould these stuffed rice balls into oval shapes. Roll 4 ovals in the sesame-sugar mixture. Roll the other 4 balls in the roasted soybean powder. Add these to the serving tray.

name: Trifle
attribution: "Trifle" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Trifle, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 swiss roll or similar sponge cake
1 packet/sachet fruit-flavoured jelly (can be found under the brand names "Quick-Jel" or "Jell-O")
Hundreds and thousands, sprinkles, or other sweet topping (optional)

steps: Slice the Swiss roll approximately ¾-inch (2 cm) thick, and line the base of a Pyrex casserole dish with it.
Pour sherry over the swiss roll.
Drain the peaches, keeping the juice/syrup aside and then arrange the peaches over the swiss roll.
Prepare the jelly as per the instructions, you may wish to use the syrup from the peaches for this. Pour the jelly into the casserole dish and allow to set in the fridge.
Make the custard, again as per the instructions (use fresh or powdered as opposed to canned). Allow this to cool to lukewarm, and pour into the casserole. Allow this to set in the fridge.
Whip the cream for the top of the trifle and spread it over the custard. Garnish with hundreds and thousands, sprinkles, or other cake decorations.
Serve!

name: Tripes à la mode de Caen (Norman Stewed Tripe)
attribution: "Tripes à la mode de Caen (Norman Stewed Tripe)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tripes_%C3%A0_la_mode_de_Caen_(Norman_Stewed_Tripe), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 calf's foot, boned and cut into pieces

steps: Preheat oven to 300°F.
Mix all of the ingredients together.
Place in a deep casserole or Dutch oven with a tight fitting lid. Then, wrap the casserole completely in foil.
Bake for 10–12 hours. Remove bones before serving.

name: Triple Chocolate Chip Cookies
attribution: "Triple Chocolate Chip Cookies" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Triple_Chocolate_Chip_Cookies, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 110 g (3.9 oz / 1 stick) unsalted butter, plus extra for greasing
180 g (6.3 oz / 1 cup) soft light brown sugar
30 g (1.1 oz / ¼ cup) cocoa powder
60 g (2.1 oz / ¾ cup) white chocolate chips
60 g (2.1 oz / ¾ cup) milk chocolate chips

steps: Preheat the oven to 190 C. Grease 3 baking trays.
Mix the flour, cocoa, bicarbonate of soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and sugar in a mixing bowl until soft and fluffy.
Beat in the egg.
Fold the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients.
Fold the chocolate chips into the dough.
Spoon heaped tablespoons of dough onto the baking trays, well spaced apart.
Bake for 12–15 minutes. If you want a chewy texture, reduce the time to 10 minutes.
Transfer the cookies to wire racks and leave them to cool.
Enjoy!

name: Tropical Sausage Combo
attribution: "Tropical Sausage Combo" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tropical_Sausage_Combo, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: Vegetable confetti (chopped carrots, tomatoes, onions, bell peppers, etc. As many colours as you can get)

steps: Preheat oven to 175°C.
Peel the plantains and smear them with butter. Place on oven tray.
Place sausages on oven rack.
Put tray and rack in oven.
Bake at 170°C for 30–35 minutes.
Chop the vegetables, and douse with olive oil and vinegar.
Serve and sprinkle with black pepper if you so wish.

name: Tubani (Nigerian Corn and Soybean Fritter)
attribution: "Tubani (Nigerian Corn and Soybean Fritter)" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tubani_(Nigerian_Corn_and_Soybean_Fritter), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Blend all the ingredients together, adding water as needed to make a smooth dough.
Mold the dough into your desired shape.
Fry the dough in vegetable oil.

name: Tuna and Herb Salad
attribution: "Tuna and Herb Salad" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tuna_and_Herb_Salad, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (12 oz) water-pack albacore tuna, drained

steps: Combine juice, zest, mustard, hot sauce, and Worcestershire sauce. Slowly stream in olive oil while whisking continuously until oil has been integrated.
Season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Combine remaining ingredients except for cheese. Add dressing and toss to coat. Sprinkle with feta before serving.

name: Tuna Casserole
attribution: "Tuna Casserole" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tuna_Casserole, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can each of cream of celery soup, cream of chicken soup, and cream of mushroom soup (substitute cream of potato if you don't like mushrooms)
1 bag of frozen vegetables (peas, carrots, and corn)
1 can of fried onion rings, 1 packet potato chips, or 1 small packet corn flakes

steps: Cook egg noodles as directed on package. While boiling water, preheat oven to 400°F.
Drain egg noodles. Mix together all ingredients except fried onion rings. Put in a casserole dish or a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake for 20 minutes.
Sprinkle fried onion topping on top of baked casserole. Bake for an additional 3 minutes, or until fried onion is slightly brown.
Let cool for 5 minutes and serve.

name: Tuna Curry
attribution: "Tuna Curry" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tuna_Curry, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 3 tablespoons (45 g / 45 ml) butter or olive oil
100 g (3½ oz) frozen vegetables, such as carrot slices, green beans, or peas
1 can (150 g/5¼ oz) tuna in water, drained

steps: Heat the oil or melt the butter in a saucepan.
Sauté the onion in the butter or olive oil until transparent.
Add the flour and stir until the flour is completely incorporated.
Add the curry powder and stir until it is completely incorporated.
Add the milk and frozen veggies and stir until the mixture gets hot again.
Stir in the tuna.
Salt and pepper to taste. Tuna is naturally salty, so add the tuna before tasting.
Heat thoroughly and serve over rice.

name: Tuna Fried Rice
attribution: "Tuna Fried Rice" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tuna_Fried_Rice, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 cup basmati rice, prepared as a firm and dry pilav
½ cup or more shredded cabbage

steps: Prepare a pilaf-style rice. This should be dry with little fat or excess moisture.
Sauté the onion in 1 tbsp olive oil.
Add the cabbage and bean sprouts.
Stir in red pepper paste and paprika.
Add the cooked rice.
Add the miso and honey, and combine thoroughly.
Add Tabasco if desired.
Mix in the tuna.
Move the rice to one side of the skillet and crack in the eggs.
When they are ready, mix the scrambled eggs in with the rice.
Garnish with katsuobushi and scallions before serving.

name: Tuna Glop
attribution: "Tuna Glop" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tuna_Glop, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 can (10 oz / 300 g) cream of mushroom soup
1 can (6 oz / 170 g) chunk tuna in water
2 cups frozen vegetables, such as peas and carrots

steps: Prepare macaroni according to directions on the package, but without salt. Drain and return to pot.
Add cream of mushroom soup.
Drain tuna and add.
Add frozen vegetables and mix well.
If you prefer crunchy vegetables, heat for 5 minutes over low heat, stirring frequently. Heat longer if you prefer softer vegetables.
Serve topped with crushed potato chips (crisps).

name: Tuna Melt Fishcakes
attribution: "Tuna Melt Fishcakes" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tuna_Melt_Fishcakes, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
steps: Preheat oven to 180ºC before beginning preparation.
In a bowl beat the eggs and mix in well the drained tuna with the ricotta.
Add a little salt and pepper, the lemon zest, basil or parsley, Parmesan and half the bread crumbs.
Distribute a trickle of olive oil in an ovenproof dish.
Work the ingredients well and, with the help of two spoons, form medium-sized balls to be covered in the other half of the breadcrumbs and lay them in the ovenproof dish.
Bake in the oven for 25–30 minutes and serve warm or cold drizzling with lemon juice and accompanied by a green salad.

name: Tuna Noodle Casserole
attribution: "Tuna Noodle Casserole" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tuna_Noodle_Casserole, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 2 cans (drained) or pouches (12 ounces each) tuna
4 cups hot, cooked medium egg noodles
2 cans (21 ounces) condensed cream of mushroom soup
¼–1 teaspoon Texas Pete or other hot sauce (optional)
3–4 ounces cheese, shredded or sliced to cover casserole

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Shred tuna and stir into 3-quart casserole with milk, noodles, peas, and soup. Add onions and hot sauce if desired.
Bake until hot, about 25–30 minutes.
Remove from oven, and top with bread crumbs mixed with butter or with cheese.
Bake another 5 minutes.

name: Tuna Rice Casserole
attribution: "Tuna Rice Casserole" from the Wikibooks Cookbook, https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Tuna_Rice_Casserole, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

ingredients.display: 1 package (10 ounces / 280 g) frozen peas, cooked
1 can (10 ounces / 280 g) cheddar cheese soup

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In large bowl, combine tuna, peas, and rice, and mix well.
In another large bowl, combine cheddar cheese soup and water.
Place soup mixture in bowl with tuna mixture.
Place combined mixture in greased casserole dish.
Bake in a preheated 400°F (200°C) oven for 20 minutes.

name: Tuna Salad
